## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Perintah:

```bash
sed -n '313,333l'
```

berbeda dari `sed -n '313,333p'`.

Opsi `l` membuat karakter tersembunyi terlihat. Contohnya, jika file menggunakan CRLF kita mungkin melihat:

```text
        foreach (\r$
```

sedangkan patch bisa terlihat:

```text
         foreach ($
```

atau kita mungkin menemukan trailing space seperti:

```text
        ) {   $
```

Ini penting karena hasil sebelumnya membuktikan teks yang terlihat sudah sangat dekat dengan patch.

`git check-attr` dan:

```bash
git config --get core.autocrlf
```

akan membantu memastikan bagaimana Git menangani line ending pada repository Windows/Laragon Anda.

Terakhir:

```bash
git apply --check --verbose
```

memberikan diagnostik apply yang lebih detail tetapi **tetap tidak mengubah source**.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Bagian kuncinya:

```bash
awk 'substr($0,1,1) == " " { print substr($0,2) }'
```

Dalam unified diff:

```text
 baris context
+baris tambahan
-baris penghapusan
```

Jadi command tersebut:

1. mengambil **hanya context/preimage**,
2. mengabaikan seluruh additions `+`,
3. menghapus satu karakter marker diff di depan context.

Dengan begitu kita memperoleh persis 21 baris old-side yang diklaim oleh:

```bash
main_root="$(pwd)"

cleanup() {

  git worktree remove --force "$tmp_dir" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT

cp \
  "$main_root/bff-9-2a-canonical-dual-transport-security-locator-v3.patch" \
  "$tmp_dir/v3.patch"

cd "$tmp_dir"

echo
echo "=== RECONSTRUCT DESIRED FILES FROM V3 LOGICAL HUNKS ==="

php <<'PHP'
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

$patchFile = 'v3.patch';

$allowedPaths = [
    'docs/api/openapi.yaml',
    'tests/Feature/OpenApiOperationContractTest.php',
];

$patchLines = file($patchFile);

if ($patchLines === false) {
    fwrite(STDERR, "Unable to read {$patchFile}.\n");
    exit(1);
}

$files = [];
$currentPath = null;
$currentHunk = null;

foreach ($patchLines as $line) {
    if (preg_match(
        '/^diff --git a\/(.+?) b\/(.+)\r?\n?$/',
        $line,
        $matches
    ) === 1) {
        $currentPath = $matches[2];
        $currentHunk = null;

        if (! in_array($currentPath, $allowedPaths, true)) {
            fwrite(
                STDERR,
                "Unexpected path in patch: {$currentPath}\n"
            );
            exit(1);
        }

        $files[$currentPath] ??= [];

        continue;
    }

    if ($currentPath === null) {
        continue;
    }

    if (preg_match(
        '/^@@ -(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? \+\d+(?:,\d+)? @@/',
        $line,
        $matches
    ) === 1) {
        $currentHunk = [
            'old_start' => (int) $matches[1],
            'old_count' => isset($matches[2])
                ? (int) $matches[2]
                : 1,
            'lines' => [],
        ];

        $files[$currentPath][] = $currentHunk;
        $currentHunk = array_key_last($files[$currentPath]);

        continue;
    }

    if ($currentHunk === null) {
        continue;
    }

    $marker = $line[0] ?? '';

    if (
        $marker === ' '
        || $marker === '+'
        || $marker === '-'
        || $marker === '\\'
    ) {
        $files[$currentPath][$currentHunk]['lines'][] = $line;
    }
}

foreach ($allowedPaths as $path) {
    if (! isset($files[$path]) || $files[$path] === []) {
        fwrite(
            STDERR,
            "No hunks found for required path: {$path}\n"
        );
        exit(1);
    }

    $source = file($path);

    if ($source === false) {
        fwrite(
            STDERR,
            "Unable to read source file: {$path}\n"
        );
        exit(1);
    }

    $result = [];
    $cursor = 0;

    foreach ($files[$path] as $hunkIndex => $hunk) {
        $start = $hunk['old_start'] - 1;

        if ($start < $cursor) {
            fwrite(
                STDERR,
                "Overlapping or out-of-order hunk in {$path}.\n"
            );
            exit(1);
        }

        while ($cursor < $start) {
            if (! array_key_exists($cursor, $source)) {
                fwrite(
                    STDERR,
                    "Hunk start exceeds source length in {$path}.\n"
                );
                exit(1);
            }

            $result[] = $source[$cursor];
            $cursor++;
        }

        $oldLinesSeen = 0;

        foreach ($hunk['lines'] as $patchLine) {
            $marker = $patchLine[0] ?? '';

            if ($marker === '\\') {
                continue;
            }

            $content = substr($patchLine, 1);

            if ($marker === '+') {
                $result[] = $content;
                continue;
            }

            if (
                $marker !== ' '
                && $marker !== '-'
            ) {
                fwrite(
                    STDERR,
                    "Unsupported patch marker in {$path}.\n"
                );
                exit(1);
            }

            if (! array_key_exists($cursor, $source)) {
                fwrite(
                    STDERR,
                    "Patch consumes beyond EOF in {$path}.\n"
                );
                exit(1);
            }

            if ($source[$cursor] !== $content) {
                fwrite(
                    STDERR,
                    sprintf(
                        "Preimage mismatch in %s at source line %d.\n",
                        $path,
                        $cursor + 1
                    )
                );

                fwrite(STDERR, "SOURCE: " . $source[$cursor]);
                fwrite(STDERR, "PATCH : " . $content);

                exit(1);
            }

            if ($marker === ' ') {
                $result[] = $content;
            }

            $cursor++;
            $oldLinesSeen++;
        }

        if ($oldLinesSeen !== $hunk['old_count']) {
            fwrite(
                STDERR,
                sprintf(
                    "Old-line count mismatch in %s hunk %d: header=%d parsed=%d.\n",
                    $path,
                    $hunkIndex + 1,
                    $hunk['old_count'],
                    $oldLinesSeen
                )
            );
            exit(1);
        }
    }

    while ($cursor < count($source)) {
        $result[] = $source[$cursor];
        $cursor++;
    }

    $bytes = file_put_contents(
        $path,
        implode('', $result)
    );

    if ($bytes === false) {
        fwrite(
            STDERR,
            "Unable to write reconstructed file: {$path}\n"
        );
        exit(1);
    }

    echo "Reconstructed: {$path}\n";
}
PHP
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Ada beberapa guard penting di sini.

Parser hanya mengizinkan dua file:

```text
docs/api/openapi.yaml
tests/Feature/OpenApiOperationContractTest.php
```

Kalau v3 ternyata memuat file lain, proses langsung berhenti.

Setiap context/deletion dari patch juga divalidasi terhadap source:

```php
if ($source[$cursor] !== $content) {
    exit(1);
}
```

Jadi kita **tidak membabi-buta menulis patch**. Logical preimage harus benar-benar cocok dengan `HEAD`.

Setelah desired state terbentuk di temporary worktree, patch v4 tidak dibuat secara manual. Ini yang terpenting:

```bash
git diff --binary -- ... > ...v4.patch
```

Dengan demikian Git yang menentukan:

- hunk boundaries,
- line counts,
- offsets,
- context,
- index metadata.

Temporary worktree kemudian dibersihkan otomatis oleh:

```bash
trap cleanup EXIT
```

bahkan jika salah satu validation gate gagal.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

`repr(line)` akan memperlihatkan whitespace atau karakter aneh yang tidak terlihat di terminal biasa.

Bagian:

```python
f"U+{ord(char):04X}"
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Step ini sengaja memisahkan tiga hal yang tidak boleh kita campur.

**Pertama, transport dispatch.** Kita perlu membuktikan kapan canonical request masuk ke Browser middleware dan kapan tetap menggunakan canonical Bearer middleware. Tanpa itu, adanya sebuah defensive branch di suatu class belum otomatis berarti error tersebut adalah observable contract endpoint.

**Kedua, status per stable machine code.** Audit pertama hanya membuktikan code-name. Sekarang `-C 12` akan mengambil `ApiErrorResponse::make(...)` lengkap sehingga kita dapat melihat misalnya apakah code tersebut benar-benar `401`, `403`, `422`, atau `503`.

**Ketiga, endpoint-level reachability.** Canonical Browser feature tests memberi bukti bahwa branch tertentu benar-benar dapat dicapai melalui HTTP endpoint, bukan hanya unit/direct middleware invocation.

Prinsipnya sama seperti foundation OpenAPI sebelumnya:

```text
document observable route contract
≠
document every defensive internal branch
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Ada satu keputusan desain penting untuk OpenAPI: ketika satu status mempunyai beberapa stable machine code, kita gunakan schema `oneOf`, bukan memilih satu `$ref` yang menyembunyikan alternatif runtime.

Contoh konseptual untuk tenant-scope `403`:

```yaml
"403":
  description: Authentication or Browser Session context is unavailable or denied.
  content:
    application/json:
      schema:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/components/schemas/AuthenticationContextDeniedError"
          - $ref: "#/components/schemas/BrowserMembershipContextRequiredError"
          - $ref: "#/components/schemas/BrowserMembershipContextDeniedError"
          - $ref: "#/components/schemas/BrowserSessionContextMismatchError"
```

Untuk `/my-memberships`, `401` harus mempertahankan kedua transport:

```yaml
oneOf:
  - AuthenticationRequiredError
  - BrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredError
```

Sedangkan workspace capability `422` harus mempertahankan **dua locator validation domains**:

```text
INVALID_BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_ID
OR
INVALID_ORGANIZATIONAL_ASSIGNMENT_ID
```

Ini penting agar BFF alignment tidak merusak contract Bearer/organizational yang sudah ada demi menambahkan BrowserSession.

```bash
def replace_response_block(
    source: str,
    operation_path: str,
    replacement: str,
) -> str:
    lines = source.splitlines(keepends=True)

    path_marker = f"  {operation_path}:\n"

    matches = [
        index
        for index, line in enumerate(lines)
        if line == path_marker
    ]

    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Expected exactly one path {operation_path!r}, "
            f"found {len(matches)}"
        )

    path_start = matches[0]

    path_end = len(lines)

    for index in range(path_start + 1, len(lines)):
        line = lines[index]

        if (
            line.startswith("  /")
            and line.endswith(":\n")
        ):
            path_end = index
            break

        if line == "components:\n":
            path_end = index
            break

    response_matches = [
        index
        for index in range(path_start, path_end)
        if lines[index] == "      responses:\n"
    ]

    if len(response_matches) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Expected one responses block for {operation_path!r}, "
            f"found {len(response_matches)}"
        )

    response_start = response_matches[0]

    # Responses are intentionally the final operation-level key in each
    # canonical operation. Fail instead of silently deleting later keys.
    for line in lines[response_start + 1:path_end]:
        if (
            line.strip()
            and line.startswith("      ")
            and not line.startswith("        ")
        ):
            raise SystemExit(
                "Unexpected operation-level key after responses for "
                f"{operation_path!r}: {line.rstrip()!r}"
            )

    replacement_lines = replacement.splitlines(
        keepends=True,
    )

    lines[
        response_start:path_end
    ] = replacement_lines

    return "".join(lines)

for operation_path, replacement in response_blocks.items():
    text = replace_response_block(
        text,
        operation_path,
        replacement,
    )

path.write_text(
    text,
    encoding="utf-8",
    newline="\n",
)

print(
    "Aligned response contracts for "
    f"{len(response_blocks)} canonical operations."
)

from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "tests/Feature/OpenApiOperationContractTest.php"
)

text = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

def replace_method(
    source: str,
    method_name: str,
    replacement: str,
) -> str:
    lines = source.splitlines(
        keepends=True,
    )

    signature = (
        f"    public function {method_name}(): void\n"
    )

    matches = [
        index
        for index, line in enumerate(lines)
        if line == signature
    ]

    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Expected exactly one method {method_name!r}, "
            f"found {len(matches)}"
        )

    start = matches[0]
    depth = 0
    opened = False
    end = None

    for index in range(start, len(lines)):
        line = lines[index]

        open_count = line.count("{")
        close_count = line.count("}")

        if open_count > 0:
            opened = True

        depth += open_count
        depth -= close_count

        if opened and depth == 0:
            end = index + 1
            break

    if end is None:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Unable to find end of method {method_name!r}"
        )

    return (
        "".join(lines[:start])
        + replacement
        + "".join(lines[end:])
    )
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Patch ini sengaja mempertahankan empat boundary berbeda.

**User-only `/my-memberships`** mempertahankan Bearer `AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED`, tetapi menambahkan Browser `BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED`, `BROWSER_SESSION_CONTEXT_MISMATCH`, dan `BROWSER_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE`.

**Tenant-scoped canonical reads** memakai satu common `403 oneOf`:

```text
AUTHENTICATION_CONTEXT_DENIED
BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_DENIED
BROWSER_SESSION_CONTEXT_MISMATCH
```

serta Browser-specific:

```text
401 BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
422 INVALID_BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_ID
503 BROWSER_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE
```

Ini sesuai status yang dibuktikan middleware runtime. `bff-9-2b-runtime-error-status-evidence.txt`

**Workspace capability** tidak mengganti organizational contract. Ia menggabungkannya dengan Browser contract:

```text
403
  tenant/browser errors
  + ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
  + ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED

422
  INVALID_BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_ID
  + INVALID_ORGANIZATIONAL_ASSIGNMENT_ID

500
  ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_RESOLUTION_FAILED
  + INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
```

Organizational status tersebut memang berasal dari middleware/controller aktif. `bff-9-2b-runtime-error-status-evidence.txt`

Terakhir, patch dibuat oleh:

```bash
git diff --binary
```

sehingga header, hunk count, offset, dan context dihitung Git sendiri.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Audit ini sengaja membedakan beberapa jenis dependency.

`/api/v1/browser/auth/me` adalah **resource-plane transitional endpoint**, bukan login/logout control plane. Karena canonical `/auth/me` sekarang sudah memakai BrowserSession secara aman, keberadaan keduanya berpotensi menciptakan dua public contracts untuk resource yang sama.

Kita juga mengaudit:

```text
BrowserMembershipLocator
```

karena komponen ini berbeda dengan:

```text
CanonicalBrowserMembershipLocator
```

Saat ini transitional locator bersifat:

```text
required: true
```

sementara canonical locator:

```text
required: false
```

dengan requirement conditional ketika `BrowserSessionAuth` dipakai. Setelah endpoint transitional hilang, sangat mungkin `BrowserMembershipLocator` menjadi orphan dan juga perlu diretire—tetapi kita **belum menyimpulkan itu sebelum audit**.

Hal yang sama berlaku untuk controller transitional. Kalau controller hanya direferensikan oleh `/browser/auth/me`, kemungkinan file tersebut dapat dihapus; kalau ada dependency lain, kita pertahankan.

## Coverage Migration yang Wajib

Ini bagian penting: saya tidak merekomendasikan sekadar menghapus `BrowserAuthenticatedContextTest.php`.

Transitional suite memiliki tujuh behavior tests, termasuk invalid membership locator dan fail-closed saat vault locator mengarah ke canonical membership yang berbeda. `bff-9-3-browser-auth-me-retirement-audit.txt`

Sebagian besar sudah mempunyai padanan canonical:

```text
browser projection safe
→ canonical me accepts BrowserSession

forged Authorization ignored
→ canonical BrowserSession ignores supplied Authorization

membership locator required
→ canonical Browser me requires locator

unknown Membership denied
→ canonical Browser me does not create unknown context
```

Tetapi sebelum transitional suite dihapus, saya ingin **migrasikan dua unique security assertions** ke:

```text
Modules/Auth/Tests/Feature/CanonicalBrowserAuthenticatedContextTest.php
```

yaitu:

```text
1. invalid X-EduCore-Membership-Id
   → 422 INVALID_BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_ID

2. locator maps to credential for different canonical Membership
   → 403 BROWSER_SESSION_CONTEXT_MISMATCH
```

Dengan demikian retirement tidak mengurangi security coverage.

Ini lebih baik daripada sekadar mengganti semua tujuh URL lama menjadi `/api/v1/auth/me`, karena itu akan menciptakan dua test classes yang menduplikasi canonical resource yang sama.

```bash
        \n    \]\)->name\('api\.v1\.browser\.auth\.me'\);
""",

)

def remove_yaml_block(
    source_lines: list[str],
    marker: str,
    sibling_prefix: str,
) -> list[str]:
    matches = [
        index
        for index, line in enumerate(source_lines)
        if line == marker
    ]

    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Expected exactly one YAML marker {marker!r}, "
            f"found {len(matches)}"
        )

    start = matches[0]
    end = len(source_lines)

    for index in range(start + 1, len(source_lines)):
        line = source_lines[index]

        if line.startswith(sibling_prefix):
            end = index
            break

    return source_lines[:start] + source_lines[end:]

def replace_method(
    source: str,
    method_name: str,
    replacement: str,
) -> str:
    lines = source.splitlines(keepends=True)

    signature = (
        f"    public function {method_name}(): void\n"
    )

    matches = [
        index
        for index, line in enumerate(lines)
        if line == signature
    ]

    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Expected exactly one method {method_name!r}, "
            f"found {len(matches)}"
        )

    start = matches[0]
    depth = 0
    opened = False
    end = None

    for index in range(start, len(lines)):
        line = lines[index]

        if "{" in line:
            opened = True

        depth += line.count("{")
        depth -= line.count("}")

        if opened and depth == 0:
            end = index + 1
            break

    if end is None:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Unable to find method end for {method_name!r}"
        )

    return (
        "".join(lines[:start])
        + replacement
        + "".join(lines[end:])
    )

    "test_canonical_browser_membership_locator_is_optional_"
    "while_transitional_locator_remains_required"
)
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Patch generation ini fail-closed pada beberapa boundary penting.

Pertama, transitional route benar-benar dihapus dari `browser.php`, tetapi `AuthenticatedContextController` tidak disentuh karena audit membuktikan controller tersebut tetap menjadi canonical `/api/v1/auth/me` implementation dan punya direct contract test. `bff-9-3-browser-auth-me-retirement-audit.txt`

Kedua, `BrowserAuthenticatedContextTest.php` tidak sekadar dihapus. Dua behavior yang belum mempunyai canonical equivalent dimigrasikan terlebih dahulu:

```text
invalid membership locator
→ 422 INVALID_BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_ID

vault credential points to another canonical Membership
→ 403 BROWSER_SESSION_CONTEXT_MISMATCH
```

Transitional suite memang mengandung kedua security behaviors tersebut. `bff-9-3-browser-auth-me-retirement-audit.txt`

Ketiga, BrowserSwitch verification berpindah ke:

dan login helper mempertahankan encrypted session cookie untuk request canonical berikutnya. Jadi kita menguji canonical resource plane, bukan mempertahankan alias hanya demi test.

```bash
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("docs/api/openapi.yaml")
lines = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
).splitlines(keepends=True)

def indentation(line: str) -> int:
    raw = line.rstrip("\r\n")

    return len(raw) - len(raw.lstrip(" "))

def remove_exact_yaml_block(
    source: list[str],
    marker: str,
    indent: int,
) -> list[str]:
    matches = [
        index
        for index, line in enumerate(source)
        if line.rstrip("\r\n") == marker
    ]

    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Expected exactly one YAML marker {marker!r}, "
            f"found {len(matches)}"
        )

    start = matches[0]
    end = len(source)

    for index in range(start + 1, len(source)):
        line = source[index]

        if not line.strip():
            continue

        if indentation(line) == indent:
            end = index
            break

    return source[:start] + source[end:]

lines = remove_exact_yaml_block(
    lines,
    "  /api/v1/browser/auth/me:",
    2,
)

lines = remove_exact_yaml_block(

    4,
)
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Perbaikannya sengaja mengikuti semantics transitional test yang sebelumnya sudah terbukti:

```text
construct exact mismatched BrowserSession vault state
        ↓
persist with withSession()
        ↓
attach current session cookie
        ↓
canonical middleware detects BrowserSession transport
        ↓
locator chooses membershipId
        ↓
vault returns token for alternateMembershipId
        ↓
canonical context comparison fails closed
        ↓

```

Kita **menghapus pemanggilan login normal** dari test ini karena login justru memasukkan credential valid terlebih dahulu dan membuat fixture mismatch kurang deterministik.

`withCredentials()` + session cookie tetap diperlukan karena `/api/v1/auth/me` bukan route `web`; BrowserSession transport canonical hanya diaktifkan ketika session cookie hadir.

Ini juga menjaga test tetap fokus pada satu invariant:

> BrowserSession vault tidak boleh memetakan locator A ke canonical credential membership B.

```text
static React SPA
+
same-origin Laravel API/BFF
+
CDN/static artifact capable
```

Laravel tidak menjadi React page-rendering runtime untuk authenticated
application flow.

---

# 3. Repository Boundary

Canonical frontend application source:

```text
frontend/
├── index.html
└── src/
    ├── app/
    ├── platform/
    ├── shared/
    └── modules/
```

Existing scaffold:

```text
resources/js/app.js
resources/css/app.css
resources/views/welcome.blade.php
```

must not evolve into a second production frontend architecture.

There must be exactly one frontend application source of truth.

---

# 4. Backend Contract Baseline

Browser control-plane endpoints:

```text
GET  /api/v1/browser/session/csrf
POST /api/v1/browser/auth/login
POST /api/v1/browser/auth/logout
POST /api/v1/browser/user/memberships/{membership_id}/switch
```

Canonical protected resource endpoints:

```text
GET /api/v1/auth/me
GET /api/v1/user/my-memberships
GET /api/v1/user/my-workspaces
GET /api/v1/core/authorization/capabilities
GET /api/v1/core/authorization/workspace-capabilities
```

The retired transitional endpoint:

```text
/api/v1/browser/auth/me
```

MUST NOT be reintroduced.

---

# 5. Security Invariants

The browser MUST NOT:

```text
store canonical bearer credentials
in localStorage
sessionStorage
IndexedDB
Cache Storage
React state
general-purpose global state
```

Authentication authority remains backend-owned.

BrowserSession cookie:

```text
HttpOnly
Secure in production
host-only
SameSite=Strict
```

is handled by the browser and Laravel BFF boundary.

Frontend MUST NOT manually construct canonical bearer Authorization headers.

Browser protected requests may use:

```text
X-EduCore-Membership-Id
```

and workspace-scoped operations may additionally use:

```text
X-EduCore-Organizational-Assignment-Id
```

Both are untrusted locators.

They are NOT authentication or authorization authority.

---

# 6. API Contract Invariants

Canonical contract source:

```text
docs/api/openapi.yaml
```

Generated TypeScript artifacts MUST be derived from this file.

Business modules MUST NOT:

```text
duplicate OpenAPI DTOs
parse canonical API errors independently
use scattered raw fetch calls
manually inject context headers
```

Generated artifacts are consumed behind:

```text
platform/api
```

The generated layer itself is not the application API abstraction.

---

# 7. State Ownership

Canonical ownership:

```text
Server state
→ TanStack Query

Authentication lifecycle
→ platform auth/session runtime

Membership/Tenant selection
→ platform tenancy runtime

Workspace selection
→ platform workspace runtime

Capability projection
→ TanStack Query + platform authorization

Form state
→ local/dedicated form abstraction

Transient UI
→ local React state

Shareable navigation state
→ URL/search params where appropriate
```

Foundation MUST NOT introduce Redux, Zustand, or another general-purpose
global store unless a later ADR explicitly requires it.

One QueryClient exists per running SPA/tab.

Authenticated Query cache MUST NOT be persisted to browser storage.

---

# 8. Context Isolation Invariant

Context-sensitive query identity MUST include the relevant context generation.

Conceptually:

```text
resource
+
session generation
+
membership/tenant when applicable
+
workspace when applicable
+
normalized operation parameters
```

A response from a superseded Tenant or Workspace context MUST NOT mutate
the current interactive UI.

Cancellation alone is not a correctness boundary.

Response fencing/generation validation remains required.

---

# 9. FEI-1 - Frontend Source Boundary & Toolchain

## Objective

Establish one independent, strict TypeScript React application boundary.

## RED Evidence

Before implementation prove:

```text
frontend/ does not exist
React is not installed
TypeScript config does not exist
frontend typecheck script does not exist
frontend production build does not exist
```

## GREEN Requirements

Implementation must establish:

```text
frontend/index.html
frontend/src/main.tsx
frontend/src/app/
frontend/src/platform/
frontend/src/shared/
frontend/src/modules/
```

and tooling for:

```text
TypeScript strict
React JSX
Vite
Tailwind CSS 4
import aliases
typecheck
production build
```

No business feature implementation is permitted in this milestone.

## Tests / Gates

Must prove:

```text
TypeScript strict mode enabled
npm lockfile exists
clean install from lockfile succeeds
typecheck succeeds
production build succeeds
single frontend entry exists
no second active resources/js application exists
```

---

# 10. FEI-2 - OpenAPI Generated Contract

## Objective

Make OpenAPI the compile-time frontend API authority.

## RED Evidence

No generated TypeScript contract currently exists.

## GREEN Requirements

Establish:

```text
OpenAPI generation command
generated contract directory
platform/api generated boundary
contract drift check
```

Generated files MUST be reproducible.

## Tests / Gates

Must prove:

```text
generation succeeds
second generation produces no diff
OpenAPI local refs remain valid
generated contract compiles
manual DTO duplication is absent
```

---

# 11. FEI-3 - Application Bootstrap & Providers

## Objective

Create the minimum application runtime composition root.

## GREEN Requirements

Composition must include only required Foundation providers such as:

```text
React root
QueryClient
router
platform runtime providers
top-level error boundary
```

Provider ownership belongs to:

```text
frontend/src/app
```

Business modules MUST NOT own global platform providers.

## Tests / Gates

Must prove:

```text
application mounts
provider composition is deterministic
QueryClient is created once per SPA runtime
bootstrap failure renders controlled recovery UI
```

---

# 12. FEI-4 - Canonical API & Browser Transport

## Objective

Create one HTTP boundary for EduCore frontend traffic.

## GREEN Requirements

`platform/api` owns:

```text
base URL handling
credentials policy
CSRF bootstrap
Membership locator injection
Workspace locator injection
canonical error normalization
AbortSignal propagation
```

Transport performs no automatic mutation retry.

Business modules MUST NOT call EduCore endpoints using scattered raw fetch.

## Tests / Gates

MSW integration tests must prove:

```text
credentials are included where required
no bearer token is exposed or constructed
Membership locator is injected only when required
Workspace locator is injected only when required
unknown canonical error code remains safe
network failure differs from API failure
cancelled request differs from failure
```

---

# 13. FEI-5 - Authentication & BrowserSession Lifecycle

## Objective

Implement BrowserSession-based authentication without exposing canonical
bearer credentials.

Canonical flow:

```text
CSRF bootstrap
↓
browser login
↓
canonical /auth/me bootstrap
↓
authenticated runtime
```

Logout:

```text
browser logout
↓
clear protected Query cache
↓
reset platform contexts
↓
anonymous runtime
```

## Tests / Gates

Must prove:

```text
successful login never exposes bearer
invalid credentials remain recoverable
/auth/me determines authenticated context
browser reload can restore valid BrowserSession
network failure does not imply logout
logout clears protected frontend state
```

Critical cookie/session behavior must eventually be proven with Playwright
against the real Laravel backend.

---

# 14. FEI-6 - Membership / Tenant Context

## Objective

Implement tab-local Membership selection.

Discovery comes from:

```text
GET /api/v1/user/my-memberships
```

Switch uses:

```text
POST /api/v1/browser/user/memberships/{membership_id}/switch
```

## Tests / Gates

Must prove:

```text
only discovered Memberships can be selected
successful switch produces authoritative context
failed switch preserves previous valid context
Tenant switch invalidates/fences Tenant-sensitive queries
two tabs can hold different Tenant selections
superseded Tenant responses cannot contaminate new context
```

---

# 15. FEI-7 - Workspace / Organizational Context

## Objective

Implement optional organizational Workspace context.

Discovery:

```text
GET /api/v1/user/my-workspaces
```

Tenant context must remain valid without organizational assignment.

## Tests / Gates

Must prove:

```text
workspace selection does not change authentication credential
workspace belongs to current Membership/Tenant context
stale workspace recovers to Tenant-level context
workspace switch fences workspace-sensitive queries
superseded workspace responses cannot mutate current UI
```

---

# 16. FEI-8 - Capability / Authorization Runtime

## Objective

Use backend capability projection for authorization UX.

Canonical source:

```text
GET /api/v1/core/authorization/capabilities

GET /api/v1/core/authorization/workspace-capabilities
```

Authorization decisions MUST use permission capability names.

Role names MUST NOT become runtime frontend authorization authority.

## Tests / Gates

Must prove:

```text
capabilities unresolved
→ protected UI fails closed

permission absent
→ restricted control hidden by default

permission present + business restriction
→ control may be disabled with explanation

backend 403
→ cannot be overridden by frontend state
```

---

# 17. FEI-9 - Router, Shell & Navigation

## Objective

Establish React Router 8 Data Mode and stable authenticated shell.

Canonical router:

```text
createBrowserRouter
```

Route tree is static for a frontend build.

Route existence MUST NOT depend on current permissions.

Business modules contribute lightweight route/navigation contracts.

Heavy module implementation is lazy-loaded.

## Tests / Gates

Must prove:

```text
deep links work
protected routes fail closed while auth unresolved
direct URL authorization is enforced
module routes lazy-load
route IDs are unique
navigation visibility does not mutate router structure
unknown route renders controlled not-found state
```

---

# 18. FEI-10 - Error, Recovery & Observability

## Objective

Provide canonical failure handling and vendor-neutral frontend observability.

Platform must distinguish:

```text
API failure
network failure
contract failure
cancelled request
route failure
lazy chunk failure
```

Human-readable backend messages MUST NOT be used for branching logic.

Observability adapter MUST NOT expose credentials or sensitive context.

## Tests / Gates

Must prove:

```text
401 handling respects operation semantics
403 produces authorization recovery UX
validation errors map to fields safely
unknown errors fail safely
runtime module errors are isolated
sensitive auth data does not enter telemetry
```

---

# 19. FEI-11 - Security & Build Gates

## Objective

Lock frontend supply-chain, browser, and artifact security.

Required gates:

```text
lockfile install
format/lint
TypeScript typecheck
unit/component/integration tests
production build
OpenAPI drift check
dependency audit
bundle regression check
CSP compatibility check
```

Production browser artifact MUST NOT contain secrets.

`VITE_*` configuration is public by definition.

Production source maps MUST NOT be publicly deployed.

---

# 20. FEI-12 - Browser E2E & Final Foundation Gate

## Objective

Prove critical architecture in a real browser against Laravel.

Playwright critical scenarios:

```text
login
reload authenticated session
logout
CSRF rejection
Membership switching
two-tab Tenant isolation
Workspace switching
stale Workspace recovery
capability denial
direct protected route
session invalidation
context race fencing
deep-link refresh
```

MSW tests do not replace these security-sensitive real-backend tests.

---

# 21. Architecture Dependency Rules

Allowed dependency direction:

```text
app
↓
platform / shared / module public contracts

modules
↓
platform
shared
their own internals

platform
↓
shared where domain-neutral

shared
↓
no platform or business-module internals
```

Forbidden examples:

```text
platform → modules/dormitory/internal

shared → platform/auth

modules/dormitory → modules/academic/internal
```

Cross-module dependencies require explicit public contracts.

---

# 22. TDD Completion Rule

A milestone is complete only when all are true:

```text
required RED evidence exists
implementation reaches GREEN
tests are automated where applicable
typecheck passes
production build passes
architecture invariants remain valid
working tree scope is reviewed
milestone commit is isolated
```

Passing manual browser interaction alone is insufficient.

---

# 23. Foundation Final Acceptance

Frontend Foundation may be locked only after proving:

```text
React SPA source boundary is singular
TypeScript strict is enforced
OpenAPI client generation is deterministic
Browser bearer credential never reaches frontend
BrowserSession auth works against real Laravel
Tenant and Workspace cache isolation are proven
context races are fenced
capability authorization fails closed
module route code splitting works
canonical errors are normalized centrally
security/build/contract gates pass
critical Playwright scenarios pass
business modules consume shared platform infrastructure
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Ada beberapa keputusan yang sengaja saya kunci di TDD ini.

Pertama, **FEI-1 hanya membangun toolchain**, bukan login, dashboard, atau UI. Ini menjaga perubahan pertama kecil dan bisa diverifikasi.

Kedua, OpenAPI dipisahkan ke **FEI-2**. Kita jangan mencampur bootstrap React dengan generated contract sekaligus karena kalau build gagal, penyebabnya menjadi sulit dibedakan.

Ketiga, API transport berada sebelum auth. Login nanti tidak boleh membangun `fetch()` sendiri; ia harus memakai infrastructure yang sudah diuji.

Keempat, Tenant dan Workspace dipisahkan. Keduanya punya lifecycle dan cache-isolation semantics berbeda.

Kelima, router/shell baru datang setelah auth/context/authorization runtime tersedia. Dengan urutan ini kita tidak membuat route guards palsu yang kemudian perlu ditulis ulang.

Dan yang penting, tidak ada Redux/Zustand sebagai default foundation. ADR-026 sudah mengunci bahwa platform runtime state dibuat sesuai ownership-nya, bukan dimasukkan ke giant global store.

# FEI-1 - Frontend Source Boundary & Toolchain

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Pada langkah ini kita hanya membangun foundation minimum:

```text
React 19
TypeScript strict
Vite 8
Tailwind 4
frontend/ source boundary
typecheck
production build
```

Belum ada:

```text
React Router
TanStack Query
API client
Auth
Tenant context
Workspace
MSW
Vitest
Playwright
```

Semua itu masuk milestone berikutnya.

React entry akan memakai `createRoot`, sesuai browser root API React modern/React 19. ([React](https://react.dev/reference/react-dom/client/createRoot?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## Struktur Folder & File

Target setelah langkah ini:

```text
educore/
├── frontend/
│   ├── index.html
│   ├── tsconfig.json
│   └── src/
│       ├── main.tsx
│       ├── styles.css
│       ├── app/
│       │   └── App.tsx
│       ├── platform/
│       │   └── .gitkeep
│       ├── shared/
│       │   └── .gitkeep
│       └── modules/
│           └── .gitkeep
│
├── package.json
├── package-lock.json
└── vite.config.js
```

Kita **tidak membuat**:

```text
frontend/package.json
frontend/package-lock.json
```

Jadi dependency graph tetap satu di root repository.

## Kode Lengkap

Jalankan dari root EduCore.

### 1. Install dependency minimum

```bash
npm install \
  react@19 \
  react-dom@19

npm install --save-dev \
  typescript@5 \
  @types/react@19 \
  @types/react-dom@19 \
  @vitejs/plugin-react@6
```

Ini sekaligus akan membuat:

```text
package-lock.json
```

### 2. Update npm scripts

Jalankan:

```bash
npm pkg set \
  scripts.typecheck="tsc --project frontend/tsconfig.json --noEmit"
```

Script existing tetap:

```text
dev   → vite
build → vite build
```

### 3. Buat frontend source boundary

```bash
mkdir -p \
  frontend/src/app \
  frontend/src/platform \
  frontend/src/shared \
  frontend/src/modules
```

### 4. Buat `frontend/index.html`

```bash
cat > frontend/index.html <<'EOF'
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
    <head>
        <meta charset="UTF-8" />
        <meta
            name="viewport"
            content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"
        />
        <meta
            name="description"
            content="EduCore"
        />

        <title>EduCore</title>
    </head>

    <body>
        <div id="root"></div>

        <script
            type="module"
            src="/frontend/src/main.tsx"
        ></script>
    </body>
</html>
EOF
```

### 5. Buat TypeScript strict config

```bash
cat > frontend/tsconfig.json <<'EOF'
{
    "compilerOptions": {
        "target": "ES2022",
        "useDefineForClassFields": true,
        "lib": [
            "ES2022",
            "DOM",
            "DOM.Iterable"
        ],

        "module": "ESNext",
        "moduleResolution": "Bundler",
        "moduleDetection": "force",

        "jsx": "react-jsx",

        "strict": true,
        "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true,
        "exactOptionalPropertyTypes": true,
        "noImplicitOverride": true,

        "allowJs": false,
        "skipLibCheck": true,
        "isolatedModules": true,
        "verbatimModuleSyntax": true,
        "resolveJsonModule": true,
        "noEmit": true,

        "baseUrl": ".",
        "paths": {
            "@/*": [
                "src/*"
            ]
        },

        "types": [
            "vite/client"
        ]
    },
    "include": [
        "src"
    ]
}
EOF
```

### 6. Buat root React application

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/App.tsx <<'EOF'
export function App() {
    return (
        <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100">
            <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-screen max-w-5xl items-center px-6 py-16">
                <section className="space-y-4">
                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400">
                        EduCore
                    </p>

                    <h1 className="text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
                        Frontend Foundation
                    </h1>

                    <p className="max-w-xl text-base leading-7 text-slate-300">
                        React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind are ready.
                    </p>
                </section>
            </div>
        </main>
    );
}
EOF
```

UI ini sengaja minimal. Kita belum membangun design system atau application shell.

### 7. Buat React entry

```bash
cat > frontend/src/main.tsx <<'EOF'
import { StrictMode } from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';

import { App } from '@/app/App';

import './styles.css';

const rootElement = document.getElementById('root');

if (rootElement === null) {
    throw new Error('EduCore frontend root element was not found.');
}

createRoot(rootElement).render(
    <StrictMode>
        <App />
    </StrictMode>,
);
EOF
```

### 8. Buat Tailwind entry

```bash
cat > frontend/src/styles.css <<'EOF'
@import 'tailwindcss';

:root {
    font-family:
        Inter,
        ui-sans-serif,
        system-ui,
        -apple-system,
        BlinkMacSystemFont,
        "Segoe UI",
        sans-serif;

    font-synthesis: none;
    text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

html {
    background: #020617;
}

body {
    min-width: 320px;
    min-height: 100vh;
    margin: 0;
}
EOF
```

Tailwind v4 dengan Vite memang cukup menggunakan `@import 'tailwindcss'` bersama `@tailwindcss/vite`; konfigurasi content klasik tidak diperlukan untuk setup dasar ini. ([Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/docs?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### 9. Buat placeholder architecture directories

```bash
touch \
  frontend/src/platform/.gitkeep \
  frontend/src/shared/.gitkeep \
  frontend/src/modules/.gitkeep
```

### 10. Update `vite.config.js`

Ganti isi penuh file:

```bash
cat > vite.config.js <<'EOF'
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';

import laravel from 'laravel-vite-plugin';
import { bunny } from 'laravel-vite-plugin/fonts';

export default defineConfig({
    plugins: [
        laravel({
            input: [
                'resources/css/app.css',
                'resources/js/app.js',
                'frontend/index.html',
            ],
            refresh: true,
            fonts: [
                bunny('Instrument Sans', {
                    weights: [400, 500, 600],
                }),
            ],
        }),

        react(),

        tailwindcss(),
    ],

    resolve: {
        alias: {
            '@': '/frontend/src',
        },
    },

    server: {
        watch: {
            ignored: [
                '**/storage/framework/views/**',
            ],
        },
    },
});
EOF
```

Kita sengaja **belum menghapus** Laravel entries:

```text
resources/css/app.css
resources/js/app.js
```

karena `welcome.blade.php` masih menggunakan `@vite(...)`.

Yang penting, `resources/js/app.js` tetap kosong dan **tidak menjadi React application**.

Frontend application source tunggal sekarang adalah:

```text
frontend/
```

Laravel-Vite bridge ini masih acceptable selama migration; ADR-020 memang membolehkan integrasi tersebut selama migration/local development. Untuk deployment final, Vite mendukung production build berbasis HTML/static assets, sehingga decoupling output/CDN dapat kita kunci pada build/security milestone nanti. ([vitejs](https://vite.dev/guide/build?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Mengapa tidak langsung React Router?

Karena FEI-1 harus membuktikan:

```text
toolchain works
```

bukan:

```text
application architecture works
```

Router baru masuk setelah build foundation stabil.

### 2. Mengapa satu `package.json`?

Karena ini satu repository dan satu SPA.

Dengan satu dependency graph:

```text
package.json
package-lock.json
node_modules/
```

kita mendapatkan:

- reproducible installation,
- CI sederhana,
- tidak ada versi Vite/Tailwind ganda,
- dependency upgrades lebih mudah.

### 3. Mengapa `strict` ditambah beberapa flag?

`strict: true` adalah baseline.

Saya tambahkan:

```json
"noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true,
"exactOptionalPropertyTypes": true,
"noImplicitOverride": true
```

karena frontend ini akan banyak bekerja dengan:

```text
generated API DTO
permissions
membership context
workspace context
optional API fields
```

Type ambiguity sebaiknya ditangkap saat compile, bukan saat runtime.

### 4. Mengapa `platform/shared/modules` masih kosong?

Karena kita tidak ingin membuat abstractions sebelum ada responsibility-nya.

```text
platform/
```

nantinya untuk:

```text
API
auth
tenant
workspace
authorization
observability
```

```text
shared/
```

untuk domain-neutral reusable code.

```text
modules/
```

untuk fitur seperti:

```text
Dormitory
Academic
HR
...
```

### 5. Mengapa ada runtime guard untuk `#root`?

Ini:

```ts
if (rootElement === null) {
    throw new Error(...);
}
```

lebih baik daripada:

```ts
document.getElementById('root')!
```

karena kita tidak menyembunyikan invariant failure dengan non-null assertion.

# Troubleshooting

### `Cannot find module '@/app/App'`

Jika Vite build lolos tetapi TypeScript gagal, pastikan:

```json
"baseUrl": ".",
"paths": {
    "@/*": ["src/*"]
}
```

ada di `frontend/tsconfig.json`.

### React plugin version conflict

Dengan Vite 8, gunakan:

```text
@vitejs/plugin-react v6
```

karena itu pasangan major yang dirilis bersama Vite 8. ([vitejs](https://vite.dev/blog/announcing-vite8?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### Build gagal pada `frontend/index.html`

Jangan mengubah Laravel backend atau menghapus plugin Laravel dulu. Kirim output build lengkap; kita akan memperbaiki hanya Vite entry configuration.

### `docs/tdd/` tetap muncul

Biarkan dulu:

```text
?? docs/tdd/
```

Itu tidak termasuk scope source FEI-1 dan jangan di-stage bersama frontend.

### Pemisahan tanggung jawabnya

Yang penting bukan sekadar lokasi folder, tetapi boundary-nya:

```text
Laravel Backend
────────────────────────────
app/
Modules/
database/
routes/
config/
tests/

          HTTP / OpenAPI

frontend/
────────────────────────────
React SPA
```

Jadi **kita tidak akan membuat React di dalam `Modules/Auth`, `Modules/User`, atau `Modules/Dormitory`**.

Contohnya:

```text
Modules/Dormitory/
```

adalah backend/domain Dormitory Laravel.

Sedangkan:

```text
frontend/src/modules/dormitory/
```

adalah presentation/frontend Dormitory.

Keduanya berkomunikasi melalui kontrak HTTP canonical:

```text
frontend
    │
    ▼
/api/v1/...
    │
    ▼
Laravel Modules
```

Bukan melalui import source code langsung.

### Satu hal yang juga saya setujui dari struktur Anda

Kita **tidak membuat frontend sebagai Node project kedua** seperti ini:

```text
frontend/
├── package.json       ❌
├── package-lock.json  ❌
└── node_modules/      ❌
```

Sebaliknya:

```text
educore/
├── package.json
├── package-lock.json
├── node_modules/
└── frontend/
```

Jadi repository tetap mempunyai:

```text
1 Composer dependency graph
1 Node dependency graph
1 backend
1 frontend SPA
1 OpenAPI contract
```

Ini lebih sederhana untuk CI/CD dan dependency management.

### Tentang `resources/`

`resources/` **tidak perlu dihapus**.

Laravel masih membutuhkannya untuk hal seperti:

```text
resources/views/
resources/css/
resources/js/
```

tetapi setelah migration selesai:

```text
resources/js/app.js
```

**bukan application frontend utama**.

Source of truth React kita adalah:

```text
frontend/src/
```

Dan nantinya business frontend akan berkembang seperti:

```text
frontend/src/modules/
├── dashboard/
├── academic/
├── dormitory/
├── hr/
├── ppdb/
└── ...
```

sementara shared infrastructure hanya dibuat sekali di:

```text
frontend/src/platform/
```

misalnya auth, API transport, tenant context, workspace context, capability/authorization, dan error handling.

Jadi, **ya—struktur root yang Anda gambarkan adalah arah yang benar**. Saya justru merekomendasikan kita lock struktur ini sebelum melanjutkan FEI-1 GREEN implementation supaya ke depan tidak muncul dua frontend architecture yang paralel.

# FEI-1 - Frontend Source Boundary & Toolchain

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Target GREEN tahap ini:

```text
educore/
├── package.json
├── package-lock.json
├── vite.config.js                  ← Laravel, TIDAK diubah
│
└── frontend/
    ├── index.html
    ├── tsconfig.json
    ├── vite.config.ts
    │
    └── src/
        ├── main.tsx
        ├── styles.css
        │
        ├── app/
        │   └── App.tsx
        │
        ├── platform/
        │   └── .gitkeep
        ├── shared/
        │   └── .gitkeep
        └── modules/
            └── .gitkeep
```

Scope FEI-1 hanya:

```text
React 19
TypeScript strict
Vite 8 React pipeline
Tailwind 4
standalone SPA entry
lockfile
typecheck
production build
```

Belum ada Router, Query, API, Auth, Vitest, MSW, atau Playwright.

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Install dependency React + TypeScript minimum

Jalankan:

```bash
npm install \
  react@^19 \
  react-dom@^19

npm install --save-dev \
  typescript@^5 \
  @types/react@^19 \
  @types/react-dom@^19 \
  @vitejs/plugin-react@^6
```

React 19 menggunakan `createRoot` dari `react-dom/client` untuk client application root. ([React](https://react.dev/reference/react-dom/client/createRoot?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Setelah command ini:

```text
package.json       modified
package-lock.json  created
```

---

## 2. Tambahkan frontend scripts

Jalankan:

```bash
npm pkg set \
  "scripts.frontend:dev=vite --config frontend/vite.config.ts" \
  "scripts.frontend:typecheck=tsc --project frontend/tsconfig.json --noEmit" \
  "scripts.frontend:build=vite build --config frontend/vite.config.ts"
```

Kita **tidak mengganti** existing:

```text
dev
build
```

Jadi nantinya:

```text
npm run dev
→ Laravel Vite pipeline existing

npm run build
→ Laravel production assets existing

npm run frontend:dev
→ React SPA

npm run frontend:typecheck
→ React TypeScript

npm run frontend:build
→ React static production build
```

---

## 3. Buat source directories

```bash
mkdir -p \
  frontend/src/app \
  frontend/src/platform \
  frontend/src/shared \
  frontend/src/modules
```

---

## 4. Buat `frontend/index.html`

```bash
cat > frontend/index.html <<'EOF'
<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
    <head>
        <meta charset="UTF-8" />
        <meta
            name="viewport"
            content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"
        />
        <meta
            name="description"
            content="EduCore education management platform"
        />

        <title>EduCore</title>
    </head>

    <body>
        <div id="root"></div>

        <script
            type="module"
            src="/src/main.tsx"
        ></script>
    </body>
</html>
EOF
```

Perhatikan:

```text
/src/main.tsx
```

bukan:

```text
/frontend/src/main.tsx
```

karena Vite root aplikasi nanti adalah `frontend/`.

---

## 5. Buat `frontend/tsconfig.json`

```bash
cat > frontend/tsconfig.json <<'EOF'
{
    "compilerOptions": {
        "target": "ES2022",
        "useDefineForClassFields": true,
        "lib": [
            "ES2022",
            "DOM",
            "DOM.Iterable"
        ],

        "module": "ESNext",
        "moduleResolution": "Bundler",
        "moduleDetection": "force",

        "jsx": "react-jsx",

        "strict": true,
        "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true,
        "exactOptionalPropertyTypes": true,
        "noImplicitOverride": true,
        "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,

        "allowJs": false,
        "skipLibCheck": true,
        "isolatedModules": true,
        "verbatimModuleSyntax": true,
        "resolveJsonModule": true,
        "noEmit": true,

        "baseUrl": ".",
        "paths": {
            "@/*": [
                "src/*"
            ]
        },

        "types": [
            "vite/client"
        ]
    },

    "include": [
        "src"
    ]
}
EOF
```

Ini adalah strict frontend compiler boundary.

---

## 6. Buat dedicated `frontend/vite.config.ts`

```bash
cat > frontend/vite.config.ts <<'EOF'
import { fileURLToPath, URL } from 'node:url';

import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

const frontendRoot = fileURLToPath(
    new URL('.', import.meta.url),
);

export default defineConfig({
    root: frontendRoot,

    plugins: [
        react(),
        tailwindcss(),
    ],

    resolve: {
        alias: {
            '@': fileURLToPath(
                new URL('./src', import.meta.url),
            ),
        },
    },

    cacheDir: fileURLToPath(
        new URL(
            '../node_modules/.vite/educore-frontend',
            import.meta.url,
        ),
    ),

    build: {
        outDir: 'dist',
        emptyOutDir: true,
    },
});
EOF
```

Poin penting:

```text
root = frontend/
```

sehingga React SPA tidak bergantung pada Laravel resources.

Production build akan menggunakan `frontend/index.html`; itu sesuai model static application Vite. ([vitejs](https://vite.dev/guide/build))

---

## 7. Buat `frontend/src/main.tsx`

```bash
cat > frontend/src/main.tsx <<'EOF'
import { StrictMode } from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';

import { App } from '@/app/App';

import './styles.css';

const rootElement = document.getElementById('root');

if (rootElement === null) {
    throw new Error(
        'EduCore frontend root element was not found.',
    );
}

createRoot(rootElement).render(
    <StrictMode>
        <App />
    </StrictMode>,
);
EOF
```

Tidak menggunakan:

```typescript
document.getElementById('root')!
```

karena kita ingin invariant failure menjadi eksplisit.

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### Backend dan frontend sekarang benar-benar terpisah

Kita mempunyai:

```text
Laravel
vite.config.js
resources/*
       │
       └── Laravel-specific tooling
```

dan:

```text
React
frontend/vite.config.ts
frontend/index.html
frontend/src/*
       │
       └── SPA tooling
```

Tetapi dependency management tetap:

```text
educore/package.json
educore/package-lock.json
educore/node_modules/
```

Ini lebih aman daripada memasukkan React HTML entry ke Laravel Vite plugin.

### Kenapa `frontend/vite.config.ts`?

Karena frontend sekarang merupakan build target mandiri.

Vite sendiri mendukung alternative root dan static production build dari `index.html`. ([vitejs](https://vite.dev/guide/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Artinya nanti CI bisa secara eksplisit mengatakan:

```text
build backend assets
build frontend SPA
```

tanpa mencampurkan source tree.

### Kenapa `frontend/dist`?

Karena untuk FEI-1 kita ingin membuktikan SPA benar-benar dapat menghasilkan static artifact:

```text
frontend/
    src/
       ↓
vite build
       ↓
frontend/dist/
```

Lokasi deployment final CDN/public hosting baru kita lock di deployment/build phase. Jangan mencampurkan source langsung dengan `public/` Laravel sekarang.

### Kenapa belum Router/Query?

Supaya kegagalan FEI-1 hanya punya sedikit kemungkinan:

```text
dependency
TypeScript
React
Vite
Tailwind
```

Bukan 20 library sekaligus.

# Troubleshooting

Jika `frontend:typecheck` gagal, kirim output TypeScript lengkap.

Jika build gagal karena config/root path, **jangan ubah `vite.config.js` Laravel**. Kita hanya perbaiki `frontend/vite.config.ts`.

Jika `@vitejs/plugin-react` menghasilkan dependency conflict, jangan gunakan `--force` atau `--legacy-peer-deps`. Vite 8 memang memiliki plugin-react v6 sebagai major yang dirilis bersamanya. ([vitejs](https://vite.dev/blog/announcing-vite8))

Jika build sukses tetapi Tailwind utility tidak muncul, kirim build output dulu; Tailwind Vite setup saat ini mengikuti integrasi resmi v4. ([Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/docs))

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. `package.json` harus menunjukkan scope minimum

Yang kita harapkan hanya tambahan foundation seperti:

```text
dependencies
├── react
└── react-dom

devDependencies
├── typescript
├── @types/react
├── @types/react-dom
└── @vitejs/plugin-react
```

Existing Vite/Tailwind/Laravel dependencies tetap dipertahankan.

Belum boleh muncul:

```text
react-router
@tanstack/react-query
axios
zustand
redux
vitest
msw
playwright
```

karena itu bukan FEI-1.

### 2. React tidak boleh muncul di Laravel source

Check:

```text
=== REACT SOURCE OUTSIDE FRONTEND ===
```

idealnya kosong.

Itu menjadi evidence awal bahwa:

```text
frontend/
```

adalah satu-satunya React application boundary.

### 3. `dist/` harus invisible bagi Git

Bagian:

```text
=== DIST TRACKING CHECK ===
```

harus kosong.

Production artifact boleh dihasilkan saat build tetapi tidak menjadi tracked source.

### 4. Laravel Vite configuration harus benar-benar untouched

Kita mengharapkan:

```text
=== LARAVEL VITE CONFIG DIFF ===
```

kosong.

Begitu juga:

```text
=== LEGACY RESOURCES DIFF ===
```

kosong.

Artinya kita berhasil menambahkan frontend baru **secara additive** tanpa merusak existing Laravel tooling.

### 5. Kenapa cek `package-lock.json` root?

Karena kita ingin membuktikan:

```text
1 repository
1 package.json
1 package-lock.json
1 node_modules
```

dan bukan tanpa sengaja membuat dependency graph kedua.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Kita memakai:

```bash
printf '%q\n' "$file"
```

karena dua nama file tersebut mempunyai karakter Unicode/private-use yang Git tampilkan sebagai byte escape:

```text
\357\200\272
```

Jadi jangan mencoba:

```bash
rm frontend...
```

dengan mengetik nama Unicode secara manual.

Jika nanti terbukti artifact kosong/tidak relevan, kita akan menghapusnya dengan discovery-based command sehingga tidak bergantung pada encoding filename.

`tsc` dan `vite` juga bukan executable lokal yang seharusnya berada di root project. Binary npm normal berada di:

```text
node_modules/.bin/tsc
node_modules/.bin/vite
```

bukan:

```text
educore/tsc
educore/vite
```

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()

exact_artifacts = [
    root / "tsc",
    root / "vite",
]

for path in exact_artifacts:
    if not path.exists():
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Expected accidental artifact to exist: {path.name!r}"
        )

    if not path.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Refusing to remove non-file artifact: {path.name!r}"
        )

    if path.stat().st_size != 0:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Refusing to remove non-empty artifact: {path.name!r}"
        )

frontend_artifacts = [
    path
    for path in root.iterdir()
    if path.is_file()
    and path.name.startswith("frontend")
]

if len(frontend_artifacts) != 2:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Expected exactly two accidental frontend-named root files, "
        f"found {len(frontend_artifacts)}: "
        f"{[path.name for path in frontend_artifacts]!r}"
    )

for path in frontend_artifacts:
    if path.stat().st_size != 0:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Refusing to remove non-empty artifact: {path.name!r}"
        )

for path in [
    *exact_artifacts,
    *frontend_artifacts,
]:
    print(f"REMOVE {path.name!r}")
    path.unlink()

print("FEI-1_ACCIDENTAL_ARTIFACTS_REMOVED")
```

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Untuk **FEI-2 GREEN**, saya rekomendasikan:

```text
docs/api/openapi.yaml
        ↓
openapi-typescript
        ↓
frontend/src/platform/api/generated/schema.d.ts
        ↓
frontend/src/platform/api/contract.ts
```

Kita pakai **`openapi-typescript` 7.13.0**. Saat ini itu versi terbaru yang dipublikasikan, mendukung OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, dan CLI resminya punya `--check` untuk memastikan generated types tidak drift dari schema. ([npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/openapi-typescript?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Kita **belum memasang `openapi-fetch`**. FEI-2 hanya compile-time contract; HTTP transport baru FEI-4. Ini juga menghindari coupling ke runtime client terlalu dini.

## Struktur Folder & File

Setelah langkah ini:

```text
frontend/src/platform/
└── api/
    ├── index.ts
    ├── contract.ts
    └── generated/
        └── schema.d.ts
```

`frontend/src/platform/.gitkeep` kita hapus karena `platform/` sudah tidak kosong.

File lain yang berubah:

```text
package.json
package-lock.json
```

Canonical schema tetap:

```text
docs/api/openapi.yaml
```

dan **tidak diubah**.

## Kode Lengkap

### 1. Install generator secara exact

```bash
npm install --save-dev --save-exact \
  openapi-typescript@7.13.0
```

Exact pin khusus generator berguna karena perubahan generator bisa mengubah generated source walaupun OpenAPI tidak berubah.

### 2. Tambahkan scripts

```bash
npm pkg set \
  "scripts.frontend:api:generate=openapi-typescript docs/api/openapi.yaml --output frontend/src/platform/api/generated/schema.d.ts" \
  "scripts.frontend:api:check=openapi-typescript docs/api/openapi.yaml --output frontend/src/platform/api/generated/schema.d.ts --check"
```

CLI resmi memang mendukung input YAML + `--output`, serta `--check` untuk memvalidasi generated output masih up-to-date. ([OpenAPI TypeScript](https://openapi-ts.dev/cli))

### 3. Buat API boundary

```bash
mkdir -p \
  frontend/src/platform/api/generated

rm -f \
  frontend/src/platform/.gitkeep
```

### 4. Generate canonical types

```bash
npm run frontend:api:generate
```

Jangan edit manual:

```text
frontend/src/platform/api/generated/schema.d.ts
```

File itu sepenuhnya machine-generated.

### 5. Buat thin contract boundary

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/api/contract.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    components,
    operations,
    paths,
} from './generated/schema';

export type ApiPaths = paths;

export type ApiComponents = components;

export type ApiOperations = operations;
EOF
```

### 6. Buat public API barrel

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/api/index.ts <<'EOF'
export type {
    ApiComponents,
    ApiOperations,
    ApiPaths,
} from './contract';
EOF
```

Business code nantinya diarahkan ke:

```ts
import type {
    ApiOperations,
} from '@/platform/api';
```

bukan langsung ke:

```ts
@/platform/api/generated/schema
```

Dengan begitu generated implementation tetap berada di balik `platform/api`.

---

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

`openapi-typescript` menghasilkan static TypeScript types tanpa menambahkan browser runtime weight. Ia mendukung OpenAPI 3.1 yang digunakan EduCore. ([OpenAPI TypeScript](https://openapi-ts.dev/introduction?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Kita juga tidak menggunakan generator besar yang sekaligus menghasilkan service classes, fetch runtime, React hooks, dan state-management abstraction. Arsitektur yang ingin kita pertahankan adalah:

```text
OpenAPI
   ↓
generated contract
   ↓
platform/api transport       ← FEI-4
   ↓
TanStack Query               ← fase berikut
   ↓
business modules
```

Bukan:

```text
generated tool
   ↓
mengontrol seluruh frontend architecture
```

Karena OpenAPI EduCore memiliki `operationId`, generator juga menghasilkan `operations` type sehingga endpoint tertentu nantinya bisa dirujuk secara compile-time berdasarkan canonical operation identity.

Contoh konseptual nanti:

```ts
type BootstrapOperation =
    ApiOperations['authBootstrapContext'];
```

Kita belum perlu menggunakannya di FEI-2.

## Troubleshooting

Jika generator gagal pada schema, **jangan ubah OpenAPI langsung**. BFF-9 sudah mengunci schema tersebut dengan backend tests; kirim generator error lengkap.

Jika `frontend:api:check` gagal segera setelah generate, itu menunjukkan nondeterminism/config issue dan kita berhenti di FEI-2.

Jika `operations` ternyata tidak diekspor, jangan membuat manual operation map. Kirim bagian atas generated file supaya kita audit output generator.

`docs/tdd/` tetap boleh muncul sebagai untracked dan tetap tidak kita masukkan ke FEI-2.

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Ada beberapa invariant penting yang kita kunci.

### 1. Operation parity

Backend/OpenAPI sudah mengunci:

```text
19 operationId
```

Generated contract juga harus mewakili tepat 19 operations.

```text

19

missing_count=0
```

### 2. Direct generated import hanya boleh dari `contract.ts`

```text

```

expected hanya:

```text

```

Dan:


```text

        ↑
contract.ts
        ↑
index.ts
        ↑
rest of frontend
```

Bukan:

```text
modules/*
app/*
shared/*
    ↓
generated/schema.d.ts
```

### 3. Generator compile-time only

Expected dependency state:

```text
openapi-typescript=7.13.0

openapi-fetch=MISSING
@hey-api/openapi-ts=MISSING
orval=MISSING
axios=MISSING
```

Ini membuktikan FEI-2 tidak diam-diam masuk ke transport implementation.

### 4. Exact pin

Target:

```text
openapi-typescript=7.13.0
```

bukan:

```text
^7.13.0
```

Generator output adalah artifact source yang kita commit, jadi reproducibility lebih penting daripada floating minor upgrade.

Jalankan **hanya corrected operation parity gate** berikut:

```bash
echo "=== FEI-2 CORRECTED GENERATED OPERATION COUNT ==="

python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

generated_path = Path(
    "frontend/src/platform/api/generated/schema.d.ts"
)

openapi_path = Path(
    "docs/api/openapi.yaml"
)

generated = generated_path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

openapi = openapi_path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

interface_match = re.search(
    r"export interface operations \{\n(?P<body>.*)\n\}",
    generated,
    flags=re.DOTALL,
)

if interface_match is None:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Could not locate generated operations interface"
    )

body = interface_match.group("body")

generated_operation_ids = re.findall(
    r"^    ([A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*): \{$",
    body,
    flags=re.MULTILINE,
)

openapi_operation_ids = re.findall(
    r"^\s*operationId:\s*(\S+)\s*$",
    openapi,
    flags=re.MULTILINE,
)

print(
    f"openapi_operation_count="
    f"{len(openapi_operation_ids)}"
)

print(
    f"generated_operation_count="
    f"{len(generated_operation_ids)}"
)

print(
    f"generated_unique_operation_count="
    f"{len(set(generated_operation_ids))}"
)

missing = sorted(
    set(openapi_operation_ids)
    - set(generated_operation_ids)
)

unexpected = sorted(
    set(generated_operation_ids)
    - set(openapi_operation_ids)
)

print(f"missing_count={len(missing)}")

for operation_id in missing:
    print(f"MISSING {operation_id}")

print(
    f"unexpected_count={len(unexpected)}"
)

for operation_id in unexpected:
    print(f"UNEXPECTED {operation_id}")

if len(openapi_operation_ids) != 19:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Expected exactly 19 canonical OpenAPI operations"
    )

if len(generated_operation_ids) != 19:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Expected exactly 19 generated operations"
    )

if len(set(generated_operation_ids)) != 19:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Generated operation IDs are not unique"
    )

if missing:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Generated contract is missing canonical operations"
    )

if unexpected:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Generated contract contains unexpected operations"
    )

print("FEI-2_OPERATION_PARITY_OK")
PY

echo
echo "=== FEI-2 FINAL DIFF CHECK ==="
git diff --check

echo
echo "=== FEI-2 WORKING TREE ==="
git status --short
```

# FEI-3 - Application Bootstrap & Providers - GREEN

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Arsitektur setelah langkah ini:

```text
main.tsx
   │
   ▼
createApplicationRuntime()
   ├── QueryClient
   └── DataRouter
           │
           ▼
     AppBootstrap
       │
       ├── ApplicationErrorBoundary
       │
       └── QueryClientProvider
               │
               └── RouterProvider
```

Kita mengunci:

```text
1 React root
1 QueryClient per SPA runtime
1 static Data Router per SPA runtime
1 top-level render error boundary
controlled route error / 404 state
```

Belum ada:

```text
API transport
auth
BrowserSession bootstrap
tenant
workspace
authorization
route guards
loaders/actions
```

Tidak perlu `react-router-dom` untuk arsitektur v8 baru; API umum datang dari `react-router`, sedangkan DOM-specific `RouterProvider` berasal dari `react-router/dom`. ([React Router](https://reactrouter.com/changelog?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 7. Buat static Data Router factory

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/router.tsx <<'EOF'
import {
    createBrowserRouter,
    type RouteObject,
} from 'react-router';

import { App } from '@/app/App';
import { NotFoundPage } from '@/app/NotFoundPage';
import { RouteErrorPage } from '@/app/RouteErrorPage';

const routes = [
    {
        id: 'root',
        path: '/',
        Component: App,
        ErrorBoundary: RouteErrorPage,
    },
    {
        id: 'not-found',
        path: '*',
        Component: NotFoundPage,
    },
] satisfies RouteObject[];

export function createAppRouter() {
    return createBrowserRouter(routes);
}
EOF
```

Route tree adalah **static configuration**. Kita tidak membuat route berdasarkan permission atau auth state.

React Router Data Mode memang menggunakan Route Objects dengan `createBrowserRouter`. ([React Router](https://reactrouter.com/start/data/route-object?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 8. Buat application runtime

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/runtime.ts <<'EOF'
import { createAppQueryClient } from '@/app/query-client';
import { createAppRouter } from '@/app/router';

export interface ApplicationRuntime {
    queryClient: ReturnType<typeof createAppQueryClient>;
    router: ReturnType<typeof createAppRouter>;
}

export function createApplicationRuntime(): ApplicationRuntime {
    return {
        queryClient: createAppQueryClient(),
        router: createAppRouter(),
    };
}
EOF
```

Ini penting untuk testability.

Kita **tidak membuat global mutable singleton** tersembunyi.

`main.tsx` nanti membuat satu runtime untuk satu SPA execution.

## 9. Buat top-level Error Boundary

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/ApplicationErrorBoundary.tsx <<'EOF'
import {
    Component,
    type ErrorInfo,
    type ReactNode,
} from 'react';

interface ApplicationErrorBoundaryProps {
    children: ReactNode;
}

interface ApplicationErrorBoundaryState {
    hasError: boolean;
}

export class ApplicationErrorBoundary extends Component<
    ApplicationErrorBoundaryProps,
    ApplicationErrorBoundaryState
> {
    public state: ApplicationErrorBoundaryState = {
        hasError: false,
    };

    public static getDerivedStateFromError(): ApplicationErrorBoundaryState {
        return {
            hasError: true,
        };
    }

    public componentDidCatch(
        _error: unknown,
        errorInfo: ErrorInfo,
    ): void {
        console.error(
            'EduCore application render failed.',
            {
                componentStack: errorInfo.componentStack,
            },
        );
    }

    public render(): ReactNode {
        if (this.state.hasError) {
            return (
                <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100">
                    <section className="mx-auto flex min-h-screen max-w-3xl items-center px-6 py-16">
                        <div className="space-y-4">
                            <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-rose-300">
                                EduCore
                            </p>

                            <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
                                Aplikasi tidak dapat dimuat
                            </h1>

                            <p className="max-w-xl leading-7 text-slate-300">
                                Terjadi kegagalan pada aplikasi.
                                Silakan muat ulang halaman.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </section>
                </main>
            );
        }

        return this.props.children;
    }
}
EOF
```

Raw error object tidak dikirim ke console. Kita hanya log generic event + React component stack. Observability adapter yang sebenarnya baru FEI-10.

## 10. Buat provider composition root

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/AppBootstrap.tsx <<'EOF'
import { QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { RouterProvider } from 'react-router/dom';

import { ApplicationErrorBoundary } from '@/app/ApplicationErrorBoundary';
import type { ApplicationRuntime } from '@/app/runtime';

interface AppBootstrapProps {
    runtime: ApplicationRuntime;
}

export function AppBootstrap({
    runtime,
}: AppBootstrapProps) {
    return (
        <ApplicationErrorBoundary>
            <QueryClientProvider client={runtime.queryClient}>
                <RouterProvider router={runtime.router} />
            </QueryClientProvider>
        </ApplicationErrorBoundary>
    );
}
EOF
```

Composition ownership sekarang berada di:

```text
frontend/src/app/
```

bukan business modules.

## 11. Ganti `main.tsx`

```bash
cat > frontend/src/main.tsx <<'EOF'
import { StrictMode } from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';

import { AppBootstrap } from '@/app/AppBootstrap';
import { createApplicationRuntime } from '@/app/runtime';

import './styles.css';

const rootElement = document.getElementById('root');

if (rootElement === null) {
    throw new Error(
        'EduCore frontend root element was not found.',
    );
}

const runtime = createApplicationRuntime();

createRoot(rootElement).render(
    <StrictMode>
        <AppBootstrap runtime={runtime} />
    </StrictMode>,
);
EOF
```

Perhatikan:

```ts
const runtime = createApplicationRuntime();
```

berada **di luar React render function**.

Jadi Strict Mode render ulang tidak membuat QueryClient/router baru.

Ini juga sejalan dengan panduan React Router bahwa router instance sebaiknya dibuat di luar React render tree. ([React Router](https://reactrouter.com/api/data-routers/RouterProvider?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```bash
    describe,
```

```bash
        consoleError.mockRestore();
    });
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### QueryClient tidak dibuat di component

Hindari:

```tsx
function App() {
    const queryClient = new QueryClient(); // ❌
}
```

Karena re-render berpotensi membangun cache baru.

Kita punya:

```text
main
↓
createApplicationRuntime
↓
QueryClient
```

satu kali per SPA runtime.

TanStack sendiri mendokumentasikan `QueryClientProvider` sebagai boundary yang menyediakan QueryClient ke aplikasi. ([TanStack](https://tanstack.com/query/latest/docs/framework/react/reference/QueryClientProvider?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### Router juga tidak dibuat saat render

Hindari:

```tsx
function App() {
    const router = createBrowserRouter(...); // ❌
}
```

React Router secara eksplisit menyarankan single router instance dibuat di luar React tree. ([React Router](https://reactrouter.com/api/data-routers/RouterProvider?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### `App.tsx` sekarang adalah route component

Ia **bukan composition root lagi**.

Separation:

```text
main.tsx
→ browser mount

runtime.ts
→ runtime instances

AppBootstrap.tsx
→ provider composition

router.tsx
→ route topology

App.tsx
→ page/UI
```

Ini jauh lebih maintainable daripada satu `App.tsx` raksasa.

### Error boundary tidak membocorkan exception

UI hanya menampilkan recovery message.

Raw exception tidak ditampilkan dan tidak dikirim ke logging sink.

# Troubleshooting

Jika install React Router v8 gagal peer-dependency, jangan gunakan `--force`. Kirim npm error lengkap. React Router v8 memang merupakan current official major dan dokumentasinya menyebutnya non-breaking upgrade dari v7. ([React Router](https://reactrouter.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Jika `RouterProvider` import gagal, pastikan persis:

```ts
import { RouterProvider } from 'react-router/dom';
```

bukan legacy:

```ts
react-router-dom
```

untuk v8. ([React Router](https://reactrouter.com/changelog?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Jika test error boundary menampilkan React console noise tetapi test PASS, jangan mengubah production boundary dulu; kirim outputnya agar kita bedakan expected React diagnostic dari real failure.

```bash
import {
    Component,
    type ErrorInfo,
    type ReactNode,
} from 'react';

interface ApplicationErrorBoundaryProps {
    children: ReactNode;
}

interface ApplicationErrorBoundaryState {
    hasError: boolean;
}

export class ApplicationErrorBoundary extends Component<
    ApplicationErrorBoundaryProps,
    ApplicationErrorBoundaryState
> {
    public override state: ApplicationErrorBoundaryState = {
        hasError: false,
    };

    public static getDerivedStateFromError(): ApplicationErrorBoundaryState {
        return {
            hasError: true,
        };
    }

    public override componentDidCatch(
        _error: unknown,
        errorInfo: ErrorInfo,
    ): void {
        console.error(
            'EduCore application render failed.',
            {
                componentStack: errorInfo.componentStack,
            },
        );
    }

    public override render(): ReactNode {
        if (this.state.hasError) {
            return (
                <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100">
                    <section className="mx-auto flex min-h-screen max-w-3xl items-center px-6 py-16">
                        <div className="space-y-4">

                                Terjadi kegagalan pada aplikasi.
                                Silakan muat ulang halaman.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </section>
                </main>
            );
        }

        return this.props.children;
    }
}
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

`override` bukan kosmetik. Dengan:

```json
"noImplicitOverride": true
```

TypeScript memaksa developer menyatakan secara eksplisit bahwa method/property tersebut berasal dari parent class.

Contohnya:

```ts
public override render(): ReactNode
```

memberi compiler kemampuan mendeteksi jika suatu hari API parent berubah dan method kita tidak lagi benar-benar meng-override sesuatu.

Ini sangat berguna untuk class component yang memang masih diperlukan untuk React Error Boundary.

Kita **tidak mematikan**:

```json
"noImplicitOverride": true
```

hanya supaya compiler hijau. Itu akan melemahkan strict baseline FEI-1.

import {

} from 'node:url';

import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config';

const frontendRoot = fileURLToPath(

);

export default defineConfig({

        clearMocks: true,
        restoreMocks: true,

```bash
});
EOF
```

Kita sengaja **tidak menggunakan**:

meskipun itu dapat menghindari temporary config file, karena dokumentasi Vitest saat ini masih menyebut mode `runner` experimental. ([Vitest](https://vitest.dev/guide/cli))

```ts
root: frontendRoot
```

maka:

```text

src/test/setup.ts
```

tetap dipahami relatif terhadap frontend.

Sementara:

```ts

```

membuat cache dependency/test tetap berada pada tooling root.

Vite sendiri memang menggunakan `node_modules/.vite-temp` saat config loader default membundle config sebelum memuatnya. ([vitejs](https://vite.dev/config/)) Dengan config tooling sekarang berada di root, temporary tooling juga tidak perlu membentuk `frontend/node_modules`.
