# Automated Tests

## 5. State-machine tests

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/auth/__tests__/state.test.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    browserAuthReducer,
    createInitialBrowserAuthState,
    type AuthenticatedBootstrapData,
    type BrowserAuthState,
} from '@/platform/auth';
import type {
    BrowserApiResponseFailure,
} from '@/platform/api';

const loginContext = {
    membership_id:
        '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab',
    tenant_id:
        '018f3b6a-7c20-7def-9abc-1234567890ab',
};

const identity: AuthenticatedBootstrapData = {
    user: {
        id:
            '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab',
        email:
            'member@example.com',
    },
    person: {
        id:
            '018f3b6a-7c20-7bcd-8def-1234567890ab',
        name:
            'EduCore Member',
    },
    membership: {
        id:
            '018f3b6a-7c20-7cde-8def-1234567890ab',
        status:
            'ACTIVE',
    },
    tenant: {
        id:
            '018f3b6a-7c20-7def-8abc-1234567890ab',
        name:
            'EduCore School',
        subdomain:
            'school',
    },
};

const authenticationRequiredFailure:
    BrowserApiResponseFailure = {
        ok: false,
        kind: 'response',
        status: 401,
        error: {
            status: 'error',
            code:
                'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED',
            message:
                'Browser session authentication is required.',
        },
    };

const contextRequiredFailure:
    BrowserApiResponseFailure = {
        ok: false,
        kind: 'response',
        status: 403,
        error: {
            status: 'error',
            code:
                'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
            message:
                'Browser Membership context is required.',
        },
    };

describe('browserAuthReducer', () => {
    it('starts with unknown authentication truth', () => {
        expect(
            createInitialBrowserAuthState(),
        ).toEqual({
            status: 'unknown',
        });
    });

    it('models the login-to-context-resolution flow', () => {
        let state: BrowserAuthState = {
            status: 'anonymous',
            failure: null,
        };

        state = browserAuthReducer(
            state,
            {
                type: 'LOGIN_STARTED',
            },
        );

        expect(state).toEqual({
            status: 'authenticating',
        });

        state = browserAuthReducer(
            state,
            {
                type: 'LOGIN_ACCEPTED',
                login: loginContext,
            },
        );

        expect(state).toEqual({
            status: 'resolving-context',
            login: loginContext,
        });

        state = browserAuthReducer(
            state,
            {
                type:
                    'BECAME_AUTHENTICATED',
                identity,
            },
        );

        expect(state).toEqual({
            status: 'authenticated',
            identity,
        });
    });

    it('keeps membership-context-required distinct from anonymous', () => {
        const state =
            browserAuthReducer(
                createInitialBrowserAuthState(),
                {
                    type:
                        'CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
                    failure:
                        contextRequiredFailure,
                },
            );

        expect(state.status).toBe(
            'membership-context-required',
        );

        expect(state).not.toEqual({
            status: 'anonymous',
            failure:
                contextRequiredFailure,
        });
    });

    it('models authenticated logout without losing identity before completion', () => {
        let state: BrowserAuthState = {
            status: 'authenticated',
            identity,
        };

        state = browserAuthReducer(
            state,
            {
                type: 'LOGOUT_STARTED',
            },
        );

        expect(state).toEqual({
            status: 'logging-out',
            identity,
        });

        state = browserAuthReducer(
            state,
            {
                type:
                    'LOGOUT_COMPLETED',
            },
        );

        expect(state).toEqual({
            status: 'anonymous',
            failure: null,
        });
    });

    it('models session expiry as anonymous instead of unavailable', () => {
        const state =
            browserAuthReducer(
                {
                    status:
                        'authenticated',
                    identity,
                },
                {
                    type:
                        'SESSION_EXPIRED',
                    failure:
                        authenticationRequiredFailure,
                },
            );

        expect(state).toEqual({
            status: 'anonymous',
            failure:
                authenticationRequiredFailure,
        });
    });

    it('fails closed on invalid authentication transitions', () => {
        expect(() => {
            browserAuthReducer(
                {
                    status:
                        'authenticated',
                    identity,
                },
                {
                    type: 'LOGIN_STARTED',
                },
            );
        }).toThrow(
            'Invalid EduCore BrowserAuth transition: authenticated -> LOGIN_STARTED',
        );
    });
});
EOF
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Login success bukan authenticated identity

Contract login hanya memberi:

```text
membership_id
tenant_id
```

sedangkan `/auth/me` memberi:

```text
user
person
membership
tenant
```

Jadi state tidak langsung:

```text
LOGIN_ACCEPTED
→ authenticated   ❌
```

melainkan:

```text
LOGIN_ACCEPTED
→ resolving-context
→ /auth/me
→ authenticated
```

Ini mengikuti contract backend apa adanya. `Pasted text.txt`

### 2. `membership-context-required` bukan anonymous

Ini sangat penting untuk FEI-6.

```text
anonymous
```

berarti browser tidak memiliki authenticated BrowserSession.

Sedangkan:

```text
membership-context-required
```

berarti session/authentication bisa saja valid tetapi canonical Membership context belum dapat diselesaikan.

Menyatukan keduanya akan menyebabkan frontend salah redirect ke login padahal yang sebenarnya dibutuhkan adalah pemilihan membership.

### 3. Identity tetap generated

Kita tidak menulis ulang:

```ts
interface User
interface Person
interface Membership
interface Tenant
```

Semua berasal dari:

```ts
AuthenticatedBootstrapData
```

yang dihasilkan OpenAPI. Contract menunjukkan bootstrap data memang terdiri dari `user`, `person`, `membership`, dan `tenant`. `Pasted text.txt`

### 4. Tidak ada token state

State tidak memiliki field seperti:

```text
accessToken
refreshToken
bearerToken
```

Browser login response memang tidak memuat token; server menyimpan canonical credential dalam BrowserSession custody. `Pasted text.txt`

### 5. Invalid transition fail closed

Contoh:

```text
authenticated
→ LOGIN_STARTED
```

bukan transition normal.

Daripada diam-diam menghasilkan state aneh, reducer melempar programmer error yang jelas.

Ini membantu menjaga lifecycle deterministic saat FEI-5B-5E mulai asynchronous.

## Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak fixture `AuthenticatedBootstrapData`, jangan cast `any`. Kirim exact missing field; generated schema tetap source of truth.

Jika state test gagal karena exact error type, jangan melemahkan `BrowserApiResponseFailure`. Context-required dan session-expired memang harus berasal dari actual HTTP response failure, bukan generic network failure.

Jika unrelated Blade/docs berubah status, jangan restore atau stage.

## Langkah Berikutnya

Jika FEI-5A hijau, baru lanjut satu step:

```text
FEI-5B - CSRF + Login Lifecycle
```

Di sana kita mulai memakai transport untuk:

```text
GET  /api/v1/browser/session/csrf
POST /api/v1/browser/auth/login
```

dan hasil login hanya akan membawa state ke:

```text
resolving-context
```

belum langsung `authenticated`.

## Response:
8/20/2026, 6:26:03 AM

FEI-5A secara runtime sudah benar, tetapi **belum hijau** karena TypeScript menemukan masalah narrowing yang valid:

```text
state.identity
TS2339
```

Penyebabnya bukan state model yang salah. `assertTransition()` hanya mengembalikan `void`, sehingga TypeScript tidak tahu bahwa setelah:

```ts
assertTransition(
    state,
    action,
    ['authenticated'],
);
```

`state` pasti bertipe `AuthenticatedBrowserAuthState`.

Test 22/22 tetap lolos karena JavaScript runtime memahami alurnya, tetapi strict TypeScript dengan benar menolak asumsi tersebut.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita perbaiki **hanya narrowing pada `LOGOUT_STARTED`**.

Tidak perlu mengubah contract, tests, reducer structure, atau memakai cast seperti:

```ts
state as AuthenticatedBrowserAuthState
```

Kita gunakan discriminated union secara langsung:

```ts
if (state.status !== 'authenticated') {
    throw ...
}
```

Setelah check tersebut, TypeScript otomatis mengetahui:

```ts
state.identity
```

aman diakses.

```bash
)

text = path.read_text(

)

old = """        case 'LOGOUT_STARTED':
            assertTransition(
                state,
                action,
                [
                    'authenticated',
                ],
            );

            return {
                status: 'logging-out',
                identity: state.identity,
            };"""

new = """        case 'LOGOUT_STARTED':
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'authenticated'
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    [
                        'Invalid EduCore BrowserAuth transition:',
                        state.status,
                        '->',
                        action.type,
                    ].join(' '),
                );
            }

            return {
                status: 'logging-out',
                identity: state.identity,
            };"""
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

`BrowserAuthState` adalah **discriminated union** berdasarkan field:

```ts
status
```

Jadi TypeScript paling kuat ketika kita melakukan narrowing langsung:

```ts
if (state.status !== 'authenticated') {
    throw ...
}

// Di sini:
// state === AuthenticatedBrowserAuthState
state.identity;
```

Ini lebih baik daripada:

```ts
(state as AuthenticatedBrowserAuthState).identity
```

karena cast tersebut meminta compiler mempercayai programmer tanpa bukti.

### Kenapa `assertTransition()` tidak cukup?

Function sekarang:

```ts
function assertTransition(...): void
```

hanya mempunyai semantic runtime.

TypeScript melihat:

```text
state sebelum function = BrowserAuthState
state sesudah function = BrowserAuthState
```

Ia tidak tahu bahwa daftar:

```ts
['authenticated']
```

berarti narrowing ke specific union member.

Kita *bisa* membuat generic assertion helper yang sophisticated, tetapi untuk satu penggunaan yang membutuhkan property narrowing itu akan menambah complexity tanpa manfaat berarti. Direct discriminant check lebih **KISS** dan lebih mudah dibaca.

### Tentang `AUTH CONTRACT DUPLICATION CHECK`

Output:

```text
interface MembershipContextRequiredBrowserAuthState
```

adalah **false positive dari grep**, bukan contract duplication.

Pattern:

```regex
interface[ ]+(User|Person|Membership|Tenant...)
```

juga mencocokkan awalan:

```text
MembershipContextRequiredBrowserAuthState
^^^^^^^^^^
```

Tidak ada interface canonical `Membership` yang diduplikasi.

Jadi bagian ini bukan blocker.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### State model sekarang punya separation yang benar

Kita sudah membedakan:

```text
unknown
```

dari:

```text
anonymous
```

Ini penting karena pada application bootstrap frontend belum tahu apakah BrowserSession valid atau tidak.

Kita juga membedakan:

```text
anonymous
```

dari:

```text
membership-context-required
```

yang nantinya mencegah session valid diarahkan secara salah ke login hanya karena membership context belum terselesaikan.

### Login belum dianggap authenticated

State machine tetap:

```text
LOGIN_STARTED
    ↓
authenticating
    ↓
LOGIN_ACCEPTED
    ↓
resolving-context
```

Bukan:

```text
LOGIN_ACCEPTED
→ authenticated
```

Identity canonical baru boleh terbentuk dari `/auth/me`.

### `unavailable` bukan anonymous

State:

```text
unavailable
```

disediakan untuk transport/server failures yang membuat authentication truth tidak dapat ditentukan secara aman.

Itu berbeda dari:

```text
anonymous
```

yang merupakan authentication truth yang sudah diketahui.

### Tidak ada async concern di reducer

Reducer tidak tahu:

```text
HTTP
MSW
React Query
router
React context
```

Ini bagus karena state transition bisa diuji sebagai pure function dan nanti mudah dipakai dari service/provider.

# FEI-5B - CSRF + Login Lifecycle

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita implementasikan satu use-case transport:

```text
loginWithBrowserSession()
        │
        ├─ 1. GET /browser/session/csrf
        │      │
        │      ├─ success 204
        │      │      ↓
        │      │
        │      └─ failure
        │             ↓
        │          STOP
        │
        └─ 2. POST /browser/auth/login
               │
               ├─ 200 BrowserLoginSuccess
               └─ canonical failure
```

Invarian utamanya:

```text
CSRF bootstrap gagal
→ login TIDAK BOLEH dikirim

login success
→ hanya BrowserLoginData
→ belum menjadi AuthenticatedBootstrapData
→ belum dianggap identity canonical
```

Jadi FEI-5B belum memanggil `/auth/me`. Itu FEI-5C.

Kita juga tidak memasukkan React Query atau Provider. Service ini dibuat dependency-injected terhadap `BrowserApiClient`, sehingga mudah dites dan tidak membuat singleton tersembunyi.

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Buat BrowserSession login service

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/auth/service.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    executeBrowserApiRequest,
    type BrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserApiResult,
} from '@/platform/api';

import type {
    BrowserLoginRequest,
    BrowserLoginSuccess,
} from '@/platform/auth/contract';

export interface BrowserLoginOptions {
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
}

function createAbortOptions(
    signal: AbortSignal | undefined,
): {
    signal?: AbortSignal;
} {
    if (signal === undefined) {
        return {};
    }

    return {
        signal,
    };
}

export async function loginWithBrowserSession(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
    request: BrowserLoginRequest,
    options: BrowserLoginOptions = {},
): Promise<
    BrowserApiResult<BrowserLoginSuccess>
> {
    const abortOptions =
        createAbortOptions(
            options.signal,
        );

    const csrfResult =
        await executeBrowserApiRequest(
            client.GET(
                '/api/v1/browser/session/csrf',
                abortOptions,
            ),
        );

    if (! csrfResult.ok) {
        return csrfResult;
    }

    return executeBrowserApiRequest(
        client.POST(
            '/api/v1/browser/auth/login',
            {
                ...abortOptions,
                body: request,
            },
        ),
    );
}
EOF
```

```bash
        let observedXsrfHeader:
            string | null = null;

        apiMockServer.use(
            http.get(
                `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/session/csrf`,
                () => {
                    requests.push(
                        'csrf',
                    );

                    document.cookie =
                        'XSRF-TOKEN=csrf%20token; Path=/';

                    return new HttpResponse(
                        null,
                        {
                            status: 204,
                        },
                    );
                },
            ),

            http.post(
                `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/auth/login`,
                async ({
                    request,
                }) => {
                    requests.push(
                        'login',
                    );

                    observedLoginBody =
                        await request.json();

                    observedXsrfHeader =
                        request.headers.get(
                            'X-XSRF-TOKEN',
                        );

                    return HttpResponse.json({
                        status: 'success',
                        data: {
                            membership_id:
                                membershipId,
                            tenant_id:
                                tenantId,
                        },
                    });
                },
            ),
        );

        const client =
            createBrowserApiClient();

        const result =
            await loginWithBrowserSession(
                client,
                loginRequest,
            );

        expect(requests).toEqual([
            'csrf',
            'login',
        ]);

        expect(
            observedLoginBody,
        ).toEqual(
            loginRequest,
        );

        expect(
            observedXsrfHeader,
        ).toBe(
            'csrf token',
        );

        expect(result).toEqual({
            ok: true,
            status: 200,
            data: {
                status: 'success',
                data: {
                    membership_id:
                        membershipId,
                    tenant_id:
                        tenantId,
                },
            },
        });

        if (! result.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                'Expected successful BrowserSession login.',
            );
        }

        expect(
            result.data,
        ).not.toHaveProperty(
            'data.access_token',
        );
    });

    it('fails closed and does not dispatch login when CSRF bootstrap fails', async () => {
        const requests: string[] = [];

        apiMockServer.use(
            http.get(
                `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/session/csrf`,
                () => {
                    requests.push(
                        'csrf',
                    );

                    return HttpResponse.error();
                },
            ),

            http.post(
                `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/auth/login`,
                () => {
                    requests.push(
                        'login',
                    );

                    return HttpResponse.json({
                        status: 'success',
                        data: {
                            membership_id:
                                membershipId,
                            tenant_id:
                                tenantId,
                        },
                    });
                },
            ),
        );

        const client =
            createBrowserApiClient();

        const result =
            await loginWithBrowserSession(
                client,
                loginRequest,
            );

        expect(requests).toEqual([
            'csrf',
        ]);

        expect(result.ok).toBe(
            false,
        );

        if (result.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                'Expected failed CSRF bootstrap.',
            );
        }

        expect(result.kind).toBe(
            'network',
        );
    });

    it('preserves canonical login validation failures', async () => {
        apiMockServer.use(
            http.get(
                `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/session/csrf`,
                () => {
                    document.cookie =
                        'XSRF-TOKEN=validation-token; Path=/';

                    return new HttpResponse(
                        null,
                        {
                            status: 204,
                        },
                    );
                },
            ),

            http.post(
                `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/auth/login`,
                () => HttpResponse.json(
                    {
                        status: 'error',
                        code:
                            'VALIDATION_FAILED',
                        message:
                            'The submitted data is invalid.',
                        errors: {
                            email: [
                                'The email field is invalid.',
                            ],
                        },
                    },
                    {
                        status: 422,
                    },
                ),
            ),
        );

        const client =
            createBrowserApiClient();

        const result =
            await loginWithBrowserSession(
                client,
                loginRequest,
            );

        expect(result).toEqual({
            ok: false,
            kind: 'response',
            status: 422,
            error: {
                status: 'error',
                code:
                    'VALIDATION_FAILED',
                message:
                    'The submitted data is invalid.',
                errors: {
                    email: [
                        'The email field is invalid.',
                    ],
                },
            },
        });
    });

    it('propagates cancellation through the complete login lifecycle', async () => {
        const requests: string[] = [];

        apiMockServer.use(
            http.get(
                `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/session/csrf`,
                () => {
                    requests.push(
                        'csrf',
                    );

                    return new HttpResponse(
                        null,
                        {
                            status: 204,
                        },
                    );
                },
            ),

            http.post(
                `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/auth/login`,
                () => {
                    requests.push(
                        'login',
                    );

                    return HttpResponse.json({
                        status: 'success',
                        data: {
                            membership_id:
                                membershipId,
                            tenant_id:
                                tenantId,
                        },
                    });
                },
            ),
        );

        const controller =
            new AbortController();

        controller.abort();

        const client =
            createBrowserApiClient();

        const result =
            await loginWithBrowserSession(
                client,
                loginRequest,
                {
                    signal:
                        controller.signal,
                },
            );

        expect(requests).toEqual([]);

        expect(result.ok).toBe(
            false,
        );

        if (result.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                'Expected aborted BrowserSession login.',
            );
        }

        expect(result.kind).toBe(
            'aborted',
        );
    });
});
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. CSRF bootstrap adalah prerequisite, bukan best-effort

Contract memang mendefinisikan endpoint bootstrap khusus dengan response `204`, sedangkan login adalah mutation request tersendiri. `Pasted text.txt`

Karena itu:

```ts
if (! csrfResult.ok) {
    return csrfResult;
}
```

adalah fail-closed behavior.

Kita tidak melakukan:

```text
CSRF gagal
→ coba login juga
```

karena itu akan membuat lifecycle security tidak deterministik.

### 2. Service tidak membuat HTTP client sendiri

Kita menerima:

```ts
client: BrowserApiClient
```

daripada:

```ts
const client = createBrowserApiClient();
```

di dalam service.

Ini memberikan:

```text
Dependency Injection
→ lebih testable
→ ownership runtime jelas
→ nanti ApplicationRuntime dapat memiliki satu client
```

dan menghindari hidden singleton.

### 3. Tidak ada token handling

Canonical bearer memang ada pada transport backend lain, tetapi **BrowserLoginSuccess tidak berisi field tersebut**; browser login data hanya `membership_id` dan `tenant_id`. `Pasted text.txt`

Karena itu service sama sekali tidak memiliki:

```text
accessToken
refreshToken
Authorization setter
storage
```

### 4. Login success belum menghasilkan `authenticated`

Service hanya mengembalikan:

```text
BrowserLoginSuccess
```

FEI-5 state nanti akan memproses:

```text
LOGIN_STARTED
      ↓
loginWithBrowserSession()
      ↓
LOGIN_ACCEPTED
      ↓
resolving-context
```

Baru FEI-5C akan memanggil:

```text
GET /api/v1/auth/me
```

untuk mendapatkan canonical identity.

### 5. `AbortSignal` dipakai untuk kedua tahap

Signal yang sama diteruskan ke:

```text
CSRF bootstrap
+
login mutation
```

Jadi page navigation/unmount nanti dapat membatalkan seluruh operation chain, bukan hanya request kedua.

### 6. Tidak ada duplicated error mapping

Kita tetap menggunakan FEI-4:

```ts
executeBrowserApiRequest()
```

Sehingga FEI-5 tidak membuat lagi mapping:

```text
401
422
503
network
aborted
```

Ini menjaga DRY dan satu transport error boundary.

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak `client.GET(..., abortOptions)` karena optional argument semantics, kirim exact error; jangan memakai `as any`.

Jika `document.cookie` yang diset di MSW handler tidak terlihat pada POST, jangan melemahkan XSRF assertion dulu. Itu berarti kita perlu menyesuaikan test harness untuk jsdom cookie timing, bukan production security policy.

Jika CSRF `204` menyebabkan `executeBrowserApiRequest()` gagal karena `data === undefined`, kirim output exact. `204` memang canonical success tanpa body, jadi executor harus tetap menganggapnya sukses. `Pasted text.txt`

Jika validation response ditolak normalizer, jangan membuat parsing baru di auth service; error normalization tetap milik `platform/api`.

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

FEI-5C membuat service berikut:

```text
bootstrapBrowserAuthentication()
           │
           ├─ membership locator tersedia
           │      ↓
           │   GET /api/v1/auth/me
           │   X-EduCore-Membership-Id
           │
           └─ locator tidak tersedia
                  ↓
               GET /api/v1/auth/me
               tanpa locator
```

Hasilnya tetap typed:

```text
200
→ AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess

401
→ BrowserSession authentication required

403
→ context required / denied / mismatch

422
→ invalid membership locator

503
→ BrowserSession unavailable
```

Kita **belum memetakan response ke reducer** pada langkah ini.

Jadi:

```text
service transport
→ FEI-5C

state orchestration
→ nanti FEI-5E
```

Ini menjaga SRP.

## 1. Buat private request-options helper

```bash
export function createBrowserAuthAbortOptions(
    signal: AbortSignal | undefined,
): {
    signal?: AbortSignal;
} {
    if (signal === undefined) {
        return {};
    }

    return {
        signal,
    };
}
EOF
```

File ini **tidak diekspor** dari public auth barrel.

## 2. Refactor `service.ts` agar memakai helper bersama

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/auth/service.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    executeBrowserApiRequest,
    type BrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserApiResult,
} from '@/platform/api';

import type {
    BrowserLoginRequest,
    BrowserLoginSuccess,
} from '@/platform/auth/contract';
import { createBrowserAuthAbortOptions } from '@/platform/auth/request-options';

export interface BrowserLoginOptions {
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export async function loginWithBrowserSession(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
    request: BrowserLoginRequest,
    options: BrowserLoginOptions = {},
): Promise<
    BrowserApiResult<BrowserLoginSuccess>
> {
    const abortOptions =
        createBrowserAuthAbortOptions(
            options.signal,
        );

    const csrfResult =
        await executeBrowserApiRequest(
            client.GET(
                '/api/v1/browser/session/csrf',
                abortOptions,
            ),
        );

    if (! csrfResult.ok) {
        return csrfResult;
    }

    return executeBrowserApiRequest(
        client.POST(
            '/api/v1/browser/auth/login',
            {
                ...abortOptions,
                body: request,
            },
        ),
    );
}
EOF
```

Behavior FEI-5B tidak berubah.

## 3. Buat canonical auth bootstrap service

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/auth/bootstrap.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    createBrowserMembershipHeaderParams,
    executeBrowserApiRequest,
    type BrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserApiResult,
    type BrowserMembershipLocator,
} from '@/platform/api';

import type {
    AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess,
} from '@/platform/auth/contract';
import { createBrowserAuthAbortOptions } from '@/platform/auth/request-options';

export interface BrowserAuthBootstrapOptions {
    readonly membershipId?:
        BrowserMembershipLocator;

    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export async function bootstrapBrowserAuthentication(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
    options: BrowserAuthBootstrapOptions = {},
): Promise<
    BrowserApiResult<
        AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess
    >
> {
    const abortOptions =
        createBrowserAuthAbortOptions(
            options.signal,
        );

    if (
        options.membershipId
            === undefined
    ) {
        return executeBrowserApiRequest(
            client.GET(
                '/api/v1/auth/me',
                abortOptions,
            ),
        );
    }

    return executeBrowserApiRequest(
        client.GET(
            '/api/v1/auth/me',
            {
                ...abortOptions,

                params: {
                    header:
                        createBrowserMembershipHeaderParams({
                            membershipId:
                                options.membershipId,
                        }),
                },
            },
        ),
    );
}
EOF
```

Perhatikan branch tanpa membership memang sengaja tidak membuat header kosong.

```bash
            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/auth/me`,
                    () => {
                        requestWasDispatched =
                            true;

                        return HttpResponse.json(
                            authenticatedResponse,
                        );
                    },
                ),
            );

            const controller =
                new AbortController();

            controller.abort();

            const client =
                createBrowserApiClient();

            const result =
                await bootstrapBrowserAuthentication(
                    client,
                    {
                        membershipId,
                        signal:
                            controller.signal,
                    },
                );

            expect(
                requestWasDispatched,
            ).toBe(false);

            expect(result.ok).toBe(
                false,
            );

            if (result.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    'Expected aborted authentication bootstrap.',
                );
            }

            expect(result.kind).toBe(
                'aborted',
            );
        });
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. `/auth/me` tetap canonical resource plane

Kita tidak menghidupkan kembali endpoint transitional:

```text
/api/v1/browser/auth/me
```

FEI-5C hanya menggunakan:

```text
/api/v1/auth/me
```

sesuai arsitektur final.

Contract canonical operation memang mendukung BrowserSession dan locator membership conditional. `Pasted text.txt`

### 2. Locator optional pada function, tetapi tidak pernah dibuat-buat

Ini sengaja:

```ts
if (
    options.membershipId
        === undefined
) {
    // request tanpa header
}
```

Bukan:

```ts
membershipId ?? ''
```

dan bukan:

```ts
'X-EduCore-Membership-Id': ''
```

Karena backend harus bisa membedakan:

```text
header absent
→ BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
```

dengan:

```text
header malformed
→ INVALID_BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_ID
```

Backend tests memang mengunci perbedaan tersebut. `Pasted text.txt`

### 3. Locator bukan authorization state

`membershipId` hanya dipakai saat membuat:

```text
X-EduCore-Membership-Id
```

Tidak ada logic seperti:

```ts
if (membershipId) {
    authenticated = true;
}
```

Identity tetap hanya berasal dari successful canonical:

```text
GET /api/v1/auth/me
```

### 4. Login → bootstrap tetap dua tahap

Setelah FEI-5B:

```text
BrowserLoginSuccess.data.membership_id
```

nantinya bisa dipakai sebagai locator:

```text
login.data.membership_id
        ↓
bootstrapBrowserAuthentication()
        ↓
AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess
```

Tetapi orchestration tersebut belum kita buat di FEI-5C.

### 5. DRY untuk AbortSignal

Daripada memiliki dua fungsi:

```text
login createAbortOptions
bootstrap createAbortOptions
```

kita punya satu private helper:

```text
request-options.ts
```

File tersebut sengaja tidak menjadi public API.

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak `'not-a-uuid'` sebagai `BrowserMembershipLocator`, jangan cast `any`. Kirim exact error; kita bisa menguji 422 dengan typed fixture berbeda tanpa melemahkan contract.

Jika `AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess` fixture ditolak compiler, kirim exact missing/mismatched field dari generated schema.

Jika request tanpa membership locator tidak menghasilkan handler dengan header `null`, jangan tambahkan empty header. Kita audit request composition terlebih dahulu.

Sekarang kita lanjut satu langkah ke **FEI-5D - Logout + Session Failure Classification**.

Contract logout penting untuk dipertahankan apa adanya: browser logout adalah mutation request-forgery-protected, **idempotent untuk anonymous BrowserSession**, sukses `200 BrowserLogoutSuccess`, dengan failure `500 InternalServerError` atau `503 LogoutUnavailable`. `Pasted text.txt` Generated operation juga mengunci response tersebut sebagai `200/500/503`. `Pasted text.txt`

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

FEI-5D menangani dua concern yang masih berada di platform auth layer:

```text
A. Secure logout lifecycle

GET /browser/session/csrf
        ↓
POST /browser/auth/logout
        ↓
200 BrowserLogoutSuccess
```

dan:

```text
B. Auth failure classification

BrowserApiFailure
        │
        ├─ 401 + BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
        │       → session authentication lost
        │
        └─ 403 + BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
                → session may still be authenticated,
                  membership context is missing
```

Klasifikasi ini penting karena nanti FEI-5E tidak boleh melakukan:

```text
semua 401/403
→ anonymous
```

`401 BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED` memang menunjukkan BrowserSession tidak memiliki authenticated credential. Runtime backend menggunakan code itu dengan HTTP `401`. `bff-9-2b-runtime-error-status-evidence.txt`

Sedangkan:

```text
403 BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
```

adalah masalah Membership context, bukan bukti bahwa browser anonymous. `bff-9-2b-runtime-error-status-evidence.txt`

Belum ada Provider, React Query, atau reducer orchestration pada langkah ini.

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Buat canonical auth failure classifier

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/auth/failure.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    BrowserApiFailure,
    BrowserApiResponseFailure,
} from '@/platform/api';

export function isBrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredFailure(
    failure: BrowserApiFailure,
): failure is BrowserApiResponseFailure {
    return (
        failure.kind === 'response'
        && failure.status === 401
        && failure.error.code
            === 'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED'
    );
}

export function isBrowserMembershipContextRequiredFailure(
    failure: BrowserApiFailure,
): failure is BrowserApiResponseFailure {
    return (
        failure.kind === 'response'
        && failure.status === 403
        && failure.error.code
            === 'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED'
    );
}
EOF
```

Classifier sengaja menggunakan **status + canonical code**, bukan message.

---

## 2. Buat secure logout service

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/auth/logout.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    executeBrowserApiRequest,
    type BrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserApiResult,
} from '@/platform/api';

import type {
    BrowserLogoutSuccess,
} from '@/platform/auth/contract';
import { createBrowserAuthAbortOptions } from '@/platform/auth/request-options';

export interface BrowserLogoutOptions {
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export async function logoutBrowserSession(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
    options: BrowserLogoutOptions = {},
): Promise<
    BrowserApiResult<BrowserLogoutSuccess>
> {
    const abortOptions =
        createBrowserAuthAbortOptions(
            options.signal,
        );

    const csrfResult =
        await executeBrowserApiRequest(
            client.GET(
                '/api/v1/browser/session/csrf',
                abortOptions,
            ),
        );

    if (! csrfResult.ok) {
        return csrfResult;
    }

    return executeBrowserApiRequest(
        client.POST(
            '/api/v1/browser/auth/logout',
            abortOptions,
        ),
    );
}
EOF
```

Logout juga bootstrap CSRF terlebih dahulu karena endpoint logout memang request-forgery-protected. `Pasted text.txt`

Ini membuat service aman bahkan jika dipanggil setelah long-lived page/session dan frontend tidak mengandalkan asumsi bahwa anti-forgery cookie pasti masih tersedia.

```bash
import type {
    BrowserApiFailure,
} from '@/platform/api';
import {
    isBrowserMembershipContextRequiredFailure,
    isBrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredFailure,
} from '@/platform/auth';

describe(
    'Browser authentication failure classification',
    () => {
        it('classifies canonical BrowserSession authentication loss', () => {
            const failure:
                BrowserApiFailure = {
                    ok: false,
                    kind: 'response',
                    status: 401,
                    error: {
                        status:
                            'error',
                        code:
                            'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED',
                        message:
                            'Authenticated browser session is required.',
                    },
                };

            expect(
                isBrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredFailure(
                    failure,
                ),
            ).toBe(true);

            expect(
                isBrowserMembershipContextRequiredFailure(
                    failure,
                ),
            ).toBe(false);
        });

        it('classifies missing membership context separately from session loss', () => {
            const failure:
                BrowserApiFailure = {
                    ok: false,
                    kind: 'response',
                    status: 403,
                    error: {
                        status:
                            'error',
                        code:
                            'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
                        message:
                            'Browser membership context is required.',
                    },
                };

            expect(
                isBrowserMembershipContextRequiredFailure(
                    failure,
                ),
            ).toBe(true);

            expect(
                isBrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredFailure(
                    failure,
                ),
            ).toBe(false);
        });

        it('does not classify matching codes with the wrong HTTP status', () => {
            const failure:
                BrowserApiFailure = {
                    ok: false,
                    kind: 'response',
                    status: 403,
                    error: {
                        status:
                            'error',
                        code:
                            'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED',
                        message:
                            'Authenticated browser session is required.',
                    },
                };

            expect(
                isBrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredFailure(
                    failure,
                ),
            ).toBe(false);
        });

        it('does not classify network failures as authentication truth', () => {
            const failure:
                BrowserApiFailure = {
                    ok: false,
                    kind: 'network',
                    cause:
                        new TypeError(
                            'Network unavailable',
                        ),
                };

            expect(
                isBrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredFailure(
                    failure,
                ),
            ).toBe(false);

            expect(
                isBrowserMembershipContextRequiredFailure(
                    failure,
                ),
            ).toBe(false);
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

## 5. Buat logout lifecycle tests

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/auth/__tests__/logout.test.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    http,
    HttpResponse,
} from 'msw';
import {
    afterEach,
    beforeEach,
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    createBrowserApiClient,
} from '@/platform/api';
import {
    logoutBrowserSession,
} from '@/platform/auth';
import { apiMockServer } from '@/test/server';

function clearXsrfCookie(): void {
    document.cookie = [
        'XSRF-TOKEN=',
        'Max-Age=0',
        'Path=/',
    ].join('; ');
}

describe(
    'logoutBrowserSession',
    () => {
        beforeEach(() => {
            clearXsrfCookie();
        });

        afterEach(() => {
            clearXsrfCookie();
        });

        it('bootstraps request forgery protection before logout', async () => {
            const requests:
                string[] = [];

            let observedXsrfHeader:
                string | null = null;

            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/session/csrf`,
                    () => {
                        requests.push(
                            'csrf',
                        );

                        document.cookie =
                            'XSRF-TOKEN=logout%20token; Path=/';

                        return new HttpResponse(
                            null,
                            {
                                status: 204,
                            },
                        );
                    },
                ),

                http.post(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/auth/logout`,
                    ({
                        request,
                    }) => {
                        requests.push(
                            'logout',
                        );

                        observedXsrfHeader =
                            request.headers.get(
                                'X-XSRF-TOKEN',
                            );

                        return HttpResponse.json({
                            status:
                                'success',
                            message:
                                'Logout completed successfully.',
                        });
                    },
                ),
            );

            const client =
                createBrowserApiClient();

            const result =
                await logoutBrowserSession(
                    client,
                );

            expect(requests).toEqual([
                'csrf',
                'logout',
            ]);

            expect(
                observedXsrfHeader,
            ).toBe(
                'logout token',
            );

            expect(result).toEqual({
                ok: true,
                status: 200,
                data: {
                    status:
                        'success',
                    message:
                        'Logout completed successfully.',
                },
            });
        });

        it('fails closed and does not dispatch logout when CSRF bootstrap fails', async () => {
            const requests:
                string[] = [];

            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/session/csrf`,
                    () => {
                        requests.push(
                            'csrf',
                        );

                        return HttpResponse.error();
                    },
                ),

                http.post(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/auth/logout`,
                    () => {
                        requests.push(
                            'logout',
                        );

                        return HttpResponse.json({
                            status:
                                'success',
                            message:
                                'Logout completed successfully.',
                        });
                    },
                ),
            );

            const client =
                createBrowserApiClient();

            const result =
                await logoutBrowserSession(
                    client,
                );

            expect(requests).toEqual([
                'csrf',
            ]);

            expect(result.ok).toBe(
                false,
            );

            if (result.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    'Expected failed logout CSRF bootstrap.',
                );
            }

            expect(result.kind).toBe(
                'network',
            );
        });

        it('preserves canonical logout-unavailable failures', async () => {
            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/session/csrf`,
                    () => {
                        document.cookie =
                            'XSRF-TOKEN=logout-unavailable; Path=/';

                        return new HttpResponse(
                            null,
                            {
                                status: 204,
                            },
                        );
                    },
                ),

                http.post(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/auth/logout`,
                    () => HttpResponse.json(
                        {
                            status:
                                'error',
                            code:
                                'LOGOUT_UNAVAILABLE',
                            message:
                                'Logout is temporarily unavailable.',
                        },
                        {
                            status: 503,
                        },
                    ),
                ),
            );

            const client =
                createBrowserApiClient();

            const result =
                await logoutBrowserSession(
                    client,
                );

            expect(result).toEqual({
                ok: false,
                kind: 'response',
                status: 503,
                error: {
                    status:
                        'error',
                    code:
                        'LOGOUT_UNAVAILABLE',
                    message:
                        'Logout is temporarily unavailable.',
                },
            });
        });

        it('preserves internal logout failures without converting them to anonymous state', async () => {
            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/session/csrf`,
                    () => {
                        document.cookie =
                            'XSRF-TOKEN=logout-internal; Path=/';

                        return new HttpResponse(
                            null,
                            {
                                status: 204,
                            },
                        );
                    },
                ),

                http.post(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/auth/logout`,
                    () => HttpResponse.json(
                        {
                            status:
                                'error',
                            code:
                                'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR',
                            message:
                                'An internal server error occurred.',
                        },
                        {
                            status: 500,
                        },
                    ),
                ),
            );

            const client =
                createBrowserApiClient();

            const result =
                await logoutBrowserSession(
                    client,
                );

            expect(result).toEqual({
                ok: false,
                kind: 'response',
                status: 500,
                error: {
                    status:
                        'error',
                    code:
                        'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR',
                    message:
                        'An internal server error occurred.',
                },
            });
        });

        it('propagates cancellation without dispatching either logout request', async () => {
            const requests:
                string[] = [];

            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/session/csrf`,
                    () => {
                        requests.push(
                            'csrf',
                        );

                        return new HttpResponse(
                            null,
                            {
                                status: 204,
                            },
                        );
                    },
                ),

                http.post(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/auth/logout`,
                    () => {
                        requests.push(
                            'logout',
                        );

                        return HttpResponse.json({
                            status:
                                'success',
                            message:
                                'Logout completed successfully.',
                        });
                    },
                ),
            );

            const controller =
                new AbortController();

            controller.abort();

            const client =
                createBrowserApiClient();

            const result =
                await logoutBrowserSession(
                    client,
                    {
                        signal:
                            controller.signal,
                    },
                );

            expect(requests).toEqual([]);

            expect(result.ok).toBe(
                false,
            );

            if (result.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    'Expected aborted BrowserSession logout.',
                );
            }

            expect(result.kind).toBe(
                'aborted',
            );
        });
    },
);
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Logout tidak langsung membuat state anonymous

Ini penting.

Service hanya mengembalikan:

```text
BrowserApiResult<BrowserLogoutSuccess>
```

Bukan:

```ts
setAuthenticated(false);
```

Karena kalau logout gagal:

```text
503 LOGOUT_UNAVAILABLE
```

kita **tidak boleh berpura-pura** bahwa credential server-side sudah direvoke.

Contract menyatakan logout melakukan best-effort revocation, membersihkan credential custody, invalidasi session, dan rotasi CSRF. Kegagalan revocation memiliki canonical `503 LogoutUnavailable`. `Pasted text.txt`

Jadi nanti FEI-5E:

```text
logout success
→ LOGOUT_COMPLETED
→ anonymous

logout failure
→ jangan LOGOUT_COMPLETED
```

### 2. Anonymous logout tetap valid

Backend secara eksplisit menyatakan logout idempotent untuk anonymous BrowserSession. `Pasted text.txt`

Karena itu frontend tidak perlu:

```ts
if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return;
}
```

di service layer.

Endpoint boleh tetap dipanggil dengan aman.

### 3. CSRF bootstrap juga dilakukan sebelum logout

Logout merupakan:

```text
POST
x-educore-request-forgery-protected: true
```

`Pasted text.txt`

Jadi security lifecycle-nya sama seperti login:

```text
CSRF bootstrap
→ protected mutation
```

Dan failure bootstrap bersifat fail-closed.

### 4. Session expiry classification menggunakan code + HTTP status

Kita tidak melakukan:

```ts
failure.error.message.includes(
    'session',
)
```

karena message bukan machine contract.

Yang kita percayai:

```text
HTTP 401
+
BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
```

Backend runtime memang menggunakan pasangan tersebut untuk missing authenticated BrowserSession. `bff-9-2b-runtime-error-status-evidence.txt`

### 5. Membership context tetap bukan logout/session expiry

```text
403
BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
```

tetap diklasifikasikan secara terpisah.

Itu diperlukan agar FEI-5E bisa menghasilkan:

```text
membership-context-required
```

bukan:

```text
anonymous
```

### 6. Network failure bukan authentication truth

Jika:

```text
Wi-Fi putus
DNS gagal
backend unreachable
```

maka kita tidak tahu apakah server-side BrowserSession masih valid.

Maka:

```text
network
≠ anonymous
```

Ini salah satu alasan state `unavailable` sudah dibuat sejak FEI-5A.

## Troubleshooting

Jika `BrowserLogoutSuccess` test fixture ditolak TypeScript, jangan cast. Generated success contract mensyaratkan literal success message, jadi kirim exact compiler error.

Jika `LOGOUT_UNAVAILABLE` ditolak canonical normalizer, kirim hasilnya; error normalization tetap tidak boleh dipindah ke `platform/auth`.

Jika CSRF bootstrap gagal tetapi logout masih dispatched, jangan melemahkan test-itu pelanggaran fail-closed lifecycle.

Jika `500 InternalServerError` memiliki canonical message berbeda dari fixture, kirim compiler/runtime output sebelum mengganti nilai.

## Langkah Berikutnya

Jika FEI-5D hijau:

```text
FEI-5A - Contract + State Model             ✅
FEI-5B - CSRF + Login Lifecycle             ✅
FEI-5C - Canonical Auth Bootstrap           ✅
FEI-5D - Logout + Failure Classification    ✅
```

baru kita masuk **FEI-5E - Auth Runtime Orchestration**, yaitu bagian yang menghubungkan service-service tadi ke reducer:

```text
initial bootstrap
login
login → canonical /auth/me
session expiry
membership context required
logout
transport unavailable
```

Masih tanpa route guard; routing tetap milestone terpisah setelah authentication truth stabil.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Sekarang kita menyatukan service-service yang sudah teruji menjadi satu runtime stateful:

```text
BrowserAuthRuntime
│
├─ bootstrap()
│    └─ /auth/me
│
├─ login()
│    ├─ CSRF
│    ├─ login
│    └─ /auth/me
│
├─ logout()
│    ├─ CSRF
│    └─ logout
│
├─ observeFailure()
│    ├─ session expired
│    └─ membership context required
│
├─ getState()
└─ subscribe()
```

Arsitekturnya sengaja dua lapis:

```text
BrowserAuthRuntime
       ↓
BrowserAuthOperations
       ↓
FEI-5B/C/D services
       ↓
BrowserApiClient
```

Dengan begitu orchestration tidak tahu detail HTTP.

Kita juga memperbaiki satu recovery edge yang baru relevan sekarang: state `unavailable` harus dapat dipulihkan oleh bootstrap berikutnya menjadi:

```text
unavailable
   ↓ retry succeeds
authenticated
```

atau:

```text
unavailable
   ↓ retry discovers context missing
membership-context-required
```

Belum ada React Context, Provider, router guard, atau navigation.

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Tambahkan recovery dari `unavailable`

Pada `state.ts`, tambahkan `unavailable` ke dua transition saja.

Gunakan replacement fail-closed berikut:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "frontend/src/platform/auth/state.ts"
)

text = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

old_context = """                [
                    'unknown',
                    'resolving-context',
                    'authenticated',
                ],"""

new_context = """                [
                    'unknown',
                    'resolving-context',
                    'authenticated',
                    'unavailable',
                ],"""

old_authenticated = """                [
                    'unknown',
                    'resolving-context',
                    'membership-context-required',
                    'authenticated',
                ],"""

new_authenticated = """                [
                    'unknown',
                    'resolving-context',
                    'membership-context-required',
                    'authenticated',
                    'unavailable',
                ],"""

if text.count(old_context) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Expected exactly one CONTEXT_REQUIRED transition list"
    )

if text.count(old_authenticated) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Expected exactly one BECAME_AUTHENTICATED transition list"
    )

text = text.replace(
    old_context,
    new_context,
)

text = text.replace(
    old_authenticated,
    new_authenticated,
)

path.write_text(
    text,
    encoding="utf-8",
)
PY
```

## 2. Buat operation boundary

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/auth/operations.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    BrowserApiClient,
    BrowserApiResult,
} from '@/platform/api';

import {
    bootstrapBrowserAuthentication,
    type BrowserAuthBootstrapOptions,
} from '@/platform/auth/bootstrap';
import type {
    AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess,
    BrowserLoginRequest,
    BrowserLoginSuccess,
    BrowserLogoutSuccess,
} from '@/platform/auth/contract';
import {
    logoutBrowserSession,
    type BrowserLogoutOptions,
} from '@/platform/auth/logout';
import {
    loginWithBrowserSession,
    type BrowserLoginOptions,
} from '@/platform/auth/service';

export interface BrowserAuthOperations {
    bootstrap(
        options?: BrowserAuthBootstrapOptions,
    ): Promise<
        BrowserApiResult<
            AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess
        >
    >;

    login(
        request: BrowserLoginRequest,
        options?: BrowserLoginOptions,
    ): Promise<
        BrowserApiResult<
            BrowserLoginSuccess
        >
    >;

    logout(
        options?: BrowserLogoutOptions,
    ): Promise<
        BrowserApiResult<
            BrowserLogoutSuccess
        >
    >;
}

export function createBrowserAuthOperations(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
): BrowserAuthOperations {
    return {
        bootstrap(
            options,
        ) {
            return bootstrapBrowserAuthentication(
                client,
                options,
            );
        },

        login(
            request,
            options,
        ) {
            return loginWithBrowserSession(
                client,
                request,
                options,
            );
        },

        logout(
            options,
        ) {
            return logoutBrowserSession(
                client,
                options,
            );
        },
    };
}
EOF
```

## 3. Buat auth runtime

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/auth/runtime.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    BrowserApiFailure,
    BrowserApiProtocolFailure,
    BrowserApiResult,
} from '@/platform/api';

import type {
    BrowserAuthBootstrapOptions,
} from '@/platform/auth/bootstrap';
import type {
    AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess,
    BrowserLoginRequest,
    BrowserLoginSuccess,
    BrowserLogoutSuccess,
} from '@/platform/auth/contract';
import {
    isBrowserMembershipContextRequiredFailure,
    isBrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredFailure,
} from '@/platform/auth/failure';
import type {
    BrowserLogoutOptions,
} from '@/platform/auth/logout';
import type {
    BrowserAuthOperations,
} from '@/platform/auth/operations';
import type {
    BrowserLoginOptions,
} from '@/platform/auth/service';
import {
    browserAuthReducer,
    createInitialBrowserAuthState,
    type BrowserAuthAction,
    type BrowserAuthState,
} from '@/platform/auth/state';

export type BrowserAuthStateListener = (
    state: BrowserAuthState,
) => void;

export interface BrowserAuthRuntime {
    getState(): BrowserAuthState;

    subscribe(
        listener: BrowserAuthStateListener,
    ): () => void;

    bootstrap(
        options?: BrowserAuthBootstrapOptions,
    ): Promise<BrowserAuthState>;

    login(
        request: BrowserLoginRequest,
        options?: BrowserLoginOptions,
    ): Promise<BrowserAuthState>;

    logout(
        options?: BrowserLogoutOptions,
    ): Promise<BrowserAuthState>;

    observeFailure(
        failure: BrowserApiFailure,
    ): BrowserAuthState;
}

function createMissingSuccessBodyFailure(
    status: number,
): BrowserApiProtocolFailure {
    return {
        ok: false,
        kind: 'protocol',
        status,
        message:
            'EduCore API returned an unexpected error response.',
    };
}

export function createBrowserAuthRuntime(
    operations: BrowserAuthOperations,
): BrowserAuthRuntime {
    let state: BrowserAuthState =
        createInitialBrowserAuthState();

    const listeners =
        new Set<
            BrowserAuthStateListener
        >();

    function publish(): void {
        for (
            const listener
            of listeners
        ) {
            listener(
                state,
            );
        }
    }

    function dispatch(
        action: BrowserAuthAction,
    ): BrowserAuthState {
        state = browserAuthReducer(
            state,
            action,
        );

        publish();

        return state;
    }

    function applyAuthenticationFailure(
        failure: BrowserApiFailure,
    ): boolean {
        if (
            isBrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredFailure(
                failure,
            )
        ) {
            if (
                state.status
                    === 'authenticated'
                || state.status
                    === 'logging-out'
                || state.status
                    === 'membership-context-required'
            ) {
                dispatch({
                    type:
                        'SESSION_EXPIRED',
                    failure,
                });
            } else {
                dispatch({
                    type:
                        'BECAME_ANONYMOUS',
                    failure,
                });
            }

            return true;
        }

        if (
            isBrowserMembershipContextRequiredFailure(
                failure,
            )
        ) {
            if (
                state.status
                    === 'membership-context-required'
            ) {
                return true;
            }

            if (
                state.status
                    === 'unknown'
                || state.status
                    === 'resolving-context'
                || state.status
                    === 'authenticated'
                || state.status
                    === 'unavailable'
            ) {
                dispatch({
                    type:
                        'CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
                    failure,
                });
            }

            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    function applyBootstrapResult(
        result: BrowserApiResult<
            AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess
        >,
    ): BrowserAuthState {
        if (! result.ok) {
            if (
                applyAuthenticationFailure(
                    result,
                )
            ) {
                return state;
            }

            return dispatch({
                type:
                    'BECAME_UNAVAILABLE',
                failure:
                    result,
            });
        }

        if (
            result.data === undefined
        ) {
            return dispatch({
                type:
                    'BECAME_UNAVAILABLE',
                failure:
                    createMissingSuccessBodyFailure(
                        result.status,
                    ),
            });
        }

        return dispatch({
            type:
                'BECAME_AUTHENTICATED',
            identity:
                result.data.data,
        });
    }

    return {
        getState() {
            return state;
        },

        subscribe(
            listener,
        ) {
            listeners.add(
                listener,
            );

            return () => {
                listeners.delete(
                    listener,
                );
            };
        },

        async bootstrap(
            options,
        ) {
            const result =
                await operations.bootstrap(
                    options,
                );

            return applyBootstrapResult(
                result,
            );
        },

        async login(
            request,
            options,
        ) {
            dispatch({
                type:
                    'LOGIN_STARTED',
            });

            const loginResult:
                BrowserApiResult<
                    BrowserLoginSuccess
                > =
                await operations.login(
                    request,
                    options,
                );

            if (! loginResult.ok) {
                return dispatch({
                    type:
                        'BECAME_ANONYMOUS',
                    failure:
                        loginResult,
                });
            }

            if (
                loginResult.data
                    === undefined
            ) {
                return dispatch({
                    type:
                        'BECAME_UNAVAILABLE',
                    failure:
                        createMissingSuccessBodyFailure(
                            loginResult.status,
                        ),
                });
            }

            const login =
                loginResult.data.data;

            dispatch({
                type:
                    'LOGIN_ACCEPTED',
                login,
            });

            const bootstrapResult =
                await operations.bootstrap({
                    membershipId:
                        login.membership_id,

                    signal:
                        options?.signal,
                });

            return applyBootstrapResult(
                bootstrapResult,
            );
        },

        async logout(
            options,
        ) {
            dispatch({
                type:
                    'LOGOUT_STARTED',
            });

            const result:
                BrowserApiResult<
                    BrowserLogoutSuccess
                > =
                await operations.logout(
                    options,
                );

            if (! result.ok) {
                return dispatch({
                    type:
                        'BECAME_UNAVAILABLE',
                    failure:
                        result,
                });
            }

            if (
                result.data === undefined
            ) {
                return dispatch({
                    type:
                        'BECAME_UNAVAILABLE',
                    failure:
                        createMissingSuccessBodyFailure(
                            result.status,
                        ),
                });
            }

            return dispatch({
                type:
                    'LOGOUT_COMPLETED',
            });
        },

        observeFailure(
            failure,
        ) {
            applyAuthenticationFailure(
                failure,
            );

            return state;
        },
    };
}
EOF
```
