## 5. Buat runtime test

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/auth/__tests__/runtime.test.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
    vi,
} from 'vitest';

import type {
    BrowserApiFailure,
    BrowserApiResult,
} from '@/platform/api';
import {
    createBrowserAuthRuntime,
    type AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess,
    type BrowserAuthOperations,
    type BrowserLoginRequest,
    type BrowserLoginSuccess,
    type BrowserLogoutSuccess,
} from '@/platform/auth';

const membershipId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab';

const tenantId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7bcd-8def-1234567890ab';

const loginRequest:
    BrowserLoginRequest = {
        email:
            'member@example.com',
        password:
            'correct-horse-battery-staple',
        tenant_uuid:
            tenantId,
    };

const loginSuccess:
    BrowserApiResult<
        BrowserLoginSuccess
    > = {
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        data: {
            status:
                'success',
            data: {
                membership_id:
                    membershipId,
                tenant_id:
                    tenantId,
            },
        },
    };

const bootstrapSuccess:
    BrowserApiResult<
        AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess
    > = {
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        data: {
            status:
                'success',
            data: {
                user: {
                    id:
                        '018f3b6a-7c20-7cde-8def-1234567890ab',
                    email:
                        'member@example.com',
                },

                person: {
                    id:
                        '018f3b6a-7c20-7def-8abc-1234567890ab',
                    name:
                        'EduCore Member',
                },

                membership: {
                    id:
                        membershipId,
                    status:
                        'ACTIVE',
                },

                tenant: {
                    id:
                        tenantId,
                    name:
                        'EduCore School',
                    subdomain:
                        'school',
                },
            },
        },
    };

const logoutSuccess:
    BrowserApiResult<
        BrowserLogoutSuccess
    > = {
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        data: {
            status:
                'success',
            message:
                'Logout completed successfully.',
        },
    };

const sessionRequiredFailure:
    BrowserApiFailure = {
        ok: false,
        kind: 'response',
        status: 401,
        error: {
            status:
                'error',
            code:
                'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED',
            message:
                'Authenticated browser session is required.',
        },
    };

const membershipContextRequiredFailure:
    BrowserApiFailure = {
        ok: false,
        kind: 'response',
        status: 403,
        error: {
            status:
                'error',
            code:
                'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
            message:
                'Browser membership context is required.',
        },
    };

const unavailableFailure:
    BrowserApiFailure = {
        ok: false,
        kind: 'network',
        cause:
            new TypeError(
                'Network unavailable',
            ),
    };

const logoutUnavailableFailure:
    BrowserApiFailure = {
        ok: false,
        kind: 'response',
        status: 503,
        error: {
            status:
                'error',
            code:
                'LOGOUT_UNAVAILABLE',
            message:
                'Logout is temporarily unavailable.',
        },
    };

function createOperations(
    overrides:
        Partial<
            BrowserAuthOperations
        > = {},
): BrowserAuthOperations {
    return {
        async bootstrap() {
            return bootstrapSuccess;
        },

        async login() {
            return loginSuccess;
        },

        async logout() {
            return logoutSuccess;
        },

        ...overrides,
    };
}

describe(
    'BrowserAuthRuntime',
    () => {
        it('bootstraps canonical authenticated identity from unknown state', async () => {
            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations(),
                );

            expect(
                runtime.getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unknown',
            });

            const state =
                await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'authenticated',
                identity:
                    bootstrapSuccess.data?.data,
            });
        });

        it('resolves initial missing BrowserSession to anonymous', async () => {
            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        async bootstrap() {
                            return sessionRequiredFailure;
                        },
                    }),
                );

            const state =
                await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'anonymous',
                failure:
                    sessionRequiredFailure,
            });
        });

        it('keeps membership-context-required distinct during initial bootstrap', async () => {
            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        async bootstrap() {
                            return membershipContextRequiredFailure;
                        },
                    }),
                );

            const state =
                await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'membership-context-required',
                failure:
                    membershipContextRequiredFailure,
            });
        });

        it('orchestrates login through context resolution into canonical identity', async () => {
            const observedStatuses:
                string[] = [];

            const bootstrap =
                vi.fn(
                    async () =>
                        bootstrapSuccess,
                );

            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        bootstrap,
                    }),
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            runtime.observeFailure(
                sessionRequiredFailure,
            );

            const unsubscribe =
                runtime.subscribe(
                    (state) => {
                        observedStatuses.push(
                            state.status,
                        );
                    },
                );

            const state =
                await runtime.login(
                    loginRequest,
                );

            unsubscribe();

            expect(
                observedStatuses,
            ).toEqual([
                'authenticating',
                'resolving-context',
                'authenticated',
            ]);

            expect(
                bootstrap,
            ).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({
                membershipId,
                signal:
                    undefined,
            });

            expect(state.status).toBe(
                'authenticated',
            );
        });

        it('returns to anonymous when browser login fails', async () => {
            const authenticationFailure:
                BrowserApiFailure = {
                    ok: false,
                    kind:
                        'response',
                    status: 401,
                    error: {
                        status:
                            'error',
                        code:
                            'AUTHENTICATION_FAILED',
                        message:
                            'Authentication failed.',
                    },
                };

            const bootstrap =
                vi.fn(
                    async () =>
                        bootstrapSuccess,
                );

            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        async login() {
                            return authenticationFailure;
                        },

                        bootstrap,
                    }),
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            runtime.observeFailure(
                sessionRequiredFailure,
            );

            const state =
                await runtime.login(
                    loginRequest,
                );

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'anonymous',
                failure:
                    authenticationFailure,
            });

            expect(
                bootstrap,
            ).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(
                1,
            );
        });

        it('transitions authenticated logout through logging-out into anonymous', async () => {
            const statuses:
                string[] = [];

            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations(),
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            const unsubscribe =
                runtime.subscribe(
                    (state) => {
                        statuses.push(
                            state.status,
                        );
                    },
                );

            const state =
                await runtime.logout();

            unsubscribe();

            expect(statuses).toEqual([
                'logging-out',
                'anonymous',
            ]);

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'anonymous',
                failure:
                    null,
            });
        });

        it('fails closed when logout outcome is unavailable', async () => {
            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        async logout() {
                            return logoutUnavailableFailure;
                        },
                    }),
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            const state =
                await runtime.logout();

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unavailable',
                failure:
                    logoutUnavailableFailure,
            });
        });

        it('observes canonical session expiry without treating it as transport unavailability', async () => {
            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations(),
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            const state =
                runtime.observeFailure(
                    sessionRequiredFailure,
                );

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'anonymous',
                failure:
                    sessionRequiredFailure,
            });
        });

        it('observes membership context loss without converting the session to anonymous', async () => {
            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations(),
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            const state =
                runtime.observeFailure(
                    membershipContextRequiredFailure,
                );

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'membership-context-required',
                failure:
                    membershipContextRequiredFailure,
            });
        });

        it('does not mutate authentication truth for unrelated observed network failures', async () => {
            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations(),
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            const before =
                runtime.getState();

            const after =
                runtime.observeFailure(
                    unavailableFailure,
                );

            expect(after).toBe(
                before,
            );

            expect(after.status).toBe(
                'authenticated',
            );
        });

        it('recovers unavailable authentication truth through a successful bootstrap retry', async () => {
            let bootstrapAttempt =
                0;

            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        async bootstrap() {
                            bootstrapAttempt +=
                                1;

                            if (
                                bootstrapAttempt
                                    === 1
                            ) {
                                return unavailableFailure;
                            }

                            return bootstrapSuccess;
                        },
                    }),
                );

            const unavailableState =
                await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(
                unavailableState.status,
            ).toBe(
                'unavailable',
            );

            const recoveredState =
                await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(
                recoveredState.status,
            ).toBe(
                'authenticated',
            );
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Runtime tidak tahu HTTP

`runtime.ts` tidak memanggil:

```text
/api/v1/auth/me
/browser/auth/login
/browser/auth/logout
```

langsung.

Ia hanya mengenal:

```ts
operations.bootstrap()
operations.login()
operations.logout()
```

Ini Dependency Inversion:

```text
orchestration
    ↓ interface
transport services
```

Transport tetap diuji oleh FEI-5B/C/D, sementara runtime dapat diuji sebagai state orchestrator.

### 2. Login sekarang punya canonical lifecycle lengkap

Runtime mengubah:

```text
anonymous
   ↓
authenticating
   ↓ login success
resolving-context
   ↓ /auth/me success
authenticated
```

`BrowserLoginSuccess` sendiri **tidak pernah dianggap identity**.

Canonical identity tetap berasal dari bootstrap result.

### 3. Login failure tetap anonymous

Login selalu dimulai dari state:

```text
anonymous
```

Jadi ketika credential salah atau validation gagal:

```text
anonymous
→ authenticating
→ request failure
→ anonymous
```

Kita sudah tahu authentication truth sebelum attempt tersebut.

Network failure selama login juga tidak secara otomatis berarti BrowserSession lama menjadi valid.

### 4. Initial bootstrap network failure berbeda

Pada startup:

```text
unknown
→ network unavailable
```

kita tidak boleh menyimpulkan:

```text
anonymous
```

Maka:

```text
unknown
→ unavailable
```

Ini mempertahankan epistemic correctness: frontend memang belum tahu authentication truth.

### 5. Generic request network failure tidak mengubah auth state

`observeFailure()` hanya bereaksi terhadap dua canonical auth signals:

```text
401 + BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
403 + BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
```

Network error dari feature request tidak otomatis membuat:

```text
authenticated → unavailable
```

karena Wi-Fi putus bukan bukti session invalid.

### 6. Logout failure fail closed

Flow:

```text
authenticated
→ logging-out
→ 503/500/network
→ unavailable
```

bukan:

```text
→ anonymous
```

Karena kita tidak dapat membuktikan final server-side logout state.

### 7. `unavailable` sekarang recoverable

Tambahan kecil pada reducer penting:

```text
unavailable
→ BECAME_AUTHENTICATED

unavailable
→ CONTEXT_REQUIRED
```

Tanpa itu temporary outage akan menjadi dead-end state.

### 8. Subscription boundary disiapkan untuk React

Runtime menyediakan:

```ts
getState()
subscribe()
```

Ini nanti kompatibel dengan React external-store pattern.

Tetapi FEI-5E **belum mengimpor React**, sehingga platform auth tetap framework-independent.

## Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak fixture `bootstrapSuccess.data?.data`, jangan tambahkan cast. Kirim error exact; kemungkinan kita perlu membuat typed identity constant terpisah agar assertion test tidak menghasilkan `undefined`.

Jika test login menunjukkan `bootstrap` dipanggil dua kali, ingat test sengaja melakukan initial bootstrap sebelum membuat state anonymous. Assertion `toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(...)` harus tetap valid; jumlah invocation tidak boleh dipakai untuk mengklaim login melakukan dua bootstrap.

Jika `unavailable → authenticated` masih ditolak reducer, cek dua transition list pada `state.ts`; jangan membuat bypass di runtime.

Jika listener test gagal, jangan menghapus intermediate states `authenticating`, `resolving-context`, atau `logging-out`. State-state tersebut penting untuk UI concurrency nanti.

## Response:
8/20/2026, 7:17:31 AM

FEI-5E secara runtime sudah benar, tetapi **belum hijau** karena satu strict TypeScript contract issue dari `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`.

Masalahnya tepat di sini:

```ts
await operations.bootstrap({
    membershipId: login.membership_id,
    signal: options?.signal,
});
```

Dengan `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true`, ini berbeda:

```ts
signal?: AbortSignal
```

dengan:

```ts
signal: AbortSignal | undefined
```

Property optional berarti **property sebaiknya tidak ada sama sekali** saat nilainya `undefined`. Kita sudah punya helper FEI-5C yang memang menyelesaikan masalah ini: `createBrowserAuthAbortOptions()`.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita perbaiki hanya construction dari bootstrap options setelah login:

```text
sebelum
{
    membershipId,
    signal: undefined        ❌ property tetap ada
}

sesudah
{
    membershipId,
    ...{}                    ✅ signal absent
}

atau jika signal tersedia:

{
    membershipId,
    ...{ signal }
}
```

Tidak perlu mengubah interface, tsconfig, test, ataupun memakai cast.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Kita **tidak** memperbaikinya dengan:

```ts
signal: options?.signal as AbortSignal
```

atau:

```ts
signal?: AbortSignal | undefined;
```

karena itu hanya melemahkan compiler contract.

Helper yang sudah kita miliki:

```ts
createBrowserAuthAbortOptions(
    options?.signal,
)
```

menghasilkan secara semantik:

```ts
// no signal
{}
```

atau:

```ts
// signal exists
{
    signal,
}
```

Ini tepat untuk `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`.

Selain itu solusi ini menjaga DRY. Login, bootstrap, logout, dan sekarang orchestration menggunakan aturan optional `AbortSignal` yang sama.

```text
→ authenticating
→ LOGIN_ACCEPTED
→ resolving-context
→ bootstrap({
      membershipId,
      signal only when present
  })
→ authenticated
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Expected boundary setelah FEI-5E:

```text
runtime.ts
   ↓ orchestration only
operations.ts
   ↓ dependency boundary
service/bootstrap/logout
   ↓ transport lifecycle
platform/api
   ↓ actual HTTP client
```

`runtime.ts` tidak boleh mengetahui endpoint seperti:

```text
/api/v1/auth/me
/api/v1/browser/auth/login
/api/v1/browser/auth/logout
```

Itu memastikan orchestration tetap testable dan tidak coupled ke HTTP implementation.

`BrowserAuthRuntime` juga tidak boleh mengimpor React. Integrasi React baru masuk FEI-5F.

Security invariant tetap:

```text
access token storage      = none
session cookie access     = none
Authorization creation   = none
message parsing           = none
raw fetch                 = none
```

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Ganti `frontend/src/app/runtime.ts`

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/runtime.ts <<'EOF'
import { createAppQueryClient } from '@/app/query-client';
import { createAppRouter } from '@/app/router';
import {
    createBrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserApiClient,
} from '@/platform/api';
import {
    createBrowserAuthOperations,
    createBrowserAuthRuntime,
    type BrowserAuthRuntime,
} from '@/platform/auth';

export interface ApplicationRuntime {
    apiClient: BrowserApiClient;
    auth: BrowserAuthRuntime;
    queryClient: ReturnType<
        typeof createAppQueryClient
    >;
    router: ReturnType<
        typeof createAppRouter
    >;
}

export function createApplicationRuntime():
    ApplicationRuntime {
    const apiClient =
        createBrowserApiClient();

    const auth =
        createBrowserAuthRuntime(
            createBrowserAuthOperations(
                apiClient,
            ),
        );

    return {
        apiClient,
        auth,
        queryClient:
            createAppQueryClient(),
        router:
            createAppRouter(),
    };
}
EOF
```

## 2. Tambahkan integration test

Buat file baru, sehingga kita tidak perlu mengubah test runtime FEI-3 yang sudah stabil.

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/__tests__/application-auth-runtime.test.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    http,
    HttpResponse,
} from 'msw';
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import { createApplicationRuntime } from '@/app/runtime';
import { apiMockServer } from '@/test/server';

describe(
    'Application authentication runtime',
    () => {
        it('composes a single Browser API client with an unknown auth runtime', () => {
            const runtime =
                createApplicationRuntime();

            expect(
                runtime.apiClient,
            ).toBeDefined();

            expect(
                runtime.auth.getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unknown',
            });
        });

        it('connects the application auth runtime to the canonical Browser API transport', async () => {
            let requestCount =
                0;

            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/auth/me`,
                    () => {
                        requestCount += 1;

                        return HttpResponse.json(
                            {
                                status:
                                    'error',
                                code:
                                    'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED',
                                message:
                                    'Authenticated browser session is required.',
                            },
                            {
                                status: 401,
                            },
                        );
                    },
                ),
            );

            const runtime =
                createApplicationRuntime();

            expect(
                runtime.auth.getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unknown',
            });

            expect(
                requestCount,
            ).toBe(0);

            const state =
                await runtime.auth.bootstrap();

            expect(
                requestCount,
            ).toBe(1);

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'anonymous',
                failure: {
                    ok: false,
                    kind:
                        'response',
                    status: 401,
                    error: {
                        status:
                            'error',
                        code:
                            'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED',
                        message:
                            'Authenticated browser session is required.',
                    },
                },
            });
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. `ApplicationRuntime` menjadi composition root

Sebelumnya application runtime hanya memiliki:

```text
QueryClient
Router
```

Sekarang:

```text
ApplicationRuntime
├─ apiClient
├─ auth
├─ queryClient
└─ router
```

Ini lebih scalable karena application services mempunyai ownership yang eksplisit.

Kita menghindari pola seperti:

```ts
// component A
const client = createBrowserApiClient();

// component B
const client = createBrowserApiClient();

// auth feature
const client = createBrowserApiClient();
```

yang akan menghasilkan banyak instance dan lifecycle ownership yang kabur.

---

### 2. Auth runtime menerima client melalui dependency chain

Dependency chain sekarang:

```text
createBrowserApiClient()
        ↓
createBrowserAuthOperations(apiClient)
        ↓
createBrowserAuthRuntime(operations)
```

Jadi tetap:

```text
runtime orchestration
→ operations abstraction
→ auth transport services
→ API transport
```

Tidak ada dependency inversion yang dirusak.

---

### 3. Kita expose `apiClient` dari `ApplicationRuntime`

Ini sengaja.

FEI-6/7/8 nanti kemungkinan membutuhkan canonical API client untuk:

```text
membership discovery
workspace discovery
capabilities
```

Daripada setiap domain membuat:

```ts
createBrowserApiClient()
```

sendiri, application runtime menjadi owner instance transport.

Nantinya dependency flow bisa tetap:

```text
ApplicationRuntime.apiClient
         ↓
domain operation adapters
```

---

### 4. Membuat runtime tidak otomatis melakukan network request

Test secara eksplisit membuktikan:

```ts
const runtime =
    createApplicationRuntime();

expect(requestCount).toBe(0);
```

Ini penting.

Construction harus bebas side effect:

```text
construct runtime
≠
bootstrap authentication
```

Side effect baru dijalankan secara eksplisit:

```ts
await runtime.auth.bootstrap();
```

FEI-5F.2 React bridge nanti yang menjadi lifecycle owner untuk initial bootstrap.

---

### 5. Integration test menggunakan canonical endpoint

Test kedua membuktikan chain sebenarnya:

```text
ApplicationRuntime
      ↓
BrowserAuthRuntime
      ↓
BrowserAuthOperations
      ↓
bootstrapBrowserAuthentication
      ↓
BrowserApiClient
      ↓
GET /api/v1/auth/me
```

Jadi kita tidak hanya mengecek:

```ts
expect(runtime.auth).toBeDefined();
```

tetapi membuktikan wiring end-to-end.

---

### 6. Tidak ada React coupling dulu

`ApplicationRuntime` adalah plain TypeScript composition.

Belum ada:

```text
createContext
useContext
useSyncExternalStore
useEffect
```

Dengan begitu kita bisa membedakan jelas:

```text
FEI-5F.1
composition

FEI-5F.2
React lifecycle bridge
```

Ini lebih aman daripada menambahkan semuanya sekaligus.

import { createAppQueryClient } from '@/app/query-client';
import { createAppRouter } from '@/app/router';

    createBrowserApiClient,

export interface ApplicationRuntime {

    queryClient: ReturnType<
        typeof createAppQueryClient

export function createApplicationRuntime():
    ApplicationRuntime {
    const apiClient =
        createBrowserApiClient();

    const auth =
        createBrowserAuthRuntime(
            createBrowserAuthOperations(
                apiClient,
            ),
        );

    return {
        apiClient,
        auth,
        queryClient:
            createAppQueryClient(),
        router:
            createAppRouter(),
    };
}

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Alasan kita tidak langsung menambahkan provider adalah initial bootstrap nanti merupakan side effect:

```text
AppBootstrap mount
        ↓
BrowserAuthProvider
        ↓
auth.bootstrap()
        ↓
GET /api/v1/auth/me
```

MSW saat ini dikonfigurasi fail-closed terhadap request tak terduga. Jadi existing `AppBootstrap.test.tsx` harus tetap memiliki explicit expectation/handler terhadap network lifecycle baru; kita tidak akan menambahkan global fallback handler yang bisa menyembunyikan accidental HTTP calls.

`useSyncExternalStore` juga mensyaratkan subscription function yang mengembalikan unsubscribe dan snapshot reader yang stabil-interface `BrowserAuthRuntime.getState()` + `subscribe()` yang sudah kita buat memang sengaja diarahkan ke bentuk tersebut. ([React](https://react.dev/reference/react/useSyncExternalStore?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Preflight mengonfirmasi desain FEI-5F.2, tetapi `StrictMode` menambahkan satu requirement penting: Effect mendapat siklus setup→cleanup tambahan pada development. Jadi bootstrap pertama dapat dibatalkan saat cleanup dan bootstrap kedua kemudian berjalan. React memang mendesain Strict Mode seperti itu untuk menguji cleanup Effect. ([React](https://react.dev/reference/react/StrictMode?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Karena itu kita **tidak boleh menguji “bootstrap pasti hanya satu kali” di bawah StrictMode**. Yang harus kita jamin adalah:

```text
first bootstrap
→ cleanup abort
→ cancelled result tidak merusak auth truth

second bootstrap
→ canonical result
→ final state benar
```

Selain itu `useSyncExternalStore` cocok untuk `BrowserAuthRuntime` karena runtime kita sudah menyediakan `subscribe()` yang mengembalikan unsubscribe dan `getState()` dengan snapshot immutable-by-replacement. Itu persis kontrak React untuk external store. ([React](https://react.dev/reference/react/useSyncExternalStore?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# FEI-5F.2 - React Auth Bridge & Bootstrap Lifecycle

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita implementasikan:

```text
ApplicationRuntime.auth
        ↓
BrowserAuthProvider
        │
        ├─ useEffect
        │    └─ initial auth.bootstrap()
        │
        └─ React Context
              ↓
        useBrowserAuthState()
              ↓
        useSyncExternalStore()
```

Ada satu koreksi kecil pada runtime:

```text
bootstrap aborted
≠ unavailable
```

Cancellation adalah lifecycle signal, bukan authentication truth.

Jadi:

```text
unknown + aborted bootstrap
→ tetap unknown

authenticated + aborted retry
→ tetap authenticated
```

Ini membuat StrictMode race-safe.

**Masih tidak ada route guard.**

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Buat React auth bridge

```bash
mkdir -p \
  frontend/src/app/auth/__tests__

cat > frontend/src/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider.tsx <<'EOF'
import {
    createContext,
    type PropsWithChildren,
    useContext,
    useEffect,
    useSyncExternalStore,
} from 'react';

import type {
    BrowserAuthRuntime,
    BrowserAuthState,
} from '@/platform/auth';

const BrowserAuthRuntimeContext =
    createContext<
        BrowserAuthRuntime | null
    >(null);

export interface BrowserAuthProviderProps
    extends PropsWithChildren {
    readonly runtime:
        BrowserAuthRuntime;
}

export function BrowserAuthProvider({
    runtime,
    children,
}: BrowserAuthProviderProps) {
    useEffect(
        () => {
            /*
             * Runtime construction is intentionally
             * side-effect free.
             *
             * Authentication truth is resolved only
             * after the React application mounts.
             */
            if (
                runtime.getState().status
                    !== 'unknown'
            ) {
                return;
            }

            const controller =
                new AbortController();

            void runtime.bootstrap({
                signal:
                    controller.signal,
            });

            return () => {
                controller.abort();
            };
        },
        [
            runtime,
        ],
    );

    return (
        <BrowserAuthRuntimeContext.Provider
            value={runtime}
        >
            {children}
        </BrowserAuthRuntimeContext.Provider>
    );
}

export function useBrowserAuthRuntime():
    BrowserAuthRuntime {
    const runtime =
        useContext(
            BrowserAuthRuntimeContext,
        );

    if (runtime === null) {
        throw new Error(
            'EduCore BrowserAuth hooks require BrowserAuthProvider.',
        );
    }

    return runtime;
}

export function useBrowserAuthState():
    BrowserAuthState {
    const runtime =
        useBrowserAuthRuntime();

    return useSyncExternalStore(
        runtime.subscribe,
        runtime.getState,
    );
}
EOF
```

## 2. Make cancelled bootstrap state-neutral

Pada `runtime.ts`, ubah bagian awal `applyBootstrapResult()`.

Gunakan fail-closed replacement:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "frontend/src/platform/auth/runtime.ts"
)

text = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

old = """    function applyBootstrapResult(
        result: BrowserApiResult<
            AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess
        >,
    ): BrowserAuthState {
        if (! result.ok) {
            if (
                applyAuthenticationFailure(
                    result,
                )
            ) {
                return state;
            }

            return dispatch({
                type:
                    'BECAME_UNAVAILABLE',
                failure:
                    result,
            });
        }"""

new = """    function applyBootstrapResult(
        result: BrowserApiResult<
            AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess
        >,
    ): BrowserAuthState {
        if (! result.ok) {
            /*
             * Cancellation is a caller lifecycle decision,
             * not authentication truth.
             *
             * This is particularly important for React
             * StrictMode's development-only Effect
             * setup/cleanup probe.
             */
            if (
                result.kind
                    === 'aborted'
            ) {
                return state;
            }

            if (
                applyAuthenticationFailure(
                    result,
                )
            ) {
                return state;
            }

            return dispatch({
                type:
                    'BECAME_UNAVAILABLE',
                failure:
                    result,
            });
        }"""

count = text.count(old)

if count != 1:
    raise SystemExit(
        f"Expected exactly one applyBootstrapResult block, found {count}"
    )

path.write_text(
    text.replace(
        old,
        new,
    ),
    encoding="utf-8",
)
PY
```

## 3. Add runtime regression for cancelled bootstrap

Tambahkan test sebelum test recovery terakhir di:

```text
frontend/src/platform/auth/__tests__/runtime.test.ts
```

Gunakan insertion terkontrol:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "frontend/src/platform/auth/__tests__/runtime.test.ts"
)

text = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

anchor = """        it('recovers unavailable authentication truth through a successful bootstrap retry', async () => {"""

addition = """        it('does not mutate authentication truth when bootstrap is cancelled', async () => {
            const abortedFailure:
                BrowserApiFailure = {
                    ok: false,
                    kind:
                        'aborted',
                    cause:
                        new Error(
                            'Bootstrap cancelled',
                        ),
                };

            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        async bootstrap() {
                            return abortedFailure;
                        },
                    }),
                );

            const before =
                runtime.getState();

            const after =
                await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(after).toBe(
                before,
            );

            expect(after).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unknown',
            });
        });

"""

count = text.count(anchor)

if count != 1:
    raise SystemExit(
        f"Expected exactly one recovery-test anchor, found {count}"
    )

path.write_text(
    text.replace(
        anchor,
        addition + anchor,
    ),
    encoding="utf-8",
)
PY
```

## 4. Integrate provider into `AppBootstrap`

Ganti penuh:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/AppBootstrap.tsx <<'EOF'
import { QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { RouterProvider } from 'react-router/dom';

import { ApplicationErrorBoundary } from '@/app/ApplicationErrorBoundary';
import { BrowserAuthProvider } from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import type { ApplicationRuntime } from '@/app/runtime';

interface AppBootstrapProps {
    runtime: ApplicationRuntime;
}

export function AppBootstrap({
    runtime,
}: AppBootstrapProps) {
    return (
        <ApplicationErrorBoundary>
            <BrowserAuthProvider
                runtime={runtime.auth}
            >
                <QueryClientProvider
                    client={runtime.queryClient}
                >
                    <RouterProvider
                        router={runtime.router}
                    />
                </QueryClientProvider>
            </BrowserAuthProvider>
        </ApplicationErrorBoundary>
    );
}
EOF
```

Composition sekarang:

```text
ApplicationErrorBoundary
└─ BrowserAuthProvider
   └─ QueryClientProvider
      └─ RouterProvider
```

Jadi semua routed components nanti dapat membaca auth state, tetapi router sendiri belum menentukan policy auth.

# 6. Buat dedicated React bridge tests

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/auth/__tests__/BrowserAuthProvider.test.tsx <<'EOF'
import {
    StrictMode,
} from 'react';
import {
    act,
    render,
    screen,
    waitFor,
} from '@testing-library/react';
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    BrowserAuthProvider,
    useBrowserAuthState,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import type {
    BrowserApiFailure,
    BrowserApiResult,
} from '@/platform/api';
import {
    createBrowserAuthRuntime,
    type AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess,
    type BrowserAuthOperations,
} from '@/platform/auth';

const membershipId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab';

const tenantId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7bcd-8def-1234567890ab';

const bootstrapSuccess:
    BrowserApiResult<
        AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess
    > = {
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        data: {
            status:
                'success',
            data: {
                user: {
                    id:
                        '018f3b6a-7c20-7cde-8def-1234567890ab',
                    email:
                        'member@example.com',
                },

                person: {
                    id:
                        '018f3b6a-7c20-7def-8abc-1234567890ab',
                    name:
                        'EduCore Member',
                },

                membership: {
                    id:
                        membershipId,
                    status:
                        'ACTIVE',
                },

                tenant: {
                    id:
                        tenantId,
                    name:
                        'EduCore School',
                    subdomain:
                        'school',
                },
            },
        },
    };

const sessionRequiredFailure:
    BrowserApiFailure = {
        ok: false,
        kind: 'response',
        status: 401,
        error: {
            status:
                'error',
            code:
                'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED',
            message:
                'Authenticated browser session is required.',
        },
    };

const abortedFailure:
    BrowserApiFailure = {
        ok: false,
        kind:
            'aborted',
        cause:
            new Error(
                'Bootstrap cancelled',
            ),
    };

function createOperations(
    bootstrap:
        BrowserAuthOperations['bootstrap'],
): BrowserAuthOperations {
    return {
        bootstrap,

        async login() {
            throw new Error(
                'Unexpected login operation.',
            );
        },

        async logout() {
            throw new Error(
                'Unexpected logout operation.',
            );
        },
    };
}

function AuthStateProbe() {
    const state =
        useBrowserAuthState();

    return (
        <output
            data-testid="auth-state"
        >
            {state.status}
        </output>
    );
}

describe(
    'BrowserAuthProvider',
    () => {
        it('bootstraps initial authentication truth after mount', async () => {
            let bootstrapCalls =
                0;

            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations(
                        async () => {
                            bootstrapCalls +=
                                1;

                            return sessionRequiredFailure;
                        },
                    ),
                );

            render(
                <BrowserAuthProvider
                    runtime={runtime}
                >
                    <AuthStateProbe />
                </BrowserAuthProvider>,
            );

            expect(
                await screen.findByText(
                    'anonymous',
                ),
            ).toBeInTheDocument();

            expect(
                bootstrapCalls,
            ).toBe(1);
        });

        it('re-renders subscribed consumers when authentication state changes', async () => {
            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations(
                        async () =>
                            bootstrapSuccess,
                    ),
                );

            render(
                <BrowserAuthProvider
                    runtime={runtime}
                >
                    <AuthStateProbe />
                </BrowserAuthProvider>,
            );

            expect(
                await screen.findByText(
                    'authenticated',
                ),
            ).toBeInTheDocument();

            act(() => {
                runtime.observeFailure(
                    sessionRequiredFailure,
                );
            });

            expect(
                screen.getByText(
                    'anonymous',
                ),
            ).toBeInTheDocument();
        });

        it('remains deterministic across StrictMode Effect setup and cleanup', async () => {
            let bootstrapCalls =
                0;

            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations(
                        async (
                            options,
                        ) => {
                            bootstrapCalls +=
                                1;

                            if (
                                bootstrapCalls
                                    !== 1
                            ) {
                                return bootstrapSuccess;
                            }

                            const signal =
                                options?.signal;

                            if (
                                signal
                                    === undefined
                            ) {
                                throw new Error(
                                    'Expected bootstrap AbortSignal.',
                                );
                            }

                            return new Promise(
                                (
                                    resolve,
                                ) => {
                                    const resolveAbort =
                                        () => {
                                            window.setTimeout(
                                                () => {
                                                    resolve(
                                                        abortedFailure,
                                                    );
                                                },
                                                10,
                                            );
                                        };

                                    if (
                                        signal.aborted
                                    ) {
                                        resolveAbort();

                                        return;
                                    }

                                    signal.addEventListener(
                                        'abort',
                                        resolveAbort,
                                        {
                                            once:
                                                true,
                                        },
                                    );
                                },
                            );
                        },
                    ),
                );

            render(
                <StrictMode>
                    <BrowserAuthProvider
                        runtime={runtime}
                    >
                        <AuthStateProbe />
                    </BrowserAuthProvider>
                </StrictMode>,
            );

            expect(
                await screen.findByText(
                    'authenticated',
                ),
            ).toBeInTheDocument();

            await waitFor(() => {
                expect(
                    bootstrapCalls,
                ).toBe(2);
            });

            await act(
                async () => {
                    await new Promise(
                        (
                            resolve,
                        ) => {
                            window.setTimeout(
                                resolve,
                                20,
                            );
                        },
                    );
                },
            );

            expect(
                runtime.getState().status,
            ).toBe(
                'authenticated',
            );

            expect(
                screen.getByText(
                    'authenticated',
                ),
            ).toBeInTheDocument();
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. `useSyncExternalStore`, bukan mirrored React state

Kita tidak membuat:

```ts
const [authState, setAuthState] =
    useState(runtime.getState());
```

lalu manual subscription.

Sebaliknya:

```ts
useSyncExternalStore(
    runtime.subscribe,
    runtime.getState,
);
```

React sendiri yang menghubungkan external store dengan render lifecycle. Contract resminya meminta `subscribe` mengembalikan unsubscribe dan `getSnapshot` mengembalikan snapshot yang stabil hingga store berubah. Runtime kita sudah memenuhi pola tersebut. ([React](https://react.dev/reference/react/useSyncExternalStore?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Ini menghindari duplicated state ownership:

```text
BrowserAuthRuntime state      ← canonical
React local auth state        ← tidak dibuat
```

---

## 2. Provider bukan pemilik authentication truth

Provider hanya bridge:

```text
React lifecycle
↔ BrowserAuthRuntime
```

State tetap berada di:

```text
platform/auth/runtime.ts
```

Jadi login/logout/session-expiry tidak diduplikasi ke React context reducer.

---

## 3. Initial bootstrap adalah explicit mount side effect

Composition tetap:

```text
createApplicationRuntime()
→ NO NETWORK
```

Sedangkan:

```text
BrowserAuthProvider mount
→ auth.bootstrap()
```

Ini menjaga FEI-5F.1 invariant.

---

## 4. Cleanup benar-benar membatalkan request

Provider membuat:

```ts
const controller =
    new AbortController();
```

dan cleanup:

```ts
controller.abort();
```

React StrictMode memang sengaja menjalankan setup dan cleanup tambahan dalam development untuk menemukan Effect yang cleanup-nya tidak simetris. ([React](https://react.dev/reference/react/StrictMode?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Kita tidak menonaktifkan StrictMode untuk menyembunyikan behavior tersebut.

---

## 5. Aborted bootstrap tidak mengubah auth truth

Ini bagian penting:

```text
AbortError / aborted result
≠ server unavailable
≠ anonymous
≠ context missing
```

Jadi runtime sekarang:

```ts
if (
    result.kind === 'aborted'
) {
    return state;
}
```

Itu bukan workaround React. Itu semantic model yang lebih benar secara umum: cancellation oleh caller tidak memberi informasi baru tentang server-side authentication.

---

## 6. StrictMode duplicate setup bukan bug yang harus “dihack”

Dedicated test justru mengharapkan dua lifecycle setup pada StrictMode development test:

```text
bootstrap #1
→ aborted by cleanup

bootstrap #2
→ succeeds
```

Yang kita kunci adalah:

```text
late aborted result #1
MUST NOT
authenticated #2 → unavailable
```

React mendokumentasikan development-only extra Effect setup+cleanup sebagai stress test cleanup logic. ([React](https://react.dev/reference/react/StrictMode?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Kita tidak membuat module-global boolean seperti:

```ts
let hasBootstrapped = true;
```

karena itu akan rusak saat legitimate unmount/remount.

---

## 7. Existing AppBootstrap test tetap fail-closed

MSW handler `/auth/me` dibuat **lokal di test**.

Kita tidak menambahkan:

```text
global default /auth/me → 401
```

ke `test/server.ts`.

Karena konfigurasi:

```text
onUnhandledRequest: 'error'
```

tetap penting untuk menangkap network side effect yang tidak disengaja.

---

## 8. Router belum mengenal auth

Masih tidak ada:

```text
RequireAuth
ProtectedRoute
redirect('/login')
loader auth guard
```

Authentication truth sudah tersedia untuk component tree, tetapi routing policy belum kita campurkan ke FEI-5.

# Troubleshooting

Jika StrictMode test mendapat **dua bootstrap calls**, itu expected pada development StrictMode; jangan mengubah expectation menjadi satu dan jangan menghapus `<StrictMode>` dari `main.tsx`. React memang melakukan extra setup+cleanup untuk Effect dalam development. ([React](https://react.dev/reference/react/StrictMode?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Jika final state menjadi `unavailable`, kirim exact order/call output. Itu berarti late cancellation masih dapat menimpa canonical bootstrap result dan runtime gate belum benar.

Jika `useSyncExternalStore` menghasilkan infinite loop warning, jangan mengganti ke `useState`. Kita audit snapshot identity; React mensyaratkan snapshot tetap sama selama external store belum berubah. ([React](https://react.dev/reference/react/useSyncExternalStore?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Jika existing `AppBootstrap.test.tsx` menghasilkan unhandled `/auth/me`, pastikan handler test lokal dipasang **sebelum** `render()`.

```text
test
cleanup
```

Ini juga lebih tepat daripada memasang `cleanup()` hanya pada `BrowserAuthProvider.test.tsx`, karena semua React/RTL test di repository harus mempunyai isolation yang sama.

### Kenapa cleanup sebelum `resetHandlers()`?

Unmount React dapat menjalankan Effect cleanup:

```text
BrowserAuthProvider unmount
→ controller.abort()
```

Jadi kita selesaikan lifecycle component terlebih dahulu, kemudian membersihkan MSW handler state.

Dengan demikian urutan test teardown menjadi:

```text
React cleanup
    ↓
Effect cleanup / abort
    ↓
MSW resetHandlers
```

Khususnya, jangan mengubah:

atau StrictMode handling.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Expected ownership akhir:

```text
createBrowserApiClient
→ platform/api/browser-client.ts
→ app/runtime.ts

createBrowserAuthOperations
→ platform/auth/operations.ts
→ app/runtime.ts

createBrowserAuthRuntime
→ platform/auth/runtime.ts
→ app/runtime.ts

initial runtime.auth.bootstrap()
→ app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider.tsx only
```

Canonical endpoint ownership seharusnya:

```text
/browser/session/csrf
→ auth service/logout tests + production service/logout

/browser/auth/login
→ service.ts

/browser/auth/logout
→ logout.ts

/api/v1/auth/me
→ bootstrap.ts
```

Tidak boleh ada:

```text
/api/v1/browser/auth/me
```

karena endpoint transitional itu sudah diretiré sebelumnya.

### Security final

Production FEI-5 tidak boleh mempunyai:

```text
access token storage
refresh token storage
Authorization writer
session cookie access
raw fetch
message parsing
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Kita belum langsung membuat `MembershipProvider` karena ada keputusan arsitektur penting yang harus berasal dari **current backend contract**, bukan asumsi frontend.

Target model kemungkinan besar akan berbentuk seperti ini:

```text
Authenticated identity
        │
        │ initial membership
        ▼
MembershipContextRuntime
        │
        ├─ discoverMemberships()
        │
        ├─ selectMembership()
        │
        └─ getCurrentContext()
                 │
                 ▼
explicit membership locator
```

Tetapi kita baru mengunci desain tersebut setelah audit.

### 1. Membership list berbeda dari current membership

Kita harus mempertahankan separation:

```text
availableMemberships[]
```

berbeda dengan:

```text
currentMembership
```

Contoh:

```text
available:
- School A
- School B
- School C

current tab:
- School B
```

Jangan membuat satu field yang mempunyai dua arti.

---

### 2. Tenant harus berasal dari Membership

Frontend tidak boleh membuat relasi independen seperti:

```ts
setTenant(tenantId);
setMembership(membershipId);
```

karena itu membuka kemungkinan:

```text
membership A
+
tenant B
```

Context FEI-6 harus mempertahankan pasangan canonical:

```text
Membership → Tenant
```

---

### 3. Tidak boleh ada browser-global active membership

Kita secara khusus mencari:

```text
active_membership_id
active_tenant_id
```

karena desain multi-tab kita tidak boleh bergantung pada:

```text
Tab A chooses Tenant A
        ↓
server global session switches
        ↓
Tab B unexpectedly becomes Tenant A
```

Target kita tetap:

```text
Tab A
membership locator A

Tab B
membership locator B
```

dengan credential custody tetap server-side.

---

### 4. Membership switch bukan authentication authority

Walaupun endpoint switch berhasil, frontend belum boleh langsung menganggap semua identity/context canonical telah benar hanya berdasarkan optimistic local assignment.

Lifecycle yang kemungkinan akan kita kunci:

```text
select target membership
        ↓
Browser membership switch
        ↓
server prepares target credential
        ↓
GET /api/v1/auth/me
with target membership locator
        ↓
canonical identity confirmed
        ↓
frontend context committed
```

Dengan pola itu:

```text
switch response
≠ final authentication truth

/auth/me
= canonical context confirmation
```

Audit backend akan memastikan apakah ini memang contract current repository.

---

### 5. FEI-6 tidak boleh memindahkan authorization

Jangan sampai membership state berkembang menjadi:

```ts
membership.roles
membership.isAdmin
membership.permissionsGuess
```

Authorization tetap FEI-8 dan canonical:

```text
permissions[]
```

FEI-6 hanya context selection.

```bash
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export async function discoverBrowserMemberships(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
    options:
        DiscoverBrowserMembershipsOptions = {},
): Promise<
    BrowserApiResult<
        MembershipListSuccess
    >
> {
    const requestOptions =
        options.signal === undefined
            ? {}
            : {
                signal:
                    options.signal,
            };

    return executeBrowserApiRequest(
        client.GET(
            '/api/v1/user/my-memberships',
            requestOptions,
        ),
    );
}
EOF
```

Perhatikan kita **tidak** memanggil:

```ts
createBrowserMembershipHeaderParams(...)
```

karena contract discovery memang sengaja tidak menerima locator. `Pasted text (2).txt`

```bash
            const result =

                    client,

                        signal:

                throw new Error(

            }
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Discovery tidak mempunyai current context

Ini sengaja salah:

```ts
discoverBrowserMemberships(
    client,
    {
        membershipId:
            currentMembershipId,
    },
);
```

Karena tujuan endpoint justru menemukan membership yang tersedia sebelum context dipilih. Contract OpenAPI menegaskan bahwa operation ini identity-scope dan tidak membutuhkan membership locator. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Dependency-nya:

```text
authenticated Person
        ↓
GET /my-memberships
        ↓
MembershipSummary[]
```

bukan:

```text
current membership
        ↓
membership list
```

---

## 2. Tenant selalu menjadi bagian MembershipSummary

Kita tidak menghasilkan:

```ts
MembershipSummary
+
separate Tenant[]
```

Canonical projection sudah memasangkan:

```text
membership_id
membership_status
tenant_id
tenant_name
tenant_subdomain
```

`Pasted text.txt`

Jadi frontend tidak perlu melakukan join sendiri yang berisiko menghasilkan membership/tenant mismatch.

---

## 3. Empty list bukan failure

Canonical:

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": []
}
```

tetap success.

FEI-6C nanti yang menentukan semantic UI/state untuk:

```text
authenticated Person
+
zero active memberships
```

Transport service tidak boleh mengubahnya menjadi invented error.

---

## 4. Authentication failure tidak ditangani di service ini

Jika discovery menerima:

```text
401 BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
```

service hanya mengembalikan canonical failure.

Kita belum membuat:

```ts
authRuntime.observeFailure(...)
```

di FEI-6B.

Itu orchestration concern FEI-6E.

Dengan demikian:

```text
membership transport
≠ authentication state machine
```

---

## 5. Context mismatch juga dipertahankan

Discovery contract dapat menghasilkan `403 BrowserSessionContextMismatchError`. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Kita tidak mengubah:

```text
403
→ anonymous
```

di layer ini.

Classification/orchestration dilakukan pada layer runtime yang tepat.

---

## 6. Browser-only switch belum disentuh

Walaupun audit juga menemukan bearer switch:

```text
/api/v1/user/memberships/{membership_id}/switch
```

frontend SPA **tidak boleh menggunakan endpoint itu**, karena success bearer variant justru berisi `access_token`. Generated schema menunjukkan perbedaan tersebut. `Pasted text.txt`

Untuk SPA nanti hanya:

```text
/api/v1/browser/user/memberships/{membership_id}/switch
```

yang boleh digunakan.

Kita akan mengunci invariant ini di FEI-6D.

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak salah satu canonical error fixture karena exact generated schema berbeda, jangan cast dan jangan pakai `any`; kirim exact error.

Jika `tenant_subdomain` ternyata nullable pada runtime test tetapi generated `MembershipSummary` mengatakan `string`, jangan mengubah frontend type. Itu berarti backend/OpenAPI drift yang perlu ditangani terpisah.

Jika cancellation tetap dispatch request, jangan melemahkan test.

Jika grep locator menemukan header hanya di test karena assertion bahwa header absent, itu valid; **production** `discovery.ts` tetap tidak boleh membuat locator.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita perlu memisahkan tiga hal yang secara semantik berbeda:

```text
availableMemberships[]
        ≠
target membership
        ≠
canonical current context
```

Canonical current context hanya dianggap benar setelah `/auth/me` mengonfirmasi pasangan:

```text
Membership
    +
Tenant
```

State yang kita kunci:

```text
unresolved
    ↓
discovering
    ├─ empty
    ├─ selection-required
    ├─ ready
    └─ unavailable

ready / selection-required
    ↓
switching
    ├─ context confirmed → ready
    └─ switch failed → kembali ke stable state
```

Ada dua invariant penting.

Pertama, jika auth sudah mempunyai canonical context:

```text
membership A
tenant A
```

maka discovery harus memuat pasangan tersebut. Kita tidak boleh menerima:

```text
/auth/me        → membership A / tenant A
discovery list  → membership B / tenant B only
```

secara diam-diam.

Kedua, **switch target tidak langsung menjadi current context**:

```text
SWITCH_STARTED(target B)
```

hanya menghasilkan:

```text
status: switching
target: B
current context: A
```

Baru canonical confirmation setelah `/auth/me` boleh mengubah context menjadi B.

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Extend membership contract

Ganti `frontend/src/platform/membership/contract.ts`:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/membership/contract.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    ApiComponents,
} from '@/platform/api';

export type MembershipSummary =
    ApiComponents['schemas']['MembershipSummary'];

export type MembershipListSuccess =
    ApiComponents['schemas']['MembershipListSuccess'];

export type CanonicalMembership =
    ApiComponents['schemas']['AuthenticatedMembership'];

export type CanonicalTenant =
    ApiComponents['schemas']['AuthenticatedTenant'];

export interface CanonicalMembershipContext {
    readonly membership:
        CanonicalMembership;

    readonly tenant:
        CanonicalTenant;
}
EOF
```

Kita reuse canonical `/auth/me` shapes, bukan membuat Membership/Tenant identity versi frontend sendiri.

---

## 2. Buat membership state machine

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/membership/state.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    BrowserApiFailure,
} from '@/platform/api';

import type {
    CanonicalMembershipContext,
    MembershipSummary,
} from '@/platform/membership/contract';

export interface UnresolvedMembershipContextState {
    readonly status:
        'unresolved';
}

export interface DiscoveringMembershipContextState {
    readonly status:
        'discovering';

    readonly context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext | null;
}

export interface ReadyMembershipContextState {
    readonly status:
        'ready';

    readonly memberships:
        readonly MembershipSummary[];

    readonly context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext;

    readonly failure:
        BrowserApiFailure | null;
}

export interface SelectionRequiredMembershipContextState {
    readonly status:
        'selection-required';

    readonly memberships:
        readonly MembershipSummary[];

    readonly failure:
        BrowserApiFailure | null;
}

export interface EmptyMembershipContextState {
    readonly status:
        'empty';
}

export interface SwitchingMembershipContextState {
    readonly status:
        'switching';

    readonly memberships:
        readonly MembershipSummary[];

    readonly context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext | null;

    readonly target:
        MembershipSummary;
}

export interface UnavailableMembershipContextState {
    readonly status:
        'unavailable';

    readonly context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext | null;

    readonly failure:
        BrowserApiFailure;
}

export type MembershipContextState =
    | UnresolvedMembershipContextState
    | DiscoveringMembershipContextState
    | ReadyMembershipContextState
    | SelectionRequiredMembershipContextState
    | EmptyMembershipContextState
    | SwitchingMembershipContextState
    | UnavailableMembershipContextState;

export type MembershipContextAction =
    | {
        readonly type:
            'DISCOVERY_STARTED';

        readonly context:
            CanonicalMembershipContext | null;
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'DISCOVERY_READY';

        readonly memberships:
            readonly MembershipSummary[];
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'DISCOVERY_EMPTY';
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'DISCOVERY_UNAVAILABLE';

        readonly failure:
            BrowserApiFailure;
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'SWITCH_STARTED';

        readonly membershipId:
            MembershipSummary['membership_id'];
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'CONTEXT_CONFIRMED';

        readonly context:
            CanonicalMembershipContext;
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'SWITCH_FAILED';

        readonly failure:
            BrowserApiFailure;
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'RESET';
    };

export function createInitialMembershipContextState():
    UnresolvedMembershipContextState {
    return {
        status:
            'unresolved',
    };
}

function invalidTransition(
    state: MembershipContextState,
    action: MembershipContextAction,
): never {
    throw new Error(
        [
            'Invalid EduCore MembershipContext transition:',
            state.status,
            '->',
            action.type,
        ].join(' '),
    );
}

function findMembership(
    memberships:
        readonly MembershipSummary[],
    membershipId:
        MembershipSummary['membership_id'],
): MembershipSummary | undefined {
    return memberships.find(
        (membership) =>
            membership.membership_id
                === membershipId,
    );
}

function contextMatchesMembership(
    context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
    membership:
        MembershipSummary,
): boolean {
    return (
        context.membership.id
            === membership.membership_id
        && context.tenant.id
            === membership.tenant_id
    );
}

function assertNonEmptyMemberships(
    memberships:
        readonly MembershipSummary[],
): void {
    if (memberships.length === 0) {
        throw new Error(
            'EduCore MembershipContext ready state requires at least one Membership.',
        );
    }
}

export function membershipContextReducer(
    state: MembershipContextState,
    action: MembershipContextAction,
): MembershipContextState {
    switch (action.type) {
        case 'DISCOVERY_STARTED':
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'unresolved'
                && state.status
                    !== 'unavailable'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'discovering',
                context:
                    action.context,
            };

        case 'DISCOVERY_READY': {
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'discovering'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            assertNonEmptyMemberships(
                action.memberships,
            );

            if (
                state.context
                    === null
            ) {
                return {
                    status:
                        'selection-required',
                    memberships:
                        action.memberships,
                    failure:
                        null,
                };
            }

            const currentMembership =
                findMembership(
                    action.memberships,
                    state.context
                        .membership.id,
                );

            if (
                currentMembership
                    === undefined
                || ! contextMatchesMembership(
                    state.context,
                    currentMembership,
                )
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    'EduCore MembershipContext discovery does not contain the canonical Membership/Tenant context.',
                );
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'ready',
                memberships:
                    action.memberships,
                context:
                    state.context,
                failure:
                    null,
            };
        }

        case 'DISCOVERY_EMPTY':
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'discovering'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            if (
                state.context
                    !== null
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    'EduCore MembershipContext cannot become empty while canonical Membership/Tenant context exists.',
                );
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'empty',
            };

        case 'DISCOVERY_UNAVAILABLE':
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'discovering'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'unavailable',
                context:
                    state.context,
                failure:
                    action.failure,
            };

        case 'SWITCH_STARTED': {
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'ready'
                && state.status
                    !== 'selection-required'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            const target =
                findMembership(
                    state.memberships,
                    action.membershipId,
                );

            if (
                target
                    === undefined
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    'EduCore MembershipContext switch target is not available to the authenticated Person.',
                );
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'switching',
                memberships:
                    state.memberships,
                context:
                    state.status
                        === 'ready'
                        ? state.context
                        : null,
                target,
            };
        }

        case 'CONTEXT_CONFIRMED':
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'switching'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            if (
                ! contextMatchesMembership(
                    action.context,
                    state.target,
                )
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    'EduCore MembershipContext canonical confirmation does not match the requested switch target.',
                );
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'ready',
                memberships:
                    state.memberships,
                context:
                    action.context,
                failure:
                    null,
            };

        case 'SWITCH_FAILED':
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'switching'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            if (
                state.context
                    === null
            ) {
                return {
                    status:
                        'selection-required',
                    memberships:
                        state.memberships,
                    failure:
                        action.failure,
                };
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'ready',
                memberships:
                    state.memberships,
                context:
                    state.context,
                failure:
                    action.failure,
            };

        case 'RESET':
            return createInitialMembershipContextState();
    }
}
EOF
```

```bash
        it('restores the previous stable context when switching fails', () => {
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. `selection-required` dibuat eksplisit

Kita tidak menggunakan:

```ts
{
    status: 'ready',
    context: null,
}
```

karena `ready` tetapi tidak punya current context ambigu.

Sekarang:

```text
memberships exist + no canonical context
→ selection-required
```

Sedangkan:

```text
memberships exist + canonical context
→ ready
```

Lebih mudah dipahami oleh UI dan runtime.

### 2. Current context tidak berasal dari `MembershipSummary`

Discovery memberi kandidat:

```text
MembershipSummary[]
```

Tetapi canonical current context berasal dari:

```text
/auth/me
→ AuthenticatedMembership
→ AuthenticatedTenant
```

Karena switch response browser hanya membuktikan bahwa credential berhasil dipersiapkan server-side; `/auth/me` dengan locator target tetap menjadi confirmation authority. Audit FEI-6A mendukung pemisahan ini. 

### 3. Target switch tidak mengganti context secara optimistik

Saat:

```text
A current
→ user selects B
```

state menjadi:

```text
switching
current context = A
target          = B
```

bukan:

```text
current context = B   ❌ terlalu dini
```

Jika switch/network gagal, kita dapat kembali ke A karena browser switch memang tidak mengganti global active membership shared session. `Pasted text (2).txt`

### 4. Membership/Tenant pair divalidasi bersama

Reducer tidak hanya memeriksa:

```text
membership.id
```

tetapi:

```text
membership.id
+
tenant.id
```

Ini mencegah malformed state:

```text
Membership A + Tenant B
```

### 5. Discovery contradiction fail-closed

Kalau `/auth/me` menyatakan:

```text
Membership A ACTIVE
```

tetapi `/my-memberships` tidak memiliki Membership A/Tenant A, kita tidak memilih membership lain secara otomatis.

Itu merupakan canonical contract inconsistency dan harus berhenti secara eksplisit.

### 6. Switch failure tidak berarti context hilang

Karena target credential preparation tidak mengganti current tab context sampai canonical confirmation, failure:

```text
switch A → B fails
```

menghasilkan:

```text
ready
context = A
failure = ...
```

bukan:

```text
unavailable
context = unknown
```

Ini akan penting pada FEI-6E.

## Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript mempermasalahkan `memberships[1]` pada test karena `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, jangan cast. Kirim exact error; kita ubah fixture menjadi named `membershipA` / `membershipB`.

Jika state test menemukan `MembershipSummary.membership_status` bukan literal `ACTIVE`, itu expected dari OpenAPI saat ini karena field tersebut bertipe `string`; jangan mempersempit frontend contract secara manual.

Jika test canonical mismatch gagal karena reducer menerima Membership A/Tenant B, jangan melemahkan test-itu invariant FEI-6.

## Langkah Berikutnya

Jika FEI-6C hijau:

```text
FEI-6A - Canonical Contract Audit         ✅
FEI-6B - Contract + Discovery             ✅
FEI-6C - Membership Context State Model   ✅
FEI-6D - Browser Membership Switch        ← NEXT
```

FEI-6D baru akan menambahkan endpoint browser-safe:

```text
POST /api/v1/browser/user/memberships/{membership_id}/switch
```

dengan CSRF bootstrap, **tanpa pernah menyentuh bearer switch endpoint atau `access_token`**.

Sekarang kita masuk **FEI-6D - Browser Membership Switch Lifecycle**.

Browser switch yang canonical adalah `POST /api/v1/browser/user/memberships/{membership_id}/switch`. Endpoint ini request-forgery-protected, menyimpan credential baru hanya di server-side BrowserSession custody, mempertahankan credential membership lain untuk tab independen, tidak menulis global active membership, dan tidak pernah mengembalikan `access_token`. `Pasted text (2).txt` Success browser hanya membawa `membership_id`, `tenant_id`, dan `tenant_name`. `Pasted text.txt`

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

FEI-6D hanya membuat **transport lifecycle**:

```text
target Membership
      ↓
GET /browser/session/csrf
      ↓
POST /browser/user/memberships/{id}/switch
      ↓
BrowserMembershipSwitchSuccess
```

Yang **belum** dilakukan:

```text
switch success
→ current context B        ❌
```

Itu baru boleh terjadi nanti setelah:

```text
browser switch success
        ↓
/auth/me + target locator
        ↓
CONTEXT_CONFIRMED
```

Jadi FEI-6D tidak menyentuh reducer orchestration.

Kita juga akan membuat request-option helper internal supaya discovery dan switch tidak menduplikasi aturan `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`.

## 4. Implement browser-safe switch service

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/membership/switch.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    executeBrowserApiRequest,
    type BrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserApiResult,
} from '@/platform/api';

import type {
    BrowserMembershipSwitchSuccess,
    BrowserMembershipSwitchTarget,
} from '@/platform/membership/contract';
import { createMembershipRequestAbortOptions } from '@/platform/membership/request-options';

export interface SwitchBrowserMembershipOptions {
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export async function switchBrowserMembership(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
    membershipId:
        BrowserMembershipSwitchTarget,
    options:
        SwitchBrowserMembershipOptions = {},
): Promise<
    BrowserApiResult<
        BrowserMembershipSwitchSuccess
    >
> {
    const abortOptions =
        createMembershipRequestAbortOptions(
            options.signal,
        );

    const csrfResult =
        await executeBrowserApiRequest(
            client.GET(
                '/api/v1/browser/session/csrf',
                abortOptions,
            ),
        );

    if (! csrfResult.ok) {
        return csrfResult;
    }

    return executeBrowserApiRequest(
        client.POST(
            '/api/v1/browser/user/memberships/{membership_id}/switch',
            {
                ...abortOptions,

                params: {
                    path: {
                        membership_id:
                            membershipId,
                    },
                },
            },
        ),
    );
}
EOF
```

```bash
            }

            expect(result.kind).toBe(
                'aborted',
            );
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Hanya browser switch yang boleh digunakan

Ada dua endpoint:

```text
Bearer:
POST /api/v1/user/memberships/{membership_id}/switch

Browser:
POST /api/v1/browser/user/memberships/{membership_id}/switch
```

Bearer variant mengembalikan `MembershipSwitchSuccess` yang berisi `access_token`. Browser variant tidak. `Pasted text.txt`

SPA kita hanya mengimplementasikan browser variant.

---

### 2. Switch mutation harus melalui CSRF bootstrap

Endpoint browser ditandai:

```text
x-educore-request-forgery-protected: true
```

`Pasted text (2).txt`

Jadi:

```text
CSRF failure
→ switch POST tidak dikirim
```

Ini sama dengan security lifecycle login/logout.

---

### 3. Switch success belum mengubah current context

`switchBrowserMembership()` hanya mengembalikan:

```ts
BrowserApiResult<
    BrowserMembershipSwitchSuccess
>
```

Ia tidak memanggil reducer dan tidak menulis current membership.

Ini menjaga:

```text
transport service
≠ context authority
```

FEI-6E nanti yang melakukan:

```text
SWITCH_STARTED
→ browser switch
→ auth bootstrap target locator
→ CONTEXT_CONFIRMED
```

---

### 4. Credential membership lama tetap valid

Backend secara eksplisit menyimpan credential target baru sambil mempertahankan credential membership yang sudah dipersiapkan sebelumnya untuk tab independen. Tidak ada shared `active_membership_id` atau `active_tenant_id`. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Karena itu tidak ada alasan frontend melakukan global state mutation di service ini.

---

### 5. Failure dipertahankan canonical

Kita tidak mengubah:

```text
403 MEMBERSHIP_SWITCH_DENIED
422 INVALID_BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_ID
503 BROWSER_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE
```

menjadi custom frontend strings/status.

Generated browser operation memang mengunci respons `200/401/403/422/500/503`. `Pasted text.txt`

---
