## Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak `params.membership_id` pada MSW handler, kirim exact error; jangan memakai `any`.

Jika canonical error message pada `MEMBERSHIP_SWITCH_DENIED` atau `BROWSER_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE` berbeda dari fixture, kirim compiler/test output dan kita selaraskan dengan runtime contract tanpa message parsing.

Jika bearer endpoint muncul di production membership source, jangan lanjut.

Jika `access_token` muncul hanya karena generated contract tidak berada di `platform/membership`, itu tidak relevan; production FEI-6D sendiri harus tetap bersih.

Jika FEI-6D hijau:

```text

```

FEI-6E baru akan menghubungkan:

```text
auth identity
        ↓

        ↓
membership runtime
        ↓
switch target
        ↓
browser credential preparation
        ↓
auth.bootstrap({ membershipId: target })
        ↓
canonical context confirmation
```

tanpa React provider dulu.

```ts
params.membership_id
```

Handler MSW saat ini memakai URL konkret:


bukan route pattern `:membership_id`. Karena URL tersebut sudah literal, MSW tidak membentuk route parameter bernama `membership_id`, sehingga `params.membership_id` menjadi `undefined` dan akhirnya `observedMembershipId = null`.

Kita perbaiki **test saja**. Production code tidak perlu disentuh.

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Gate kecil ini adalah **FEI-6D.1 — Membership Switch Path Assertion Fix**.

Kita ingin test membuktikan dua hal secara terpisah:

```text
1. request mencapai canonical browser switch endpoint
2. target membership ID benar-benar berada di pathname
```

Cara paling tepat adalah membaca:

```ts
new URL(request.url).pathname
```

bukan mengandalkan `params` dari handler literal.

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Sebelumnya test secara implisit mengasumsikan:

```ts
http.post(
    '/memberships/<literal UUID>/switch',
    ({ params }) => {
        params.membership_id;
    },
);
```

Padahal route tersebut bukan parameterized MSW route.

Agar `params.membership_id` tersedia, handler harus berbentuk semacam:

```ts
http.post(
    '/memberships/:membership_id/switch',
    ...
);
```

Tetapi kita sebenarnya tidak membutuhkan parsing route parameter di sini. Yang ingin dibuktikan adalah request dari generated OpenAPI client menghasilkan path yang benar.

Maka assertion yang lebih langsung adalah:

```ts
expect(
    new URL(request.url).pathname,
).toBe(
    `/api/v1/browser/user/memberships/${membershipId}/switch`,
);
```

Ini justru lebih kuat untuk contract test karena membuktikan **actual outgoing URL**.

### Jangan ubah production code

Jangan mengganti:

```ts
params: {
    path: {
        membership_id:
            membershipId,
    },
},
```

di `switch.ts`.

Generated OpenAPI client sudah membuktikan interpolasinya berhasil karena request handler literal tersebut berhasil menerima POST dan mengembalikan success response.

Kalau interpolation production salah, MSW handler:

```text
/api/v1/browser/user/memberships/<expected-id>/switch
```

tidak akan pernah match.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Yang paling penting di gate ini bukan hanya jumlah test.

Kita juga memastikan production membership layer tetap mengikuti boundary:

```text

→ GET /api/v1/user/my-memberships

switch.ts
→ GET /api/v1/browser/session/csrf
→ POST /api/v1/browser/user/memberships/{membership_id}/switch
```

Dan tetap **tidak** melakukan:

```text
Bearer membership switch
access_token handling
Authorization header
global membership storage
React state
membership reducer mutation
```

Artinya FEI-6D tetap sebuah transport service, bukan context authority.

> **Designing membership orchestration**
>
> I’m considering an auth-aware membership runtime with explicit bootstrapping, subscriptions, context discovery, reset behavior, and fail-closed handling. I’m weighing whether anonymous or unresolved auth states should reset quietly or remain unresolved.
>
> **Designed membership orchestration**
>
> 
>
> **Handling concurrency safely**
>
> I’m preserving stable membership state during aborted or failed operations, while guarding against stale responses overwriting newer results. Authentication failures should reset membership, whereas validation or service errors should retain the prior context with an appropriate failure state.
>
> **Handled concurrency safely**
>
> 
>

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Runtime ini akan menjadi coordinator antara tiga boundary yang sudah ada:

```text
BrowserAuthRuntime
        │
        │ canonical auth truth
        ▼
MembershipContextRuntime
        │
        ├── discover()
        │
        └── switchMembership()
                  │
                  ▼
        browser credential preparation
                  │
                  ▼
        auth.bootstrap({
            membershipId: target
        })
                  │
                  ▼
        canonical /auth/me confirmation
```

Invariant paling penting:

```text
browser switch success
        ≠
membership context confirmed
```

Context baru hanya boleh di-commit setelah `BrowserAuthRuntime.bootstrap({ membershipId })` menghasilkan canonical authenticated identity yang cocok dengan target.

Kita juga perlu menyiapkan runtime supaya nanti aman terhadap React StrictMode:

```text
bootstrap #1
→ cancelled

bootstrap #2
→ succeeds

late result #1
→ MUST NOT overwrite #2
```

Karena itu runtime akan memakai **operation revision + stable-state rollback**.

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Izinkan restart discovery yang aman

Saat StrictMode nanti menjalankan Effect setup dua kali, discovery kedua harus boleh menggantikan discovery pertama.

Patch `frontend/src/platform/membership/state.ts`:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "frontend/src/platform/membership/state.ts"
)

text = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

old = """        case 'DISCOVERY_STARTED':
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'unresolved'
                && state.status
                    !== 'unavailable'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }"""

new = """        case 'DISCOVERY_STARTED':
            /*
             * Discovery may restart from any stable state or
             * replace another in-flight discovery.
             *
             * Runtime operation revisions ensure stale
             * asynchronous results cannot overwrite the
             * latest discovery.
             *
             * A Membership switch is the only state that
             * cannot be interrupted by discovery.
             */
            if (
                state.status
                    === 'switching'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }"""

count = text.count(old)

if count != 1:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Expected exactly one DISCOVERY_STARTED guard, "
        f"found {count}"
    )

path.write_text(
    text.replace(
        old,
        new,
    ),
    encoding="utf-8",
)
PY
```

```bash
import type {
    BrowserApiClient,

import {

    switchBrowserMembership,

} from '@/platform/membership/switch';

    BrowserMembershipSwitchTarget,
} from '@/platform/membership/contract';

export interface MembershipContextOperations {
    discover(
        options?:
            DiscoverBrowserMembershipsOptions,
    ): ReturnType<
        typeof discoverBrowserMemberships
    >;

    switchMembership(
        membershipId:
            BrowserMembershipSwitchTarget,
        options?:
            SwitchBrowserMembershipOptions,
    ): ReturnType<
        typeof switchBrowserMembership
    >;
}

export function createMembershipContextOperations(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
): MembershipContextOperations {
    return {
        discover(
            options,
        ) {
            return discoverBrowserMemberships(
                client,
                options,
            );
        },

        switchMembership(
            membershipId,
            options,
        ) {
            return switchBrowserMembership(
                client,
                membershipId,
                options,
            );
        },
    };
}
EOF
```

## 3. Buat MembershipContextRuntime

Buat `frontend/src/platform/membership/runtime.ts`:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/membership/runtime.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    isBrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredFailure,
    type BrowserAuthRuntime,
    type BrowserAuthState,
} from '@/platform/auth';

import type {
    BrowserMembershipSwitchTarget,
    CanonicalMembershipContext,
} from '@/platform/membership/contract';
import type {
    MembershipContextOperations,
} from '@/platform/membership/operations';
import { createMembershipRequestAbortOptions } from '@/platform/membership/request-options';
import {
    createInitialMembershipContextState,
    membershipContextReducer,
    type MembershipContextAction,
    type MembershipContextState,
} from '@/platform/membership/state';

export interface MembershipContextRuntimeOptions {
    readonly signal?:
        AbortSignal;
}

export type MembershipAuthenticationRuntime =
    Pick<
        BrowserAuthRuntime,
        | 'getState'
        | 'bootstrap'
        | 'observeFailure'
    >;

export interface MembershipContextRuntime {
    getState():
        MembershipContextState;

    subscribe(
        listener: () => void,
    ): () => void;

    bootstrap(
        options?:
            MembershipContextRuntimeOptions,
    ): Promise<
        MembershipContextState
    >;

    switchMembership(
        membershipId:
            BrowserMembershipSwitchTarget,
        options?:
            MembershipContextRuntimeOptions,
    ): Promise<
        MembershipContextState
    >;

    reset():
        MembershipContextState;
}

function canonicalContextFromAuthentication(
    state: BrowserAuthState,
):
    | CanonicalMembershipContext
    | null
    | undefined {
    if (
        state.status
            === 'authenticated'
    ) {
        return {
            membership:
                state.identity.membership,

            tenant:
                state.identity.tenant,
        };
    }

    if (
        state.status
            === 'membership-context-required'
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    /*
     * undefined means the authentication runtime is
     * currently not eligible for Membership discovery:
     *
     * unknown
     * anonymous
     * authenticating
     * resolving-context
     * logging-out
     * unavailable
     */
    return undefined;
}

function isTransientState(
    state: MembershipContextState,
): boolean {
    return (
        state.status
            === 'discovering'
        || state.status
            === 'switching'
    );
}

export function createMembershipContextRuntime(
    operations:
        MembershipContextOperations,
    authentication:
        MembershipAuthenticationRuntime,
): MembershipContextRuntime {
    let state:
        MembershipContextState =
            createInitialMembershipContextState();

    /*
     * Stable state is deliberately kept separately from
     * transient discovering/switching state.
     *
     * Cancellation therefore restores the last meaningful
     * state instead of leaving the runtime stuck in an
     * in-flight state.
     */
    let stableState:
        MembershipContextState =
            state;

    let operationRevision =
        0;

    const listeners =
        new Set<
            () => void
        >();

    const getState = () =>
        state;

    const subscribe = (
        listener: () => void,
    ) => {
        listeners.add(
            listener,
        );

        return () => {
            listeners.delete(
                listener,
            );
        };
    };

    const notify = () => {
        for (
            const listener
            of listeners
        ) {
            listener();
        }
    };

    const replaceState = (
        next:
            MembershipContextState,
    ) => {
        if (
            Object.is(
                state,
                next,
            )
        ) {
            return state;
        }

        state =
            next;

        if (
            ! isTransientState(
                next,
            )
        ) {
            stableState =
                next;
        }

        notify();

        return state;
    };

    const dispatch = (
        action:
            MembershipContextAction,
    ) =>
        replaceState(
            membershipContextReducer(
                state,
                action,
            ),
        );

    const reset = () => {
        /*
         * Invalidate every outstanding asynchronous
         * operation before resetting local Membership
         * truth.
         */
        operationRevision +=
            1;

        return dispatch({
            type:
                'RESET',
        });
    };

    const bootstrap = async (
        options:
            MembershipContextRuntimeOptions = {},
    ): Promise<
        MembershipContextState
    > => {
        /*
         * Discovery must never interrupt credential
         * preparation + canonical context confirmation.
         */
        if (
            state.status
                === 'switching'
        ) {
            return state;
        }

        const authenticationState =
            authentication.getState();

        const context =
            canonicalContextFromAuthentication(
                authenticationState,
            );

        if (
            context
                === undefined
        ) {
            return reset();
        }

        const rollbackState =
            stableState;

        const revision =
            ++operationRevision;

        dispatch({
            type:
                'DISCOVERY_STARTED',
            context,
        });

        const result =
            await operations.discover(
                createMembershipRequestAbortOptions(
                    options.signal,
                ),
            );

        /*
         * A newer operation owns Membership truth now.
         * A late result is intentionally ignored.
         */
        if (
            revision
                !== operationRevision
        ) {
            return state;
        }

        if (
            ! result.ok
        ) {
            /*
             * Cancellation is caller lifecycle, not
             * Membership truth.
             */
            if (
                result.kind
                    === 'aborted'
            ) {
                return replaceState(
                    rollbackState,
                );
            }

            if (
                isBrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredFailure(
                    result,
                )
            ) {
                authentication.observeFailure(
                    result,
                );

                return reset();
            }

            return dispatch({
                type:
                    'DISCOVERY_UNAVAILABLE',
                failure:
                    result,
            });
        }

        try {
            if (
                result.data.data.length
                    === 0
            ) {
                return dispatch({
                    type:
                        'DISCOVERY_EMPTY',
                });
            }

            return dispatch({
                type:
                    'DISCOVERY_READY',
                memberships:
                    result.data.data,
            });
        } catch (error) {
            /*
             * Discovery contradictions are invariant
             * failures. Restore the last stable state
             * before surfacing the programming/server
             * contract error.
             */
            replaceState(
                rollbackState,
            );

            throw error;
        }
    };

    const switchMembership =
        async (
            membershipId:
                BrowserMembershipSwitchTarget,
            options:
                MembershipContextRuntimeOptions = {},
        ): Promise<
            MembershipContextState
        > => {
            const rollbackState =
                stableState;

            const revision =
                ++operationRevision;

            /*
             * The reducer validates both:
             * - current state is switchable
             * - target exists in discovered memberships
             */
            dispatch({
                type:
                    'SWITCH_STARTED',
                membershipId,
            });

            const switchResult =
                await operations.switchMembership(
                    membershipId,
                    createMembershipRequestAbortOptions(
                        options.signal,
                    ),
                );

            if (
                revision
                    !== operationRevision
            ) {
                return state;
            }

            if (
                ! switchResult.ok
            ) {
                if (
                    switchResult.kind
                        === 'aborted'
                ) {
                    return replaceState(
                        rollbackState,
                    );
                }

                if (
                    isBrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredFailure(
                        switchResult,
                    )
                ) {
                    authentication.observeFailure(
                        switchResult,
                    );

                    return reset();
                }

                return dispatch({
                    type:
                        'SWITCH_FAILED',
                    failure:
                        switchResult,
                });
            }

            /*
             * Browser switch success only proves the target
             * credential was prepared in BrowserSession
             * custody.
             *
             * It is NOT yet current Membership truth.
             */
            const confirmedAuthentication =
                await authentication.bootstrap({
                    membershipId,
                    ...createMembershipRequestAbortOptions(
                        options.signal,
                    ),
                });

            if (
                revision
                    !== operationRevision
            ) {
                return state;
            }

            if (
                confirmedAuthentication.status
                    === 'authenticated'
            ) {
                const confirmedContext:
                    CanonicalMembershipContext = {
                        membership:
                            confirmedAuthentication
                                .identity
                                .membership,

                        tenant:
                            confirmedAuthentication
                                .identity
                                .tenant,
                    };

                try {
                    return dispatch({
                        type:
                            'CONTEXT_CONFIRMED',
                        context:
                            confirmedContext,
                    });
                } catch (error) {
                    /*
                     * Authentication confirmed a canonical
                     * Membership/Tenant pair different from
                     * the requested switch target.
                     *
                     * Do not retain either context locally.
                     */
                    reset();

                    throw error;
                }
            }

            /*
             * BrowserAuthRuntime treats an aborted bootstrap
             * as authentication-state-neutral. If target
             * confirmation was cancelled, preserve the
             * previous stable Membership context too.
             */
            if (
                options.signal
                    ?.aborted
                === true
            ) {
                return replaceState(
                    rollbackState,
                );
            }

            /*
             * Canonical authentication confirmation failed
             * or became unavailable.
             *
             * AuthenticationRuntime already owns the exact
             * reason. MembershipRuntime must not claim the
             * previous or target Membership as current when
             * canonical auth truth cannot confirm it.
             */
            return reset();
        };

    return {
        getState,
        subscribe,
        bootstrap,
        switchMembership,
        reset,
    };
}
EOF
```

```bash
function createOperations(
    overrides:
        Partial<
            MembershipContextOperations
        > = {},
): MembershipContextOperations {
    return {
        async discover() {
            return discoverySuccess;
        },

        async switchMembership() {
            return switchSuccess;
        },

        ...overrides,
    };
}

function createAuthenticationHarness(
    initialState:
        BrowserAuthState,
    bootstrapImplementation?:
        MembershipAuthenticationRuntime['bootstrap'],
) {
    let state =
        initialState;

    const observedFailures:
        BrowserApiFailure[] = [];

    const bootstrapMembershipIds:
        Array<
            string | null
        > = [];

    const runtime:
        MembershipAuthenticationRuntime = {
            getState() {
                return state;
            },

            async bootstrap(
                options,
            ) {
                bootstrapMembershipIds.push(
                    options?.membershipId
                        ?? null,
                );

                if (
                    bootstrapImplementation
                        !== undefined
                ) {
                    const next =
                        await bootstrapImplementation(
                            options,
                        );

                    state =
                        next;

                    return next;
                }

                return state;
            },

            observeFailure(
                failure,
            ) {
                observedFailures.push(
                    failure,
                );

                state = {
                    status:
                        'anonymous',
                    failure,
                };

                return state;
            },
        };

    return {
        runtime,

        getState() {
            return state;
        },

        observedFailures,
        bootstrapMembershipIds,
    };
}

describe(
    'MembershipContextRuntime',
    () => {
        it('discovers Memberships against an existing canonical authentication context', async () => {
            const authentication =
                createAuthenticationHarness(
                    authenticatedA,

            const runtime =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    createOperations(),
                    authentication.runtime,
                );

            const state =
                await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'ready',
                memberships,
                context: {
                    membership:
                        authenticatedA
                            .identity
                            .membership,
                    tenant:
                        authenticatedA
                            .identity
                            .tenant,
                },
                failure:
                    null,
            });
        });

        it('discovers Memberships for a BrowserSession that still requires explicit context selection', async () => {
            const authentication =
                createAuthenticationHarness({
                    status:
                        'membership-context-required',
                    failure:
                        membershipRequiredFailure,
                });

            const runtime =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    createOperations(),
                    authentication.runtime,
                );

            const state =
                await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'selection-required',
                memberships,
                failure:
                    null,
            });
        });

        it('does not perform Membership discovery when authentication truth is not eligible', async () => {
            let discoveryCalls =
                0;

            const authentication =
                createAuthenticationHarness({
                    status:
                        'anonymous',
                    failure:
                        null,
                });

            const runtime =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        async discover() {
                            discoveryCalls +=
                                1;

                            return discoverySuccess;
                        },
                    }),
                    authentication.runtime,
                );

            const state =
                await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(
                discoveryCalls,
            ).toBe(0);

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });
        });

        it('propagates BrowserSession expiry discovered through Membership discovery back to authentication truth', async () => {
            const authentication =
                createAuthenticationHarness({
                    status:
                        'membership-context-required',
                    failure:
                        membershipRequiredFailure,
                });

            const runtime =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        async discover() {
                            return sessionRequiredFailure;
                        },
                    }),
                    authentication.runtime,
                );

            const state =
                await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            expect(
                authentication
                    .observedFailures,
            ).toEqual([
                sessionRequiredFailure,
            ]);

            expect(
                authentication.getState()
                    .status,
            ).toBe(
                'anonymous',
            );
        });

        it('fails closed to unavailable when Membership discovery cannot resolve safely', async () => {
            const authentication =
                createAuthenticationHarness({
                    status:
                        'membership-context-required',
                    failure:
                        membershipRequiredFailure,
                });

            const runtime =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        async discover() {
                            return networkFailure;
                        },
                    }),
                    authentication.runtime,
                );

            const state =
                await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unavailable',
                context:
                    null,
                failure:
                    networkFailure,
            });
        });

        it('ignores a late cancelled discovery when a newer discovery already resolved', async () => {
            let discoveryCalls =
                0;

            const authentication =
                createAuthenticationHarness({
                    status:
                        'membership-context-required',
                    failure:
                        membershipRequiredFailure,
                });

            const operations =
                createOperations({
                    discover(
                        options,
                    ) {
                        discoveryCalls +=
                            1;

                        if (
                            discoveryCalls
                                === 1
                        ) {
                            return new Promise(
                                (
                                    resolve,
                                ) => {
                                    options
                                        ?.signal
                                        ?.addEventListener(
                                            'abort',
                                            () => {
                                                setTimeout(
                                                    () => {
                                                        resolve(
                                                            abortedFailure,
                                                        );
                                                    },
                                                    10,
                                                );
                                            },
                                            {
                                                once:
                                                    true,
                                            },
                                        );
                                },
                            );
                        }

                        return Promise.resolve(
                            discoverySuccess,
                        );
                    },
                });

            const runtime =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    operations,
                    authentication.runtime,
                );

            const controller =
                new AbortController();

            const first =
                runtime.bootstrap({
                    signal:
                        controller.signal,
                });

            controller.abort();

            const second =
                await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(second).toEqual({
                status:
                    'selection-required',
                memberships,
                failure:
                    null,
            });

            await first;

            expect(
                runtime.getState(),
            ).toEqual(
                second,
            );

            expect(
                discoveryCalls,
            ).toBe(2);
        });

        it('commits a Membership switch only after canonical authentication confirms the target context', async () => {
            let switchTarget:
                string | null = null;

            const authentication =
                createAuthenticationHarness(
                    authenticatedA,
                    async (
                        options,
                    ) => {
                        expect(
                            options?.membershipId,
                        ).toBe(
                            membershipBId,
                        );

                        return authenticatedB;
                    },
                );

            const runtime =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        async switchMembership(
                            membershipId,
                        ) {
                            switchTarget =
                                membershipId;

                            return switchSuccess;
                        },
                    }),
                    authentication.runtime,
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            const state =
                await runtime.switchMembership(
                    membershipBId,
                );

            expect(
                switchTarget,
            ).toBe(
                membershipBId,
            );

            expect(
                authentication
                    .bootstrapMembershipIds,
            ).toEqual([
                membershipBId,
            ]);

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'ready',
                memberships,
                context: {
                    membership:
                        authenticatedB
                            .identity
                            .membership,
                    tenant:
                        authenticatedB
                            .identity
                            .tenant,
                },
                failure:
                    null,
            });
        });

        it('keeps the previous canonical context when Browser Membership credential preparation fails', async () => {
            const authentication =
                createAuthenticationHarness(
                    authenticatedA,
                );

            const runtime =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        async switchMembership() {
                            return switchDeniedFailure;
                        },
                    }),
                    authentication.runtime,
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            const state =
                await runtime.switchMembership(
                    membershipBId,
                );

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'ready',
                memberships,
                context: {
                    membership:
                        authenticatedA
                            .identity
                            .membership,
                    tenant:
                        authenticatedA
                            .identity
                            .tenant,
                },
                failure:
                    switchDeniedFailure,
            });

            expect(
                authentication
                    .bootstrapMembershipIds,
            ).toEqual([]);
        });

        it('resets Membership truth when BrowserSession expires during switch preparation', async () => {
            const authentication =
                createAuthenticationHarness(
                    authenticatedA,
                );

            const runtime =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        async switchMembership() {
                            return sessionRequiredFailure;
                        },
                    }),
                    authentication.runtime,
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            const state =
                await runtime.switchMembership(
                    membershipBId,
                );

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            expect(
                authentication
                    .observedFailures,
            ).toEqual([
                sessionRequiredFailure,
            ]);

            expect(
                authentication.getState()
                    .status,
            ).toBe(
                'anonymous',
            );
        });

        it('resets Membership truth when target canonical authentication cannot be confirmed', async () => {
            const authentication =
                createAuthenticationHarness(
                    authenticatedA,
                    async () => ({
                        status:
                            'membership-context-required',
                        failure:
                            membershipRequiredFailure,
                    }),
                );

            const runtime =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    createOperations(),
                    authentication.runtime,
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            const state =
                await runtime.switchMembership(
                    membershipBId,
                );

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            expect(
                authentication.getState()
                    .status,
            ).toBe(
                'membership-context-required',
            );
        });

        it('restores the previous stable Membership context when switch preparation is cancelled', async () => {
            const authentication =
                createAuthenticationHarness(
                    authenticatedA,
                );

            const runtime =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    createOperations({
                        async switchMembership() {
                            return abortedFailure;
                        },
                    }),
                    authentication.runtime,
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            const before =
                runtime.getState();

            const after =
                await runtime.switchMembership(
                    membershipBId,
                );

            expect(after).toBe(
                before,
            );

            expect(
                authentication
                    .bootstrapMembershipIds,
            ).toEqual([]);
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Runtime tidak mengetahui HTTP

Dependency-nya:

```text
MembershipContextRuntime
        ↓
MembershipContextOperations
```

bukan:

```text
MembershipContextRuntime
        ↓
client.GET / client.POST
```

Ini mengikuti Dependency Inversion dan membuat runtime mudah diuji.

---

### 2. Authentication tetap source of truth

Runtime membership **tidak membuat identity sendiri**.

Initial canonical context berasal dari:

```text
BrowserAuthRuntime.getState()
    ↓
authenticated.identity.membership
authenticated.identity.tenant
```

Setelah switch:

```text
Browser switch success
        ↓
BrowserAuthRuntime.bootstrap({
    membershipId: target
})
        ↓
authenticated identity
        ↓
CONTEXT_CONFIRMED
```

Jadi frontend tidak mempercayai switch response sebagai authentication authority.

---

### 3. Discovery hanya boleh berjalan pada dua auth conditions

Eligible:

```text
authenticated
membership-context-required
```

Tidak eligible:

```text
unknown
anonymous
authenticating
resolving-context
logging-out
unavailable
```

Dalam keadaan itu Membership runtime kembali ke:

```text
unresolved
```

dan **tidak membuat HTTP request**.

---

### 4. Stable state dipisahkan dari transient state

Transient:

```text
discovering
switching
```

Stable:

```text
unresolved
ready
selection-required
empty
unavailable
```

Jika operasi dibatalkan:

```text
stable A
→ switching
→ abort
→ stable A
```

bukan:

```text
stable A
→ switching
→ abort
→ switching forever
```

---

### 5. Operation revision mencegah stale async overwrite

Contoh:

```text
revision 1 → discovery starts
revision 1 → cancelled

revision 2 → discovery starts
revision 2 → success
             state = selection-required

revision 1 → late aborted result arrives
             ignored
```

Ini pondasi penting sebelum React StrictMode provider.

---

### 6. Session expiry dipropagasikan ke Auth runtime

Jika Membership endpoint menghasilkan:

```text
401 BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
```

runtime tidak sekadar:

```text
membership unavailable
```

tetapi:

```text
authentication.observeFailure()
        ↓
auth = anonymous

membership = unresolved
```

Karena session expiry adalah authentication truth.

---

### 7. Transport switch failure berbeda dari confirmation failure

Jika credential preparation gagal:

```text
403 MEMBERSHIP_SWITCH_DENIED
```

maka context A tetap canonical:

```text
ready
context A
failure = switch denied
```

Tetapi jika switch preparation berhasil lalu `/auth/me` tidak mampu mengonfirmasi B:

```text
switch B success
        ↓
auth bootstrap B fails
        ↓
membership = unresolved
```

Kita **tidak mengklaim A atau B sebagai current context** ketika authentication truth sudah tidak mampu mengonfirmasinya.

---

### 8. `operations.ts` belum di-compose ke application runtime

Sengaja.

Saat ini:

```text
platform/membership runtime
```

masih framework-independent.

Kita belum menambahkan:

```text
ApplicationRuntime.membership
```

Itu dilakukan setelah runtime sendiri terbukti hijau.

---

## Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak `MembershipAuthenticationRuntime['bootstrap']` pada test harness, kirim exact error; jangan gunakan `any`.

Jika runtime race test macet, jangan menghapus test atau operation revision. Itu berarti cancellation path belum menyelesaikan promise dengan benar.

Jika confirmation B menghasilkan mismatch terhadap target B, jangan melemahkan `CONTEXT_CONFIRMED`; kirim exact state karena pairing Membership/Tenant adalah security invariant.

Jika full suite turun dari 91/91, kita belum masuk composition.

```text
ApplicationRuntime
├── apiClient
├── auth
├── membership   ← new
├── queryClient

```

dengan `membership` memakai **apiClient dan auth runtime yang sama**, bukan membuat transport/auth instance kedua.

FEI-6E secara behavior sudah sangat dekat selesai: **91/91 test PASS**, tetapi **typecheck masih gagal**, jadi gate belum boleh dikunci.

Akar masalahnya sudah terkonfirmasi dari transport contract aktual. `BrowserApiSuccess<TData>` memang mendefinisikan `data: TData | undefined`, sehingga `result.ok === true` belum cukup untuk membuktikan response mempunyai body.  API layer juga sudah mempunyai failure resmi `BrowserApiProtocolFailure` dengan `kind: 'protocol'`, `status`, dan canonical protocol message, jadi missing success payload sebaiknya diperlakukan sebagai **protocol failure**, bukan di-cast atau diabaikan. 

Kita lakukan satu repair gate: **FEI-6E.1A - Discovery Success Payload Narrowing**.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Saat ini runtime secara implisit menganggap:

```text
HTTP success
=
payload pasti ada
```

Padahal transport abstraction sengaja mendukung endpoint `204`, sehingga model generiknya adalah:

```ts
{
    ok: true;
    data: T | undefined;
}
```

Membership discovery berbeda: contract-nya membutuhkan `MembershipListSuccess`.

Jadi boundary yang benar:

```text
result.ok === true
        ↓
result.data exists?
   ├─ no  → protocol failure → unavailable
   └─ yes → inspect memberships[]
```

Kita **tidak** menggunakan:

```ts
result.data!
result.data as MembershipListSuccess
```

karena itu hanya membungkam compiler dan menghilangkan runtime protection.

## Kode Lengkap

### 1. Tambahkan protocol failure type

Di paling atas `runtime.ts`, sebelum import auth, tambahkan:

```ts
import type {
    BrowserApiProtocolFailure,
} from '@/platform/api';
```

Lalu replace block success discovery dengan script fail-closed berikut:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "frontend/src/platform/membership/runtime.ts"
)

text = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

old_import = """import {
    isBrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredFailure,
    type BrowserAuthRuntime,
    type BrowserAuthState,
} from '@/platform/auth';"""

new_import = """import type {
    BrowserApiProtocolFailure,
} from '@/platform/api';
import {
    isBrowserSessionAuthenticationRequiredFailure,
    type BrowserAuthRuntime,
    type BrowserAuthState,
} from '@/platform/auth';"""

old_block = """        try {
            if (
                result.data.data.length
                    === 0
            ) {
                return dispatch({
                    type:
                        'DISCOVERY_EMPTY',
                });
            }

            return dispatch({
                type:
                    'DISCOVERY_READY',
                memberships:
                    result.data.data,
            });
        } catch (error) {"""

new_block = """        if (
            result.data
                === undefined
        ) {
            /*
             * A successful HTTP status without the
             * contract-required MembershipListSuccess
             * payload is a protocol failure.
             *
             * Never invent an empty Membership list and
             * never bypass the transport's optional-data
             * contract with a type assertion.
             */
            const failure:
                BrowserApiProtocolFailure = {
                    ok: false,
                    kind:
                        'protocol',
                    status:
                        result.status,
                    message:
                        'EduCore API returned an unexpected error response.',
                };

            return dispatch({
                type:
                    'DISCOVERY_UNAVAILABLE',
                failure,
            });
        }

        try {
            const discoveredMemberships =
                result.data.data;

            if (
                discoveredMemberships.length
                    === 0
            ) {
                return dispatch({
                    type:
                        'DISCOVERY_EMPTY',
                });
            }

            return dispatch({
                type:
                    'DISCOVERY_READY',
                memberships:
                    discoveredMemberships,
            });
        } catch (error) {"""

for label, old in [
    ("runtime import", old_import),
    ("discovery success block", old_block),
]:
    count = text.count(old)

    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Expected exactly one {label}, found {count}"
        )

text = text.replace(
    old_import,
    new_import,
)

text = text.replace(
    old_block,
    new_block,
)

path.write_text(
    text,
    encoding="utf-8",
)
PY
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Repair ini penting karena ada tiga layer contract berbeda:

```text
OpenAPI operation
GET /my-memberships
→ 200 MembershipListSuccess

Browser transport
→ generic TData | undefined

Membership runtime
→ operation-specific invariant
```

Transport layer tidak boleh memaksakan semua success mempunyai body karena `/browser/session/csrf` memang bisa success tanpa data.

Sebaliknya Membership runtime tahu bahwa discovery `200` wajib mempunyai:

```ts
MembershipListSuccess
```

Maka validasi harus berada di sini.

### Kenapa menjadi `unavailable`?

Response:

```text
HTTP 200
body missing
```

bukan:

```text
empty membership list
```

dan bukan:

```text
anonymous
```

Ini adalah protocol inconsistency:

```text
transport succeeded
+
application contract missing
```

Sehingga state yang aman:

```text
unavailable
```

dengan:

```text
kind = protocol
```

### Kenapa tidak throw?

Invariant seperti:

```text
/auth/me says Membership A
discovery says incompatible Tenant
```

memang layak throw karena merupakan contradictory canonical truth.

Tetapi missing network response payload sudah mempunyai representasi failure resmi di API boundary:

```text
BrowserApiProtocolFailure
```

jadi lebih baik dikembalikan sebagai controlled state daripada menghasilkan rejected promise.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita ingin membuktikan seluruh Membership Context Runtime sebagai satu boundary:

```text
auth truth
    ↓
membership discovery
    ↓
membership state
    ↓
browser switch preparation
    ↓
auth.bootstrap(target locator)
    ↓
canonical confirmation
```

Dengan invariant final:

```text
no HTTP in runtime
no bearer/token handling
no React
no global membership storage
no unsafe type escape
late async result cannot overwrite newer truth
missing success payload fails closed
session expiry propagates to auth
```

Namun pada TypeScript 6.0, `baseUrl` sudah **deprecated**. Dokumentasi resmi TypeScript juga menjelaskan bahwa sejak TypeScript 4.1, `paths` tidak lagi membutuhkan `baseUrl`; tanpa `baseUrl`, nilai `paths` akan di-resolve relatif terhadap `tsconfig.json`. Jadi kalau VS Code/editor Anda menggunakan bundled TypeScript 6.x, sangat mungkin `baseUrl` yang terlihat sebagai error/warning. Kita sebaiknya membersihkannya sekarang.

# FEI-6E.1B - Remove Deprecated `baseUrl`

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita hilangkan:

```json
"baseUrl": "."
```

tetapi **mempertahankan**:

```json
"paths": {
    "@/*": [
        "src/*"
    ]
}
```

Alias tetap mempunyai dua boundary yang jelas:

```text
TypeScript:
@/* → frontend/src/*

Vite runtime:
@   → frontend/src
```

Vite sendiri memang mempunyai alias `@` secara eksplisit, jadi runtime bundling tidak bergantung pada `baseUrl`. 

## Struktur Folder & File

Hanya ubah:

```text
frontend/tsconfig.json
```

Jangan ubah:

```text
frontend/vite.config.ts
frontend/src/platform/membership/
frontend/src/platform/auth/
```

Belum staging.

## Kode Lengkap

Gunakan replacement fail-closed:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "frontend/tsconfig.json"
)

text = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

old = """        "baseUrl": ".",
        "paths": {"""

new = """        "paths": {"""

count = text.count(old)

if count != 1:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Expected exactly one baseUrl + paths block, "
        f"found {count}"
    )

path.write_text(
    text.replace(
        old,
        new,
    ),
    encoding="utf-8",
)
PY
```

Lalu lihat hasilnya:

```bash
echo "=== FEI-6E.1B TSCONFIG ==="
cat frontend/tsconfig.json
```

Bagian terkait harus menjadi:

```json
"noEmit": true,

"paths": {
    "@/*": [
        "src/*"
    ]
},

"types": [
    "vite/client"
]
```

Tidak perlu mengubahnya menjadi:

```json
"@/*": [
    "./src/*"
]
```

Keduanya bisa bekerja, tetapi kita tidak perlu menambah perubahan semantik yang tidak dibutuhkan. Tanpa `baseUrl`, `paths` tersebut di-resolve relatif terhadap lokasi `frontend/tsconfig.json`. ([TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/modules/reference.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### Kenapa `baseUrl` sebaiknya dihapus?

Historically `baseUrl` dibuat untuk AMD module loader. Dokumentasi TypeScript sekarang secara eksplisit mengatakan fitur tersebut tidak direkomendasikan untuk konteks umum, dan sejak TS 4.1 tidak diperlukan untuk `paths`. ([TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig/baseUrl.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

TypeScript 6.0 kemudian mendeprekasinya. ([TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/release-notes/typescript-6-0.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Jadi konfigurasi kita:

```json
"baseUrl": ".",
"paths": {
    "@/*": ["src/*"]
}
```

dapat disederhanakan menjadi:

```json
"paths": {
    "@/*": ["src/*"]
}
```

### Kenapa typecheck sebelumnya tetap PASS?

Karena CLI project yang Anda jalankan masih berasal dari dependency:

```json
"typescript": "^5.9.3"
```

Sedangkan editor bisa memakai versi TypeScript berbeda. Itu menjelaskan situasi seperti:

```text
terminal tsc 5.9
→ PASS

VS Code bundled TS 6.x
→ baseUrl deprecated / ditandai editor
```

Jadi ini sangat mungkin **tooling-version diagnostic**, bukan syntax JSON rusak.

### Vite tidak terdampak

Runtime alias sudah terpisah:

```ts
resolve: {
    alias: {
        '@': fileURLToPath(
            new URL('./src', import.meta.url),
        ),
    },
},
```

Sehingga:

```text
TypeScript resolution
≠
Vite runtime alias implementation
```

tetapi keduanya menunjuk source directory yang sama.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Error TypeScript tadi justru memberi jawaban yang presisi:

```text
Did you forget a leading './'?
```

Ketika sebelumnya ada:

```json
"baseUrl": "."
```

maka:

```json
"src/*"
```

ditafsirkan relatif terhadap `baseUrl`.

Setelah `baseUrl` tidak ada, target tersebut perlu dibuat eksplisit relatif:

```json
"./src/*"
```

Sehingga resolution menjadi:

```text
frontend/tsconfig.json
        │
        └── ./src/*
             ↓
frontend/src/*
```

Ini lebih eksplisit dan menghilangkan dependency terhadap `baseUrl`.

### Kenapa build dan tests tadi tetap PASS?

Karena Vite memiliki alias-nya sendiri:

```ts
alias: {
    '@': fileURLToPath(
        new URL('./src', import.meta.url),
    ),
},
```

Jadi:

```text
Vite runtime resolution ✅

TypeScript compiler resolution ❌
```

adalah kondisi yang sangat mungkin.

Itulah kenapa **build/test hijau tidak menggantikan typecheck**. Gate kita memang tepat karena menangkap konfigurasi compiler yang tidak sinkron.

### Jangan mengembalikan `baseUrl`

Kita sudah punya fix yang lebih sempit:

```diff
- "baseUrl": ".",
  "paths": {
-     "@/*": ["src/*"]
+     "@/*": ["./src/*"]
  }
```

Tidak ada alasan menambah kembali konfigurasi lama.

## Kode Lengkap

Gunakan script yang memverifikasi **state sebelum dan sesudah write**:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("frontend/tsconfig.json")

text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

old = '''        "baseUrl": ".",
        "paths": {
            "@/*": [
                "src/*"
            ]
        },'''

new = '''        "paths": {
            "@/*": [
                "./src/*"
            ]
        },'''

old_count = text.count(old)
new_count = text.count(new)

print(f"Before write: old={old_count}, new={new_count}")

if old_count != 1:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Expected exactly one original baseUrl/paths block, "
        f"found {old_count}"
    )

if new_count != 0:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Expected new block to be absent before replacement, "
        f"found {new_count}"
    )

updated = text.replace(
    old,
    new,
)

path.write_text(
    updated,
    encoding="utf-8",
)

verified = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

if '"baseUrl"' in verified:
    raise SystemExit(
        "baseUrl still exists after write"
    )

if '"./src/*"' not in verified:
    raise SystemExit(
        "./src/* alias target missing after write"
    )

print("Write verified successfully.")
PY
```

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita tambahkan:

```text
ApplicationRuntime
├── apiClient
├── auth
├── membership   ← NEW
├── queryClient
└── router
```

Composition yang benar:

```text
                 ┌──────────────┐
                 │  apiClient   │
                 └──────┬───────┘
                        │
              ┌─────────┴─────────┐
              ▼                   ▼
       AuthOperations      MembershipOperations
              │                   │
              ▼                   │
        AuthRuntime ───────────────┤
                                  ▼
                       MembershipRuntime
```

Artinya:

```ts
const apiClient = createBrowserApiClient();

const auth = createBrowserAuthRuntime(
    createBrowserAuthOperations(apiClient),
);

const membership = createMembershipContextRuntime(
    createMembershipContextOperations(apiClient),
    auth,
);
```

**Tidak boleh**:

```ts
createBrowserApiClient() // kedua

createBrowserAuthRuntime(...) // kedua
```

Membership runtime harus menerima **instance auth yang sama** yang diekspos sebagai `runtime.auth`.

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Compose Membership runtime

Ganti `frontend/src/app/runtime.ts`:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/runtime.ts <<'EOF'
import { createAppQueryClient } from '@/app/query-client';
import { createAppRouter } from '@/app/router';
import {
    createBrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserApiClient,
} from '@/platform/api';
import {
    createBrowserAuthOperations,
    createBrowserAuthRuntime,
    type BrowserAuthRuntime,
} from '@/platform/auth';
import {
    createMembershipContextOperations,
    createMembershipContextRuntime,
    type MembershipContextRuntime,
} from '@/platform/membership';

export interface ApplicationRuntime {
    apiClient: BrowserApiClient;
    auth: BrowserAuthRuntime;
    membership:
        MembershipContextRuntime;
    queryClient: ReturnType<
        typeof createAppQueryClient
    >;
    router: ReturnType<
        typeof createAppRouter
    >;
}

export function createApplicationRuntime():
    ApplicationRuntime {
    const apiClient =
        createBrowserApiClient();

    const auth =
        createBrowserAuthRuntime(
            createBrowserAuthOperations(
                apiClient,
            ),
        );

    const membership =
        createMembershipContextRuntime(
            createMembershipContextOperations(
                apiClient,
            ),
            auth,
        );

    return {
        apiClient,
        auth,
        membership,
        queryClient:
            createAppQueryClient(),
        router:
            createAppRouter(),
    };
}
EOF
```

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/__tests__/runtime.test.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    createApplicationRuntime,
} from '@/app/runtime';

describe(
    'createApplicationRuntime',
    () => {
        it('creates isolated application runtime instances', () => {
            const firstRuntime =
                createApplicationRuntime();

            const secondRuntime =
                createApplicationRuntime();

            expect(
                firstRuntime.apiClient,
            ).not.toBe(
                secondRuntime.apiClient,
            );

            expect(
                firstRuntime.auth,
            ).not.toBe(
                secondRuntime.auth,
            );

            expect(
                firstRuntime.membership,
            ).not.toBe(
                secondRuntime.membership,
            );

            expect(
                firstRuntime.queryClient,
            ).not.toBe(
                secondRuntime.queryClient,
            );

            expect(
                firstRuntime.router,
            ).not.toBe(
                secondRuntime.router,
            );
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

Ini memastikan dua `ApplicationRuntime` terpisah tidak berbagi state mutable.

## 3. Tambahkan application Membership composition tests

Buat:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/__tests__/application-membership-runtime.test.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    http,
    HttpResponse,
} from 'msw';
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    createApplicationRuntime,
} from '@/app/runtime';
import { apiMockServer } from '@/test/server';

const membershipId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab';

const tenantId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7cde-8def-1234567890ab';

describe(
    'Application Membership runtime',
    () => {
        it('composes an unresolved Membership runtime without dispatching network requests', async () => {
            let membershipRequestCount =
                0;

            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/user/my-memberships`,
                    () => {
                        membershipRequestCount +=
                            1;

                        return HttpResponse.json({
                            status:
                                'success',
                            data: [],
                        });
                    },
                ),
            );

            const runtime =
                createApplicationRuntime();

            expect(
                runtime.membership
                    .getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            expect(
                membershipRequestCount,
            ).toBe(0);

            const state =
                await runtime.membership
                    .bootstrap();

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            expect(
                membershipRequestCount,
            ).toBe(0);
        });

        it('shares canonical authentication truth with Membership discovery', async () => {
            let authRequestCount =
                0;

            let membershipRequestCount =
                0;

            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/auth/me`,
                    () => {
                        authRequestCount +=
                            1;

                        return HttpResponse.json(
                            {
                                status:
                                    'error',
                                code:
                                    'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
                                message:
                                    'Browser membership context is required.',
                            },
                            {
                                status: 403,
                            },
                        );
                    },
                ),

                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/user/my-memberships`,
                    () => {
                        membershipRequestCount +=
                            1;

                        return HttpResponse.json({
                            status:
                                'success',
                            data: [
                                {
                                    membership_id:
                                        membershipId,
                                    membership_status:
                                        'ACTIVE',
                                    tenant_id:
                                        tenantId,
                                    tenant_name:
                                        'EduCore School A',
                                    tenant_subdomain:
                                        'school-a',
                                },
                            ],
                        });
                    },
                ),
            );

            const runtime =
                createApplicationRuntime();

            expect(
                runtime.auth.getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unknown',
            });

            expect(
                runtime.membership
                    .getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            const authState =
                await runtime.auth
                    .bootstrap();

            expect(authState).toEqual({
                status:
                    'membership-context-required',
                failure: {
                    ok: false,
                    kind:
                        'response',
                    status: 403,
                    error: {
                        status:
                            'error',
                        code:
                            'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
                        message:
                            'Browser membership context is required.',
                    },
                },
            });

            expect(
                authRequestCount,
            ).toBe(1);

            expect(
                membershipRequestCount,
            ).toBe(0);

            const membershipState =
                await runtime.membership
                    .bootstrap();

            expect(
                membershipRequestCount,
            ).toBe(1);

            expect(
                membershipState,
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'selection-required',
                memberships: [
                    {
                        membership_id:
                            membershipId,
                        membership_status:
                            'ACTIVE',
                        tenant_id:
                            tenantId,
                        tenant_name:
                            'EduCore School A',
                        tenant_subdomain:
                            'school-a',
                    },
                ],
                failure:
                    null,
            });
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Composition Root menjadi satu-satunya tempat wiring

Platform layer sebelumnya hanya mendefinisikan:

```text
BrowserAuthRuntime
MembershipContextRuntime
BrowserApiClient
```

Application layer sekarang melakukan wiring.

Ini sesuai Dependency Inversion:

```text
platform
→ tidak tahu application

application
→ tahu platform implementations
```

---

## 2. Membership menggunakan Auth runtime yang sama

Integration test kedua penting.

Urutannya:

```text
runtime.auth.bootstrap()
        ↓
auth → membership-context-required
        ↓
runtime.membership.bootstrap()
        ↓
membership discovery dijalankan
```

Jika composition secara salah membuat auth runtime kedua:

```ts
const authForMembership =
    createBrowserAuthRuntime(...);
```

maka auth internal Membership masih:

```text
unknown
```

dan:

```text
membership.bootstrap()
→ unresolved
→ discovery request = 0
```

Test kita akan gagal.

Jadi test ini bukan sekadar memastikan property `membership` ada; ia membuktikan **shared authentication truth**.

---

## 3. Runtime construction tidak boleh menghasilkan HTTP

`createApplicationRuntime()` hanya melakukan dependency wiring:

```text
construct transport
construct auth
construct membership
construct QueryClient
construct router
```

Tidak:

```text
GET /auth/me
GET /my-memberships
```

Lifecycle tetap dimiliki provider/runtime caller.

Ini menjaga application startup predictable dan testable.

---

## 4. Tidak membuat API client kedua

Current application baseline membuat satu `apiClient` lalu memasukkannya ke Auth operations. 

Kita mempertahankan invariant itu:

```ts
createMembershipContextOperations(
    apiClient,
)
```

bukan:

```ts
createMembershipContextOperations(
    createBrowserApiClient(),
)
```

Dengan begitu:

```text
Auth transport
Membership transport
```

memakai policy browser API yang sama:

```text
same-origin credentials
Authorization stripping
XSRF handling
error normalization
```

---

## 5. Isolation antar ApplicationRuntime tetap dijaga

Existing test hanya memastikan QueryClient/router tidak dibagi antar runtime. 

Sekarang kita perluas menjadi:

```text
apiClient    isolated
auth         isolated
membership   isolated
queryClient  isolated
router       isolated
```

Penting untuk test isolation, SSR-like future scenarios, dan mencegah accidental shared mutable singleton di factory.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Test ini harus membuktikan dua invariant application composition:

```text
createApplicationRuntime()
    → tidak otomatis melakukan HTTP
```

dan:

```text
runtime.auth
        │
        │ shared instance
        ▼
runtime.membership
        ↓
melihat auth state yang sama
```

Test kedua sangat penting karena sekadar melihat:

```ts
createMembershipContextRuntime(
    ...,
    auth,
)
```

belum cukup sebagai regression protection.

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/__tests__/application-membership-runtime.test.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    http,
    HttpResponse,
} from 'msw';
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    createApplicationRuntime,
} from '@/app/runtime';
import { apiMockServer } from '@/test/server';

const membershipId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab';

const tenantId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7cde-8def-1234567890ab';

describe(
    'Application Membership runtime',
    () => {
        it('composes an unresolved Membership runtime without dispatching network requests', async () => {
            let membershipRequestCount =
                0;

            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/user/my-memberships`,
                    () => {
                        membershipRequestCount +=
                            1;

                        return HttpResponse.json({
                            status:
                                'success',
                            data: [],
                        });
                    },
                ),
            );

            const runtime =
                createApplicationRuntime();

            expect(
                runtime.membership
                    .getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            expect(
                membershipRequestCount,
            ).toBe(0);

            const state =
                await runtime.membership
                    .bootstrap();

            expect(state).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            expect(
                membershipRequestCount,
            ).toBe(0);
        });

        it('shares canonical authentication truth with Membership discovery', async () => {
            let authRequestCount =
                0;

            let membershipRequestCount =
                0;

            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/auth/me`,
                    () => {
                        authRequestCount +=
                            1;

                        return HttpResponse.json(
                            {
                                status:
                                    'error',
                                code:
                                    'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
                                message:
                                    'Browser membership context is required.',
                            },
                            {
                                status: 403,
                            },
                        );
                    },
                ),

                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/user/my-memberships`,
                    () => {
                        membershipRequestCount +=
                            1;

                        return HttpResponse.json({
                            status:
                                'success',
                            data: [
                                {
                                    membership_id:
                                        membershipId,
                                    membership_status:
                                        'ACTIVE',
                                    tenant_id:
                                        tenantId,
                                    tenant_name:
                                        'EduCore School A',
                                    tenant_subdomain:
                                        'school-a',
                                },
                            ],
                        });
                    },
                ),
            );

            const runtime =
                createApplicationRuntime();

            expect(
                runtime.auth.getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unknown',
            });

            expect(
                runtime.membership
                    .getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            const authState =
                await runtime.auth
                    .bootstrap();

            expect(authState).toEqual({
                status:
                    'membership-context-required',
                failure: {
                    ok: false,
                    kind:
                        'response',
                    status: 403,
                    error: {
                        status:
                            'error',
                        code:
                            'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
                        message:
                            'Browser membership context is required.',
                    },
                },
            });

            expect(
                authRequestCount,
            ).toBe(1);

            expect(
                membershipRequestCount,
            ).toBe(0);

            const membershipState =
                await runtime.membership
                    .bootstrap();

            expect(
                membershipRequestCount,
            ).toBe(1);

            expect(
                membershipState,
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'selection-required',
                memberships: [
                    {
                        membership_id:
                            membershipId,
                        membership_status:
                            'ACTIVE',
                        tenant_id:
                            tenantId,
                        tenant_name:
                            'EduCore School A',
                        tenant_subdomain:
                            'school-a',
                    },
                ],
                failure:
                    null,
            });
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Test pertama membuktikan composition root tidak mempunyai side effect:

```text
construct runtime
→ zero HTTP
```

Bahkan ketika `membership.bootstrap()` dipanggil sementara auth masih:

```text
unknown
```

Membership runtime harus tetap:

```text
unresolved
```

dan tidak melakukan discovery.

Test kedua membuktikan sharing instance secara behavioral.

Urutannya:

```text
auth initially unknown
        ↓
runtime.auth.bootstrap()
        ↓
membership-context-required
        ↓
runtime.membership.bootstrap()
        ↓
GET /user/my-memberships
        ↓
selection-required
```

Kalau `membership` diam-diam memakai auth runtime kedua, internal auth-nya masih `unknown`, sehingga request discovery tidak akan terkirim. Test akan langsung gagal.

Ini jauh lebih kuat daripada hanya menguji struktur object.

Jika targeted test pertama gagal karena membership request ternyata terkirim saat auth masih `unknown`, jangan mengubah test; itu berarti orchestration boundary bocor.

Jika test kedua menghasilkan:

```text
membershipRequestCount = 0
```

setelah auth state menjadi `membership-context-required`, jangan membuat discovery dipaksa manual. Itu berarti runtime membership tidak menerima shared `auth` instance.

Jika TypeScript error muncul, kirim exact output; jangan memakai `any` atau cast.

### Composition gate

Di `runtime.ts` kita mengharapkan secara semantik hanya:

```ts id="ajtsd4"
const apiClient =
    createBrowserApiClient();

const auth =
    createBrowserAuthRuntime(
        createBrowserAuthOperations(
            apiClient,
        ),
    );

const membership =
    createMembershipContextRuntime(
        createMembershipContextOperations(
            apiClient,
        ),
        auth,
    );
```

Jadi dependency graph-nya:

```text id="nkzx0k"
apiClient ──→ auth
    │
    └──────→ membership operations

auth ──────→ membership runtime
```

Tidak ada hidden second client atau second auth authority.

Karena cleanup TypeScript masih belum committed, final gate ini juga memastikan:

```text id="r0b3e4"

@/* → ./src/*
```

tetap bertahan dan tidak di-rewrite oleh editor/tooling.

> **Designing provider lifecycle**
>
> I’m designing a membership provider that watches authentication state, bootstraps only for eligible states, resets otherwise, and remains safe under Strict Mode. I’m also checking for duplicate work during membership switching and auth-driven rerenders.
>
> **Designed provider lifecycle**
>
> 
>
> **Refining bootstrap triggers**
>
> I’m narrowing the effect to authentication and membership status changes. Bootstrapping should occur only when authentication is eligible and membership is unresolved, while resets should follow ineligible states without interrupting active switches.

Current `BrowserAuthProvider` memang menjadi pemilik initial auth bootstrap dan sudah menggunakan `AbortController` + `useSyncExternalStore`.  `AppBootstrap` saat ini menaruh Query/Router langsung di dalam `BrowserAuthProvider`, jadi FEI-6F akan menyisipkan Membership provider **di dalam auth provider**, karena Membership lifecycle harus membaca canonical auth state. 

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita masuk:

```text
FEI-6F - React Membership Context Bridge
```

Target hierarchy:

```text
ApplicationErrorBoundary
└── BrowserAuthProvider
    └── MembershipContextProvider
        └── QueryClientProvider
            └── RouterProvider
```

Lifecycle:

```text
React mount
   ↓
BrowserAuthProvider
   ↓
auth bootstrap
   ↓
unknown
→ resolving-context
→ authenticated
   OR
→ membership-context-required
   ↓
MembershipContextProvider
   ↓
membership.bootstrap()
```

Yang sangat penting: Membership provider **tidak boleh melakukan auth bootstrap sendiri**.

Selain itu ada satu detail StrictMode penting. Membership provider hanya boleh restart discovery ketika runtime sedang:

```text
unresolved
discovering
```

Tidak ketika:

```text
switching
ready
selection-required
empty
unavailable
```

Ini menjaga switch lifecycle yang sudah kita kunci di FEI-6E.
