## 1. Buat React Membership bridge

```bash
mkdir -p \
  frontend/src/app/membership/__tests__

cat > frontend/src/app/membership/MembershipContextProvider.tsx <<'EOF'
import {
    createContext,
    type PropsWithChildren,
    useContext,
    useEffect,
    useSyncExternalStore,
} from 'react';

import {
    useBrowserAuthState,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import type {
    MembershipContextRuntime,
    MembershipContextState,
} from '@/platform/membership';

const MembershipRuntimeContext =
    createContext<
        MembershipContextRuntime | null
    >(null);

export interface MembershipContextProviderProps
    extends PropsWithChildren {
    readonly runtime:
        MembershipContextRuntime;
}

export function MembershipContextProvider({
    runtime,
    children,
}: MembershipContextProviderProps) {
    const authenticationState =
        useBrowserAuthState();

    useEffect(
        () => {
            const authenticationStatus =
                authenticationState.status;

            if (
                authenticationStatus
                    === 'authenticated'
                || authenticationStatus
                    === 'membership-context-required'
            ) {
                const membershipStatus =
                    runtime.getState().status;

                /*
                 * StrictMode may clean up the first Effect
                 * while discovery is already in flight.
                 *
                 * The Membership runtime explicitly
                 * supports replacing an in-flight
                 * discovery and rejects discovery while
                 * switching.
                 */
                if (
                    membershipStatus
                        !== 'unresolved'
                    && membershipStatus
                        !== 'discovering'
                ) {
                    return;
                }

                const controller =
                    new AbortController();

                void runtime.bootstrap({
                    signal:
                        controller.signal,
                });

                return () => {
                    controller.abort();
                };
            }

            /*
             * resolving-context is intentionally neutral.
             *
             * Membership switching confirms its target by
             * calling BrowserAuthRuntime.bootstrap(), which
             * temporarily moves authentication through
             * resolving-context.
             *
             * Resetting Membership truth here would cancel
             * that canonical confirmation lifecycle.
             */
            if (
                authenticationStatus
                    === 'resolving-context'
            ) {
                return;
            }

            if (
                runtime.getState().status
                    !== 'unresolved'
            ) {
                runtime.reset();
            }
        },
        [
            authenticationState.status,
            runtime,
        ],
    );

    return (
        <MembershipRuntimeContext.Provider
            value={runtime}
        >
            {children}
        </MembershipRuntimeContext.Provider>
    );
}

export function useMembershipContextRuntime():
    MembershipContextRuntime {
    const runtime =
        useContext(
            MembershipRuntimeContext,
        );

    if (runtime === null) {
        throw new Error(
            'EduCore MembershipContext hooks require MembershipContextProvider.',
        );
    }

    return runtime;
}

export function useMembershipContextState():
    MembershipContextState {
    const runtime =
        useMembershipContextRuntime();

    return useSyncExternalStore(
        runtime.subscribe,
        runtime.getState,
    );
}
EOF
```

## 2. Compose provider di AppBootstrap

Ganti `frontend/src/app/AppBootstrap.tsx`:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/AppBootstrap.tsx <<'EOF'
import {
    QueryClientProvider,
} from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
    RouterProvider,
} from 'react-router/dom';

import {
    ApplicationErrorBoundary,
} from '@/app/ApplicationErrorBoundary';
import {
    BrowserAuthProvider,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import {
    MembershipContextProvider,
} from '@/app/membership/MembershipContextProvider';
import type {
    ApplicationRuntime,
} from '@/app/runtime';

interface AppBootstrapProps {
    runtime:
        ApplicationRuntime;
}

export function AppBootstrap({
    runtime,
}: AppBootstrapProps) {
    return (
        <ApplicationErrorBoundary>
            <BrowserAuthProvider
                runtime={runtime.auth}
            >
                <MembershipContextProvider
                    runtime={
                        runtime.membership
                    }
                >
                    <QueryClientProvider
                        client={
                            runtime.queryClient
                        }
                    >
                        <RouterProvider
                            router={
                                runtime.router
                            }
                        />
                    </QueryClientProvider>
                </MembershipContextProvider>
            </BrowserAuthProvider>
        </ApplicationErrorBoundary>
    );
}
EOF
```

Membership provider sengaja berada di bawah `BrowserAuthProvider`, karena ia memakai `useBrowserAuthState()`. Current auth provider memang menyediakan runtime melalui React context dan subscription hook tersebut.

```bash
import {
    StrictMode,
} from 'react';
import {
    act,
    render,
    screen,
    waitFor,
} from '@testing-library/react';
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    BrowserAuthProvider,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import {
    MembershipContextProvider,
    useMembershipContextState,
} from '@/app/membership/MembershipContextProvider';
import type {
    BrowserApiFailure,
    BrowserApiResult,
} from '@/platform/api';
import {
    createBrowserAuthRuntime,
    type AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess,
    type BrowserAuthOperations,
} from '@/platform/auth';
import {
    createMembershipContextRuntime,
    type MembershipContextOperations,
    type MembershipListSuccess,
} from '@/platform/membership';

const membershipId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab';

const tenantId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7cde-8def-1234567890ab';

const membershipRequiredFailure:
    BrowserApiFailure = {
        ok: false,
        kind:
            'response',
        status: 403,
        error: {
            status:
                'error',
            code:
                'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
            message:
                'Browser membership context is required.',
        },
    };

const sessionRequiredFailure:
    BrowserApiFailure = {
        ok: false,
        kind:
            'response',
        status: 401,
        error: {
            status:
                'error',
            code:
                'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED',
            message:
                'Authenticated browser session is required.',
        },
    };

const abortedFailure:
    BrowserApiFailure = {
        ok: false,
        kind:
            'aborted',
        cause:
            new Error(
                'Membership discovery cancelled',
            ),
    };

const discoverySuccess:
    BrowserApiResult<
        MembershipListSuccess
    > = {
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        data: {
            status:
                'success',
            data: [
                {
                    membership_id:
                        membershipId,
                    membership_status:
                        'ACTIVE',
                    tenant_id:
                        tenantId,
                    tenant_name:
                        'EduCore School',
                    tenant_subdomain:
                        'school',
                },
            ],
        },
    };

function createAuthOperations(
    bootstrap:
        BrowserAuthOperations['bootstrap'],
): BrowserAuthOperations {
    return {
        bootstrap,

        async login() {
            throw new Error(
                'Unexpected login operation.',
            );
        },

        async logout() {
            throw new Error(
                'Unexpected logout operation.',
            );
        },
    };
}

function createMembershipOperations(
    discover:
        MembershipContextOperations['discover'],
): MembershipContextOperations {
    return {
        discover,

        async switchMembership() {
            throw new Error(
                'Unexpected Membership switch operation.',
            );
        },
    };
}

function MembershipStateProbe() {
    const state =
        useMembershipContextState();

    return (
        <output
            data-testid="membership-state"
        >
            {state.status}
        </output>
    );
}

describe(
    'MembershipContextProvider',
    () => {
        it('waits for canonical authentication truth before starting Membership discovery', async () => {
            let resolveAuthentication!:
                (
                    result:
                        BrowserApiResult<
                            AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess
                        >,
                ) => void;

            const authenticationResult =
                new Promise<
                    BrowserApiResult<
                        AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess
                    >
                >(
                    (
                        resolve,
                    ) => {
                        resolveAuthentication =
                            resolve;
                    },
                );

            const authentication =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createAuthOperations(
                        async () =>
                            authenticationResult,
                    ),
                );

            let discoveryCalls =
                0;

            const membership =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    createMembershipOperations(
                        async () => {
                            discoveryCalls +=
                                1;

                            return discoverySuccess;
                        },
                    ),
                    authentication,
                );

            render(
                <BrowserAuthProvider
                    runtime={
                        authentication
                    }
                >
                    <MembershipContextProvider
                        runtime={
                            membership
                        }
                    >
                        <MembershipStateProbe />
                    </MembershipContextProvider>
                </BrowserAuthProvider>,
            );

            expect(
                screen.getByText(
                    'unresolved',
                ),
            ).toBeInTheDocument();

            expect(
                discoveryCalls,
            ).toBe(0);

            await act(
                async () => {
                    resolveAuthentication(
                        membershipRequiredFailure,
                    );

                    await authenticationResult;
                },
            );

            expect(
                await screen.findByText(
                    'selection-required',
                ),
            ).toBeInTheDocument();

            expect(
                discoveryCalls,
            ).toBe(1);
        });

        it('clears Membership truth when authentication becomes anonymous', async () => {
            const authentication =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createAuthOperations(
                        async () =>
                            membershipRequiredFailure,
                    ),
                );

            const membership =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    createMembershipOperations(
                        async () =>
                            discoverySuccess,
                    ),
                    authentication,
                );

            render(
                <BrowserAuthProvider
                    runtime={
                        authentication
                    }
                >
                    <MembershipContextProvider
                        runtime={
                            membership
                        }
                    >
                        <MembershipStateProbe />
                    </MembershipContextProvider>
                </BrowserAuthProvider>,
            );

            expect(
                await screen.findByText(
                    'selection-required',
                ),
            ).toBeInTheDocument();

            act(() => {
                authentication.observeFailure(
                    sessionRequiredFailure,
                );
            });

            expect(
                await screen.findByText(
                    'unresolved',
                ),
            ).toBeInTheDocument();

            expect(
                membership.getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });
        });

        it('remains deterministic across StrictMode Membership discovery setup and cleanup', async () => {
            const authentication =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createAuthOperations(
                        async () => {
                            throw new Error(
                                'Unexpected authentication bootstrap.',
                            );
                        },
                    ),
                );

            authentication.observeFailure(
                membershipRequiredFailure,
            );

            expect(
                authentication
                    .getState()
                    .status,
            ).toBe(
                'membership-context-required',
            );

            let discoveryCalls =
                0;

            const membership =
                createMembershipContextRuntime(
                    createMembershipOperations(
                        (
                            options,
                        ) => {
                            discoveryCalls +=
                                1;

                            if (
                                discoveryCalls
                                    !== 1
                            ) {
                                return Promise.resolve(
                                    discoverySuccess,
                                );
                            }

                            const signal =
                                options?.signal;

                            if (
                                signal
                                    === undefined
                            ) {
                                throw new Error(
                                    'Expected Membership discovery AbortSignal.',
                                );
                            }

                            return new Promise(
                                (
                                    resolve,
                                ) => {
                                    const resolveAbort =
                                        () => {
                                            window.setTimeout(
                                                () => {
                                                    resolve(
                                                        abortedFailure,
                                                    );
                                                },
                                                10,
                                            );
                                        };

                                    if (
                                        signal.aborted
                                    ) {
                                        resolveAbort();

                                        return;
                                    }

                                    signal.addEventListener(
                                        'abort',
                                        resolveAbort,
                                        {
                                            once:
                                                true,
                                        },
                                    );
                                },
                            );
                        },
                    ),
                    authentication,
                );

            render(
                <StrictMode>
                    <BrowserAuthProvider
                        runtime={
                            authentication
                        }
                    >
                        <MembershipContextProvider
                            runtime={
                                membership
                            }
                        >
                            <MembershipStateProbe />
                        </MembershipContextProvider>
                    </BrowserAuthProvider>
                </StrictMode>,
            );

            expect(
                await screen.findByText(
                    'selection-required',
                ),
            ).toBeInTheDocument();

            await waitFor(() => {
                expect(
                    discoveryCalls,
                ).toBe(2);
            });

            await act(
                async () => {
                    await new Promise(
                        (
                            resolve,
                        ) => {
                            window.setTimeout(
                                resolve,
                                20,
                            );
                        },
                    );
                },
            );

            expect(
                membership.getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'selection-required',
                memberships:
                    discoverySuccess
                        .data
                        ?.data,
                failure:
                    null,
            });

            expect(
                screen.getByText(
                    'selection-required',
                ),
            ).toBeInTheDocument();
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

Existing AppBootstrap sebelumnya hanya membuktikan auth menjadi `anonymous`.  Sekarang root integration test lebih kuat: ia membuktikan provider ordering benar dan Membership discovery baru berjalan setelah auth menghasilkan `membership-context-required`.

---

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Auth bootstrap tetap single-owner

Hanya:

```text
BrowserAuthProvider
→ runtime.auth.bootstrap()
```

Membership provider tidak melakukan:

```text
auth.bootstrap() ❌
```

Ia hanya bereaksi terhadap canonical auth state.

### 2. `resolving-context` sengaja netral

Ini critical untuk switch:

```text
membership.switchMembership(B)
        ↓
Browser switch succeeds
        ↓
auth.bootstrap(B)
        ↓
auth = resolving-context
```

Kalau provider melakukan `membership.reset()` ketika melihat `resolving-context`, kita akan membatalkan switch yang sedang menunggu canonical confirmation.

Karena itu:

```text
resolving-context
→ preserve Membership runtime state
```

### 3. StrictMode restart hanya untuk discovery

Pada StrictMode:

```text
Effect setup #1
→ discovery starts

cleanup #1
→ abort

Effect setup #2
→ runtime currently discovering
→ discovery may restart
```

Platform runtime FEI-6E sudah mempunyai revision protection untuk membuat late aborted result pertama tidak menimpa result kedua.

### 4. Provider tidak berlangganan Membership state untuk lifecycle effect

Ini disengaja.

Jika effect dependency menggunakan:

```ts
membershipState.status
```

maka:

```text
unresolved
→ effect starts bootstrap
→ runtime immediately becomes discovering
→ React rerenders
→ effect cleanup aborts its own request
```

dan berpotensi membentuk cancellation loop.

Karena itu lifecycle memakai:

```ts
runtime.getState()
```

sementara consumer state memakai:

```ts
useSyncExternalStore()
```

Separation of Concerns-nya jelas.

### 5. Tidak ada route guard

FEI-6F hanya bridge state/runtime.

Belum:

```text
Navigate
redirect
loader guard
workspace bootstrap
permission/capability
```

Itu tetap milik FEI-7/8/9.

## Troubleshooting

Jika StrictMode test hanya melakukan satu discovery atau berakhir `unresolved`, jangan menghapus StrictMode test. Itu berarti Effect restart/cancellation ownership belum benar.

Jika discovery terus berulang, cek apakah Membership state dimasukkan sebagai dependency lifecycle effect. Jangan memperbaikinya dengan debounce.

Jika AppBootstrap berhenti pada `membership-context-required` tetapi Membership tetap `unresolved`, cek provider ordering terlebih dahulu: Membership provider harus berada **di dalam** BrowserAuthProvider.

Jika `resolving-context` menyebabkan Membership reset saat switch, jangan tambahkan special-case di runtime; provider-lah yang harus tetap netral terhadap auth transitional state tersebut.

## FEI-6G.1 — Final Integrity Audit

### Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Sebelum staging/commit, kita harus membuktikan bahwa seluruh FEI-6 membentuk satu boundary yang utuh:

```text
Canonical membership discovery
        ↓
Membership state model
        ↓
Browser-safe switch
        ↓
Canonical /auth/me confirmation
        ↓
Membership runtime
        ↓
Application composition
        ↓
React bridge
```

Dengan invariants final:

```text
✅ no bearer membership switch
✅ no access/bearer token handling
✅ no browser-global Membership storage
✅ no raw HTTP outside API transport
✅ no authorization/workspace implementation
✅ no route guard
✅ one auth bootstrap owner
✅ one apiClient + one auth runtime
✅ switch response ≠ canonical context
✅ Membership/Tenant confirmed together
✅ StrictMode cancellation safe
✅ unrelated files untouched
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### Kenapa exact-fileset script diperlukan?

`git status` saja tidak cukup. Kita ingin invariant matematis:

```text
actual staged files
==
expected FEI-6 files
```

Bukan hanya:

```text
"kelihatannya benar"
```

Script akan fail closed jika ada satu file kurang atau satu file tambahan.

### Kenapa test files ikut commit?

Karena test di FEI-6 bukan sekadar verification sementara. Mereka mengunci architectural contracts:

```text
discovery semantics
state transitions
switch safety
cancellation/revision behavior
canonical auth confirmation
shared application runtime
React lifecycle
StrictMode determinism
```

Tanpa test tersebut, commit hanya menyimpan implementasi tanpa regression protection.

### Kenapa belum commit?

Karena staged index adalah boundary terakhir sebelum history permanen.

Urutan yang aman:

```text
working tree audit ✅
        ↓
explicit staging
        ↓
cached diff audit
        ↓
commit
```

bukan:

```text
git add .
git commit
```

## Troubleshooting

Jika exact-fileset melaporkan `Unexpected`, **jangan commit**. Kita keluarkan file tersebut dari index secara scoped dengan `git restore --staged -- <file>`.

Jika `Missing`, jangan ulang `git add .`; cukup stage path yang hilang saja.

Jika `git diff --cached --check` menghasilkan whitespace error pada file selain `tsconfig`, kirim exact output.

Jika CRLF warning pada `tsconfig` muncul tetapi cached diff tetap hanya tiga baris perubahan di atas dan `diff --check` bersih, warning itu tetap bukan blocker.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Yang berubah hanya posisi:

```diff
 git grep \
+  --cached \
   -n \
   -E \
-  'pattern' \
-  --cached -- \
+  -e 'pattern' \
+  -- \
```

`-e` juga sengaja digunakan agar pattern secara eksplisit ditandai sebagai pattern dan parser Git tidak ambigu.

# FEI-7A - Locked Audit Findings

### 1. Canonical discovery endpoint

Endpoint yang dipakai frontend:

```http
GET /api/v1/user/my-workspaces
```

Operation:

```text
userWorkspaceIndex
```

Current contract sudah dual transport:

```text
BearerAuth
OR
BrowserSessionAuth
```

Untuk Browser Session:

```http
X-EduCore-Membership-Id: <membership-uuid>
```

wajib digunakan untuk memilih canonical Membership credential server-side. Organizational assignment header **tidak digunakan untuk discovery**. Generated client juga sudah merepresentasikan endpoint ini. 

Current Laravel route menggunakan:

```text
UseBrowserSessionForCanonicalApi
InjectTransportAwareTenantContext
```

jadi `/my-workspaces` memang berada di **current verified Membership/Tenant scope**, bukan global Person discovery seperti `/my-memberships`. 

Hubungannya:

```text
/my-memberships
→ Person scope
→ no Membership locator

/my-workspaces
→ Membership/Tenant scope
→ Browser Session requires Membership locator
```

Ini boundary pertama yang harus kita pertahankan.

---

### 2. Workspace response bukan flattened generic object

Canonical success:

```ts
{
    status: 'success',
    data: {
        tenant: {
            id,
            name,
        },
        workspaces: WorkspaceSummary[],
    },
}
```

Generated contract mengunci:

```ts
WorkspaceSummary =
    TenantWorkspaceSummary
    | OrganizationWorkspaceSummary
    | OrganizationUnitWorkspaceSummary
```

dan `WorkspaceDiscoveryData` membawa `tenant + workspaces`. 

Jadi FEI-7 TypeScript harus mempertahankan **discriminated union**, bukan:

```ts
interface Workspace {
    type: string;
    organizationId?: string;
    ...
}
```

yang terlalu longgar.

---

### 3. Tiga canonical Workspace types

#### TENANT

```text
type                         TENANT
organizational_assignment_id null
organization_id              null
organization_unit_id         null
label                        string
```

#### ORGANIZATION

```text
type                         ORGANIZATION
organizational_assignment_id UUIDv7
organization_id              UUIDv7
organization_unit_id         null
label                        string
```

#### ORGANIZATION_UNIT

```text
type                         ORGANIZATION_UNIT
organizational_assignment_id UUIDv7
organization_id              UUIDv7
organization_unit_id         UUIDv7
label                        string
```

Tenant workspace bukan `"no workspace"`. Itu adalah **first-class valid workspace context**. ADR secara eksplisit melarang fake assignment untuk tenant context. 

Jadi nanti:

```ts
workspace.type === 'TENANT'
```

berbeda secara fundamental dengan:

```text
workspace unresolved
```

---

### 4. TENANT workspace selalu safe baseline

Backend `ListMyWorkspaces` sendiri selalu membuat TENANT workspace setelah canonical Membership/Tenant berhasil diverifikasi, lalu baru menambahkan active Organization/OrganizationUnit assignments. Ia juga fail closed jika Membership dan Tenant tidak cocok. 

Canonical flow:

```text
verified Membership/Tenant
        ↓
TENANT workspace
        +
active organizational assignments
```

Backend tests juga membuktikan inactive, cross-Membership, dan cross-Tenant assignments tidak boleh masuk projection. 

Karena itu **fresh login** dan **fresh Membership/Tenant switch** harus default ke:

```text
TENANT
```

bukan:

```text
first workspace in array
```

PRD dan ADR keduanya sudah mengunci keputusan ini.  

---

### 5. Workspace selection bukan server mutation

Tidak ada:

```http
POST /workspace/switch
```

dan kita **tidak akan membuatnya**.

Semantics:

```text
Membership switch
→ authentication-context change
→ server credential preparation
→ canonical /auth/me confirmation

Workspace switch
→ local target selection
→ verify organizational context/capabilities
→ publish local context
```

Workspace switch:

```text
DOES NOT change Membership
DOES NOT change Tenant
DOES NOT rotate credentials
DOES NOT create server-side active workspace
```

ADR-024 mengunci lifecycle:

```text
prepare
   ↓
verify capabilities
   ↓
commit
```

Ini sangat penting untuk desain state machine FEI-7.

---

### 6. Organizational assignment adalah locator, bukan authority

Current API foundation sudah memiliki:

```ts
OrganizationalAssignmentLocator

BrowserWorkspaceRequestContext {
    membershipId;
    organizationalAssignmentId;
}

createBrowserWorkspaceHeaderParams(...)
```

Untuk Organization/Unit:

```http
X-EduCore-Membership-Id: ...
X-EduCore-Organizational-Assignment-Id: ...
```

Tetapi untuk TENANT workspace:

```http
X-EduCore-Membership-Id: ...
```

dan **tidak ada** organizational-assignment header.

Existing transport tests sudah membuktikan `/my-workspaces` hanya membawa Membership locator, sedangkan workspace-capabilities membawa kedua locator. 

Jangan pernah membuat:

```text
X-EduCore-Organizational-Assignment-Id: tenantId
```

atau:

```text
X-EduCore-Organizational-Assignment-Id: null
```

---

### 7. Browser security semantics sudah locked

Canonical Browser Workspace backend tests membuktikan:

```text
BrowserSession + valid Membership locator
→ workspace discovery succeeds

browser supplied Authorization header
→ ignored

missing Membership locator
→ BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED

unknown/unprepared Membership locator
→ BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_DENIED

BrowserSession cookie present
+ forged/valid Authorization
→ BrowserSession transport wins

Bearer transport
→ remains stateless

response
→ never exposes access_token / bearer credential
```

Jadi FEI-7 tidak perlu membangun security transport baru. Ia harus memakai `BrowserApiClient` dan Membership locator machinery yang sudah dibuat FEI-4/6.

---

### 8. Workspace state harus tab-local

ADR menolak:

```text
localStorage.activeWorkspace
BrowserSession.activeWorkspace
global active workspace
```

karena:

```text
Tab A
Membership A / Tenant A
Workspace Academic

Tab B
Membership A / Tenant A
Workspace Finance
```

harus valid secara bersamaan. 

Jadi:

```text
Workspace selection
≠ shared browser authority
```

---

### 9. Reload restoration boleh ada, tapi hanya hint

ADR-024 memperbolehkan concept:

```text
sessionStorage
→ workspace restoration hint
```

tetapi yang disimpan bukan authority.

Conceptual key material:

```text
membershipId
tenantId
organizationalAssignmentId
```

Restore lifecycle:

```text
restore hint
    ↓
auth / Membership/Tenant canonical truth
    ↓
GET /my-workspaces
    ↓
assignment masih ada?
    │
 yes│         no
    ▼          ▼
verify       discard
            ↓
          TENANT
```

Jadi kita boleh menggunakan `sessionStorage` pada FEI-7 nanti, **tetapi hanya untuk restoration hint**, berbeda dengan larangan global Membership storage pada FEI-6.

---

### 10. Membership change harus invalidate seluruh Workspace truth

Dependency wajib:

```text
Workspace catalog
Workspace current context
Workspace restoration hint
```

seluruhnya scoped oleh:

```text
membershipId
+
tenantId
```

Jika FEI-6 berubah dari:

```text
Membership A / Tenant A
```

ke:

```text
Membership B / Tenant B
```

maka FEI-7 harus:

```text
invalidate old workspace catalog
discard incompatible restoration
rediscover B workspaces
select TENANT B
```

Workspace tidak boleh mempertahankan Organization A selama Membership B sedang aktif.

---

## Boundary penting dengan FEI-8

Ada satu dependency arsitektural yang perlu kita lock sekarang.

ADR-024 mengatakan Workspace target baru **tidak boleh dipublish sebagai READY sebelum capability/context verification berhasil**. 

Tetapi capability projection concrete implementation memang milestone berikut:

```text
FEI-8 - Authorization / Capabilities
```

Maka FEI-7 **tidak boleh mengakali dependency itu** dengan:

```ts
selectedWorkspace = target; // immediately authoritative ❌
```

Arah implementasinya nanti harus menyediakan seam seperti:

```text
WorkspaceRuntime
       │
       ├── discovery
       ├── selection/restoration
       │
       └── verifier boundary
               ↓
          FEI-8 capability runtime
```

Dengan begitu:

```text
FEI-7
→ owns Workspace state/orchestration

FEI-8
→ owns capability projection

Workspace commit
→ tetap dapat menunggu authoritative verifier
```

Kita akan desain seam tersebut pada state/runtime step, bukan mengimplementasikan permissions sekarang.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Audit ini memberi kita satu desain fundamental:

```text
Membership Context
= authentication / tenant boundary

Workspace Context
= operating / organizational projection
```

Jangan pernah membalik dependency:

```text
Workspace
→ determines Tenant            ❌

Assignment ID
→ grants permission            ❌

Workspace selection
→ changes BrowserSession       ❌

Workspace selection
→ exchanges bearer            ❌
```

Yang benar:

```text
canonical Membership/Tenant
        ↓
discover allowed Workspaces
        ↓
select tab-local candidate
        ↓
backend verification
        ↓
publish effective Workspace
```

Ini menjaga SOLID dan Clean Architecture karena Workspace layer bergantung pada canonical upstream context, bukan menciptakan authority sendiri.

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/workspace/contract.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    ApiComponents,
} from '@/platform/api';

export type TenantWorkspaceSummary =
    ApiComponents['schemas']['TenantWorkspaceSummary'];

export type OrganizationWorkspaceSummary =
    ApiComponents['schemas']['OrganizationWorkspaceSummary'];

export type OrganizationUnitWorkspaceSummary =
    ApiComponents['schemas']['OrganizationUnitWorkspaceSummary'];

export type WorkspaceSummary =
    ApiComponents['schemas']['WorkspaceSummary'];

    ApiComponents['schemas']['WorkspaceDiscoveryTenant'];

    ApiComponents['schemas']['WorkspaceDiscoveryData'];

    ApiComponents['schemas']['WorkspaceDiscoverySuccess'];
EOF
```

Tidak kita buat ulang interface manual seperti:

```ts
interface Workspace {
    type: string;
    organizational_assignment_id?: string;
}
```

karena itu akan kehilangan discriminator dan nullability yang sudah canonical di OpenAPI.

## 2. Workspace discovery service

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/workspace/discovery.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    createBrowserMembershipHeaderParams,
    executeBrowserApiRequest,
    type BrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserApiResult,
    type BrowserMembershipLocator,
} from '@/platform/api';

import type {
    WorkspaceDiscoverySuccess,
} from '@/platform/workspace/contract';

export interface DiscoverBrowserWorkspacesOptions {
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export async function discoverBrowserWorkspaces(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
    membershipId:
        BrowserMembershipLocator,
    options:
        DiscoverBrowserWorkspacesOptions = {},
): Promise<
    BrowserApiResult<
        WorkspaceDiscoverySuccess
    >
> {
    const requestOptions = {
        params: {
            header:
                createBrowserMembershipHeaderParams({
                    membershipId,
                }),
        },

        ...(
            options.signal
                === undefined
                ? {}
                : {
                    signal:
                        options.signal,
                }
        ),
    };

    return executeBrowserApiRequest(
        client.GET(
            '/api/v1/user/my-workspaces',
            requestOptions,
        ),
    );
}
EOF
```

Perhatikan bahwa service hanya mengirim:

```text
X-EduCore-Membership-Id
```

Tidak ada:

```text
X-EduCore-Organizational-Assignment-Id
```

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/workspace/__tests__/discovery.test.ts <<'EOF'

                kind:
                    'response',
                status: 401,
                error: {
                    status:
                        'error',
                    code:
                        'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED',
                    message:
                        'Authenticated browser session is required.',
                },
            });
        });

        it('preserves unavailable Browser Membership context failures', async () => {
            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/user/my-workspaces`,
                    () => HttpResponse.json(
                        {
                            status:
                                'error',
                            code:
                                'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_DENIED',
                            message:

                            status:

            const client =
                createBrowserApiClient();

            const result =
                await discoverBrowserWorkspaces(
                    client,
                    membershipId,

            expect(result).toEqual({
                ok: false,
                kind:
                    'response',
                status: 403,
                error: {
                    status:
                        'error',
                    code:
                        'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_DENIED',
                    message:
                        'Browser membership context is not available in this session.',
                },
            });

        it('preserves invalid Browser Membership locator failures', async () => {
            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/user/my-workspaces`,
                    () => HttpResponse.json(
                        {
                            status:
                                'error',
                            code:
                                'INVALID_BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_ID',
                            message:
                                'Browser membership identifier is invalid.',
                        },
                        {
                            status:
                                422,
                        },
                    ),
                ),
            );

            const client =
                createBrowserApiClient();

            const result =
                await discoverBrowserWorkspaces(
                    client,
                    membershipId,
                );

            expect(result).toMatchObject({
                ok: false,
                kind:
                    'response',
                status: 422,
                error: {
                    status:
                        'error',
                    code:
                        'INVALID_BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_ID',
                },
            });
        });

        it('propagates cancellation without dispatching Workspace discovery', async () => {
            let requestWasDispatched =
                false;

            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/user/my-workspaces`,
                    () => {
                        requestWasDispatched =
                            true;

                        return HttpResponse.json(
                            workspaceDiscoveryResponse,
                        );
                    },
                ),
            );

            const controller =
                new AbortController();

            controller.abort();

            const client =
                createBrowserApiClient();

            const result =
                await discoverBrowserWorkspaces(
                    client,
                    membershipId,
                    {
                        signal:
                            controller.signal,
                    },
                );

            expect(
                requestWasDispatched,
            ).toBe(false);

            expect(result.ok).toBe(
                false,
            );

            if (result.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    'Expected aborted Workspace discovery.',
                );
            }

            expect(result.kind).toBe(
                'aborted',
            );
        });
    },
);
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### OpenAPI tetap Source of Truth

Contract hanya melakukan:

```text
ApiComponents
    ↓
type aliases
```

Sehingga ketika OpenAPI drift berubah, TypeScript ikut mendeteksinya.

Tidak ada duplicate DTO.

### Discriminated union tetap utuh

Ini penting:

```ts
if (
    workspace.type
        === 'TENANT'
) {
    workspace
        .organizational_assignment_id;
    // null
}
```

dan:

```ts
if (
    workspace.type
        === 'ORGANIZATION_UNIT'
) {
    workspace
        .organizational_assignment_id;
    // UUIDv7

    workspace
        .organization_unit_id;
    // UUIDv7
}
```

TypeScript nanti membantu kita menjaga semantic per Workspace type.

### Discovery membutuhkan Membership secara eksplisit

Signature:

```ts
discoverBrowserWorkspaces(
    client,
    membershipId,
)
```

sengaja berbeda dari FEI-6:

```ts
discoverBrowserMemberships(
    client,
)
```

karena scope kedua endpoint memang berbeda:

```text
my-memberships
→ Person scope

my-workspaces
→ canonical Membership/Tenant scope
```

### Organizational locator tidak boleh dikirim saat discovery

Test pertama mengunci dua hal sekaligus:

```text
X-EduCore-Membership-Id
→ present

X-EduCore-Organizational-Assignment-Id
→ absent
```

Ini mencegah bug seperti:

```text
old Workspace assignment
        ↓
my-workspaces rediscovery
        ↓
request accidentally scoped by stale assignment
```

Workspace discovery harus selalu menemukan catalog dari current Membership/Tenant, bukan dari current organizational assignment.

### Service belum melakukan semantic validation

Misalnya backend secara kontradiktif mengembalikan:

```json
{
  "tenant": { "...": "..." },
  "workspaces": []
}
```

FEI-7B belum mengubah itu menjadi TENANT workspace buatan frontend.

Itu keputusan yang benar:

```text
transport service
→ preserves canonical result

state/runtime
→ validates Workspace invariants
```

Nanti FEI-7C/7E yang harus fail closed jika TENANT baseline hilang atau projection bertentangan dengan canonical Membership/Tenant.

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak `requestOptions`, jangan memakai `as any` atau cast generated client. Kirim exact TypeScript error; kita sempitkan shape request-nya.

Jika test pertama melihat Organizational Assignment header, jangan mengubah expectation. Itu berarti discovery mulai membawa stale Workspace context yang seharusnya tidak menjadi bagian request.

Jika error test `422` hanya berbeda pada message, itu bukan alasan mengubah production service; test tersebut sengaja mengunci stable machine code dan transport status, bukan bergantung pada copy message.

Jika full suite bukan `102/102`, FEI-7B belum kita kunci.

# Langkah Berikutnya

Jika seluruh gate di atas hijau:

```text
FEI-7A ✅ Contract & Boundary Audit
FEI-7B ✅ Workspace Contract + Discovery Service
FEI-7C ← Workspace State Model
```

FEI-7C nanti baru mendefinisikan state machine dan invariant penting seperti **TENANT first-class**, current catalog, candidate target, serta Membership/Tenant consistency. Belum `sessionStorage` dan belum capability implementation.

# FEI-7B.1 - Transport Type Alignment Repair

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita pisahkan dua hal:

```text
OpenAPI component aliases
→ canonical Workspace model

openapi-fetch inferred response
→ actual transport client type
```

`contract.ts` tetap strict:

```text
TENANT
→ null assignment
→ null organization
→ null unit
```

Tetapi `discovery.ts` **tidak boleh mengklaim** bahwa `openapi-fetch` mengembalikan type yang lebih sempit daripada yang sebenarnya diinfer library.

Jadi:

```ts
discoverBrowserWorkspaces()
```

akan membiarkan TypeScript menginfer return type dari:

```text
client.GET(...)
→ executeBrowserApiRequest(...)
```

Ini justru lebih type-safe daripada forcing annotation.

Semantic canonical validation nanti menjadi tanggung jawab state/runtime FEI-7C/7E.

```bash
import {
    createBrowserMembershipHeaderParams,
    executeBrowserApiRequest,
    type BrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserMembershipLocator,
} from '@/platform/api';

export interface DiscoverBrowserWorkspacesOptions {
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export async function discoverBrowserWorkspaces(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
    membershipId:
        BrowserMembershipLocator,
    options:
        DiscoverBrowserWorkspacesOptions = {},
) {
    const requestOptions = {
        params: {
            header:
                createBrowserMembershipHeaderParams({
                    membershipId,
                }),
        },

        ...(
            options.signal
                === undefined
                ? {}
                : {
                    signal:
                        options.signal,
                }
        ),
    };

    return executeBrowserApiRequest(
        client.GET(
            '/api/v1/user/my-workspaces',
            requestOptions,
        ),
    );
}
EOF
```

```diff
...

-} from '@/platform/workspace/contract';
...
-): Promise<
-    BrowserApiResult<
```

Tidak ada runtime behavior yang berubah.

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Kenapa bukan cast?

Jangan:

```ts
return executeBrowserApiRequest(
    ...
) as Promise<
    BrowserApiResult<
        WorkspaceDiscoverySuccess
    >
>;
```

Itu hanya membungkam compiler.

TS2322 sedang mengatakan:

```text
actual transport type
≠
declared return type
```

Compiler benar untuk menolak kontrak palsu tersebut.

---

### 2. Kenapa `contract.ts` tidak diubah?

Karena OpenAPI component sendiri memang mengunci canonical DTO:

```text
TenantWorkspaceSummary:
  organizational_assignment_id: null
  organization_id: null
  organization_unit_id: null
```

Kita tetap membutuhkan strict component types tersebut untuk Workspace domain/state.

Jangan melemahkan:

```ts
TenantWorkspaceSummary
```

menjadi:

```ts
{
    type: 'TENANT';
    organizational_assignment_id?: null;
}
```

hanya demi menyesuaikan tooling transport.

---

### 3. Ini menjaga Separation of Concerns

Nantinya:

```text
discovery.ts
→ transport truth

state/runtime
→ application invariant truth
```

Contohnya jika backend suatu hari mengembalikan malformed response:

```json
{
  "type": "TENANT",
  "label": "School"
}
```

kita tidak ingin transport layer diam-diam menciptakan:

```json
{
  "organizational_assignment_id": null,
  "organization_id": null,
  "organization_unit_id": null
}
```

karena itu menyamarkan contract violation.

FEI-7C/7E nanti boleh mengatakan:

```text
canonical Workspace invariant invalid
→ fail closed
```

---

### 4. Kenapa inference acceptable?

Karena return type bukan `any`.

Ia tetap berasal dari:

```text
BrowserApiClient
→ ApiPaths
→ openapi-fetch
→ generated schema
→ executeBrowserApiRequest<TData>
```

Browser client sendiri dibuat langsung dengan:

```ts
createClient<ApiPaths>()
```

jadi type inference tetap anchored ke generated OpenAPI. 

Dan normalizer kita generic:

```ts
executeBrowserApiRequest<TData>()
→ BrowserApiResult<TData>
```

sehingga inferred endpoint data tetap dipertahankan.

FEI-7B sekarang **✅ COMPLETE dan locked**: 21 files / 102 tests, typecheck/OpenAPI/build hijau, dan semua boundary audit bersih. Kita lanjut satu langkah saja ke **FEI-7C — Workspace State Model**; saya samakan pola reducer dengan FEI-6 supaya state transitions konsisten dan gampang direview.

> **Designing state transitions**
>
> I’m defining states for unresolved, ready, switching, recovering, and unavailable conditions. I’m also checking canonical membership, tenant consistency, discovered workspaces, current workspace, and candidate targets while keeping identity validation ID-based.
>
> **Designed state transitions**
>
> 
>
> **Refining recovery states**
>
> I’m separating unavailable discovery from recovery after stale authority. Recovery retains only canonical membership and failure, while current workspace and catalog are discarded until fresh discovery succeeds. Empty or multiply tenant-scoped results are treated as invalid catalog data.
>
> **Implemented FEI-7C state model and inspected membership state tests**
>
> 
>
> Worked for 1m 14s

FEI-7B **✅ COMPLETE dan locked**.

```text
FEI-7A  ✅ Contract & Boundary Audit
FEI-7B  ✅ Workspace Contract + Discovery Service
FEI-7C  ← Workspace State Model
```

Hasil final FEI-7B sesuai target: **21 test files / 102 tests**, typecheck/OpenAPI/build seluruhnya PASS, hanya Membership locator yang dikirim saat discovery, dan belum ada state/storage/authz/raw HTTP. Current FEI-6 reducer juga sudah memberi pola fail-closed yang bagus untuk kita pertahankan di Workspace. 

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

FEI-7C hanya mengimplementasikan **pure Workspace state machine**.

Belum:

```text
HTTP orchestration
sessionStorage
restoration
capabilities
React
ApplicationRuntime
```

State harus membedakan:

```text
UNRESOLVED
     ↓
DISCOVERING
     ↓
READY
     │
     ├── select target
     ↓
SWITCHING
     │
     ├── target verified
     │       ↓
     │     READY
     │
     └── failure
             ↓
           READY(previous)

READY
  ↓ stale current workspace
RECOVERING
  ↓
DISCOVERING
```

Tiga invariant utamanya:

```text
1. TENANT adalah Workspace valid dan selalu safe baseline.

2. Target Workspace belum menjadi current Workspace
   selama status masih SWITCHING.

3. Workspace catalog/current selalu berada di bawah
   canonical Membership/Tenant yang sama.
```

Konsep nomor 2 sangat penting untuk FEI-8:

```text
select Organization B
        ↓
SWITCHING
current tetap A
target = B
        ↓
future capability verifier
        ↓
TARGET_VERIFIED
        ↓
current = B
```

Jadi FEI-7C sudah menyiapkan **verification seam** tanpa mengimplementasikan authorization.

## 1. Workspace state model

Buat `frontend/src/platform/workspace/state.ts`:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/workspace/state.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    BrowserApiFailure,
} from '@/platform/api';
import type {
    CanonicalMembershipContext,
} from '@/platform/membership';

import type {
    WorkspaceDiscoveryData,
    WorkspaceDiscoveryTenant,
    WorkspaceSummary,
} from '@/platform/workspace/contract';

export interface UnresolvedWorkspaceContextState {
    readonly status:
        'unresolved';
}

export interface DiscoveringWorkspaceContextState {
    readonly status:
        'discovering';

    readonly context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext;
}

export interface ReadyWorkspaceContextState {
    readonly status:
        'ready';

    readonly context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext;

    readonly tenant:
        WorkspaceDiscoveryTenant;

    readonly workspaces:
        readonly WorkspaceSummary[];

    readonly current:
        WorkspaceSummary;

    readonly failure:
        BrowserApiFailure | null;
}

export interface SwitchingWorkspaceContextState {
    readonly status:
        'switching';

    readonly context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext;

    readonly tenant:
        WorkspaceDiscoveryTenant;

    readonly workspaces:
        readonly WorkspaceSummary[];

    readonly current:
        WorkspaceSummary;

    readonly target:
        WorkspaceSummary;
}

export interface RecoveringWorkspaceContextState {
    readonly status:
        'recovering';

    readonly context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext;

    readonly failure:
        BrowserApiFailure;
}

export interface UnavailableWorkspaceContextState {
    readonly status:
        'unavailable';

    readonly context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext;

    readonly failure:
        BrowserApiFailure;
}

export type WorkspaceContextState =
    | UnresolvedWorkspaceContextState
    | DiscoveringWorkspaceContextState
    | ReadyWorkspaceContextState
    | SwitchingWorkspaceContextState
    | RecoveringWorkspaceContextState
    | UnavailableWorkspaceContextState;

export type WorkspaceContextAction =
    | {
        readonly type:
            'DISCOVERY_STARTED';

        readonly context:
            CanonicalMembershipContext;
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'DISCOVERY_READY';

        readonly discovery:
            WorkspaceDiscoveryData;
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'DISCOVERY_UNAVAILABLE';

        readonly failure:
            BrowserApiFailure;
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'SWITCH_STARTED';

        readonly target:
            WorkspaceSummary;
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'TARGET_VERIFIED';
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'SWITCH_FAILED';

        readonly failure:
            BrowserApiFailure;
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'RECOVERY_STARTED';

        readonly failure:
            BrowserApiFailure;
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'RESET';
    };

export function createInitialWorkspaceContextState():
    UnresolvedWorkspaceContextState {
    return {
        status:
            'unresolved',
    };
}

function invalidTransition(
    state: WorkspaceContextState,
    action: WorkspaceContextAction,
): never {
    throw new Error(
        [
            'Invalid EduCore WorkspaceContext transition:',
            state.status,
            '->',
            action.type,
        ].join(' '),
    );
}

function workspaceIdentityMatches(
    first: WorkspaceSummary,
    second: WorkspaceSummary,
): boolean {
    if (
        first.type
            !== second.type
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    if (
        first.type
            === 'TENANT'
        && second.type
            === 'TENANT'
    ) {
        return true;
    }

    if (
        first.type
            === 'ORGANIZATION'
        && second.type
            === 'ORGANIZATION'
    ) {
        return (
            first.organizational_assignment_id
                === second.organizational_assignment_id
        );
    }

    if (
        first.type
            === 'ORGANIZATION_UNIT'
        && second.type
            === 'ORGANIZATION_UNIT'
    ) {
        return (
            first.organizational_assignment_id
                === second.organizational_assignment_id
        );
    }

    return false;
}

function findWorkspace(
    workspaces:
        readonly WorkspaceSummary[],
    target:
        WorkspaceSummary,
): WorkspaceSummary | undefined {
    return workspaces.find(
        (workspace) =>
            workspaceIdentityMatches(
                workspace,
                target,
            ),
    );
}

function assertDiscoveryMatchesContext(
    context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
    discovery:
        WorkspaceDiscoveryData,
): WorkspaceSummary {
    if (
        discovery.tenant.id
            !== context.tenant.id
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'EduCore WorkspaceContext discovery Tenant does not match the canonical Membership/Tenant context.',
        );
    }

    const tenantWorkspaces =
        discovery.workspaces.filter(
            (workspace) =>
                workspace.type
                    === 'TENANT',
        );

    if (
        tenantWorkspaces.length
            !== 1
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'EduCore WorkspaceContext discovery must contain exactly one TENANT Workspace.',
        );
    }

    const assignmentIds =
        new Set<string>();

    for (
        const workspace
        of discovery.workspaces
    ) {
        if (
            workspace.type
                === 'TENANT'
        ) {
            continue;
        }

        const assignmentId =
            workspace
                .organizational_assignment_id;

        if (
            assignmentIds.has(
                assignmentId,
            )
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                'EduCore WorkspaceContext discovery contains duplicate organizational assignment locators.',
            );
        }

        assignmentIds.add(
            assignmentId,
        );
    }

    const tenantWorkspace =
        tenantWorkspaces[0];

    if (
        tenantWorkspace
            === undefined
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'EduCore WorkspaceContext discovery must contain exactly one TENANT Workspace.',
        );
    }

    return tenantWorkspace;
}

export function workspaceContextReducer(
    state: WorkspaceContextState,
    action: WorkspaceContextAction,
): WorkspaceContextState {
    switch (action.type) {
        case 'DISCOVERY_STARTED':
            /*
             * Discovery may replace unresolved, stale,
             * unavailable, or previous stable Workspace
             * truth.
             *
             * An active Workspace switch cannot be
             * interrupted at reducer level. Runtime
             * orchestration owns cancellation/revisions.
             */
            if (
                state.status
                    === 'switching'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'discovering',
                context:
                    action.context,
            };

        case 'DISCOVERY_READY': {
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'discovering'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            const tenantWorkspace =
                assertDiscoveryMatchesContext(
                    state.context,
                    action.discovery,
                );

            return {
                status:
                    'ready',
                context:
                    state.context,
                tenant:
                    action.discovery.tenant,
                workspaces:
                    action.discovery.workspaces,
                current:
                    tenantWorkspace,
                failure:
                    null,
            };
        }

        case 'DISCOVERY_UNAVAILABLE':
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'discovering'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'unavailable',
                context:
                    state.context,
                failure:
                    action.failure,
            };

        case 'SWITCH_STARTED': {
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'ready'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            const target =
                findWorkspace(
                    state.workspaces,
                    action.target,
                );

            if (
                target
                    === undefined
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    'EduCore WorkspaceContext switch target is not available in the current Workspace catalog.',
                );
            }

            if (
                workspaceIdentityMatches(
                    state.current,
                    target,
                )
            ) {
                return state;
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'switching',
                context:
                    state.context,
                tenant:
                    state.tenant,
                workspaces:
                    state.workspaces,
                current:
                    state.current,
                target,
            };
        }

        case 'TARGET_VERIFIED':
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'switching'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'ready',
                context:
                    state.context,
                tenant:
                    state.tenant,
                workspaces:
                    state.workspaces,
                current:
                    state.target,
                failure:
                    null,
            };

        case 'SWITCH_FAILED':
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'switching'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'ready',
                context:
                    state.context,
                tenant:
                    state.tenant,
                workspaces:
                    state.workspaces,
                current:
                    state.current,
                failure:
                    action.failure,
            };

        case 'RECOVERY_STARTED':
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'ready'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            /*
             * A stale current organizational context is no
             * longer authoritative. Do not expose the old
             * Workspace catalog/current Workspace while
             * recovery is active.
             */
            return {
                status:
                    'recovering',
                context:
                    state.context,
                failure:
                    action.failure,
            };

        case 'RESET':
            return createInitialWorkspaceContextState();
    }
}
EOF
```

```bash
                            'DISCOVERY_STARTED',
                        context,
                    },
                );

            expect(
                () =>
                    workspaceContextReducer(
                        discovering,
                        {
                            type:
                                'DISCOVERY_READY',
                            discovery: {
                                tenant:
                                    discovery.tenant,
                                workspaces: [
                                    organizationWorkspace,
                                    unitWorkspace,
                                ],
                            },
                        },
                    ),
            ).toThrow(
                'EduCore WorkspaceContext discovery must contain exactly one TENANT Workspace.',
            );
        });

        it('fails closed when discovery contains multiple TENANT Workspaces', () => {
            const discovering =
                workspaceContextReducer(
                    createInitialWorkspaceContextState(),
                    {
                        type:
                            'DISCOVERY_STARTED',
                        context,
                    },
                );

            expect(
                () =>
                    workspaceContextReducer(
                        discovering,
                        {
                            type:
                                'DISCOVERY_READY',
                            discovery: {
                                tenant:
                                    discovery.tenant,
                                workspaces: [
                                    tenantWorkspace,
                                    {
                                        ...tenantWorkspace,
                                        label:
                                            'Duplicate Tenant',
                                    },
                                ],
                            },
                        },
                    ),
            ).toThrow(
                'EduCore WorkspaceContext discovery must contain exactly one TENANT Workspace.',
            );
        });

        it('fails closed when organizational assignment locators are duplicated', () => {
            const duplicateUnit:
                WorkspaceSummary = {
                    type:
                        'ORGANIZATION_UNIT',
                    organizational_assignment_id:
                        organizationAssignmentId,
                    organization_id:
                        organizationId,
                    organization_unit_id:
                        organizationUnitId,
                    label:
                        'Duplicate Assignment',
                };

            const discovering =
                workspaceContextReducer(
                    createInitialWorkspaceContextState(),
                    {
                        type:
                            'DISCOVERY_STARTED',
                        context,
                    },
                );

            expect(
                () =>
                    workspaceContextReducer(
                        discovering,
                        {
                            type:
                                'DISCOVERY_READY',
                            discovery: {
                                tenant:
                                    discovery.tenant,
                                workspaces: [
                                    tenantWorkspace,
                                    organizationWorkspace,
                                    duplicateUnit,
                                ],
                            },
                        },
                    ),
            ).toThrow(
                'EduCore WorkspaceContext discovery contains duplicate organizational assignment locators.',
            );
        });

        it('keeps the current Workspace authoritative while a canonical catalog target is switching', () => {
            const ready =
                createReadyState();

            const switching =
                workspaceContextReducer(
                    ready,
                    {
                        type:
                            'SWITCH_STARTED',
                        target: {
                            ...organizationWorkspace,
                            label:
                                'Untrusted Caller Label',
                        },
                    },
                );

            expect(switching).toEqual({
                status:
                    'switching',
                context,
                tenant:
                    discovery.tenant,
                workspaces:
                    discovery.workspaces,
                current:
                    tenantWorkspace,
                target:
                    organizationWorkspace,
            });
        });

        it('treats selecting the current Workspace as a no-op', () => {
            const ready =
                createReadyState();

            const state =
                workspaceContextReducer(
                    ready,
                    {
                        type:
                            'SWITCH_STARTED',
                        target:
                            tenantWorkspace,
                    },
                );

            expect(state).toBe(
                ready,
            );
        });

        it('rejects a switch target that is not in the current Workspace catalog', () => {
            const ready =
                createReadyState();

            const unavailableTarget:
                WorkspaceSummary = {
                    type:
                        'ORGANIZATION',
                    organizational_assignment_id:
                        '018f3b6a-7c20-7def-9def-1234567890ab',
                    organization_id:
                        '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8abc-1234567890ab',
                    organization_unit_id:
                        null,
                    label:
                        'Unavailable Workspace',
                };

            expect(
                () =>
                    workspaceContextReducer(
                        ready,
                        {
                            type:
                                'SWITCH_STARTED',
                            target:
                                unavailableTarget,
                        },
                    ),
            ).toThrow(
                'EduCore WorkspaceContext switch target is not available in the current Workspace catalog.',
            );
        });

        it('commits the target Workspace only after target verification', () => {
            const ready =
                createReadyState();

            const switching =
                workspaceContextReducer(
                    ready,
                    {
                        type:
                            'SWITCH_STARTED',
                        target:
                            organizationWorkspace,
                    },
                );

            expect(
                switching.status,
            ).toBe(
                'switching',
            );

            if (
                switching.status
                    !== 'switching'
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    'Expected Workspace switching state.',
                );
            }

            expect(
                switching.current,
            ).toEqual(
                tenantWorkspace,
            );

            const verified =
                workspaceContextReducer(
                    switching,
                    {
                        type:
                            'TARGET_VERIFIED',
                    },
                );

            expect(verified).toEqual({
                status:
                    'ready',
                context,
                tenant:
                    discovery.tenant,
                workspaces:
                    discovery.workspaces,
                current:
                    organizationWorkspace,
                failure:
                    null,
            });
        });

        it('restores the previous current Workspace when target verification fails', () => {
            const ready =
                createReadyState();

            const switching =
                workspaceContextReducer(
                    ready,
                    {
                        type:
                            'SWITCH_STARTED',
                        target:
                            organizationWorkspace,
                    },
                );

            const restored =
                workspaceContextReducer(
                    switching,
                    {
                        type:
                            'SWITCH_FAILED',
                        failure:
                            networkFailure,
                    },
                );

            expect(restored).toEqual({
                status:
                    'ready',
                context,
                tenant:
                    discovery.tenant,
                workspaces:
                    discovery.workspaces,
                current:
                    tenantWorkspace,
                failure:
                    networkFailure,
            });
        });

        it('removes stale Workspace authority while recovery is active', () => {
            const ready =
                createReadyState();

            const switching =
                workspaceContextReducer(
                    ready,
                    {
                        type:
                            'SWITCH_STARTED',
                        target:
                            organizationWorkspace,
                    },
                );

            const organizationalReady =
                workspaceContextReducer(
                    switching,
                    {
                        type:
                            'TARGET_VERIFIED',
                    },
                );

            const recovering =
                workspaceContextReducer(
                    organizationalReady,
                    {
                        type:
                            'RECOVERY_STARTED',
                        failure:
                            contextDeniedFailure,
                    },
                );

            expect(recovering).toEqual({
                status:
                    'recovering',
                context,
                failure:
                    contextDeniedFailure,
            });

            expect(
                'current'
                    in recovering,
            ).toBe(false);

            expect(
                'workspaces'
                    in recovering,
            ).toBe(false);

            const rediscovering =
                workspaceContextReducer(
                    recovering,
                    {
                        type:
                            'DISCOVERY_STARTED',
                        context,
                    },
                );

            expect(rediscovering).toEqual({
                status:
                    'discovering',
                context,
            });
        });
    },
);
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. TENANT bukan `null`

Sesudah discovery:

```text
status  = ready
current = {
    type: TENANT,
    organizational_assignment_id: null,
    ...
}
```

Bukan:

```text
current = null
```

Ini menghilangkan ambiguity:

```text
null =
belum load?
tenant mode?
error?
```

---

### 2. Discovery harus cocok dengan canonical Tenant

Reducer menerima canonical:

```text
Membership
+
Tenant
```

dari upstream FEI-6.

Kemudian discovery wajib:

```text
discovery.tenant.id
===
context.tenant.id
```

Kalau tidak:

```text
throw
→ fail closed
```

Workspace tidak pernah boleh menentukan Tenant baru.

---

### 3. Exactly one TENANT Workspace

Backend sudah menjanjikan safe TENANT baseline.

Maka:

```text
0 TENANT  → contract violation
2 TENANT  → contract violation
1 TENANT  → valid
```

Kita tidak membuat TENANT fallback sendiri jika backend melanggar contract.

---

### 4. Assignment locator harus unik

Catalog seperti:

```text
Organization A → assignment X
Unit B         → assignment X
```

ditolak.

Walaupun `type` berbeda, assignment merupakan canonical organizational locator sehingga satu catalog tidak boleh ambigu.

---

### 5. Caller target tidak langsung dipercaya

Perhatikan test:

```ts
target: {
    ...organizationWorkspace,
    label:
        'Untrusted Caller Label',
}
```

Reducer hanya memakai input itu untuk **identity lookup**, kemudian mengambil canonical object dari:

```text
state.workspaces
```

Sehingga:

```text
caller object
≠ authoritative Workspace object
```

Canonical catalog tetap authority.

---

### 6. Prepare → verify → commit

Saat:

```text
SWITCH_STARTED
```

state:

```text
current = old
target  = candidate
```

Belum:

```text
current = candidate
```

Hanya:

```text
TARGET_VERIFIED
```

yang commit target.

Ini seam penting untuk FEI-8 capability projection tanpa memasukkan permission logic ke FEI-7C.

---

### 7. Switch failure mempertahankan context lama

Contoh:

```text
Tenant workspace
→ select Organization A
→ verification network failure
```

hasil:

```text
READY
current = Tenant
failure = network failure
```

Bukan blank Workspace.

Ini transactional rollback semantics.

---

### 8. Recovery berbeda dengan switch failure

`SWITCH_FAILED` berarti:

```text
target baru gagal
current lama masih authoritative
```

Sedangkan:

```text
RECOVERY_STARTED
```

berarti **current lama sendiri sudah stale/denied**.

Karena itu recovery sengaja menghapus:

```text
current
workspaces
```

dari state authoritative.

State hanya mempertahankan canonical upstream:

```text
Membership/Tenant
```

untuk rediscovery.

---

### 9. Pure reducer

`state.ts` tidak mengetahui:

```text
HTTP
BrowserApiClient
sessionStorage
capabilities
React
QueryClient
```

Separation of Concerns tetap bersih seperti FEI-6 reducer yang juga memisahkan transition rules dari runtime orchestration.

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript bermasalah pada narrowing `WorkspaceSummary`, jangan gunakan `as`. Kirim exact error; kita perbaiki discriminator logic.

Jika duplicate locator test gagal karena reducer menganggap Organization dan Unit boleh memakai assignment yang sama, jangan ubah expectation. Assignment adalah locator canonical per placement dan harus non-ambigu dalam catalog.

Jika `RECOVERY_STARTED` masih menghasilkan state yang mempunyai `current`, jangan terima itu sebagai harmless. Stale Workspace tidak boleh tetap terlihat authoritative selama recovery.

Jika full test count bukan `114`, kita audit sebelum lanjut.

```text
FEI-7D ← Tab-Local Selection + Restoration Hint
```

FEI-7D baru akan membahas `sessionStorage`, tetapi **hanya sebagai restoration hint yang terikat Membership/Tenant**, tidak pernah sebagai Workspace authority.

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Lifecycle FEI-7D:

```text
Current verified Workspace
        │
        ├── TENANT
        │     ↓
        │   clear hint
        │
        └── ORGANIZATION / ORGANIZATION_UNIT
              ↓
        save minimal sessionStorage hint
              ↓
             reload
              ↓
      canonical Membership/Tenant
              ↓
        fresh /my-workspaces
              ↓
      resolve saved assignment
          ┌───┴────┐
        found      stale
          │          │
          ▼          ▼
       candidate    null
          │
          ▼
   future verification
```

Yang disimpan hanya:

```text
version
membershipId
tenantId
organizationalAssignmentId
```

Tidak disimpan:

```text
label
organizationId
organizationUnitId
permissions
capabilities
token
bearer credential
```

Dan yang sangat penting:

```text
stored assignment
≠ Workspace

stored assignment
≠ authorization

stored assignment
≠ request header authority
```

Resolver selalu mengembalikan **canonical Workspace object dari fresh catalog**, bukan object dari storage.

---

# Struktur Folder & File

Tambahkan:

```text
frontend/src/platform/workspace/
├── restoration.ts
└── __tests__/
    └── restoration.test.ts
```

Ubah:

```text
frontend/src/platform/workspace/index.ts
```

Tidak ubah:

```text
state.ts
discovery.ts
contract.ts
platform/api/*
platform/membership/*
app/*
```

Belum staging.
