## 1. Semantic validation boundary

Buat `frontend/src/platform/authorization/validation.ts`:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/authorization/validation.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    CanonicalMembershipContext,
} from '@/platform/membership';

import type {
    PermissionName,
    TenantCapabilityData,
    TenantCapabilitySuccess,
    WorkspaceCapabilityData,
    WorkspaceCapabilityScope,
    WorkspaceCapabilitySuccess,
} from '@/platform/authorization/contract';

export interface OrganizationCapabilityScopeExpectation {
    readonly type:
        'organization';

    readonly organizationalAssignmentId:
        WorkspaceCapabilityScope[
            'organizational_assignment_id'
        ];

    readonly organizationId:
        WorkspaceCapabilityScope[
            'organization_id'
        ];

    readonly organizationUnitId:
        null;
}

export interface OrganizationUnitCapabilityScopeExpectation {
    readonly type:
        'organization_unit';

    readonly organizationalAssignmentId:
        WorkspaceCapabilityScope[
            'organizational_assignment_id'
        ];

    readonly organizationId:
        WorkspaceCapabilityScope[
            'organization_id'
        ];

    readonly organizationUnitId:
        Exclude<
            WorkspaceCapabilityScope[
                'organization_unit_id'
            ],
            null
        >;
}

export type WorkspaceCapabilityScopeExpectation =
    | OrganizationCapabilityScopeExpectation
    | OrganizationUnitCapabilityScopeExpectation;

export interface ValidCapabilityProjection<
    Data,
> {
    readonly ok:
        true;

    readonly data:
        Data;
}

export interface InvalidCapabilityProjection {
    readonly ok:
        false;

    readonly kind:
        | 'invalid-payload'
        | 'scope-mismatch';
}

export type CapabilityProjectionValidationResult<
    Data,
> =
    | ValidCapabilityProjection<Data>
    | InvalidCapabilityProjection;

function isRecord(
    value: unknown,
): value is Record<
    string,
    unknown
> {
    return (
        typeof value
            === 'object'
        && value !== null
        && ! Array.isArray(
            value,
        )
    );
}

function isNonEmptyString(
    value: unknown,
): value is string {
    return (
        typeof value
            === 'string'
        && value.length
            > 0
    );
}

function isPermissionNames(
    value: unknown,
): value is PermissionName[] {
    if (
        ! Array.isArray(
            value,
        )
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    const names =
        new Set<string>();

    for (
        const item
        of value
    ) {
        if (
            ! isNonEmptyString(
                item,
            )
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        if (
            names.has(
                item,
            )
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        names.add(
            item,
        );
    }

    return true;
}

function isTenantCapabilitySuccess(
    value: unknown,
): value is TenantCapabilitySuccess {
    if (
        ! isRecord(
            value,
        )
        || value.status
            !== 'success'
        || ! isRecord(
            value.data,
        )
        || ! isRecord(
            value.data.scope,
        )
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    const data =
        value.data;

    const scope =
        data.scope;

    return (
        scope.type
            === 'tenant'
        && isNonEmptyString(
            scope.tenant_id,
        )
        && isNonEmptyString(
            scope.membership_id,
        )
        && typeof data
            .is_global_superadmin
            === 'boolean'
        && isPermissionNames(
            data.permissions,
        )
    );
}

function isWorkspaceCapabilitySuccess(
    value: unknown,
): value is WorkspaceCapabilitySuccess {
    if (
        ! isRecord(
            value,
        )
        || value.status
            !== 'success'
        || ! isRecord(
            value.data,
        )
        || ! isRecord(
            value.data.scope,
        )
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    const data =
        value.data;

    const scope =
        data.scope;

    if (
        scope.type
            !== 'organization'
        && scope.type
            !== 'organization_unit'
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    return (
        isNonEmptyString(
            scope.tenant_id,
        )
        && isNonEmptyString(
            scope.membership_id,
        )
        && isNonEmptyString(
            scope
                .organizational_assignment_id,
        )
        && isNonEmptyString(
            scope.organization_id,
        )
        && (
            scope.organization_unit_id
                === null
            || isNonEmptyString(
                scope.organization_unit_id,
            )
        )
        && typeof data
            .is_global_superadmin
            === 'boolean'
        && isPermissionNames(
            data.permissions,
        )
    );
}

function invalidPayload():
    InvalidCapabilityProjection {
    return {
        ok:
            false,
        kind:
            'invalid-payload',
    };
}

function scopeMismatch():
    InvalidCapabilityProjection {
    return {
        ok:
            false,
        kind:
            'scope-mismatch',
    };
}

export function validateTenantCapabilityProjection(
    context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
    value:
        unknown,
): CapabilityProjectionValidationResult<
    TenantCapabilityData
> {
    if (
        ! isTenantCapabilitySuccess(
            value,
        )
    ) {
        return invalidPayload();
    }

    if (
        value.data.scope
            .membership_id
            !== context.membership.id
        || value.data.scope
            .tenant_id
            !== context.tenant.id
    ) {
        return scopeMismatch();
    }

    return {
        ok:
            true,
        data:
            value.data,
    };
}

export function validateWorkspaceCapabilityProjection(
    context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
    expected:
        WorkspaceCapabilityScopeExpectation,
    value:
        unknown,
): CapabilityProjectionValidationResult<
    WorkspaceCapabilityData
> {
    if (
        ! isWorkspaceCapabilitySuccess(
            value,
        )
    ) {
        return invalidPayload();
    }

    const scope =
        value.data.scope;

    if (
        scope.membership_id
            !== context.membership.id
        || scope.tenant_id
            !== context.tenant.id
        || scope.type
            !== expected.type
        || scope
            .organizational_assignment_id
            !== expected
                .organizationalAssignmentId
        || scope.organization_id
            !== expected.organizationId
        || scope.organization_unit_id
            !== expected
                .organizationUnitId
    ) {
        return scopeMismatch();
    }

    return {
        ok:
            true,
        data:
            value.data,
    };
}
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### HTTP 200 bukan authorization proof

Transport success hanya membuktikan:

```text
request selesai
+
server mengembalikan 2xx
```

Belum membuktikan:

```text
response tersebut milik Membership/Tenant/Workspace yang sedang kita verifikasi
```

Karena itu semantic validation merupakan security boundary, bukan sekadar data validation.

### Kita membedakan dua failure class

```text
invalid-payload
```

berarti response tidak memenuhi canonical schema runtime, misalnya:

```text
duplicate permissions
empty PermissionName
missing scope
invalid boolean
```

Sedangkan:

```text
scope-mismatch
```

berarti payload terlihat structurally valid tetapi authority context-nya berbeda:

```text
Membership B
Tenant B
Assignment B
Organization B
Unit B
```

Keduanya harus fail closed, tetapi perbedaannya berguna untuk observability dan runtime translation nanti.

### `uniqueItems` divalidasi saat runtime

TypeScript tidak dapat menjamin OpenAPI:

```yaml
uniqueItems: true
```

Maka validator menggunakan `Set`.

Array kosong tetap valid karena OpenAPI tidak memiliki `minItems`.

### Tidak hard-code permission catalog

Validator hanya memeriksa:

```text
string
length > 0
unique
```

Ia tidak memiliki daftar seperti:

```text
academic.grades.write
dormitory.rooms.manage
...
```

sebagai enum authority.

Dengan demikian permission baru di backend tidak memerlukan perubahan semantic validator.

### Authorization tetap belum bergantung pada Workspace module

Perhatikan expectation:

```ts
WorkspaceCapabilityScopeExpectation
```

bukan:

```ts
WorkspaceSummary
```

Ini intentional.

Dependency sekarang tetap:

```text
membership contract
       ↓
authorization validation
```

Bukan:

```text
authorization
↔
workspace
```

Nanti concrete verifier menjadi adapter yang menerjemahkan `WorkspaceSummary` menjadi `WorkspaceCapabilityScopeExpectation`.

### No casts

Input validator adalah:

```ts
unknown
```

lalu dipersempit dengan runtime guards.

Tidak ada:

```ts
as TenantCapabilitySuccess
as WorkspaceCapabilitySuccess
as any
```

Ini penting karena titik ini justru berada di trust boundary.

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak predicate `PermissionName[]`, jangan cast. Kirim exact error; kita derive guard dari generated type dengan bentuk yang TypeScript dapat buktikan.

Jika canonical `organization_unit_id` ternyata di generated type memiliki inference berbeda dari `string | null`, jangan gunakan `as`. Kita sesuaikan expectation alias langsung terhadap generated schema.

Jika validator menerima duplicate permission names, itu blocker karena OpenAPI mengunci `uniqueItems: true`.

Jika scope mismatch malah menghasilkan `invalid-payload`, cek apakah fixture secara tidak sengaja merusak structural shape. Structural validity dan identity mismatch sengaja dibedakan.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Validator memang sengaja menerima:

```ts
value: unknown
```

Ini benar karena response eksternal adalah trust boundary.

Masalahnya bukan karena kita terlalu strict. Masalahnya urutan narrowing:

```ts
isRecord(value.data)
isRecord(value.data.scope)

const data = value.data;
const scope = data.scope;
```

TypeScript tidak cukup kuat untuk mempertahankan semua property-path narrowing tersebut ke alias baru.

Perbaikannya adalah melakukan narrowing **bertahap terhadap local variable**:

```text
unknown value
   ↓ isRecord
Record

unknown data
   ↓ isRecord
Record

unknown scope
   ↓ isRecord
Record
```

Bukan cast.

Tetap dilarang:

```ts
as Record<string, unknown>
as TenantCapabilitySuccess
as WorkspaceCapabilitySuccess
as any
```

## Kode Lengkap

Di `validation.ts`, ganti **hanya dua function** berikut.

### 1. `isTenantCapabilitySuccess`

Ganti implementation-nya menjadi:

```ts
function isTenantCapabilitySuccess(
    value: unknown,
): value is TenantCapabilitySuccess {
    if (
        ! isRecord(
            value,
        )
        || value.status
            !== 'success'
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    const data =
        value.data;

    if (
        ! isRecord(
            data,
        )
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    const scope =
        data.scope;

    if (
        ! isRecord(
            scope,
        )
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    return (
        scope.type
            === 'tenant'
        && isNonEmptyString(
            scope.tenant_id,
        )
        && isNonEmptyString(
            scope.membership_id,
        )
        && typeof data
            .is_global_superadmin
            === 'boolean'
        && isPermissionNames(
            data.permissions,
        )
    );
}
```

### 2. `isWorkspaceCapabilitySuccess`

Ganti implementation-nya menjadi:

```ts
function isWorkspaceCapabilitySuccess(
    value: unknown,
): value is WorkspaceCapabilitySuccess {
    if (
        ! isRecord(
            value,
        )
        || value.status
            !== 'success'
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    const data =
        value.data;

    if (
        ! isRecord(
            data,
        )
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    const scope =
        data.scope;

    if (
        ! isRecord(
            scope,
        )
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    if (
        scope.type
            !== 'organization'
        && scope.type
            !== 'organization_unit'
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    return (
        isNonEmptyString(
            scope.tenant_id,
        )
        && isNonEmptyString(
            scope.membership_id,
        )
        && isNonEmptyString(
            scope
                .organizational_assignment_id,
        )
        && isNonEmptyString(
            scope.organization_id,
        )
        && (
            scope.organization_unit_id
                === null
            || isNonEmptyString(
                scope.organization_unit_id,
            )
        )
        && typeof data
            .is_global_superadmin
            === 'boolean'
        && isPermissionNames(
            data.permissions,
        )
    );
}
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### Mengapa Vitest lulus tetapi TypeScript gagal?

Output Anda menunjukkan:

```text
26 test files
158 tests
PASS
```

namun kemudian:

```text
TS18046: 'scope' is of type 'unknown'
```

`Pasted text.txt`

Ini normal karena Vitest/Vite melakukan transpilation dan menjalankan JavaScript; itu bukan pengganti full static `tsc --noEmit`.

Karena itu pipeline kita memang benar mempunyai kedua gate:

```text
runtime correctness
        +
compile-time correctness
```

Keduanya wajib hijau.

### Kenapa local-variable narrowing lebih baik?

Versi sebelumnya secara konseptual:

```ts
isRecord(value.data.scope)
```

memvalidasi sebuah **property expression**.

Versi baru:

```ts
const data = value.data;

if (!isRecord(data)) {
    return false;
}

const scope = data.scope;

if (!isRecord(scope)) {
    return false;
}
```

memvalidasi identifier stabil satu per satu.

Sesudah:

```ts
isRecord(scope)
```

TypeScript tahu pasti:

```ts
scope: Record<string, unknown>
```

sehingga:

```ts
scope.type
scope.tenant_id
scope.membership_id
```

legal untuk dibaca sebagai `unknown` dan kemudian dipersempit oleh validator masing-masing.

### Security boundary tidak dilemahkan

Kita **tidak** memperbaiki error dengan:

```ts
const scope =
    value.data.scope as WorkspaceCapabilityScope;
```

Itu justru akan membypass tujuan FEI-8C.

Alurnya tetap:

```text
unknown
↓
runtime validation
↓
structurally valid canonical shape
↓
scope identity validation
↓
authorization projection accepted
```

## Troubleshooting

Jika setelah perubahan masih muncul `TS18046`, kirim exact line baru. Jangan tambahkan cast.

Jika error berubah menjadi type-predicate incompatibility seperti:

```text
A type predicate's type must be assignable...
```

itu berarti generated OpenAPI type mempunyai detail yang belum dipenuhi runtime guard. Kita akan memperbaiki guard tersebut secara eksplisit, bukan memaksa assertion.

Jika 11 validation tests berubah gagal, jangan mengubah expectations. Semantic behavior sebelumnya sudah terbukti benar; repair ini seharusnya hanya memperbaiki compile-time narrowing.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Expected full suite sekarang tetap:

```text

```

```text
projection   9

```

Jadi:

```text
AUTHORIZATION TEST COUNT

```

### Kenapa kita audit uniqueness?

OpenAPI mengunci:

```text
permissions:
  uniqueItems: true
```

TypeScript hanya memberi:

```ts
string[]
```

dan tidak bisa menjamin uniqueness.

Karena itu runtime semantic validator harus mempertahankan:

```ts
const names =
    new Set<string>();
```

serta duplicate rejection.

### Kenapa `scope-mismatch` penting?

Payload seperti:

```text
status = success
valid permissions[]
valid UUID-like strings
```

masih berbahaya jika:

```text
tenant_id != current Tenant
```

Maka structural validity tidak cukup.

Kita mempertahankan dua kelas:

```text
invalid-payload
scope-mismatch
```

sebelum state/runtime layer dibangun.

### Kenapa belum `hasPermission()`?

Karena FEI-8C adalah **trust boundary**, bukan decision/query API.

Urutan yang aman:

```text
transport
→ semantic validation
→ state
→ runtime
→ verifier
→ permission query helpers
→ UI/route consumption
```

Bukan langsung:

```text
HTTP
→ hasPermission(...)
```

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

FEI-8D membuat **pure authorization state machine** yang hanya mengenal capability projection yang sudah melewati semantic boundary FEI-8C.

State lifecycle:

```text
unresolved
    ↓ LOAD_STARTED
loading
    ├── PROJECTION_ACCEPTED
    │       ↓
    │     ready
    │
    └── LOAD_FAILED
            ↓
        unavailable
```

Dan kapan pun upstream context berubah:

```text
RESET
 ↓
unresolved
```

Prinsip keamanan terpenting pada FEI-8D:

```text
LOAD_STARTED
→ immediately removes old capability authority
```

Kita **tidak mempertahankan stale permissions selama loading**.

Jadi misalnya sebelumnya:

```text
Tenant A
permissions:
  academic.grades.write
```

lalu application mulai memperoleh capability baru, state menjadi:

```text
loading
```

bukan:

```text
loading
+ old permissions remain authoritative
```

Ini intentional fail-closed behavior.

Pola reducer discriminated-union + explicit invalid transitions ini konsisten dengan Membership state yang sudah committed: Membership juga menggunakan state union, action union, dan `invalidTransition()` untuk menolak state transition yang tidak sah.  Auth state juga menerapkan explicit transition guards daripada membiarkan arbitrary mutation. 

FEI-8D **belum** membuat:

```text
HTTP runtime
operations adapter
WorkspaceContextVerifier
hasPermission()
route guard
React provider
ApplicationRuntime wiring
storage/cache
```

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Buat `state.ts`

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/authorization/state.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    BrowserApiFailure,
} from '@/platform/api';

import type {
    TenantCapabilityData,
    WorkspaceCapabilityData,
} from '@/platform/authorization/contract';

import type {
    InvalidCapabilityProjection,
} from '@/platform/authorization/validation';

export type CapabilityProjectionData =
    | TenantCapabilityData
    | WorkspaceCapabilityData;

export type CapabilityStateFailure =
    | BrowserApiFailure
    | InvalidCapabilityProjection;

export interface UnresolvedCapabilityState {
    readonly status:
        'unresolved';
}

export interface LoadingCapabilityState {
    readonly status:
        'loading';
}

export interface ReadyCapabilityState {
    readonly status:
        'ready';

    readonly projection:
        CapabilityProjectionData;
}

export interface UnavailableCapabilityState {
    readonly status:
        'unavailable';

    readonly failure:
        CapabilityStateFailure;
}

export type CapabilityState =
    | UnresolvedCapabilityState
    | LoadingCapabilityState
    | ReadyCapabilityState
    | UnavailableCapabilityState;

export type CapabilityAction =
    | {
        readonly type:
            'LOAD_STARTED';
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'PROJECTION_ACCEPTED';

        readonly projection:
            CapabilityProjectionData;
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'LOAD_FAILED';

        readonly failure:
            CapabilityStateFailure;
    }
    | {
        readonly type:
            'RESET';
    };

export function createInitialCapabilityState():
    UnresolvedCapabilityState {
    return {
        status:
            'unresolved',
    };
}

function invalidTransition(
    state:
        CapabilityState,
    action:
        CapabilityAction,
): never {
    throw new Error(
        [
            'Invalid EduCore Capability transition:',
            state.status,
            '->',
            action.type,
        ].join(' '),
    );
}

export function capabilityReducer(
    state:
        CapabilityState,
    action:
        CapabilityAction,
): CapabilityState {
    switch (
        action.type
    ) {
        case 'LOAD_STARTED':
            /*
             * Starting any capability load removes previous
             * authorization authority immediately.
             *
             * Runtime operation revisions will later guard
             * against stale asynchronous completions.
             *
             * This reducer intentionally does not preserve
             * a previous capability projection while loading.
             */
            return {
                status:
                    'loading',
            };

        case 'PROJECTION_ACCEPTED':
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'loading'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'ready',

                projection:
                    action.projection,
            };

        case 'LOAD_FAILED':
            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'loading'
            ) {
                return invalidTransition(
                    state,
                    action,
                );
            }

            return {
                status:
                    'unavailable',

                failure:
                    action.failure,
            };

        case 'RESET':
            return createInitialCapabilityState();
    }
}
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. State hanya menyimpan capability authority saat `ready`

Perhatikan:

```ts
export interface LoadingCapabilityState {
    readonly status:
        'loading';
}
```

Tidak ada:

```ts
previousPermissions
currentProjection
staleProjection
```

Dengan begitu hanya satu state yang memiliki authorization authority:

```text
ready
```

Secara konseptual:

```ts
if (
    state.status
        !== 'ready'
) {
    // no capability authority
}
```

Ini membuat fail-closed behavior mudah dipahami dan sulit disalahgunakan.

---

## 2. `LOAD_STARTED` boleh menggantikan state apa pun

Ini intentional:

```ts
case 'LOAD_STARTED':
    return {
        status:
            'loading',
    };
```

Jika projection sebelumnya `ready`, projection langsung hilang.

Jika sebelumnya `unavailable`, retry juga masuk `loading`.

Jika load sedang berjalan dan runtime memulai generation baru:

```text
loading
→ LOAD_STARTED
→ loading
```

tetap aman.

Nanti FEI-8E runtime akan memakai operation revision seperti Membership/Workspace agar stale async completion tidak dapat publish hasil lama.

---

## 3. `PROJECTION_ACCEPTED` sangat ketat

Hanya:

```text
loading
→ PROJECTION_ACCEPTED
→ ready
```

Yang berikut ditolak:

```text
unresolved → PROJECTION_ACCEPTED ❌
ready      → PROJECTION_ACCEPTED ❌
unavailable→ PROJECTION_ACCEPTED ❌
```

Tujuannya agar capability authority tidak dapat berubah diam-diam tanpa explicit loading lifecycle.

---

## 4. Failure semantic dan transport berada dalam satu failure boundary

FEI-8 mempunyai dua sumber kegagalan.

Transport:

```text
response
protocol
network
aborted
```

Browser API failure memang telah dimodelkan sebagai discriminated union di platform API. 

Semantic:

```text
invalid-payload
scope-mismatch
```

Maka:

```ts
export type CapabilityStateFailure =
    | BrowserApiFailure
    | InvalidCapabilityProjection;
```

State tidak menerjemahkan failure tersebut.

Itu tanggung jawab runtime/application layer nanti.

---

## 5. Tidak ada permission calculation di reducer

Reducer tidak melakukan:

```ts
permissions.includes(...)
```

dan tidak memahami:

```text
academic.grades.write
dormitory.rooms.manage
```

Nilai dalam test hanyalah fixture.

State bertugas:

```text
lifecycle authority
```

bukan:

```text
authorization decision
```

Ini menjaga Separation of Concerns.

---

## 6. Tidak ada duplicated semantic validation

Reducer tidak memvalidasi lagi:

```text
tenant_id
membership_id
organization_id
permissions uniqueness
```

Karena itu sudah ownership FEI-8C.

Flow:

```text
projection.ts
   ↓
validation.ts
   ↓
state.ts
```

DRY dan Clean Architecture.

---

## 7. Tentang `as const` di tests

Anda akan melihat:

```ts
false as const
'network' as const
```

Itu bukan unsafe cast.

`as const` hanya mempertahankan literal type:

```text
false → false
"network" → "network"
```

Ia tidak mengubah unknown menjadi trusted DTO.

Audit unsafe kita tetap mencari:

```text
as any
as unknown as
@ts-ignore
@ts-expect-error
.data!
```

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak union `CapabilityStateFailure`, jangan cast. Kirim exact error karena Browser API failure dan semantic failure seharusnya dapat hidup sebagai discriminated union berdasarkan `kind`.

Jika test `LOAD_STARTED` menunjukkan projection lama masih ada, itu blocker. FEI-8D sengaja tidak mempertahankan stale capability authority.

Jika `PROJECTION_ACCEPTED` berhasil dari `ready` tanpa error, reducer implementation tidak sesuai invariant.

Jika full suite bukan `168/168`, jangan lanjut ke runtime.

Jika grep `STATE MUST HAVE NO AUTHORIZATION DECISION LOGIC` menemukan kata `Capability`, itu bukan masalah; yang dilarang adalah permission evaluation seperti `permissions.includes()` atau role inference.

---

# Langkah Berikutnya

Jika FEI-8D seluruhnya hijau:

```text
FEI-8A ✅ Contract & Boundary Audit
FEI-8B ✅ Projection Transport
FEI-8C ✅ Semantic Validation Boundary
FEI-8D ✅ Capability State Model

FEI-8E ← Capability Runtime Orchestration
```

FEI-8E nanti baru menghubungkan:

```text
Membership context
        +
Workspace context
        ↓
projection transport
        ↓
semantic validation
        ↓
Capability state
```

serta menambahkan operation-generation guard, cancellation handling, upstream invalidation, dan stale-result protection-tanpa React terlebih dahulu.

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita lakukan **FEI-8E.0 — Runtime Dependency & Verifier Composition Audit**.

Alasannya, sekarang ada potensi circular dependency:

```text
WorkspaceRuntime
      │
      │ requires
      ▼
WorkspaceContextVerifier
      │
      │ concrete implementation berasal dari FEI-8
      ▼
Authorization
```

Tetapi capability runtime untuk active Workspace secara alami ingin membaca:

```text
MembershipRuntime
+
WorkspaceRuntime
```

Kalau kita langsung membuat:

```text
CapabilityRuntime
      ↓
WorkspaceRuntime
      ↓
CapabilityRuntime sebagai verifier
```

maka hasilnya circular:

```text
CapabilityRuntime
   ↕
WorkspaceRuntime
```

Itu tidak boleh terjadi.

Architecture yang lebih sehat kemungkinan besar harus berbentuk:

```text
BrowserApiClient
      │
      ▼
Authorization Operations
      │
      ├───────────────┐
      │               │
      ▼               ▼
Workspace Verifier    Capability Runtime
      │               ▲
      ▼               │
Workspace Runtime ────┘
```

Dengan kata lain:

```text
stateless authorization operations
        ↓
concrete WorkspaceContextVerifier
        ↓
WorkspaceRuntime dapat dibangun
        ↓
CapabilityRuntime dapat subscribe ke
Membership + committed Workspace
```

Ini menghilangkan cycle.

Tetapi sebelum mengunci desain itu, kita perlu melihat **exact public interfaces yang sekarang ada di working tree Anda**, terutama karena FEI-7 belum ada di `origin/main` sehingga saya tidak mau menebak nama field `WorkspaceSummary`.

Jadi langkah ini **audit-only**, tidak mengubah source.

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Kenapa kita tidak langsung membuat CapabilityRuntime?

Karena composition order sekarang security-sensitive.

Workspace punya lifecycle:

```text
target selected
    ↓
WorkspaceContextVerifier.verify(...)
    ↓
success
    ↓
TARGET_VERIFIED
    ↓
Workspace committed
```

Kalau verifier dibuat dari CapabilityRuntime yang sendiri membutuhkan committed Workspace:

```text
Workspace target
    ↓
needs CapabilityRuntime
    ↓
CapabilityRuntime needs Workspace ready
```

kita menghasilkan deadlock arsitektural.

---

## 2. Verifier seharusnya kemungkinan stateless

Boundary yang lebih tepat:

```text
AuthorizationOperations
        │
        ├── projectTenant(...)
        └── projectWorkspace(...)
```

Kemudian:

```text
WorkspaceCapabilityVerifier
        │
        ├── TENANT
        │    → project tenant
        │    → semantic validate
        │
        └── ORG / UNIT
             → project workspace
             → semantic validate
```

Verifier tidak membutuhkan `CapabilityState`.

Ia hanya menjawab:

```text
Apakah target Workspace ini memiliki
canonical capability projection yang
cocok dengan Membership/Tenant/Workspace?
```

Ini tepat dengan contract FEI-7:

```ts
WorkspaceContextVerifier.verify(...)
```

---

## 3. CapabilityRuntime punya tanggung jawab berbeda

Setelah Workspace benar-benar committed, baru CapabilityRuntime bertugas menyediakan authorization projection aktif untuk application:

```text
Membership ready
+
Workspace ready
        ↓
load active capability projection
        ↓
semantic validation
        ↓
CapabilityState.ready
```

Jadi:

```text
Workspace verifier
≠
Capability state runtime
```

Walaupun keduanya menggunakan transport + validator yang sama.

Ini Separation of Concerns yang penting.

---

## 4. Kemungkinan terjadi dua request capability

Dengan boundary sekarang, skenario Workspace switch bisa menjadi:

```text
1. verifier loads target capability
2. Workspace commits target
3. CapabilityRuntime observes new Workspace
4. CapabilityRuntime loads active capability
```

Artinya dua request.

Saya **tidak akan mengoptimalkan ini prematur** dengan shared mutable cache atau hidden handoff sebelum kita melihat exact interface.

Lebih aman:

```text
correctness
→ composition
→ optimization later
```

daripada membuat verifier dan runtime saling share hidden state.

Jika nanti terbukti perlu, kita bisa membuat verified-projection cache dengan explicit ownership dan generation key.

---

## 5. `ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED` harus tetap melewati verifier

Ini sangat penting.

Current Workspace runtime sudah mengetahui failure:

```text
ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED
```

untuk stale Workspace recovery.

Maka concrete verifier nanti harus:

```text
workspace capability request
        ↓
403 ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED
        ↓
return BrowserApiFailure unchanged
        ↓
WorkspaceRuntime recovery
```

Bukan diterjemahkan menjadi:

```text
{ ok: false, kind: 'scope-mismatch' }
```

`scope-mismatch` hanya untuk **successful payload yang authority scope-nya tidak cocok**.

# Troubleshooting

Jika output `sed` terlalu panjang, tidak masalah; kirim sebagaimana adanya.

Jika ternyata `WorkspaceContextRuntime` public interface tidak mengekspos `subscribe`, kita tidak boleh menambahkan polling. Nanti kita tentukan boundary yang sesuai dari implementation nyata.

Jika `WorkspaceSummary` ternyata bukan discriminated union yang kuat, jangan membuat cast di verifier. Kita akan menambahkan explicit Workspace → capability expectation mapper dengan exhaustive runtime checks.

Jika Authorization saat ini sudah memiliki accidental import dari Workspace, itu blocker dan kita audit dulu sebelum FEI-8E implementation.

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

FEI-8E.1 menyelesaikan dependency yang sebelumnya menghalangi Workspace composition:

```text
BrowserApiClient
      ↓
CapabilityProjectionOperations
      ↓
WorkspaceCapabilityVerifier
      ↓
WorkspaceContextRuntime
```

Verifier bersifat **stateless**.

Ia tidak membutuhkan:

```text
CapabilityState
CapabilityRuntime
React
ApplicationRuntime
```

Untuk setiap target:

```text
TENANT
→ tenant capability endpoint
→ semantic validation
→ { ok: true }

ORGANIZATION / UNIT
→ workspace capability endpoint
→ semantic validation
→ { ok: true }
```

Failure:

```text
HTTP/API failure
→ pass through unchanged

200 + invalid payload
→ BrowserApiProtocolFailure

200 + canonical scope mismatch
→ BrowserApiProtocolFailure
```

Khusus:

```text
403 ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED
```

harus diteruskan unchanged agar FEI-7 Workspace runtime tetap bisa melakukan stale recovery.

Empty `permissions[]` **tidak membuat Workspace invalid**. Verifier membuktikan canonical context, bukan memutuskan suatu permission tertentu.

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. `operations.ts`

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/authorization/operations.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    BrowserApiClient,
    BrowserMembershipLocator,
    OrganizationalAssignmentLocator,
} from '@/platform/api';

import {
    projectBrowserTenantCapabilities,
    projectBrowserWorkspaceCapabilities,
    type ProjectBrowserCapabilitiesOptions,
} from '@/platform/authorization/projection';

export interface CapabilityProjectionOperations {
    projectTenant(
        membershipId:
            BrowserMembershipLocator,
        options?:
            ProjectBrowserCapabilitiesOptions,
    ): ReturnType<
        typeof projectBrowserTenantCapabilities
    >;

    projectWorkspace(
        membershipId:
            BrowserMembershipLocator,
        organizationalAssignmentId:
            OrganizationalAssignmentLocator,
        options?:
            ProjectBrowserCapabilitiesOptions,
    ): ReturnType<
        typeof projectBrowserWorkspaceCapabilities
    >;
}

export function createCapabilityProjectionOperations(
    client:
        BrowserApiClient,
): CapabilityProjectionOperations {
    return {
        projectTenant(
            membershipId,
            options,
        ) {
            return projectBrowserTenantCapabilities(
                client,
                membershipId,
                options,
            );
        },

        projectWorkspace(
            membershipId,
            organizationalAssignmentId,
            options,
        ) {
            return projectBrowserWorkspaceCapabilities(
                client,
                membershipId,
                organizationalAssignmentId,
                options,
            );
        },
    };
}
EOF
```

```bash
import type {
    BrowserApiProtocolFailure,
} from '@/platform/api';
import type {
    CanonicalMembershipContext,
} from '@/platform/membership/contract';
import type {
    OrganizationUnitWorkspaceSummary,
    OrganizationWorkspaceSummary,
    WorkspaceSummary,
} from '@/platform/workspace/contract';
import type {
    WorkspaceContextVerifier,
    WorkspaceVerificationOptions,
    WorkspaceVerificationResult,
} from '@/platform/workspace/verification';

import type {
    CapabilityProjectionOperations,
} from '@/platform/authorization/operations';
import {
    validateTenantCapabilityProjection,
    validateWorkspaceCapabilityProjection,
    type CapabilityProjectionValidationResult,
    type WorkspaceCapabilityScopeExpectation,
} from '@/platform/authorization/validation';

type OrganizationalWorkspaceSummary =
    | OrganizationWorkspaceSummary
    | OrganizationUnitWorkspaceSummary;

function createProtocolFailure(
    status:
        number,
): BrowserApiProtocolFailure {
    return {
        ok:
            false,

        kind:
            'protocol',

        status,

        message:
            'EduCore API returned an unexpected error response.',
    };
}

function verificationFromValidation<Data>(
    validation:
        CapabilityProjectionValidationResult<Data>,
    status:
        number,
): WorkspaceVerificationResult {
    if (
        ! validation.ok
    ) {
        /*
         * A successful transport response whose payload is
         * malformed or bound to another canonical scope is
         * a protocol violation from the Workspace verifier's
         * perspective.
         *
         * WorkspaceVerificationResult intentionally exposes
         * only BrowserApiFailure, so semantic transport
         * contradictions fail closed as protocol failures.
         */
        return createProtocolFailure(
            status,
        );
    }

    return {
        ok:
            true,
    };
}

function expectationFromWorkspace(
    workspace:
        OrganizationalWorkspaceSummary,
): WorkspaceCapabilityScopeExpectation {
    if (
        workspace.type
            === 'ORGANIZATION'
    ) {
        return {
            type:
                'organization',

            organizationalAssignmentId:
                workspace
                    .organizational_assignment_id,

            organizationId:
                workspace.organization_id,

            organizationUnitId:
                null,
        };
    }

    return {
        type:
            'organization_unit',

        organizationalAssignmentId:
            workspace
                .organizational_assignment_id,

        organizationId:
            workspace.organization_id,

        organizationUnitId:
            workspace
                .organization_unit_id,
    };
}

async function verifyTenantWorkspace(
    operations:
        CapabilityProjectionOperations,
    context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
    options:
        WorkspaceVerificationOptions,
): Promise<
    WorkspaceVerificationResult
> {
    const result =
        await operations.projectTenant(
            context.membership.id,
            options,
        );

    if (
        ! result.ok
    ) {
        return result;
    }

    return verificationFromValidation(
        validateTenantCapabilityProjection(
            context,
            result.data,
        ),
        result.status,
    );
}

async function verifyOrganizationalWorkspace(
    operations:
        CapabilityProjectionOperations,
    context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
    workspace:
        OrganizationalWorkspaceSummary,
    options:
        WorkspaceVerificationOptions,
): Promise<
    WorkspaceVerificationResult
> {
    const result =
        await operations.projectWorkspace(
            context.membership.id,
            workspace
                .organizational_assignment_id,
            options,
        );

    if (
        ! result.ok
    ) {
        /*
         * Preserve canonical failures unchanged.
         *
         * ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED in particular must
         * remain observable by WorkspaceContextRuntime so
         * stale Workspace recovery can execute.
         */
        return result;
    }

    return verificationFromValidation(
        validateWorkspaceCapabilityProjection(
            context,
            expectationFromWorkspace(
                workspace,
            ),
            result.data,
        ),
        result.status,
    );
}

export function createWorkspaceCapabilityVerifier(
    operations:
        CapabilityProjectionOperations,
): WorkspaceContextVerifier {
    return {
        verify(
            context,
            workspace:
                WorkspaceSummary,
            options = {},
        ) {
            if (
                workspace.type
                    === 'TENANT'
            ) {
                return verifyTenantWorkspace(
                    operations,
                    context,
                    options,
                );
            }

            return verifyOrganizationalWorkspace(
                operations,
                context,
                workspace,
                options,
            );
        },
    };
}
EOF
```

### Kenapa tidak ada cast?

Karena setelah:

```ts
if (workspace.type === 'TENANT')
```

branch sisanya otomatis:

```text
OrganizationWorkspaceSummary
|
OrganizationUnitWorkspaceSummary
```

berkat discriminated `WorkspaceSummary`. `Pasted text.txt`

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Cycle sudah dihilangkan

Sekarang graph-nya:

```text
authorization/projection
        ↑
authorization/operations
        ↑
authorization/workspace-verifier
        ↓
workspace verifier PORT
```

Belum ada:

```text
CapabilityRuntime
→ WorkspaceRuntime
→ CapabilityRuntime
```

Jadi FEI-8E.2 nanti aman dibuat setelah Workspace runtime tersedia.

### 2. Dependency ke Workspace hanya ada di adapter

Sebelumnya kita menjaga seluruh authorization foundation tidak tahu Workspace.

Sekarang dependency memang muncul, tetapi hanya di:

```text
workspace-verifier.ts
```

Ini intentional adapter boundary.

Yang tetap tidak boleh import Workspace:

```text
contract.ts
projection.ts
operations.ts
validation.ts
state.ts
```

### 3. Semantic mismatch menjadi protocol failure

`WorkspaceVerificationResult` hanya mengizinkan:

```text
{ ok: true }
|
BrowserApiFailure
```

Maka FEI-8C:

```text
invalid-payload
scope-mismatch
```

tidak boleh dilempar sembarangan atau dianggap success.

Keduanya diterjemahkan:

```text
200 malformed/mismatched
→ protocol failure
```

Pola ini konsisten dengan runtime foundation sebelumnya yang juga memperlakukan successful HTTP tanpa contract-required payload sebagai protocol failure, bukan mengarang data. `Pasted text.txt`

### 4. Response failure tidak diterjemahkan

Untuk:

```text
ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED
```

kita melakukan:

```ts
if (!result.ok) {
    return result;
}
```

Jadi identity object failure tetap sama.

Ini penting karena Workspace runtime sudah mengenali machine code tersebut untuk stale recovery. `Pasted text.txt`

### 5. `permissions: []` tetap valid

Workspace verifier bukan:

```text
"Apakah user punya permission X?"
```

Verifier menjawab:

```text
"Apakah backend berhasil memproyeksikan
canonical capability scope untuk target ini?"
```

User dengan valid Organization tetapi tanpa effective permission tetap memiliki valid context.

Permission decision baru dilakukan downstream.

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

FEI-8E.2 membangun runtime yang mem-publish **effective capability projection untuk Workspace yang benar-benar committed**.

Dependency graph final:

```text
Membership Runtime ─────┐
                        │
Workspace Runtime ──────┼──→ Capability Runtime
                        │
Capability Operations ──┘
```

Lifecycle:

```text
Membership ready
+
Workspace ready
+
kedua canonical context cocok
        ↓
LOAD_STARTED
        ↓
projection transport
        ↓
semantic validation
        ↓
PROJECTION_ACCEPTED
        ↓
CapabilityState.ready
```

Jika salah satu upstream menjadi transient/non-ready:

```text
Workspace switching
Membership switching
Membership invalidated
Workspace recovery
        ↓
cancel active request
        ↓
RESET
        ↓
unresolved
```

Ini sengaja fail-closed. Capability lama **tidak dipertahankan** saat upstream context sedang berubah.

Runtime juga wajib melindungi dari:

```text
request A dimulai
↓
context berubah
↓
request B dimulai
↓
request A selesai terlambat
```

Hasil A tidak boleh pernah mem-publish authority.

Kita gunakan:

```text
AbortController
+
operationRevision
```

```bash
import type {
```

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/authorization/workspace-verifier.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    BrowserApiProtocolFailure,
} from '@/platform/api';
import type {
    CanonicalMembershipContext,
} from '@/platform/membership/contract';
import type {
    WorkspaceSummary,
} from '@/platform/workspace/contract';
import type {
    WorkspaceContextVerifier,
    WorkspaceVerificationOptions,
    WorkspaceVerificationResult,
} from '@/platform/workspace/verification';

import type {
    CapabilityProjectionOperations,
} from '@/platform/authorization/operations';
import {
    validateTenantCapabilityProjection,
    validateWorkspaceCapabilityProjection,
    type CapabilityProjectionValidationResult,
} from '@/platform/authorization/validation';
import {
    createWorkspaceCapabilityScopeExpectation,
    type OrganizationalWorkspaceSummary,
} from '@/platform/authorization/workspace-scope';

function createProtocolFailure(
    status:
        number,
): BrowserApiProtocolFailure {
    return {
        ok:
            false,

        kind:
            'protocol',

        status,

        message:
            'EduCore API returned an unexpected error response.',
    };
}

function verificationFromValidation<Data>(
    validation:
        CapabilityProjectionValidationResult<Data>,
    status:
        number,
): WorkspaceVerificationResult {
    if (
        ! validation.ok
    ) {
        return createProtocolFailure(
            status,
        );
    }

    return {
        ok:
            true,
    };
}

async function verifyTenantWorkspace(
    operations:
        CapabilityProjectionOperations,
    context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
    options:
        WorkspaceVerificationOptions,
): Promise<
    WorkspaceVerificationResult
> {
    const result =
        await operations.projectTenant(
            context.membership.id,
            options,
        );

    if (
        ! result.ok
    ) {
        return result;
    }

    return verificationFromValidation(
        validateTenantCapabilityProjection(
            context,
            result.data,
        ),
        result.status,
    );
}

async function verifyOrganizationalWorkspace(
    operations:
        CapabilityProjectionOperations,
    context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
    workspace:
        OrganizationalWorkspaceSummary,
    options:
        WorkspaceVerificationOptions,
): Promise<
    WorkspaceVerificationResult
> {
    const result =
        await operations.projectWorkspace(
            context.membership.id,
            workspace
                .organizational_assignment_id,
            options,
        );

    if (
        ! result.ok
    ) {
        /*
         * Preserve canonical failures unchanged.
         *
         * ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED must remain visible
         * to WorkspaceContextRuntime stale recovery.
         */
        return result;
    }

    return verificationFromValidation(
        validateWorkspaceCapabilityProjection(
            context,
            createWorkspaceCapabilityScopeExpectation(
                workspace,
            ),
            result.data,
        ),
        result.status,
    );
}

export function createWorkspaceCapabilityVerifier(
    operations:
        CapabilityProjectionOperations,
): WorkspaceContextVerifier {
    return {
        verify(
            context,
            workspace:
                WorkspaceSummary,
            options = {},
        ) {
            if (
                workspace.type
                    === 'TENANT'
            ) {
                return verifyTenantWorkspace(
                    operations,
                    context,
                    options,
                );
            }

            return verifyOrganizationalWorkspace(
                operations,
                context,
                workspace,
                options,
            );
        },
    };
}
EOF
```

## 3. Capability runtime

Buat `runtime.ts`:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/authorization/runtime.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    CanonicalMembershipContext,
} from '@/platform/membership/contract';
import type {
    WorkspaceSummary,
} from '@/platform/workspace/contract';

import type {
    CapabilityProjectionOperations,
} from '@/platform/authorization/operations';
import {
    capabilityReducer,
    createInitialCapabilityState,
    type CapabilityAction,
    type CapabilityState,
} from '@/platform/authorization/state';
import {
    validateTenantCapabilityProjection,
    validateWorkspaceCapabilityProjection,
} from '@/platform/authorization/validation';
import {
    createWorkspaceCapabilityScopeExpectation,
} from '@/platform/authorization/workspace-scope';

export interface CapabilityRuntimeOptions {
    readonly signal?:
        AbortSignal;
}

export interface CapabilityMembershipSourceState {
    readonly status:
        string;

    readonly context?:
        CanonicalMembershipContext | null;
}

export interface CapabilityWorkspaceSourceState {
    readonly status:
        string;

    readonly context?:
        CanonicalMembershipContext;

    readonly current?:
        WorkspaceSummary;
}

export interface CapabilityMembershipRuntime {
    getState():
        CapabilityMembershipSourceState;

    subscribe(
        listener:
            () => void,
    ): () => void;
}

export interface CapabilityWorkspaceRuntime {
    getState():
        CapabilityWorkspaceSourceState;

    subscribe(
        listener:
            () => void,
    ): () => void;
}

export interface CapabilityRuntime {
    getState():
        CapabilityState;

    subscribe(
        listener:
            () => void,
    ): () => void;

    bootstrap(
        options?:
            CapabilityRuntimeOptions,
    ): Promise<
        CapabilityState
    >;

    refresh(
        options?:
            CapabilityRuntimeOptions,
    ): Promise<
        CapabilityState
    >;

    reset():
        CapabilityState;

    dispose():
        void;
}

interface ActiveCapabilityTarget {
    readonly context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext;

    readonly workspace:
        WorkspaceSummary;

    readonly identity:
        string;
}

interface ActiveAbortOperation {
    readonly controller:
        AbortController;

    cleanup():
        void;
}

function canonicalContextsMatch(
    first:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
    second:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
): boolean {
    return (
        first.membership.id
            === second.membership.id
        && first.tenant.id
            === second.tenant.id
    );
}

function capabilityTargetIdentity(
    context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
    workspace:
        WorkspaceSummary,
): string {
    if (
        workspace.type
            === 'TENANT'
    ) {
        return JSON.stringify([
            context.membership.id,
            context.tenant.id,
            workspace.type,
        ]);
    }

    return JSON.stringify([
        context.membership.id,
        context.tenant.id,
        workspace.type,
        workspace
            .organizational_assignment_id,
        workspace.organization_id,
        workspace.organization_unit_id,
    ]);
}

function resolveCapabilityTarget(
    membership:
        CapabilityMembershipRuntime,
    workspace:
        CapabilityWorkspaceRuntime,
): ActiveCapabilityTarget | undefined {
    const membershipState =
        membership.getState();

    const workspaceState =
        workspace.getState();

    if (
        membershipState.status
            !== 'ready'
        || workspaceState.status
            !== 'ready'
        || membershipState.context
            === undefined
        || membershipState.context
            === null
        || workspaceState.context
            === undefined
        || workspaceState.current
            === undefined
    ) {
        return undefined;
    }

    if (
        ! canonicalContextsMatch(
            membershipState.context,
            workspaceState.context,
        )
    ) {
        return undefined;
    }

    return {
        context:
            membershipState.context,

        workspace:
            workspaceState.current,

        identity:
            capabilityTargetIdentity(
                membershipState.context,
                workspaceState.current,
            ),
    };
}

function createAbortOperation(
    externalSignal?:
        AbortSignal,
): ActiveAbortOperation {
    const controller =
        new AbortController();

    if (
        externalSignal
            === undefined
    ) {
        return {
            controller,

            cleanup() {
                // No external listener.
            },
        };
    }

    const abortFromExternal =
        () => {
            controller.abort();
        };

    if (
        externalSignal.aborted
    ) {
        controller.abort();

        return {
            controller,

            cleanup() {
                // No listener was registered.
            },
        };
    }

    externalSignal.addEventListener(
        'abort',
        abortFromExternal,
        {
            once:
                true,
        },
    );

    return {
        controller,

        cleanup() {
            externalSignal
                .removeEventListener(
                    'abort',
                    abortFromExternal,
                );
        },
    };
}

export function createCapabilityRuntime(
    operations:
        CapabilityProjectionOperations,
    membership:
        CapabilityMembershipRuntime,
    workspace:
        CapabilityWorkspaceRuntime,
): CapabilityRuntime {
    let state:
        CapabilityState =
            createInitialCapabilityState();

    let operationRevision =
        0;

    let activeTargetIdentity:
        string | null =
            null;

    let activeAbortOperation:
        ActiveAbortOperation | null =
            null;

    let disposed =
        false;

    const listeners =
        new Set<
            () => void
        >();

    const publish =
        (
            action:
                CapabilityAction,
        ): CapabilityState => {
            state =
                capabilityReducer(
                    state,
                    action,
                );

            for (
                const listener
                of listeners
            ) {
                listener();
            }

            return state;
        };

    const cancelActiveOperation =
        (): void => {
            operationRevision +=
                1;

            if (
                activeAbortOperation
                    === null
            ) {
                return;
            }

            activeAbortOperation
                .cleanup();

            activeAbortOperation
                .controller
                .abort();

            activeAbortOperation =
                null;
        };

    const resetAuthority =
        (): CapabilityState => {
            cancelActiveOperation();

            activeTargetIdentity =
                null;

            if (
                state.status
                    === 'unresolved'
            ) {
                return state;
            }

            return publish({
                type:
                    'RESET',
            });
        };

    const load =
        async (
            options:
                CapabilityRuntimeOptions = {},
            force =
                false,
        ): Promise<
            CapabilityState
        > => {
            if (
                disposed
            ) {
                return state;
            }

            const target =
                resolveCapabilityTarget(
                    membership,
                    workspace,
                );

            if (
                target
                    === undefined
            ) {
                return resetAuthority();
            }

            if (
                ! force
                && activeTargetIdentity
                    === target.identity
                && (
                    state.status
                        === 'loading'
                    || state.status
                        === 'ready'
                    || state.status
                        === 'unavailable'
                )
            ) {
                return state;
            }

            cancelActiveOperation();

            const revision =
                operationRevision;

            const abortOperation =
                createAbortOperation(
                    options.signal,
                );

            activeAbortOperation =
                abortOperation;

            activeTargetIdentity =
                target.identity;

            publish({
                type:
                    'LOAD_STARTED',
            });

            const result =
                target.workspace.type
                    === 'TENANT'
                    ? await operations
                        .projectTenant(
                            target.context
                                .membership.id,
                            {
                                signal:
                                    abortOperation
                                        .controller
                                        .signal,
                            },
                        )
                    : await operations
                        .projectWorkspace(
                            target.context
                                .membership.id,
                            target.workspace
                                .organizational_assignment_id,
                            {
                                signal:
                                    abortOperation
                                        .controller
                                        .signal,
                            },
                        );

            abortOperation
                .cleanup();

            if (
                activeAbortOperation
                    === abortOperation
            ) {
                activeAbortOperation =
                    null;
            }

            if (
                disposed
                || revision
                    !== operationRevision
            ) {
                return state;
            }

            if (
                ! result.ok
            ) {
                if (
                    result.kind
                        === 'aborted'
                ) {
                    activeTargetIdentity =
                        null;

                    return publish({
                        type:
                            'RESET',
                    });
                }

                return publish({
                    type:
                        'LOAD_FAILED',

                    failure:
                        result,
                });
            }

            const validation =
                target.workspace.type
                    === 'TENANT'
                    ? validateTenantCapabilityProjection(
                        target.context,
                        result.data,
                    )
                    : validateWorkspaceCapabilityProjection(
                        target.context,
                        createWorkspaceCapabilityScopeExpectation(
                            target.workspace,
                        ),
                        result.data,
                    );

            if (
                ! validation.ok
            ) {
                return publish({
                    type:
                        'LOAD_FAILED',

                    failure:
                        validation,
                });
            }

            return publish({
                type:
                    'PROJECTION_ACCEPTED',

                projection:
                    validation.data,
            });
        };

    const synchronize =
        (): void => {
            void load();
        };

    const unsubscribeMembership =
        membership.subscribe(
            synchronize,
        );

    const unsubscribeWorkspace =
        workspace.subscribe(
            synchronize,
        );

    return {
        getState() {
            return state;
        },

        subscribe(
            listener,
        ) {
            listeners.add(
                listener,
            );

            return () => {
                listeners.delete(
                    listener,
                );
            };
        },

        bootstrap(
            options = {},
        ) {
            return load(
                options,
            );
        },

        refresh(
            options = {},
        ) {
            return load(
                options,
                true,
            );
        },

        reset() {
            return resetAuthority();
        },

        dispose() {
            if (
                disposed
            ) {
                return;
            }

            disposed =
                true;

            unsubscribeMembership();
            unsubscribeWorkspace();

            resetAuthority();

            listeners.clear();
        },
    };
}
EOF
```

```bash
    return {
        runtime: {
            getState() {
                return state;
            },

            subscribe(
                listener,
            ) {
                listeners.add(
                    listener,
                );

                return () => {
                    listeners.delete(
                        listener,
                    );
                };
            },
        },

        setState(
            nextState,
        ) {
            state =
                nextState;

            for (
                const listener
                of listeners
            ) {
                listener();
            }
        },
    };
}

function createWorkspaceSource(
    initial:
        CapabilityWorkspaceSourceState,
): MutableWorkspaceSource {
    let state =
        initial;

    const listeners =
        new Set<
            () => void
        >();

    return {
        runtime: {
            getState() {
                return state;
            },

            subscribe(
                listener,
            ) {
                listeners.add(
                    listener,
                );

                return () => {
                    listeners.delete(
                        listener,
                    );
                };
            },
        },

        setState(
            nextState,
        ) {
            state =
                nextState;

            for (
                const listener
                of listeners
            ) {
                listener();
            }
        },
    };
}

function readyMembershipState():
    CapabilityMembershipSourceState {
    return {
        status:
            'ready',

        context,
    };
}

function readyWorkspaceState(
    current:
        WorkspaceSummary,
): CapabilityWorkspaceSourceState {
    return {
        status:
            'ready',

        context,

        current,
    };
}

interface OperationsProbe {
    readonly tenantMembershipIds:
        string[];

    readonly workspaceRequests:
        Array<{
            readonly membershipId:
                string;

            readonly organizationalAssignmentId:
                string;
        }>;
}

function createProbe():
    OperationsProbe {
    return {
        tenantMembershipIds:
            [],

        workspaceRequests:
            [],
    };
}

function createOperations(
    probe:
        OperationsProbe,
    tenantResult:
        TenantProjectionResult = {
            ok:
                true,

            status:
                200,

            data:
                tenantCapabilitySuccess,
        },
    workspaceResult:
        WorkspaceProjectionResult = {
            ok:
                true,

            status:
                200,

            data:
                organizationCapabilitySuccess,
        },
): CapabilityProjectionOperations {
    return {
        async projectTenant(
            requestedMembershipId,
        ) {
            probe
                .tenantMembershipIds
                .push(
                    requestedMembershipId,
                );

            return tenantResult;
        },

        async projectWorkspace(
            requestedMembershipId,
            requestedOrganizationalAssignmentId,
        ) {
            probe
                .workspaceRequests
                .push({
                    membershipId:
                        requestedMembershipId,

                    organizationalAssignmentId:
                        requestedOrganizationalAssignmentId,
                });

            return workspaceResult;
        },
    };
}

interface Deferred<Value> {
    readonly promise:
        Promise<Value>;

    resolve(
        value:
            Value,
    ): void;
}

function createDeferred<Value>():
    Deferred<Value> {
    let resolvePromise:
        (
            value:
                Value,
        ) => void
        | undefined;

    const promise =
        new Promise<Value>(
            (
                resolve,
            ) => {
                resolvePromise =
                    resolve;
            },
        );

    return {
        promise,

        resolve(
            value,
        ) {
            if (
                resolvePromise
                    === undefined
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    'Deferred resolver is unavailable.',
                );
            }

            resolvePromise(
                value,
            );
        },
    };
}

describe(
    'Capability runtime',
    () => {
        it('remains unresolved and dispatches no projection while upstream context is not ready', async () => {
            const probe =
                createProbe();

            const membership =
                createMembershipSource({
                    status:
                        'discovering',
                });

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceSource({
                    status:
                        'unresolved',
                });

            const runtime =
                createCapabilityRuntime(
                    createOperations(
                        probe,
                    ),
                    membership.runtime,
                    workspace.runtime,
                );

            await expect(
                runtime.bootstrap(),
            ).resolves.toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            expect(
                probe.tenantMembershipIds,
            ).toEqual([]);

            expect(
                probe.workspaceRequests,
            ).toEqual([]);

            runtime.dispose();
        });

        it('loads and publishes validated TENANT capability authority', async () => {
            const membership =
                createMembershipSource(
                    readyMembershipState(),
                );

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceSource(
                    readyWorkspaceState(
                        tenantWorkspace,
                    ),
                );

            const runtime =
                createCapabilityRuntime(
                    createOperations(
                        createProbe(),
                    ),
                    membership.runtime,
                    workspace.runtime,
                );

            await expect(
                runtime.bootstrap(),
            ).resolves.toEqual({
                status:
                    'ready',

                projection:
                    tenantCapabilitySuccess.data,
            });

            runtime.dispose();
        });

        it('loads organizational capability with exact Membership and assignment locators', async () => {
            const probe =
                createProbe();

            const membership =
                createMembershipSource(
                    readyMembershipState(),
                );

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceSource(
                    readyWorkspaceState(
                        organizationWorkspace,
                    ),
                );

            const runtime =
                createCapabilityRuntime(
                    createOperations(
                        probe,
                    ),
                    membership.runtime,
                    workspace.runtime,
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(
                probe.workspaceRequests,
            ).toEqual([
                {
                    membershipId,

                    organizationalAssignmentId,
                },
            ]);

            expect(
                runtime.getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'ready',

                projection:
                    organizationCapabilitySuccess.data,
            });

            runtime.dispose();
        });

        it('validates ORGANIZATION_UNIT against its exact committed unit scope', async () => {
            const membership =
                createMembershipSource(
                    readyMembershipState(),
                );

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceSource(
                    readyWorkspaceState(
                        organizationUnitWorkspace,
                    ),
                );

            const runtime =
                createCapabilityRuntime(
                    createOperations(
                        createProbe(),
                        {
                            ok:
                                true,

                            status:
                                200,

                            data:
                                tenantCapabilitySuccess,
                        },
                        {
                            ok:
                                true,

                            status:
                                200,

                            data:
                                organizationUnitCapabilitySuccess,
                        },
                    ),
                    membership.runtime,
                    workspace.runtime,
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(
                runtime.getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'ready',

                projection:
                    organizationUnitCapabilitySuccess.data,
            });

            runtime.dispose();
        });

        it('fails closed on a semantically mismatched successful projection', async () => {
            const mismatched:
                TenantCapabilitySuccess = {
                    ...tenantCapabilitySuccess,

                    data: {
                        ...tenantCapabilitySuccess.data,

                        scope: {
                            ...tenantCapabilitySuccess
                                .data
                                .scope,

                            membership_id:
                                otherMembershipId,
                        },
                    },
                };

            const membership =
                createMembershipSource(
                    readyMembershipState(),
                );

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceSource(
                    readyWorkspaceState(
                        tenantWorkspace,
                    ),
                );

            const runtime =
                createCapabilityRuntime(
                    createOperations(
                        createProbe(),
                        {
                            ok:
                                true,

                            status:
                                200,

                            data:
                                mismatched,
                        },
                    ),
                    membership.runtime,
                    workspace.runtime,
                );

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(
                runtime.getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unavailable',

                failure: {
                    ok:
                        false,

                    kind:
                        'scope-mismatch',
                },
            });

            runtime.dispose();
        });

        it('preserves canonical transport failures without inventing capability authority', async () => {
            const failure:
                TenantProjectionResult = {
                    ok:
                        false,

                    kind:
                        'network',

                    cause:
                        new Error(
                            'offline',

            const membership =
                createMembershipSource(

            const workspace =

            const runtime =

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(
                runtime.getState(),

                status:

            runtime.dispose();

        it('invalidates capability authority immediately when Workspace leaves ready state', async () => {
            const membership =
                createMembershipSource(
                    readyMembershipState(),

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceSource(

            const runtime =
                createCapabilityRuntime(

            await runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(
                runtime.getState()
                    .status,

            workspace.setState({
                status:

            expect(
                runtime.getState(),

                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

        it('does not duplicate projection loads for repeated notifications of the same committed context', async () => {
            const probe =
                createProbe();

            const membership =
                createMembershipSource(
                    readyMembershipState(),

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceSource(

            const runtime =

            workspace.setState(

            await Promise.resolve();

            expect(
                probe.tenantMembershipIds,
            ).toHaveLength(
                1,

            runtime.dispose();
        });

        it('ignores a stale capability completion after the committed Workspace changes', async () => {
            const first =
                createDeferred<
                    TenantProjectionResult
                >();

            const probe =
                createProbe();

            const operations:
                CapabilityProjectionOperations = {
                    projectTenant(
                        requestedMembershipId,
                    ) {
                        probe
                            .tenantMembershipIds
                            .push(

                    },

                    async projectWorkspace(
                        requestedMembershipId,
                        requestedOrganizationalAssignmentId,

                        probe

                            .push({
                                membershipId:
                                    requestedMembershipId,

                                organizationalAssignmentId:
                                    requestedOrganizationalAssignmentId,

                        return {

                            data:

            const membership =
                createMembershipSource(

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceSource(
                    readyWorkspaceState(
                        tenantWorkspace,

                );

            const runtime =
                createCapabilityRuntime(
                    operations,
                    membership.runtime,
                    workspace.runtime,
                );

            const firstLoad =
                runtime.bootstrap();

            expect(
                runtime.getState()
                    .status,
            ).toBe(
                'loading',
            );

            workspace.setState({
                status:
                    'switching',

                context,

                current:
                    tenantWorkspace,
            });

            workspace.setState(
                readyWorkspaceState(
                    organizationWorkspace,
                ),
            );

            await Promise.resolve();
            await Promise.resolve();

            expect(
                runtime.getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'ready',

                projection:
                    organizationCapabilitySuccess.data,
            });

            first.resolve({
                ok:
                    true,

                status:
                    200,

                data:
                    tenantCapabilitySuccess,
            });

            await firstLoad;

            expect(
                runtime.getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'ready',

                projection:
                    organizationCapabilitySuccess.data,
            });

            runtime.dispose();
        });

        it('treats explicit request cancellation as authority-neutral and returns to unresolved', async () => {
            const membership =
                createMembershipSource(
                    readyMembershipState(),
                );

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceSource(
                    readyWorkspaceState(
                        tenantWorkspace,
                    ),
                );

            const operations:
                CapabilityProjectionOperations = {
                    async projectTenant(
                        _membershipId,
                        options,
                    ) {
                        return new Promise(
                            (
                                resolve,
                            ) => {
                                options
                                    ?.signal
                                    ?.addEventListener(
                                        'abort',
                                        () => {
                                            resolve({
                                                ok:
                                                    false,

                                                kind:
                                                    'aborted',

                                                cause:
                                                    new Error(

                                        },
                                        {
                                            once:

                                    );
                            },
                        );
                    },

                    async projectWorkspace() {
                        return {
                            ok:

                            status:
                                200,

                            data:
                                organizationCapabilitySuccess,
                        };
                    },
                };

            const runtime =
                createCapabilityRuntime(
                    operations,
                    membership.runtime,
                    workspace.runtime,

            const controller =
                new AbortController();

            const load =
                runtime.bootstrap({
                    signal:
                        controller.signal,

            controller.abort();

            await load;

            expect(
                runtime.getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',

            runtime.dispose();
        });

        it('does not load capabilities when Membership and Workspace canonical contexts disagree', async () => {
            const probe =

            expect(

        it('dispose invalidates capability authority and detaches upstream subscriptions', async () => {

            const membership =

                probe.workspaceRequests,
            ).toEqual([]);

);
```
