# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Runtime hanya percaya committed Workspace

Kita sengaja hanya menerima:

```ts
workspaceState.status === 'ready'
```

Bukan:

```text
switching.current
```

Walaupun Workspace switching masih menyimpan Workspace lama sebagai stable truth, Authorization runtime memilih fail-closed selama transition.

Hasilnya:

```text
Workspace switching
→ Capability unresolved
```

Ini mencegah UI/action baru menggunakan capability lama ketika organizational context sedang berubah.

---

### 2. Upstream context harus cocok dua arah

Kita tidak hanya membaca Membership runtime.

Kita membuktikan:

```text
Membership.context.membership.id
===
Workspace.context.membership.id

Membership.context.tenant.id
===
Workspace.context.tenant.id
```

Jika tidak:

```text
no request
+
unresolved
```

Ini mencegah transient race antara dua runtime upstream.

---

### 3. `activeTargetIdentity` mencegah request duplikat

Membership dan Workspace keduanya memiliki subscription.

Satu lifecycle bisa memicu beberapa notification untuk canonical context yang sama.

Tanpa identity key:

```text
Membership event → request
Workspace event  → request
```

Dengan:

```text
membership + tenant + workspace identity
```

context yang sama tidak diproyeksikan ulang secara otomatis.

`refresh()` tetap dapat memaksa reload.

---

### 4. `operationRevision` adalah authority fence

Abort saja tidak cukup.

Ada implementation/network layer yang mungkin tetap menyelesaikan promise setelah abort.

Karena itu:

```ts
if (
    revision !== operationRevision
) {
    return state;
}
```

menjadi final stale-result fence.

Old result tidak boleh menyentuh state.

---

### 5. Semantic failure tetap semantic di CapabilityRuntime

Perhatikan bedanya dengan Workspace verifier.

Workspace verifier port hanya memahami:

```text
BrowserApiFailure
```

maka semantic contradiction diterjemahkan menjadi protocol failure.

Capability state sendiri memang memiliki:

```text
BrowserApiFailure
|
InvalidCapabilityProjection
```

Jadi runtime capability boleh menyimpan exact:

```text
invalid-payload
scope-mismatch
```

Ini lebih baik untuk observability.

---

### 6. Tidak ada permission decision

`ready` hanya berarti:

```text
validated canonical capability projection tersedia
```

Belum berarti:

```text
user boleh action X
```

FEI-8E.2 tetap tidak memiliki:

```ts
hasPermission(...)
canAccess(...)
permissions.includes(...)
```

Decision API nanti menjadi layer berikutnya.

---

### 7. Minimal upstream ports

`CapabilityMembershipRuntime` dan `CapabilityWorkspaceRuntime` sengaja hanya membutuhkan:

```text
getState()
subscribe()
```

Bukan seluruh runtime API.

Ini Dependency Inversion:

```text
Capability Runtime
tidak membutuhkan
switchMembership()
switchWorkspace()
recoverStaleWorkspace()
```

Ia observer, bukan controller upstream.

---

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "frontend/src/platform/authorization/__tests__/runtime.test.ts"
)

marker = (
    "EOFcat > "
    "frontend/src/platform/authorization/"
    "__tests__/runtime.test.ts <<'EOF'"
)

text = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

count = text.count(marker)

if count != 1:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Expected exactly one accidental heredoc marker "
        f"in {path}, found {count}. "
        "No file was changed."
    )

clean, duplicate = text.split(
    marker,
    1,
)

clean = clean.rstrip() + "\n"

if "describe(" not in clean:
    raise SystemExit(
        "The retained section does not appear to contain "
        "the runtime test suite. No file was changed."
    )

if "createCapabilityRuntime" not in clean:
    raise SystemExit(
        "The retained section does not contain "
        "createCapabilityRuntime. No file was changed."
    )

if len(duplicate.strip()) == 0:
    raise SystemExit(
        "The marker was found but no duplicated content "
        "followed it. No file was changed."
    )

path.write_text(
    clean,
    encoding="utf-8",
    newline="\n",
)

print(
    f"Removed accidental duplicate content from {path}"
)
print(
    f"Retained {len(clean.splitlines())} lines"
)
PY
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Kenapa tidak memakai `head -n 1257`?

Secara teknis bisa:

```bash

```

tetapi itu bergantung pada line number dari satu snapshot.

Script di atas menggunakan **semantic marker**:

```text

```

dan memverifikasi marker muncul tepat sekali sebelum menulis.

Lebih aman terhadap line-number drift.

## 2. Script bersifat fail-closed

Kalau:

```text
marker tidak ada
marker > 1
bagian pertama tidak mengandung suite
duplicate ternyata kosong
```

script berhenti tanpa menulis file.

Ini jauh lebih aman daripada blanket `sed` atau overwrite besar.

bisa terjadi bersamaan.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Audit ini penting karena FEI-8F berbeda dari FEI-8E: kita mulai menyentuh **composition root**.

Composition root boleh mengenal banyak concrete implementations:

```text
app/runtime.ts
├── API
├── Auth
├── Membership
├── Workspace
└── Authorization
```

Itu bukan pelanggaran Separation of Concerns.

Justru di sinilah dependency injection seharusnya dilakukan.

Yang tidak boleh adalah dependency balik seperti:

```text
platform/workspace
→ app/runtime

platform/authorization
→ app/runtime
```

### Workspace verifier dibuat sebelum Workspace runtime

Factory nantinya harus secara eksplisit melakukan konsep berikut:

```ts
const capabilityOperations = ...
const workspaceVerifier = ...
const workspace = ...
const capabilities = ...
```

Sehingga tidak ada fake verifier seperti:

```ts
verify: async () => ({ ok: true })
```

dan tidak ada circular runtime reference.

### Workspace belum otomatis berarti React Provider

FEI-8F.0 juga mengecek apakah application saat ini sudah punya provider boundary untuk Workspace.

Kalau belum, jangan sekaligus membuat:

```text
WorkspaceContextProvider
CapabilityContextProvider
route guards
navigation
```

dalam satu step.

Application composition dan React exposure adalah dua concerns berbeda.

Kemungkinan pembagian setelah audit:

```text
FEI-8F.1 Platform runtime composition
FEI-8F.2 Workspace React bridge
FEI-8F.3 Capability React bridge
```

Tetapi kita lock pembagiannya setelah melihat current composition.

### Fresh login vs reload policy harus tetap terjaga

FEI-7 sudah mengunci:

```text
fresh login
→ TENANT

fresh Membership/Tenant switch
→ TENANT

reload
→ restoration boleh dilakukan
  setelah canonical confirmation
```

Composition baru tidak boleh sekadar memanggil semua `bootstrap()` tanpa memperhatikan lifecycle tersebut.

Karena itu `AppBootstrap.tsx` dan provider flow wajib diaudit sebelum WorkspaceRuntime diaktifkan secara production.

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

FEI-8F.1 membuat production dependency graph yang selama ini belum ada:

```text
BrowserApiClient
      │
      ├── Auth Operations
      │       ↓
      │     Auth Runtime
      │       ↓
      ├── Membership Operations
      │       ↓
      │   Membership Runtime
      │

                  │
                  ├── Workspace Capability Verifier
                  │           ↓
                  │     Workspace Runtime
                  │           │
                  └───────────┴──→ Capability Runtime
```

Constructor order harus:

```text
apiClient
→ auth
→ membership
→ capabilityOperations
→ workspaceVerifier
→ workspace
→ capabilities
→ queryClient/router
```

Ini menyelesaikan poin paling penting dari FEI-7/8:

```text
NO fake verifier
NO capability ↔ workspace cycle
NO React dependency
NO bootstrap side effect dari constructor
```

`createApplicationRuntime()` hanya **compose object graph**. Ia tidak boleh otomatis melakukan:

```text
auth.bootstrap()
membership.bootstrap()
workspace.bootstrap()
capabilities.bootstrap()
```

Lifecycle activation tetap menjadi tanggung jawab React bridges berikutnya.

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Update application composition root

Ganti `frontend/src/app/runtime.ts`:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/runtime.ts <<'EOF'
import { createAppQueryClient } from '@/app/query-client';
import { createAppRouter } from '@/app/router';
import {
    createBrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserApiClient,
} from '@/platform/api';
import {
    createBrowserAuthOperations,
    createBrowserAuthRuntime,
    type BrowserAuthRuntime,
} from '@/platform/auth';
import {
    createCapabilityProjectionOperations,
    createCapabilityRuntime,
    createWorkspaceCapabilityVerifier,
    type CapabilityRuntime,
} from '@/platform/authorization';
import {
    createMembershipContextOperations,
    createMembershipContextRuntime,
    type MembershipContextRuntime,
} from '@/platform/membership';
import {
    createWorkspaceContextOperations,
    createWorkspaceContextRuntime,
    type WorkspaceContextRuntime,
} from '@/platform/workspace';

export interface ApplicationRuntime {
    apiClient:
        BrowserApiClient;

    auth:
        BrowserAuthRuntime;

    membership:
        MembershipContextRuntime;

    workspace:
        WorkspaceContextRuntime;

    capabilities:
        CapabilityRuntime;

    queryClient:
        ReturnType<
            typeof createAppQueryClient
        >;

    router:
        ReturnType<
            typeof createAppRouter
        >;
}

export function createApplicationRuntime():
    ApplicationRuntime {
    const apiClient =
        createBrowserApiClient();

    const auth =
        createBrowserAuthRuntime(
            createBrowserAuthOperations(
                apiClient,
            ),
        );

    const membership =
        createMembershipContextRuntime(
            createMembershipContextOperations(
                apiClient,
            ),
            auth,
        );

    /*
     * Capability projection operations are deliberately
     * shared by both the stateless Workspace verifier and
     * the active Capability runtime.
     *
     * This keeps the dependency graph acyclic:
     *
     * operations
     *   ├─> Workspace verifier
     *   │       ↓
     *   │   Workspace runtime
     *   │       ↓
     *   └────> Capability runtime
     */
    const capabilityOperations =
        createCapabilityProjectionOperations(
            apiClient,
        );

    const workspaceVerifier =
        createWorkspaceCapabilityVerifier(
            capabilityOperations,
        );

    const workspace =
        createWorkspaceContextRuntime(
            createWorkspaceContextOperations(
                apiClient,
            ),
            membership,
            workspaceVerifier,
        );

    const capabilities =
        createCapabilityRuntime(
            capabilityOperations,
            membership,
            workspace,
        );

    return {
        apiClient,
        auth,
        membership,
        workspace,
        capabilities,

        queryClient:
            createAppQueryClient(),

        router:
            createAppRouter(),
    };
}
EOF
```

```bash
import {

import {
    createApplicationRuntime,
} from '@/app/runtime';

describe(
    'createApplicationRuntime',
    () => {
        it('creates isolated application runtime instances', () => {
            const firstRuntime =
                createApplicationRuntime();

            const secondRuntime =
                createApplicationRuntime();

            expect(
                firstRuntime.apiClient,
            ).not.toBe(
                secondRuntime.apiClient,
            );

            expect(
                firstRuntime.auth,
            ).not.toBe(
                secondRuntime.auth,
            );

            expect(
                firstRuntime.membership,
            ).not.toBe(
                secondRuntime.membership,
            );

            expect(
                firstRuntime.workspace,
            ).not.toBe(
                secondRuntime.workspace,
            );

            expect(
                firstRuntime.capabilities,
            ).not.toBe(
                secondRuntime.capabilities,
            );

            expect(
                firstRuntime.queryClient,
            ).not.toBe(
                secondRuntime.queryClient,
            );

            expect(
                firstRuntime.router,
            ).not.toBe(
                secondRuntime.router,
            );

            firstRuntime
                .capabilities
                .dispose();

            firstRuntime
                .workspace
                .dispose();

            secondRuntime
                .capabilities
                .dispose();

            secondRuntime
                .workspace
                .dispose();
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

Kita belum menambahkan `ApplicationRuntime.dispose()` karena application lifecycle ownership belum ada di production composition. Itu lebih aman dibahas saat bridge/lifecycle integration.

## 3. Tambahkan composition-boundary test

Buat:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/__tests__/application-workspace-capability-runtime.test.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    createApplicationRuntime,
} from '@/app/runtime';

describe(
    'Application Workspace and Capability runtimes',
    () => {
        it('composes unresolved Workspace and Capability runtimes without eagerly dispatching lifecycle work', async () => {
            const runtime =
                createApplicationRuntime();

            expect(
                runtime.workspace
                    .getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            expect(
                runtime.capabilities
                    .getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            /*
             * Capability bootstrap cannot invent authority
             * while Membership and Workspace are not ready.
             */
            await expect(
                runtime.capabilities
                    .bootstrap(),
            ).resolves.toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            /*
             * Workspace bootstrap likewise remains dormant
             * while canonical Membership/Tenant truth has
             * not become ready.
             */
            await expect(
                runtime.workspace
                    .bootstrap(),
            ).resolves.toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            expect(
                runtime.capabilities
                    .getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            runtime.capabilities
                .dispose();

            runtime.workspace
                .dispose();
        });

        it('keeps Capability authority unresolved when Workspace has no committed context', () => {
            const runtime =
                createApplicationRuntime();

            expect(
                runtime.membership
                    .getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            expect(
                runtime.workspace
                    .getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            expect(
                runtime.capabilities
                    .getState(),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            runtime.capabilities
                .dispose();

            runtime.workspace
                .dispose();
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

Ada **2 test baru**.

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Composition root boleh mengenal semua concrete modules

Import berikut di `app/runtime.ts` memang benar:

```text
api
auth
membership
workspace
authorization
```

Composition root adalah tempat Dependency Injection dilakukan.

Yang tetap dilarang adalah arah sebaliknya:

```text
platform/authorization → app
platform/workspace     → app
```

---

## 2. `CapabilityProjectionOperations` dibuat sekali

Bukan:

```ts
createWorkspaceCapabilityVerifier(
    createCapabilityProjectionOperations(apiClient),
);

createCapabilityRuntime(
    createCapabilityProjectionOperations(apiClient),
    ...
);
```

Kita sengaja:

```ts
const capabilityOperations =
    createCapabilityProjectionOperations(
        apiClient,
    );
```

lalu share instance yang sama.

Itu menjaga:

```text
one browser transport
one projection boundary
two consumers
```

tanpa shared mutable authorization state.

---

## 3. Verifier dibuat sebelum Workspace

Ini inti dari FEI-8F:

```ts
const workspaceVerifier =
    createWorkspaceCapabilityVerifier(
        capabilityOperations,
    );

const workspace =
    createWorkspaceContextRuntime(
        ...,
        workspaceVerifier,
    );
```

Tidak ada:

```ts
verify: async () => ({
    ok: true,
})
```

Jadi Workspace hanya dapat commit target setelah canonical capability verification yang nyata.

---

## 4. CapabilityRuntime dibuat paling akhir

Ia membutuhkan:

```text
Membership runtime
+
committed Workspace runtime
```

maka baru dibuat setelah Workspace:

```ts
const capabilities =
    createCapabilityRuntime(
        capabilityOperations,
        membership,
        workspace,
    );
```

Graph tetap acyclic.

---

## 5. Constructor tidak bootstrap

Ini sangat penting terhadap kebijakan FEI-7.

`createApplicationRuntime()` tidak melakukan network request dan tidak memutuskan:

```text
fresh login
vs
reload restoration
```

Karena policy itu lifecycle/application concern.

Setelah constructor:

```text
auth          unknown
membership    unresolved
workspace     unresolved
capabilities  unresolved
```

Baru React bridges nanti yang mengaktifkan lifecycle dalam urutan canonical.

---

## 6. Kenapa belum menambah Provider?

Audit menunjukkan provider hierarchy saat ini hanya:

```text
ApplicationErrorBoundary
└── BrowserAuthProvider
    └── MembershipContextProvider
        └── QueryClientProvider
            └── RouterProvider
```

`Pasted text.txt`

FEI-8F.1 hanya memperluas **runtime graph**, bukan React graph.

Dengan ini kita bisa menguji composition tanpa sekaligus membuka risiko:

```text
StrictMode duplicate effects
restoration policy regression
Workspace bootstrap timing
Capability bootstrap timing
```

---

## 7. Kenapa belum `ApplicationRuntime.dispose()`?

Workspace dan Capability memang mempunyai `dispose()`, sedangkan current application root tidak memiliki lifecycle disposal owner. `Pasted text.txt`

Menambahkan global `dispose()` sekarang akan membuat API baru tanpa consumer.

Pada unit test kita explicit cleanup:

```ts
runtime.capabilities.dispose();
runtime.workspace.dispose();
```

Nanti ketika React bridge/lifecycle ownership jelas, kita bisa menentukan apakah `ApplicationRuntime.dispose()` memang diperlukan.

---

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript mengatakan `MembershipContextRuntime` tidak assignable ke `CapabilityMembershipRuntime`, jangan cast. Kirim exact compiler error; kita akan memperketat minimal port type di `authorization/runtime.ts`.

Jika `WorkspaceContextRuntime` tidak assignable ke `CapabilityWorkspaceRuntime`, sama: jangan `as CapabilityWorkspaceRuntime`.

Jika constructor sendiri memicu network request, itu blocker. Composition root harus side-effect-free terhadap lifecycle.

Jika AppBootstrap regression gagal, jangan tambahkan Workspace provider sebagai “fix”. Provider activation memang belum bagian FEI-8F.1.

Jika full suite bukan **190/190**, tetap di FEI-8F.1.

tanpa memasukkan permission decision/UI guards terlebih dahulu.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita harus memastikan provider nanti mempertahankan tiga kebijakan yang sudah locked:

```text
reload
→ boleh mempertimbangkan restoration hint

fresh login
→ TENANT baseline

fresh Membership/Tenant switch
→ TENANT baseline
```

Masalahnya, public Workspace runtime yang sudah kita audit hanya menunjukkan:

```ts
bootstrap({
    signal,
})
```

belum terlihat adanya:

```ts
restore: boolean
skipRestoration: boolean
```

Karena itu jangan dulu membuat provider seperti:

```ts
useEffect(() => {
    if (membershipState.status === 'ready') {
        void runtime.bootstrap();
    }
}, [membershipState.status, runtime]);
```

sampai kita membuktikan bagaimana `bootstrap()`, `reset()`, Membership invalidation, dan restoration hint berinteraksi.

Risiko yang ingin kita hindari:

```text
fresh login
      ↓
Membership ready
      ↓
Workspace bootstrap
      ↓
stale sessionStorage hint restored   ❌
```

Kita juga perlu memastikan apakah Membership switch sendiri sudah membersihkan hint:

```text
Membership A
→ switching
→ Membership B

Workspace runtime subscription
→ invalidate Workspace
→ clear old restoration?
```

Jika sudah, React Provider tidak boleh menduplikasi storage ownership.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Provider tidak boleh mengambil alih storage ownership tanpa alasan

Saat ini restoration sudah dimiliki platform Workspace:

```text
workspace/restoration.ts
```

Idealnya React bridge hanya mengatur lifecycle:

```text
upstream ready
→ runtime.bootstrap()
```

bukan:

```text
React Provider
→ sessionStorage manipulation
```

Tetapi kita perlu membuktikan runtime sendiri bisa membedakan reload vs fresh transition.

Jika runtime sudah membersihkan hint ketika Membership berubah, kita gunakan behavior itu dan tidak menambah storage coupling ke React.

### 2. Dependency effect harus mengikuti upstream truth

Membership Provider yang sudah stabil memakai dependency:

```ts
[
    authenticationState.status,
    runtime,
]
```

dan bukan:

```ts
[
    authenticationState.status,
    membershipState.status,
    runtime,
]
```

karena self-state dependency bisa menghasilkan StrictMode/re-bootstrap loop. 

Workspace Provider kemungkinan akan memakai filosofi yang sama:

```text
Membership state sebagai upstream trigger
Workspace runtime sebagai target
```

tetapi exact trigger baru kita lock setelah audit.

### 3. `switching` kemungkinan harus authority-neutral

Ketika Membership:

```text
ready
→ switching
```

Workspace seharusnya segera invalid.

Dan Capability runtime sudah subscribe langsung ke Workspace, sehingga alurnya menjadi:

```text
Membership switching
    ↓
Workspace unresolved
    ↓
Capability unresolved
```

Tidak perlu React Capability Provider untuk membuat invalidation tersebut bekerja; FEI-8E.2 sudah membuktikan runtime subscription-nya.

### 4. Provider bukan tempat permission logic

FEI-8F.2 tetap hanya Workspace lifecycle bridge.

Belum ada:

```text
hasPermission()
permissions.includes()
route guard
navigation filtering
Capability Provider
```

Kita menjaga urutan:

```text
Runtime composition   ✅
Workspace lifecycle
Capability lifecycle
Decision API
UI consumption
```

FEI-8F.2A **✅ COMPLETE dan locked**.

Audit memberi jawaban yang cukup tegas untuk lifecycle Workspace:

- `workspace.bootstrap()` **selalu** memanggil `runDiscovery(..., true)`, jadi public bootstrap saat ini selalu mengizinkan restoration. `Pasted text (2).txt`
- Restoration baru dibaca **setelah TENANT berhasil ditemukan dan diverifikasi**, sehingga hint tidak pernah menjadi authority sebelum canonical baseline. `Pasted text (2).txt`
- `reset()` membersihkan restoration hint, **kecuali** ketika Workspace masih `unresolved`; exception itu memang sengaja untuk menjaga reload hint selama Membership awal masih bootstrap. `Pasted text.txt`
- Perubahan Membership/Tenant otomatis meng-invalidasi Workspace dan memanggil `reset()` apabila Workspace sudah memiliki context. Ini berarti Membership switch yang sudah berjalan akan membersihkan hint lama. `Pasted text.txt`
- Runtime **tidak otomatis bootstrap** saat Membership kembali `ready`; subscription hanya melakukan invalidation. React bridge tetap harus memulai bootstrap. `Pasted text (2).txt`
- Internal runtime sebenarnya **sudah memiliki seam `restoreHint: boolean`** di `runDiscovery()`, tetapi belum diekspos oleh public `bootstrap()`. Stale recovery bahkan sudah memakai `false`. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Karena itu kita **belum boleh langsung membuat Workspace Provider**. Langkah berikutnya adalah satu perubahan kecil:

# FEI-8F.2B - Workspace Bootstrap Restoration Policy Seam

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita expose explicit policy pada `workspace.bootstrap()`:

```text
reload
→ restoreHint: true

fresh login
→ restoreHint: false

fresh Membership/Tenant context
→ restoreHint: false
```

Tetapi `false` tidak cukup sekadar “jangan baca hint”.

Untuk fresh context, kita juga harus **discard hint lama**, karena jika dibiarkan:

```text
fresh login
→ bootstrap restoreHint:false
→ TENANT
→ old hint masih di sessionStorage
→ bootstrap berikut / reload
→ old organizational Workspace dapat muncul lagi
```

Jadi semantics yang kita lock:

```text
restoreHint: true
→ preserve + validate advisory reload hint

restoreHint: false
→ discard previous hint
→ discover
→ verify TENANT
→ remain TENANT
```

Default tetap `true` agar existing runtime/API dan regression FEI-7 tidak berubah.

Kita belum membuat React Provider pada langkah ini.

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Tambahkan bootstrap-specific options

Di `frontend/src/platform/workspace/runtime.ts`, biarkan base options:

```ts
export interface WorkspaceContextRuntimeOptions {
    readonly signal?:
        AbortSignal;
}
```

Lalu tepat setelahnya tambahkan:

```ts
export interface WorkspaceContextBootstrapOptions
    extends WorkspaceContextRuntimeOptions {
    /*
     * Reload bootstrap may validate and restore the
     * advisory per-tab Workspace hint.
     *
     * Fresh authentication or Membership/Tenant context
     * must set this to false so stale organizational
     * context is discarded and TENANT remains the safe
     * baseline.
     *
     * Default true preserves the established reload
     * behavior for existing callers.
     */
    readonly restoreHint?:
        boolean;
}
```

Kemudian ubah interface `WorkspaceContextRuntime` dari:

```ts
bootstrap(
    options?:
        WorkspaceContextRuntimeOptions,
): Promise<
    WorkspaceContextState
>;
```

menjadi:

```ts
bootstrap(
    options?:
        WorkspaceContextBootstrapOptions,
): Promise<
    WorkspaceContextState
>;
```

---

## 2. Ubah implementation `bootstrap`

Current implementation Anda adalah:

```ts
const bootstrap =
    async (
        options:
            WorkspaceContextRuntimeOptions = {},
    ): Promise<
        WorkspaceContextState
    > => {
        if (
            state.status
                === 'switching'
        ) {
            return state;
        }

        const context =
            currentMembershipContext();

        if (
            context
                === undefined
        ) {
            return reset();
        }

        return runDiscovery(
            context,
            options,
            true,
        );
    };
```

Ganti seluruh block itu dengan:

```ts
const bootstrap =
    async (
        options:
            WorkspaceContextBootstrapOptions = {},
    ): Promise<
        WorkspaceContextState
    > => {
        /*
         * A concurrent explicit switch owns Workspace
         * transition until verification completes.
         */
        if (
            state.status
                === 'switching'
        ) {
            return state;
        }

        const context =
            currentMembershipContext();

        if (
            context
                === undefined
        ) {
            return reset();
        }

        const restoreHint =
            options.restoreHint
                ?? true;

        if (
            ! restoreHint
        ) {
            /*
             * Fresh authentication / Membership context
             * must establish TENANT as a genuinely fresh
             * baseline.
             *
             * Merely skipping the read would leave an old
             * organizational hint available to a later
             * bootstrap or reload.
             */
            clearRestorationHint();
        }

        return runDiscovery(
            context,
            {
                ...(
                    options.signal
                        === undefined
                        ? {}
                        : {
                            signal:
                                options.signal,
                        }
                ),
            },
            restoreHint,
        );
    };
```

Perhatikan kita **tidak** meneruskan `restoreHint` ke generic verification options.

`runDiscovery()` tetap mendapatkan:

```ts
WorkspaceContextRuntimeOptions
```

yang hanya mengandung `signal`.

Ini menjaga transport/verifier boundary tetap bersih.

---

## 3. Export bootstrap options di `index.ts`

Pada `frontend/src/platform/workspace/index.ts`, bagian runtime types saat ini kira-kira:

```ts
export type {
    WorkspaceContextRuntime,
    WorkspaceContextRuntimeOptions,
    WorkspaceMembershipRuntime,
} from './runtime';
```

Ganti menjadi:

```ts
export type {
    WorkspaceContextBootstrapOptions,
    WorkspaceContextRuntime,
    WorkspaceContextRuntimeOptions,
    WorkspaceMembershipRuntime,
} from './runtime';
```

## 4. Tambahkan test fresh-context policy

Jangan rewrite seluruh `runtime.test.ts`.

Tambahkan **satu test** ke dalam existing:

```ts
describe(
    'WorkspaceContext runtime',
    () => {
        // existing tests...
    },
);
```

Test baru:

```ts
it('discards a restoration hint and remains on verified TENANT when bootstrap disables restoration', async () => {
    const organizationalWorkspace =
        workspaceDiscovery
            .workspaces
            .find(
                (workspace) =>
                    workspace.type
                        === 'ORGANIZATION',
            );

    if (
        organizationalWorkspace
            === undefined
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'Workspace runtime test fixture requires an ORGANIZATION Workspace.',
        );
    }

    persistBrowserWorkspaceRestorationHint(
        canonicalContext,
        organizationalWorkspace,
    );

    const runtime =
        createWorkspaceContextRuntime(
            operations,
            membership.runtime,
            verifier,
        );

    const result =
        await runtime.bootstrap({
            restoreHint:
                false,
        });

    expect(
        result.status,
    ).toBe(
        'ready',
    );

    if (
        result.status
            !== 'ready'
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'Workspace runtime must be ready after fresh-context bootstrap.',
        );
    }

    expect(
        result.current.type,
    ).toBe(
        'TENANT',
    );

    expect(
        verifier.requests,
    ).toEqual([
        expect.objectContaining({
            workspace: expect.objectContaining({
                type:
                    'TENANT',
            }),
        }),
    ]);

    expect(
        readBrowserWorkspaceRestorationHint(),
    ).toEqual({
        ok:
            true,
        hint:
            null,
    });

    runtime.dispose();
});
```

### Penting soal fixture test

Nama fixture pada contoh di atas:

```ts
workspaceDiscovery
canonicalContext
operations
membership
verifier
```

harus menggunakan **fixture/helper existing yang memang sudah ada dalam `runtime.test.ts` Anda**.

Jangan membuat duplicate second fixture ecosystem hanya untuk test ini.

Karena saya belum menerima seluruh 1.200+ baris `runtime.test.ts`, lakukan audit cepat berikut dulu untuk mendapatkan exact names:

```bash
grep -nE \
  'const (context|canonicalContext|workspaceDiscovery|discovery)|function create.*(Operations|Membership|Verifier)|persistBrowserWorkspaceRestorationHint|readBrowserWorkspaceRestorationHint' \
  frontend/src/platform/workspace/__tests__/runtime.test.ts \
  | head -120
```

Jika existing names berbeda, sesuaikan identifier saja; semantics test di atas tetap sama.

Tidak perlu menambah `as`, `any`, atau fixture cast.

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Kenapa default tetap `true`?

Karena public behavior yang sudah locked saat ini:

```ts
bootstrap()
→ restoration allowed
```

`Pasted text (2).txt`

Mengubah default menjadi `false` akan merusak reload semantics FEI-7.

Jadi:

```ts
options.restoreHint ?? true
```

adalah backward-compatible.

---

## 2. Kenapa `restoreHint:false` harus clear storage?

Internal `runDiscovery(..., false)` saat ini hanya berhenti setelah TENANT ready:

```ts
if (! restoreHint) {
    return state;
}
```

Ia tidak otomatis membersihkan hint. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Untuk stale recovery ini aman karena recovery **sudah memanggil `clearRestorationHint()` sebelum `runDiscovery(..., false)`**. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Fresh bootstrap belum mempunyai langkah itu.

Karena itu public policy seam harus menambahkan clear.

---

## 3. Kenapa tidak expose `runDiscovery()`?

Karena `runDiscovery` adalah implementation detail yang menangani:

```text
discovery
TENANT validation
TENANT verification
optional restoration
target verification
rollback
operation revision
```

React tidak boleh mengetahui semua itu.

React hanya perlu mengatakan:

```text
bootstrap this context as reload
```

atau:

```text
bootstrap this context fresh
```

dan runtime tetap menguasai mechanics.

---

## 4. Kenapa boolean masih acceptable?

Biasanya boolean flag mudah menjadi ambiguous.

Tetapi di sini vocabulary-nya sudah eksplisit:

```ts
restoreHint: true | false
```

dan hanya mengontrol satu advisory behavior.

Kita tidak memakai generic:

```ts
fresh: true
mode: 2
specialCase: true
```

Jika policy berkembang lebih dari dua state nanti, baru layak menjadi discriminated mode.

---

## 5. Membership switch sudah aman

Saat Workspace sudah memiliki context dan Membership berubah menjadi non-ready/mismatch, subscription memanggil `reset()`, yang membersihkan old hint. `Pasted text.txt`

Jadi seam ini terutama menyelesaikan case penting:

```text
Workspace masih unresolved
+
fresh auth lifecycle
+
old sessionStorage hint masih ada
```

karena initial unresolved state memang sengaja **tidak** membersihkan hint untuk mendukung reload. `Pasted text.txt`

Itulah ambiguity yang React Provider tidak bisa selesaikan tanpa explicit bootstrap policy.

# Troubleshooting

Jika test baru gagal karena fixture helper names berbeda, jangan mengubah runtime. Kirim hasil command fixture audit berikut:

```bash
grep -nE \
  'const (context|canonicalContext|workspaceDiscovery|discovery)|function create.*(Operations|Membership|Verifier)|persistBrowserWorkspaceRestorationHint|readBrowserWorkspaceRestorationHint' \
  frontend/src/platform/workspace/__tests__/runtime.test.ts \
  | head -160
```

Jika `WorkspaceContextBootstrapOptions` menyebabkan type error di verifier/operations, jangan cast. Bootstrap options hanya boleh dibatasi menjadi `{signal}` sebelum masuk `runDiscovery()` seperti kode di atas.

Jika existing 13th restoration test berubah behavior ketika memakai default `bootstrap()`, itu blocker-default reload restoration tidak boleh berubah.

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "frontend/src/platform/workspace/__tests__/runtime.test.ts"
)

text = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

start_marker = (
    "it('discards a restoration hint and remains on verified TENANT "
    "when bootstrap disables restoration', async () => {"
)

start = text.find(start_marker)

if start == -1:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Expected FEI-8F.2B placeholder test was not found. "
        "No file was changed."
    )

next_describe = text.find(
    "describe(",
    start,
)

next_test = text.find(
    "\nit(",
    start + len(start_marker),
)

candidates = [
    position
    for position in (
        next_describe,
        next_test,
    )
    if position != -1
]

if not candidates:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Could not determine the end of the placeholder test. "
        "No file was changed."
    )

end = min(candidates)

before = text[:start].rstrip()
after = text[end:].lstrip()

clean = (
    before
    + "\n\n"
    + after
)

# Remove trailing spaces/tabs without touching logical content.
clean = "\n".join(
    line.rstrip()
    for line in clean.splitlines()
) + "\n"

if clean.count(start_marker) != 0:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Placeholder test still exists after repair. "
        "No file was written."
    )

path.write_text(
    clean,
    encoding="utf-8",
    newline="\n",
)

print(
    "Removed invalid FEI-8F.2B placeholder test "
    "and cleaned trailing whitespace."
)
PY
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Tidak memakai fixture placeholder lagi

Test ini hanya memakai identifier yang inventory Anda benar-benar membuktikan tersedia:

```text
context
tenantWorkspace
organizationWorkspace
readyMembershipState
createSuccessOperations
readRestorationHint
```

Jadi kita tidak mengulang masalah `workspaceDiscovery`, `canonicalContext`, atau `verifier.requests` yang sebelumnya ternyata tidak ada.

### 2. Membership stub dibuat minimal

Workspace runtime hanya memerlukan:

```text
getState()
subscribe()
```

Jadi test tidak perlu membuat Membership runtime penuh.

Ini sesuai Interface Segregation Principle: test menyediakan dependency sekecil contract yang dibutuhkan.

### 3. Verifier mencatat type, bukan permission

Kita hanya membuktikan Workspace apa yang diverifikasi:

```text
['TENANT']
```

Jika runtime mencoba restoration meskipun `restoreHint:false`, hasil akan menjadi:

```text
['TENANT', 'ORGANIZATION']
```

dan test gagal.

Itu assertion yang kuat karena tidak hanya mengecek final state, tetapi juga membuktikan organizational restoration **tidak pernah dijalankan**.

### 4. Kita membuktikan hint benar-benar ada terlebih dahulu

Sebelum bootstrap:

```ts
expect(
    readRestorationHint(),
).not.toBeNull();
```

Ini penting. Tanpa assertion itu, test bisa “PASS” hanya karena storage memang sudah kosong.

Setelah bootstrap:

```ts
expect(
    readRestorationHint(),
).toBeNull();
```

Jadi causal chain-nya jelas.

### 5. TENANT dibandingkan dengan canonical fixture

Bukan hanya:

```ts
state.current.type === 'TENANT'
```

tetapi:

```ts
state.current === tenantWorkspace secara value
```

sehingga runtime harus mem-publish canonical discovery object yang benar.

Initial authentication bootstrap boleh langsung `unknown → authenticated`, sedangkan fresh login memiliki jejak `authenticating → resolving-context → authenticated`. `Pasted text (3).txt` Membership switch juga eksplisit melalui `switching → ready`, dan `ready` membawa canonical `membership.id + tenant.id`, jadi pergantian context bisa dikenali tanpa cast atau heuristic. `Pasted text (2).txt` Membership runtime sendiri baru meng-commit target setelah canonical Auth mengonfirmasinya. `Pasted text.txt`

Kita tetap satu langkah dulu: **FEI-8F.2C.1 - Workspace Bootstrap Lifecycle Classifier**. Belum memasang Provider ke `AppBootstrap`.

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita buat classifier kecil, pure dari sisi React, yang mempertahankan lifecycle history:

```text
initial reload
unknown → authenticated
Membership ready
→ restoreHint: true
```

Fresh login:

```text
anonymous
→ authenticating / resolving-context
→ authenticated
→ Membership ready
→ restoreHint: false
```

Membership switch:

```text
Membership ready(A)
→ switching
→ ready(B)
→ restoreHint: false
```

Classifier ini sengaja tidak memakai:

```ts
firstReady
firstRender
Date.now()
sessionStorage
```

dan tidak mengenal Workspace runtime.

React Provider berikutnya tinggal bertanya:

```text
"Untuk canonical context ini, restoreHint true atau false?"
```

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Lifecycle classifier

Buat:

```bash
mkdir -p \
  frontend/src/app/workspace/__tests__

cat > frontend/src/app/workspace/lifecycle.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    BrowserAuthState,
} from '@/platform/auth';
import type {
    CanonicalMembershipContext,
    MembershipContextState,
} from '@/platform/membership';

type NonReadyMembershipStatus =
    Exclude<
        MembershipContextState['status'],
        'ready'
    >;

export type WorkspaceMembershipLifecycleObservation =
    | {
        readonly status:
            'ready';

        readonly context:
            CanonicalMembershipContext;
    }
    | {
        readonly status:
            NonReadyMembershipStatus;
    };

export interface WorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleDecision {
    readonly contextIdentity:
        string;

    readonly restoreHint:
        boolean;
}

export interface WorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier {
    observe(
        authenticationStatus:
            BrowserAuthState['status'],
        membership:
            WorkspaceMembershipLifecycleObservation,
    ):
        | WorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleDecision
        | null;
}

function createContextIdentity(
    context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
): string {
    return JSON.stringify([
        context.membership.id,
        context.tenant.id,
    ]);
}

function isFreshAuthenticationTransition(
    status:
        BrowserAuthState['status'],
): boolean {
    return (
        status
            === 'authenticating'
        || status
            === 'resolving-context'
    );
}

export function createWorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier():
    WorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier {
    let freshContextPending =
        false;

    let currentDecision:
        WorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleDecision
        | null =
            null;

    /*
     * The classifier observes explicit upstream lifecycle
     * states rather than guessing from "first render".
     *
     * The same decision is retained for the same canonical
     * Membership/Tenant context so React StrictMode effect
     * replay cannot change restoration policy midway
     * through one bootstrap.
     */
    return {
        observe(
            authenticationStatus,
            membership,
        ) {
            if (
                isFreshAuthenticationTransition(
                    authenticationStatus,
                )
            ) {
                freshContextPending =
                    true;

                currentDecision =
                    null;
            }

            if (
                membership.status
                    === 'switching'
            ) {
                /*
                 * Membership switching means the next
                 * canonical context is fresh even if the
                 * target eventually resolves to identifiers
                 * seen earlier in this browser tab.
                 */
                freshContextPending =
                    true;

                currentDecision =
                    null;
            }

            if (
                membership.status
                    !== 'ready'
            ) {
                return null;
            }

            const contextIdentity =
                createContextIdentity(
                    membership.context,
                );

            if (
                currentDecision
                    ?.contextIdentity
                    === contextIdentity
            ) {
                return currentDecision;
            }

            currentDecision = {
                contextIdentity,

                restoreHint:
                    ! freshContextPending,
            };

            freshContextPending =
                false;

            return currentDecision;
        },
    };
}

export function createWorkspaceMembershipLifecycleObservation(
    state:
        MembershipContextState,
): WorkspaceMembershipLifecycleObservation {
    if (
        state.status
            === 'ready'
    ) {
        return {
            status:
                'ready',

            context:
                state.context,
        };
    }

    return {
        status:
            state.status,
    };
}
EOF
```

## 2. Unit tests

Buat:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/workspace/__tests__/lifecycle.test.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    createWorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier,
    createWorkspaceMembershipLifecycleObservation,
} from '@/app/workspace/lifecycle';
import type {
    CanonicalMembershipContext,
    MembershipContextState,
} from '@/platform/membership';

const membershipId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab';

const otherMembershipId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7bcd-8def-1234567890ab';

const tenantId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7cde-8def-1234567890ab';

const otherTenantId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7def-8def-1234567890ab';

const context:
    CanonicalMembershipContext = {
        membership: {
            id:
                membershipId,

            status:
                'ACTIVE',
        },

        tenant: {
            id:
                tenantId,

            name:
                'EduCore School',

            subdomain:
                'educore-school',
        },
    };

const otherContext:
    CanonicalMembershipContext = {
        membership: {
            id:
                otherMembershipId,

            status:
                'ACTIVE',
        },

        tenant: {
            id:
                otherTenantId,

            name:
                'EduCore School B',

            subdomain:
                'educore-school-b',
        },
    };

function readyMembershipState(
    canonicalContext:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
): MembershipContextState {
    return {
        status:
            'ready',

        memberships: [
            {
                membership_id:
                    canonicalContext
                        .membership
                        .id,

                membership_status:
                    canonicalContext
                        .membership
                        .status,

                tenant_id:
                    canonicalContext
                        .tenant
                        .id,

                tenant_name:
                    canonicalContext
                        .tenant
                        .name,

                tenant_subdomain:
                    canonicalContext
                        .tenant
                        .subdomain,
            },
        ],

        context:
            canonicalContext,

        failure:
            null,
    };
}

describe(
    'Workspace bootstrap lifecycle classifier',
    () => {
        it('allows restoration for the first canonical context resolved by initial session bootstrap', () => {
            const classifier =
                createWorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier();

            expect(
                classifier.observe(
                    'unknown',
                    {
                        status:
                            'unresolved',
                    },
                ),
            ).toBeNull();

            const decision =
                classifier.observe(
                    'authenticated',
                    createWorkspaceMembershipLifecycleObservation(
                        readyMembershipState(
                            context,
                        ),
                    ),
                );

            expect(
                decision,
            ).toEqual({
                contextIdentity:
                    JSON.stringify([
                        membershipId,
                        tenantId,
                    ]),

                restoreHint:
                    true,
            });
        });

        it('disables restoration after a fresh authentication lifecycle', () => {
            const classifier =
                createWorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier();

            classifier.observe(
                'anonymous',
                {
                    status:
                        'unresolved',
                },
            );

            classifier.observe(
                'authenticating',
                {
                    status:
                        'unresolved',
                },
            );

            classifier.observe(
                'resolving-context',
                {
                    status:
                        'discovering',
                },
            );

            const decision =
                classifier.observe(
                    'authenticated',
                    createWorkspaceMembershipLifecycleObservation(
                        readyMembershipState(
                            context,
                        ),
                    ),
                );

            expect(
                decision?.restoreHint,
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );
        });

        it('disables restoration for a canonical context committed after Membership switching', () => {
            const classifier =
                createWorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier();

            classifier.observe(
                'authenticated',
                createWorkspaceMembershipLifecycleObservation(
                    readyMembershipState(
                        context,
                    ),
                ),
            );

            classifier.observe(
                'authenticated',
                {
                    status:
                        'switching',
                },
            );

            const decision =
                classifier.observe(
                    'authenticated',
                    createWorkspaceMembershipLifecycleObservation(
                        readyMembershipState(
                            otherContext,
                        ),
                    ),
                );

            expect(
                decision,
            ).toEqual({
                contextIdentity:
                    JSON.stringify([
                        otherMembershipId,
                        otherTenantId,
                    ]),

                restoreHint:
                    false,
            });
        });

        it('retains the same decision for repeated observation of one canonical context', () => {
            const classifier =
                createWorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier();

            classifier.observe(
                'authenticating',
                {
                    status:
                        'unresolved',
                },
            );

            const membership =
                createWorkspaceMembershipLifecycleObservation(
                    readyMembershipState(
                        context,
                    ),
                );

            const first =
                classifier.observe(
                    'authenticated',
                    membership,
                );

            const second =
                classifier.observe(
                    'authenticated',
                    membership,
                );

            expect(
                first,
            ).toEqual(
                second,
            );

            expect(
                second?.restoreHint,
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );
        });

        it('does not create a restoration decision before canonical Membership readiness', () => {
            const classifier =
                createWorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier();

            expect(
                classifier.observe(
                    'authenticated',
                    {
                        status:
                            'discovering',
                    },
                ),
            ).toBeNull();

            expect(
                classifier.observe(
                    'membership-context-required',
                    {
                        status:
                            'selection-required',
                    },
                ),
            ).toBeNull();

            expect(
                classifier.observe(
                    'resolving-context',
                    {
                        status:
                            'switching',
                    },
                ),
            ).toBeNull();
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Initial reload dikenali dari absennya fresh-transition

Initial BrowserSession bootstrap memang dapat langsung menghasilkan authenticated identity dari state `unknown`; fresh login berbeda karena reducer punya state eksplisit `authenticating` dan `resolving-context`. `Pasted text (3).txt`

Karena itu classifier tidak perlu menebak:

```ts
firstReady === true
```

Ia justru menyimpan:

```text
pernah melihat fresh auth transition?
```

### 2. Membership switch adalah signal eksplisit

Membership reducer mempunyai state:

```text
switching
```

sebelum `CONTEXT_CONFIRMED → ready`. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Maka:

```ts
membership.status === 'switching'
```

adalah signal yang jauh lebih kuat daripada membandingkan object reference.

### 3. Canonical identity memakai Membership + Tenant

Context identity:

```text
membership.id
+
tenant.id
```

sesuai canonical context model.

Kita tidak menggunakan:

```text
workspace label
organization id
role
permission
```

untuk menentukan auth lifecycle.

### 4. Decision disimpan per current canonical context

Ini penting untuk StrictMode.

Misalnya:

```text
fresh login
→ classifier menghasilkan false
→ effect bootstrap #1
→ StrictMode cleanup
→ effect bootstrap #2
```

Kedua bootstrap harus memakai:

```text
restoreHint:false
```

bukan berubah menjadi `true` pada replay kedua.

Karena itu `currentDecision` tidak langsung “dikonsumsi”.

### 5. Classifier tetap React-independent

File ini tidak mengimpor:

```text
react
useEffect
useRef
sessionStorage
WorkspaceRuntime
```

Sehingga lifecycle logic bisa diuji sendiri sebelum kita menambahkan effect orchestration.

Ini membuat FEI-8F.2C.2 jauh lebih kecil.

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak `membership_status` karena generated `MembershipSummary` memakai literal/alias yang berbeda, jangan cast. Kirim exact compiler error; kita akan memakai existing valid Membership fixture shape.

Jika fresh-login test menghasilkan `restoreHint:true`, classifier gagal mempertahankan pending fresh lifecycle dan belum boleh dipakai Provider.

Jika repeated-observation test berubah dari `false` menjadi `true`, itu blocker StrictMode.

Jika classifier mulai membutuhkan Workspace state untuk bekerja, desainnya salah: policy ditentukan oleh **Auth + Membership lifecycle**, bukan oleh target Workspace.

# Langkah Berikutnya

Jika **5/5 + typecheck PASS**, FEI-8F.2C.1 kita lock.

Baru kita masuk satu langkah berikut:

```text
FEI-8F.2C.2 - WorkspaceContextProvider
```

Provider itu akan sangat tipis:

```text
Auth state
+
Membership state
        ↓
lifecycle classifier
        ↓
Membership ready?
        ↓
runtime.bootstrap({
    restoreHint: decision.restoreHint
})
```

dengan hierarchy:

```text
BrowserAuthProvider
└── MembershipContextProvider
    └── WorkspaceContextProvider
```

Capability React bridge tetap belum masuk.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Jangan mengubah production classifier:

```text
frontend/src/app/workspace/lifecycle.ts
```

Problem berada di helper test:

```ts
tenant_subdomain:
    canonicalContext
        .tenant
        .subdomain,
```

Walaupun fixture aktual berisi `'educore-school'`, annotation:

```ts
const context:
    CanonicalMembershipContext
```

membuat TypeScript melihat property tersebut sebagai:

```ts

```

```ts
as string
!
as any
```

Solusinya adalah membuat test fixture menyediakan `tenant_subdomain` yang memang bertipe `string`.

# Kode Lengkap

Di bagian constants, tambahkan dua constant:

```ts

    'educore-school';

const otherTenantSubdomain =

```

Kemudian context pertama ubah:

```ts
const context:
    CanonicalMembershipContext = {
        membership: {
            id:
                membershipId,

            status:
                'ACTIVE',
        },

        tenant: {
            id:
                tenantId,

            name:
                'EduCore School',

            subdomain:
                tenantSubdomain,

```

Context kedua:

```ts
const otherContext:
    CanonicalMembershipContext = {
        membership: {
            id:
                otherMembershipId,

            status:
                'ACTIVE',
        },

        tenant: {
            id:
                otherTenantId,

            name:
                'EduCore School B',

            subdomain:
                otherTenantSubdomain,
        },
    };
```

Lalu ubah helper `readyMembershipState()`.

Dari:


Menjadi:

```ts
function readyMembershipState(
    canonicalContext:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
    tenantSubdomain:
        string,
): MembershipContextState {
    return {
        status:
            'ready',

        memberships: [
            {
                membership_id:
                    canonicalContext
                        .membership
                        .id,

                    canonicalContext
```

Kemudian update semua pemanggil untuk `context`.

Dari:


# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### Kenapa tidak `?? ''`?

Secara teknis ini compile:

```ts
tenant_subdomain:
    canonicalContext.tenant.subdomain
    ?? '',
```

tetapi itu memperkenalkan fixture yang secara semantik bisa invalid.

Kita tahu `MembershipSummary` membutuhkan subdomain valid, jadi test harus menyediakan value valid secara eksplisit.

### Kenapa tidak `as string`?

Karena itu hanya menyembunyikan perbedaan contract:

```text
Canonical context:
subdomain = string | null

Membership summary:
tenant_subdomain = string
```

TypeScript justru sedang menunjukkan boundary contract yang valid.

### Kenapa helper menerima parameter?

Karena helper sekarang mengatakan dengan jelas:

```text
canonical context
+
required Membership summary subdomain
→ ready Membership fixture
```

Tidak ada implicit assumption bahwa property nullable pasti non-null.

# FEI-8F.2C.2 - WorkspaceContextProvider Isolated Bridge

Belum mengubah `AppBootstrap.tsx`. Kita buktikan Provider secara terisolasi dulu.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Provider akan menjadi bridge tipis:

```text
Auth state
+
Membership state
       ↓
Lifecycle classifier
       ↓
canonical Membership ready?
       ↓
Workspace runtime bootstrap({
    restoreHint
})
```

Invariant:

```text
initial reload       → restoreHint:true
fresh login          → restoreHint:false
Membership switch    → restoreHint:false
```

Yang sangat penting: classifier harus tetap menerima observasi saat upstream **belum ready**, supaya state `authenticating`, `resolving-context`, dan `switching` tidak terlewat.

Provider tidak boleh:

```text
read sessionStorage
call raw HTTP
decide permissions
own capability state
depend on Workspace state as effect dependency
```

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. `WorkspaceContextProvider.tsx`

Buat:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/workspace/WorkspaceContextProvider.tsx <<'EOF'
import {
    createContext,
    type PropsWithChildren,
    useContext,
    useEffect,
    useRef,
    useSyncExternalStore,
} from 'react';

import {
    useBrowserAuthState,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import {
    useMembershipContextState,
} from '@/app/membership/MembershipContextProvider';
import {
    createWorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier,
    createWorkspaceMembershipLifecycleObservation,
    type WorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier,
} from '@/app/workspace/lifecycle';
import type {
    WorkspaceContextRuntime,
    WorkspaceContextState,
} from '@/platform/workspace';

const WorkspaceRuntimeContext =
    createContext<
        WorkspaceContextRuntime | null
    >(null);

export interface WorkspaceContextProviderProps
    extends PropsWithChildren {
    readonly runtime:
        WorkspaceContextRuntime;
}

function useWorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier():
    WorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier {
    const classifierRef =
        useRef<
            WorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier
            | null
        >(null);

    if (
        classifierRef.current
            === null
    ) {
        classifierRef.current =
            createWorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier();
    }

    return classifierRef.current;
}

export function WorkspaceContextProvider({
    runtime,
    children,
}: WorkspaceContextProviderProps) {
    const authenticationState =
        useBrowserAuthState();

    const membershipState =
        useMembershipContextState();

    const lifecycleClassifier =
        useWorkspaceBootstrapLifecycleClassifier();

    useEffect(
        () => {
            /*
             * Observe every upstream lifecycle transition
             * before deciding whether Workspace may
             * bootstrap.
             *
             * In particular, authenticating,
             * resolving-context, and Membership switching
             * are needed to distinguish fresh context from
             * initial reload.
             */
            const decision =
                lifecycleClassifier.observe(
                    authenticationState.status,
                    createWorkspaceMembershipLifecycleObservation(
                        membershipState,
                    ),
                );

            if (
                decision
                    === null
            ) {
                return;
            }

            /*
             * Workspace authority may only be established
             * after canonical authentication and canonical
             * Membership/Tenant truth are both ready.
             */
            if (
                authenticationState.status
                    !== 'authenticated'
                || membershipState.status
                    !== 'ready'
            ) {
                return;
            }

            const workspaceStatus =
                runtime.getState().status;

            /*
             * StrictMode may clean up the first Effect while
             * Workspace discovery is already in flight.
             *
             * WorkspaceRuntime supports replacing an
             * in-flight discovery through its operation
             * revision fence.
             *
             * Stable READY/UNAVAILABLE states are not
             * automatically reloaded by React.
             */
            if (
                workspaceStatus
                    !== 'unresolved'
                && workspaceStatus
                    !== 'discovering'
            ) {
                return;
            }

            const controller =
                new AbortController();

            void runtime.bootstrap({
                signal:
                    controller.signal,

                restoreHint:
                    decision.restoreHint,
            });

            return () => {
                controller.abort();
            };
        },
        [
            authenticationState.status,
            lifecycleClassifier,
            membershipState,
            runtime,
        ],
    );

    return (
        <WorkspaceRuntimeContext.Provider
            value={runtime}
        >
            {children}
        </WorkspaceRuntimeContext.Provider>
    );
}

export function useWorkspaceContextRuntime():
    WorkspaceContextRuntime {
    const runtime =
        useContext(
            WorkspaceRuntimeContext,
        );

    if (
        runtime
            === null
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'EduCore WorkspaceContext hooks require WorkspaceContextProvider.',
        );
    }

    return runtime;
}

export function useWorkspaceContextState():
    WorkspaceContextState {
    const runtime =
        useWorkspaceContextRuntime();

    return useSyncExternalStore(
        runtime.subscribe,
        runtime.getState,
    );
}
EOF
```

```bash
const membershipId =

const otherTenantId =

const otherTenantSubdomain =

const context:

const membershipSummary:

const otherMembershipSummary:
    MembershipSummary = {
        membership_id:
            otherMembershipId,

        membership_status:
            'ACTIVE',

        tenant_id:
            otherTenantId,

        tenant_name:
            'EduCore School B',

        tenant_subdomain:
            otherTenantSubdomain,
    };

function createAuthenticatedState(
    canonicalContext:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
): BrowserAuthState {
    return {
        status:
            'authenticated',

        identity: {
            user: {
                id:
                    '018f3b6a-7c20-7eee-8def-1234567890ab',

                email:
                    'member@example.com',
            },

            person: {
                id:
                    '018f3b6a-7c20-7fff-8def-1234567890ab',

                name:
                    'EduCore Member',
            },

            membership:
                canonicalContext
                    .membership,

            tenant:
                canonicalContext
                    .tenant,
        },
    };
}

function createReadyMembershipState(
    canonicalContext:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
    memberships:
        readonly MembershipSummary[],
): MembershipContextState {
    return {
        status:
            'ready',

        memberships,

        context:
            canonicalContext,

        failure:
            null,
    };
}

interface ControlledAuth {
    readonly runtime:
        BrowserAuthRuntime;

    publish(
        state:
            BrowserAuthState,
    ): void;
}

function createControlledAuth(
    initialState:
        BrowserAuthState,
): ControlledAuth {
    let state =
        initialState;

    const listeners =
        new Set<
            (
                state:
                    BrowserAuthState,
            ) => void
        >();

    const runtime:
        BrowserAuthRuntime = {
        getState() {
            return state;
        },

        subscribe(
            listener,
        ) {
            listeners.add(
                listener,
            );

            return () => {
                listeners.delete(
                    listener,
                );
            };
        },

        async bootstrap() {
            return state;
        },

        async login() {
            return state;
        },

        async logout() {
            return state;
        },

        observeFailure() {
            return state;
        },
    };

    return {
        runtime,

        publish(
            nextState,
        ) {
            state =
                nextState;

            for (
                const listener
                of listeners
            ) {
                listener(
                    state,
                );
            }
        },
    };
}

interface ControlledMembership {
    readonly runtime:
        MembershipContextRuntime;

    publish(
        state:
            MembershipContextState,
    ): void;
}

function createControlledMembership(
    initialState:
        MembershipContextState,
): ControlledMembership {
    let state =
        initialState;

    const listeners =
        new Set<
            () => void
        >();

    const publish =
        (
            nextState:
                MembershipContextState,
        ) => {
            state =
                nextState;

            for (
                const listener
                of listeners
            ) {
                listener();
            }
        };

    const runtime:
        MembershipContextRuntime = {
        getState() {
            return state;
        },

        subscribe(
            listener,
        ) {
            listeners.add(
                listener,
            );

            return () => {
                listeners.delete(
                    listener,
                );
            };
        },

        async bootstrap() {
            return state;
        },

        async switchMembership() {
            return state;
        },

        reset() {
            publish({
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            return state;
        },
    };

    return {
        runtime,
        publish,
    };
}

interface RecordingWorkspace {
    readonly runtime:
        WorkspaceContextRuntime;

    readonly bootstrapCalls:
        WorkspaceContextBootstrapOptions[];
}

function createRecordingWorkspace():
    RecordingWorkspace {
    let state:
        WorkspaceContextState = {
            status:
                'unresolved',
        };

    const listeners =
        new Set<
            () => void
        >();

    const bootstrapCalls:
        WorkspaceContextBootstrapOptions[] =
            [];

    const notify =
        () => {
            for (
                const listener
                of listeners
            ) {
                listener();
            }
        };

    const runtime:
        WorkspaceContextRuntime = {
        getState() {
            return state;
        },

        subscribe(
            listener,
        ) {
            listeners.add(
                listener,
            );

            return () => {
                listeners.delete(
                    listener,
                );
            };
        },

        async bootstrap(
            options = {},
        ) {
            bootstrapCalls.push(
                options,
            );

            return state;
        },

        async switchWorkspace() {
            return state;
        },

        async recoverStaleWorkspace() {
            return state;
        },

        reset() {
            state = {
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            };

            notify();

            return state;
        },

        dispose() {
            listeners.clear();
        },
    };

    return {
        runtime,
        bootstrapCalls,
    };
}

interface RuntimeHarness {
    readonly auth:
        ControlledAuth;

    readonly membership:
        ControlledMembership;

    readonly workspace:
        RecordingWorkspace;
}

function renderHarness(
    harness:
        RuntimeHarness,
) {
    return render(
        <BrowserAuthProvider
            runtime={
                harness.auth.runtime
            }
        >
            <MembershipContextProvider
                runtime={
                    harness
                        .membership
                        .runtime
                }
            >
                <WorkspaceContextProvider
                    runtime={
                        harness
                            .workspace
                            .runtime
                    }
                >
                    <div>
                        Workspace child
                    </div>
                </WorkspaceContextProvider>
            </MembershipContextProvider>
        </BrowserAuthProvider>,
    );
}

describe(
    'WorkspaceContextProvider',
    () => {
        it('allows restoration for initial canonical context resolved from page bootstrap', async () => {
            const harness:
                RuntimeHarness = {
                auth:
                    createControlledAuth({
                        status:
                            'unknown',
                    }),

                membership:
                    createControlledMembership({
                        status:
                            'unresolved',
                    }),

                workspace:
                    createRecordingWorkspace(),
            };

            renderHarness(
                harness,
            );

            act(() => {
                harness.auth.publish(
                    createAuthenticatedState(
                        context,
                    ),
                );
            });

            act(() => {
                harness.membership.publish(
                    createReadyMembershipState(
                        context,
                        [
                            membershipSummary,
                        ],
                    ),
                );
            });

            await waitFor(() => {
                expect(
                    harness
                        .workspace
                        .bootstrapCalls,
                ).toHaveLength(
                    1,
                );
            });

            expect(
                harness
                    .workspace
                    .bootstrapCalls[0]
                    ?.restoreHint,
            ).toBe(
                true,
            );
        });

        it('disables restoration after fresh authentication lifecycle', async () => {
            const harness:
                RuntimeHarness = {
                auth:
                    createControlledAuth({
                        status:
                            'anonymous',

                        failure:
                            null,
                    }),

                membership:
                    createControlledMembership({
                        status:
                            'unresolved',
                    }),

                workspace:
                    createRecordingWorkspace(),
            };

            renderHarness(
                harness,
            );

            act(() => {
                harness.auth.publish({
                    status:
                        'authenticating',
                });
            });

            act(() => {
                harness.auth.publish({
                    status:
                        'resolving-context',

                    login: {
                        membership_id:
                            membershipId,

                        tenant_id:
                            tenantId,
                    },
                });
            });

            act(() => {
                harness.auth.publish(
                    createAuthenticatedState(
                        context,
                    ),
                );
            });

            act(() => {
                harness.membership.publish(
                    createReadyMembershipState(
                        context,
                        [
                            membershipSummary,
                        ],
                    ),
                );
            });

            await waitFor(() => {
                expect(
                    harness
                        .workspace
                        .bootstrapCalls,
                ).toHaveLength(
                    1,
                );
            });

            expect(
                harness
                    .workspace
                    .bootstrapCalls[0]
                    ?.restoreHint,
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );
        });

        it('disables restoration after canonical Membership switching', async () => {
            const harness:
                RuntimeHarness = {
                auth:
                    createControlledAuth(
                        createAuthenticatedState(
                            context,

                    ),

                membership:
                    createControlledMembership(
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Effect dependency hanya upstream

Dependency utama:

```ts
authenticationState.status
membershipState
runtime
```

Tidak ada:

```ts
workspaceState.status
```

Ini penting supaya Workspace tidak membuat self-trigger loop:

```text
bootstrap
→ discovering
→ render
→ bootstrap
→ discovering
→ ...
```

Filosofinya sama dengan Membership Provider yang sudah locked.

### 2. Classifier diamati sebelum gating

Urutan ini sengaja:

```ts
classifier.observe(...)
```

**sebelum**:

```ts
if (
    authenticationState.status !== 'authenticated'
    || membershipState.status !== 'ready'
) {
    return;
}
```

Kalau dibalik, Provider tidak akan pernah melihat:

```text
authenticating
resolving-context
switching
```

dan fresh context akan keliru dianggap reload.

### 3. Provider tidak memiliki restoration storage

Provider hanya mengirim:

```ts
restoreHint:
    decision.restoreHint
```

Sedangkan clear/read/persist tetap dimiliki Workspace runtime.

Ini mempertahankan:

```text
React = lifecycle policy
Platform = restoration mechanism
```

### 4. `useRef` mempertahankan classifier

Classifier state harus bertahan antarrender.

Ini juga membuat StrictMode effect replay tidak mengubah:

```text
fresh false
→ replay
→ tetap false
```

karena classifier menyimpan decision untuk canonical context yang sama.

### 5. Stable Workspace tidak auto-reload

Provider hanya bootstrap saat:

```text
unresolved
discovering
```

Tidak otomatis retry dari:

```text
ready
unavailable
switching
recovering
```

karena retry/recovery adalah explicit lifecycle concern, bukan render side effect.

## Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak shape `login` pada state `resolving-context`, jangan cast. Kirim exact compiler error; kita sesuaikan fixture dengan generated `BrowserLoginData`.

Jika Provider test menghasilkan dua bootstrap calls pada test biasa tanpa `<StrictMode>`, jangan sekadar ubah expectation menjadi 2. Kita harus mencari duplicate lifecycle trigger.

Jika initial reload menghasilkan `restoreHint:false`, classifier history tidak terhubung benar ke Provider.

Jika fresh login menghasilkan `true`, itu blocker keamanan/context correctness.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Sekarang `WorkspaceContextProvider` dipasang ke production provider tree:

```text
ApplicationErrorBoundary
└── BrowserAuthProvider
    └── MembershipContextProvider
        └── WorkspaceContextProvider
            └── QueryClientProvider
                └── RouterProvider
```

Lifecycle yang diharapkan:

```text
page mount
   ↓
Auth bootstrap
   ↓
Membership bootstrap
   ↓
canonical Membership ready
   ↓
Workspace Provider
   ↓
Workspace discovery
   ↓
TENANT capability verification
   ↓
Workspace ready / TENANT
```

Capability **React Provider belum dibuat**.

Namun perlu diperhatikan: `CapabilityRuntime` sudah ter-compose pada FEI-8F.1 dan subscribe langsung terhadap Membership + Workspace. Jadi ketika Workspace menjadi `ready`, runtime tersebut dapat melakukan projection otomatis. Ini bukan Capability React integration; ini memang runtime orchestration yang sudah kita lock sebelumnya.
