Ganti isi:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/AppBootstrap.tsx <<'EOF'
import {
    QueryClientProvider,
} from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
    RouterProvider,
} from 'react-router/dom';

import {
    ApplicationErrorBoundary,
} from '@/app/ApplicationErrorBoundary';
import {
    BrowserAuthProvider,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import {
    MembershipContextProvider,
} from '@/app/membership/MembershipContextProvider';
import type {
    ApplicationRuntime,
} from '@/app/runtime';
import {
    WorkspaceContextProvider,
} from '@/app/workspace/WorkspaceContextProvider';

interface AppBootstrapProps {
    runtime:
        ApplicationRuntime;
}

export function AppBootstrap({
    runtime,
}: AppBootstrapProps) {
    return (
        <ApplicationErrorBoundary>
            <BrowserAuthProvider
                runtime={runtime.auth}
            >
                <MembershipContextProvider
                    runtime={
                        runtime.membership
                    }
                >
                    <WorkspaceContextProvider
                        runtime={
                            runtime.workspace
                        }
                    >
                        <QueryClientProvider
                            client={
                                runtime.queryClient
                            }
                        >
                            <RouterProvider
                                router={
                                    runtime.router
                                }
                            />
                        </QueryClientProvider>
                    </WorkspaceContextProvider>
                </MembershipContextProvider>
            </BrowserAuthProvider>
        </ApplicationErrorBoundary>
    );
}
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Provider ordering mengikuti dependency truth

Workspace berada **di dalam Membership Provider**:

```text
Auth
→ Membership
→ Workspace
```

karena Workspace tidak boleh bootstrap tanpa canonical Membership/Tenant.

Sebaliknya ini salah:

```text
Workspace
└── Membership
```

karena `WorkspaceContextProvider` menggunakan:

```ts
useMembershipContextState()
```

---

### 2. Test pertama membuktikan fail-closed

Ketika Auth hanya menghasilkan:

```text
membership-context-required
```

dan Membership menghasilkan:

```text
selection-required
```

maka:

```text
Workspace     unresolved
Capabilities  unresolved
```

serta:

```text
GET /my-workspaces = 0
```

Ini penting. Mounting Provider tidak boleh dengan sendirinya menciptakan Workspace authority.

---

### 3. Test kedua menguji production path sebenarnya

Path yang dibuktikan:

```text
/auth/me
   ↓
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Audit ini ingin menentukan apakah Provider cukup menjadi **read bridge**:

```text
CapabilityRuntime
     ↓
useSyncExternalStore
     ↓
React consumers
```

Ini desain yang paling bersih bila runtime memang sudah otomatis bereaksi terhadap upstream subscriptions.

Jika demikian, Provider tidak membutuhkan:

```ts
useEffect(() => {
    runtime.bootstrap();
});
```

karena itu justru bisa membuat duplicate request.

Capability Provider juga tidak boleh menyediakan API seperti:

```text
hasPermission()
canAccess()
isAllowed()
```

pada tahap ini.

FEI-8F.3 hanya mengekspos **canonical capability projection state**:

```text
unresolved
loading
ready
unavailable
```

Permission-decision API akan menjadi boundary berikutnya, bukan dicampur ke provider.

> **Designing the React bridge**
>
> I’m planning a read-only provider that exposes runtime capability state without bootstrapping it. I’ll test initial state, published updates, and hook behavior outside the provider while keeping fixtures minimal.
>
> **Designed the React bridge**
>
> 
>
> Worked for 15s

FEI-8F.3A **✅ COMPLETE / LOCKED**.

Audit menjawab boundary dengan cukup tegas:

```text
Membership notification ─┐
                         ├─→ synchronize()
Workspace notification ──┘
                              ↓
                            load()
```

Capability runtime sudah subscribe langsung ke Membership dan Workspace; `synchronize()` memanggil `load()` otomatis. `bootstrap()` hanyalah explicit non-forced load, sedangkan `refresh()` memanggil `load(..., true)` untuk memaksa projection ulang. Upstream yang belum valid membuat authority kembali `unresolved`, dan `dispose()` melepas kedua subscription serta menghapus capability authority. `Pasted text.txt`

Jadi Capability React bridge **tidak membutuhkan `useEffect()` sama sekali**.

Kita lanjut satu langkah ke **FEI-8F.3B - CapabilityContextProvider Isolated Read Bridge**.

---

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Capability Provider hanya menjadi adapter:

```text
CapabilityRuntime
      ↓
React Context
      ↓
useSyncExternalStore
      ↓
React consumer
```

Ia **tidak** boleh melakukan:

```ts
runtime.bootstrap();
runtime.refresh();
runtime.reset();
```

saat mount.

Alasannya, load lifecycle sudah dimiliki platform runtime. Menambahkan bootstrap effect di React berisiko menghasilkan:

```text
Workspace ready
→ runtime subscription load

React effect
→ bootstrap
→ second load
```

Walaupun runtime punya dedup fence, React tetap tidak perlu ikut memiliki orchestration yang sudah dimiliki platform.

State yang diekspos tetap mentah dan canonical:

```text
unresolved
loading
ready
unavailable
```

dengan `ready.projection` sebagai satu-satunya capability authority. `Pasted text.txt`

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. `CapabilityContextProvider.tsx`

Buat folder:

```bash
mkdir -p \
  frontend/src/app/authorization/__tests__
```

Buat file:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/authorization/CapabilityContextProvider.tsx <<'EOF'
import {
    createContext,
    type PropsWithChildren,
    useContext,
    useSyncExternalStore,
} from 'react';

import type {
    CapabilityRuntime,
    CapabilityState,
} from '@/platform/authorization';

const CapabilityRuntimeContext =
    createContext<
        CapabilityRuntime | null
    >(null);

export interface CapabilityContextProviderProps
    extends PropsWithChildren {
    readonly runtime:
        CapabilityRuntime;
}

/*
 * CapabilityRuntime already owns lifecycle orchestration
 * through its Membership and Workspace subscriptions.
 *
 * This Provider is deliberately a read bridge only.
 * It must not bootstrap, refresh, reset, or otherwise
 * manufacture authorization authority from React.
 */
export function CapabilityContextProvider({
    runtime,
    children,
}: CapabilityContextProviderProps) {
    return (
        <CapabilityRuntimeContext.Provider
            value={runtime}
        >
            {children}
        </CapabilityRuntimeContext.Provider>
    );
}

export function useCapabilityRuntime():
    CapabilityRuntime {
    const runtime =
        useContext(
            CapabilityRuntimeContext,
        );

    if (
        runtime
            === null
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'EduCore Capability hooks require CapabilityContextProvider.',
        );
    }

    return runtime;
}

export function useCapabilityState():
    CapabilityState {
    const runtime =
        useCapabilityRuntime();

    return useSyncExternalStore(
        runtime.subscribe,
        runtime.getState,
    );
}
EOF
```

## 2. `CapabilityContextProvider.test.tsx`

Buat:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/authorization/__tests__/CapabilityContextProvider.test.tsx <<'EOF'
import {
    act,
    render,
    screen,
} from '@testing-library/react';
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    CapabilityContextProvider,
    useCapabilityRuntime,
    useCapabilityState,
} from '@/app/authorization/CapabilityContextProvider';
import type {
    CapabilityRuntime,
    CapabilityState,
} from '@/platform/authorization';

interface ControlledCapabilityRuntime {
    readonly runtime:
        CapabilityRuntime;

    readonly calls: {
        bootstrap:
            number;

        refresh:
            number;

        reset:
            number;
    };

    publish(
        state:
            CapabilityState,
    ): void;
}

function createControlledCapabilityRuntime(
    initialState:
        CapabilityState = {
            status:
                'unresolved',
        },
): ControlledCapabilityRuntime {
    let state =
        initialState;

    const listeners =
        new Set<
            () => void
        >();

    const calls = {
        bootstrap:
            0,

        refresh:
            0,

        reset:
            0,
    };

    const notify =
        () => {
            for (
                const listener
                of listeners
            ) {
                listener();
            }
        };

    const runtime:
        CapabilityRuntime = {
        getState() {
            return state;
        },

        subscribe(
            listener,
        ) {
            listeners.add(
                listener,
            );

            return () => {
                listeners.delete(
                    listener,
                );
            };
        },

        async bootstrap() {
            calls.bootstrap +=
                1;

            return state;
        },

        async refresh() {
            calls.refresh +=
                1;

            return state;
        },

        reset() {
            calls.reset +=
                1;

            state = {
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            };

            notify();

            return state;
        },

        dispose() {
            listeners.clear();
        },
    };

    return {
        runtime,
        calls,

        publish(
            nextState,
        ) {
            state =
                nextState;

            notify();
        },
    };
}

function CapabilityStateProbe() {
    const state =
        useCapabilityState();

    return (
        <div>
            <span>
                Capability status
            </span>

            <output
                aria-label="Capability status"
            >
                {state.status}
            </output>
        </div>
    );
}

function CapabilityRuntimeProbe({
    expectedRuntime,
}: {
    readonly expectedRuntime:
        CapabilityRuntime;
}) {
    const runtime =
        useCapabilityRuntime();

    return (
        <output
            aria-label="Capability runtime identity"
        >
            {
                runtime
                    === expectedRuntime
                    ? 'same'
                    : 'different'
            }
        </output>
    );
}

describe(
    'CapabilityContextProvider',
    () => {
        it('exposes the composed Capability runtime without dispatching lifecycle work on mount', () => {
            const controlled =
                createControlledCapabilityRuntime();

            render(
                <CapabilityContextProvider
                    runtime={
                        controlled.runtime
                    }
                >
                    <CapabilityRuntimeProbe
                        expectedRuntime={
                            controlled.runtime
                        }
                    />

                    <CapabilityStateProbe />
                </CapabilityContextProvider>,
            );

            expect(
                screen.getByLabelText(
                    'Capability runtime identity',
                ),
            ).toHaveTextContent(
                'same',
            );

            expect(
                screen.getByLabelText(
                    'Capability status',
                ),
            ).toHaveTextContent(
                'unresolved',
            );

            /*
             * CapabilityRuntime already reacts to upstream
             * Membership/Workspace subscriptions.
             *
             * React must not create an additional lifecycle
             * owner.
             */
            expect(
                controlled.calls,
            ).toEqual({
                bootstrap:
                    0,

                refresh:
                    0,

                reset:
                    0,
            });
        });

        it('publishes Capability state changes through useSyncExternalStore without invoking runtime commands', () => {
            const controlled =
                createControlledCapabilityRuntime();

            render(
                <CapabilityContextProvider
                    runtime={
                        controlled.runtime
                    }
                >
                    <CapabilityStateProbe />
                </CapabilityContextProvider>,
            );

            expect(
                screen.getByLabelText(
                    'Capability status',
                ),
            ).toHaveTextContent(
                'unresolved',
            );

            act(() => {
                controlled.publish({
                    status:
                        'loading',
                });
            });

            expect(
                screen.getByLabelText(
                    'Capability status',
                ),
            ).toHaveTextContent(
                'loading',
            );

            act(() => {
                controlled.publish({
                    status:
                        'unavailable',

                    failure: {
                        ok:
                            false,

                        kind:
                            'network',

                        cause:
                            new TypeError(
                                'Network unavailable',
                            ),
                    },
                });
            });

            expect(
                screen.getByLabelText(
                    'Capability status',
                ),
            ).toHaveTextContent(
                'unavailable',
            );

            expect(
                controlled.calls,
            ).toEqual({
                bootstrap:
                    0,

                refresh:
                    0,

                reset:
                    0,
            });
        });

        it('fails closed when Capability hooks are used outside their Provider', () => {
            function InvalidConsumer() {
                useCapabilityState();

                return null;
            }

            expect(
                () => {
                    render(
                        <InvalidConsumer />,
                    );
                },
            ).toThrow(
                'EduCore Capability hooks require CapabilityContextProvider.',
            );
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Tidak ada `useEffect`

Ini boundary terpenting.

Runtime sudah mempunyai:

```ts
membership.subscribe(
    synchronize,
);

workspace.subscribe(
    synchronize,
);
```

dan:

```ts
const synchronize = () => {
    void load();
};
```

Jadi perubahan Workspace ke `ready` otomatis menjadi trigger capability projection. `Pasted text.txt`

Provider tidak perlu:

```ts
useEffect(() => {
    void runtime.bootstrap();
}, [runtime]);
```

---

## 2. `useSyncExternalStore` adalah boundary React yang tepat

Runtime sudah menyediakan:

```ts
getState()
subscribe()
```

Jadi adapter:

```ts
useSyncExternalStore(
    runtime.subscribe,
    runtime.getState,
);
```

memberi React snapshot canonical tanpa menggandakan state:

```text
CapabilityRuntime state
        ↓
React snapshot
```

bukan:

```text
CapabilityRuntime
        ↓
useState copy
        ↓
sync effect
```

Tidak ada dua sources of truth.

---

## 3. Provider mengekspos state, bukan decision API

Belum ada:

```ts
hasPermission()
can()
cannot()
isAuthorized()
```

Capability projection memang berisi `permissions[]`, tetapi FEI-8F.3 hanya membuat projection tersebut tersedia bagi React.

Authorization decision semantics merupakan fase berikutnya.

---

## 4. `unavailable` tetap fail-closed

Capability reducer menghapus projection lama ketika `LOAD_STARTED`, dan failure menghasilkan:

```text
unavailable
+ failure
```

tanpa menyimpan authorization authority sebelumnya. `Pasted text.txt`

Provider tidak mengubah semantics tersebut.

---

## 5. `bootstrap()` dan `refresh()` tetap tersedia

`useCapabilityRuntime()` tetap memberi consumer runtime utuh.

Artinya future explicit retry UI dapat melakukan:

```ts
runtime.refresh()
```

tetapi Provider **tidak melakukannya otomatis**.

Perbedaan responsibility:

```text
Runtime subscription
→ normal lifecycle synchronization

explicit user/application action
→ refresh()

Provider mount
→ nothing
```

# Troubleshooting

Jika test `unavailable` gagal typecheck karena shape `BrowserApiFailure` berbeda, jangan cast. Kirim exact compiler error dan kita gunakan existing canonical failure fixture.

Jika Provider membutuhkan effect agar state berubah, itu berarti test stub salah-`useSyncExternalStore` seharusnya menerima perubahan melalui `subscribe()`.

Jika `bootstrapCalls` menjadi `1`, cari lifecycle call tersembunyi; read bridge tidak boleh memanggil runtime command.

Jika test outside-provider menghasilkan console error tetapi tetap `toThrow()` PASS, itu bukan architecture failure. Yang penting hook benar-benar fail closed.

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Sekarang kita memasang read-only `CapabilityContextProvider` ke provider tree production:

```text
ApplicationErrorBoundary
└── BrowserAuthProvider
    └── MembershipContextProvider
        └── WorkspaceContextProvider
            └── CapabilityContextProvider
                └── QueryClientProvider
                    └── RouterProvider
```

Tidak ada lifecycle effect baru.

Flow tetap:

```text
Membership ready
      +
Workspace ready
      ↓
CapabilityRuntime subscription
      ↓
load()
      ↓
Capability ready
      ↓
CapabilityContextProvider
      ↓
React consumers dapat membaca state
```

Provider hanya membuat runtime tersedia ke React.

```bash
import {
    QueryClientProvider,
} from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
    RouterProvider,
} from 'react-router/dom';

import {
    ApplicationErrorBoundary,
} from '@/app/ApplicationErrorBoundary';
import {
    CapabilityContextProvider,
} from '@/app/authorization/CapabilityContextProvider';
import {
    BrowserAuthProvider,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import {
    MembershipContextProvider,
} from '@/app/membership/MembershipContextProvider';
import type {
    ApplicationRuntime,
} from '@/app/runtime';
import {
    WorkspaceContextProvider,
} from '@/app/workspace/WorkspaceContextProvider';

interface AppBootstrapProps {
    runtime:
        ApplicationRuntime;
}

export function AppBootstrap({
    runtime,
}: AppBootstrapProps) {
    return (
        <ApplicationErrorBoundary>
            <BrowserAuthProvider
                runtime={runtime.auth}
            >
                <MembershipContextProvider
                    runtime={
                        runtime.membership
                    }
                >
                    <WorkspaceContextProvider
                        runtime={
                            runtime.workspace
                        }
                    >
                        <CapabilityContextProvider
                            runtime={
                                runtime.capabilities
                            }
                        >
                            <QueryClientProvider
                                client={
                                    runtime.queryClient
                                }
                            >
                                <RouterProvider
                                    router={
                                        runtime.router
                                    }
                                />
                            </QueryClientProvider>
                        </CapabilityContextProvider>
                    </WorkspaceContextProvider>
                </MembershipContextProvider>
            </BrowserAuthProvider>
        </ApplicationErrorBoundary>
    );
}
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Capability berada setelah Workspace

Ordering:

```text
Membership
→ Workspace
→ Capability
```

mencerminkan dependency semantics.

Capability runtime tidak bisa menghasilkan authority sampai canonical Membership dan committed Workspace sama-sama `ready`.

Provider sebenarnya bisa secara teknis diletakkan di tempat lain karena ia hanya membawa runtime object, tetapi tree ini membuat ownership hierarchy eksplisit dan lebih mudah dipahami.

### 2. Tidak ada bootstrap effect

`CapabilityContextProvider` tidak melakukan:

```ts
useEffect(...)
runtime.bootstrap()
```

dan `AppBootstrap` juga tidak melakukannya.

Platform runtime tetap satu-satunya lifecycle owner:

```text
membership.subscribe()
workspace.subscribe()
       ↓
synchronize()
       ↓
load()
```

Ini menghindari duplicate lifecycle owner.

### 3. Test sekarang membuktikan capability authority

Sebelumnya integration test membuktikan:

```text
Capability endpoint request >= 1
```

Sekarang kita juga membuktikan hasil akhirnya:

```text
CapabilityState
→ ready
→ tenant scope
→ canonical membershipId
→ canonical tenantId
→ permissions []
```

Jadi test tidak hanya melihat network side effect.

### 4. Tetap tidak ada permission decision

Kita hanya mengecek canonical projection:

```ts
projection.permissions
```

Belum ada:

```ts
permissions.includes(...)
hasPermission(...)
canAccess(...)
```

Jadi FEI-8F.3 tetap projection/read bridge, bukan authorization decision layer.

### 5. Selection-required tetap fail closed

Test AppBootstrap pertama sebelumnya sudah membuktikan:

```text
Auth membership-context-required
Membership selection-required
Workspace unresolved
Capabilities unresolved
```

Pemasangan `CapabilityContextProvider` tidak boleh mengubah invariant itu karena provider tidak dispatch apa pun.

# Troubleshooting

Jika Capability berhenti di `loading`, jangan menambah Provider effect. Periksa MSW capability response atau async completion.

Jika Capability menjadi `unavailable`, kirim exact `runtime.capabilities.getState()`; kemungkinan semantic projection fixture tidak match contract.

Jika assertion `scope` TypeScript gagal karena union `TenantCapabilityData | WorkspaceCapabilityData`, jangan cast. Kita tambahkan discriminated narrowing berdasarkan `scope.type`.

Jika test pertama yang `selection-required` membuat Capability selain `unresolved`, itu blocker serius: authority muncul sebelum canonical context lengkap.

Jika full suite naik bukan ke `203`, itu sendiri bukan blocker selama semua tracked suites PASS; jumlah final kita lock berdasarkan output aktual.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Capability runtime seharusnya tidak diam-diam mengubah Workspace

Saat capability request mendapat:

```text
ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED
```

Capability runtime saat ini secara desain hanya memahami capability authority:

```text
loading
→ unavailable
```

Workspace recovery adalah responsibility berbeda:

```text
clear stale Workspace
→ rediscover catalog
→ verify TENANT
→ commit safe baseline
```

Karena itu kemungkinan solusi bersih bukan:

```ts
CapabilityRuntime
→ import WorkspaceContextRuntime
→ recoverStaleWorkspace()
```

melainkan coordinator di application/platform orchestration layer.

Audit ini harus memastikan boundary tersebut.

### 2. Kita harus menghindari recovery loop

Target lifecycle nanti harus kurang lebih:

```text
Workspace ORGANIZATION ready
       ↓
Capability projection
       ↓
ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED
       ↓
Capability authority removed
       ↓
Coordinator invokes Workspace recovery ONCE
       ↓
Workspace recovering
       ↓
fresh discovery
       ↓
TENANT ready
       ↓
Capability runtime auto-loads TENANT
```

Bukan:

```text
denied
→ retry same Workspace
→ denied
→ retry same Workspace
→ ...
```

Workspace runtime sudah memiliki stale-recovery behavior yang menonaktifkan restoration pada cycle tersebut; kita tinggal memastikan ada owner yang memanggilnya.

### 3. Runtime disposal juga perlu explicit owner

Saat ini:

```ts
createApplicationRuntime()
```

membuat subscriptions jangka panjang:

```text
Workspace → Membership subscription
Capability → Membership + Workspace subscriptions
```

Kalau runtime hidup selama seluruh SPA lifetime, itu tidak masalah.

Tetapi architecture tetap perlu memiliki lifecycle ownership yang eksplisit, terutama untuk:

```text
test unmount
HMR
future remount
multiple application roots
```

Audit harus menentukan apakah:

```text
ApplicationRuntime.dispose()
```

perlu dibuat, lalu entrypoint menjadi owner.

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita buat application-level coordinator:

```text
CapabilityRuntime
      │
      │ unavailable
      │ ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED
      ▼
CapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator
      │
      │ only if active Workspace is organizational
      ▼
WorkspaceRuntime.recoverStaleWorkspace()
```

Coordinator berada di `app`, bukan di `platform/authorization`, karena ini adalah orchestration antar-dua runtime.

Boundary-nya:

```text
Capability runtime
→ hanya owns capability authority

Workspace runtime
→ hanya owns Workspace lifecycle/recovery

Application coordinator
→ menghubungkan failure capability
  ke recovery Workspace
```

Coordinator harus menjamin:

```text
non-denied failure          → ignore
TENANT Workspace            → ignore
organizational denied       → recover exactly once
recovery sedang in-flight   → jangan duplicate
recovery exception          → report, jangan unhandled rejection
dispose                     → detach subscription
```

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/authorization/capability-workspace-recovery.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    CapabilityRuntime,
} from '@/platform/authorization';
import {
    isOrganizationalContextDeniedFailure,
    type WorkspaceContextRuntime,
} from '@/platform/workspace';

export type CapabilityRecoverySource =
    Pick<
        CapabilityRuntime,
        | 'getState'
        | 'subscribe'
    >;

export type WorkspaceRecoveryTarget =
    Pick<
        WorkspaceContextRuntime,
        | 'getState'
        | 'recoverStaleWorkspace'
    >;

export interface CapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinatorOptions {
    /*
     * Async recovery errors cannot be surfaced through a
     * React ErrorBoundary.
     *
     * Application composition therefore supplies an
     * explicit reporting boundary instead of allowing an
     * unhandled Promise rejection.
     */
    readonly reportFailure:
        (error: unknown) => void;
}

export interface CapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator {
    dispose():
        void;
}

export function createCapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator(
    capabilities:
        CapabilityRecoverySource,
    workspace:
        WorkspaceRecoveryTarget,
    options:
        CapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinatorOptions,
): CapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator {
    let disposed =
        false;

    let recoveryInFlight =
        false;

    const synchronize =
        (): void => {
            if (
                disposed
                || recoveryInFlight
            ) {
                return;
            }

            const capabilityState =
                capabilities.getState();

            if (
                capabilityState.status
                    !== 'unavailable'
            ) {
                return;
            }

            const failure =
                capabilityState.failure;

            /*
             * Invalid semantic projections use their own
             * failure kinds. Only canonical response
             * failures can represent the stable backend
             * ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED contract.
             */
            if (
                failure.kind
                    !== 'response'
                || ! isOrganizationalContextDeniedFailure(
                    failure,
                )
            ) {
                return;
            }

            const workspaceState =
                workspace.getState();

            /*
             * Workspace runtime deliberately rejects stale
             * recovery unless an organizational Workspace
             * is currently authoritative.
             *
             * Guard here as well so normal TENANT denial
             * cannot become an erroneous recovery attempt.
             */
            if (
                workspaceState.status
                    !== 'ready'
                || workspaceState.current.type
                    === 'TENANT'
            ) {
                return;
            }

            recoveryInFlight =
                true;

            void workspace
                .recoverStaleWorkspace(
                    failure,
                )
                .catch(
                    (
                        error:
                            unknown,
                    ) => {
                        options.reportFailure(
                            error,
                        );
                    },
                )
                .finally(
                    () => {
                        recoveryInFlight =
                            false;
                    },
                );
        };

    const unsubscribe =
        capabilities.subscribe(
            synchronize,
        );

    /*
     * Supporting an already-unavailable source makes this
     * coordinator deterministic regardless of construction
     * timing.
     *
     * In production it will normally be attached before any
     * Capability projection occurs.
     */
    synchronize();

    return {
        dispose() {
            if (
                disposed
            ) {
                return;
            }

            disposed =
                true;

            unsubscribe();
        },
    };
}
EOF
```

```bash
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
    vi,
} from 'vitest';

import type {
    CapabilityState,
} from '@/platform/authorization';
import {
    createCapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator,
    type CapabilityRecoverySource,
    type WorkspaceRecoveryTarget,
} from '@/app/authorization/capability-workspace-recovery';
import type {
    BrowserApiFailure,
} from '@/platform/api';
import type {
    CanonicalMembershipContext,
} from '@/platform/membership';
import type {
    WorkspaceContextState,
    WorkspaceSummary,
} from '@/platform/workspace';

const membershipId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab';

const tenantId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7bcd-8def-1234567890ab';

const organizationalAssignmentId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7cde-8def-1234567890ab';

const organizationId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7def-8def-1234567890ab';

const context:
    CanonicalMembershipContext = {
        membership: {
            id:
                membershipId,

            status:
                'ACTIVE',
        },

        tenant: {
            id:
                tenantId,

            name:
                'EduCore School',

            subdomain:
                'school',
        },
    };

const tenantWorkspace:
    WorkspaceSummary = {
        type:
            'TENANT',

        organizational_assignment_id:
            null,

        organization_id:
            null,

        organization_unit_id:
            null,

        label:
            'EduCore School',
    };

const organizationWorkspace:
    WorkspaceSummary = {
        type:
            'ORGANIZATION',

        organizational_assignment_id:
            organizationalAssignmentId,

        organization_id:
            organizationId,

        organization_unit_id:
            null,

        label:
            'EduCore Organization',
    };

const contextDeniedFailure:
    BrowserApiFailure = {
        ok:
            false,

        kind:
            'response',

        status:
            403,

        error: {
            status:
                'error',

            code:
                'ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED',

            message:
                'Organizational context is no longer available.',
        },
    };

const networkFailure:
    BrowserApiFailure = {
        ok:
            false,

        kind:
            'network',

        cause:
            new Error(
                'offline',
            ),
    };

function readyWorkspaceState(
    current:
        WorkspaceSummary,
): WorkspaceContextState {
    return {
        status:
            'ready',

        context,

        tenant: {
            id:
                tenantId,

            name:
                'EduCore School',
        },

        workspaces: [
            tenantWorkspace,
            organizationWorkspace,
        ],

        current,

        failure:
            null,
    };
}

interface ControlledCapabilitySource {
    readonly source:
        CapabilityRecoverySource;

    setState(
        state:
            CapabilityState,
    ): void;
}

function createCapabilitySource(
    initialState:
        CapabilityState = {
            status:
                'unresolved',
        },
): ControlledCapabilitySource {
    let state =
        initialState;

    const listeners =
        new Set<
            () => void
        >();

    return {
        source: {
            getState() {
                return state;
            },

            subscribe(
                listener,
            ) {
                listeners.add(
                    listener,
                );

                return () => {
                    listeners.delete(
                        listener,
                    );
                };
            },
        },

        setState(
            nextState,
        ) {
            state =
                nextState;

            for (
                const listener
                of listeners
            ) {
                listener();
            }
        },
    };
}

interface Deferred<Value> {
    readonly promise:
        Promise<Value>;

    resolve(
        value:
            Value,
    ): void;

    reject(
        reason:
            unknown,
    ): void;
}

function createDeferred<Value>():
    Deferred<Value> {
    let resolve:
        (
            value:
                Value,
        ) => void =
            () => {
                throw new Error(
                    'Deferred resolver is unavailable.',
                );
            };

    let reject:
        (
            reason:
                unknown,
        ) => void =
            () => {
                throw new Error(
                    'Deferred rejector is unavailable.',
                );
            };

    const promise =
        new Promise<Value>(
            (
                promiseResolve,
                promiseReject,
            ) => {
                resolve =
                    promiseResolve;

                reject =
                    promiseReject;
            },
        );

    return {
        promise,
        resolve,
        reject,
    };
}

function createWorkspaceRecoveryTarget(
    current:
        WorkspaceSummary,
    recover:
        (
            failure:
                BrowserApiFailure,
        ) => Promise<
            WorkspaceContextState
        >,
) {
    let state =
        readyWorkspaceState(
            current,
        );

    const recoveryCalls:
        BrowserApiFailure[] = [];

    const target:
        WorkspaceRecoveryTarget = {
        getState() {
            return state;
        },

        async recoverStaleWorkspace(
            failure,
        ) {
            recoveryCalls.push(
                failure,
            );

            const recovered =
                await recover(
                    failure,
                );

            state =
                recovered;

            return recovered;
        },
    };

    return {
        target,
        recoveryCalls,
    };
}

describe(
    'Capability Workspace recovery coordinator',
    () => {
        it('ignores capability failures that are not ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED', () => {
            const capabilities =
                createCapabilitySource();

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceRecoveryTarget(
                    organizationWorkspace,
                    async () =>
                        readyWorkspaceState(
                            tenantWorkspace,
                        ),
                );

            const reportFailure =
                vi.fn();

            const coordinator =
                createCapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator(
                    capabilities.source,
                    workspace.target,
                    {
                        reportFailure,
                    },
                );

            capabilities.setState({
                status:
                    'unavailable',

                failure:
                    networkFailure,
            });

            expect(
                workspace.recoveryCalls,
            ).toHaveLength(
                0,
            );

            expect(
                reportFailure,
            ).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

            coordinator.dispose();
        });

        it('ignores ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED while TENANT is already authoritative', () => {
            const capabilities =
                createCapabilitySource();

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceRecoveryTarget(
                    tenantWorkspace,
                    async () =>
                        readyWorkspaceState(
                            tenantWorkspace,
                        ),
                );

            const coordinator =
                createCapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator(
                    capabilities.source,
                    workspace.target,
                    {
                        reportFailure:
                            vi.fn(),
                    },
                );

            capabilities.setState({
                status:
                    'unavailable',

                failure:
                    contextDeniedFailure,
            });

            expect(
                workspace.recoveryCalls,
            ).toHaveLength(
                0,
            );

            coordinator.dispose();
        });

        it('routes organizational context denial to Workspace stale recovery exactly once while recovery is in flight', async () => {
            const capabilities =
                createCapabilitySource();

            const deferred =
                createDeferred<
                    WorkspaceContextState
                >();

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceRecoveryTarget(
                    organizationWorkspace,
                    () =>
                        deferred.promise,
                );

            const coordinator =
                createCapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator(
                    capabilities.source,
                    workspace.target,
                    {
                        reportFailure:
                            vi.fn(),
                    },
                );

            capabilities.setState({
                status:
                    'unavailable',

                failure:
                    contextDeniedFailure,
            });

            /*
             * A duplicate notification of the same denied
             * authority must not start a second recovery
             * while the first recovery still owns the
             * transition.
             */
            capabilities.setState({
                status:
                    'unavailable',

                failure:
                    contextDeniedFailure,
            });

            expect(
                workspace.recoveryCalls,
            ).toEqual([
                contextDeniedFailure,
            ]);

            deferred.resolve(
                readyWorkspaceState(
                    tenantWorkspace,
                ),
            );

            await deferred.promise;

            coordinator.dispose();
        });

        it('reports asynchronous Workspace recovery failures instead of creating an unhandled rejection', async () => {
            const capabilities =
                createCapabilitySource();

            const recoveryFailure =
                new Error(
                    'Workspace recovery failed.',
                );

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceRecoveryTarget(
                    organizationWorkspace,
                    async () => {
                        throw recoveryFailure;
                    },
                );

            const reportFailure =
                vi.fn();

            const coordinator =
                createCapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator(
                    capabilities.source,
                    workspace.target,
                    {
                        reportFailure,
                    },
                );

            capabilities.setState({
                status:
                    'unavailable',

                failure:
                    contextDeniedFailure,
            });

            await Promise.resolve();
            await Promise.resolve();

            expect(
                reportFailure,
            ).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(
                1,
            );

            expect(
                reportFailure,
            ).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
                recoveryFailure,
            );

            coordinator.dispose();
        });

        it('detaches from Capability lifecycle after disposal', () => {
            const capabilities =
                createCapabilitySource();

            const workspace =
                createWorkspaceRecoveryTarget(
                    organizationWorkspace,
                    async () =>
                        readyWorkspaceState(
                            tenantWorkspace,
                        ),
                );

            const coordinator =
                createCapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator(
                    capabilities.source,
                    workspace.target,
                    {
                        reportFailure:
                            vi.fn(),
                    },
                );

            coordinator.dispose();

            capabilities.setState({
                status:
                    'unavailable',

                failure:
                    contextDeniedFailure,
            });

            expect(
                workspace.recoveryCalls,
            ).toHaveLength(
                0,
            );
        });
    },
);
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### Coordinator hanya menghubungkan lifecycle

Tidak ada perubahan ke:

```text
CapabilityRuntime
WorkspaceRuntime
```

Ini menjaga dependency graph:

```text
platform/authorization ─┐
                        ├→ app coordinator
platform/workspace ─────┘
```

bukan:

```text
authorization
→ imports workspace recovery
```

Jadi platform modules tetap independen.

### Failure harus tetap canonical response failure

Capability state juga bisa gagal karena semantic validation seperti `scope-mismatch`. `Pasted text.txt`

Karena itu coordinator melakukan narrowing:

```ts
failure.kind === 'response'
```

baru memanggil:

```ts
isOrganizationalContextDeniedFailure(
    failure,
)
```

Helper Workspace sendiri memastikan:

```text
kind   = response
status = 403
code   = ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED
```

`Pasted text.txt`

Tidak ada string matching terhadap `message`.

### Recovery hanya ketika Workspace organizational

Workspace runtime memang sudah menolak recovery jika:

```text
state !== ready
atau
current.type === TENANT
```

`Pasted markdown.md`

Coordinator mengulang guard tersebut agar tidak memakai exception sebagai normal control flow.

### `recoveryInFlight` mencegah loop/duplikasi

Saat recovery dimulai:

```text
Workspace ready ORGANIZATION
→ recovering
→ Capability reset
→ discovery
→ Workspace TENANT ready
→ Capability tenant load
```

Banyak notification dapat terjadi di tengah lifecycle itu.

Boolean fence memastikan satu denied event tidak memulai beberapa `recoverStaleWorkspace()` secara bersamaan.

### Async failure tidak dibiarkan menjadi unhandled rejection

Karena callback subscription bukan async owner, kita wajib menangkap failure:

```ts
.catch(...)
```

Lalu menyerahkannya ke explicit:

```ts
reportFailure(error)
```

Pada FEI-8F.4B.2 kita akan menentukan concrete production reporter ketika coordinator dipasang ke `createApplicationRuntime()`.

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak `tenant` fixture, jangan cast. Kirim exact error karena berarti `WorkspaceDiscoveryTenant` generated shape berbeda dari `{ id, name }`.

Jika `failure.kind !== 'response'` tidak cukup untuk narrowing, jangan gunakan `as BrowserApiFailure`. Kita buat explicit type guard berdasarkan union canonical.

Jika test async reporter belum terpanggil setelah dua microtask, jangan menambah arbitrary timeout. Gunakan deferred Promise agar completion deterministic.

Jika duplicate test menghasilkan dua recovery calls, `recoveryInFlight` belum dipasang sebelum `recoverStaleWorkspace()` dipanggil dan itu blocker.

# Langkah Berikutnya

Jika hasilnya **5/5 + typecheck PASS**, kita lock:

```text
FEI-8F.4B.1 ✅
```

Lalu satu langkah berikutnya:

```text
FEI-8F.4B.2 - Application Runtime Recovery Integration
```

Di sana baru:

```text
createApplicationRuntime()
        ↓
create Capability runtime
        ↓
attach recovery coordinator
```

dan kita buktikan secara integration:

```text
ORGANIZATION ready
→ capability endpoint returns ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED
→ capability authority removed
→ Workspace recovery
→ TENANT ready
→ TENANT capability projection ready
```

Setelah recovery production benar-benar hidup, baru **FEI-8F.4C - Application Runtime Disposal Ownership**.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita hubungkan coordinator ke composition graph production:

```text
createApplicationRuntime()
        │
        ├─ WorkspaceRuntime
        │
        ├─ CapabilityRuntime
        │
        └─ CapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator
                     │
                     ▼
        ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED
                     │
                     ▼
        Workspace.recoverStaleWorkspace()
```

Integration test akan membuktikan lifecycle penuh:

```text
TENANT ready
    ↓
switch → ORGANIZATION
    ↓
Workspace verifier sukses
    ↓
ORGANIZATION committed
    ↓
active Capability projection
    ↓
403 ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED
    ↓
Coordinator
    ↓
Workspace recovering
    ↓
fresh /my-workspaces
    ↓
TENANT verified
    ↓
TENANT committed
    ↓
Capability auto-load
    ↓
TENANT Capability ready
```

Workspace capability response memang menggunakan scope `organization | organization_unit` dengan exact membership, tenant, assignment, organization, dan optional unit identifiers. `Pasted text.txt`

Kita **belum** membuat aggregate `ApplicationRuntime.dispose()` pada langkah ini. Itu tetap FEI-8F.4C.

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Update `frontend/src/app/runtime.ts`

Ganti isi file dengan:

```ts
import {
    createCapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator,
} from '@/app/authorization/capability-workspace-recovery';
import { createAppQueryClient } from '@/app/query-client';
import { createAppRouter } from '@/app/router';
import {
    createBrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserApiClient,
} from '@/platform/api';
import {
    createBrowserAuthOperations,
    createBrowserAuthRuntime,
    type BrowserAuthRuntime,
} from '@/platform/auth';
import {
    createCapabilityProjectionOperations,
    createCapabilityRuntime,
    createWorkspaceCapabilityVerifier,
    type CapabilityRuntime,
} from '@/platform/authorization';
import {
    createMembershipContextOperations,
    createMembershipContextRuntime,
    type MembershipContextRuntime,
} from '@/platform/membership';
import {
    createWorkspaceContextOperations,
    createWorkspaceContextRuntime,
    type WorkspaceContextRuntime,
} from '@/platform/workspace';

export interface ApplicationRuntime {
    apiClient:
        BrowserApiClient;

    auth:
        BrowserAuthRuntime;

    membership:
        MembershipContextRuntime;

    workspace:
        WorkspaceContextRuntime;

    capabilities:
        CapabilityRuntime;

    queryClient:
        ReturnType<
            typeof createAppQueryClient
        >;

    router:
        ReturnType<
            typeof createAppRouter
        >;
}

function reportApplicationRuntimeCoordinationFailure(
    error:
        unknown,
): void {
    /*
     * Cross-runtime recovery happens outside React render
     * and Effect execution, therefore an ErrorBoundary
     * cannot catch an asynchronous coordination failure.
     *
     * Do not include authentication credentials,
     * membership payloads, or capability projections in
     * this diagnostic.
     */
    console.error(
        'EduCore application runtime coordination failed.',
        error,
    );
}

export function createApplicationRuntime():
    ApplicationRuntime {
    const apiClient =
        createBrowserApiClient();

    const auth =
        createBrowserAuthRuntime(
            createBrowserAuthOperations(
                apiClient,
            ),
        );

    const membership =
        createMembershipContextRuntime(
            createMembershipContextOperations(
                apiClient,
            ),
            auth,
        );

    /*
     * Capability projection operations are deliberately
     * shared by both the stateless Workspace verifier and
     * the active Capability runtime.
     *
     * This keeps the dependency graph acyclic:
     *
     * operations
     *   ├─> Workspace verifier
     *   │       ↓
     *   │   Workspace runtime
     *   │       ↓
     *   └────> Capability runtime
     */
    const capabilityOperations =
        createCapabilityProjectionOperations(
            apiClient,
        );

    const workspaceVerifier =
        createWorkspaceCapabilityVerifier(
            capabilityOperations,
        );

    const workspace =
        createWorkspaceContextRuntime(
            createWorkspaceContextOperations(
                apiClient,
            ),
            membership,
            workspaceVerifier,
        );

    const capabilities =
        createCapabilityRuntime(
            capabilityOperations,
            membership,
            workspace,
        );

    /*
     * CapabilityRuntime owns capability authority while
     * WorkspaceRuntime owns organizational recovery.
     *
     * Application composition is therefore the correct
     * boundary for connecting a canonical stale
     * capability failure to Workspace recovery.
     *
     * Aggregate disposal ownership is deliberately
     * deferred to FEI-8F.4C. CapabilityRuntime disposal
     * currently clears its subscribers, which also
     * detaches this coordinator in existing tests.
     */
    createCapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator(
        capabilities,
        workspace,
        {
            reportFailure:
                reportApplicationRuntimeCoordinationFailure,
        },
    );

    return {
        apiClient,
        auth,
        membership,
        workspace,
        capabilities,

        queryClient:
            createAppQueryClient(),

        router:
            createAppRouter(),
    };
}
```

### Kenapa coordinator handle belum disimpan?

Sengaja.

Jangan membuat API sementara seperti:

```ts
runtime.recoveryCoordinator
```

hanya untuk membuangnya lagi pada fase disposal.

Pada FEI-8F.4C kita akan mengubah factory menjadi:

```text
create coordinator
      ↓
capture dalam closure
      ↓
ApplicationRuntime.dispose()
```

sehingga implementation detail coordinator tetap private.

```ts
                if (
                    switchedState.status

                    throw new Error(

                expect(
                    switchedState.current,
                ).toEqual(

                await waitFor(() => {
                    const workspaceState =
                        runtime.workspace
                            .getState();

                    expect(
                        workspaceState.status,

                    if (
                        workspaceState.status
                            !== 'ready'

                    }

                    expect(
                        workspaceState.current,

                    const capabilityState =
                        runtime.capabilities
                            .getState();

                    expect(

                        tenant_id:

                        membership_id:

                /*
                 * Initial discovery + stale recovery
                 * discovery prove that Workspace recovery
                 * actually reran canonical discovery.
                 */
                expect(
                    workspaceDiscoveryRequests,
                ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
                    2,
                );

                /*
                 * Exactly two organizational capability
                 * requests are expected:
                 *
                 * 1. target verification succeeds
                 * 2. active projection is denied
                 *
                 * Recovery itself deliberately falls back
                 * to TENANT and must not retry the stale
                 * organizational locator.
                 */
                expect(
                    workspaceCapabilityRequests,
                ).toBe(
                    2,
                );

                /*
                 * TENANT capability projection occurs
                 * during initial Workspace verification
                 * and again during/after stale recovery.
                 * The exact count is deliberately not an
                 * optimization contract because Workspace
                 * verification and CapabilityRuntime may
                 * independently project authority.
                 */
                expect(
                    tenantCapabilityRequests,
                ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
                    2,
                );
            } finally {
                runtime.capabilities
                    .dispose();

                runtime.workspace
                    .dispose();
            }
        });
    },
);
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Coordinator dibuat setelah kedua runtime tersedia

Urutan composition menjadi:

```text
Capability operations
        ↓
Workspace verifier
        ↓
Workspace runtime
        ↓
Capability runtime
        ↓
Recovery coordinator
```

Tidak ada cycle antar-module.

`platform/authorization` tidak perlu mengimpor recovery Workspace.

---

## 2. Recovery dipicu active projection, bukan target verification

Ini detail penting.

Request pertama:

```text
/workspace-capabilities
→ success
```

digunakan untuk:

```text
Workspace.switchWorkspace()
→ verify target
→ commit ORGANIZATION
```

Request kedua:

```text
/workspace-capabilities
→ ORGANIZATIONAL_CONTEXT_DENIED
```

berasal dari CapabilityRuntime setelah Workspace benar-benar committed.

Jadi test membuktikan masalah yang memang belum tertutup oleh Workspace verifier:

```text
Workspace valid ketika dipilih
↓
assignment kemudian stale/denied
↓
active capability read menemukan stale state
```

---

## 3. Tidak retry organizational locator

Setelah denial, Workspace recovery menggunakan discovery dengan:

```text
restoreHint:false
```

dan fallback TENANT. Workspace runtime memang sudah dirancang menghapus restoration hint dan tidak langsung mencoba assignment lama lagi. `Pasted text.txt`

Karena itu:

```ts
expect(
    workspaceCapabilityRequests,
).toBe(2);
```

merupakan loop-prevention assertion yang penting.

Kalau menjadi `3+`, kita harus investigasi stale retry.

---

## 4. Capability kembali otomatis

Coordinator hanya mengubah Workspace.

Ia **tidak** memanggil:

```ts
capabilities.refresh()
capabilities.bootstrap()
```

Setelah Workspace recovery:

```text
recovering
→ TENANT ready
```

Capability runtime mendapat notification Workspace dan menjalankan `load()` sendiri.

Itu menjaga single lifecycle ownership.

---

## 5. Production recovery error dilog tanpa sensitive context

Reporter:

```ts
console.error(
    'EduCore application runtime coordination failed.',
    error,
);
```

tidak mencatat:

```text
token
cookie
permission list
Membership payload
organizational assignment
```

Ini hanya fallback untuk unexpected cross-runtime orchestration failure.

Unit test 4B.1 sudah membuktikan async failure tidak menjadi unhandled rejection.

---

## 6. Disposal belum dilompati

Untuk test kita masih melakukan:

```ts
runtime.capabilities.dispose();
runtime.workspace.dispose();
```

karena `ApplicationRuntime.dispose()` memang belum ada.

Ini disengaja. Audit menunjukkan production entrypoint sekarang belum mempunyai disposal owner. `Pasted text.txt`

Kita akan menutupnya khusus pada FEI-8F.4C, bukan mencampurkannya ke recovery integration.

---

# Troubleshooting

Jika integration test gagal saat `switchWorkspace()` dan request kedua sudah langsung denied, cek `workspaceCapabilityRequests`. **Request pertama harus selalu success** karena itu verifier; denial baru boleh terjadi pada active Capability projection.

Jika final Workspace berhenti pada:

```text
recovering
```

cek `/my-workspaces` recovery request dan TENANT capability verifier response. Jangan menambah retry di coordinator.

Jika final Capability tetap:

```text
unresolved
```

padahal Workspace sudah TENANT `ready`, itu berarti CapabilityRuntime tidak mendapat notification atau target identity tidak resolve; jangan panggil `capabilities.refresh()` dari coordinator.

Jika `workspaceCapabilityRequests > 2`, itu potensial stale retry loop dan **jangan melonggarkan expectation**.

Jika `console.error` muncul pada happy-path integration test, recovery melempar exception dan harus diselesaikan sebelum lanjut.

Kita masuk ke gap lifecycle terakhir:

# FEI-8F.4C - Application Runtime Disposal Ownership

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Saat ini runtime production membentuk subscription graph:

```text
MembershipRuntime
      │
      ├────────────→ WorkspaceRuntime
      │                    │
      └────────────┐       │
                   ▼       ▼
              CapabilityRuntime
                     │
                     ▼
              RecoveryCoordinator
```

Maka teardown harus memiliki **satu owner** dan urutan deterministik:

```text
ApplicationRuntime.dispose()
        │
        ├─ 1. RecoveryCoordinator.dispose()
        ├─ 2. CapabilityRuntime.dispose()
        └─ 3. WorkspaceRuntime.dispose()
```

Urutan ini penting. Coordinator dilepas dahulu supaya teardown Capability/Workspace tidak dapat memicu cross-runtime recovery baru.

`dispose()` juga harus **idempotent**:

```ts
runtime.dispose();
runtime.dispose();
```

tetap hanya menjalankan child teardown satu kali.

Untuk entrypoint, kita akan membuat `main.tsx` memiliki React root secara eksplisit dan membersihkan root + runtime saat Vite HMR membuang module.

Kita **tidak** memasang `beforeunload`, `unload`, atau `pagehide`.

Alasannya:

- browser sendiri membuang JS realm pada normal document teardown;
- `unload`/`beforeunload` buruk untuk BFCache;
- `pagehide` juga bisa terjadi saat halaman masuk BFCache, sehingga disposal justru dapat merusak restoration/resume semantics.

```text
frontend/src/platform/authorization/*
frontend/src/platform/workspace/*
```

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Tambahkan aggregate `dispose()` ke `ApplicationRuntime`

Di:

```text
frontend/src/app/runtime.ts
```

tambahkan ke interface:

```ts
export interface ApplicationRuntime {
    apiClient:
        BrowserApiClient;

    auth:
        BrowserAuthRuntime;

    membership:
        MembershipContextRuntime;

    workspace:
        WorkspaceContextRuntime;

    capabilities:
        CapabilityRuntime;

    queryClient:
        ReturnType<
            typeof createAppQueryClient
        >;

    router:
        ReturnType<
            typeof createAppRouter
        >;

    dispose():
        void;
}
```

Kemudian bagian coordinator yang sekarang seperti ini:

```ts
createCapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator(
    capabilities,
    workspace,
    {
        reportFailure:
            reportApplicationRuntimeCoordinationFailure,
    },
);
```

ubah menjadi:

```ts
const recoveryCoordinator =
    createCapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator(
        capabilities,
        workspace,
        {
            reportFailure:
                reportApplicationRuntimeCoordinationFailure,
        },
    );

let disposed =
    false;

const dispose =
    (): void => {
        if (
            disposed
        ) {
            return;
        }

        disposed =
            true;

        /*
         * Detach cross-runtime orchestration before
         * disposing either source runtime.
         *
         * Capability teardown must not be able to trigger
         * a new Workspace recovery while application
         * ownership is being released.
         */
        recoveryCoordinator
            .dispose();

        /*
         * CapabilityRuntime subscribes to both Membership
         * and Workspace, so detach it before Workspace
         * releases its own upstream subscription.
         */
        capabilities
            .dispose();

        workspace
            .dispose();
    };
```

Lalu pada object `return`, tambahkan:

```ts
return {
    apiClient,
    auth,
    membership,
    workspace,
    capabilities,

    queryClient:
        createAppQueryClient(),

    router:
        createAppRouter(),

    dispose,
};
```

Jadi bagian akhir factory harus berbentuk:

```ts
const recoveryCoordinator =
    createCapabilityWorkspaceRecoveryCoordinator(
        capabilities,
        workspace,
        {
            reportFailure:
                reportApplicationRuntimeCoordinationFailure,
        },
    );

let disposed =
    false;

const dispose =
    (): void => {
        if (
            disposed
        ) {
            return;
        }

        disposed =
            true;

        recoveryCoordinator
            .dispose();

        capabilities
            .dispose();

        workspace
            .dispose();
    };

return {
    apiClient,
    auth,
    membership,
    workspace,
    capabilities,

    queryClient:
        createAppQueryClient(),

    router:
        createAppRouter(),

    dispose,
};
```

## 2. Tambahkan disposal contract test

Pada:

```text
frontend/src/app/__tests__/runtime.test.ts
```

pastikan import Vitest memiliki `vi`.

Contoh:

```ts
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
    vi,
} from 'vitest';
```

Lalu tambahkan test berikut di existing `describe(...)`:

```ts
it('owns idempotent disposal of composed long-lived runtimes', () => {
    const runtime =
        createApplicationRuntime();

    const capabilitiesDispose =
        vi.spyOn(
            runtime.capabilities,
            'dispose',
        );

    const workspaceDispose =
        vi.spyOn(
            runtime.workspace,
            'dispose',
        );

    runtime.dispose();

    expect(
        capabilitiesDispose,
    ).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(
        1,
    );

    expect(
        workspaceDispose,
    ).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(
        1,
    );

    /*
     * Application ownership is idempotent even though
     * individual child runtimes also protect themselves.
     *
     * This prevents accidental repeated teardown from
     * HMR or future mounting infrastructure.
     */
    runtime.dispose();

    expect(
        capabilitiesDispose,
    ).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(
        1,
    );

    expect(
        workspaceDispose,
    ).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(
        1,
    );
});
```

Jangan menguji private coordinator dengan mengeksposnya dari `ApplicationRuntime`.

Its implementation detail tetap private.

Coordinator sendiri sudah punya unit test bahwa `dispose()` melepaskan Capability subscription.

## 3. Jadikan `main.tsx` explicit lifecycle owner

Ganti:

```ts
createRoot(rootElement).render(
    <StrictMode>
        <AppBootstrap runtime={runtime} />
    </StrictMode>,
);
```

dengan:

```ts
const root =
    createRoot(
        rootElement,
    );

root.render(
    <StrictMode>
        <AppBootstrap
            runtime={runtime}
        />
    </StrictMode>,
);

/*
 * Normal browser document teardown releases the complete
 * JavaScript realm, so no unload/pagehide handler is
 * required.
 *
 * Vite HMR is different: this module can be disposed while
 * the document itself remains alive. Explicitly unmount
 * React first so Provider Effects abort their work, then
 * release long-lived platform subscriptions.
 */
if (
    import.meta.hot
) {
    import.meta.hot.dispose(
        () => {
            root.unmount();

            runtime.dispose();
        },
    );
}
```

Sehingga `main.tsx` lengkap menjadi:

```ts
import { StrictMode } from 'react';
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';

import { AppBootstrap } from '@/app/AppBootstrap';
import { createApplicationRuntime } from '@/app/runtime';

import './styles.css';

const rootElement =
    document.getElementById(
        'root',
    );

if (
    rootElement
        === null
) {
    throw new Error(
        'EduCore frontend root element was not found.',
    );
}

const runtime =
    createApplicationRuntime();

const root =
    createRoot(
        rootElement,
    );

root.render(
    <StrictMode>
        <AppBootstrap
            runtime={runtime}
        />
    </StrictMode>,
);

/*
 * Normal browser document teardown releases the complete
 * JavaScript realm, so no unload/pagehide handler is
 * required.
 *
 * Vite HMR is different: this module can be disposed while
 * the document itself remains alive. Explicitly unmount
 * React first so Provider Effects abort their work, then
 * release long-lived platform subscriptions.
 */
if (
    import.meta.hot
) {
    import.meta.hot.dispose(
        () => {
            root.unmount();

            runtime.dispose();
        },
    );
}
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. `ApplicationRuntime` menjadi aggregate lifecycle owner

Sebelumnya caller harus tahu:

```ts
runtime.capabilities.dispose();
runtime.workspace.dispose();
```

Itu membocorkan dependency ordering ke luar.

Sekarang:

```ts
runtime.dispose();
```

cukup.

Ini lebih dekat ke **Facade + Encapsulation**:

```text
caller
  ↓
ApplicationRuntime
  ↓
internal teardown graph
```

---

### 2. Coordinator dilepas paling awal

Kalau kita membalik:

```text
capabilities.dispose()
→ coordinator.dispose()
```

secara teori coordinator masih terdaftar sebagai Capability listener ketika child runtime sedang berubah.

Lebih aman:

```text
coordinator OFF
→ capability subscriptions OFF
→ workspace subscriptions OFF
```

---

### 3. Tidak memasukkan Auth/Membership dispose palsu

Saat ini:

```text
BrowserAuthRuntime
MembershipContextRuntime
```

tidak memiliki long-lived upstream subscriptions yang membutuhkan public `dispose()`.

Jangan membuat API hanya demi simetri.

Kita membersihkan resources yang memang memiliki explicit lifecycle ownership.

---

### 4. React cleanup dilakukan sebelum runtime cleanup

Pada HMR:

```text
root.unmount()
    ↓
BrowserAuth Provider Effect cleanup
Membership Provider Effect cleanup
Workspace Provider Effect cleanup
    ↓
abort in-flight lifecycle operations

runtime.dispose()
    ↓
detach long-lived runtime subscriptions
```

Ini lebih aman dibanding:

```text
runtime.dispose()
→ React masih mounted sesaat
```

---

### 5. Jangan gunakan React `useEffect(() => runtime.dispose())`

Ini sangat penting karena aplikasi memakai:

```tsx
<StrictMode>
```

Dalam development, StrictMode melakukan Effect setup/cleanup replay.

Jika `AppBootstrap` mempunyai:

```ts
useEffect(
    () => () => runtime.dispose(),
    [runtime],
);
```

maka development replay dapat:

```text
mount
→ effect
→ StrictMode cleanup
→ runtime permanently disposed
→ remount
```

Itu bug.

Karena itu aggregate lifetime dimiliki **entrypoint di luar React tree**.

---

### 6. Tidak menambahkan unload handler

Jangan tambahkan:

```ts
window.addEventListener(
    'beforeunload',
    ...
);

window.addEventListener(
    'unload',
    ...
);

window.addEventListener(
    'pagehide',
    ...
);
```

Selain tidak diperlukan untuk resource JS in-memory, ini dapat mengganggu browser lifecycle/BFCache dan bahkan berpotensi membersihkan Workspace restoration state pada saat yang salah.

Jika recovery integration gagal setelah penambahan dispose tetapi sebelum `runtime.dispose()` dipanggil, berarti composition berubah secara tidak sengaja.

# FEI-8 Final Integrity Audit

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Audit terakhir ini tidak menambah fitur.

Kita ingin memastikan seluruh Authorization/Capability Foundation yang dibangun dari FEI-8A sampai FEI-8F tetap memenuhi architecture contract secara menyeluruh:

```text
canonical backend authority
          ↓
Capability projection
          ↓
semantic validation
          ↓
Capability runtime
          ↓
React read bridge
```

dan:

```text
Membership
   ↓
Workspace
   ↓
Capability
```

tanpa muncul kembali shortcut seperti:

```text
membership.role
frontend role checks
raw permissions.includes()
raw authorization HTTP from app
bearer token in browser
organizational locator as authority
```

Audit ini juga akan menentukan apakah FEI-8 bisa benar-benar di-lock atau masih ada gap sebelum masuk ke permission decision layer.

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Audit ini mempunyai beberapa gate utama.

### Authority gate

Satu-satunya authority frontend harus berasal dari:

```text
CapabilityState.ready
└── projection
    └── permissions[]
```

Bukan dari:

```text
Membership role
Workspace type
organizational assignment
route name
UI assumption
```

Workspace menentukan **scope/context**, bukan authorization authority.

---

### Transport gate

Application layer tidak boleh tahu:

```text
/api/v1/core/authorization/*
X-EduCore-Membership-Id
X-EduCore-Organizational-Assignment-Id
```

secara raw.

Transport ownership harus tetap:

```text
platform/api
+
platform/authorization
+
platform/workspace
```

---

### Browser credential gate

Tidak boleh ada:

```text
Authorization: Bearer ...
localStorage token
sessionStorage token
```

Browser authentication authority tetap BrowserSession cookie, sedangkan canonical bearer credential tetap server-side.

---

### Dependency-direction gate

Yang legal:

```text
app
 ↓
platform
```

Yang tidak legal:

```text
platform
 ↓
app
```

Ini penting agar platform runtime tetap React-independent dan reusable.

---

### Lifecycle gate

Sekarang graph harus sudah utuh:

```text
initial load
→ Auth
→ Membership
→ Workspace
→ Capability
```

fresh context:

```text
login/switch
→ restoration disabled
→ TENANT baseline
```

stale context:

```text
organizational capability denied
→ Capability unavailable
→ coordinator
→ Workspace recovery
→ TENANT
→ Capability reload
```

teardown:

```text
HMR dispose
→ React unmount
→ ApplicationRuntime.dispose
```

---

# Troubleshooting

Jika `FORBID ROLE-BASED FRONTEND AUTHORITY` menemukan generated/generated-like contract references, jangan langsung hapus. Kita klasifikasikan apakah itu data model atau actual decision source.

Jika `console.error` hanya menemukan:

```ts
reportApplicationRuntimeCoordinationFailure()
```

itu expected. Logging tersebut adalah explicit async recovery error boundary dan tidak mengandung credentials.

Jika grep `organizational_assignment_id.*authoriz` menemukan komentar atau type names, kita cek konteks. Yang dilarang adalah menggunakannya **sebagai authority**, bukan keberadaan locator.

Jika unsafe-type grep menemukan sesuatu di existing historical code di luar FEI-8 scope, jangan refactor massal. Kita tentukan apakah itu memengaruhi boundary yang sedang di-lock.

```text
   atau app/authorization?

   workspace readiness

   permission denied?

9. Apa existing router/layout/component structure yang akan
   menjadi consumer pertama?

10. Apakah sudah ada role/permission shortcut legacy yang
    perlu dimigrasikan?
```

Prinsip yang akan kita pertahankan:

```text
Backend = authority source
Capability Runtime = canonical frontend authority snapshot
Decision layer = interpretation
UI / Router = consumer
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Ada satu keputusan penting yang **belum boleh kita asumsikan**: apakah decision API cukup mengembalikan `boolean`.

Contoh sederhana:

```ts
can('student.read')
```

memang nyaman, tetapi empat lifecycle state ini berbeda:

```text
unresolved
loading
unavailable
ready tetapi permission tidak ada
```

Kalau semuanya langsung menjadi:

```text
false
```

itu aman secara authorization karena fail-closed, tetapi UI kehilangan informasi apakah:

```text
user memang denied
atau
authority belum selesai dimuat
atau
backend sedang unavailable
```

Karena itu audit kemungkinan akan membawa kita ke dua layer:

```text
low-level decision:
evaluatePermission(...)
→ rich result

ergonomic UI:
can(...)
→ boolean fail-closed
```

Tetapi kita belum mengunci desain sebelum melihat actual consumers.

Hal kedua: UI idealnya **tidak menyebarkan** kode seperti:

```ts
capability.projection
    .permissions
    .includes(
        'student.read',
    );
```

ke banyak component.

Jika itu dibiarkan, authorization semantics tersebar dan sulit diubah.

Target arsitektur kemungkinan:

```text
Capability projection
       ↓
Decision service/functions
       ↓
Authorization hook
       ↓
Route/UI consumer
```

bukan:

```text
Component A → permissions.includes()
Component B → permissions.includes()
Component C → permissions.includes()
```

---

```text
2. Apakah nama permission runtime-only string?

3. Apakah ada decision helper existing?

4. Apakah ada raw permissions[] consumer production?

5. Apakah ada role-based authorization production?

6. Apa actual Router architecture?

7. Apa route pertama yang nantinya cocok menjadi guard target?

8. Apa state yang tampil saat:
   - auth unresolved
   - membership unresolved
   - workspace unresolved
   - capability unresolved/loading
   - capability unavailable
   - permission denied

9. Haruskah decision layer tinggal di platform atau app?

10. Perlukah richer AuthorizationDecision contract?

11. Apakah route guard harus berupa loader,
    component boundary,
    atau kombinasi?

12. Apa minimum scope FEI-9B?
```

FEI-9A **✅ COMPLETE / LOCKED**.

Audit memberi boundary yang sangat jelas. `PermissionName` bukan frontend enum; ia berasal langsung dari OpenAPI dan saat ini adalah canonical non-empty `string`. `Pasted text.txt`  Tidak ada production consumer `permissions[]`, tidak ada role-based authorization, tidak ada capability-ready consumer, dan router masih hanya `/` + `*`, jadi belum ada alasan membuat fake protected route. `Pasted text.txt`

ADR-027 juga sudah mengunci semantics yang harus kita ikuti: runtime authorization vocabulary hanya canonical `permissions[]`; primitive konseptualnya `has`, `hasAll`, `hasAny`; matching harus **exact**, bukan wildcard/prefix; dan `is_global_superadmin` **tidak boleh menjadi frontend bypass**.  Permission evaluation setelah projection READY harus synchronous/pure, idealnya memakai internal `ReadonlySet<PermissionName>` untuk menghindari repeated linear scans. 

Karena ADR juga membedakan capability-loading dari actual permission denial pada route UX, lifecycle interpretation tidak boleh dicampur ke primitive ini. 

Jadi kita lanjut hanya ke:

# FEI-9B - Pure Permission Decision Primitive

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita bangun layer React-independent:

```text
validated Capability projection
          ↓
createPermissionEvaluator()
          ↓
internal permission Set snapshot
          ↓
has()
hasAll()
hasAny()
```

Boundary sengaja menerima **validated `CapabilityProjectionData`**, bukan seluruh `CapabilityState`.

Artinya:

```text
unresolved/loading/unavailable
```

belum menjadi concern FEI-9B. Nanti FEI-9C akan menerjemahkan lifecycle itu menjadi authorization UX seperti `pending`, `unavailable`, `denied`, atau `allowed`.

Dengan demikian tidak ada risiko primitive ini menyamakan:

```text
authority belum ready
```

dengan:

```text
authority ready + permission absent
```

### Contract yang kita lock

```ts
interface PermissionEvaluator {
    has(permission): boolean;
    hasAll(permissions): boolean;
    hasAny(permissions): boolean;
}
```

Semantics:

```text
has("x")
→ exact match only

hasAll([])
→ true

hasAny([])
→ false

is_global_superadmin=true
+ permission absent
→ false

future unknown backend permissions
→ harmless
```

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. `permission-evaluator.ts`

Buat:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/authorization/permission-evaluator.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    PermissionName,
} from '@/platform/authorization/contract';
import type {
    CapabilityProjectionData,
} from '@/platform/authorization/state';

export interface PermissionEvaluator {
    /*
     * Exact canonical permission matching only.
     *
     * Frontend does not implement wildcard, prefix,
     * hierarchy, role inheritance, or superadmin bypass.
     */
    has(
        permission:
            PermissionName,
    ): boolean;

    hasAll(
        permissions:
            readonly PermissionName[],
    ): boolean;

    hasAny(
        permissions:
            readonly PermissionName[],
    ): boolean;
}

export function createPermissionEvaluator(
    projection:
        CapabilityProjectionData,
): PermissionEvaluator {
    /*
     * Take an immutable-by-ownership snapshot rather than
     * repeatedly scanning projection.permissions.
     *
     * The Set itself remains private so consumers cannot
     * mutate authorization authority through this API.
     */
    const permissions =
        new Set<
            PermissionName
        >(
            projection.permissions,
        );

    const has =
        (
            permission:
                PermissionName,
        ): boolean =>
            permissions.has(
                permission,
            );

    return {
        has,

        hasAll(
            requiredPermissions,
        ) {
            /*
             * No required permission means there is no
             * permission restriction at this evaluation
             * boundary.
             */
            return requiredPermissions
                .every(
                    has,
                );
        },

        hasAny(
            requiredPermissions,
        ) {
            /*
             * An empty ANY requirement cannot be satisfied.
             */
            return requiredPermissions
                .some(
                    has,
                );
        },
    };
}
EOF
```
