Buat:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/authorization/__tests__/permission-evaluator.test.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    createPermissionEvaluator,
    type CapabilityProjectionData,
} from '@/platform/authorization';

const studentsView =
    'academic.students.view';

const gradesWrite =
    'academic.grades.write';

const roomsManage =
    'dormitory.rooms.manage';

function createTenantProjection(
    permissions:
        string[],
    isGlobalSuperadmin =
        false,
): CapabilityProjectionData {
    return {
        scope: {
            type:
                'tenant',

            tenant_id:
                '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab',

            membership_id:
                '018f3b6a-7c20-7bcd-8def-1234567890ab',
        },

        is_global_superadmin:
            isGlobalSuperadmin,

        permissions,
    };
}

function createWorkspaceProjection(
    permissions:
        string[],
): CapabilityProjectionData {
    return {
        scope: {
            type:
                'organization',

            tenant_id:
                '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab',

            membership_id:
                '018f3b6a-7c20-7bcd-8def-1234567890ab',

            organizational_assignment_id:
                '018f3b6a-7c20-7cde-8def-1234567890ab',

            organization_id:
                '018f3b6a-7c20-7def-8def-1234567890ab',

            organization_unit_id:
                null,
        },

        is_global_superadmin:
            false,

        permissions,
    };
}

describe(
    'Permission evaluator',
    () => {
        it('matches canonical permission names exactly', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createPermissionEvaluator(
                    createTenantProjection([
                        studentsView,
                        gradesWrite,
                    ]),
                );

            expect(
                evaluator.has(
                    studentsView,
                ),
            ).toBe(
                true,
            );

            expect(
                evaluator.has(
                    'academic.students',
                ),
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );

            expect(
                evaluator.has(
                    'academic.*',
                ),
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );
        });

        it('requires every permission for hasAll', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createPermissionEvaluator(
                    createTenantProjection([
                        studentsView,
                        gradesWrite,
                    ]),
                );

            expect(
                evaluator.hasAll([
                    studentsView,
                    gradesWrite,
                ]),
            ).toBe(
                true,
            );

            expect(
                evaluator.hasAll([
                    studentsView,
                    roomsManage,
                ]),
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );
        });

        it('requires at least one permission for hasAny', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createPermissionEvaluator(
                    createTenantProjection([
                        studentsView,
                    ]),
                );

            expect(
                evaluator.hasAny([
                    roomsManage,
                    studentsView,
                ]),
            ).toBe(
                true,
            );

            expect(
                evaluator.hasAny([
                    roomsManage,
                    gradesWrite,
                ]),
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );
        });

        it('uses explicit empty requirement semantics', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createPermissionEvaluator(
                    createTenantProjection([]),
                );

            expect(
                evaluator.hasAll([]),
            ).toBe(
                true,
            );

            expect(
                evaluator.hasAny([]),
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );
        });

        it('does not treat is_global_superadmin as a permission bypass', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createPermissionEvaluator(
                    createTenantProjection(
                        [],
                        true,
                    ),
                );

            expect(
                evaluator.has(
                    studentsView,
                ),
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );

            expect(
                evaluator.hasAll([
                    studentsView,
                ]),
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );

            expect(
                evaluator.hasAny([
                    studentsView,
                ]),
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );
        });

        it('uses the same permission semantics for organizational capability projections', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createPermissionEvaluator(
                    createWorkspaceProjection([
                        roomsManage,
                    ]),
                );

            expect(
                evaluator.has(
                    roomsManage,
                ),
            ).toBe(
                true,
            );

            expect(
                evaluator.has(
                    studentsView,
                ),
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );
        });

        it('takes a permission snapshot instead of observing later projection mutation', () => {
            const projection =
                createTenantProjection([
                    studentsView,
                ]);

            const evaluator =
                createPermissionEvaluator(
                    projection,
                );

            projection.permissions.push(
                gradesWrite,
            );

            expect(
                evaluator.has(
                    studentsView,
                ),
            ).toBe(
                true,
            );

            expect(
                evaluator.has(
                    gradesWrite,
                ),
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );
        });

        it('does not let unrelated future backend permissions grant known frontend requirements', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createPermissionEvaluator(
                    createTenantProjection([
                        'future.module.permission',
                    ]),
                );

            expect(
                evaluator.has(
                    studentsView,
                ),
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Kenapa primitive tinggal di `platform/authorization`

Ini pure authorization interpretation:

```text
Capability projection
→ exact permission membership
```

Ia tidak mengenal:

```text
React
Router
navigation
buttons
pages
loading UI
```

Jadi tempat yang tepat adalah:

```text
platform/authorization
```

bukan `app`.

ADR juga secara eksplisit menyatakan permission evaluation setelah projection READY harus synchronous dan deterministic, tanpa hidden network call. 

---

### 2. Kenapa tidak menerima `CapabilityState`

Kalau kita menulis:

```ts
hasPermission(
    state,
    permission,
): boolean
```

maka:

```text
unresolved  → false
loading     → false
unavailable → false
ready denied→ false
```

semuanya hilang menjadi satu boolean.

Padahal ADR mengunci direct-route behavior:

```text
Capability loading
→ jangan render protected route
→ jangan langsung unauthorized

Capability READY + permission absent
→ ACCESS DENIED
```

Jadi primitive ini hanya menerima **projection yang sudah READY**.

FEI-9C yang akan memegang lifecycle semantics.

---

### 3. Kenapa internal `Set`

Tanpa evaluator:

```ts
permissions.includes(...)
```

akan tersebar ke semua consumer dan setiap check menjadi linear scan.

Dengan:

```text
projection
→ Set once
→ O(1)-average lookup
```

serta satu vocabulary API:

```text
has
hasAll
hasAny
```

Ini juga persis arah yang direkomendasikan ADR-027. 

---

### 4. `Set` sengaja tidak diekspos

Walaupun kita bisa mendeklarasikan:

```ts
ReadonlySet<PermissionName>
```

JavaScript object di baliknya tetap `Set`.

Daripada membuka:

```ts
evaluator.permissions
```

kita simpan sebagai closure private.

Consumer hanya bisa bertanya:

```text
has?
hasAll?
hasAny?
```

dan tidak bisa mengubah snapshot.

---

### 5. `is_global_superadmin` tidak dipakai

ADR-027 sangat eksplisit: flag tersebut bukan frontend authorization bypass. 

Maka implementation bahkan tidak membaca:

```ts
projection.is_global_superadmin
```

Permission authority tetap hanya:

```text
projection.permissions[]
```

---

### 6. Exact matching, tanpa wildcard

Tidak ada:

```ts
startsWith()
endsWith()
split('.')
RegExp
```

Hanya:

```ts
permissions.has(permission)
```

Jadi:

```text
academic.students.view ≠ academic.students
academic.students.view ≠ academic.*
```

Ini sesuai ADR canonical permission semantics. 

---

### 7. Unknown future permission aman

Backend mungkin nanti mengirim permission baru yang frontend versi sekarang belum mengenal. ADR mengatakan frontend tidak boleh crash atau memperlakukannya sebagai wildcard. 

Internal Set secara natural memenuhi itu:

```text
future.permission
```

hanya menjadi entry lain, tidak memberikan permission yang tidak diminta.

# Troubleshooting

Jika `permissions: string[]` pada fixture ditolak karena `PermissionName` ternyata lebih sempit dalam generated TypeScript, jangan cast. Ubah helper menjadi:

```ts
permissions:
    PermissionName[]
```

dan import canonical `PermissionName`.

Jika test mutation:

```ts
projection.permissions.push(...)
```

ditolak karena generated array menjadi readonly, itu justru baik. Kita sesuaikan test untuk membuktikan snapshot dengan mutable source fixture tanpa unsafe cast.

Jika grep `NO ROLE / SUPERADMIN BYPASS` menemukan kata `superadmin` hanya di komentar, itu bukan blocker; yang penting implementation tidak membaca flag tersebut.

# FEI-9C - Authorization Lifecycle Decision Model

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

FEI-9B menjawab:

```text
"Apakah permission X ada?"
```

FEI-9C menjawab pertanyaan yang lebih tinggi:

```text
"Bagaimana status authorization saat ini?"
```

Kita harus menjaga empat keadaan berbeda:

```text
Capability unresolved
        ↓
PENDING

Capability loading
        ↓
PENDING

Capability unavailable
        ↓
UNAVAILABLE

Capability ready
        ↓
evaluate permission
        ├── satisfied → ALLOWED
        └── absent    → DENIED
```

Yang **tidak boleh** terjadi:

```text
unresolved
loading
unavailable
permission absent
        ↓
semuanya false / denied
```

karena itu akan menyebabkan route/UI salah menampilkan `Access Denied` ketika authority sebenarnya belum siap.

ADR-027 sendiri sudah mengunci exact permission matching dan primitive `has`, `hasAll`, `hasAny`; frontend juga tidak boleh menggunakan role atau `is_global_superadmin` sebagai bypass. 

### Desain yang kita gunakan

Kita membuat evaluator lifecycle sekali:

```text
CapabilityState
      ↓
createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator()
      ↓
internal PermissionEvaluator snapshot jika READY
      ↓
evaluate(requirement)
      ↓
AuthorizationDecision
```

Dengan begitu, bila satu navigation tree mengevaluasi banyak permission:

```text
Capability projection
→ Set dibuat sekali
→ banyak decision
```

bukan Set baru untuk setiap menu/button.

## 1. `frontend/src/platform/authorization/decision.ts`

Buat:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/authorization/decision.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    PermissionName,
} from '@/platform/authorization/contract';
import {
    createPermissionEvaluator,
    type PermissionEvaluator,
} from '@/platform/authorization/permission-evaluator';
import type {
    CapabilityState,
    CapabilityStateFailure,
} from '@/platform/authorization/state';

export type PermissionRequirement =
    | {
        readonly mode:
            'single';

        readonly permission:
            PermissionName;
    }
    | {
        readonly mode:
            'all';

        readonly permissions:
            readonly PermissionName[];
    }
    | {
        readonly mode:
            'any';

        readonly permissions:
            readonly PermissionName[];
    };

export interface PendingAuthorizationDecision {
    readonly status:
        'pending';

    /*
     * Preserve whether authority has not started resolving
     * yet or is actively loading.
     *
     * Both remain fail-closed for protected content, but
     * neither represents an authorization denial.
     */
    readonly capabilityStatus:
        | 'unresolved'
        | 'loading';
}

export interface UnavailableAuthorizationDecision {
    readonly status:
        'unavailable';

    readonly failure:
        CapabilityStateFailure;
}

export interface AllowedAuthorizationDecision {
    readonly status:
        'allowed';
}

export interface DeniedAuthorizationDecision {
    readonly status:
        'denied';
}

export type AuthorizationDecision =
    | PendingAuthorizationDecision
    | UnavailableAuthorizationDecision
    | AllowedAuthorizationDecision
    | DeniedAuthorizationDecision;

export interface AuthorizationDecisionEvaluator {
    evaluate(
        requirement:
            PermissionRequirement,
    ): AuthorizationDecision;
}

function evaluateReadyRequirement(
    evaluator:
        PermissionEvaluator,
    requirement:
        PermissionRequirement,
): boolean {
    switch (
        requirement.mode
    ) {
        case 'single':
            return evaluator.has(
                requirement.permission,
            );

        case 'all':
            return evaluator.hasAll(
                requirement.permissions,
            );

        case 'any':
            return evaluator.hasAny(
                requirement.permissions,
            );
    }
}

export function createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator(
    state:
        CapabilityState,
): AuthorizationDecisionEvaluator {
    switch (
        state.status
    ) {
        case 'unresolved': {
            const decision:
                PendingAuthorizationDecision = {
                    status:
                        'pending',

                    capabilityStatus:
                        'unresolved',
                };

            return {
                evaluate() {
                    return decision;
                },
            };
        }

        case 'loading': {
            const decision:
                PendingAuthorizationDecision = {
                    status:
                        'pending',

                    capabilityStatus:
                        'loading',
                };

            return {
                evaluate() {
                    return decision;
                },
            };
        }

        case 'unavailable': {
            const decision:
                UnavailableAuthorizationDecision = {
                    status:
                        'unavailable',

                    failure:
                        state.failure,
                };

            return {
                evaluate() {
                    return decision;
                },
            };
        }

        case 'ready': {
            /*
             * Build the permission lookup snapshot once for
             * this READY capability state.
             *
             * Many navigation, route, and action decisions
             * can then share the same evaluator without
             * repeatedly scanning permissions[].
             */
            const permissionEvaluator =
                createPermissionEvaluator(
                    state.projection,
                );

            return {
                evaluate(
                    requirement,
                ) {
                    return evaluateReadyRequirement(
                        permissionEvaluator,
                        requirement,
                    )
                        ? {
                            status:
                                'allowed',
                        }
                        : {
                            status:
                                'denied',
                        };
                },
            };
        }
    }
}
EOF
```

## 3. `decision.test.ts`

Buat:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/authorization/__tests__/decision.test.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator,
    type CapabilityProjectionData,
    type CapabilityState,
    type PermissionRequirement,
} from '@/platform/authorization';

const studentsView =
    'academic.students.view';

const gradesWrite =
    'academic.grades.write';

const roomsManage =
    'dormitory.rooms.manage';

const studentsRequirement:
    PermissionRequirement = {
        mode:
            'single',

        permission:
            studentsView,
    };

function createTenantProjection(
    permissions:
        string[],
    isGlobalSuperadmin =
        false,
): CapabilityProjectionData {
    return {
        scope: {
            type:
                'tenant',

            tenant_id:
                '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab',

            membership_id:
                '018f3b6a-7c20-7bcd-8def-1234567890ab',
        },

        is_global_superadmin:
            isGlobalSuperadmin,

        permissions,
    };
}

function readyState(
    permissions:
        string[],
    isGlobalSuperadmin =
        false,
): CapabilityState {
    return {
        status:
            'ready',

        projection:
            createTenantProjection(
                permissions,
                isGlobalSuperadmin,
            ),
    };
}

describe(
    'Authorization decision evaluator',
    () => {
        it('keeps unresolved capability authority pending instead of denying access', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator({
                    status:
                        'unresolved',
                });

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate(
                    studentsRequirement,
                ),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'pending',

                capabilityStatus:
                    'unresolved',
            });
        });

        it('keeps loading capability authority pending instead of denying access', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator({
                    status:
                        'loading',
                });

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate(
                    studentsRequirement,
                ),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'pending',

                capabilityStatus:
                    'loading',
            });
        });

        it('preserves unavailable capability failure instead of converting it to permission denial', () => {
            const failure = {
                ok:
                    false as const,

                kind:
                    'network' as const,

                cause:
                    new Error(
                        'offline',
                    ),
            };

            const evaluator =
                createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator({
                    status:
                        'unavailable',

                    failure,
                });

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate(
                    studentsRequirement,
                ),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unavailable',

                failure,
            });
        });

        it('allows a ready capability with the exact required permission', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator(
                    readyState([
                        studentsView,
                    ]),
                );

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate(
                    studentsRequirement,
                ),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'allowed',
            });
        });

        it('denies a ready capability when the exact required permission is absent', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator(
                    readyState([
                        gradesWrite,
                    ]),
                );

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate(
                    studentsRequirement,
                ),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'denied',
            });
        });

        it('supports ALL permission requirements with explicit empty semantics', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator(
                    readyState([
                        studentsView,
                        gradesWrite,
                    ]),
                );

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate({
                    mode:
                        'all',

                    permissions: [
                        studentsView,
                        gradesWrite,
                    ],
                }),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'allowed',
            });

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate({
                    mode:
                        'all',

                    permissions: [
                        studentsView,
                        roomsManage,
                    ],
                }),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'denied',
            });

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate({
                    mode:
                        'all',

                    permissions:
                        [],
                }),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'allowed',
            });
        });

        it('supports ANY permission requirements with explicit empty semantics', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator(
                    readyState([
                        studentsView,
                    ]),
                );

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate({
                    mode:
                        'any',

                    permissions: [
                        roomsManage,
                        studentsView,
                    ],
                }),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'allowed',
            });

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate({
                    mode:
                        'any',

                    permissions: [
                        roomsManage,
                        gradesWrite,
                    ],
                }),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'denied',
            });

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate({
                    mode:
                        'any',

                    permissions:
                        [],
                }),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'denied',
            });
        });

        it('never treats global superadmin metadata as an authorization bypass', () => {
            const evaluator =
                createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator(
                    readyState(
                        [],
                        true,
                    ),
                );

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate(
                    studentsRequirement,
                ),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'denied',
            });
        });

        it('retains the READY permission snapshot used when the decision evaluator was created', () => {
            const state =
                readyState([
                    studentsView,
                ]);

            if (
                state.status
                    !== 'ready'
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    'Expected READY capability fixture.',
                );
            }

            const evaluator =
                createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator(
                    state,
                );

            state.projection
                .permissions
                .push(
                    gradesWrite,
                );

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate(
                    studentsRequirement,
                ),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'allowed',
            });

            expect(
                evaluator.evaluate({
                    mode:
                        'single',

                    permission:
                        gradesWrite,
                }),
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'denied',
            });
        });
    },
);
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. `pending !== denied`

Ini invariant terpenting FEI-9C.

```text
unresolved/loading
```

berarti:

```text
authorization truth belum tersedia
```

bukan:

```text
user tidak punya permission
```

ADR-027 secara eksplisit mengatakan direct protected route saat capability masih loading tidak boleh langsung diarahkan menjadi unauthorized. 

---

### 2. `unavailable !== denied`

Misalnya:

```text
network failure
protocol failure
scope mismatch
```

adalah failure mendapatkan authority.

Itu berbeda dari:

```text
Capability READY
+
permission absent
```

Karena itu failure tetap dibawa:

```ts
{
    status: 'unavailable',
    failure,
}
```

Nanti UX dapat menampilkan controlled retry/error state tanpa mengklaim user memang tidak authorized.

---

### 3. Hanya READY boleh menghasilkan `allowed` atau `denied`

Invariant:

```text
CapabilityState.ready
        ↓
PermissionEvaluator
        ↓
allowed / denied
```

State lain tidak pernah masuk evaluator.

Dengan demikian tidak ada authority yang "diciptakan" saat capability belum canonical READY.

---

### 4. Permission Set dibangun sekali

FEI-9B sudah menyediakan efficient snapshot evaluator.

FEI-9C tidak melakukan:

```ts
createPermissionEvaluator(...)
```

pada setiap `evaluate()`.

Ia hanya melakukan saat factory menerima:

```text
CapabilityState.ready
```

Jadi:

```text
1 Capability state
→ 1 permission Set
→ N authorization decisions
```

Ini sesuai arahan ADR bahwa permission evaluation seharusnya pure dan memakai efficient immutable lookup representation. 

---

### 5. Decision model tidak mengenal React atau router

File ini tidak tahu:

```text
Navigate
loader
Component
button
sidebar
useMemo
useEffect
```

Ia hanya menerjemahkan:

```text
Capability lifecycle
+
Permission requirement
→ Authorization decision
```

Jadi tetap reusable untuk:

```text
React hook
route guard
navigation evaluator
action evaluator
tests
```

---

### 6. Requirement adalah explicit union

Daripada API ambigu seperti:

```ts
can(['a', 'b'])
```

yang tidak jelas apakah `ALL` atau `ANY`, contract sekarang eksplisit:

```ts
{
    mode: 'single',
    permission: '...'
}
```

atau:

```ts
{
    mode: 'all',
    permissions: [...]
}
```

atau:

```ts
{
    mode: 'any',
    permissions: [...]
}
```

Ini mengurangi authorization bug akibat implicit semantics.

---

### 7. Tidak ada superadmin bypass

ADR-027 menyatakan frontend tidak boleh melakukan:

```ts
if (isGlobalSuperadmin) {
    return true;
}
```

FEI-9C hanya menggunakan FEI-9B evaluator, sehingga flag tersebut tetap tidak berpartisipasi dalam decision.

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak:

```ts
false as const
```

pada failure fixture, ganti fixture dengan explicit:

```ts
const failure:
    BrowserApiFailure = {
        ...
    };
```

dan import canonical `BrowserApiFailure`. Jangan gunakan cast ke union.

Jika mutation test ditolak karena generated `permissions` menjadi readonly, jangan gunakan unsafe cast. Kita akan buat mutable input sebelum memasukkannya ke projection fixture.

Jika grep menemukan `membership_id` karena scope fixture/test, itu bukan role-based authorization. Gate hanya implementation `decision.ts`.

Jika TypeScript mempermasalahkan `evaluateReadyRequirement()` tidak mempunyai final return, jangan tambahkan default `return false`. Itu bisa membuat future union mode fail-open/fail-silent. Kirim compiler error dan kita gunakan explicit exhaustive `never` guard.

# Langkah Berikutnya

Jika **9/9 + seluruh gate bersih**, maka:

```text
FEI-9B ✅ Permission Evaluation Primitive
FEI-9C ✅ Authorization Lifecycle Decision Model
```

Baru setelah itu kita masuk:

```text
FEI-9D - React Authorization Decision Hook
```

React layer nanti hanya:

```text
useCapabilityState()
        ↓
memoized AuthorizationDecisionEvaluator
        ↓
useAuthorizationDecision(requirement)
```

tanpa network request, tanpa role checks, tanpa route redirect.

Route guard tetap **belum** dibuat sampai hook tersebut terbukti benar secara isolated.

Langkah berikutnya tetap isolated dari router: kita tambahkan **React decision hook** yang hanya mengadaptasi `useCapabilityState()` ke evaluator FEI-9C, tanpa network, redirect, role logic, atau side effect.

> **Designing the hook**
>
> I’m shaping the React hook around the existing capability-state reader and evaluator, while checking memoization and rerender behavior. I’m weighing per-hook evaluators against shared context so the implementation stays simple and efficient.

>
> 
>
> **Implementing and testing**

FEI-9C **✅ COMPLETE / LOCKED**.

Current foundation is now:

```text
FEI-9A ✅ Authorization Consumption Audit
FEI-9B ✅ Pure Permission Evaluator
FEI-9C ✅ Authorization Lifecycle Decision Model

FEI-9D ← React Authorization Decision Hook
```

FEI-9C correctly preserves the distinction required by ADR-027: capability loading must not be interpreted as unauthorized, while `READY + missing permission` is a genuine UX denial. 

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Sekarang kita membuat adapter React yang sangat tipis:

```text
CapabilityContextProvider
        ↓
useCapabilityState()
        ↓
useAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator()
        ↓
useAuthorizationDecision(requirement)
        ↓
pending / unavailable / allowed / denied
```

Hook **tidak** boleh memiliki:

```text
HTTP
bootstrap()
refresh()
redirect()
Navigate
router knowledge
role checks
superadmin bypass
permissions.includes(...)
```

Lifecycle authority tetap berasal dari Capability runtime.

Permission semantics tetap berasal dari FEI-9B/9C.

React hanya menghubungkan keduanya.

Ada dua hook:

```ts
useAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator()
```

untuk consumer yang perlu mengevaluasi banyak requirement terhadap snapshot capability yang sama, misalnya navigation catalog.

Dan convenience hook:

```ts
useAuthorizationDecision(requirement)
```

untuk satu action/route requirement.

Ini juga selaras dengan ADR-027 bahwa permission evaluation setelah capability READY harus synchronous dan tidak melakukan hidden network calls.

## 1. `useAuthorizationDecision.ts`

Buat:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/authorization/useAuthorizationDecision.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    useMemo,
} from 'react';

import {
    createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator,
    type AuthorizationDecision,
    type AuthorizationDecisionEvaluator,
    type PermissionRequirement,
} from '@/platform/authorization';

import {
    useCapabilityState,
} from '@/app/authorization/CapabilityContextProvider';

export function useAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator():
    AuthorizationDecisionEvaluator {
    const capabilityState =
        useCapabilityState();

    /*
     * CapabilityRuntime publishes stable snapshots until
     * authority changes.
     *
     * Build one decision evaluator for the current
     * Capability snapshot so a React consumer can evaluate
     * multiple requirements without rebuilding the
     * permission lookup for every decision.
     */
    return useMemo(
        () =>
            createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator(
                capabilityState,
            ),
        [
            capabilityState,
        ],
    );
}

export function useAuthorizationDecision(
    requirement:
        PermissionRequirement,
): AuthorizationDecision {
    const evaluator =
        useAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator();

    /*
     * Evaluation itself is synchronous and pure.
     *
     * Do not memoize by requirement object identity here:
     * callers may legitimately provide an inline immutable
     * requirement object on every render.
     */
    return evaluator.evaluate(
        requirement,
    );
}
EOF
```

---

## 2. Test `useAuthorizationDecision.test.tsx`

Buat:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/authorization/__tests__/useAuthorizationDecision.test.tsx <<'EOF'
import {
    type PropsWithChildren,
} from 'react';
import {
    act,
    renderHook,
} from '@testing-library/react';
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    CapabilityContextProvider,
} from '@/app/authorization/CapabilityContextProvider';
import {
    useAuthorizationDecision,
    useAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator,
} from '@/app/authorization/useAuthorizationDecision';
import type {
    CapabilityRuntime,
    CapabilityState,
    PermissionRequirement,
} from '@/platform/authorization';

const studentsView =
    'academic.students.view';

const gradesWrite =
    'academic.grades.write';

const studentsRequirement:
    PermissionRequirement = {
        mode:
            'single',

        permission:
            studentsView,
    };

interface ControlledCapabilityRuntime {
    readonly runtime:
        CapabilityRuntime;

    readonly calls: {
        bootstrap:
            number;

        refresh:
            number;

        reset:
            number;
    };

    publish(
        state:
            CapabilityState,
    ): void;
}

function createControlledCapabilityRuntime(
    initialState:
        CapabilityState = {
            status:
                'unresolved',
        },
): ControlledCapabilityRuntime {
    let state =
        initialState;

    const listeners =
        new Set<
            () => void
        >();

    const calls = {
        bootstrap:
            0,

        refresh:
            0,

        reset:
            0,
    };

    const notify =
        () => {
            for (
                const listener
                of listeners
            ) {
                listener();
            }
        };

    const runtime:
        CapabilityRuntime = {
        getState() {
            return state;
        },

        subscribe(
            listener,
        ) {
            listeners.add(
                listener,
            );

            return () => {
                listeners.delete(
                    listener,
                );
            };
        },

        async bootstrap() {
            calls.bootstrap +=
                1;

            return state;
        },

        async refresh() {
            calls.refresh +=
                1;

            return state;
        },

        reset() {
            calls.reset +=
                1;

            state = {
                status:
                    'unresolved',
            };

            notify();

            return state;
        },

        dispose() {
            listeners.clear();
        },
    };

    return {
        runtime,
        calls,

        publish(
            nextState,
        ) {
            state =
                nextState;

            notify();
        },
    };
}

function readyState(
    permissions:
        string[],
    isGlobalSuperadmin =
        false,
): CapabilityState {
    return {
        status:
            'ready',

        projection: {
            scope: {
                type:
                    'tenant',

                tenant_id:
                    '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab',

                membership_id:
                    '018f3b6a-7c20-7bcd-8def-1234567890ab',
            },

            is_global_superadmin:
                isGlobalSuperadmin,

            permissions,
        },
    };
}

function createWrapper(
    runtime:
        CapabilityRuntime,
) {
    return function Wrapper({
        children,
    }: PropsWithChildren) {
        return (
            <CapabilityContextProvider
                runtime={runtime}
            >
                {children}
            </CapabilityContextProvider>
        );
    };
}

describe(
    'React authorization decision hooks',
    () => {
        it('exposes unresolved Capability authority as pending rather than denied', () => {
            const controlled =
                createControlledCapabilityRuntime();

            const {
                result,
            } =
                renderHook(
                    () =>
                        useAuthorizationDecision(
                            studentsRequirement,
                        ),
                    {
                        wrapper:
                            createWrapper(
                                controlled.runtime,
                            ),
                    },
                );

            expect(
                result.current,
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'pending',

                capabilityStatus:
                    'unresolved',
            });

            expect(
                controlled.calls,
            ).toEqual({
                bootstrap:
                    0,

                refresh:
                    0,

                reset:
                    0,
            });
        });

        it('reacts to Capability lifecycle changes without dispatching runtime commands', () => {
            const controlled =
                createControlledCapabilityRuntime();

            const {
                result,
            } =
                renderHook(
                    () =>
                        useAuthorizationDecision(
                            studentsRequirement,
                        ),
                    {
                        wrapper:
                            createWrapper(
                                controlled.runtime,
                            ),
                    },
                );

            act(() => {
                controlled.publish({
                    status:
                        'loading',
                });
            });

            expect(
                result.current,
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'pending',

                capabilityStatus:
                    'loading',
            });

            act(() => {
                controlled.publish(
                    readyState([
                        studentsView,
                    ]),
                );
            });

            expect(
                result.current,
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'allowed',
            });

            expect(
                controlled.calls,
            ).toEqual({
                bootstrap:
                    0,

                refresh:
                    0,

                reset:
                    0,
            });
        });

        it('denies only after READY authority proves the required permission is absent', () => {
            const controlled =
                createControlledCapabilityRuntime(
                    readyState([
                        gradesWrite,
                    ]),
                );

            const {
                result,
            } =
                renderHook(
                    () =>
                        useAuthorizationDecision(
                            studentsRequirement,
                        ),
                    {
                        wrapper:
                            createWrapper(
                                controlled.runtime,
                            ),
                    },
                );

            expect(
                result.current,
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'denied',
            });
        });

        it('preserves unavailable Capability failure for controlled recovery UX', () => {
            const failure = {
                ok:
                    false as const,

                kind:
                    'network' as const,

                cause:
                    new Error(
                        'offline',
                    ),
            };

            const controlled =
                createControlledCapabilityRuntime({
                    status:
                        'unavailable',

                    failure,
                });

            const {
                result,
            } =
                renderHook(
                    () =>
                        useAuthorizationDecision(
                            studentsRequirement,
                        ),
                    {
                        wrapper:
                            createWrapper(
                                controlled.runtime,
                            ),
                    },
                );

            expect(
                result.current,
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'unavailable',

                failure,
            });
        });

        it('inherits canonical ALL and ANY requirement semantics from the platform decision model', () => {
            const controlled =
                createControlledCapabilityRuntime(
                    readyState([
                        studentsView,
                        gradesWrite,
                    ]),
                );

            const {
                result,
            } =
                renderHook(
                    () => {
                        const evaluator =
                            useAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator();

                        return {
                            all:
                                evaluator.evaluate({
                                    mode:
                                        'all',

                                    permissions: [
                                        studentsView,
                                        gradesWrite,
                                    ],
                                }),

                            any:
                                evaluator.evaluate({
                                    mode:
                                        'any',

                                    permissions: [
                                        'dormitory.rooms.manage',
                                        studentsView,
                                    ],
                                }),
                        };
                    },
                    {
                        wrapper:
                            createWrapper(
                                controlled.runtime,
                            ),
                    },
                );

            expect(
                result.current,
            ).toEqual({
                all: {
                    status:
                        'allowed',
                },

                any: {
                    status:
                        'allowed',
                },
            });
        });

        it('never invents access from global superadmin metadata', () => {
            const controlled =
                createControlledCapabilityRuntime(
                    readyState(
                        [],
                        true,

            const {
                result,
            } =
                renderHook(
                    () =>
                        useAuthorizationDecision(

                    {

                            createWrapper(
                                controlled.runtime,
                            ),

            expect(
                result.current,
            ).toEqual({
                status:
                    'denied',

    },
);
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Hook tidak memiliki authorization semantics sendiri

Tidak ada logic:

```ts
permissions.includes(...)
```

di React.

Flow tetap:

```text
React
  ↓
FEI-9C AuthorizationDecisionEvaluator
  ↓
FEI-9B PermissionEvaluator
```

Jadi hanya ada satu implementation canonical untuk exact permission semantics.

---

### 2. Evaluator dimemoize berdasarkan Capability snapshot

```ts
useMemo(
    () =>
        createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator(
            capabilityState,
        ),
    [capabilityState],
);
```

Capability runtime mempertahankan snapshot yang sama sampai state berubah.

Jadi selama authority tidak berubah:

```text
render
render
render
   ↓
same Capability snapshot
   ↓
same evaluator
   ↓
same internal permission Set
```

Ketika:

```text
Workspace change
Capability reload
Capability failure
Capability ready baru
```

runtime mempublish snapshot baru dan evaluator otomatis dibangun ulang.

---

### 3. Requirement tidak perlu `useMemo`

Consumer nanti boleh menulis:

```ts
useAuthorizationDecision({
    mode:
        'single',

    permission:
        'academic.students.view',
});
```

tanpa dipaksa membuat:

```ts
const requirement =
    useMemo(...);
```

karena `evaluate()` memang synchronous/pure.

Tidak ada state atau effect yang bergantung pada object identity requirement.

---

### 4. Tidak ada bootstrap atau refresh

Hook ini **observer**, bukan lifecycle owner.

Capability lifecycle tetap:

```text
Membership
+
Workspace
→ CapabilityRuntime
→ state publication
```

Hook hanya membaca publication tersebut.

Itu menjaga FEI-8 Capability Provider tetap read-only.

---

### 5. `pending`, `unavailable`, `denied` tetap terpisah sampai UI

React sekarang dapat membedakan:

```ts
decision.status === 'pending'
decision.status === 'unavailable'
decision.status === 'denied'
decision.status === 'allowed'
```

Ini nanti memungkinkan route boundary mengikuti ADR:

```text
pending
→ loading UX

unavailable
→ controlled unavailable/retry UX

denied
→ access denied UX

allowed
→ render page
```

Bukan:

```text
!can
→ redirect unauthorized
```

ADR memang menetapkan bahwa direct route ketika capability masih loading tidak boleh langsung diperlakukan sebagai unauthorized. 

---

### 6. Belum ada route guard

Kita sengaja belum mengubah:

```text
app/router.tsx
```

Karena router saat ini baru:

```text
/
*
```

dan tidak punya business module route.

Kita tidak akan membuat fake protected route hanya demi infrastructure test.

---

# Troubleshooting

Jika `renderHook` tidak tersedia dari `@testing-library/react`, jangan install dependency baru. Kirim compiler/runtime error dan test kita ubah menjadi probe component dengan existing `render()`.

Jika failure fixture dengan `as const` bermasalah, gunakan explicit canonical `BrowserApiFailure` type. Jangan memakai `as unknown as`.

Jika hook tidak rerender setelah `controlled.publish()`, masalah ada pada controlled runtime `subscribe()`/snapshot publication; jangan tambahkan React state lokal.

Jika router berubah pada tahap ini, revert hanya `frontend/src/app/router.tsx`. FEI-9D tidak membutuhkan route implementation.

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

## FEI-9E - Route Authorization Boundary Audit

Tujuan audit ini adalah menentukan state machine route protection yang canonical.

ADR-027 sudah mengunci urutan konseptual route guard:

```text
1. Authentication READY?
2. Membership/Tenant READY?
3. Required organizational context available?
4. Correct capability projection READY?
5. Required permission satisfied?
6. Render route
```

Capability yang masih loading tidak boleh langsung dianggap unauthorized, sedangkan direct URL dengan Capability READY tetapi permission tidak ada harus menghasilkan controlled access-denied UX. 

Yang perlu kita tentukan sekarang adalah **exact mapping terhadap state machine yang benar-benar sudah ada di source code**.

Contohnya:

```text
Auth unknown
Auth authenticating
Auth anonymous
Auth unavailable

Membership unresolved
Membership discovering
Membership selection-required
Membership empty
Membership switching
Membership unavailable
Membership ready

Workspace unresolved
Workspace discovering
Workspace switching
Workspace recovering
Workspace unavailable
Workspace ready

Authorization pending
Authorization unavailable
Authorization denied
Authorization allowed
```

Kita tidak boleh membuat guard dengan logika simplistik:

```ts
if (!authenticated) redirect('/login');
if (!can) return <AccessDenied />;
```

karena itu bisa salah untuk beberapa lifecycle state.

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Audit ini harus menjawab beberapa keputusan architecture sebelum kita menulis satu baris guard.

### 1. Auth lifecycle ≠ authorization lifecycle

Misalnya:

```text
Auth unknown
```

belum berarti anonymous.

Demikian pula:

```text
Capability pending
```

belum berarti denied.

Kita harus menjaga perbedaan ini sampai route UX.

---

### 2. Membership selection bukan permission denial

State seperti:

```text
membership-context-required
selection-required
```

harus menghasilkan UX memilih canonical membership/tenant.

Bukan:

```text
403
Access denied
```

Authorization bahkan belum mempunyai context yang cukup untuk dievaluasi.

---

### 3. Workspace requirement harus dievaluasi sebelum permission

Misalnya future route:

```text
/dormitory/rooms

requires:
ORGANIZATION workspace
+
dormitory.rooms.view
```

Jika current Workspace:

```text
TENANT
```

kita tidak boleh langsung berkata:

```text
permission denied
```

karena capability projection yang aktif masih projection TENANT.

ADR sudah mengunci bahwa route context tidak boleh menyebabkan frontend secara otomatis memilih organizational Workspace atau menebak Workspace dari role. 

Expected UX adalah sesuatu seperti:

```text
context required
→ user selects valid Workspace explicitly
```

---

### 4. `unavailable` bukan 403

Authorization state:

```text
unavailable
```

bisa berasal dari:

```text
network failure
protocol failure
semantic mismatch
```

Ini harus menjadi controlled system/retry state.

Bukan:

```text
Access denied
```

Karena kita belum tahu authorization truth.

---

### 5. Denied route sebaiknya tidak menggunakan router error boundary

Kemungkinan besar:

```text
Permission READY + absent
```

adalah expected UX state, bukan exception.

Jadi jangan langsung menggunakan:

```ts
throw new Response('', {
    status: 403,
});
```

sebelum kita memastikan architecture.

Kemungkinan desain yang lebih tepat:

```text
RouteAuthorizationBoundary
    ├─ pending
    ├─ context-required
    ├─ unavailable
    ├─ denied
    └─ allowed → children
```

Tetapi audit dulu akan menentukan exact contract.

---

### 6. Kita belum punya login route

Audit FEI-9A menunjukkan router baru:

```text
/
*
```

Jadi kalau ternyata masih tidak ada:

```text
/login
```

kita **tidak boleh mengarang redirect `/login`** pada route authorization layer.

Authentication UX route adalah concern terpisah yang harus ada secara canonical terlebih dahulu.

---

### 7. Data Router loader tidak otomatis menjadi tempat terbaik

React Router Data Mode memang tersedia, tetapi current authorization truth berada di external React/runtime stores:

```text
AuthRuntime
MembershipRuntime
WorkspaceRuntime
CapabilityRuntime
```

Kita perlu menentukan apakah:

```text
loader
```

memiliki clean access ke runtime tanpa membuat duplicate subscription/lifecycle semantics.

Bisa saja route guard awal lebih tepat berupa React boundary component.

Audit ini akan memberi bukti.

Audit ini menghasilkan keputusan yang cukup tegas untuk tidak langsung membuat route guard. State Auth memang mempunyai delapan lifecycle berbeda; terutama `unknown`, `authenticating`, `resolving-context`, `anonymous`, `membership-context-required`, `authenticated`, `logging-out`, dan `unavailable`. Membership juga membedakan `selection-required`, `empty`, `switching`, `unavailable`, dan `ready`, sehingga semuanya tidak boleh direduksi menjadi satu boolean `authenticated`. `Pasted text (4).txt`

Workspace juga punya lifecycle sendiri (`unresolved`, `discovering`, `ready`, `switching`, `recovering`, `unavailable`), dan stale recovery sengaja menghapus authoritative Workspace lama selama recovery. `Pasted text (3).txt` Authorization decision yang sudah kita buat kemudian menambahkan `pending`, `unavailable`, `allowed`, dan `denied` tanpa mencampurkan lifecycle tersebut. `Pasted text (2).txt`

ADR-027/028 mengunci bahwa known route tetap ada lalu policy menghasilkan `Allowed / Denied / Context Required`; known route tanpa permission adalah Access Denied, sedangkan organizational-required route pada TENANT adalah Context Required-bukan 404 dan bukan immediate denial.  

## Hasil FEI-9E yang dikunci

Mapping lifecycle kita sekarang:

| Layer | State | Route interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| Auth | `unknown`, `authenticating`, `resolving-context` | pending |
| Auth | `anonymous` | unauthenticated |
| Auth | `membership-context-required` | lanjut ke Membership context UX, **bukan login** |
| Auth | `authenticated` | proceed |
| Auth | `logging-out` | transition/pending |
| Auth | `unavailable` | authentication unavailable |
| Membership | `unresolved`, `discovering`, `switching` | pending |
| Membership | `selection-required` | membership context required |
| Membership | `empty` | no Membership available |
| Membership | `unavailable` | Membership unavailable |
| Membership | `ready` | proceed |
| Workspace | `unresolved`, `discovering`, `switching`, `recovering` | pending |
| Workspace | `unavailable` | Workspace unavailable |
| Workspace | `ready` | evaluate route context |
| Authorization | `pending` | loading, not denied |
| Authorization | `unavailable` | controlled unavailable |
| Authorization | `denied` | Access Denied |
| Authorization | `allowed` | render |

Current application juga **belum mempunyai `/login`, Membership-selection page, Workspace-selection page, AccessDenied page, atau AuthorizationUnavailable page**; modules hanya `.gitkeep`. `Pasted text.txt` Karena itu membuat redirect/UI sekarang akan mengarang destination yang belum ada.

Router saat ini juga tidak mempunyai loader/action dan `createAppRouter()` tidak menerima `ApplicationRuntime`; state yang diperlukan guard justru diekspos melalui React hooks/providers. Jadi untuk topology sekarang, guard akhirnya lebih cocok sebagai **React boundary**, bukan loader. Namun kita belum membuat boundary itu.

ADR-028 sendiri menyatakan public `/login` dan protected application shell secara konseptual terpisah, serta canonical protected guard order tetap Auth → Membership → route context → Capability readiness → permission → render. 

Satu hal sengaja **belum** kita inventaris sebagai invariant: apakah route metadata suatu hari harus membedakan `ORGANIZATION` vs `ORGANIZATION_UNIT`. ADR yang ada baru mengunci generic **organizational context**. Jadi untuk Foundation kita gunakan KISS:

```text
tenant
organizational
```

dan bukan membuat requirement level baru yang belum dibutuhkan.

### Kenapa dibuat di `platform/routing`, bukan `app`

maka future:

akan membuat dependency direction yang kurang sehat.

```text
platform/routing
      ↑

modules/*

```

Sedangkan permission semantics tetap direuse dari:

```text
platform/authorization
```

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. `frontend/src/platform/routing/route-policy.ts`

```bash
mkdir -p \
  frontend/src/platform/routing/__tests__

cat > frontend/src/platform/routing/route-policy.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    PermissionRequirement,
} from '@/platform/authorization';

export type RouteContextRequirement =
    | 'tenant'
    | 'organizational';

export type RouteAuthorizationScope =
    | 'tenant'
    | 'workspace';

/*
 * Public routes do not require a ProtectedRoutePolicy.
 *
 * This contract describes only routes that participate in
 * the authenticated application policy boundary.
 */
export interface ProtectedRoutePolicy {
    /*
     * Stable module/application-owned identity.
     *
     * Route IDs are not translated labels and must remain
     * stable across presentation changes.
     */
    readonly routeId:
        string;

    /*
     * "tenant"
     *     Route may operate without an organizational
     *     Workspace requirement.
     *
     * "organizational"
     *     Route requires an explicitly selected
     *     organizational Workspace.
     *
     * This contract deliberately does not invent separate
     * ORGANIZATION vs ORGANIZATION_UNIT requirements yet.
     */
    readonly contextRequirement:
        RouteContextRequirement;

    /*
     * Which canonical Capability projection family must be
     * used by the later route evaluator.
     *
     * This metadata never performs Capability loading.
     */
    readonly authorizationScope:
        RouteAuthorizationScope;

    /*
     * null represents a protected/context-aware route that
     * has no additional permission requirement.
     *
     * Otherwise the route reuses the canonical explicit
     * single/all/any PermissionRequirement semantics.
     */
    readonly requiredPermissions:
        PermissionRequirement | null;
}

function snapshotPermissionRequirement(
    requirement:
        PermissionRequirement,
): PermissionRequirement {
    switch (
        requirement.mode
    ) {
        case 'single':
            return {
                mode:
                    'single',

                permission:
                    requirement.permission,
            };

        case 'all':
            return {
                mode:
                    'all',

                permissions: [
                    ...requirement.permissions,
                ],
            };

        case 'any':
            return {
                mode:
                    'any',

                permissions: [
                    ...requirement.permissions,
                ],
            };
    }
}

export function defineProtectedRoutePolicy(
    policy:
        ProtectedRoutePolicy,
): ProtectedRoutePolicy {
    if (
        policy.routeId
            .trim()
            .length
            === 0
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'EduCore protected route policy requires a non-empty stable routeId.',
        );
    }

    return {
        routeId:
            policy.routeId,

        contextRequirement:
            policy.contextRequirement,

        authorizationScope:
            policy.authorizationScope,

        requiredPermissions:
            policy.requiredPermissions
                === null
                ? null
                : snapshotPermissionRequirement(
                    policy.requiredPermissions,
                ),
    };
}
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Route existence tidak bergantung permission

Jangan membangun:

```text
permission absent
→ remove RouteObject
→ 404
```

ADR-028 melarang semantic itu. Route tetap ada, lalu policy-lah yang menentukan Allowed / Denied / Context Required. 

`ProtectedRoutePolicy` karena itu metadata, bukan mechanism yang membuat/menghapus router.

---

### 2. `tenant | organizational`, bukan Workspace identity

Policy tidak menyimpan:

```text
organization_id
organization_unit_id
organizational_assignment_id
```

karena route permission tidak boleh memilih Workspace tertentu.

ADR secara eksplisit melarang permission requirement memindahkan Workspace secara otomatis. `Pasted text.txt`

Kelak:

```text
contextRequirement = organizational
+
current Workspace = TENANT
→ context-required
```

Bukan:

```text
scan workspaces
→ pilih yang punya permission
```

---

### 3. `authorizationScope` dipisahkan dari `contextRequirement`

Keduanya bukan konsep yang identik.

```text
contextRequirement
→ context yang harus tersedia

authorizationScope
→ capability family yang harus authoritative
```

Untuk baseline:

```text
tenant
→ Tenant Capability projection

workspace
→ active organizational Workspace projection
```

Kita belum menerapkan evaluator, jadi tidak ada implicit switch atau fetch.

---

### 4. Tidak mengarang ORGANIZATION vs ORGANIZATION_UNIT policy

Current Workspace runtime memang membedakan tiga exact Workspace type. `Pasted text (3).txt`

Namun ADR route requirement yang ada baru mengunci:

```text
tenant
vs
organizational context
```

Jadi kita tidak membuat:

```text
requiresOrganization
requiresOrganizationUnit
```

sampai business route nyata menunjukkan kebutuhan tersebut.

KISS/YAGNI di sini penting.

---

### 5. `requiredPermissions` reuse FEI-9C

Tidak ada route-specific authorization vocabulary baru seperti:

```ts
permissions: string[]
permissionMode: 'and' | 'or'
```

Kita sudah punya canonical:

```ts
PermissionRequirement
```

dengan:

```text
single
all
any
```

Maka route policy cukup mereuse itu.

---

### 6. `null` bukan `all: []`

FEI-9B memang menetapkan:

```text
hasAll([]) = true
```

tetapi metadata route lebih jelas bila:

```ts
requiredPermissions: null
```

berarti:

```text
route protected/context-aware
tetapi tidak memiliki additional permission restriction
```

daripada menyamarkan "tidak ada requirement" sebagai empty-ALL trick.

---

### 7. Route ID hanya divalidasi non-empty

ADR-028 meminta stable namespaced ID dan uniqueness pada composition. 

Kita **belum** memaksakan regex seperti:

```text
^[a-z]+\.[a-z]+\.[a-z]+$
```

karena exact syntax belum dikunci.

Saat module route catalog sudah ada, application composition test-lah yang akan menangani:

```text
duplicate route IDs
conflicting paths
```

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. `frontend/src/platform/routing/route-access.ts`

Buat:

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/routing/route-access.ts <<'EOF'
import type {
    BrowserAuthState,
} from '@/platform/auth';
import {
    createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator,
    type CapabilityState,
    type CapabilityStateFailure,
} from '@/platform/authorization';
import type {
    MembershipContextState,
} from '@/platform/membership';
import type {
    WorkspaceContextState,
    WorkspaceSummary,
} from '@/platform/workspace';

import type {
    ProtectedRoutePolicy,
    RouteAuthorizationScope,
    RouteContextRequirement,
} from '@/platform/routing/route-policy';

export type ProtectedRoutePendingSource =
    | 'authentication'
    | 'membership'
    | 'workspace'
    | 'authorization';

export type ProtectedRouteUnavailableSource =
    | 'authentication'
    | 'membership'
    | 'workspace'
    | 'authorization';

export interface PendingProtectedRouteAccessDecision {
    readonly status:
        'pending';

    readonly source:
        ProtectedRoutePendingSource;
}

export interface UnauthenticatedProtectedRouteAccessDecision {
    readonly status:
        'unauthenticated';
}

export interface MembershipRequiredProtectedRouteAccessDecision {
    readonly status:
        'membership-required';
}

export interface MembershipEmptyProtectedRouteAccessDecision {
    readonly status:
        'membership-empty';
}

export interface UnavailableProtectedRouteAccessDecision {
    readonly status:
        'unavailable';

    readonly source:
        ProtectedRouteUnavailableSource;

    readonly failure:
        CapabilityStateFailure;
}

export interface ContextRequiredProtectedRouteAccessDecision {
    readonly status:
        'context-required';

    readonly requiredContext:
        RouteContextRequirement;

    readonly currentWorkspace:
        WorkspaceSummary['type'];
}

export interface DeniedProtectedRouteAccessDecision {
    readonly status:
        'denied';
}

export interface AllowedProtectedRouteAccessDecision {
    readonly status:
        'allowed';
}

export type ProtectedRouteAccessDecision =
    | PendingProtectedRouteAccessDecision
    | UnauthenticatedProtectedRouteAccessDecision
    | MembershipRequiredProtectedRouteAccessDecision
    | MembershipEmptyProtectedRouteAccessDecision
    | UnavailableProtectedRouteAccessDecision
    | ContextRequiredProtectedRouteAccessDecision
    | DeniedProtectedRouteAccessDecision
    | AllowedProtectedRouteAccessDecision;

export interface ProtectedRouteAccessInput {
    readonly policy:
        ProtectedRoutePolicy;

    readonly authentication:
        BrowserAuthState;

    readonly membership:
        MembershipContextState;

    readonly workspace:
        WorkspaceContextState;

    readonly capability:
        CapabilityState;
}

function pending(
    source:
        ProtectedRoutePendingSource,
): PendingProtectedRouteAccessDecision {
    return {
        status:
            'pending',

        source,
    };
}

function unavailable(
    source:
        ProtectedRouteUnavailableSource,
    failure:
        CapabilityStateFailure,
): UnavailableProtectedRouteAccessDecision {
    return {
        status:
            'unavailable',

        source,

        failure,
    };
}

function contextRequired(
    requiredContext:
        RouteContextRequirement,
    currentWorkspace:
        WorkspaceSummary['type'],
): ContextRequiredProtectedRouteAccessDecision {
    return {
        status:
            'context-required',

        requiredContext,

        currentWorkspace,
    };
}

function authorizationScopeMatchesWorkspace(
    authorizationScope:
        RouteAuthorizationScope,
    workspace:
        WorkspaceSummary,
): boolean {
    if (
        authorizationScope
            === 'tenant'
    ) {
        return workspace.type
            === 'TENANT';
    }

    return workspace.type
        !== 'TENANT';
}

function requiredContextForAuthorizationScope(
    authorizationScope:
        RouteAuthorizationScope,
): RouteContextRequirement {
    return authorizationScope
        === 'tenant'
        ? 'tenant'
        : 'organizational';
}

export function evaluateProtectedRouteAccess(
    input:
        ProtectedRouteAccessInput,
): ProtectedRouteAccessDecision {
    const {
        policy,
        authentication,
        membership,
        workspace,
        capability,
    } = input;

    /*
     * 1. Authentication authority.
     *
     * Transitional authentication states must never render
     * protected content and must never be interpreted as an
     * authoritative unauthenticated result.
     */
    switch (
        authentication.status
    ) {
        case 'unknown':
        case 'authenticating':
        case 'resolving-context':
        case 'logging-out':
            return pending(
                'authentication',
            );

        case 'anonymous':
            return {
                status:
                    'unauthenticated',
            };

        case 'unavailable':
            return unavailable(
                'authentication',
                authentication.failure,
            );

        case 'membership-context-required':
        case 'authenticated':
            break;
    }

    /*
     * 2. Membership/Tenant authority.
     *
     * membership-context-required deliberately reaches this
     * stage because Membership discovery/selection is the
     * required UX, not another login attempt.
     */
    switch (
        membership.status
    ) {
        case 'unresolved':
        case 'discovering':
        case 'switching':
            return pending(
                'membership',
            );

        case 'selection-required':
            return {
                status:
                    'membership-required',
            };

        case 'empty':
            return {
                status:
                    'membership-empty',
            };

        case 'unavailable':
            return unavailable(
                'membership',
                membership.failure,
            );

        case 'ready':
            break;
    }

    /*
     * Membership truth alone must never promote a browser
     * that still reports membership-context-required into
     * an authenticated protected route.
     *
     * This also makes temporary cross-runtime publication
     * ordering fail closed.
     */
    if (
        authentication.status
            !== 'authenticated'
    ) {
        return pending(
            'authentication',
        );
    }

    /*
     * 3. Workspace authority.
     *
     * Switching and stale-context recovery invalidate the
     * active Workspace for route authorization purposes.
     */
    switch (
        workspace.status
    ) {
        case 'unresolved':
        case 'discovering':
        case 'switching':
        case 'recovering':
            return pending(
                'workspace',
            );

        case 'unavailable':
            return unavailable(
                'workspace',
                workspace.failure,
            );

        case 'ready':
            break;
    }

    /*
     * An explicitly organizational route cannot be
     * evaluated from the TENANT Workspace.
     *
     * The evaluator does not choose another Workspace.
     */
    if (
        policy.contextRequirement
            === 'organizational'
        && workspace.current.type
            === 'TENANT'
    ) {
        return contextRequired(
            'organizational',
            workspace.current.type,
        );
    }

    /*
     * A protected route may intentionally have no
     * additional permission requirement.
     *
     * In that case authenticated Membership/Workspace
     * readiness is sufficient and Capability availability
     * is not manufactured into a new restriction.
     */
    if (
        policy.requiredPermissions
            === null
    ) {
        return {
            status:
                'allowed',
        };
    }

    /*
     * The current Workspace determines which Capability
     * projection family can be authoritative.
     *
     * Route policy never triggers an automatic Workspace
     * switch merely to obtain another permission set.
     */
    if (
        ! authorizationScopeMatchesWorkspace(
            policy.authorizationScope,
            workspace.current,
        )
    ) {
        return contextRequired(
            requiredContextForAuthorizationScope(
                policy.authorizationScope,
            ),
            workspace.current.type,
        );
    }

    /*
     * 4. Required Capability projection readiness.
     */
    switch (
        capability.status
    ) {
        case 'unresolved':
        case 'loading':
            return pending(
                'authorization',
            );

        case 'unavailable':
            return unavailable(
                'authorization',
                capability.failure,
            );

        case 'ready':
            break;
    }

    /*
     * 5. Permission policy.
     *
     * Exact matching, ALL/ANY semantics, and the prohibition
     * on role/superadmin bypass remain owned by the
     * Authorization decision layer.
     */
    const authorization =
        createAuthorizationDecisionEvaluator(
            capability,
        ).evaluate(
            policy.requiredPermissions,
        );

    switch (
        authorization.status
    ) {
        case 'pending':
            return pending(
                'authorization',
            );

        case 'unavailable':
            return unavailable(
                'authorization',
                authorization.failure,
            );

        case 'denied':
            return {
                status:
                    'denied',
            };

        case 'allowed':
            return {
                status:
                    'allowed',
            };
    }
}
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Urutan evaluasi adalah bagian dari security semantics

Evaluator sengaja tidak menulis:

```ts
if (
    authorization.status
        === 'denied'
) {
    return denied;
}
```

di awal.

Urutan canonical adalah:

```text
Auth
↓
Membership
↓
Workspace
↓
Route context
↓
Capability
↓
Permission
```

Ini sesuai ADR route guard order. 

Contoh paling penting:

```text
Workspace = TENANT
route requires ORGANIZATIONAL
Capability says permission absent
```

hasil harus:

```text
CONTEXT REQUIRED
```

bukan:

```text
ACCESS DENIED
```

Karena permission belum dievaluasi di Workspace yang valid. ADR-027/028 mengunci persis distinction ini. `Pasted text.txt` 

---

### 2. `membership-context-required` bukan anonymous

Auth runtime mempunyai state canonical:

```text
membership-context-required
```

dan Membership provider memang melakukan discovery pada state tersebut. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Jadi evaluator tidak boleh:

```text
membership-context-required
→ unauthenticated
→ /login
```

Yang benar:

```text
membership-context-required
↓
Membership discovery
↓
selection-required
↓
membership-required
```

---

### 3. Membership READY tidak boleh sendiri mempromosikan Auth

Ada kemungkinan sangat singkat publication ordering seperti:

```text
Membership READY
Auth masih membership-context-required
```

Pure evaluator tetap:

```text
pending(authentication)
```

sampai Auth benar-benar:

```text
authenticated
```

Ini fail-closed dan tidak membuat cross-runtime timing menjadi authorization authority.

---

### 4. Workspace `switching` dan `recovering` bukan READY

Workspace reducer memang menghapus authoritative organizational Workspace saat stale recovery dan berpindah ke `recovering`. `Pasted text (3).txt`

Maka route result:

```text
switching / recovering
→ pending(workspace)
```

Bukan mempertahankan permission dari Workspace sebelumnya.

---

### 5. Authorization scope tidak menyebabkan auto-switch

Contoh:

```text
route authorizationScope = tenant
current Workspace = ORGANIZATION
```

hasil:

```text
context-required:
    tenant
```

Bukan:

```text
switchWorkspace(TENANT)
```

Demikian juga workspace-scoped route dari TENANT:

```text
context-required:
    organizational
```

ADR secara eksplisit melarang permission-driven automatic Workspace switching. `Pasted text.txt`

---

### 6. Kenapa `tenant` context dan `authorizationScope` tetap terpisah

Untuk baseline FEI-9:

```text
contextRequirement
→ prerequisite context UX

authorizationScope
→ Capability projection family
```

`contextRequirement: organizational` mempunyai aturan eksplisit:

```text
TENANT current
→ context-required
```

Sedangkan `authorizationScope` menentukan apakah permission harus berasal dari:

```text
tenant Capability
atau
workspace Capability
```

Kita belum membuat regex/policy rule yang memaksa keduanya selalu one-to-one karena ADR menyimpan kedua metadata tersebut sebagai field terpisah. 

---

### 7. Route tanpa permission tidak dibuat bergantung Capability secara artifisial

Policy FEI-9F.1 mengizinkan:

```ts
requiredPermissions:
    null
```

Artinya:

```text
protected/context-aware
tetapi tidak punya additional permission restriction
```

Maka setelah Auth/Membership/Workspace requirement valid:

```text
allowed
```

meskipun Capability projection sedang unavailable.

Kita tidak mengarang restriction yang metadata route sendiri tidak meminta.

---

### 8. Tidak mengekspos raw permission scans

Evaluator route tidak melakukan:

```ts
capability.projection
    .permissions
    .includes(...)
```

Ia tetap mendelegasikan ke:

```text
AuthorizationDecisionEvaluator
        ↓
PermissionEvaluator
```

Sehingga exact matching dan no-superadmin-bypass tetap single-source-of-truth.

---

### 9. Tidak ada redirect di pure evaluator

Output:

```text
unauthenticated
```

bukan:

```text
redirect('/login')
```

Walaupun ADR-028 nantinya mengarahkan authoritative unauthenticated protected route ke `/login`, `/login` sendiri belum ada di application router saat ini. 

Navigation tetap concern React/router layer berikutnya.

---

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak `membershipContextFailure`, jangan cast. Pastikan exact canonical shape:

```ts
{
    ok: false,
    kind: 'response',
    status: 409,
    error: {
        status: 'error',
        code: 'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
        message: 'Membership context is required.',
    },
}
```

`BrowserApiResponseFailure` memang mempunyai `ok`, `kind`, `status`, dan canonical error body tersebut. 

Jika Membership fixture ditolak, exact generated `MembershipSummary` fields adalah:

```text
membership_id
membership_status
tenant_id
tenant_name
tenant_subdomain
```

dan canonical Auth bootstrap mempunyai `user`, `person`, `membership`, serta `tenant`.  

Jika organizational Workspace fixture ditolak, canonical fields tetap:

```text
type
organizational_assignment_id
organization_id
organization_unit_id
label
```

Jika test `requiredPermissions: null` terasa mengejutkan karena capability unavailable masih `allowed`, jangan ubah menjadi denied/pending. Itu adalah explicit semantics FEI-9F.1: route tersebut memang tidak meminta permission authority tambahan. Jika nanti product policy menyatakan seluruh protected route wajib mempunyai Capability projection, kita ubah kontraknya secara eksplisit, bukan menyelundupkan rule melalui evaluator.

Jika **17/17 + seluruh gate bersih**, kita lock:

```text
FEI-9F.1 ✅ Protected Route Policy Contract
FEI-9F.2 ✅ Pure Route Authorization Lifecycle Evaluator
```

Baru berikutnya:

```text
FEI-9F.3 - React Protected Route Access Hook
```

Layer itu hanya akan menggabungkan:

```text
useBrowserAuthState()
useMembershipContextState()
useWorkspaceContextState()
useCapabilityState()
        ↓
evaluateProtectedRouteAccess()
```

dan tetap **belum melakukan redirect atau render Access Denied UI**.

Dengan begitu React Router boundary baru dibuat setelah pure route state machine dan React observation layer sama-sama terbukti benar.

Sekarang kita hanya lanjut ke:

# FEI-9F.3 - React Protected Route Access Hook

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Pure evaluator FEI-9F.2 sudah menerima:

```ts
{
    policy,
    authentication,
    membership,
    workspace,
    capability,
}
```

React layer sekarang hanya bertugas membaca current snapshots:

```text
useBrowserAuthState()
        │
useMembershipContextState()
        │
useWorkspaceContextState()
        │
useCapabilityState()
        │
        ▼
evaluateProtectedRouteAccess()
        │
        ▼
ProtectedRouteAccessDecision
```

Hook ini **bukan route guard UI**.

Jadi belum ada:

```text
Navigate
redirect()
Outlet
/login
AccessDeniedPage
ContextRequiredPage
AuthorizationUnavailablePage
```

Hook juga tidak boleh:

```text
bootstrap runtime
switch Membership
switch Workspace
refresh Capability
membaca permissions[] langsung
```

Ia hanya observer/read adapter.

Tambah:

```text
frontend/src/app/routing/
├── useProtectedRouteAccess.ts
└── __tests__/
    └── useProtectedRouteAccess.test.tsx
```

Tidak perlu barrel app-routing dulu karena belum ada public app routing package.

Jangan ubah:

```text
frontend/src/app/router.tsx
frontend/src/app/App.tsx
frontend/src/app/AppBootstrap.tsx

frontend/src/app/auth/*
frontend/src/app/membership/*
frontend/src/app/workspace/*

frontend/src/platform/routing/*
frontend/src/platform/authorization/*
```
