## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Anonymous bukan error

Ini perbedaan domain penting:

```text
authentication required
≠
authentication failed
```

`BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED` digunakan bootstrap untuk mengatakan:

> browser saat ini tidak mempunyai authenticated session.

Sedangkan login endpoint secara canonical mendefinisikan actual credential rejection sebagai `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`. `Pasted text.txt`

Jadi presenter harus memperlakukan keduanya berbeda.

### 2. Tidak perlu mengubah runtime

Kita tidak perlu membuat:

```text
anonymous.failure = null
```

di runtime.

Failure tersebut berguna sebagai technical authentication truth dan bisa berguna untuk observability/lifecycle decisions.

Application presentation layer cukup mengatakan:

```text
technical failure exists
but
no user-facing failure presentation
```

Separation of Concerns tetap terjaga.

### 3. Tidak menggunakan backend message

Jangan:

```ts
failure.error.message.includes(
    'Browser Session',
)
```

Kita hanya memakai:

```text
status = 401
code = BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
```

### 4. Kenapa ditemukan sekarang?

FEI-10E.1 menguji individual failure categories dengan benar, tetapi sebelum React integration kita sekarang melihat relationship antara:

```text
BrowserAuthState
+
failure presenter
```

Itulah fungsi gated progression: contract-level edge case ditutup sebelum UI mengonsumsinya.

## Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak `null` dari `presentResponseFailure`, pastikan signature sudah diubah menjadi:

```ts
LoginFailurePresentation | null
```

Jangan gunakan cast.

Jika test `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` tiba-tiba menjadi `null`, periksa ordering:

```text
BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
harus exact comparison

AUTHENTICATION_FAILED
harus tetap case berikutnya
```

Jangan membuat condition generik:

```ts
if (failure.status === 401) {
    return null;
}
```

karena itu akan menyembunyikan invalid credentials.

# FEI-10E.2 — Controlled Login Failure UI Integration

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita hubungkan failure presenter ke UI:

```text
BrowserAuthState
anonymous.failure
       ↓
presentLoginFailure()
       ↓
LoginPage
       ↓
LoginForm
├─ safe form-level message
└─ safe field errors
```

Responsibility tetap:

```text
platform/auth
→ technical authentication truth

login-failure.ts
→ technical failure → safe UX vocabulary

LoginPage
→ composition + failure visibility lifecycle

LoginForm
→ render form/error presentation
```

Ada satu UX requirement penting: setelah login gagal lalu user mulai memperbaiki input, **error server lama harus hilang**. Kita tidak menghapus failure dari Auth runtime; `LoginPage` hanya menyembunyikan presentation lama sampai submit berikutnya.

Tidak ada manual HTTP, CSRF, navigation, atau parsing raw backend message.

---

# Struktur Folder & File

Ubah:

```text
frontend/src/app/LoginPage.tsx
frontend/src/app/auth/LoginForm.tsx

frontend/src/app/__tests__/LoginPage.test.tsx
frontend/src/app/auth/__tests__/LoginForm.test.tsx
```

Tetap gunakan tanpa perubahan:

```text
frontend/src/app/auth/login-failure.ts
frontend/src/app/auth/login-form.ts
frontend/src/platform/auth/*
frontend/src/platform/api/*
frontend/src/app/routing/*
```

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Ganti `frontend/src/app/LoginPage.tsx`

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/LoginPage.tsx <<'EOF'
import {
    useState,
} from 'react';

import {
    useBrowserAuthRuntime,
    useBrowserAuthState,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import {
    LoginForm,
} from '@/app/auth/LoginForm';
import {
    presentLoginFailure,
} from '@/app/auth/login-failure';
import type {
    BrowserLoginRequest,
} from '@/platform/auth';

export function LoginPage() {
    const runtime =
        useBrowserAuthRuntime();

    const authentication =
        useBrowserAuthState();

    const [
        failureDismissed,
        setFailureDismissed,
    ] = useState(
        false,
    );

    const formDisabled =
        authentication.status
            !== 'anonymous';

    const failurePresentation =
        authentication.status
            === 'anonymous'
        && ! failureDismissed
            ? presentLoginFailure(
                authentication.failure,
            )
            : null;

    function handleFormInputChange(): void {
        /*
         * Auth runtime keeps the authoritative technical
         * failure. The application only dismisses the current
         * user-facing presentation once the user begins
         * correcting input.
         */
        if (
            authentication.status
                === 'anonymous'
            && authentication.failure
                !== null
        ) {
            setFailureDismissed(
                true,
            );
        }
    }

    async function handleValidatedSubmit(
        request: BrowserLoginRequest,
    ): Promise<void> {
        /*
         * The subscribed React snapshot controls the visible
         * form state, while the live runtime state is checked
         * again immediately before dispatching authentication.
         *
         * This prevents a stale render or rapid duplicate
         * submit from attempting an invalid LOGIN_STARTED
         * transition after another login already began.
         */
        if (
            runtime.getState()
                .status
                !== 'anonymous'
        ) {
            return;
        }

        /*
         * A new login attempt owns a fresh failure lifecycle.
         * Any previously dismissed presentation must therefore
         * be eligible to appear again if this attempt fails.
         */
        setFailureDismissed(
            false,
        );

        /*
         * BrowserAuthRuntime owns:
         * - CSRF bootstrap
         * - browser login transport
         * - canonical context resolution
         *
         * LoginPage deliberately does not inspect the returned
         * state or navigate. LoginRouteBoundary reacts to the
         * authoritative authentication state instead.
         */
        await runtime.login(
            request,
        );
    }

    return (
        <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100">
            <section className="mx-auto flex min-h-screen max-w-lg items-center px-6 py-16">
                <div className="w-full space-y-6">
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400">
                            EduCore
                        </p>

                        <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
                            Masuk ke EduCore
                        </h1>

                        <p className="leading-7 text-slate-300">
                            Gunakan akun EduCore dan identifier Tenant Anda
                            untuk memulai Browser Session yang aman.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <LoginForm
                        disabled={
                            formDisabled
                        }
                        externalErrors={
                            failurePresentation
                                ?.fieldErrors
                        }
                        formError={
                            failurePresentation
                                ?.message
                            ?? null
                        }
                        onInputChange={
                            handleFormInputChange
                        }
                        onValidatedSubmit={
                            handleValidatedSubmit
                        }
                    />
                </div>
            </section>
        </main>
    );
}
EOF
```

```bash
cat > frontend/src/app/auth/LoginForm.tsx <<'EOF'
import {
    type FormEvent,
    useState,
} from 'react';

import {
    type LoginFormErrors,
    validateLoginForm,
} from '@/app/auth/login-form';
import type {
    BrowserLoginRequest,
} from '@/platform/auth';

export interface LoginFormProps {
    readonly onValidatedSubmit: (
        request: BrowserLoginRequest,
    ) => void | Promise<void>;

    readonly disabled?:
        boolean;

    readonly externalErrors?:
        LoginFormErrors;

    readonly formError?:
        string | null;

    readonly onInputChange?:
        () => void;
}

export function LoginForm({
    onValidatedSubmit,
    disabled = false,
    externalErrors = {},
    formError = null,
    onInputChange,
}: LoginFormProps) {
    const [
        email,
        setEmail,
    ] = useState('');

    const [
        password,
        setPassword,
    ] = useState('');

    const [
        tenantUuid,
        setTenantUuid,
    ] = useState('');

    const [
        localErrors,
        setLocalErrors,
    ] = useState<
        LoginFormErrors
    >({});

    /*
     * Local validation belongs closest to the form and takes
     * precedence over server presentation for the same field.
     */
    const errors:
        LoginFormErrors = {
            ...externalErrors,
            ...localErrors,
        };

    function clearFieldError(
        field:
            keyof LoginFormErrors,
    ): void {
        setLocalErrors(
            (current) => {
                if (
                    current[field]
                        === undefined
                ) {
                    return current;
                }

                const next = {
                    ...current,
                };

                delete next[field];

                return next;
            },
        );
    }

    function notifyInputChange(): void {
        onInputChange?.();
    }

    async function handleSubmit(
        event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
    ): Promise<void> {
        event.preventDefault();

        if (disabled) {
            return;
        }

        const validation =
            validateLoginForm({
                email,
                password,
                tenantUuid,
            });

        if (! validation.ok) {
            setLocalErrors(
                validation.errors,
            );

            return;
        }

        setLocalErrors({});

        await onValidatedSubmit(
            validation.request,
        );
    }

    return (
        <form
            aria-describedby={
                formError === null
                    ? undefined
                    : 'login-form-error'
            }
            className="space-y-5"
            noValidate
            onSubmit={(event) => {
                void handleSubmit(
                    event,
                );
            }}
        >
            {
                formError !== null
                    ? (
                        <div
                            className="rounded-lg border border-red-900/60 bg-red-950/40 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-200"
                            id="login-form-error"
                            role="alert"
                        >
                            {formError}
                        </div>
                    )
                    : null
            }

            <div className="space-y-2">
                <label
                    className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-200"
                    htmlFor="login-email"
                >
                    Email
                </label>

                <input
                    aria-describedby={
                        errors.email
                            === undefined
                            ? undefined
                            : 'login-email-error'
                    }
                    aria-invalid={
                        errors.email
                            !== undefined
                    }
                    autoCapitalize="none"
                    autoComplete="username"
                    className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2 text-slate-100 outline-none focus:border-slate-400 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
                    disabled={disabled}
                    id="login-email"
                    inputMode="email"
                    name="email"
                    onChange={(event) => {
                        setEmail(
                            event.target.value,
                        );

                        clearFieldError(
                            'email',
                        );

                        notifyInputChange();
                    }}
                    spellCheck={false}
                    type="email"
                    value={email}
                />

                {
                    errors.email
                        !== undefined
                        ? (
                            <p
                                className="text-sm text-red-300"
                                id="login-email-error"
                                role="alert"
                            >
                                {errors.email}
                            </p>
                        )
                        : null
                }
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
                <label
                    className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-200"
                    htmlFor="login-password"
                >
                    Password
                </label>

                <input
                    aria-describedby={
                        errors.password
                            === undefined
                            ? undefined
                            : 'login-password-error'
                    }
                    aria-invalid={
                        errors.password
                            !== undefined
                    }
                    autoComplete="current-password"
                    className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2 text-slate-100 outline-none focus:border-slate-400 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
                    disabled={disabled}
                    id="login-password"
                    name="password"
                    onChange={(event) => {
                        setPassword(
                            event.target.value,
                        );

                        clearFieldError(
                            'password',
                        );

                        notifyInputChange();
                    }}
                    type="password"
                    value={password}
                />

                {
                    errors.password
                        !== undefined
                        ? (
                            <p
                                className="text-sm text-red-300"
                                id="login-password-error"
                                role="alert"
                            >
                                {errors.password}
                            </p>
                        )
                        : null
                }
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
                <label
                    className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-200"
                    htmlFor="login-tenant-uuid"
                >
                    Tenant UUID
                </label>

                <input
                    aria-describedby={
                        errors.tenantUuid
                            === undefined
                            ? 'login-tenant-uuid-help'
                            : 'login-tenant-uuid-help login-tenant-uuid-error'
                    }
                    aria-invalid={
                        errors.tenantUuid
                            !== undefined
                    }
                    autoCapitalize="none"
                    autoComplete="off"
                    className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-sm text-slate-100 outline-none focus:border-slate-400 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
                    disabled={disabled}
                    id="login-tenant-uuid"
                    name="tenantUuid"
                    onChange={(event) => {
                        setTenantUuid(
                            event.target.value,
                        );

                        clearFieldError(
                            'tenantUuid',
                        );

                        notifyInputChange();
                    }}
                    spellCheck={false}
                    type="text"
                    value={tenantUuid}
                />

                <p
                    className="text-sm text-slate-400"
                    id="login-tenant-uuid-help"
                >
                    Masukkan identifier Tenant EduCore yang diberikan kepada Anda.
                </p>

                {
                    errors.tenantUuid
                        !== undefined
                        ? (
                            <p
                                className="text-sm text-red-300"
                                id="login-tenant-uuid-error"
                                role="alert"
                            >
                                {errors.tenantUuid}
                            </p>
                        )
                        : null
                }
            </div>

            <button
                className="w-full rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-slate-950 transition hover:bg-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
                disabled={disabled}
                type="submit"
            >
                Masuk
            </button>
        </form>
    );
}
```

## 4. Tambahkan failure-capable harness pada `LoginPage.test.tsx`

Di interface `RuntimeHarness`, tambahkan:

```ts
    setState(
        nextState: BrowserAuthState,
    ): void;
```

Lalu sebelum `return { runtime, loginRequests }`, tambahkan helper:

```ts
    function setState(
        nextState: BrowserAuthState,
    ): void {
        state =
            nextState;

        publish();
    }
```

Dan ubah return menjadi:

```ts
    return {
        runtime,
        loginRequests,
        setState,
    };
```

Tambahkan tiga test berikut ke `describe('LoginPage', ...)`:

`setState()` belum dipakai pada tiga test di atas, tetapi kita tetap **tidak perlu menambahkannya** jika tidak ada test yang menggunakannya. Jadi untuk menjaga KISS, **jangan lakukan modification `RuntimeHarness`/`setState` di atas**.

Cukup tambahkan ketiga test; existing harness sudah menerima initial `BrowserAuthState`.

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Runtime tetap authoritative

Kita tidak melakukan:

```ts
authentication.failure = null
```

dan tidak menambah runtime action hanya demi UI.

Sebaliknya:

```text
runtime failure
→ tetap ada

failureDismissed
→ UI-local presentation state saja
```

Technical truth dan presentation state tetap terpisah.

---

### 2. Failure baru dapat muncul lagi

Saat user mulai mengetik:

```text
failureDismissed = true
```

Jika kemudian user submit lagi:

```ts
setFailureDismissed(false);
await runtime.login(request);
```

Maka bila attempt kedua gagal, failure presentation akan muncul kembali.

Jadi kita tidak membuat error permanently hidden.

---

### 3. Raw backend validation tidak pernah masuk JSX

`LoginPage` hanya menerima:

```ts
presentLoginFailure(
    authentication.failure,
)
```

dan `LoginForm` hanya menerima:

```text
safe message
safe fieldErrors
```

Tidak ada:

```tsx
authentication.failure.error.message
```

di UI.

---

### 4. Local errors menang atas server errors

Merge:

```ts
{
    ...externalErrors,
    ...localErrors,
}
```

artinya:

```text
server says email invalid
+
current local input now empty
→ "Email wajib diisi."
```

lebih relevan daripada stale server validation message.

Ini menjaga validation hierarchy:

```text
current local truth
> previous server field presentation
```

---

### 5. Editing input dismisses current server feedback

Kita sengaja menyembunyikan **seluruh server presentation**, bukan satu field saja.

Alasannya login merupakan satu credential tuple:

```text
email
password
tenant_uuid
```

Jika salah satu berubah, previous authentication outcome tidak lagi merepresentasikan credential tuple saat ini.

Untuk `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`, ini khususnya penting karena kita memang tidak mengetahui field mana yang salah.

---

### 6. Fresh anonymous tetap bersih

Karena FEI-10E.1A sudah mengunci:

```text
BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
→ null
```

initial anonymous route tidak akan menampilkan failure card.

# Troubleshooting

Jika `LoginForm` test gagal karena dua `role="alert"`, jangan menggunakan `getByRole('alert')` tanpa selector. Gunakan text-specific assertions seperti kode final di atas.

Jika external server error tidak hilang setelah edit, pastikan setiap `onChange` memanggil:

```ts
notifyInputChange();
```

dan `LoginPage` memasang:

```tsx
onInputChange={
    handleFormInputChange
}
```

Jika server field error masih terlihat bersamaan dengan new local error sebelum parent rerender, local error memang harus menang karena:

```ts
{
    ...externalErrors,
    ...localErrors,
}
```

Jika fresh anonymous route menampilkan generic error, **jangan workaround di `LoginPage`**. Itu berarti FEI-10E.1A presenter suppression tidak lagi bekerja dan presenter regression harus diperiksa.

Jika TypeScript meminta cast pada `externalErrors`, jangan gunakan `as any`.

```text
externalErrors?: LoginFormErrors
```

Ini efek yang benar dari `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true`.

# FEI-10E.2A — Exact Optional Property Alignment

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Dengan:

```json
"exactOptionalPropertyTypes": true
```

dua hal berikut berbeda:

```ts
externalErrors?: LoginFormErrors
```

dan:

```ts
externalErrors: LoginFormErrors | undefined
```

Optional property berarti:

> property boleh tidak ada.

Bukan:

> property selalu ada dan nilainya boleh `undefined`.

Saat ini JSX menghasilkan explicit:

```tsx
externalErrors={
    failurePresentation?.fieldErrors
}
```

yang dapat menjadi:

```ts
externalErrors={undefined}
```

Itulah yang ditolak TypeScript.

Solusi paling sederhana dan deterministic:

```text
failure presentation ada
→ fieldErrors

failure presentation tidak ada
→ {}
```

Tidak perlu memperlebar contract `LoginFormProps` menjadi `LoginFormErrors | undefined`.

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Ubah hanya:

```text
frontend/src/app/LoginPage.tsx
```

Jangan ubah:

```text
frontend/src/app/auth/LoginForm.tsx
frontend/src/app/auth/login-failure.ts
frontend/src/platform/auth/*
frontend/src/platform/api/*
frontend/src/app/routing/*
```

---

## Kode Lengkap

Di `LoginPage.tsx`, cari:

```tsx
externalErrors={
    failurePresentation
        ?.fieldErrors
}
```

ganti menjadi:

```tsx
externalErrors={
    failurePresentation
        ?.fieldErrors
    ?? {}
}
```

Jadi bagian final `LoginForm`:

```tsx
<LoginForm
    disabled={
        formDisabled
    }
    externalErrors={
        failurePresentation
            ?.fieldErrors
        ?? {}
    }
    formError={
        failurePresentation
            ?.message
        ?? null
    }
    onInputChange={
        handleFormInputChange
    }
    onValidatedSubmit={
        handleValidatedSubmit
    }
/>
```

Untuk melakukan perubahan secara targeted:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "frontend/src/app/LoginPage.tsx"
)

text = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8"
)

old = """                        externalErrors={
                            failurePresentation
                                ?.fieldErrors
                        }
"""

new = """                        externalErrors={
                            failurePresentation
                                ?.fieldErrors
                            ?? {}
                        }
"""

count = text.count(old)

if count != 1:
    raise SystemExit(
        f"Expected exactly one externalErrors block, found {count}."
    )

path.write_text(
    text.replace(
        old,
        new,
    ),
    encoding="utf-8",
)

print(
    "Aligned externalErrors with exactOptionalPropertyTypes."
)
PY
```

---

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Jangan ubah prop type menjadi lebih longgar

Kita bisa saja menulis:

```ts
readonly externalErrors?:
    LoginFormErrors | undefined;
```

tetapi itu memperlebar public component contract tanpa kebutuhan.

`LoginForm` sudah memiliki default:

```ts
externalErrors = {}
```

dan secara semantik memang bekerja dengan object:

```text
ada field errors → object berisi errors
tidak ada error → empty object
```

Jadi caller lebih baik memberikan:

```ts
{}
```

daripada explicit `undefined`.

### 2. `formError` tidak bermasalah

Contract-nya:

```ts
readonly formError?:
    string | null;
```

dan caller memberikan:

```ts
failurePresentation?.message ?? null
```

jadi nilainya selalu:

```text
string | null
```

bukan `undefined`.

Tidak perlu diubah.

### 3. Tidak ada unsafe cast

Jangan menyelesaikan ini dengan:

```ts
as LoginFormErrors
```

atau:

```ts
as any
```

TypeScript menemukan ambiguity yang valid; kita hilangkan ambiguity dari data flow.

### 4. Behavior tidak berubah

Sebelumnya runtime intent:

```text
no failure
→ no external field errors
```

Sesudah fix:

```text
no failure
→ {}
→ no external field errors
```

Jadi ini murni type-contract alignment.

## Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript masih menunjukkan error yang sama, pastikan expression final benar-benar:

```tsx
failurePresentation
    ?.fieldErrors
?? {}
```

bukan:

```tsx
failurePresentation
    ?.fieldErrors
```

Jika formatter/parser mempermasalahkan layout `??`, bentuk ini ekuivalen:

```tsx
externalErrors={
    failurePresentation === null
        ? {}
        : failurePresentation.fieldErrors
}
```

Tetapi gunakan versi `?? {}` terlebih dahulu karena lebih sederhana.

Jangan mengubah `tsconfig.json` atau mematikan `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`. Strictness ini justru membantu menjaga contract component tetap presisi.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Kenapa ketiga field diuji?

Login adalah satu credential tuple:

```text
email
+
password
+
tenant_uuid
```

Previous login outcome merepresentasikan **seluruh tuple tersebut**.

Contoh:

```text
attempt #1
email=A
password=B
tenant=C
→ AUTHENTICATION_FAILED
```

Jika user mengubah password saja:

```text
email=A
password=D
tenant=C
```

maka error dari attempt #1 sudah stale.

Hal yang sama berlaku jika email atau Tenant UUID berubah.

Karena itu setiap credential field harus mengirim:

```ts
onInputChange?.();
```

### 2. LoginForm tidak tahu kenapa callback dipanggil

`LoginForm` hanya mengatakan:

```text
"credential input changed"
```

Ia tidak melakukan:

```ts
setFailureDismissed(true)
```

karena itu application state milik `LoginPage`.

Separation tetap:

```text
LoginForm
→ input event

LoginPage
→ failure presentation lifecycle
```

### 3. Tidak menguji implementation detail

Kita tidak memeriksa:

```ts
notifyInputChange()
```

secara internal.

Yang diuji adalah public component contract:

```tsx
<LoginForm
    onInputChange={callback}
/>
```

kemudian real user interaction.

Ini membuat test tahan terhadap refactor internal.

```text
→ resolving-context
→ /auth/me
→ BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
→ membership-context-required
→ LoginRouteBoundary keluar dari /login
→ protected route
→ MembershipContextProvider
→ discovery / selection-required
```

Kita khususnya ingin memastikan **tidak ada loop** seperti:

```text
/login
↔ protected route
↔ membership-context-required
↔ /login
```

dan tidak ada hidden ownership:

```text
LoginPage → Membership switch   ❌
LoginPage → Workspace bootstrap ❌
LoginPage → capabilities        ❌
```

Audit ini juga menentukan apakah masih perlu production implementation setelah FEI-10E atau tinggal menambah lifecycle proof.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Audit ini sengaja tidak menambahkan redirect manual setelah:

```ts
await runtime.login(request);
```

Karena successful navigation harus tetap berasal dari perubahan authoritative Auth state:

```text
runtime
→ authenticated / membership-context-required
→ React subscription
→ LoginRouteBoundary rerender
→ Navigate
```

Bukan imperative flow:

```ts
await runtime.login(request);
navigate('/dashboard');
```

Untuk Membership juga sama. `membership-context-required` bukan alasan `LoginPage` memilih Membership. Itu hanya sinyal bahwa authentication berhasil tetapi contextual Membership truth masih perlu diselesaikan oleh Membership lifecycle.

Dengan demikian kita menjaga dependency direction:

```text
Authentication
      ↓
Membership
      ↓
Workspace
      ↓
Capability
```

bukan:

```text
LoginPage
├─ Auth
├─ Membership
├─ Workspace
└─ Authorization
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Full suite sekarang penting

Sampai sekarang kita banyak menjalankan targeted regression.

Final gate harus menjawab:

```text
"Apakah FEI-10 merusak area frontend lain?"
```

bukan hanya:

```text
"Apakah LoginForm bekerja?"
```

Karena itu kita jalankan seluruh frontend test suite.

### 2. Build production juga wajib

Typecheck saja tidak membuktikan bundler graph valid.

Build memastikan:

```text
React imports
Vite aliases
generated API types
tree graph
production compilation
```

semuanya valid.

### 3. Security scans merupakan architectural invariants

Kita ingin membuktikan tidak ada:

```text
bearer token browser storage
manual Authorization bearer
password logging/storage
password normalization
raw backend diagnostic rendering
manual CSRF in UI
manual login HTTP
```

Itu lebih penting daripada sekadar UI terlihat benar.

### 4. Return destination tetap routing-owned

FEI-10 harus selesai dengan boundary:

```text
LoginPage
→ authentication intent only

LoginRouteBoundary
→ returnTo consumption

ProtectedRouteBoundary
→ returnTo production
```

Login form tidak boleh menjadi routing controller.

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita **belum langsung membuat test Playwright**.

Pertama kita harus mengetahui bagaimana browser nyata akan menjalankan EduCore di environment lokal Anda:

```text
Chromium
   ↓
frontend origin
   ↓
Laravel/BFF origin
   ↓
BrowserSession cookie
   ↓
CSRF
   ↓
canonical API
```

Ada beberapa detail yang tidak boleh kita tebak:

- apakah Playwright sudah terpasang;
- apakah sudah ada `playwright.config.*`;
- command apa yang menjalankan frontend;
- Laravel berjalan di URL/port mana;
- apakah Vite dev server proxy ke Laravel atau browser harus mengakses Laravel langsung;
- bagaimana SPA fallback saat membuka `/login` atau `/` langsung;
- apakah environment testing memakai HTTP atau HTTPS;
- bagaimana `Secure` cookie policy bekerja di local environment;
- database mana yang aman dipakai E2E;
- apakah fixture user/Tenant login sudah tersedia;
- apakah real login E2E bisa dibuat deterministic tanpa merusak development DB.

Tujuan FEI-10H.0 adalah memperoleh semua fakta tersebut terlebih dahulu.

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Playwright tidak boleh memakai mocked backend

FEI-10H nanti harus berbeda dari Vitest/MSW:

```text
Vitest integration
Browser-like DOM
→ MSW/fake runtime

Playwright E2E
real Chromium
→ real network
→ real Laravel BFF
→ real session/database
```

Kalau Playwright masih route-intercept login API dan mengembalikan fake response:

```ts
page.route(
    '**/browser/auth/login',
    ...
)
```

itu **bukan** gate yang kita cari.

Untuk FEI-10H, endpoint authentication harus benar-benar Laravel.

---

### 2. Kita harus mengisolasi database E2E

Real browser bukan berarti kita boleh menggunakan data development sembarangan.

Ideal akhirnya:

```text
dedicated E2E environment
        ↓
dedicated E2E database
        ↓
deterministic fixture
        ↓
Playwright
        ↓
cleanup/reset
```

Saya tidak akan meminta Anda membuat user/password manual di development DB sebelum audit fixture strategy selesai.

---

### 3. Secure cookie adalah bagian penting

Architecture kita mensyaratkan BrowserSession aman.

Tetapi local development sering berjalan:

```text
http://localhost
```

sedangkan cookie production mungkin:

```text
Secure
HttpOnly
SameSite=Strict
```

Kita perlu mengetahui policy Laravel aktual sebelum menentukan test server topology.

Kita tidak akan “memperbaiki” real-browser test dengan melemahkan production security secara sembarang.

---

### 4. Same-origin harus benar-benar dibuktikan

Target architecture kita:

```text
browser
        ↓
same-origin Laravel Browser BFF
```

Jadi kita perlu memastikan Vite/local environment tidak tanpa sengaja berubah menjadi:

```text
localhost:5173
        ↓ cross-origin
localhost:8000
```

dengan behavior cookie yang berbeda dari production.

Kalau development memakai proxy, Playwright harus menjalankan topology yang sesuai contract tersebut.

---

### 5. Jangan commit credentials

Nanti Playwright membutuhkan login credentials.

Password test tidak boleh:

```ts
const password =
    'production-password';
```

dan jangan disimpan dari akun nyata.

Kita akan menggunakan deterministic E2E fixture atau environment variable khusus testing setelah mengetahui backend fixture capability.

---

# Troubleshooting

Jika:

```text
@playwright/test: not installed
```

itu **bukan kegagalan** FEI-10H.0. Jangan install apa pun dulu. Setelah audit, kita akan menambah dependency/config secara terkontrol pada step berikutnya.

Jika:

```bash
php artisan route:list --columns=...
```

tidak didukung Laravel version Anda, jalankan:

```bash
php artisan route:list
```

dan kirim hasil relevant-nya.

Jika `php artisan tinker --execute` tidak tersedia atau gagal, cukup kirim error-nya. **Jangan** mengubah config.

Jika `php artisan about` memperlihatkan detail yang menurut Anda sensitif, boleh hapus bagian tersebut sebelum mengirim. Kita hanya membutuhkan environment/config topology, bukan secret.

Yang paling penting: **jangan kirim value password, `APP_KEY`, database password, bearer token, cookie value, session ID, atau secret lainnya.**

# FEI-10H.1 - Real Browser Same-Origin Playwright Foundation

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Ini akan menjadi **test Chromium nyata pertama** kita.

Kita membangun topology lokal:

```text
Real Chromium
     │
     │ http://127.0.0.1:5173
     ▼
Vite SPA
     │
     │ /api/*
     │ Vite reverse proxy
     ▼
Laravel
http://127.0.0.1:8000
     │
     ▼
real BrowserSession middleware
real canonical /api/v1/auth/me
```

Dari perspektif browser:

```text
SPA       http://127.0.0.1:5173/login
API       http://127.0.0.1:5173/api/v1/auth/me
```

Jadi browser benar-benar melakukan **same-origin request**. Proxy hanya meneruskan request tersebut server-side ke Laravel.

Test pertama:

```text
Chromium nyata
→ buka /login
→ React benar-benar bootstrap
→ GET /api/v1/auth/me
→ Vite proxy
→ Laravel nyata
→ real 401 BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
→ LoginPage tetap tampil
```

Tidak ada MSW, fake runtime, atau `page.route()`.


Jangan menyentuh:

```text

frontend/src/platform/*
Modules/*

resources/views/welcome1.blade.php

```

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Install Playwright test runner

Dari root repository:

```bash
npm install --save-dev @playwright/test
```

Lalu install **hanya Chromium**:

```bash
npx playwright install chromium
```

Browser binary tersebut adalah local tooling dan bukan file yang kita commit.

---

## 2. Tambahkan script E2E

Jalankan:

```bash
node - <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');

const path =
    'package.json';

const pkg =
    JSON.parse(
        fs.readFileSync(
            path,
            'utf8',
        ),
    );

pkg.scripts ??= {};

if (
    pkg.scripts['frontend:e2e']
        !== undefined
) {
    throw new Error(
        'frontend:e2e script already exists; refusing to overwrite it.',
    );
}

pkg.scripts['frontend:e2e'] =
    'playwright test --config frontend/playwright.config.ts';

fs.writeFileSync(
    path,
    `${JSON.stringify(
        pkg,
        null,
        4,
    )}\n`,
);

console.log(
    'Added frontend:e2e script.',
);
NODE
```

---

## 3. Ganti `frontend/vite.config.ts`

```ts
import {
    fileURLToPath,
    URL,
} from 'node:url';

import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import {
    defineConfig,
} from 'vite';

const frontendRoot =
    fileURLToPath(
        new URL(
            '.',
            import.meta.url,
        ),
    );

/*
 * The browser must observe canonical API traffic as
 * same-origin traffic.
 *
 * Local Vite therefore acts as the development reverse
 * proxy only; Laravel remains the Browser BFF owner.
 *
 * CI or another development environment may override the
 * target without changing application source.
 */
const browserBffOrigin =
    process.env
        .EDUCORE_BFF_ORIGIN
    ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:8000';

export default defineConfig({
    root:
        frontendRoot,

    plugins: [
        react(),
        tailwindcss(),
    ],

    resolve: {
        alias: {
            '@':
                fileURLToPath(
                    new URL(
                        './src',
                        import.meta.url,
                    ),
                ),
        },
    },

    cacheDir:
        fileURLToPath(
            new URL(
                '../node_modules/.vite/educore-frontend',
                import.meta.url,
            ),
        ),

    server: {
        /*
         * Browser-visible requests remain:
         *
         *     http://127.0.0.1:5173/api/...
         *
         * The proxy forwards those requests to Laravel
         * without moving cross-origin responsibility into
         * React application code.
         */
        proxy: {
            '/api': {
                target:
                    browserBffOrigin,

                changeOrigin:
                    true,
            },
        },
    },

    build: {
        outDir:
            'dist',

        emptyOutDir:
            true,
    },
});
```

Ini **bukan API mocking**.

Tidak ada response palsu di sini. Vite hanya bertindak sebagai local reverse proxy.

---

## 4. Buat `frontend/playwright.config.ts`

```bash
mkdir -p frontend/e2e

cat > frontend/playwright.config.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    defineConfig,
    devices,
} from '@playwright/test';

export default defineConfig({
    testDir:
        './e2e',

    /*
     * Later authenticated tests will share one
     * deterministic backend fixture environment.
     *
     * Start conservatively with one worker rather than
     * inventing concurrent database isolation before the
     * fixture contract exists.
     */
    fullyParallel:
        false,

    workers:
        1,

    forbidOnly:
        true,

    retries:
        0,

    reporter:
        'list',

    timeout:
        30_000,

    expect: {
        timeout:
            5_000,
    },

    use: {
        baseURL:
            'http://127.0.0.1:5173',

        trace:
            'retain-on-failure',

        screenshot:
            'only-on-failure',
    },

    /*
     * Keep browser artifacts under node_modules so failed
     * E2E runs do not pollute the repository worktree.
     */
    outputDir:
        '../node_modules/.cache/educore-playwright',

    webServer: [
        {
            command:
                'php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000',

            url:
                'http://127.0.0.1:8000/up',

            timeout:
                120_000,

            reuseExistingServer:
                false,
        },

        {
            command:
                'npm run frontend:dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort',

            url:
                'http://127.0.0.1:5173/login',

            timeout:
                120_000,

            reuseExistingServer:
                false,
        },
    ],

    projects: [
        {
            name:
                'chromium',

            use: {
                ...devices[
                    'Desktop Chrome'
                ],
            },
        },
    ],
});
EOF
```

### Kenapa `workers: 1`?

Karena nanti kita akan menggunakan real database fixture.

Sebelum fixture isolation dirancang, jangan mengasumsikan:

```text
parallel browser
+
shared Laravel DB
=
safe
```

KISS dan deterministic terlebih dahulu.

## 5. Buat real-browser test pertama

Buat:

`frontend/e2e/authentication.spec.ts`

```bash
cat > frontend/e2e/authentication.spec.ts <<'EOF'
import {
    expect,
    test,
} from '@playwright/test';

test(
    'real browser reaches the Laravel BrowserSession authentication boundary through the same-origin BFF path',
    async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        /*
         * Register the observer before navigation because
         * BrowserAuthProvider performs canonical bootstrap
         * immediately after the React application mounts.
         */
        const authenticationResponse =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) => {
                    const url =
                        new URL(
                            response.url(),
                        );

                    return (
                        url.origin
                            === 'http://127.0.0.1:5173'
                        && url.pathname
                            === '/api/v1/auth/me'
                    );
                },
            );

        await page.goto(
            '/login',
        );

        const response =
            await authenticationResponse;

        /*
         * The browser only knows the Vite origin.
         *
         * Seeing the canonical response under port 5173
         * proves that browser API traffic remained
         * same-origin while Vite forwarded it to Laravel.
         */
        expect(
            response.url(),
        ).toBe(
            'http://127.0.0.1:5173/api/v1/auth/me',
        );

        expect(
            response.status(),
        ).toBe(
            401,
        );

        const body:
            unknown =
            await response.json();

        expect(
            body,
        ).toMatchObject({
            status:
                'error',

            code:
                'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED',
        });

        /*
         * Canonical BrowserSession transport must never
         * manufacture browser-side Bearer authorization.
         */
        expect(
            response
                .request()
                .headers()[
                    'authorization'
                ],
        ).toBeUndefined();

        /*
         * This is real React rendered by real Chromium,
         * after the real Laravel authentication boundary
         * established authoritative anonymous truth.
         */
        await expect(
            page.getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Masuk ke EduCore',
                },
            ),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await expect(
            page.getByLabel(
                'Email',
            ),
        ).toBeEnabled();

        await expect(
            page.getByLabel(
                'Password',
            ),
        ).toBeEnabled();

        await expect(
            page.getByLabel(
                'Tenant UUID',
            ),
        ).toBeEnabled();

        /*
         * Expected anonymous bootstrap must not surface as
         * a failed-login message.
         */
        await expect(
            page.getByText(
                'Permintaan masuk tidak dapat diproses. Silakan coba lagi.',
            ),
        ).toHaveCount(
            0,
        );

        expect(
            page.url(),
        ).toBe(
            'http://127.0.0.1:5173/login',
        );
    },
);
EOF
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Ini benar-benar browser test

Berbeda dari test sebelumnya:

```text
Vitest
→ jsdom
→ MSW
```

sekarang:

```text
Playwright
→ executable Chromium
→ Vite HTTP server
→ real network socket
→ PHP Laravel server
→ real middleware/controllers
```

Tidak ada `apiMockServer`.

Tidak ada:

```ts
page.route(...)
```

Tidak ada fake response.

---

## 2. Kita belum menggunakan credential

Ini disengaja.

Test pertama hanya membuktikan plumbing:

```text
Browser
→ SPA
→ canonical auth bootstrap
→ Laravel
→ BrowserSession authentication boundary
→ React state
```

Jadi belum ada risiko menggunakan:

```text
development user
development password
development tenant
```

Browser login yang benar-benar menulis BrowserSession baru dilakukan setelah kita membangun dedicated E2E fixture/database.

---

## 3. Same-origin sekarang bisa dibuktikan, bukan diasumsikan

Current audit menemukan `frontend/vite.config.ts` tidak memiliki proxy. `Pasted text.txt`

Tanpa proxy:

```text
browser @ :5173
→ /api/*
→ Vite
→ gagal / bukan Laravel
```

Menulis frontend code seperti:

```ts
fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/...')
```

bukan solusi karena itu menciptakan cross-origin architecture.

Reverse proxy adalah layer yang benar:

```text
browser
→ /api/*
→ same origin
→ infrastructure proxy
→ Laravel
```

React tidak mengetahui backend physical origin.

---

## 4. Kita tidak mengubah production security policy

Audit menemukan local:

```text
session.secure    null
same_site         lax
```

sementara production security policy secara eksplisit mengharuskan secure/http-only/strict. `Pasted text.txt`

Kita **tidak mengubah policy production** untuk membuat Playwright jalan.

FEI-10H nanti mempunyai dua kelas proof:

```text
real-browser functional topology
+
backend security-policy tests
```

Dan nantinya jika diperlukan kita dapat menambahkan HTTPS browser gate secara terpisah. Jangan mematikan `HttpOnly`, Secure production enforcement, atau policy lain.

---

## 5. Kenapa belum seed login user?

PHPUnit `BrowserLoginTest` memang menggunakan contoh:

```text
password = secret123
```

tetapi fixture tersebut dibuat oleh PHPUnit dan dibersihkan oleh `RefreshDatabase`. `Pasted text.txt`

Jadi salah jika Playwright menganggap:

```text
secret123 pasti ada di development database
```

Tidak ada bukti itu benar.

Kita akan membuat E2E fixture secara eksplisit pada langkah berikutnya.

# Troubleshooting

### `Executable doesn't exist`

Jika Playwright memberi:

```text
Executable doesn't exist ...
```

jalankan lagi:

```bash
npx playwright install chromium
```

Jangan install semua browser dulu.

### Port 8000 sudah dipakai

Jangan matikan server lain secara acak.

Cek:

```bash
netstat -ano | grep ':8000'
```

Kirim outputnya. Kita align port secara deterministic.

Hal yang sama untuk `5173`.

### Laravel `/up` gagal

Jalankan:

```bash
php artisan serve \
  --host=127.0.0.1 \
  --port=8000
```

lalu dari terminal lain:

```bash
curl -i \
  http://127.0.0.1:8000/up
```

Kita perlu memperbaiki backend-server startup sebelum mengubah Playwright.

### `/auth/me` mendapat 404 dari Vite

Berarti proxy belum aktif.

Periksa:

```bash
grep -n -A15 \
  "proxy:" \
  frontend/vite.config.ts
```

Jangan mengubah frontend API client menjadi absolute Laravel URL.

### `/auth/me` mendapat 500 dari Laravel

Jangan ubah E2E expectation menjadi 500.

Kirim response/backend log. Kemungkinan perlu melihat session/database environment.

# FEI-10H.1A - Playwright/Vitest Runner Isolation & Repository CWD

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita ingin membuat boundary test runner eksplisit:

```text
Vitest
→ *.test.ts
→ *.test.tsx
→ *.spec.ts[x] milik Vitest bila ada
→ TIDAK melihat Playwright

Playwright
→ *.e2e.ts saja
```

Dan process topology:

```text
frontend/playwright.config.ts
        ↓
repositoryRoot
├─ php artisan serve
└─ npm run frontend:dev
```

Dengan begitu:

```text
test runner ownership
+
server working directory
```

tidak lagi bergantung pada implicit defaults.

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Ubah:

```text
frontend/playwright.config.ts
```

Rename:

```text
frontend/e2e/authentication.spec.ts
↓
frontend/e2e/authentication.e2e.ts
```

Tidak perlu mengubah:

```text
vitest.config.ts
package.json
frontend/vite.config.ts
frontend/src/*
Modules/*
```

`package.json` dan lockfile tetap mempunyai perubahan instalasi Playwright dari H.1 sebelumnya; jangan revert.

---

## Kode Lengkap

### 1. Rename Playwright test

```bash
mv \
  frontend/e2e/authentication.spec.ts \
  frontend/e2e/authentication.e2e.ts
```

---

### 2. Ganti `frontend/playwright.config.ts`

Gunakan penuh:

```ts
import {
    fileURLToPath,
    URL,
} from 'node:url';

import {
    defineConfig,
    devices,
} from '@playwright/test';

const repositoryRoot =
    fileURLToPath(
        new URL(
            '../',
            import.meta.url,
        ),
    );

export default defineConfig({
    testDir:
        './e2e',

    /*
     * Playwright E2E files deliberately use a dedicated
     * suffix so Vitest's normal *.test.* / *.spec.*
     * discovery cannot claim the same files.
     */
    testMatch:
        '**/*.e2e.ts',

    /*
     * Authenticated E2E tests will later share a
     * deterministic backend fixture environment.
     *
     * Keep execution serial until database isolation
     * is explicitly implemented.
     */
    fullyParallel:
        false,

    workers:
        1,

    forbidOnly:
        true,

    retries:
        0,

    reporter:
        'list',

    timeout:
        30_000,

    expect: {
        timeout:
            5_000,
    },

    use: {
        baseURL:
            'http://127.0.0.1:5173',

        trace:
            'retain-on-failure',

        screenshot:
            'only-on-failure',
    },

    outputDir:
        '../node_modules/.cache/educore-playwright',

    webServer: [
        {
            /*
             * Playwright resolves web-server commands from
             * the configuration directory by default.
             *
             * Laravel's artisan entry point lives at the
             * repository root, so make that ownership
             * explicit rather than relying on caller cwd.
             */
            cwd:
                repositoryRoot,

            command:
                'php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000',

            url:
                'http://127.0.0.1:8000/up',

            timeout:
                120_000,

            reuseExistingServer:
                false,
        },

        {
            /*
             * package.json also belongs to the repository
             * root, therefore the frontend npm script uses
             * the same explicit working directory.
             */
            cwd:
                repositoryRoot,

            command:
                'npm run frontend:dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort',

            url:
                'http://127.0.0.1:5173/login',

            timeout:
                120_000,

            reuseExistingServer:
                false,
        },
    ],

    projects: [
        {
            name:
                'chromium',

            use: {
                ...devices[
                    'Desktop Chrome'
                ],
            },
        },
    ],
});
```

Playwright secara resmi mendukung `testMatch` untuk menentukan file mana yang menjadi Playwright test, jadi suffix `.e2e.ts` adalah boundary runner yang eksplisit. ([Playwright](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-testconfig?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Kenapa tidak menambah exclusion ke Vitest?

Kita bisa menulis:

```text
exclude frontend/e2e/**
```

tetapi itu membuat Vitest mengetahui struktur Playwright.

Lebih bersih jika ownership datang dari nama file:

```text
Vitest       *.test.* / *.spec.*
Playwright   *.e2e.ts
```

Vitest secara default hanya mengoleksi pola `test`/`spec`, sedangkan Playwright dapat dikonfigurasi khusus dengan `testMatch`. ([Vitest](https://main.vitest.dev/guide/learn/writing-tests?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Ini lebih DRY karena kita tidak perlu mempertahankan dua daftar exclusion yang saling bergantung.

Jangan memakai:

```ts
cwd: '..'
```

jika kita bisa membuat path absolut deterministic.

Dengan:

```ts
const repositoryRoot =
    fileURLToPath(
        new URL('../', import.meta.url),
    );
```

config tetap bekerja terlepas command dipanggil dari:

```text
repo root
frontend/
IDE
CI runner
```

Playwright menjelaskan bahwa default CWD web server adalah directory config, persis penyebab `artisan` tidak ditemukan pada run Anda. ([Playwright](https://playwright.dev/docs/test-webserver?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```text
→ Laravel
```

bahkan terbentuk.

Jadi jangan memperbaikinya dengan:

```text

React change
proxy change
session config change
```

Semua itu salah layer.


dengan:

# FEI-10H.1B - Real Anonymous Bootstrap Chain Alignment

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Canonical `/api/v1/auth/me` adalah tenant-scoped BrowserSession read.

Untuk BrowserSession transport, endpoint tersebut membutuhkan:

```text
X-EduCore-Membership-Id
```

sebagai locator. OpenAPI kita bahkan sudah mengunci locator tersebut sebagai conditional BrowserSession locator untuk `/auth/me`. `Pasted markdown.md`

Lebih penting lagi, runtime backend melakukan pengecekan locator **sebelum** pengecekan apakah BrowserSession sudah authenticated:

```text
no X-EduCore-Membership-Id
        ↓
403 BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
```

sedangkan:

```text
locator tersedia
+
BrowserSession tidak authenticated
        ↓
401 BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
```

Urutan tersebut terlihat langsung pada middleware audit: pengecekan missing membership menghasilkan `BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` di awal middleware, sementara `BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED` berada di bagian akhir. `bff-9-2b-runtime-error-status-evidence.txt`

Jadi fresh browser flow yang sebenarnya adalah:

```text
Chromium membuka /login
        ↓
GET /api/v1/auth/me
tanpa Membership locator
        ↓
403 BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
        ↓
AuthRuntime:
membership-context-required
        ↓
MembershipContextProvider
        ↓
GET /api/v1/user/my-memberships
        ↓
endpoint user-scope
tidak membutuhkan Membership locator
        ↓
fresh anonymous BrowserSession
        ↓
401 BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
        ↓
MembershipRuntime:
authentication.observeFailure()
        ↓
AuthRuntime → anonymous
        ↓
Login UI authoritative
```

Frontend Membership runtime memang sudah dirancang persis demikian: ketika Membership discovery mendapat `BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED`, failure diteruskan ke Auth runtime lalu Membership state di-reset. `Pasted text.txt`

Jadi **jangan ubah Laravel**, dan jangan memaksa `/auth/me` menjadi 401.

E2E kita yang perlu disejajarkan dengan canonical lifecycle.

```ts
import {
    expect,
    test,
} from '@playwright/test';

test(
    'real anonymous browser resolves canonical Membership context before becoming authoritative login state',
    async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        /*
         * Register both observers before navigation.
         *
         * The real anonymous BrowserSession lifecycle is:
         *
         * /auth/me
         *     -> Membership locator required
         *
         * /user/my-memberships
         *     -> BrowserSession authentication required
         *
         * The second response establishes authoritative
         * anonymous authentication truth.
         */
        const authenticationContextResponse =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) => {
                    const url =
                        new URL(
                            response.url(),
                        );

                    return (
                        url.origin
                            === 'http://127.0.0.1:5173'
                        && url.pathname
                            === '/api/v1/auth/me'
                    );
                },
            );

        const membershipDiscoveryResponse =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) => {
                    const url =
                        new URL(
                            response.url(),
                        );

                    return (
                        url.origin
                            === 'http://127.0.0.1:5173'
                        && url.pathname
                            === '/api/v1/user/my-memberships'
                    );
                },
            );

        await page.goto(
            '/login',
        );

        /*
         * Tenant-scoped canonical BrowserSession reads
         * cannot select a Membership credential without
         * the tab-local Membership locator.
         */
        const contextResponse =
            await authenticationContextResponse;

        expect(
            contextResponse.status(),
        ).toBe(
            403,
        );

        const contextBody:
            unknown =
            await contextResponse.json();

        expect(
            contextBody,
        ).toMatchObject({
            status:
                'error',

            code:
                'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
        });

        /*
         * BrowserSession transport must never rely on
         * JavaScript-supplied Bearer authorization.
         */
        expect(
            contextResponse
                .request()
                .headers()[
                    'authorization'
                ],
        ).toBeUndefined();

        /*
         * Membership discovery is intentionally user-scoped
         * and therefore requires no Membership locator.
         *
         * On a fresh anonymous BrowserSession it becomes the
         * request that establishes authoritative anonymous
         * authentication truth.
         */
        const discoveryResponse =
            await membershipDiscoveryResponse;

        expect(
            discoveryResponse.status(),
        ).toBe(
            401,
        );

        const discoveryBody:
            unknown =
            await discoveryResponse.json();

        expect(
            discoveryBody,
        ).toMatchObject({
            status:
                'error',

            code:
                'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED',
        });

        expect(
            discoveryResponse
                .request()
                .headers()[
                    'authorization'
                ],
        ).toBeUndefined();

        /*
         * The application must settle back on the public
         * login boundary after the two-step canonical
         * anonymous resolution.
         */
        await expect(
            page.getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Masuk ke EduCore',
                },
            ),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await expect(
            page.getByLabel(
                'Email',
            ),
        ).toBeEnabled();

        await expect(
            page.getByLabel(
                'Password',
            ),
        ).toBeEnabled();

        await expect(
            page.getByLabel(
                'Tenant UUID',
            ),
        ).toBeEnabled();

        /*
         * Neither expected context-resolution response may
         * become user-facing login failure prose.
         */
        await expect(
            page.getByText(
                'Permintaan masuk tidak dapat diproses. Silakan coba lagi.',
            ),
        ).toHaveCount(
            0,
        );

        const finalUrl =
            new URL(
                page.url(),
            );

        expect(
            finalUrl.origin,
        ).toBe(
            'http://127.0.0.1:5173',
        );

        expect(
            finalUrl.pathname,
        ).toBe(
            '/login',
        );

        /*
         * During canonical resolution LoginRouteBoundary may
         * briefly leave /login for the protected application.
         *
         * Once Membership discovery proves the BrowserSession
         * anonymous, ProtectedRouteBoundary safely returns to
         * login and preserves only the internal destination.
         */
        expect(
            finalUrl.searchParams.get(
                'returnTo',
            ),
        ).toBe(
            '/',
        );
    },
);
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. 403 bukan authorization denial untuk user

Dalam lifecycle ini:

```text
BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
```

tidak berarti:

```text
403 Access Denied
```

Ia berarti:

```text
Auth context belum dapat diproyeksikan
karena Membership locator belum tersedia.
```

Frontend kita memang sudah membedakannya dari `denied`.

Route-access contract bahkan secara eksplisit menyebut `membership-context-required` harus masuk ke Membership discovery/selection, bukan dianggap unauthenticated atau permission denial. `bff-9-2b-error-contract-audit.txt`

---

### 2. `/my-memberships` adalah discriminator yang benar

Kita tidak dapat menentukan dari initial tenant-scoped `/auth/me` apakah:

```text
A. BrowserSession authenticated tetapi belum punya locator
```

atau:

```text
B. BrowserSession benar-benar anonymous
```

karena keduanya sampai pada missing Membership locator terlebih dahulu.

Maka canonical next step adalah user-scope Membership discovery:

```text
GET /api/v1/user/my-memberships
```

Endpoint ini memang **tidak memakai Membership locator**, karena tujuannya justru menemukan Membership milik authenticated Person. `Pasted markdown.md`

Untuk anonymous browser:

```text
/my-memberships
→ 401
```

dan itu menjadi authoritative anonymous truth.

---

### 3. Ini menemukan gap dalam test assumption, bukan production bug

Sebelumnya Vitest kita memodelkan direct anonymous bootstrap:

```text
/auth/me
→ 401
```

Itu merupakan simplifikasi test harness.

Real browser sekarang menunjukkan contract sebenarnya:

```text
/auth/me
→ 403 context required
→ /my-memberships
→ 401 anonymous
```

Ini persis alasan kenapa real-browser E2E penting: ada lifecycle antar-middleware yang tidak terlihat dari MSW test tunggal.

Untuk saat ini **jangan ubah Vitest**. Kita sedang membuktikan real browser dahulu. Setelah E2E hijau, baru kita audit apakah mock integration perlu diperketat agar mencerminkan sequence real backend ini.

---

### 4. Tidak ada network mocking

Test tetap menggunakan:

```text
real Chromium
→ real Vite proxy
→ real Laravel
```

Tidak ada:

```ts
page.route()
route.fulfill()
MSW
```

Jadi kedua response benar-benar berasal dari backend.

```text
no Laravel session cookie yet

UseBrowserSessionForCanonicalApi

        ↓
InjectTransportAwareTenantContext

403 AUTHENTICATION_CONTEXT_DENIED
```

```text
A. BrowserSession transport activation
B. initial BrowserSession bootstrap
C. frontend Auth bootstrap sequencing
D. route middleware composition
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. `AUTHENTICATION_CONTEXT_DENIED` sangat berbeda

Kita sebelumnya mengharapkan BrowserSession vocabulary:

```text
BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_DENIED
BROWSER_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE
```

Tetapi real response:

```text
AUTHENTICATION_CONTEXT_DENIED
```

adalah canonical authentication-context vocabulary.

Ini petunjuk kuat bahwa request mungkin mencapai:

```text
InjectTenantContext
```

tanpa terlebih dahulu berubah menjadi BrowserSession-aware context.

Karena browser tidak mempunyai bearer token, canonical context secara benar fail-closed menjadi 403.

Jadi **jangan menambahkan `AUTHENTICATION_CONTEXT_DENIED` sebagai anonymous presenter case** hanya supaya E2E hijau. Itu akan menyembunyikan transport problem.

---

### 2. Fresh BrowserSession mempunyai chicken-and-egg problem yang perlu dibuktikan

Browser login flow kita saat submit memang:

```text
GET /browser/session/csrf
→ Laravel session mulai/resume
→ POST /browser/auth/login
```

Tetapi initial Auth bootstrap saat membuka `/login` berjalan:

```text
GET /auth/me
```

Kalau `/auth/me` hanya mengenali BrowserSession transport setelah browser sudah mempunyai Laravel session cookie, maka fresh browser belum mempunyai activation signal.

Itu bisa menghasilkan:

```text
fresh browser
→ /auth/me
→ interpreted as canonical bearer transport
→ bearer absent
→ AUTHENTICATION_CONTEXT_DENIED
```

Audit H.1C akan memastikan apakah memang begitu.

---

### 3. Jangan menyelesaikan ini di presentation layer

Sangat menggoda membuat:

```ts
AUTHENTICATION_CONTEXT_DENIED
→ anonymous
```

Itu tidak aman.

Code tersebut juga bisa berarti canonical bearer context benar-benar invalid pada situasi lain.

UI tidak boleh mengubah technical security failure menjadi anonymous truth tanpa explicit transport contract.

---

### 4. Jangan langsung membuat `/auth/me` public

Begitu juga jangan menghapus middleware hanya supaya fresh browser mendapat sesuatu.

Canonical `/auth/me` tetap harus protected.

Yang perlu kita selidiki adalah **transport selection**, bukan melemahkan authentication boundary.

---

### 5. Ini alasan real-browser gate sangat bernilai

Semua mocked regression tetap hijau:

```text
53 files
340 tests
PASS
```

tetapi real Chromium menemukan:

```text
actual middleware sequence
≠
mocked assumption
```

Ini tepat jenis bug/integration drift yang Playwright real backend memang dirancang untuk menemukan.

---

## Cara Menjalankan & Menguji (Testing)

H.1C adalah **audit-only**.

Jangan menjalankan E2E berulang kali dulu karena kita sudah mempunyai reproducible failure:

```text
/auth/me
→ 403
→ AUTHENTICATION_CONTEXT_DENIED
```

Yang kita cari sekarang adalah matrix:

```text
UseBrowserSession activation condition     ?
Requires existing session cookie           ?
Transport attribute set when fresh          ?
Canonical /auth/me middleware order         ?
InjectTransportAwareTenantContext fallback  ?
CSRF endpoint creates session               ?
Auth bootstrap calls CSRF first             ?
Existing feature test covers fresh browser  ?
```

Target output audit harus memungkinkan kita menentukan dengan pasti:

```text
ROOT CAUSE = backend transport selection
```

atau:

```text
ROOT CAUSE = frontend bootstrap sequencing
```

atau kombinasi keduanya.

> **Centralizing session setup**
>
> I’m weighing a shared browser-session initializer against a smaller bootstrap-only change. Centralizing it better avoids repeated CSRF setup while preserving the existing login and logout flow, though it broadens the change and requires regression tests.
>
> **Inspected authentication bootstrap tests and matching ZIP paths**
>
> 
>
> **Implemented CSRF authentication bootstrapping, frontend session helpers, server defaults, and role-based tests**
>
> 
>
> Worked for 4m 20s

FEI-10H.1C **✅ COMPLETE / LOCKED**. Audit sekarang membuktikan root cause secara pasti.

`UseBrowserSessionForCanonicalApi` hanya mengaktifkan BrowserSession jika request **sudah membawa cookie Laravel session**. Jika cookie belum ada, request diteruskan sebagai canonical bearer transport; `InjectTransportAwareTenantContext` kemudian memilih `InjectTenantContext`, dan karena Browser API client memang tidak mengirim bearer, hasil yang benar dari jalur itu adalah `403 AUTHENTICATION_CONTEXT_DENIED`. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Pada sisi frontend, initial `bootstrapBrowserAuthentication()` langsung memanggil `/api/v1/auth/me`, sedangkan CSRF/BrowserSession bootstrap saat ini baru dilakukan oleh login/logout. Di sisi backend, `/api/v1/browser/session/csrf` memang secara eksplisit berada pada `web` middleware dan bertugas memulai/resume Laravel browser session serta cookie pair. `Pasted text.txt`

Jadi root cause-nya:

```text
ROOT CAUSE
✅ Frontend initial BrowserSession bootstrap sequencing

Bukan:
❌ Laravel middleware bug
❌ Playwright bug
❌ Vite proxy bug
❌ error presenter bug
```

# FEI-10H.1D - BrowserSession Preflight Initialization

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Browser SPA harus membentuk BrowserSession transport **sebelum initial canonical `/auth/me` probe**.

Flow setelah perbaikan:

```text
fresh Chromium
    ↓
GET /api/v1/browser/session/csrf
    ↓
Laravel web middleware
    ↓
laravel-session cookie created
    ↓
GET /api/v1/auth/me
    ↓
UseBrowserSessionForCanonicalApi sees cookie
    ↓
BrowserSession transport
    ↓
403 BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
    ↓
Membership discovery
    ↓
401 BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
    ↓
AuthRuntime = anonymous
    ↓
LoginPage
```

Kita juga akan menghilangkan duplikasi bootstrap session pada Auth login/logout dengan satu primitive bersama.

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Buat:

```text
frontend/src/platform/auth/session-bootstrap.ts
frontend/src/platform/auth/__tests__/session-bootstrap.test.ts
```

Ubah:

```text
frontend/src/platform/auth/bootstrap.ts
frontend/src/platform/auth/service.ts
frontend/src/platform/auth/logout.ts
frontend/src/test/server.ts
```

Jangan ubah:

```text
Modules/*
docs/api/openapi.yaml

frontend/src/app/*
frontend/src/platform/auth/runtime.ts
frontend/src/platform/auth/state.ts
frontend/e2e/authentication.e2e.ts
```

E2E H.1B **jangan dilonggarkan**. Setelah fix, test real browser yang sebelumnya gagal harus menjadi bukti bahwa sequencing sudah benar.

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Buat `frontend/src/platform/auth/session-bootstrap.ts`

```ts
import {
    executeBrowserApiRequest,
    type BrowserApiClient,
} from '@/platform/api';

import {
    createBrowserAuthAbortOptions,
} from '@/platform/auth/request-options';

export interface BrowserSessionBootstrapOptions {
    readonly signal?:
        AbortSignal;
}

/*
 * Establish or resume the first-party Laravel BrowserSession
 * before a BrowserSession-aware canonical resource is used.
 *
 * This operation never authenticates a user and never exposes
 * canonical bearer credentials to browser JavaScript.
 */
export async function initializeBrowserSession(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
    options: BrowserSessionBootstrapOptions = {},
) {
    const abortOptions =
        createBrowserAuthAbortOptions(
            options.signal,
        );

    return executeBrowserApiRequest(
        client.GET(
            '/api/v1/browser/session/csrf',
            abortOptions,
        ),
    );
}
```

Kita sengaja tidak menaruh logic ini di React.

Ownership tetap:

```text
platform/auth
→ BrowserSession transport initialization

LoginPage
→ authentication intent only
```

## 2. Ganti `frontend/src/platform/auth/bootstrap.ts`

```ts
import {
    createBrowserMembershipHeaderParams,
    executeBrowserApiRequest,
    type BrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserApiResult,
    type BrowserMembershipLocator,
} from '@/platform/api';

import type {
    AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess,
} from '@/platform/auth/contract';
import {
    createBrowserAuthAbortOptions,
} from '@/platform/auth/request-options';
import {
    initializeBrowserSession,
} from '@/platform/auth/session-bootstrap';

export interface BrowserAuthBootstrapOptions {
    readonly membershipId?:
        BrowserMembershipLocator;

    readonly signal?:
        AbortSignal;
}

export async function bootstrapBrowserAuthentication(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
    options: BrowserAuthBootstrapOptions = {},
): Promise<
    BrowserApiResult<
        AuthenticatedBootstrapSuccess
    >
> {
    const abortOptions =
        createBrowserAuthAbortOptions(
            options.signal,
        );

    if (
        options.membershipId
            === undefined
    ) {
        /*
         * Initial BrowserAuth bootstrap has no Membership
         * locator yet.
         *
         * Establish BrowserSession transport first so the
         * dual-transport canonical endpoint cannot mistake
         * the first-party SPA for a bearer-only client.
         */
        const sessionResult =
            await initializeBrowserSession(
                client,
                {
                    signal:
                        options.signal,
                },
            );

        if (! sessionResult.ok) {
            return sessionResult;
        }

        return executeBrowserApiRequest(
            client.GET(
                '/api/v1/auth/me',
                abortOptions,
            ),
        );
    }

    /*
     * A Membership-specific bootstrap only occurs after an
     * existing BrowserSession lifecycle:
     *
     * - successful Browser login, or
     * - Browser Membership switching.
     *
     * Re-bootstrap of the session is therefore deliberately
     * unnecessary here.
     */
    return executeBrowserApiRequest(
        client.GET(
            '/api/v1/auth/me',
            {
                ...abortOptions,

                params: {
                    header:
                        createBrowserMembershipHeaderParams({
                            membershipId:
                                options.membershipId,
                        }),
                },
            },
        ),
    );
}
```

Perhatikan intentional asymmetry:

```text
bootstrap()
→ initialize BrowserSession first

bootstrap({ membershipId })
→ do not initialize again
```

Karena membership-specific bootstrap hanya terjadi setelah BrowserSession sudah ada.

## 3. Ganti `frontend/src/platform/auth/service.ts`

```ts
import {
    executeBrowserApiRequest,
    type BrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserApiResult,
} from '@/platform/api';

import type {
    BrowserLoginRequest,
    BrowserLoginSuccess,
} from '@/platform/auth/contract';
import {
    createBrowserAuthAbortOptions,
} from '@/platform/auth/request-options';
import {
    initializeBrowserSession,
} from '@/platform/auth/session-bootstrap';

export interface BrowserLoginOptions {
    readonly signal?:
        AbortSignal;
}

export async function loginWithBrowserSession(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
    request: BrowserLoginRequest,
    options: BrowserLoginOptions = {},
): Promise<
    BrowserApiResult<
        BrowserLoginSuccess
    >
> {
    const abortOptions =
        createBrowserAuthAbortOptions(
            options.signal,
        );

    const sessionResult =
        await initializeBrowserSession(
            client,
            {
                signal:
                    options.signal,
            },
        );

    if (! sessionResult.ok) {
        return sessionResult;
    }

    return executeBrowserApiRequest(
        client.POST(
            '/api/v1/browser/auth/login',
            {
                ...abortOptions,

                body:
                    request,
            },
        ),
    );
}
```

Behavior login tidak berubah. Kita hanya menghilangkan duplikasi raw CSRF endpoint call.

## 4. Ganti `frontend/src/platform/auth/logout.ts`

```ts
import {
    executeBrowserApiRequest,
    type BrowserApiClient,
    type BrowserApiResult,
} from '@/platform/api';

import type {
    BrowserLogoutSuccess,
} from '@/platform/auth/contract';
import {
    createBrowserAuthAbortOptions,
} from '@/platform/auth/request-options';
import {
    initializeBrowserSession,
} from '@/platform/auth/session-bootstrap';

export interface BrowserLogoutOptions {
    readonly signal?:
        AbortSignal;
}

export async function logoutBrowserSession(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
    options: BrowserLogoutOptions = {},
): Promise<
    BrowserApiResult<
        BrowserLogoutSuccess
    >
> {
    const abortOptions =
        createBrowserAuthAbortOptions(
            options.signal,
        );

    const sessionResult =
        await initializeBrowserSession(
            client,
            {
                signal:
                    options.signal,
            },
        );

    if (! sessionResult.ok) {
        return sessionResult;
    }

    return executeBrowserApiRequest(
        client.POST(
            '/api/v1/browser/auth/logout',
            abortOptions,
        ),
    );
}
```

Sekarang Auth transport ownership menjadi:

```text
initializeBrowserSession()
          ↑
     ┌────┼────┐
 bootstrap  login  logout
```

Runtime handler MSW tersebut tetap dapat override default handler ini.

Jadi kita tidak perlu menduplikasi mock CSRF di puluhan integration tests.
