## 6. Buat regression proof `session-bootstrap.test.ts`

```ts
import {
    http,
    HttpResponse,
} from 'msw';
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    createBrowserApiClient,
} from '@/platform/api';
import {
    bootstrapBrowserAuthentication,
} from '@/platform/auth/bootstrap';
import {
    apiMockServer,
} from '@/test/server';

describe(
    'BrowserSession authentication bootstrap',
    () => {
        it('establishes BrowserSession transport before initial canonical authentication bootstrap', async () => {
            const sequence:
                string[] = [];

            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/session/csrf`,
                    () => {
                        sequence.push(
                            'session',
                        );

                        return new HttpResponse(
                            null,
                            {
                                status:
                                    204,
                            },
                        );
                    },
                ),

                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/auth/me`,
                    () => {
                        sequence.push(
                            'auth',
                        );

                        return HttpResponse.json(
                            {
                                status:
                                    'error',

                                code:
                                    'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',

                                message:
                                    'Browser membership context is required.',
                            },
                            {
                                status:
                                    403,
                            },
                        );
                    },
                ),
            );

            const client =
                createBrowserApiClient();

            const result =
                await bootstrapBrowserAuthentication(
                    client,
                );

            expect(
                sequence,
            ).toEqual([
                'session',
                'auth',
            ]);

            expect(
                result,
            ).toEqual({
                ok:
                    false,

                kind:
                    'response',

                status:
                    403,

                error: {
                    status:
                        'error',

                    code:
                        'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',

                    message:
                        'Browser membership context is required.',
                },
            });
        });

        it('fails closed without probing canonical authentication when BrowserSession initialization fails', async () => {
            let authenticationRequests =
                0;

            apiMockServer.use(
                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/browser/session/csrf`,
                    () =>
                        HttpResponse.error(),
                ),

                http.get(
                    `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/auth/me`,
                    () => {
                        authenticationRequests +=
                            1;

                        return HttpResponse.json({
                            status:
                                'success',
                        });
                    },
                ),
            );

            const client =
                createBrowserApiClient();

            const result =
                await bootstrapBrowserAuthentication(
                    client,
                );

            expect(
                result.ok,
            ).toBe(
                false,
            );

            if (result.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    'Expected BrowserSession bootstrap failure.',
                );
            }

            expect(
                result.kind,
            ).toBe(
                'network',
            );

            expect(
                authenticationRequests,
            ).toBe(
                0,
            );
        });
    },
);
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Backend tidak perlu diubah

Backend sudah menjalankan contract yang benar:

```php
if (
    ! $request->cookies->has(
        $cookieName,
    )
) {
    return $next(
        $request,
    );
}
```

Artinya cookie merupakan **explicit BrowserSession transport discriminator**. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Kita tidak boleh mengubahnya menjadi:

```text
"tidak ada bearer berarti pasti browser"
```

karena itu akan membuat canonical API stateless menjadi stateful untuk arbitrary unauthenticated API clients.

---

### 2. CSRF endpoint sebenarnya bukan hanya “CSRF endpoint”

Namanya memang:

```text
/browser/session/csrf
```

tetapi backend contract-nya mengatakan:

> Initialize the Laravel browser session / anti-forgery cookie pair.

Dan route menggunakan `web` middleware. `Pasted text.txt`

Jadi secara architectural function:

```text
BrowserSession initialization
+
request-forgery initialization
```

bukan sekadar:

```text
fetch CSRF token
```

Karena itu `initializeBrowserSession()` adalah nama frontend yang lebih tepat.

---

### 3. Fail closed

Jika initialization gagal:

```text
session bootstrap failure
        ↓
DO NOT call /auth/me
```

Kita tidak fallback ke bearer transport.

Itu penting karena Browser API client adalah first-party BrowserSession client.

---

### 4. Runtime tidak berubah

Kita tidak perlu memodifikasi:

```text
BrowserAuthRuntime
BrowserAuthState
BrowserAuthProvider
```

Runtime akan tetap menerima contract yang selama ini ia pahami:

```text
403 BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
```

atau:

```text
401 BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
```

Bukan lagi accidental:

```text
403 AUTHENTICATION_CONTEXT_DENIED
```

---

### 5. Tidak ada bearer exposure

Browser client tetap:

```ts
headers.delete(
    'Authorization',
);
```

Session initialization hanya membentuk cookie server-side; tidak memperkenalkan token ke JavaScript.

---

# FEI-10H.1D.1 - Exact Optional Signal Alignment

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Saat ini kode membuat:

```ts
{
    signal:
        options.signal,
}
```

Secara runtime ini terlihat masuk akal, tetapi dengan:

```text
exactOptionalPropertyTypes = true
```

ada perbedaan antara:

```ts
{}
```

dan:

```ts
{
    signal: undefined,
}
```

Interface kita:

```ts
readonly signal?:
    AbortSignal;
```

berarti:

> properti boleh **tidak ada**, tetapi jika ada nilainya harus `AbortSignal`.

Bukan:

> properti boleh ada dengan nilai `undefined`.

Kabar baiknya, ketiga file tersebut sudah mempunyai:

```ts
const abortOptions =
    createBrowserAuthAbortOptions(
        options.signal,
    );
```

Primitive ini memang bertugas membentuk optional signal secara aman. Jadi kita cukup **reuse `abortOptions`**.

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Ubah hanya:

```text
frontend/src/platform/auth/bootstrap.ts
frontend/src/platform/auth/service.ts
frontend/src/platform/auth/logout.ts
```

Jangan ubah:

```text
frontend/src/platform/auth/session-bootstrap.ts
frontend/src/platform/auth/__tests__/session-bootstrap.test.ts

frontend/e2e/*
frontend/src/app/*
Modules/*
tsconfig*
```

---

## Kode Lengkap

### 1. `bootstrap.ts`

Cari:

```ts
const sessionResult =
    await initializeBrowserSession(
        client,
        {
            signal:
                options.signal,
        },
    );
```

Ganti menjadi:

```ts
const sessionResult =
    await initializeBrowserSession(
        client,
        abortOptions,
    );
```

---

### 2. `service.ts`

Cari:

```ts
const sessionResult =
    await initializeBrowserSession(
        client,
        {
            signal:
                options.signal,
        },
    );
```

Ganti:

```ts
const sessionResult =
    await initializeBrowserSession(
        client,
        abortOptions,
    );
```

---

### 3. `logout.ts`

Sama, ganti:

```ts
const sessionResult =
    await initializeBrowserSession(
        client,
        {
            signal:
                options.signal,
        },
    );
```

menjadi:

```ts
const sessionResult =
    await initializeBrowserSession(
        client,
        abortOptions,
    );
```

Tidak ada perubahan lain.

---

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Ini lebih baik daripada memperlebar type:

```ts
signal?: AbortSignal | undefined;
```

karena problem sebenarnya bukan pada contract `BrowserSessionBootstrapOptions`.

Contract itu sudah benar:

```ts
signal?: AbortSignal;
```

Problem berada pada caller yang secara eksplisit membuat:

```ts
signal: undefined
```

Kita juga sudah memiliki canonical helper:

```ts
createBrowserAuthAbortOptions()
```

yang sudah digunakan untuk request berikutnya. Jadi reuse:

```text
options.signal
     ↓
createBrowserAuthAbortOptions()
     ↓
abortOptions
     ├─ initializeBrowserSession()
     └─ API request
```

lebih DRY dan konsisten.

Ini juga menghindari:

```ts
as BrowserSessionBootstrapOptions
```

atau:

```ts
as any
```

yang hanya menyembunyikan masalah type.

# FEI-10H.2 — Dedicated E2E Authentication Fixture Audit

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Sekarang **belum langsung membuat user E2E atau login test**.

Sebelum Playwright mengirim credential nyata, kita harus memastikan database E2E benar-benar terisolasi dari:

```text
.env development database
real developer accounts
existing Tenant data
manual user/password
```

Target architecture berikutnya:

```text
Playwright
    ↓
Laravel E2E environment
    ↓
dedicated E2E database
    ↓
deterministic fixture
    ├─ User
    ├─ Person
    ├─ Tenant
    ├─ Membership
    └─ password khusus E2E
    ↓
real browser login
```

Ini penting karena PHPUnit `RefreshDatabase` tidak otomatis melindungi database ketika Laravel dijalankan sebagai HTTP server oleh Playwright.

### Jangan gunakan `.env` development untuk authenticated E2E


yang berarti Laravel menggunakan environment normal/local.

Itu masih aman untuk test anonymous H.1 karena kita tidak menulis credential/domain data.

Tetapi untuk:

```text
POST /browser/auth/login
```

kita membutuhkan fixture persistent selama Playwright berjalan.

Maka authenticated E2E harus berubah menjadi sesuatu seperti:

```text
APP_ENV=e2e
DB_DATABASE=educore_e2e
```

atau menggunakan testing environment yang memang aman untuk HTTP server.

Kita belum menentukan bentuk akhirnya sebelum audit.

### PHPUnit `RefreshDatabase` tidak bisa menjadi E2E fixture manager

PHPUnit bekerja:

```text
test process
→ setup database
→ request
→ rollback/reset
```

Playwright berbeda:

```text
Playwright process
        ↓
independent PHP HTTP server
        ↓
independent database connection
```

Jadi kita butuh explicit lifecycle:

```text
prepare E2E database
→ seed deterministic account
→ launch Laravel
→ execute browser
→ cleanup/reset
```

### Fixture harus berasal dari domain canonical

Kita tidak akan sekadar:

```sql
INSERT INTO users ...
```

kalau aplikasi sudah memiliki factory/domain creation pattern.

Kita ingin fixture mengikuti relationship:

```text
User
→ Person
→ Membership
→ Tenant
```

yang sama dengan canonical authentication resolver.

### Credential E2E boleh deterministic

Misalnya nanti:

```text
email    e2e.member@example.test
password e2e-only-secret
```

bukan credential sensitif karena:

- hanya ada di dedicated E2E DB;
- tidak digunakan pada production/development;
- database dibuat ulang;
- bukan akun manusia.

Tetapi kita baru menentukan nilainya setelah fixture ownership jelas.

## Cara Menjalankan & Menguji (Testing)

H.2 sekarang **audit-only**.

Target hasilnya adalah matrix:

```text
Dedicated testing DB        ada / belum
HTTP --env=testing safe     ya / tidak
Factories                   ada / tidak
Reusable auth fixture       ada / tidak
Tenant setup primitive      diketahui
Person setup primitive      diketahui
Membership setup primitive  diketahui
User password setup         diketahui
Database reset strategy     diketahui
```

Hal terpenting:

```text
development DB
≠
database yang akan digunakan authenticated Playwright
```

Kalau ternyata `.env.testing` menunjuk database dedicated, itu kandidat kuat.

Kalau `.env.testing` masih mengarah ke database development yang sama, **jangan jalankan migrate:fresh atau db:wipe**.

Jika command:


memberikan warning/error koneksi database, **jangan buat database atau migrate dulu**. Kirim hasilnya.

Jika nama database dari local dan testing ternyata sama, itu adalah blocker penting. Jangan menjalankan authenticated E2E sampai kita membuat environment khusus.

Jika `BrowserLoginTest` ternyata membangun seluruh User/Tenant/Membership fixture manual tanpa reusable factory, itu juga tidak masalah. Kita akan mengekstrak E2E fixture secara terkontrol pada langkah implementasi berikutnya.

# FEI-10H.2A - Dedicated E2E Environment & Database Isolation

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Target topology menjadi:

```text
Development
.env
→ educore
→ SESSION_DRIVER=database

PHPUnit
.env.testing
→ educore_testing
→ SESSION_DRIVER=array

Playwright
.env.e2e
→ educore_e2e
→ SESSION_DRIVER=database
```

Ini penting supaya nanti:

```text
migrate:fresh E2E
```

tidak mungkin menghapus:

```text
educore          ❌ development
educore_testing  ❌ PHPUnit
```

dan BrowserSession Playwright benar-benar persisten:

```text
CSRF request
→ session cookie
→ login request
→ /auth/me
→ reload
```

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Pada langkah ini:

```text
.gitignore                       modified
frontend/playwright.config.ts    modified

.env.e2e                         local + ignored
educore_e2e                      local PostgreSQL database
```

Belum ada:

```text
E2E user fixture
E2E seeder
authenticated Playwright test
```

Itu baru milestone berikutnya.

---

## Kode Lengkap

### 1. Ignore `.env.e2e`

Tambahkan satu baris pada `.gitignore` setelah `.env.testing`:

```text
.env
.env.testing
.env.e2e
.env.backup
.env.production
```

Bisa dilakukan aman dengan:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(".gitignore")
text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

needle = ".env.testing\n"

if ".env.e2e\n" in text:
    print(".env.e2e already ignored")
else:
    if text.count(needle) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Expected exactly one {needle!r}"
        )

    text = text.replace(
        needle,
        needle + ".env.e2e\n",
    )

    path.write_text(
        text,
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    print("Added .env.e2e to .gitignore")
PY
```

---

### 2. Buat `.env.e2e` dari testing environment

Jangan menulis credential database ulang secara manual.

```bash
test ! -f .env.e2e \
  || {
    echo ".env.e2e already exists; refusing to overwrite"
    exit 1
  }

cp .env.testing .env.e2e
```

Kemudian ubah hanya konfigurasi E2E:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(".env.e2e")
text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

replacements = {
    "APP_ENV=testing":
        "APP_ENV=e2e",

    "DB_DATABASE=educore_testing":
        "DB_DATABASE=educore_e2e",

    "SESSION_DRIVER=array":
        "SESSION_DRIVER=database",
}

for old, new in replacements.items():
    count = text.count(old)

    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"Expected exactly one occurrence of {old!r}, found {count}"
        )

    text = text.replace(
        old,
        new,
    )

path.write_text(
    text,
    encoding="utf-8",
)

print(
    "Prepared .env.e2e without printing secret values."
)
PY
```

Jangan `cat .env.e2e`.

---

### 3. Pastikan BrowserSession flags lokal eksplisit

Tambahkan tanpa menampilkan secret:

```bash
cat >> .env.e2e <<'EOF'
SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=false
SESSION_HTTP_ONLY=true
SESSION_SAME_SITE=lax
EOF
```

Ini **khusus environment E2E HTTP lokal**.

Production security tidak berubah.

---

### 4. Buat PostgreSQL database E2E

Kita dapat menggunakan koneksi `educore_testing` yang sudah terbukti bekerja hanya untuk membuat database baru.

Jalankan:

```bash
php artisan --env=testing tinker --execute="
\$database = 'educore_e2e';

\$existing = DB::selectOne(
    'select 1 as present from pg_database where datname = ?',
    [\$database],
);

if (\$existing !== null) {
    dump([
        'database' => \$database,
        'status' => 'already-exists',
    ]);

    return;
}

DB::unprepared(
    'CREATE DATABASE \"educore_e2e\"'
);

dump([
    'database' => \$database,
    'status' => 'created',
]);
"
```

Command ini **tidak menghapus database apa pun**.

Kalau PostgreSQL user tidak memiliki privilege `CREATE DATABASE`, jangan menaikkan privilege aplikasi. Buat database kosong bernama:

```text
educore_e2e
```

melalui pgAdmin/Laragon/PostgreSQL admin account, lalu lanjut ke langkah berikut.

---

### 5. Verifikasi environment sebelum tindakan destructive apa pun

```bash
php artisan --env=e2e tinker --execute="
dump([
    'environment' => app()->environment(),
    'connection' => config('database.default'),
    'database' => config(
        'database.connections.'
        .config('database.default')
        .'.database'
    ),
    'session_driver' => config('session.driver'),
    'session_secure' => config('session.secure'),
    'session_http_only' => config('session.http_only'),
    'session_same_site' => config('session.same_site'),
]);
"
```

**Harus persis secara substantif:**

```text
environment       e2e
connection        pgsql
database          educore_e2e
session_driver    database
session_secure    false
session_http_only true
session_same_site lax
```

Kalau database bukan `educore_e2e`, **STOP**.

---

### 6. Pastikan migration session table tersedia

```bash
echo "=== SESSION TABLE MIGRATION ==="

grep -RInE \
  "create\(['\"]sessions['\"]|Schema::create\(['\"]sessions['\"]" \
  database/migrations \
  Modules \
  --include='*.php' \
  || true
```

Kita membutuhkan migration `sessions`, karena E2E memakai:

```text
SESSION_DRIVER=database
```

---

### 7. Baru migrate database E2E

Tambahkan safety gate langsung sebelum `migrate:fresh`:

```bash
php artisan --env=e2e tinker --execute="
\$environment = app()->environment();

\$database = config(
    'database.connections.'
    .config('database.default')
    .'.database'
);

if (
    \$environment !== 'e2e'
    || \$database !== 'educore_e2e'
) {
    throw new RuntimeException(
        'REFUSING destructive E2E database operation.'
    );
}

dump([
    'safe_environment' => \$environment,
    'safe_database' => \$database,
]);
" \
&& php artisan migrate:fresh \
  --env=e2e \
  --force
```

Safety check ini wajib. Jangan menjalankan `migrate:fresh` terpisah tanpa memeriksa environment/database.

---

### 8. Arahkan Laravel Playwright ke E2E environment

Di:

```text
frontend/playwright.config.ts
```

ubah hanya command Laravel dari:

```ts
command:
    'php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000',
```

menjadi:

```ts
command:
    'php artisan --env=e2e serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000',
```

Tidak ada perubahan lain pada config Playwright.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### Database E2E harus berbeda dari PHPUnit

Walaupun `educore_testing` sudah bukan development DB, kita tetap tidak menggunakan database yang sama untuk dua test harness.

Karena:

```text
PHPUnit
→ RefreshDatabase
→ educore_testing

Playwright
→ independent PHP server
→ persistent BrowserSession
→ educore_e2e
```

Kalau keduanya berbagi database, satu test runner dapat melakukan migration/reset saat runner lain masih menggunakan data.

Separation ini murah tetapi menghilangkan satu kelas race/destructive-test problem.

### `SESSION_DRIVER=array` memang tidak cocok

PHPUnit dapat memakai `array` karena lifecycle session berada dalam test harness Laravel.

Tetapi browser nyata membuat beberapa request terpisah:

```text
GET /browser/session/csrf
POST /browser/auth/login
GET /auth/me
GET /my-memberships
reload
```

Semua request tersebut harus menemukan session state yang sama.

Karena itu E2E membutuhkan backend persistence seperti:

```text
SESSION_DRIVER=database
```

### `.env.e2e` tidak boleh committed

Audit menunjukkan `.env.testing` sendiri sudah ignored, tetapi `.env.e2e` belum tercakup. Karena itu kita menambahkan `.env.e2e` ke `.gitignore`. `Pasted text (3).txt`

Credential E2E/database config lokal tetap berada di machine masing-masing.

### Belum membuat fixture

`BrowserLoginTest` memberi kita canonical minimal fixture:

```text
persons
users
tenants
memberships
```

dengan active status dan bcrypt password. `Pasted text.txt`

Tetapi kita belum menyalinnya sekarang. Environment/database isolation harus terbukti dulu sebelum kita memberikan command yang memasukkan credential.

## Troubleshooting

Jika pembuatan database memberikan:

```text
permission denied to create database
```

itu bukan bug aplikasi. Jangan memberi role aplikasi privilege tambahan. Buat `educore_e2e` melalui database administrator lalu lanjutkan.

Jika `migrate:fresh` menunjukkan database selain:

```text
educore_e2e
```

batalkan command. Jangan lanjut.

Jika `Schema::hasTable('sessions')` adalah `false`, jangan mengubah session driver menjadi `file` hanya agar Playwright hijau. Kirim hasil migration inventory; kita perlu memastikan canonical database-session infrastructure tersedia.

Jika anonymous Playwright yang sebelumnya PASS sekarang gagal setelah `--env=e2e`, kirim response exact-nya. Itu berarti ada perbedaan konfigurasi antara local dan E2E yang memang perlu kita selesaikan sebelum credential fixture.

# FEI-10H.2B - Deterministic Browser Authentication Fixture

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita membuat satu fixture E2E minimal mengikuti relationship canonical backend yang memang digunakan `BrowserLoginTest`:

```text
Person
  ↓
User
  ↓
Membership ──→ Tenant
```

Backend test existing membuktikan empat record tersebut sudah cukup untuk Browser login canonical. `Pasted text.txt`

Tetapi fixture baru harus memenuhi tambahan requirement E2E:

```text
✅ deterministic
✅ idempotent
✅ hanya boleh berjalan di APP_ENV=e2e
✅ hanya boleh menyentuh educore_e2e
✅ tidak didaftarkan ke DatabaseSeeder
✅ tidak menyentuh development/testing DB
✅ password hanya credential buatan khusus E2E
```

Pada langkah ini **belum ada Playwright login**.

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Tambah hanya:

```text
database/seeders/E2EBrowserAuthenticationSeeder.php
```

Tidak mengubah:

```text
database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php
frontend/e2e/*
frontend/src/*
Modules/*
.env
.env.testing
```

Seeder harus dipanggil secara eksplisit sehingga tidak pernah ikut:

```bash
php artisan db:seed
```

secara normal.

---

# Kode Lengkap

Buat:

```bash
cat > database/seeders/E2EBrowserAuthenticationSeeder.php <<'PHP'
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Modules\Core\Support\Uuid\UuidV7;
use RuntimeException;

final class E2EBrowserAuthenticationSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public const PERSON_ID =
        '019c8f4a-7b10-7000-8000-000000000001';

    public const USER_ID =
        '019c8f4a-7b10-7000-8000-000000000002';

    public const TENANT_ID =
        '019c8f4a-7b10-7000-8000-000000000003';

    public const MEMBERSHIP_ID =
        '019c8f4a-7b10-7000-8000-000000000004';

    public const EMAIL =
        'browser-e2e@educore.test';

    public const PASSWORD =
        'E2eOnly-Secret123!';

    public const TENANT_SUBDOMAIN =
        'browser-e2e';

    public function run(): void
    {
        $this->assertSafeEnvironment();
        $this->assertFixtureIdentifiers();

        DB::transaction(
            function (): void {
                $now =
                    now();

                DB::table(
                    'persons',
                )->updateOrInsert(
                    [
                        'id' =>
                            self::PERSON_ID,
                    ],
                    [
                        'name' =>
                            'EduCore Browser E2E User',

                        'status' =>
                            'ACTIVE',

                        'created_at' =>
                            $now,

                        'updated_at' =>
                            $now,
                    ],
                );

                DB::table(
                    'users',
                )->updateOrInsert(
                    [
                        'id' =>
                            self::USER_ID,
                    ],
                    [
                        'person_id' =>
                            self::PERSON_ID,

                        'email' =>
                            self::EMAIL,

                        'password' =>
                            Hash::make(
                                self::PASSWORD,
                            ),

                        'status' =>
                            'ACTIVE',

                        'is_superadmin' =>
                            false,

                        'created_at' =>
                            $now,

                        'updated_at' =>
                            $now,
                    ],
                );

                DB::table(
                    'tenants',
                )->updateOrInsert(
                    [
                        'id' =>
                            self::TENANT_ID,
                    ],
                    [
                        'name' =>
                            'EduCore Browser E2E Tenant',

                        'subdomain' =>
                            self::TENANT_SUBDOMAIN,

                        'is_active' =>
                            true,

                        'created_at' =>
                            $now,

                        'updated_at' =>
                            $now,
                    ],
                );

                DB::table(
                    'memberships',
                )->updateOrInsert(
                    [
                        'id' =>
                            self::MEMBERSHIP_ID,
                    ],
                    [
                        'person_id' =>
                            self::PERSON_ID,

                        'tenant_id' =>
                            self::TENANT_ID,

                        'status' =>
                            'ACTIVE',

                        'created_at' =>
                            $now,

                        'updated_at' =>
                            $now,
                    ],
                );
            },
        );
    }

    private function assertSafeEnvironment(): void
    {
        $environment =
            app()->environment();

        $connection =
            config(
                'database.default',
            );

        if (
            ! is_string(
                $connection,
            )
            || trim(
                $connection,
            ) === ''
        ) {
            throw new RuntimeException(
                'E2E fixture refused: invalid database connection.',
            );
        }

        $database =
            config(
                sprintf(
                    'database.connections.%s.database',
                    $connection,
                ),
            );

        if (
            $environment !== 'e2e'
            || $database !== 'educore_e2e'
        ) {
            throw new RuntimeException(
                sprintf(
                    'E2E fixture refused: expected environment e2e and database educore_e2e; received environment %s and database %s.',
                    is_string($environment)
                        ? $environment
                        : get_debug_type(
                            $environment,
                        ),
                    is_string($database)
                        ? $database
                        : get_debug_type(
                            $database,
                        ),
                ),
            );
        }
    }

    private function assertFixtureIdentifiers(): void
    {
        foreach (
            [
                self::PERSON_ID,
                self::USER_ID,
                self::TENANT_ID,
                self::MEMBERSHIP_ID,
            ]
            as $identifier
        ) {
            if (
                ! UuidV7::validate(
                    $identifier,
                )
            ) {
                throw new RuntimeException(
                    sprintf(
                        'E2E fixture contains invalid UUIDv7 identifier: %s.',
                        $identifier,
                    ),
                );
            }
        }
    }
}
PHP
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Mengikuti canonical fixture yang sudah terbukti

Kita tidak menciptakan model authentication baru.

`BrowserLoginTest` existing menggunakan record:

```text
persons
users
tenants
memberships
```

dengan status aktif dan password bcrypt/hash. `Pasted text.txt`

Jadi E2E fixture mengikuti backend contract yang sama.

---

### 2. Seeder fail-closed terhadap database salah

Bagian paling penting justru ini:

```php
if (
    $environment !== 'e2e'
    || $database !== 'educore_e2e'
) {
    throw new RuntimeException(...);
}
```

Sehingga bahkan jika seseorang salah menjalankan:

```bash
php artisan db:seed \
  --class=Database\\Seeders\\E2EBrowserAuthenticationSeeder
```

pada `.env` development:

```text
environment = local
database    = educore
```

seeder harus **menolak sebelum satu INSERT pun terjadi**.

---

### 3. Tidak dimasukkan ke `DatabaseSeeder`

Jangan lakukan:

```php
$this->call(
    E2EBrowserAuthenticationSeeder::class,
);
```

Karena kemudian:

```bash
php artisan db:seed
```

bisa membawa fixture E2E ke environment yang tidak semestinya.

Seeder ini explicit tooling:

```text
caller harus tahu:
"I am preparing E2E"
```

---

### 4. Credential bukan secret pengguna

Credential:

```text
browser-e2e@educore.test
E2eOnly-Secret123!
```

adalah synthetic fixture credential.

Ia bukan:

- password developer;
- account production;
- account testing manusia;
- token bearer;
- API secret.

Nanti Playwright boleh menggunakannya karena akun ini hanya dapat dibentuk di `educore_e2e`.

---

### 5. Fixed UUID berguna untuk browser E2E

Tenant UUID login form nanti dapat menggunakan nilai deterministic:

```text
019c8f4a-7b10-7000-8000-000000000003
```

daripada melakukan database lookup atau parsing output runtime.

Tetapi custom `UuidV7::validate()` tetap dijalankan sebelum fixture ditulis, sehingga kesalahan konstanta fail-fast.

---

### 6. `updateOrInsert()` membuat setup idempotent

Seeder dapat dijalankan:

```text
run 1
run 2
run 3
```

tanpa membuat user/tenant/membership tambahan.

Ini penting untuk local Playwright iteration.

## Troubleshooting

Jika muncul:

```text
E2E fixture contains invalid UUIDv7
```

jangan menghapus validator. Kirim output tersebut; kita akan mengganti static fixture IDs dengan valid deterministic UUIDv7.

Jika PostgreSQL memberi unique constraint pada email/subdomain saat first seed, jangan menghapus data manual sembarangan. Itu berarti DB E2E sudah memiliki conflicting fixture dari percobaan sebelumnya; kita audit row tersebut.

Jika development safety test justru berhasil melakukan seeding, itu **critical blocker**. Jangan lanjut.

Jika anonymous Chromium gagal setelah fixture ada, fixture seharusnya tidak memengaruhi fresh browser; kirim actual lifecycle karena berarti ada state/session leakage.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### PHP syntax harus lolos sebelum fixture dianggap final

Seeder sekarang merupakan executable database tooling. Walaupun sudah berhasil dieksekusi dua kali, `php -l` tetap menjadi cheap static gate untuk mendokumentasikan source PHP-nya valid.

### Safety guard tetap menjadi boundary utama

Yang harus masih terlihat:

```php
$environment !== 'e2e'
|| $database !== 'educore_e2e'
```

Artinya fixture memiliki dua independent constraints:

```text
APP_ENV harus e2e
AND
database harus educore_e2e
```

Salah salah satu → fail closed.

### Fixture count harus tetap tepat satu

Setelah dua kali seeding:

```text
Person       1
User         1
Tenant       1
Membership   1
```

adalah bukti tambahan bahwa idempotency benar-benar bertahan pada persisted database, bukan hanya bahwa command kedua tidak melempar exception.

### `.env.e2e` tidak boleh muncul di worktree

`git check-ignore` harus tetap menunjukkan `.env.e2e` di-ignore.

Jangan stage atau commit file tersebut.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### Kenapa belum langsung mengisi form lewat Playwright?

Login sukses sendiri kemungkinan akan mudah:

```text
email
password
tenant UUID
→ POST login
→ 200
```

Tetapi itu bukan seluruh frontend lifecycle.

Setelah login, runtime kita memang dirancang meneruskan:

```text
Auth
→ Membership
→ Workspace
→ Capability
→ Routing
```

Jika fixture tidak mempunyai authorization data, kemungkinan yang terjadi bisa berupa:

```text
authenticated
→ capability permissions = []
→ root route allowed
```

atau:

```text
authenticated
→ capability permissions = []
→ Access Denied
```

atau bahkan projection membutuhkan seeded permission catalog.

Kita harus tahu mana yang canonical.

---

### Jangan menambahkan role hanya supaya browser terlihat “berhasil”

Authorization architecture kita sudah locked:

```text
permissions[]
= canonical frontend authorization authority
```

Bukan:

```text
role name
is_superadmin
hierarchy assumptions
```

Maka kalau H.3 memang memerlukan permission, kita harus membuat minimal canonical authorization fixture berdasarkan:

```text
role
→ role_permissions
→ membership_roles
→ permission
```

bukan menambahkan frontend bypass.

---

### Login success dan application access adalah dua proof berbeda

Nanti real-browser test idealnya bisa membuktikan secara terpisah:

```text
Proof A
POST login returns 200

Proof B
canonical /auth/me succeeds

Proof C
Membership becomes ready

Proof D
Workspace becomes TENANT

Proof E
Capability projection succeeds

Proof F
routing reaches stable protected state
```

Dengan begitu jika H.3 gagal, kita tahu layer tepatnya.

```text
TENANT Workspace
   ↓

protected /

Frontend Foundation
```

Form yang sudah dibangun memang mempunyai field `Email`, `Password`, `Tenant UUID` serta tombol submit `Masuk`, sehingga Playwright dapat berinteraksi melalui semantic accessible locators, bukan CSS implementation detail. `Pasted text.txt` `Pasted text.txt`

```ts
import {

import {
    defineConfig,

} from '@playwright/test';

const repositoryRoot =
    fileURLToPath(
        new URL(
            '../',
            import.meta.url,
        ),
    );

export default defineConfig({
    testDir:
        './e2e',

    /*
     * Playwright owns only explicit *.e2e.ts files.
     *
     * This prevents Vitest from claiming Playwright suites
     * through its normal *.test.* / *.spec.* discovery.
     */
    testMatch:
        '**/*.e2e.ts',

    /*

    fullyParallel:

    forbidOnly:

            'only-on-failure',

    outputDir:
        '../node_modules/.cache/educore-playwright',

    webServer: [

             * Fixture preparation is explicit and guarded

             * The seeder refuses every environment/database

            command:
                'php artisan db:seed --env=e2e --class="Database\\Seeders\\E2EBrowserAuthenticationSeeder" && php artisan --env=e2e serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000',

            url:

});
```

```ts
import {
    expect,
    test,
} from '@playwright/test';

const e2eMembershipId =
    '019c8f4a-7b10-7000-8000-000000000004';

const e2eTenantId =
    '019c8f4a-7b10-7000-8000-000000000003';

const e2eEmail =
    'browser-e2e@educore.test';

const e2ePassword =
    'E2eOnly-Secret123!';

const applicationOrigin =
    'http://127.0.0.1:5173';

function matchesApplicationApiPath(
    responseUrl: string,
    pathname: string,
): boolean {
    const url =
        new URL(
            responseUrl,
        );

    return (
        url.origin
            === applicationOrigin
        && url.pathname
            === pathname
    );
}

test(
    'real anonymous browser resolves canonical Membership context before becoming authoritative login state',
    async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        const authenticationContextResponse =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) =>
                    matchesApplicationApiPath(
                        response.url(),
                        '/api/v1/auth/me',
                    ),
            );

        const membershipDiscoveryResponse =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) =>
                    matchesApplicationApiPath(
                        response.url(),
                        '/api/v1/user/my-memberships',
                    ),
            );

        await page.goto(
            '/login',
        );

        const contextResponse =
            await authenticationContextResponse;

        expect(
            contextResponse.status(),
        ).toBe(
            403,
        );

        const contextBody:
            unknown =
            await contextResponse.json();

        expect(
            contextBody,
        ).toMatchObject({
            status:
                'error',

            code:
                'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
        });

        expect(
            contextResponse
                .request()
                .headers()[
                    'authorization'
                ],
        ).toBeUndefined();

        const discoveryResponse =
            await membershipDiscoveryResponse;

        expect(
            discoveryResponse.status(),
        ).toBe(
            401,
        );

        const discoveryBody:
            unknown =
            await discoveryResponse.json();

        expect(
            discoveryBody,
        ).toMatchObject({
            status:
                'error',

            code:
                'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED',
        });

        expect(
            discoveryResponse
                .request()
                .headers()[
                    'authorization'
                ],
        ).toBeUndefined();

        await expect(
            page.getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Masuk ke EduCore',
                },
            ),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await expect(
            page.getByLabel(
                'Email',
            ),
        ).toBeEnabled();

        await expect(
            page.getByLabel(
                'Password',
            ),
        ).toBeEnabled();

        await expect(
            page.getByLabel(
                'Tenant UUID',
            ),
        ).toBeEnabled();

        await expect(
            page.getByText(
                'Permintaan masuk tidak dapat diproses. Silakan coba lagi.',
            ),
        ).toHaveCount(
            0,
        );

        const finalUrl =
            new URL(
                page.url(),
            );

        expect(
            finalUrl.origin,
        ).toBe(
            applicationOrigin,
        );

        expect(
            finalUrl.pathname,
        ).toBe(
            '/login',
        );

        expect(
            finalUrl.searchParams.get(
                'returnTo',
            ),
        ).toBe(
            '/',
        );
    },
);

test(
    'real browser authenticates through BrowserSession and reaches the protected Tenant application',
    async ({
        context,
        page,
    }) => {
        /*
         * First establish authoritative anonymous truth.
         *
         * Starting every test with a fresh Playwright
         * BrowserContext proves that persisted E2E database
         * fixture data is not itself browser authority.
         */
        await page.goto(
            '/login',
        );

        await expect(
            page.getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Masuk ke EduCore',
                },
            ),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await expect(
            page.getByLabel(
                'Email',
            ),
        ).toBeEnabled();

        /*
         * Exercise the real controlled LoginForm instead of
         * issuing API requests directly from Playwright.
         */
        await page
            .getByLabel(
                'Email',
            )
            .fill(
                e2eEmail,
            );

        await page
            .getByLabel(
                'Password',
            )
            .fill(
                e2ePassword,
            );

        await page
            .getByLabel(
                'Tenant UUID',
            )
            .fill(
                e2eTenantId,
            );

        /*
         * Register all network observers before submission.
         *
         * Header predicates distinguish post-login canonical
         * requests from the initial anonymous bootstrap.
         */
        const loginResponsePromise =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) =>
                    matchesApplicationApiPath(
                        response.url(),
                        '/api/v1/browser/auth/login',
                    )
                    && response
                        .request()
                        .method()
                        === 'POST',
            );

        const authenticatedContextResponsePromise =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) =>
                    matchesApplicationApiPath(
                        response.url(),
                        '/api/v1/auth/me',
                    )
                    && response
                        .request()
                        .headers()[
                            'x-educore-membership-id'
                        ]
                        === e2eMembershipId,
            );

        const membershipDiscoveryResponsePromise =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) =>
                    matchesApplicationApiPath(
                        response.url(),
                        '/api/v1/user/my-memberships',
                    )
                    && response.status()
                        === 200,
            );

        const workspaceDiscoveryResponsePromise =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) =>
                    matchesApplicationApiPath(
                        response.url(),
                        '/api/v1/user/my-workspaces',
                    )
                    && response
                        .request()
                        .headers()[
                            'x-educore-membership-id'
                        ]
                        === e2eMembershipId,
            );

        const capabilityResponsePromise =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) =>
                    matchesApplicationApiPath(
                        response.url(),
                        '/api/v1/core/authorization/capabilities',
                    )
                    && response
                        .request()
                        .headers()[
                            'x-educore-membership-id'
                        ]
                        === e2eMembershipId,
            );

        await page
            .getByRole(
                'button',
                {
                    name:
                        'Masuk',
                },
            )
            .click();

        const [
            loginResponse,
            authenticatedContextResponse,
            membershipDiscoveryResponse,
            workspaceDiscoveryResponse,
            capabilityResponse,
        ] =
            await Promise.all([
                loginResponsePromise,
                authenticatedContextResponsePromise,
                membershipDiscoveryResponsePromise,
                workspaceDiscoveryResponsePromise,
                capabilityResponsePromise,
            ]);

        /*
         * Browser login returns only safe context.
         *
         * Canonical bearer credential remains inside the
         * server-side BrowserSession vault.
         */
        expect(
            loginResponse.status(),
        ).toBe(
            200,
        );

        const loginBody:
            unknown =
            await loginResponse.json();

        expect(
            loginBody,
        ).toMatchObject({
            status:
                'success',

            data: {
                membership_id:
                    e2eMembershipId,

                tenant_id:
                    e2eTenantId,
            },
        });

        expect(
            JSON.stringify(
                loginBody,
            ),
        ).not.toContain(
            'access_token',
        );

        /*
         * Successful login is not accepted until canonical
         * /auth/me confirms the server-held credential.
         */
        expect(
            authenticatedContextResponse.status(),
        ).toBe(
            200,
        );

        const authenticatedContextBody:
            unknown =
            await authenticatedContextResponse.json();

        expect(
            authenticatedContextBody,
        ).toMatchObject({
            status:
                'success',

            data: {
                user: {
                    email:
                        e2eEmail,
                },

                membership: {
                    id:
                        e2eMembershipId,

                    status:
                        'ACTIVE',
                },

                tenant: {
                    id:
                        e2eTenantId,
                },
            },
        });

        expect(
            membershipDiscoveryResponse.status(),
        ).toBe(
            200,
        );

        expect(
            workspaceDiscoveryResponse.status(),
        ).toBe(
            200,
        );

        const workspaceBody:
            unknown =
            await workspaceDiscoveryResponse.json();

        expect(
            workspaceBody,
        ).toMatchObject({
            status:
                'success',

            data: {
                tenant: {
                    id:
                        e2eTenantId,
                },
            },
        });

        /*
         * An empty RBAC catalog is valid for the current
         * permission-free protected application shell.
         */
        expect(
            capabilityResponse.status(),
        ).toBe(
            200,
        );

        const capabilityBody:
            unknown =
            await capabilityResponse.json();

        expect(
            capabilityBody,
        ).toMatchObject({
            status:
                'success',

            data: {
                scope: {
                    type:
                        'tenant',

                    tenant_id:
                        e2eTenantId,

                    membership_id:
                        e2eMembershipId,
                },

                is_global_superadmin:
                    false,

                permissions:
                    [],
            },
        });

        /*
         * None of the real browser requests may manufacture
         * JavaScript-owned canonical Bearer authority.
         */
        for (
            const response
            of [
                loginResponse,
                authenticatedContextResponse,
                membershipDiscoveryResponse,
                workspaceDiscoveryResponse,
                capabilityResponse,
            ]
        ) {
            expect(
                response
                    .request()
                    .headers()[
                        'authorization'
                    ],
            ).toBeUndefined();
        }

        /*
         * Root protected application requires canonical
         * Auth + Membership + TENANT Workspace readiness,
         * but no additional permission.
         */
        await expect(
            page.getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Frontend Foundation',
                },
            ),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await expect(
            page.getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Masuk ke EduCore',
                },
            ),
        ).toHaveCount(
            0,
        );

        const finalUrl =
            new URL(
                page.url(),
            );

        expect(
            finalUrl.origin,
        ).toBe(
            applicationOrigin,
        );

        expect(
            finalUrl.pathname,
        ).toBe(
            '/',
        );

        /*
         * Playwright may inspect HttpOnly metadata from the
         * browser process even though page JavaScript cannot
         * read the session cookie.
         */
        const cookies =
            await context.cookies();

        const sessionCookie =
            cookies.find(
                (cookie) =>
                    cookie.name
                        === 'laravel-session',
            );

        expect(
            sessionCookie,
        ).toBeDefined();

        expect(
            sessionCookie?.httpOnly,
        ).toBe(
            true,
        );

        expect(
            sessionCookie?.sameSite,
        ).toBe(
            'Lax',
        );

        /*
         * HttpOnly must make the canonical Laravel session
         * identifier invisible to browser JavaScript.
         */
        const visibleCookies =
            await page.evaluate(
                () =>
                    document.cookie,
            );

        expect(
            visibleCookies,
        ).not.toContain(
            'laravel-session=',
        );

        /*
         * Browser storage may contain context restoration
         * hints, but never passwords or Bearer credentials.
         */
        const browserStorage =
            await page.evaluate(
                () => ({
                    localStorage:
                        Object.fromEntries(
                            Object.entries(
                                window.localStorage,
                            ),
                        ),

                    sessionStorage:
                        Object.fromEntries(
                            Object.entries(
                                window.sessionStorage,
                            ),
                        ),
                }),
            );

        const serializedStorage =
            JSON.stringify(
                browserStorage,
            );

        expect(
            serializedStorage,
        ).not.toContain(
            e2ePassword,
        );

        expect(
            serializedStorage,
        ).not.toContain(
            'access_token',
        );

        expect(
            serializedStorage,
        ).not.toMatch(
            /Bearer\s+/iu,
        );
    },
);
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Kita tidak menambahkan RBAC palsu

Current E2E DB memang:

```text
roles              0
permissions        0
role_permissions   0
membership_roles   0
```

`Pasted text.txt`

Tetapi current protected shell bukan business permission route. Itulah alasan fixture tetap minimal:

```text
identity
+
tenant membership
```

Business route seperti Academic/Dormitory nantinya baru mempunyai permission policy eksplisit.

Menambahkan `admin` sekarang hanya agar test “terlihat sukses” justru akan mengurangi kualitas test karena kita tidak lagi membuktikan bahwa shell benar-benar permission-neutral.

### 2. Empty Capability masih valid

Capability query hanya mengevaluasi canonical permission yang terdaftar. Tidak ada wildcard/synthetic permission yang dibuat. `Pasted text.txt`

Karena catalog kosong:

```text
catalog []
→ effective permissions []
```

dan projection tetap valid.

Lebih penting lagi, protected route evaluator tidak menjadikan Capability availability sebagai pembatas baru ketika policy `requiredPermissions` adalah `null`. `Pasted text (3).txt`

### 3. Login dilakukan melalui UI

Kita sengaja tidak menulis:

```ts
request.post('/api/v1/browser/auth/login')
```

karena FEI-10 adalah **Browser Login UX integration**.

Real proof harus melewati:

```text
LoginForm
→ validation
→ LoginPage
→ BrowserAuthRuntime
→ Auth service
→ Browser API client
→ Laravel
```

### 4. Seeder menjadi bagian deterministic test startup

Playwright tidak lagi bergantung pada:

> “Saya sudah seed database tadi.”

Setiap E2E invocation melakukan:

```text
safe idempotent fixture seed
→ Laravel server
→ Vite
→ Chromium
```

Tetapi seeder sendiri tetap mempunyai hard safety boundary:

```text
APP_ENV=e2e
AND
DB=educore_e2e
```

### 5. Server-held bearer benar-benar diuji

Ada tiga level proof:

```text
login JSON
→ tidak ada access_token

HTTP requests browser
→ tidak ada Authorization

browser storage
→ tidak ada Bearer/access_token/password
```

Ini lebih kuat daripada hanya static grep.

### 6. Session cookie diuji dari dua perspektif

Test runner dapat melihat:

```text
laravel-session
httpOnly=true
```

sementara page JavaScript harus melihat:

```text
document.cookie
→ tidak mengandung laravel-session
```

Ini membuktikan BrowserSession credential boundary bekerja secara browser nyata.

# Troubleshooting

Jika login mendapatkan `419`, **jangan bypass CSRF**. Kirim login response + cookie inventory. Itu berarti real request-forgery lifecycle belum sesuai.

Jika login `401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`, jangan mengubah frontend. Verifikasi otomatis seeder benar-benar berjalan dari `[WebServer]` output dan fixture masih ada di `educore_e2e`.

Jika login `200` tetapi `/auth/me` gagal, itu berarti server-side BrowserSession credential custody/locator continuation yang perlu diaudit.

Jika `/auth/me` dan Membership berhasil tetapi `/my-workspaces` gagal, jangan menambahkan Organization fixture dulu. Tenant-only workspace memang harus tetap tersedia tanpa organizational assignment.

Jika capability mengembalikan `200` tetapi `permissions` bukan `[]`, jangan menyesuaikan assertion dulu. Itu berarti E2E database sudah mempunyai authorization catalog yang tidak kita perkirakan dan harus diaudit.

Jika test berhenti karena tidak menemukan `Frontend Foundation`, kirim response statuses dan final URL. Kita akan menentukan tepat runtime mana yang tidak mencapai `ready`.

# FEI-10H.3C — BrowserSession Reload Persistence

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Sekarang kita menguji property yang berbeda dari successful login:

> **Apakah authenticated browser tetap authenticated setelah full page reload tanpa mengirim email/password lagi?**

Ini penting karena BrowserSession seharusnya menjadi authority lintas HTTP request.

Target lifecycle:

```text
successful login
        ↓
BrowserSession cookie
        ↓
page.reload()
        ↓
fresh React runtime
        ↓
bootstrap BrowserSession
        ↓
canonical /auth/me
        ↓
Membership
        ↓
Workspace
        ↓
protected application
```

Reload ini harus berhasil **tanpa**:

```text
POST /browser/auth/login lagi
password replay
Bearer dari browser storage
```

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Ubah hanya:

```text
frontend/e2e/authentication.e2e.ts
```

Tidak perlu mengubah:

```text
frontend/playwright.config.ts
database/seeders/E2EBrowserAuthenticationSeeder.php
frontend/src/*
Modules/*
```

Kita cukup menambah **satu test baru**.

---

# Kode Lengkap

Tambahkan test berikut **di akhir**:

```ts
test(
    'real BrowserSession remains authoritative after a full page reload without credential replay',
    async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        await page.goto(
            '/login',
        );

        await expect(
            page.getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Masuk ke EduCore',
                },
            ),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await page
            .getByLabel(
                'Email',
            )
            .fill(
                e2eEmail,
            );

        await page
            .getByLabel(
                'Password',
            )
            .fill(
                e2ePassword,
            );

        await page
            .getByLabel(
                'Tenant UUID',
            )
            .fill(
                e2eTenantId,
            );

        let loginRequestCount =
            0;

        page.on(
            'request',
            (request) => {
                if (
                    matchesApplicationApiPath(
                        request.url(),
                        '/api/v1/browser/auth/login',
                    )
                    && request.method()
                        === 'POST'
                ) {
                    loginRequestCount +=
                        1;
                }
            },
        );

        await page
            .getByRole(
                'button',
                {
                    name:
                        'Masuk',
                },
            )
            .click();

        await expect(
            page.getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Frontend Foundation',
                },
            ),
        ).toBeVisible();

        expect(
            loginRequestCount,
        ).toBe(
            1,
        );

        /*
         * Register reload lifecycle observers before the
         * browser performs the full document navigation.
         *
         * The new React runtime must recover authentication
         * exclusively from the HttpOnly BrowserSession.
         */
        const reloadedAuthenticationResponsePromise =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) =>
                    matchesApplicationApiPath(
                        response.url(),
                        '/api/v1/auth/me',
                    )
                    && response
                        .request()
                        .headers()[
                            'x-educore-membership-id'
                        ]
                        === e2eMembershipId,
            );

        const reloadedMembershipResponsePromise =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) =>
                    matchesApplicationApiPath(
                        response.url(),
                        '/api/v1/user/my-memberships',
                    )
                    && response.status()
                        === 200,
            );

        const reloadedWorkspaceResponsePromise =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) =>
                    matchesApplicationApiPath(
                        response.url(),
                        '/api/v1/user/my-workspaces',
                    )
                    && response
                        .request()
                        .headers()[
                            'x-educore-membership-id'
                        ]
                        === e2eMembershipId,
            );

        await page.reload();

        const [
            authenticationResponse,
            membershipResponse,
            workspaceResponse,
        ] =
            await Promise.all([
                reloadedAuthenticationResponsePromise,
                reloadedMembershipResponsePromise,
                reloadedWorkspaceResponsePromise,
            ]);

        expect(
            authenticationResponse.status(),
        ).toBe(
            200,
        );

        expect(
            membershipResponse.status(),
        ).toBe(
            200,
        );

        expect(
            workspaceResponse.status(),
        ).toBe(
            200,
        );

        /*
         * Reload must never cause the browser to replay the
         * login credential flow.
         */
        expect(
            loginRequestCount,
        ).toBe(
            1,
        );

        for (
            const response
            of [
                authenticationResponse,
                membershipResponse,
                workspaceResponse,
            ]
        ) {
            expect(
                response
                    .request()
                    .headers()[
                        'authorization'
                    ],
            ).toBeUndefined();
        }

        await expect(
            page.getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Frontend Foundation',
                },
            ),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await expect(
            page.getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Masuk ke EduCore',
                },
            ),
        ).toHaveCount(
            0,
        );

        const finalUrl =
            new URL(
                page.url(),
            );

        expect(
            finalUrl.origin,
        ).toBe(
            applicationOrigin,
        );

        expect(
            finalUrl.pathname,
        ).toBe(
            '/',
        );

        /*
         * A fresh document still must not obtain canonical
         * bearer material through browser-owned storage.
         */
        const browserStorage =
            await page.evaluate(
                () => ({
                    localStorage:
                        Object.fromEntries(
                            Object.entries(
                                window.localStorage,
                            ),
                        ),

                    sessionStorage:
                        Object.fromEntries(
                            Object.entries(
                                window.sessionStorage,
                            ),
                        ),
                }),
            );

        const serializedStorage =
            JSON.stringify(
                browserStorage,
            );

        expect(
            serializedStorage,
        ).not.toContain(
            e2ePassword,
        );

        expect(
            serializedStorage,
        ).not.toContain(
            'access_token',
        );

        expect(
            serializedStorage,
        ).not.toMatch(
            /Bearer\s+/iu,
        );
    },
);
```

---

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Reload adalah cold frontend runtime

`page.reload()` menghancurkan state React yang sedang aktif.

Secara konseptual:

```text
BrowserAuthRuntime memory
MembershipContext memory
WorkspaceContext memory
Capability memory
```

# FEI-10H.3C.1 — Fix Playwright Test Boundary

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita harus memastikan struktur file kembali menjadi:

```ts
test('anonymous...', async () => {
    ...
});

test('successful login...', async () => {
    ...
});

test('reload persistence...', async () => {
    ...
});
```

Bukan:

```ts
test('successful login...', async () => {
    ...

    test('reload persistence...', async () => {
        ...
    });
});
```

`test()` Playwright harus dideklarasikan ketika module dimuat, bukan ketika test lain sedang dieksekusi.

## Struktur Folder & File

Hanya:

```text
frontend/e2e/authentication.e2e.ts
```

Jangan ubah:

```text
frontend/playwright.config.ts
database/seeders/E2EBrowserAuthenticationSeeder.php
frontend/src/*
Modules/*
```

## Kode Lengkap

Sebelum mengubah apa pun, kita perlu melihat boundary aktual agar tidak menebak posisi `});` yang salah.

Jalankan **hanya command ini**:

```bash
echo "=== FEI-10H.3C.1 TEST BOUNDARY AUDIT ==="

nl -ba \
  frontend/e2e/authentication.e2e.ts \
  | sed -n '620,900p'
```

Output ini akan memperlihatkan:

```text
akhir successful-login test
line 661 test(
isi reload test
closing braces di tail file
```

dan dari situ kita bisa memindahkan **tepat satu test boundary** tanpa menyentuh logic H.3B yang sudah terbukti 2/2 PASS sebelumnya.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

TypeScript tetap PASS karena nested call ini secara sintaks TypeScript valid:

```ts
async () => {
    test(...);
}
```

Masalahnya adalah **Playwright runtime contract**, bukan syntax/type contract.

Karena itu:

```text
frontend:typecheck ✅
Playwright runtime ❌
```

tidak kontradiktif.

Dan error ini:

```text
Playwright Test did not expect test() to be called here
```

sangat berbeda dari misalnya:

```text
/auth/me → 401
reload → /login
timeout waiting for workspace
```

Jadi kita **tidak boleh** sekarang mengubah session, authentication runtime, cookie configuration, ataupun backend. Belum ada bukti bahwa area tersebut bermasalah.

atau:

dan jangan menambah:

```text
BARU page.reload()
```

```text
    ↓
❌ timeout
```

## Kode Lengkap

Gunakan patch terarah berikut. Script ini mencari exact block yang sekarang ada dan menggantinya; jika source sudah berbeda, ia akan **fail** daripada melakukan replacement sembarangan.

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "frontend/e2e/authentication.e2e.ts"
)

text = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

old = """                await page
                    .getByRole(
                        'button',
                        {
                            name:
                                'Masuk',
                        },
                    )
                    .click();

                await expect(
                    page.getByRole(
                        'heading',
                        {
                            name:
                                'Frontend Foundation',
                        },
                    ),
                ).toBeVisible();

                expect(
                    loginRequestCount,
                ).toBe(
                    1,
                );
"""

new = """                /*
                 * Establish the successful-login precondition
                 * through authoritative backend milestones
                 * before testing reload persistence.
                 *
                 * Do not rely on an arbitrary UI timeout:
                 * the real Auth -> Membership -> Workspace
                 * lifecycle may legitimately take longer than
                 * the default assertion timeout.
                 */
                const loginResponsePromise =
                    page.waitForResponse(
                        (response) =>
                            matchesApplicationApiPath(
                                response.url(),
                                '/api/v1/browser/auth/login',
                            )
                            && response
                                .request()
                                .method()
                                === 'POST',
                    );

                const authenticatedContextResponsePromise =
                    page.waitForResponse(
                        (response) =>
                            matchesApplicationApiPath(
                                response.url(),
                                '/api/v1/auth/me',
                            )
                            && response
                                .request()
                                .headers()[
                                    'x-educore-membership-id'
                                ]
                                === e2eMembershipId,
                    );

                const membershipDiscoveryResponsePromise =
                    page.waitForResponse(
                        (response) =>
                            matchesApplicationApiPath(
                                response.url(),
                                '/api/v1/user/my-memberships',
                            )
                            && response.status()
                                === 200,
                    );

                const workspaceDiscoveryResponsePromise =
                    page.waitForResponse(
                        (response) =>
                            matchesApplicationApiPath(
                                response.url(),
                                '/api/v1/user/my-workspaces',
                            )
                            && response
                                .request()
                                .headers()[
                                    'x-educore-membership-id'
                                ]
                                === e2eMembershipId,
                    );

                await page
                    .getByRole(
                        'button',
                        {
                            name:
                                'Masuk',
                        },
                    )
                    .click();

                const [
                    loginResponse,
                    authenticatedContextResponse,
                    membershipDiscoveryResponse,
                    workspaceDiscoveryResponse,
                ] =
                    await Promise.all([
                        loginResponsePromise,
                        authenticatedContextResponsePromise,
                        membershipDiscoveryResponsePromise,
                        workspaceDiscoveryResponsePromise,
                    ]);

                expect(
                    loginResponse.status(),
                ).toBe(
                    200,
                );

                expect(
                    authenticatedContextResponse.status(),
                ).toBe(
                    200,
                );

                expect(
                    membershipDiscoveryResponse.status(),
                ).toBe(
                    200,
                );

                expect(
                    workspaceDiscoveryResponse.status(),
                ).toBe(
                    200,
                );

                expect(
                    loginRequestCount,
                ).toBe(
                    1,
                );

                await expect(
                    page.getByRole(
                        'heading',
                        {
                            name:
                                'Frontend Foundation',
                        },
                    ),
                ).toBeVisible();
"""

count = text.count(old)

if count != 1:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Expected exactly one H.3C login precondition block; "
        f"found {count}."
    )

path.write_text(
    text.replace(
        old,
        new,
    ),
    encoding="utf-8",
)

print(
    "Updated H.3C successful-login precondition."
)
PY
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Event-driven, bukan time-driven

Kita tidak melakukan:

```ts
await page.waitForTimeout(10000);
```

Karena itu akan membuat test:

```text
lambat ketika sistem cepat
+
flaky ketika sistem lebih lambat
```

sudah dipasang sebelum klik dan tetap tidak berubah.

masih membuktikan bahwa reload **tidak melakukan credential replay**.

Semua promise didaftarkan **sebelum**:

Ini penting agar response cepat tidak lolos dari observer.

### 3. Extract network lifecycle dari trace tanpa membuka GUI

Jalankan script audit-only berikut:

```bash
echo
echo "=== FEI-10H.3C.3 3. RELOAD API TRACE ==="

python - <<'PY'
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from zipfile import ZipFile

root = Path(
    "node_modules/.cache/educore-playwright"
)

traces = sorted(
    root.rglob("trace.zip"),
    key=lambda path: path.stat().st_mtime,
    reverse=True,
)

if not traces:
    raise SystemExit(
        "No Playwright trace.zip found."
    )

trace = traces[0]

print(
    f"TRACE={trace}"
)

interesting_paths = {
    "/api/v1/browser/session/csrf",
    "/api/v1/browser/auth/login",
    "/api/v1/auth/me",
    "/api/v1/user/my-memberships",
    "/api/v1/user/my-workspaces",
    "/api/v1/core/authorization/capabilities",
    "/api/v1/core/authorization/workspace-capabilities",
}

seen: set[
    tuple[str, str, str, str, str]
] = set()

def header_value(
    headers: object,
    expected_name: str,
) -> str:
    if isinstance(
        headers,
        dict,
    ):
        for name, value in headers.items():
            if (
                str(name).lower()
                == expected_name.lower()
            ):
                return str(value)

    if isinstance(
        headers,
        list,
    ):
        for item in headers:
            if not isinstance(
                item,
                dict,
            ):
                continue

            name = item.get(
                "name",
            )

            if (
                isinstance(
                    name,
                    str,
                )
                and name.lower()
                    == expected_name.lower()
            ):
                return str(
                    item.get(
                        "value",
                        "",
                    )
                )

    return "-"

def emit_candidate(
    request: object,
    response: object = None,
) -> None:
    if not isinstance(
        request,
        dict,
    ):
        return

    url = request.get(
        "url",
    )

    if not isinstance(
        url,
        str,
    ):
        return

    parsed = urlparse(
        url,
    )

    if parsed.path not in interesting_paths:
        return

    method = str(
        request.get(
            "method",
            "?",
        )
    )

    status = "-"

    if isinstance(
        response,
        dict,
    ):
        raw_status = response.get(
            "status",
        )

        if raw_status is not None:
            status = str(
                raw_status,
            )

    headers = request.get(
        "headers",
        {},
    )

    membership = header_value(
        headers,
        "x-educore-membership-id",
    )

    authorization = header_value(
        headers,
        "authorization",
    )

    key = (
        method,
        parsed.path,
        status,
        membership,
        authorization,
    )

    if key in seen:
        return

    seen.add(
        key,
    )

    print(
        f"{method:6} "
        f"{parsed.path:55} "
        f"status={status:4} "
        f"membership={membership} "
        f"authorization={authorization}"
    )

def walk(
    value: object,
) -> None:
    if isinstance(
        value,
        dict,
    ):
        request = value.get(
            "request",
        )

        response = value.get(
            "response",
        )

        emit_candidate(
            request,
            response,
        )

        if (
            isinstance(
                value.get("url"),
                str,
            )
            and isinstance(
                value.get("method"),
                str,
            )
        ):
            emit_candidate(
                value,
                response,
            )

        for child in value.values():
            walk(
                child,
            )

    elif isinstance(
        value,
        list,
    ):
        for child in value:
            walk(
                child,
            )

with ZipFile(
    trace,
) as archive:
    for name in archive.namelist():
        if not (
            name.endswith(".trace")
            or name.endswith(".network")
        ):
            continue

        raw = archive.read(
            name,
        ).decode(
            "utf-8",
            errors="ignore",
        )

        for line in raw.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()

            if not line.startswith(
                "{"
            ):
                continue

            try:
                payload = json.loads(
                    line,
                )
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue

            walk(
                payload,
            )

if not seen:
    print(
        "No matching API records found "
        "through structured trace parsing."
    )
PY
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### Kenapa observer sekarang timeout?

Observer H.3C mencari **request spesifik**:

```text

+
X-EduCore-Membership-Id = fixture membership
```

Timeout tidak otomatis berarti:

> BrowserSession hilang.

Misalnya reload bisa melakukan:

```text

X-EduCore-Membership-Id: absent
```

```text

```

Session masih hidup, tetapi frontend belum memulihkan locator Membership.

### Session authority dan locator context harus dibedakan

Arsitektur kita memang memisahkan:

```text

→ authentication credential custody

X-EduCore-Membership-Id
→ tenant/membership locator only
```

Maka reload bisa memiliki:

```text
BrowserSession ✅
Membership locator ❌
```

tanpa kontradiksi.

Kita harus tahu apakah itulah yang sedang terjadi.

### Jangan memperbaiki test predicate dulu

Jangan mengganti observer menjadi:

```ts
page.waitForResponse(
    response =>

)
```

lalu menganggap test PASS.

H.3C memang ingin membuktikan bahwa browser akhirnya pulih hingga canonical membership-aware `/auth/me`.

Kita boleh membuat observer lebih diagnostik kemudian, tetapi tidak boleh menghilangkan invariant-nya.

# FEI-10H.3C.4A - Membership Restoration Storage Primitive

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Pada langkah ini kita **belum mengubah bootstrap lifecycle**.

Kita hanya membuat primitive storage yang aman:

```text
authenticated Membership
        ↓
persist {
  membership_id,
  tenant_id
}
        ↓
sessionStorage

reload
        ↓
read hint
        ↓
belum authoritative
```

Kenapa `sessionStorage`, bukan `localStorage`?

```text
sessionStorage
→ tab-local
→ survive reload
→ hilang ketika tab/browser context selesai

localStorage
→ cross-tab / long-lived
→ terlalu luas untuk active contextual selection
```

Pola ini konsisten dengan Workspace restoration existing yang juga menggunakan browser `sessionStorage`. `Pasted text.txt`

Security invariant:

```text
restoration hint ≠ authentication
restoration hint ≠ authorization
restoration hint ≠ bearer credential
```

Nanti H.3C.4B baru akan mengirim hint tersebut ke canonical `/auth/me` untuk **server verification** sebelum Membership menjadi authoritative.
