# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Buat `frontend/src/platform/membership/restoration.ts`

```bash
cat > frontend/src/platform/membership/restoration.ts <<'TS'
import type {
    CanonicalMembershipContext,
} from '@/platform/membership/contract';

const MEMBERSHIP_RESTORATION_STORAGE_KEY =
    'educore.membership-restoration.v1';

export interface MembershipRestorationHint {
    readonly membership_id:
        CanonicalMembershipContext[
            'membership'
        ]['id'];

    readonly tenant_id:
        CanonicalMembershipContext[
            'tenant'
        ]['id'];
}

export interface MembershipRestorationHintStorage {
    getItem(
        key:
            string,
    ): string | null;

    setItem(
        key:
            string,
        value:
            string,
    ): void;

    removeItem(
        key:
            string,
    ): void;
}

function isNonEmptyString(
    value:
        unknown,
): value is string {
    return (
        typeof value
            === 'string'
        && value
            .trim()
            .length
            > 0
    );
}

function isMembershipRestorationHint(
    value:
        unknown,
): value is MembershipRestorationHint {
    if (
        typeof value
            !== 'object'
        || value
            === null
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    if (
        ! (
            'membership_id'
            in value
        )
        || ! (
            'tenant_id'
            in value
        )
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    return (
        isNonEmptyString(
            value.membership_id,
        )
        && isNonEmptyString(
            value.tenant_id,
        )
    );
}

function defaultStorage():
    MembershipRestorationHintStorage | null {
    if (
        typeof window
            === 'undefined'
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    return window.sessionStorage;
}

export function readBrowserMembershipRestorationHint(
    storage:
        MembershipRestorationHintStorage | null =
            defaultStorage(),
): MembershipRestorationHint | null {
    if (
        storage
            === null
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    let serialized:
        string | null;

    try {
        serialized =
            storage.getItem(
                MEMBERSHIP_RESTORATION_STORAGE_KEY,
            );
    } catch {
        /*
         * Storage availability is browser capability,
         * not authentication truth.
         *
         * Fail closed without manufacturing context.
         */
        return null;
    }

    if (
        serialized
            === null
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    let parsed:
        unknown;

    try {
        parsed =
            JSON.parse(
                serialized,
            );
    } catch {
        /*
         * Invalid client-owned state must never become a
         * canonical Membership locator.
         */
        clearBrowserMembershipRestorationHint(
            storage,
        );

        return null;
    }

    if (
        ! isMembershipRestorationHint(
            parsed,
        )
    ) {
        clearBrowserMembershipRestorationHint(
            storage,
        );

        return null;
    }

    return {
        membership_id:
            parsed.membership_id,

        tenant_id:
            parsed.tenant_id,
    };
}

export function persistBrowserMembershipRestorationHint(
    context:
        CanonicalMembershipContext,
    storage:
        MembershipRestorationHintStorage | null =
            defaultStorage(),
): boolean {
    if (
        storage
            === null
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    if (
        ! isNonEmptyString(
            context.membership.id,
        )
        || ! isNonEmptyString(
            context.tenant.id,
        )
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    const hint:
        MembershipRestorationHint = {
            membership_id:
                context.membership.id,

            tenant_id:
                context.tenant.id,
        };

    try {
        storage.setItem(
            MEMBERSHIP_RESTORATION_STORAGE_KEY,
            JSON.stringify(
                hint,
            ),
        );

        return true;
    } catch {
        /*
         * Browser storage failure must not promote or
         * invalidate canonical authentication authority.
         */
        return false;
    }
}

export function clearBrowserMembershipRestorationHint(
    storage:
        MembershipRestorationHintStorage | null =
            defaultStorage(),
): boolean {
    if (
        storage
            === null
    ) {
        return false;
    }

    try {
        storage.removeItem(
            MEMBERSHIP_RESTORATION_STORAGE_KEY,
        );

        return true;
    } catch {
        return false;
    }
}
TS
```

```bash
import {
    afterEach,
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import type {
    CanonicalMembershipContext,
} from '@/platform/membership';
import {
    clearBrowserMembershipRestorationHint,
    persistBrowserMembershipRestorationHint,
    readBrowserMembershipRestorationHint,
} from '@/platform/membership/restoration';

const membershipId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7abc-8def-1234567890ab';

const tenantId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7cde-8def-1234567890ab';

const context:
    CanonicalMembershipContext = {
        membership: {
            id:
                membershipId,

            status:
                'ACTIVE',
        },

        tenant: {
            id:
                tenantId,

            name:
                'EduCore School',

            subdomain:
                'educore-school',
        },
    };

afterEach(
    () => {
        window.sessionStorage.clear();
    },
);

describe(
    'Membership restoration hint',
    () => {
        it(
            'persists only the canonical Membership and Tenant locator pair in sessionStorage',
            () => {
                expect(
                    persistBrowserMembershipRestorationHint(
                        context,
                    ),
                ).toBe(
                    true,
                );

                expect(
                    readBrowserMembershipRestorationHint(),
                ).toEqual({
                    membership_id:
                        membershipId,

                    tenant_id:
                        tenantId,
                });

                const serialized =
                    JSON.stringify(
                        Object.fromEntries(
                            Object.entries(
                                window.sessionStorage,
                            ),
                        ),
                    );

                expect(
                    serialized,
                ).not.toContain(
                    'access_token',
                );

                expect(
                    serialized,
                ).not.toMatch(
                    /Bearer\s+/iu,
                );
            },
        );

        it(
            'clears the restoration hint explicitly',
            () => {
                persistBrowserMembershipRestorationHint(
                    context,
                );

                expect(
                    clearBrowserMembershipRestorationHint(),
                ).toBe(
                    true,
                );

                expect(
                    readBrowserMembershipRestorationHint(),
                ).toBeNull();
            },
        );

        it(
            'rejects and removes malformed client-owned restoration state',
            () => {
                window.sessionStorage.setItem(
                    'educore.membership-restoration.v1',
                    JSON.stringify({
                        membership_id:
                            '',
                        tenant_id:
                            tenantId,
                    }),
                );

                expect(
                    readBrowserMembershipRestorationHint(),
                ).toBeNull();

                expect(
                    window.sessionStorage.getItem(
                        'educore.membership-restoration.v1',
                    ),
                ).toBeNull();
            },
        );

        it(
            'rejects and removes non-json client-owned restoration state',
            () => {
                window.sessionStorage.setItem(
                    'educore.membership-restoration.v1',
                    '{invalid-json',
                );

                expect(
                    readBrowserMembershipRestorationHint(),
                ).toBeNull();

                expect(
                    window.sessionStorage.getItem(
                        'educore.membership-restoration.v1',
                    ),
                ).toBeNull();
            },
        );
    },
);
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Tidak menyimpan seluruh Membership object

Yang masuk storage hanya:

```json
{
  "membership_id": "...",
  "tenant_id": "..."
}
```

Tidak ada:

```text
email
user
person
permissions[]
roles
bearer
access_token
password
BrowserSession ID
```

KISS dan principle of least data.

---

## 2. Hint bukan authority

Data ini sengaja disebut:

```text
MembershipRestorationHint
```

bukan:

```text
AuthenticatedMembership
ActiveAuthorizationContext
```

Karena browser boleh mengubah `sessionStorage`.

Nanti canonical server tetap harus membuktikan:

```text
hint membership_id
        ↓
HttpOnly BrowserSession
        ↓
server-held membership credential
        ↓
GET /auth/me
        ↓
canonical Membership/Tenant
```

Jadi attacker mengubah storage tidak memberi permission baru.

---

## 3. `tenant_id` ikut disimpan

Walaupun H.3C berikutnya terutama memakai `membership_id`, pasangan:

```text
membership_id + tenant_id
```

membuat hint memiliki konteks yang lebih eksplisit dan memungkinkan cross-check canonical setelah restore.

Ini juga mencegah kita memperlakukan Membership locator sebagai identifier tanpa Tenant context.

---

## 4. Malformed storage dibuang

Untuk:

```text
invalid JSON
missing membership_id
empty membership_id
missing tenant_id
```

behavior-nya:

```text
clear hint
→ return null
→ normal selection flow
```

Bukan exception dan bukan authenticated state.

Fail closed.

---

## 5. Storage failure bukan auth failure

Browser dapat memblokir storage karena privacy/security policy.

Jika `sessionStorage` gagal:

```text
persist → false
read    → null
clear   → false
```

Auth tetap boleh berjalan.

Karena storage adalah UX restoration convenience, bukan security authority.

---

# Troubleshooting

Jika test fixture `CanonicalMembershipContext` gagal typecheck karena generated schema mempunyai field Tenant tambahan yang tidak terlihat pada audit, **jangan gunakan `as`** untuk memaksa tipe. Kirim TS error-nya dan kita sesuaikan fixture ke canonical schema.

Jika `sessionStorage` tidak tersedia pada Vitest, itu berarti environment test file tidak jsdom sebagaimana existing Workspace tests; jangan mengganti primitive ke `localStorage`.

Jika `index.ts` ternyata sudah mempunyai export restoration serupa, script akan berhenti tanpa duplikasi.

Jangan menjalankan E2E H.3C dulu pada substep ini-production bootstrap belum memakai hint sehingga `Pilih Membership` memang masih expected.

---

# Langkah Berikutnya

Jika H.3C.4A hijau, baru kita lanjut **FEI-10H.3C.4B - Verified Membership Restoration Wiring**.

Pada langkah itu lifecycle-nya akan menjadi:

```text
page reload
→ initial BrowserSession bootstrap
→ 403 BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
→ read tab-local Membership hint
→ canonical /auth/me + Membership locator
→ server verifies BrowserSession credential
→ authenticated canonical context
→ /my-memberships cross-check
→ Workspace restoration
→ Frontend Foundation
```

Jadi kita tidak akan mengakali reducer atau auto-select Membership. Kita menambahkan missing reload hint sambil tetap mempertahankan canonical server verification sebagai authority.

# Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Lifecycle yang kita implementasikan:

```text
fresh login
→ canonical Membership ready
→ persist tab-local hint

reload
→ initial /auth/me tanpa locator
→ membership-context-required
→ discover memberships
→ read sessionStorage hint
→ pastikan hint ada dalam discovery
→ /auth/me + membership locator
→ backend verifies BrowserSession credential
→ canonical context harus match discovery target
→ Membership ready
```

Jika hint stale/tampered:

```text
hint
→ tidak ditemukan di discovery
→ clear hint
→ selection-required
```

Jika backend tidak mengonfirmasi target:

```text
hint
→ discovery match
→ /auth/me verification fails/mismatches
→ clear hint
→ selection-required
```

Jadi browser-owned storage tetap **bukan authority**.

```bash
             *
             * Persist it only after discovery has validated
             * that the pair is still available.
             */
            if (
                discoveredState.status
                    === 'ready'
            ) {
                persistCurrentContext(
                    discoveredState.context,
                );

                return discoveredState;
            }

            /*
             * Fresh authentication without canonical

             * Restoration is enabled only when the caller
             * explicitly classifies this bootstrap as an

                options.restoreHint
                    !== true
                || discoveredState.status
                    !== 'selection-required'

                return discoveredState;

            const restorationHint =
                readBrowserMembershipRestorationHint();

            if (
                restorationHint
                    === null

                return discoveredState;

             * arbitrary Membership.

             * Discovery must first prove that the stored
             * Membership/Tenant pair is still available to

                discoveredMemberships.find(

                            === restorationHint

                        && membership.tenant_id
                            === restorationHint

                membershipId:
                    restorationTarget

            if (

                        .tenant_id

                    discoveredState,

                    type:
                        'CONTEXT_CONFIRMED',
                    context:
                        confirmedContext,
```

## 2. Patch `MembershipContextProvider.tsx`

Provider hanya menentukan **kapan restoration boleh dicoba**.

Current provider memang merupakan owner dari initial Membership bootstrap. `Pasted text (3).txt`

Jalankan:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "frontend/src/app/membership/MembershipContextProvider.tsx"
)

text = path.read_text(
    encoding="utf-8",
)

needle = """                void runtime.bootstrap({
                    signal:
                        controller.signal,
                });
"""

replacement = """                void runtime.bootstrap({
                    signal:
                        controller.signal,

                    /*
                     * Only an initial BrowserSession that
                     * still needs Membership context may
                     * consume a tab-local restoration hint.
                     *
                     * A normal authenticated lifecycle
                     * already owns canonical context and
                     * must not need restoration.
                     */
                    restoreHint:
                        authenticationStatus
                            === 'membership-context-required',
                });
"""

if text.count(needle) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(
        "Expected exactly one Membership provider bootstrap call."
    )

text = text.replace(
    needle,
    replacement,
)

path.write_text(
    text,
    encoding="utf-8",
)

print(
    "Enabled restoration only for membership-context-required bootstrap."
)
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Discovery tetap menjadi validation layer pertama

Hint:

```text
membership A
```

tidak langsung dipakai ke `/auth/me`.

Pertama:

```text
GET /user/my-memberships
```

harus membuktikan pasangan:

```text
membership_id + tenant_id
```

masih tersedia.

### 2. Backend tetap authority terakhir

Setelah discovery match:

```ts
authentication.bootstrap({
    membershipId,
});
```

memanggil canonical `/auth/me`.

Baru ketika response menjadi:

```text
authenticated
+
membership sama
+
tenant sama
```

reducer mendapat:

```text
CONTEXT_CONFIRMED
```

Reducer existing sendiri sudah menolak confirmation yang tidak cocok dengan target. `Pasted text.txt`

### 3. Tidak ada membership switch saat reload

Ini penting.

Kita **tidak** menjalankan:

```text
POST /browser/user/memberships/{id}/switch
```

karena reload bukan perubahan pilihan Membership.

Switch endpoint digunakan ketika user memang memilih context baru; existing runtime baru setelah server mempersiapkan credential akan melakukan canonical `/auth/me` confirmation. `Pasted text.txt`

Reload hanya:

```text
restore locator
→ verify existing BrowserSession credential
```

### 4. Provider hanya memberi lifecycle classification

Provider tidak membaca `sessionStorage`.

Ia hanya mengatakan:

```text
membership-context-required
→ restoreHint = true

authenticated
→ restoreHint = false
```

Storage dan verification tetap platform-runtime concern.

Ini menjaga separation of concerns.

### 5. Explicit selection semantics tidak berubah

Tanpa hint:

```text
membership-context-required
→ discover Membership
→ selection-required
```

tetap sama seperti sebelumnya. Existing reducer memang mendefinisikan discovery tanpa canonical context sebagai explicit `selection-required`. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Jadi kita tidak memperkenalkan:

```text
if memberships.length === 1
    auto select
```

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak `observeFailure()` pada test harness karena return type berbeda, jangan pakai `as`. Kirim error exact-nya; kita sesuaikan stub dengan contract `MembershipAuthenticationRuntime`.

Jika existing runtime test gagal karena `sessionStorage` state antar-test, jangan menghapus persistence. Kita tambahkan storage cleanup yang scoped pada suite tersebut.

Jika test “mismatched canonical confirmation” melempar exception daripada kembali `selection-required`, kirim stack-nya. Client-owned restoration hint harus gagal sebagai recoverable stale hint, bukan menjatuhkan Application Error Boundary.

Jika regression menunjukkan fresh login berubah menjadi `selection-required`, hentikan. `restoreHint` tidak boleh memengaruhi normal authenticated bootstrap.

Warning CRLF saja tetap bukan blocker.

# Langkah Berikutnya

Jika H.3C.4B seluruhnya hijau, statusnya:

```text
FEI-10H.3C.4A - Membership Restoration Storage Primitive
✅ LOCKED

FEI-10H.3C.4B - Verified Membership Restoration Wiring
✅ COMPLETE / LOCKED
```

Baru setelah itu kita kembali ke **FEI-10H.3C.4C - Real Browser Reload Verification** dan menjalankan Playwright 3-test suite untuk membuktikan:

```text
login
→ sessionStorage locator hint
→ reload
→ /auth/me tanpa locator → context required
→ discovery
→ restored /auth/me WITH locator
→ authenticated
→ TENANT Workspace
→ Frontend Foundation
→ loginRequestCount tetap 1
```

Itu akan menjadi proof terakhir sebelum H.3C dapat benar-benar ditutup.

# FEI-10H.3C.4C — Real Browser Reload Verification

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Sekarang kita kembali ke browser nyata untuk membuktikan bahwa fix unit/runtime benar-benar menyelesaikan failure yang sebelumnya kita temukan.

Expected lifecycle setelah successful login:

```text
Login
→ Membership canonical ready
→ sessionStorage restoration hint ditulis
→ protected /
→ page.reload()

fresh React runtime
→ initial /auth/me tanpa Membership locator
→ BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
→ /user/my-memberships
→ restoration hint dibaca
→ hint diverifikasi terhadap discovery
→ /auth/me WITH X-EduCore-Membership-Id
→ canonical context confirmed
→ Membership ready
→ Workspace ready
→ protected /
```

Dan invariant penting:

```text
POST /browser/auth/login tetap hanya 1 kali
```

Jadi reload tidak replay email/password.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Kita tidak mengubah Playwright assertion yang sebelumnya gagal

Ini penting.

Observer existing masih menunggu:

```text
/auth/me
+
X-EduCore-Membership-Id = fixture membership
```

Kita tidak melonggarkan assertion supaya test hijau.

Dengan demikian jika sekarang PASS, itu merupakan proof bahwa **production restoration lifecycle benar-benar menghasilkan membership-aware canonical bootstrap**.

---

### 2. Test sebelumnya sudah memberi baseline failure yang bagus

Sebelum fix:

```text
reload
→ final UI "Pilih Membership"
→ no membership-aware /auth/me
→ timeout
```

Setelah H.3C.4B, yang kita harapkan:

```text
reload
→ temporary membership-context-required
→ discovery
→ restoration verification
→ membership-aware /auth/me 200
→ Frontend Foundation
```

Ini bentuk regression test yang kuat karena kita mempunyai failure-before/fix-after yang jelas.

---

### 3. `sessionStorage` boleh berisi locator

Existing H.3B/H.3C security assertion melarang:

```text
password
access_token
Bearer ...
```

Tetapi sekarang `sessionStorage` memang **diharapkan** memiliki:

```json
{
  "membership_id": "...",
  "tenant_id": "..."
}
```

Itu tidak melanggar security boundary karena locator bukan authentication credential.

Jangan menambahkan assertion bahwa `sessionStorage` harus kosong.

---

### 4. Login count harus tetap `1`

Flow yang salah:

```text
login
→ reload
→ login ulang otomatis
→ app
```

secara UX mungkin terlihat berhasil tetapi security/design-nya salah.

Karena itu assertion:

```ts
expect(
    loginRequestCount,
).toBe(
    1,
);
```

tetap sangat penting.

## Troubleshooting

Jika test ketiga masih berakhir di:

```text
Pilih Membership
```

jangan mengubah reducer. Kita audit apakah hint benar-benar ditulis sebelum reload.

Kalau perlu, next audit akan membedakan:

```text
hint absent
vs
hint read but discovery mismatch
vs
/auth/me restoration verification rejected
```

Jika `/auth/me` dengan locator muncul tetapi `401/403`, jangan mengubah Playwright predicate. Itu berarti client restoration sudah bekerja dan backend canonical verification sedang menolak context tertentu.

Jika test berhenti pada Workspace state setelah Membership restore sukses, jangan mengubah Membership lagi. Itu berarti H.3C sudah bergeser ke Workspace restoration layer.

Jika `loginRequestCount` menjadi `2`, itu blocker meskipun UI akhirnya sukses.

Jika hanya warning CRLF muncul dari `git diff --check`, tetap bukan blocker.

# FEI-10H.3C.4D - Reload Workspace Continuation Audit

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita sekarang punya chain:

```text
page.reload()
    ↓
BrowserSession                    ✅
initial auth bootstrap            ✅
Membership discovery              ✅
Membership restoration hint       ✅
membership-aware /auth/me         ✅
canonical Membership confirmed    ✅
Workspace continuation            ❌ belum terlihat
```

Failure berpindah dari line observer `/auth/me` sebelumnya ke observer `/user/my-workspaces` line `888`. Jadi **jangan ubah lagi Membership runtime**.

Sekarang kita perlu membedakan:

```text
A. /my-workspaces tidak pernah dikirim
   → Workspace lifecycle activation/sequencing issue

B. /my-workspaces dikirim tanpa Membership header
   → Workspace request-context issue

C. /my-workspaces dikirim dan error
   → backend/context continuation issue

D. Workspace sebenarnya ready tanpa discovery baru
   → assertion E2E salah terhadap restoration semantics
```

Existing Workspace design memang sudah memiliki restoration lifecycle dan `restoreHint`, sehingga kita harus audit apakah lifecycle itu mendapat canonical Membership publication setelah reload, bukan menambahkan storage baru sembarangan. `Pasted text (2).txt`

# FEI-10H.3C.4E - Membership Bootstrap Cancellation Ownership

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita perlu memisahkan dua kejadian:

```text
internal transition
membership-context-required
→ resolving-context
→ authenticated

TIDAK BOLEH abort Membership bootstrap
```

dibanding:

```text
real lifecycle invalidation
→ logout / anonymous / unavailable / unmount

HARUS abort Membership bootstrap
```

Solusinya adalah membuat `AbortController` menjadi **provider-owned ref**, bukan cleanup milik effect yang otomatis dieksekusi setiap perubahan `authenticationState.status`.

Dengan begitu:

```text
restoration starts
→ controller alive

Auth → resolving-context
→ controller tetap alive

/auth/me 200
→ Membership CONTEXT_CONFIRMED
→ Membership ready

Auth → authenticated
→ no second bootstrap

Workspace lifecycle
→ /my-workspaces
```

# Kode Lengkap

Ganti seluruh isi:

```text
frontend/src/app/membership/MembershipContextProvider.tsx
```

dengan:

```tsx
import {
    createContext,
    type PropsWithChildren,
    useContext,
    useEffect,
    useRef,
    useSyncExternalStore,
} from 'react';

import {
    useBrowserAuthState,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import type {
    MembershipContextRuntime,
    MembershipContextState,
} from '@/platform/membership';

const MembershipRuntimeContext =
    createContext<
        MembershipContextRuntime | null
    >(null);

export interface MembershipContextProviderProps
    extends PropsWithChildren {
    readonly runtime:
        MembershipContextRuntime;
}

export function MembershipContextProvider({
    runtime,
    children,
}: MembershipContextProviderProps) {
    const authenticationState =
        useBrowserAuthState();

    /*
     * The controller belongs to the Provider lifecycle,
     * not to one authentication-status Effect execution.
     *
     * Membership restoration itself temporarily drives
     * BrowserAuth through resolving-context. React must not
     * interpret that internal canonical verification
     * transition as cancellation of the Membership
     * operation that initiated it.
     */
    const activeBootstrapControllerRef =
        useRef<
            AbortController | null
        >(null);

    /*
     * Runtime replacement / Provider unmount is a genuine
     * lifecycle boundary.
     *
     * StrictMode cleanup also reaches this path, so the
     * next Effect replay may safely replace an aborted
     * discovery through the Membership runtime's existing
     * revision semantics.
     */
    useEffect(
        () => {
            return () => {
                activeBootstrapControllerRef
                    .current
                    ?.abort();

                activeBootstrapControllerRef
                    .current =
                        null;
            };
        },
        [
            runtime,
        ],
    );

    useEffect(
        () => {
            const authenticationStatus =
                authenticationState.status;

            if (
                authenticationStatus
                    === 'authenticated'
                || authenticationStatus
                    === 'membership-context-required'
            ) {
                const membershipStatus =
                    runtime.getState().status;

                /*
                 * StrictMode may replay while discovery is
                 * already in flight.
                 *
                 * The runtime supports replacing an
                 * in-flight discovery, but it must never
                 * start another bootstrap while Membership
                 * is switching or already authoritative.
                 */
                if (
                    membershipStatus
                        !== 'unresolved'
                    && membershipStatus
                        !== 'discovering'
                ) {
                    return;
                }

                /*
                 * An existing live Provider-owned operation
                 * already owns this lifecycle.
                 */
                if (
                    activeBootstrapControllerRef
                        .current
                        !== null
                    && ! activeBootstrapControllerRef
                        .current
                        .signal
                        .aborted
                ) {
                    return;
                }

                const controller =
                    new AbortController();

                activeBootstrapControllerRef
                    .current =
                        controller;

                void runtime.bootstrap({
                    signal:
                        controller.signal,

                    /*
                     * Only initial BrowserSession recovery
                     * may consume the tab-local advisory
                     * restoration hint.
                     */
                    restoreHint:
                        authenticationStatus
                            === 'membership-context-required',
                }).finally(
                    () => {
                        if (
                            activeBootstrapControllerRef
                                .current
                                === controller
                        ) {
                            activeBootstrapControllerRef
                                .current =
                                    null;
                        }
                    },
                );

                /*
                 * Deliberately no Effect cleanup here.
                 *
                 * authentication.status may transition to
                 * resolving-context as part of this very
                 * Membership bootstrap. Cancelling on every
                 * dependency transition would make the
                 * operation abort itself.
                 */
                return;
            }

            if (
                authenticationStatus
                    === 'resolving-context'
            ) {
                /*
                 * Canonical Membership confirmation owns
                 * this temporary Auth transition.
                 *
                 * Keep both the in-flight Membership
                 * bootstrap and current Membership truth
                 * unchanged.
                 */
                return;
            }

            /*
             * All other Auth states invalidate Membership
             * authority.
             *
             * Cancel any provider-owned bootstrap before
             * resetting local context.
             */
            activeBootstrapControllerRef
                .current
                ?.abort();

            activeBootstrapControllerRef
                .current =
                    null;

            if (
                runtime.getState().status
                    !== 'unresolved'
            ) {
                runtime.reset();
            }
        },
        [
            authenticationState.status,
            runtime,
        ],
    );

    return (
        <MembershipRuntimeContext.Provider
            value={runtime}
        >
            {children}
        </MembershipRuntimeContext.Provider>
    );
}

export function useMembershipContextRuntime():
    MembershipContextRuntime {
    const runtime =
        useContext(
            MembershipRuntimeContext,
        );

    if (
        runtime
            === null
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'EduCore MembershipContext hooks require MembershipContextProvider.',
        );
    }

    return runtime;
}

export function useMembershipContextState():
    MembershipContextState {
    const runtime =
        useMembershipContextRuntime();

    return useSyncExternalStore(
        runtime.subscribe,
        runtime.getState,
    );
}
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. `resolving-context` sekarang benar-benar netral

Sebelumnya secara source branch-nya memang:

```ts
if (
    authenticationStatus
        === 'resolving-context'
) {
    return;
}
```

tetapi itu belum cukup karena React menjalankan cleanup effect sebelumnya **sebelum** menjalankan body effect baru.

Cleanup lama:

```ts
return () => {
    controller.abort();
};
```

membatalkan restoration lebih dulu. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Sekarang status berubah:

```text
membership-context-required
→ resolving-context
```

hanya menjalankan effect baru yang `return`, tanpa ada status-owned cleanup yang abort operation.

---

### 2. Cancellation tetap dipertahankan

Kita tidak menghilangkan cancellation.

Abort tetap terjadi pada genuine invalidation:

```text
anonymous
unknown
authenticating
logging-out
unavailable
Provider unmount
runtime replacement
```

Jadi ini bukan membuat request “uncancellable”.

---

### 3. `AbortController` menjadi lifecycle resource

Controller disimpan dalam:

```ts
useRef<AbortController | null>
```

karena lifespan-nya lebih panjang daripada satu render/effect execution.

Ini separation of concerns yang lebih tepat:

```text
React auth-status Effect
→ klasifikasi lifecycle

Provider ref
→ ownership operation

Membership runtime
→ state + canonical verification
```

---

### 4. Tidak ada perubahan security authority

Fix ini sama sekali tidak mengubah:

```text
sessionStorage hint
canonical /auth/me verification
Membership/Tenant matching
BrowserSession custody
permission authority
```

Ia hanya mencegah legitimate canonical verification dibatalkan oleh React lifecycle miliknya sendiri.

---

### 5. Workspace tidak perlu disentuh

Trace menunjukkan tidak ada `/my-workspaces` karena Membership tidak pernah dipublikasikan stabil sebagai `ready`.

Workspace provider sudah mensyaratkan:

```ts
authenticationState.status === 'authenticated'
&& membershipState.status === 'ready'
```

sebelum `runtime.bootstrap()`. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Jadi tidak adanya `/my-workspaces` adalah consequence, bukan root cause.

```bash
        page.on(

         */
        expect(
            loginResponse
                .request()
                .headers()[
                    'authorization'
                ],
        ).toBeUndefined();

        expect(
            JSON.stringify(
                loginBody,
            ),
        ).not.toContain(
            'access_token',
        );

        /*
         * Frontend presentation deliberately replaces raw
         * backend authentication prose with controlled UX.
         */
        await expect(
            page.getByText(
                safeFailureMessage,
            ),
        ).toBeVisible();

        await expect(
            page.getByText(
                rawBackendMessage,
            ),
        ).toHaveCount(
            0,
        );

        /*
         * BrowserAuthRuntime returns to authoritative
         * anonymous state, so the same form becomes usable
         * again rather than transitioning into an
         * unavailable/protected state.
         */
        await expect(
            submitButton,
        ).toBeEnabled();

        await expect(
            emailInput,
        ).toBeEnabled();

        await expect(
            passwordInput,
        ).toBeEnabled();

        await expect(
            tenantInput,
        ).toBeEnabled();

        /*
         * Preserve useful non-secret correction context.
         *
         * Password persistence itself is deliberately not
         * locked as an E2E UX contract.
         */
        await expect(
            emailInput,
        ).toHaveValue(
            e2eEmail,
        );

        await expect(
            tenantInput,
        ).toHaveValue(
            e2eTenantId,
        );

        /*
         * A rejected credential must stop at login.
         *
         * BrowserAuthRuntime must not attempt canonical
         * identity, Membership, Workspace, or Capability
         * continuation after a failed login response.
         */
        expect(
            postFailureContinuationRequests,
        ).toEqual([]);

        const finalUrl =
            new URL(
                page.url(),
            );

        expect(
            finalUrl.origin,
        ).toBe(
            applicationOrigin,
        );

        expect(
            finalUrl.pathname,
        ).toBe(
            '/login',
        );

        await expect(
            page.getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Frontend Foundation',
                },
            ),
        ).toHaveCount(
            0,
        );

        /*
         * Browser storage may contain non-secret contextual
         * hints elsewhere in authenticated flows, but a
         * failed credential must never place the attempted
         * password or Bearer material there.
         */
        const browserStorage =
            await page.evaluate(
                () => ({
                    localStorage:
                        Object.fromEntries(
                            Object.entries(
                                window.localStorage,
                            ),
                        ),

                    sessionStorage:
                        Object.fromEntries(
                            Object.entries(
                                window.sessionStorage,
                            ),
                        ),
                }),
            );

        const serializedStorage =
            JSON.stringify(
                browserStorage,
            );

        expect(
            serializedStorage,
        ).not.toContain(
            wrongPassword,
        );

        expect(
            serializedStorage,
        ).not.toContain(
            'access_token',
        );

        expect(
            serializedStorage,
        ).not.toMatch(
            /Bearer\s+/iu,
        );

        /*
         * Beginning a correction dismisses the stale
         * failure presentation without dispatching another
         * authentication request.
         */
        await passwordInput.fill(
            e2ePassword,
        );

        await expect(
            page.getByText(
                safeFailureMessage,
            ),
        ).toHaveCount(
            0,
        );

        await expect(
            submitButton,
        ).toBeEnabled();

        expect(
            postFailureContinuationRequests,
        ).toEqual([]);
    },
);
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Kita menunggu authoritative anonymous state dahulu

Sebelum memasang request counter:

```ts
await expect(
    submitButton,
).toBeEnabled();
```

Ini penting karena LoginPage hanya enable ketika:

```ts
authentication.status === 'anonymous'
```

Sehingga initial requests:

```text
/auth/me 403
/my-memberships 401
```

tidak salah dihitung sebagai continuation dari invalid login.

### 2. Backend contract dan UX contract diuji terpisah

Network harus benar-benar memberikan:

```json
{
  "status": "error",
  "code": "AUTHENTICATION_FAILED",
  "message": "Invalid authentication credentials."
}
```

Backend contract tersebut memang sudah dibuktikan oleh `BrowserLoginTest`, termasuk bahwa authenticated vault state tetap `null`. `Pasted text.txt`

Tetapi browser UI harus hanya menampilkan:

```text
Email, password, atau Tenant UUID tidak cocok.
```

Presenter existing memang sengaja menerjemahkan `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` dan tidak meneruskan raw server message. `Pasted text (2).txt`

Jadi E2E membuktikan dua boundary sekaligus:

```text
backend API contract     ✅
presentation isolation  ✅
```

### 3. Failed login tidak boleh memulai bootstrap

Runtime existing:

```text
operations.login()
→ failure
→ BECAME_ANONYMOUS
→ return
```

dan hanya successful login yang mencapai:

```text
LOGIN_ACCEPTED
→ operations.bootstrap({ membershipId })
```

`Pasted text.txt`

Karena itu counter untuk:

```text
/auth/me
/my-memberships
/my-workspaces
/capabilities
```

harus tetap kosong setelah submit gagal.

### 4. Kita tidak mengunci password-retention behavior

Source saat ini memang tidak menghapus local password state setelah failure. `Pasted text (3).txt`

Namun saya tidak menyarankan menjadikannya permanent UX contract.

Karena itu E2E hanya mengunci:

```text
email retained
tenant retained
form usable
error dismissible
```

bukan:

```text
password harus tetap tersimpan di input
```

Itu memberi kebebasan nanti jika kita memutuskan password sebaiknya dibersihkan setelah authentication failure.

### 5. Error hilang saat user memperbaiki input

LoginPage memang memiliki:

```text
failureDismissed
```

dan input change menyembunyikan current failure presentation tanpa mengubah technical failure di Auth runtime. `Pasted text (3).txt`

E2E memastikan perilaku tersebut benar di browser nyata.

# Troubleshooting

Jika `postFailureContinuationRequests` berisi `/auth/me`, jangan langsung menghapus assertion. Itu berarti runtime melakukan continuation setelah `401`, bertentangan dengan runtime contract yang sudah kita audit.

Jika backend login `401` tetapi safe error tidak muncul, audit Auth state publication/presenter integration; jangan mengubah backend message.

Jika raw backend message muncul di UI, itu security/presentation regression dan merupakan blocker.

Jika button tetap disabled sesudah `401`, Auth runtime kemungkinan tidak kembali ke `anonymous`.

Jika hanya CRLF warning muncul, tetap tidak perlu line-ending normalization.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Ada potensi masalah penting di sini.

Frontend validator saat ini sudah mencegah invalid email/UUID sebelum network request. Artinya test seperti:

```text
email = "invalid"
```

tidak akan pernah mencapai Laravel.

Itu bagus untuk UX, tetapi berarti kita tidak boleh menulis E2E palsu yang berharap backend `422` dari input yang frontend sendiri blok.

Kita perlu mencari **contract gap yang sah**, misalnya:

```text
frontend hanya memeriksa format
backend punya length/rule tambahan
```

Jika ada, itulah candidate real-server-validation E2E.

Jika ternyata validator frontend dan Laravel sudah benar-benar sejajar sehingga semua predictable `422` diblok lokal, maka hasil audit H.3E.1 bisa menyimpulkan:

```text
real 422 through normal Login UI
→ tidak memiliki legitimate deterministic input
```

Dalam kondisi itu kita **tidak akan memaksa test**. Existing unit/component/backend contract coverage mungkin sudah menjadi boundary yang benar.

Ini lebih baik daripada menambahkan artificial bypass ke production UI.

---

## Cara Menjalankan & Menguji (Testing)

Langkah ini hanya audit.

Dari output nanti kita tentukan matrix:

```text
Rule                     Frontend      Backend
email required           ?             ?
email format             ?             ?
email max length         ?             ?
password required        ?             ?
password min/max         ?             ?
tenant UUID required     ?             ?
tenant UUID format       ?             ?
unknown extra fields     ?             ?
```

Target utama adalah menemukan:

```text
frontend accepts
+
backend returns 422
```

secara deterministic dan tanpa mengubah production validator.

---

## Troubleshooting

Jika backend menggunakan FormRequest/shared canonical validator di lokasi lain, kirim output `grep`; kita ikuti ownership-nya.

Jika semua backend validation sudah direplikasi frontend, **itu bukan masalah** dan jangan sengaja membuat divergence.

Jika `BrowserLoginTest` hanya menguji empty fields, belum berarti ada candidate E2E 422-kita tetap harus membandingkan exact rules.

Status kerja yang banyak tetap expected. Jangan stage `welcome.blade.php`, `welcome1.blade.php`, atau `docs/tdd/`, dan jangan gunakan `git add .`.

---

## Langkah Berikutnya

Setelah audit ini ada dua kemungkinan.

Jika ditemukan legitimate frontend/backend validation gap:

```text
FEI-10H.3E.2
→ Real Canonical Validation Failure UX
```

Jika tidak ada:

```text
FEI-10H.3E
→ close as "not applicable for normal UI E2E"
→ preserve unit + backend feature coverage
```

Untuk sekarang jalankan **FEI-10H.3E.1 saja**.

 * version.
 *
 * Client validation therefore checks only canonical
 * hexadecimal UUID structure and does not invent a
 * UUID-version authority that the frontend does not own.
 */
const GENERIC_UUID_PATTERN =
    /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/iu;

function normalizeEmail(
    value: string,
): string {
    return value
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase();
}

function normalizeTenantUuid(
    value: string,
): string {
    return value.trim();
}

export function validateLoginForm(
    values: LoginFormValues,
): LoginFormValidation {
    const email =
        normalizeEmail(
            values.email,
        );

    const tenantUuid =
        normalizeTenantUuid(
            values.tenantUuid,
        );

    const errors:
        LoginFormErrors = {};

    if (
        email.length === 0
    ) {
        errors.email =
            'Email wajib diisi.';
    } else if (
        ! BASIC_EMAIL_PATTERN.test(
            email,
        )
    ) {
        errors.email =
            'Format email tidak valid.';
    }

    /*
     * Password is deliberately not trimmed.
     *
     * Authentication credentials must be submitted exactly
     * as entered by the user. Whitespace may legitimately
     * be part of a credential.
     */
    if (
        values.password.length
            === 0
    ) {
        errors.password =
            'Password wajib diisi.';
    }

    if (
        tenantUuid.length
            === 0
    ) {
        errors.tenantUuid =
            'Tenant UUID wajib diisi.';
    } else if (
        ! GENERIC_UUID_PATTERN.test(
            tenantUuid,
        )
    ) {
        errors.tenantUuid =
            'Tenant UUID tidak valid.';
    }

    if (
        Object.keys(
            errors,
        ).length > 0
    ) {
        return {
            ok:
                false,

            errors,
        };
    }

    const request:
        BrowserLoginRequest = {
            email,

            password:
                values.password,

            tenant_uuid:
                tenantUuid,
        };

    return {
        ok:
            true,

        request,
    };
}

# FEI-10H.3E.2 - Real Canonical Validation Failure UX

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita tambahkan satu proof real-browser:

```text
valid email
+ valid Tenant UUID
+ password "short"
        ↓
frontend validation PASS
        ↓
real POST /browser/auth/login
        ↓
LoginTokenRequest min:6
        ↓
422 VALIDATION_FAILED
        ↓
errors.password
        ↓
safe frontend field presentation
        ↓
tetap anonymous
```

Yang tidak boleh terjadi:

```text
credential verification
BrowserSession authenticated vault
/auth/me authenticated continuation
Membership discovery
Workspace discovery
Capability discovery
protected application
```

Ini berbeda dari H.3D:

```text
H.3D
syntactically valid credential
→ authentication attempt
→ 401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED

H.3E
canonical request invalid
→ rejected before authentication
→ 422 VALIDATION_FAILED
```

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Ubah hanya:

```text
frontend/e2e/authentication.e2e.ts
```

Tidak mengubah:

```text
frontend/src/app/auth/login-form.ts
frontend/src/app/auth/login-failure.ts
Modules/Auth/*
bootstrap/app.php
Playwright config
E2E seeder
```

Kita sengaja **tidak** menambahkan `min:6` ke login-form validator pada langkah ini. Untuk form login, frontend cukup melakukan cheap validation; canonical server tetap harus mampu menolak constraint yang lebih ketat.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Kenapa memilih `"short"`?

Frontend hanya melakukan:

```ts
if (
    values.password.length === 0
)
```

jadi `"short"` lolos dan benar-benar dikirim.

Backend menerapkan:

```php
'password' => [
    'required',
    'string',
    'min:6',
],
```

sehingga request deterministik berhenti pada FormRequest dengan `422`, sebelum `BrowserLoginController` memperoleh `$request->validated()` untuk credential issuance. `Pasted text.txt`

Ini exactly boundary yang ingin H.3E buktikan.

### 2. Tidak mengassert raw Laravel field message

Kita sengaja **tidak** menulis:

```ts
expect(...).toContain(
    'The password field must be at least 6 characters.',
);
```

Karena wording tersebut bukan frontend contract.

Yang stable:

```text
HTTP 422
code = VALIDATION_FAILED
errors.password exists
```

Frontend lalu memiliki wording sendiri:

```text
Periksa kembali data login yang ditandai.

Password tidak dapat diterima.
Periksa kembali password Anda.
```

Presenter existing memang meng-map `errors.password` ke presentation tersebut. `Pasted text.txt`

### 3. Backend validation tetap authority

Kita tidak menyamakan seluruh Laravel rule ke browser.

Khusus login, itu sehat karena:

```text
client validation
→ UX convenience

server validation
→ canonical request boundary
```

Misalnya perubahan policy backend di masa depan tetap harus ditangani frontend sebagai controlled `422`, bukan menjadi unexpected error.

### 4. Tidak ada authenticated continuation

Sama seperti H.3D, listener dipasang setelah initial anonymous bootstrap selesai.

Setelah `422` kita mengharapkan:

```text
/auth/me                 0
/my-memberships          0
/my-workspaces           0
/capabilities            0
```

sebagai continuation dari attempt tersebut.

### 5. Correction UX ikut dibuktikan

Setelah user mengganti password:

```text
safe form error     → hilang
safe password error → hilang
```

tanpa login kedua.

Ini membuktikan integration antara:

```text
Auth failure state
→ failure presenter
→ LoginPage failureDismissed
→ LoginForm externalErrors
```

## Troubleshooting

Jika browser tidak mengirim request dan menampilkan local password error, berarti frontend validator sudah berubah sejak audit. Jangan melemahkannya; kita cari candidate server validation lain.

Jika response menjadi `401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`, maka password `"short"` ternyata lolos backend validation-bertentangan dengan audited `min:6`; audit actual request/backend environment sebelum mengubah test.

Jika `422` benar tetapi UI menampilkan generic unexpected error, itu berarti transport parser atau presenter tidak mempertahankan `VALIDATION_FAILED`.

Jika field message aman muncul tetapi raw `"The submitted data is invalid."` juga muncul di UI, itu presentation leak dan blocker.

Jika hanya CRLF warning muncul, jangan normalize line endings.

# FEI-10H.3F.1 — BrowserSession Unavailable Real-E2E Feasibility Audit

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Frontend sudah memiliki contract:

```text
503
BROWSER_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE
→ "Layanan sesi EduCore sedang tidak tersedia. Silakan coba lagi."
```

Backend juga punya failure path ketika credential benar tetapi server-side BrowserSession vault gagal dibentuk.

Namun berbeda dengan `401` dan `422`, kondisi `503` ini adalah **infrastructure failure**. Sebelum menulis Playwright, kita harus memastikan bisa memicunya secara deterministik di environment E2E **tanpa**:

```text
page.route()
MSW
production code hack
global env yang melemahkan runtime
backend production mutation
```

Jika tidak ada seam yang aman, H.3F mungkin seharusnya tetap di backend feature + frontend component/integration testing, bukan dipaksakan menjadi real-browser E2E.

---

Audit-only.

Jangan ubah source.

Periksa:

```text

SessionCredentialVault
BrowserLoginController
E2E environment/config
service providers/bindings
existing test-only seams
frontend presenter tests
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Kita sedang mencari salah satu dari tiga hasil.

### A. Sudah ada safe E2E injection seam

Contoh secara konseptual:

```text
APP_ENV=e2e
+
config flag khusus E2E
→ bind failing BrowserSessionCredentialVault
```

Kalau sudah ada boundary seperti itu, kita bisa menulis real-browser 503 tanpa mengubah production behavior.

### B. Bisa dibuat test-only seam yang benar-benar terisolasi

Misalnya provider hanya pada:

```php
$app->environment('e2e')
```

dan diaktifkan dengan explicit environment variable.

Tetapi keputusan ini belum kita ambil sebelum audit.

### C. Tidak ada legitimate real-browser seam

Kalau satu-satunya cara untuk menghasilkan 503 adalah:

```text
mematikan database/session
merusak production implementation
page.route(...)
hardcode failure pada BrowserLoginController
```

maka **jangan lakukan**.

Coverage existing sebenarnya sudah memiliki dua sisi:

```text
backend feature:
credential valid
→ vault throws
→ 503 BROWSER_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE
→ vault clear
→ no access_token leak

frontend presenter:
503 BROWSER_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE
→ controlled safe message
```

Dalam kasus itu, tidak adanya real-E2E bukan coverage hole yang layak dibayar dengan test architecture buruk.

# Troubleshooting

Jika binding `BrowserSessionCredentialVaultInterface` berada di provider modular yang tidak tercetak seluruhnya, kirim file tersebut secara penuh.

Jika ada configuration flag existing tetapi namanya ambigu, jangan langsung pakai. Kita perlu memastikan flag itu hanya berlaku untuk E2E dan fail-closed.

Jangan mengubah `.env.e2e` pada langkah audit ini.

Jangan mematikan PostgreSQL/session backend untuk memaksa 503; itu dapat menyebabkan failure jauh sebelum BrowserLoginController dan tidak membuktikan contract yang kita inginkan.

Jangan menggunakan `page.route()` karena H.3 real-browser suite sejauh ini sengaja membuktikan Laravel nyata tanpa browser network mocking.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Sebelum membuat logout E2E, kita perlu memastikan beberapa contract.

Pertama, backend harus benar-benar:

```text
revoke held server-side bearer credentials
→ clear BrowserSession vault
→ invalidate shared Laravel session
→ rotate CSRF/session state
```

bukan hanya membuat frontend state anonymous.

Kedua, frontend harus membersihkan context turunan:

```text
Auth anonymous
→ Membership reset
→ Membership restoration hint cleared
→ Workspace invalidated/reset
→ Workspace restoration hint tidak boleh memulihkan session lama
```

Ini sangat penting setelah perubahan Membership reload restoration H.3C.

Logout yang hanya menghapus cookie tetapi meninggalkan:

```text
educore.membership-restoration.v1
workspace restoration hint
```

harus tetap aman; ideally local context juga dibersihkan agar UX tidak membawa stale selection ke auth lifecycle berikutnya.

Ketiga, kita perlu tahu apakah saat ini **sudah ada tombol/entry point logout** di protected UI.

Kalau belum ada, jangan menulis Playwright dengan direct `page.evaluate(runtime.logout())` atau API call. Real UX E2E harus melalui public application interaction.

## Cara Menjalankan & Menguji (Testing)

Step ini audit-only.

Keputusan yang kita cari:

```text
credential revocation                  ?

```

Dari sana baru kita menentukan apakah H.3G membutuhkan implementasi UI logout atau hanya E2E proof existing behavior.

Jika grep tidak menemukan logout UI sama sekali, itu bukan error audit. Itu kemungkinan justru gap FEI-10 yang harus kita implementasikan secara eksplisit.

Jika backend logout memiliki partial-failure behavior, kirim seluruh controller/test-nya; kita harus membedakan successful logout dengan `LOGOUT_UNAVAILABLE`.

Jangan menambahkan tombol logout sebelum audit selesai.

} from '@/platform/auth/request-options';
import {
    initializeBrowserSession,
} from '@/platform/auth/session-bootstrap';

export interface BrowserLogoutOptions {
    readonly signal?:
        AbortSignal;
}

export async function logoutBrowserSession(
    client: BrowserApiClient,
    options: BrowserLogoutOptions = {},
): Promise<
    BrowserApiResult<
        BrowserLogoutSuccess
    >
> {
    const abortOptions =
        createBrowserAuthAbortOptions(
            options.signal,
        );

    const sessionResult =
        await initializeBrowserSession(
            client,
            abortOptions,
        );

    if (! sessionResult.ok) {
        return sessionResult;
    }

    return executeBrowserApiRequest(
        client.POST(
            '/api/v1/browser/auth/logout',
            abortOptions,
        ),
    );
}

# FEI-10H.3G.2 - Browser Logout UX Integration

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Pada langkah ini kita **belum menambah Playwright test**. Kita membuat interaction production yang benar terlebih dahulu:

```text
protected App
→ user klik "Keluar"
→ BrowserAuthRuntime.logout()
→ LOGOUT_STARTED
→ backend Browser logout
→ LOGOUT_COMPLETED
→ anonymous
→ ProtectedRouteBoundary
→ /login
```

Ownership tetap bersih:

```text
LogoutButton
    ↓ command only
BrowserAuthRuntime
    ↓
Auth operations
    ↓
BrowserSession transport
    ↓
Laravel BFF
```

`LogoutButton` tidak boleh:

```text
fetch('/logout') sendiri
clear sessionStorage sendiri
clear Membership sendiri
clear Workspace sendiri
navigate('/login') sendiri
```

Semua downstream cleanup harus tetap merupakan konsekuensi authority lifecycle.

---

```text
frontend/src/app/auth/__tests__/LogoutButton.test.tsx
```

```text
frontend/src/app/App.tsx
```


## Kode Lengkap

### 1. `frontend/src/app/auth/LogoutButton.tsx`

```tsx
import {
    useBrowserAuthRuntime,
    useBrowserAuthState,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';

export function LogoutButton() {
    const runtime =
        useBrowserAuthRuntime();

    const authentication =
        useBrowserAuthState();

    const loggingOut =
        authentication.status
            === 'logging-out';

    /*
     * The protected application normally renders this
     * component only while authentication is authoritative.
     *
     * Keep the component defensive so route/provider
     * transitions cannot expose an invalid logout command.
     */
    if (
        authentication.status
            !== 'authenticated'
        && authentication.status
            !== 'logging-out'
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    async function handleLogout(): Promise<void> {
        /*
         * React snapshot controls the visible button state,
         * but the live runtime state is checked again at the
         * command boundary.
         *
         * This prevents duplicate/stale clicks from
         * dispatching LOGOUT_STARTED after another logout
         * has already begun.
         */
        if (
            runtime.getState()
                .status
                !== 'authenticated'
        ) {
            return;
        }

        /*
         * BrowserAuthRuntime owns the complete logout
         * lifecycle:
         *
         * - CSRF bootstrap
         * - BrowserSession logout transport
         * - authentication state transition
         *
         * Membership, Workspace, restoration hints, and
         * routing react downstream to authority loss.
         */
        await runtime.logout();
    }

    return (
        <button
            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-700 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-200 transition hover:border-slate-500 hover:text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            disabled={
                loggingOut
            }
            onClick={() => {
                void handleLogout();
            }}
            type="button"
        >
            {
                loggingOut
                    ? 'Keluar...'
                    : 'Keluar'
            }
        </button>
    );
}
```

```tsx
import {
    fireEvent,
    render,
    screen,
    waitFor,
} from '@testing-library/react';
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
    vi,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    LogoutButton,
} from '@/app/auth/LogoutButton';
import {
    BrowserAuthProvider,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import {
    createBrowserAuthRuntime,
    type BrowserAuthOperations,
} from '@/platform/auth';

const membershipId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7cde-8def-1234567890ab';

const tenantId =
    '018f3b6a-7c20-7def-8abc-1234567890ab';

function createOperations(
    logout:
        BrowserAuthOperations['logout'],
): BrowserAuthOperations {
    return {
        async bootstrap() {
            return {
                ok:
                    true,

                status:
                    200,

                data: {
                    status:
                        'success',

                    data: {
                        user: {
                            id:
                                '018f3b6a-7c20-7000-8000-000000000001',

                            email:
                                'member@example.com',
                        },

                        person: {
                            id:
                                '018f3b6a-7c20-7000-8000-000000000002',

                            name:
                                'EduCore Member',
                        },

                        membership: {
                            id:
                                membershipId,

                            status:
                                'ACTIVE',
                        },

                        tenant: {
                            id:
                                tenantId,

                            name:
                                'EduCore School',

                            subdomain:
                                'educore-school',
                        },
                    },
                },
            };
        },

        async login() {
            throw new Error(
                'LogoutButton test must not perform login.',
            );
        },

        logout,
    };
}

async function renderAuthenticatedLogoutButton(
    logout:
        BrowserAuthOperations['logout'],
) {
    const runtime =
        createBrowserAuthRuntime(
            createOperations(
                logout,
            ),
        );

    await runtime.bootstrap();

    render(
        <BrowserAuthProvider
            runtime={
                runtime
            }
        >
            <LogoutButton />
        </BrowserAuthProvider>,
    );

    return runtime;
}

describe(
    'LogoutButton',
    () => {
        it('delegates logout exactly once to BrowserAuthRuntime', async () => {
            const logout =
                vi.fn(
                    async () => ({
                        ok:
                            true as const,

                        status:
                            200,

                        data: {
                            status:
                                'success' as const,

                            message:
                                'Logout completed successfully.' as const,
                        },
                    }),
                );

            const runtime =
                await renderAuthenticatedLogoutButton(
                    logout,
                );

            fireEvent.click(
                screen.getByRole(
                    'button',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Keluar',
                    },
                ),
            );

            await waitFor(() => {
                expect(
                    logout,
                ).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(
                    1,
                );
            });

            await waitFor(() => {
                expect(
                    runtime.getState(),
                ).toEqual({
                    status:
                        'anonymous',

                    failure:
                        null,
                });
            });

            expect(
                screen.queryByRole(
                    'button',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Keluar',
                    },
                ),
            ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
        });

        it('prevents duplicate logout dispatch while the first operation is live', async () => {
            let resolveLogout:
                (
                    value: {
                        ok: true;
                        status: 200;
                        data: {
                            status: 'success';
                            message: 'Logout completed successfully.';
                        };
                    },
                ) => void =
                    () => undefined;

            const logout =
                vi.fn(
                    () =>
                        new Promise<{
                            ok: true;
                            status: 200;
                            data: {
                                status: 'success';
                                message: 'Logout completed successfully.';
                            };
                        }>(
                            (resolve) => {
                                resolveLogout =
                                    resolve;
                            },
                        ),
                );

            await renderAuthenticatedLogoutButton(
                logout,
            );

            const button =
                screen.getByRole(
                    'button',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Keluar',
                    },
                );

            fireEvent.click(
                button,
            );

            await waitFor(() => {
                expect(
                    logout,
                ).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(
                    1,
                );
            });

            const loggingOutButton =
                screen.getByRole(
                    'button',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Keluar...',
                    },
                );

            expect(
                loggingOutButton,
            ).toBeDisabled();

            fireEvent.click(
                loggingOutButton,
            );

            expect(
                logout,
            ).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(
                1,
            );

            resolveLogout({
                ok:
                    true,

                status:
                    200,

                data: {
                    status:
                        'success',

                    message:
                        'Logout completed successfully.',
                },
            });

            await waitFor(() => {
                expect(
                    screen.queryByRole(
                        'button',
                        {
                            name:
                                'Keluar...',
                        },
                    ),
                ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
            });
        });

        it('does not render logout outside authoritative authentication lifecycle', () => {
            const runtime =
                createBrowserAuthRuntime(
                    createOperations(
                        async () => ({
                            ok:
                                true,

                            status:
                                200,

                            data: {
                                status:
                                    'success',

                                message:
                                    'Logout completed successfully.',
                            },
                        }),
                    ),
                );

            render(
                <BrowserAuthProvider
                    runtime={
                        runtime
                    }
                >
                    <LogoutButton />
                </BrowserAuthProvider>,
            );

            expect(
                screen.queryByRole(
                    'button',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Keluar',
                    },
                ),
            ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
        });
    },
);
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### Logout UI tidak memiliki transport knowledge

`LogoutButton` hanya tahu:

```ts
runtime.logout()
```

Ia tidak tahu endpoint:

```text
/api/v1/browser/auth/logout
```

Transport existing sudah menangani CSRF bootstrap sebelum POST logout. `Pasted text.txt`

Ini menjaga **Separation of Concerns**.

### Tidak melakukan navigation manual

Setelah successful logout:

```text
Auth → anonymous
```

Protected route yang saat ini membungkus `/` akan menghasilkan keputusan unauthenticated dan mengarahkan ke `/login`. Router memang menempatkan root di dalam protected boundary. `Pasted text (3).txt`

Jadi jangan:

```tsx
navigate('/login');
```

di tombol.

Kalau kita melakukan itu, UI bisa pindah halaman sebelum server-side credential/session cleanup benar-benar berhasil.

### Membership cleanup tetap downstream

Saat logout dimulai, Auth menjadi:

```text
logging-out
```

Membership provider menganggap semua Auth state selain authenticated, membership-context-required, dan resolving-context sebagai invalidasi authority lalu memanggil `runtime.reset()`. `Pasted text (3).txt`

Karena Membership reset juga menghapus tab-local Membership restoration hint, logout tidak perlu menyentuh `sessionStorage` secara langsung.

### Workspace ikut invalid

Workspace runtime berlangganan Membership runtime. Ketika Membership context hilang/tidak cocok, Workspace melakukan `reset()`, yang juga mempunyai ownership terhadap Workspace restoration hint. `Pasted text (3).txt`

Chain cleanup tetap:

```text
Auth
 ↓
Membership
 ↓
Workspace
 ↓
Capabilities
```

bukan satu tombol yang membersihkan empat subsystem sekaligus.

### Duplicate click fail-safe

Kita memakai dua lapisan:

```text
render snapshot:
logging-out → disabled

live command:
runtime.getState().status === authenticated
```

Sama prinsipnya dengan LoginPage yang sudah locked.

## Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak fixture `bootstrap` karena generated Auth contract mempunyai field tambahan, kirim error exact. Jangan menggunakan `as any`; kita sesuaikan fixture secara typed.

Jika test kedua tidak sempat menemukan `Keluar...` karena runtime menyelesaikan terlalu cepat, pastikan promise deferred yang diberikan di atas digunakan.

Jika test ketiga mulai bootstrap otomatis dan akhirnya tombol muncul, berarti `BrowserAuthProvider` initial lifecycle berbeda dari baseline. Kirim output test; jangan mock provider terlebih dahulu.

Jika `workspace/runtime.test.ts` membutuhkan waktu lebih panjang tetapi PASS, bukan blocker.

Warning `find -maxdepth` dari audit sebelumnya juga tidak relevan-itu hanya ordering option pada command audit, bukan source problem.

# FEI-10H.3G.3 - Real Browser Logout Proof

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Sekarang kita buktikan seluruh logout lifecycle di Chromium nyata:

```text
real login
→ BrowserSession authenticated
→ Membership + Workspace ready
→ restoration hint ada
→ protected application
→ klik Keluar
→ CSRF preflight
→ POST /browser/auth/logout
→ server revokes bearer
→ server clears vault
→ server invalidates session
→ browser session cookie rotates
→ Auth anonymous
→ Membership reset
→ Workspace reset
→ restoration hints cleared
→ /login
→ reload
→ tetap anonymous
```

Invariant security:

```text
POST login                 = 1
POST logout                = 1

Authorization header       = absent
old BrowserSession cookie  = tidak survive
Membership hint            = cleared
Workspace/context hint     = cleared
password storage           = absent
access_token storage       = absent
Bearer storage             = absent

reload after logout
→ no Membership locator replay
→ no authenticated restoration
```

Backend logout memang sudah membuktikan session invalidation, CSRF rotation, vault cleanup, dan token revocation di feature layer. `Pasted text (2).txt` Sekarang kita mengunci integration dari UI sampai Laravel nyata.

```bash
    'real browser logout revokes BrowserSession authority and remains anonymous after reload',
    async ({
        page,
    }) => {
        let loginRequestCount =

        let logoutRequestCount =

        const postLogoutMembershipAwareAuthenticationRequests:

        const loginResponsePromise =

                        response.url(),
                        '/api/v1/browser/auth/login',

                        .request()

         * E2E test to private storage-key constants.
         */
        const contextualRestorationKeys =
            await page.evaluate(
                ({
                    membershipId,
                    tenantId,
                }) =>
                    Object.entries(
                        window.sessionStorage,
                    )
                        .filter(
                            ([
                                ,

                                || value.includes(

                        .map(

                .context()
                .cookies();

                (cookie) =>
                    cookie.name
                        === 'laravel-session',
            );

            authenticatedSessionCookie
                === undefined
        ) {

        expect(

                .httpOnly,

        const logoutCsrfResponsePromise =

                .request()
                .headers()[
                    'authorization'
                ],
        ).toBeUndefined();

            loginRequestCount,
        ).toBe(
            1,

        expect(
            logoutRequestCount,
        ).toBe(
            1,
        );

        await expect(
            page.getByRole(

                    name:

        await expect(
            page.getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Frontend Foundation',

        const loggedOutUrl =

                page.url(),
            );

        expect(
            loggedOutUrl.origin,
        ).toBe(
            applicationOrigin,
        );

        expect(
            loggedOutUrl.pathname,
        ).toBe(
            '/login',
        );

        /*
         * Auth loss must invalidate every contextual
         * restoration key that existed while authenticated.
         */
        const contextualStorageAfterLogout =
            await page.evaluate(
                (keys) =>
                    Object.fromEntries(
                        keys.map(
                            (key) => [
                                key,
                                window.sessionStorage
                                    .getItem(
                                        key,
                                    ),
                            ],
                        ),
                    ),
                contextualRestorationKeys,
            );

        for (

            of contextualRestorationKeys

            expect(
                contextualStorageAfterLogout[
                    key

            ).toBeNull();
        }

        /*
         * Laravel invalidates the authenticated shared
         * session and creates a new anonymous session.

        const loggedOutCookies =
            await page
                .context()
                .cookies();

        const loggedOutSessionCookie =
            loggedOutCookies.find(

                        === 'laravel-session',

        expect(
            loggedOutSessionCookie
                .value,

            authenticatedSessionCookie
                .value,
        );

        /*
         * A fresh document must recover anonymous truth
         * from the new server session. It must not replay
         * the former Membership locator.
         */
        const anonymousAuthenticationResponsePromise =
            page.waitForResponse(
                (response) =>
                    matchesApplicationApiPath(
                        response.url(),
                        '/api/v1/auth/me',
                    )
                    && response
                        .request()
                        .headers()[
                            'x-educore-membership-id'
                        ] === undefined,
            );

        await page.reload();

        const anonymousAuthenticationResponse =
            await anonymousAuthenticationResponsePromise;

        expect(
            anonymousAuthenticationResponse
                .status(),

        expect(
            anonymousAuthenticationResponse
                .request()
                .headers()[
                    'authorization'
                ],
        ).toBeUndefined();

        await expect(
            page.getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Masuk ke EduCore',

        expect(
            new URL(

        expect(

        );

        expect(
            logoutRequestCount,
        ).toBe(
            1,
        );

        expect(
            postLogoutMembershipAwareAuthenticationRequests,
        ).toEqual([]);

        /*
         * Logout must leave no browser-owned secret

        const browserStorage =
            await page.evaluate(
                () => ({
                    localStorage:
                        Object.fromEntries(

                    sessionStorage:

        expect(

        expect(

```

### Kenapa storage key tidak di-hardcode?

Kita sudah tahu Membership punya key tertentu, tetapi Workspace juga memiliki restoration ownership sendiri. Daripada E2E mengikat dirinya ke private implementation constant, test mengambil **key yang benar-benar berisi canonical Membership/Tenant locator sebelum logout**, kemudian memastikan key tersebut hilang sesudah authority loss.

Ini menguji behavior:

```text
contextual restoration existed
→ logout
→ contextual restoration gone
```

bukan private naming convention.

---

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Logout dilakukan lewat UI production

Test mengklik:

```text
Keluar
```

bukan melakukan:

```ts
page.request.post(...)
page.evaluate(() => runtime.logout())
```

Jadi chain yang diuji benar-benar:

```text
React UI
→ BrowserAuthRuntime
→ frontend transport
→ Laravel BFF
```

### 2. CSRF preflight juga dibuktikan

Frontend logout transport menjalankan BrowserSession initialization/CSRF sebelum POST logout. Existing unit test sudah menguji behavior tersebut secara isolated. `Pasted text.txt`

E2E sekarang membuktikan request nyata:

```text
GET  /browser/session/csrf 204
POST /browser/auth/logout  200
```

### 3. Cookie rotation adalah proof penting

Backend explicitly:

```php
$request->session()->invalidate();
$request->session()->regenerateToken();
```

dan backend feature test sudah membuktikan session ID berubah. `Pasted text (2).txt`

E2E memperluasnya sampai browser:

```text
authenticated laravel-session value
!=
anonymous post-logout laravel-session value
```

dan keduanya tetap HttpOnly.

### 4. Reload adalah security proof sebenarnya

Redirect ke login saja belum cukup.

Tanpa reload test, ada kemungkinan UI hanya menjadi anonymous sementara BrowserSession authority masih hidup.

Karena itu kita melakukan:

```text
logout
→ /login
→ page.reload()
→ /auth/me without Membership locator
→ 401
→ tetap /login
```

Ini membuktikan server-side session authority benar-benar telah hilang.

### 5. Tidak ada stale Membership restoration

H.3C memperkenalkan advisory restoration hint. Logout sekarang harus membuktikan bahwa feature tersebut tidak dapat “menghidupkan kembali” Membership lama.

Expected:
