## Troubleshooting

Jika logout `200` tetapi cookie value tidak berubah, **jangan hapus assertion**. Itu bertentangan dengan backend session invalidation contract dan perlu diaudit.

Jika setelah reload `/auth/me` menghasilkan `403` bukannya `401`, cek apakah vault/session authority benar-benar masih mempunyai Membership credential. Setelah successful logout kita mengharapkan session anonymous baru, jadi `401` adalah contract yang tepat.

Jika contextual restoration key masih ada, jangan membersihkannya dari `LogoutButton`. Root cause harus tetap diselesaikan pada Membership/Workspace reset ownership.

Jika route setelah logout menjadi `/login?returnTo=%2F`, itu tetap valid karena test hanya mengassert `pathname === '/login'`.

Jika test gagal hanya karena cookie name ternyata bukan `laravel-session`, kirim nama cookie yang terlihat dari Playwright-jangan langsung hardcode nama lain sebelum memastikan `.env.e2e`.

# FEI-10H.3G.3A - Align Post-Logout Anonymous Bootstrap Proof

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Setelah logout:

```text
new anonymous Laravel session
→ reload
→ CSRF/session bootstrap
→ /auth/me tanpa Membership locator
→ 403 BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
→ Membership discovery
→ 401 BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
→ Auth anonymous
→ /login
```

Kenapa `/auth/me` lebih dulu 403?

Karena canonical `/auth/me` adalah **Tenant/Membership-scoped resource**. Route-nya memakai `InjectTransportAwareTenantContext`, bukan user-only context. `Pasted text.txt`

Pada BrowserSession transport, middleware melihat locator lebih dulu. Tanpa:

```text
X-EduCore-Membership-Id
```

hasil canonical-nya adalah:

```text
403
BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
```

Kemudian frontend Membership lifecycle melakukan user-scoped discovery `/my-memberships`. Pada anonymous BrowserSession, endpoint itu menghasilkan:

```text
401
BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
```

dan barulah Auth runtime memperoleh definitive anonymous truth.

Ini memang lifecycle yang sudah kita temukan dan pertahankan sejak H.1/H.3C.

## Kode Lengkap

Cari bagian post-logout reload yang sekarang kurang lebih:

```ts

    page.waitForResponse(
        (response) =>
            matchesApplicationApiPath(
                response.url(),
                '/api/v1/auth/me',
            )
            && response
                .request()
                .headers()[

                ] === undefined,
```

Ganti seluruh block tersebut sampai sebelum assertion Login heading dengan berikut:

```ts
/*
 * A fresh anonymous BrowserSession first reaches the
 * Tenant-scoped canonical /auth/me boundary without a
 * Membership locator.
 *
 * That boundary intentionally reports context-required
 * before user-scoped Membership discovery establishes
 * definitive anonymous authentication truth.
 */
const anonymousContextResponsePromise =
    page.waitForResponse(
        (response) =>
            matchesApplicationApiPath(
                response.url(),
                '/api/v1/auth/me',
            )
            && response
                .request()
                .headers()[
                    'x-educore-membership-id'
                ] === undefined,
    );

const anonymousMembershipResponsePromise =
    page.waitForResponse(
        (response) =>
            matchesApplicationApiPath(
                response.url(),
                '/api/v1/user/my-memberships',
            )
            && response
                .request()
                .headers()[
                    'x-educore-membership-id'
                ] === undefined,
    );

await page.reload();

const [
    anonymousContextResponse,
    anonymousMembershipResponse,
] =
    await Promise.all([
        anonymousContextResponsePromise,
        anonymousMembershipResponsePromise,
    ]);

expect(
    anonymousContextResponse
        .status(),
).toBe(
    403,
);

const anonymousContextBody:
    unknown =
    await anonymousContextResponse
        .json();

expect(
    anonymousContextBody,
).toMatchObject({
    status:
        'error',

    code:
        'BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED',
});

expect(
    anonymousMembershipResponse
        .status(),
).toBe(
    401,
);

const anonymousMembershipBody:
    unknown =
    await anonymousMembershipResponse
        .json();

expect(
    anonymousMembershipBody,
).toMatchObject({
    status:
        'error',

    code:
        'BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED',
});

/*
 * Neither anonymous-bootstrap request may carry browser
 * bearer authority or replay the former Membership
 * locator.
 */
for (
    const response
    of [
        anonymousContextResponse,
        anonymousMembershipResponse,
    ]
) {
    expect(
        response
            .request()
            .headers()[
                'authorization'
            ],
    ).toBeUndefined();

    expect(
        response
            .request()
            .headers()[
                'x-educore-membership-id'
            ],
    ).toBeUndefined();
}
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Ini test correction, bukan production workaround

Kita tidak mengubah:

```text
BrowserAuthRuntime
MembershipRuntime
router
backend middleware
logout controller
```

Karena canonical contract memang mendukung urutan ini.

Backend test secara eksplisit membuktikan `/auth/me` tanpa Membership locator menghasilkan `403 BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED`. `Pasted text.txt`

Jadi mengubah backend agar menghasilkan `401` justru akan merusak contract yang sudah locked.

### 2. `401` tetap wajib dibuktikan

Kita tidak sekadar mengganti:

```ts
401 → 403
```

dan selesai.

Itu terlalu lemah.

Kita harus membuktikan full anonymous resolution:

```text
/auth/me
403 context-required

        ↓

/my-memberships
401 authentication-required

        ↓

Login UI
anonymous
```

Dengan begitu test memastikan 403 bukan stale authenticated session.

### 3. Kenapa 403 tidak berarti logout gagal?

Karena `BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` tidak menyatakan identity authenticated.

Ia hanya berarti request memasuki BrowserSession transport tetapi resource Tenant-scoped membutuhkan Membership locator.

Fresh anonymous session juga mempunyai BrowserSession cookie setelah CSRF initialization. `UseBrowserSessionForCanonicalApi` memang mengaktifkan BrowserSession transport ketika configured session cookie hadir. `bff-9-2b-runtime-error-status-evidence.txt`

Definitive identity check terjadi pada user-scoped Membership discovery.

### 4. Security proof justru menjadi lebih kuat

Setelah patch, kita membuktikan dua request post-logout:

```text
/auth/me
membership locator = absent
Authorization      = absent

/my-memberships
membership locator = absent
Authorization      = absent
```

dan response akhir:

```text
BROWSER_SESSION_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
```

Ini jauh lebih presisi daripada hanya memeriksa satu HTTP status.

## Troubleshooting

Jika `/auth/me` 403 tetapi body bukan:

```text
BROWSER_MEMBERSHIP_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
```

dan halaman tetap `/login`, logout authority sudah terbukti benar.

`.env.example` tetap di luar H.3G.3A. Jangan stage dulu perubahan PostgreSQL tersebut bersama FEI-10.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Full Vitest wajib dijalankan sekarang

Selama H.3 kita sengaja memakai targeted regressions agar feedback cepat.

Closure gate berbeda. Sekarang seluruh frontend harus lolos karena perubahan FEI-10 menyentuh beberapa lifecycle sekaligus:

```text
Auth
Membership
Workspace
Capability
Routing
Login UX
Logout UX
```

Target bukan hanya test yang kita tambahkan.

### 2. Real browser tetap Laravel nyata

Expected inventory tetap:

```text
6 tests in 1 file
```

yang mencakup:

```text
anonymous bootstrap
successful login
reload persistence
invalid credentials
canonical validation
logout + anonymous reload
```

Tidak boleh ada `page.route()` atau MSW di E2E.

### 3. Security audit harus tetap negatif

Browser tidak boleh memiliki:

```text
access_token
Bearer credential
Authorization authority
```

Membership restoration memang boleh berada di `sessionStorage`, tetapi hanya locator:

```text
membership_id
tenant_id
```

dan logout sudah membuktikan locator itu dibersihkan.

### 4. Login/Logout UI tetap command-only

Kita ingin scan berikut kosong:

```text
fetch(...)
axios
sessionStorage
localStorage
navigate(...)
```

pada LoginPage/LoginForm/LogoutButton.

Artinya application UI tidak mengambil ownership platform/network/context cleanup.

### 5. Backend production tetap frozen

Seluruh FEI-10H berhasil dicapai secara additive di frontend/E2E infrastructure.

Maka:

```bash
git diff -- Modules/Auth Modules/User Modules/Core
```

harus kosong.

### 6. `.env.example` perlu dipisahkan

Dari output terakhir:

```diff
-DB_CONNECTION=sqlite
+DB_CONNECTION=pgsql

-# DB_PORT=3306
+# DB_PORT=5432
```

Perubahan itu tidak diperlukan oleh FEI-10H real-browser implementation karena `.env.e2e` sudah menjadi boundary local E2E.

Jadi pada final commit nanti `.env.example` **jangan ikut distage**, kecuali kita secara terpisah memutuskan perubahan tersebut memang perubahan proyek yang diinginkan.

Kita juga tidak akan me-revert-nya tanpa mengetahui ownership perubahan itu.

bukan whitespace error.

# FEI-10 Final Closure - Step 2A: Surgical Whitespace Repair

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Perbaiki **hanya empat blank line yang memiliki trailing spaces**:

```text
frontend/e2e/authentication.e2e.ts
  line 661

frontend/src/app/__tests__/LoginPage.test.tsx
  line 34
  line 131

frontend/src/app/auth/__tests__/login-form.test.ts
  line 239
```

Kita tidak menjalankan formatter, tidak mengubah CRLF secara global, dan tidak menyentuh file lain.

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Hanya tiga file:

```text
frontend/e2e/authentication.e2e.ts
frontend/src/app/__tests__/LoginPage.test.tsx
frontend/src/app/auth/__tests__/login-form.test.ts
```

---

## Kode Lengkap

Gunakan script berbasis **bytes** berikut agar line ending existing tetap dipertahankan:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

targets = {
    Path("frontend/e2e/authentication.e2e.ts"): [661],
    Path("frontend/src/app/__tests__/LoginPage.test.tsx"): [34, 131],
    Path("frontend/src/app/auth/__tests__/login-form.test.ts"): [239],
}

for path, line_numbers in targets.items():
    data = path.read_bytes()
    lines = data.splitlines(keepends=True)

    for line_number in line_numbers:
        index = line_number - 1

        if index >= len(lines):
            raise SystemExit(
                f"{path}:{line_number}: line does not exist"
            )

        line = lines[index]

        if line.endswith(b"\r\n"):
            body = line[:-2]
            ending = b"\r\n"
        elif line.endswith(b"\n"):
            body = line[:-1]
            ending = b"\n"
        else:
            body = line
            ending = b""

        if body.strip(b" \t") != b"":
            raise SystemExit(
                f"{path}:{line_number}: expected whitespace-only line, got {body!r}"
            )

        if body == b"":
            raise SystemExit(
                f"{path}:{line_number}: line already clean"
            )

        lines[index] = ending

    path.write_bytes(
        b"".join(lines)
    )

    print(
        f"Cleaned {path}: {line_numbers}"
    )
PY
```

Kemudian re-stage **hanya tiga file itu**:

```bash

  frontend/e2e/authentication.e2e.ts \
  frontend/src/app/__tests__/LoginPage.test.tsx \
  frontend/src/app/auth/__tests__/login-form.test.ts
```

```bash
echo

echo
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Script bersifat **fail-closed**. Ia hanya akan mengubah line yang:

1. berada tepat pada nomor yang kita temukan dari `git diff --cached --check`;
2. seluruh isinya hanya space/tab;
3. memang masih memiliki whitespace.

Karena file dibaca dan ditulis sebagai bytes, kita tidak melakukan normalisasi seluruh file dari CRLF ke LF atau sebaliknya.

Tidak perlu menjalankan Prettier/ESLint/formatter seluruh project untuk masalah empat blank lines ini. Itu justru dapat memperbesar diff tanpa manfaat.

Security scan Step 2 juga tidak menunjukkan blocker. Match seperti:

```text
Bearer
Authorization
password
sessionStorage
```

berasal dari security assertions, comments, form password handling, dan intentional Membership restoration tests/storage. Tidak terlihat pola production seperti menyimpan `access_token` atau membuat browser Bearer credential. `Pasted text.txt`

Browser tidak pernah menjadi pemilik canonical bearer.

Context turunannya tetap:

```text
Auth
 ↓
Membership
 ↓
Workspace
 ↓
Capability
 ↓
Protected Routing
```

Login/logout UI juga tidak melakukan manual context cleanup atau navigation authority sendiri.

Itu penting untuk maintainability: ketika authentication truth berubah, subsystem downstream bereaksi berdasarkan authority lifecycle, bukan berdasarkan coupling antar-component.

# FEI-11A — Current Shell & Navigation Contract Audit

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Sebelum membuat sidebar/header/menu, kita harus mengetahui siapa yang sekarang menjadi authority untuk:

```text
Route definition
Route policy
Authentication
Membership
Workspace
Capability / permission
Post-login destination
Protected rendering
Application root
```

Target arsitekturnya nanti bukan sekadar:

```tsx
<Sidebar>
    <a href="/users">Users</a>
</Sidebar>
```

Navigation harus menjadi **projection dari route + authorization authority**, bukan sumber authorization baru.

Boundary yang ingin kita pertahankan:

```text
Canonical Route Policy
        ↓
Navigation Definition
        ↓
Auth / Membership / Workspace / Capability state
        ↓
Navigation Projection
        ↓
Application Shell UI
```

Jadi menu:

```text
boleh menyembunyikan entry yang tidak relevan
```

tetapi:

```text
TIDAK BOLEH menjadi security boundary
```

Protected route tetap authority terakhir.

Kita juga perlu memastikan FEI-11 tidak menciptakan duplikasi seperti:

```text
router permission = 'users.read'

sidebar permission = 'user.view'

page permission = 'users.list'
```

Itu akan menyebabkan authorization drift.

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Navigation bukan authorization layer

FEI-8/9 sudah membentuk authorization decision dan protected route boundary.

Maka FEI-11 tidak boleh membuat sistem kedua seperti:

```ts
const menuPermissions = {
    users: ['admin', 'superadmin'],
};
```

Itu melanggar keputusan bahwa:

```text
permissions[] = canonical runtime authorization vocabulary
```

dan role bukan source authority.

Model yang kita inginkan nanti kira-kira:

```text
Route Policy
{
    path
    workspace policy
    required permissions
}

             ↓ projection

Navigation Entry
{
    label
    destination
    route identity
}

             ↓ runtime evaluation

visible / unavailable
```

Bukan:

```text
Navigation
→ menentukan sendiri apakah user authorized
```

### 2. Route definitions sebaiknya menjadi single source

Audit nomor 3–7 sangat penting.

Kita perlu tahu apakah route sekarang dideklarasikan secara terpusat atau tersebar.

Jika canonical route metadata sudah ada, navigation sebaiknya menggunakan referensi yang sama.

Contoh prinsip yang mungkin kita pakai nanti:

```ts
{
    id: 'home',
    path: '/',
    policy: ...
}
```

kemudian:

```ts
navigationEntry.routeId = 'home'
```

bukan mengulang:

```ts
navigationEntry.path = '/';
navigationEntry.permission = ...;
navigationEntry.workspace = ...;
```

Semakin sedikit duplicated policy, semakin kecil risiko drift.

### 3. Workspace-aware bukan sekadar label

Karena architecture kita punya:

```text
TENANT
ORGANIZATION
ORGANIZATION_UNIT
```

navigation mungkin berubah berdasarkan workspace projection.

Contoh nanti:

```text
TENANT
→ platform administration

ORGANIZATION
→ organization operations

ORGANIZATION_UNIT
→ unit operations
```

Tetapi kita belum menetapkan menu tersebut pada H.11A.

Audit dulu harus menunjukkan route mana yang memang tersedia sekarang.

### 4. Jangan menciptakan fake routes

FEI-9 sebelumnya sudah mengunci prinsip:

```text
no fake dashboard
```

Karena itu FEI-11 tidak boleh membuat menu:

```text
Dashboard
Users
Academic
Dormitory
HR
```

hanya untuk membuat sidebar terlihat lengkap apabila route/feature canonical belum ada.

Navigation hanya boleh menunjukkan destination nyata.

### 5. Shell harus mengikuti authority lifecycle

Nantinya authenticated shell kemungkinan hanya boleh muncul setelah route authority siap:

```text
Auth authenticated
+
Membership ready
+
Workspace ready
+
Capability ready
+
Protected route allowed
```

Kita perlu memastikan apakah `ProtectedRouteBoundary` sudah menjadi tempat yang tepat untuk memasang shell atau shell harus menjadi route layout parent.

Itulah alasan kita audit router/provider graph lebih dulu.

# FEI-11B - Authenticated Application Shell Structure

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita akan memisahkan **global authenticated application chrome** dari page content.

Saat ini:

```text
ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary
        ↓
App
├── brand
├── LogoutButton
└── page content
```

Target:

```text
ProtectedApplicationLifecycleBoundary
        ↓
ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary
        ↓
AuthenticatedApplicationShell
├── global header
│   ├── EduCore identity
│   ├── authenticated Person
│   ├── current Workspace
│   └── LogoutButton
│
└── <Outlet />
        ↓
      App
      └── page content only
```

Ini penting karena nanti semua protected route:

```text
/
Academic
Dormitory
HR
...
```

tidak boleh mengimplementasikan header/logout/navigation sendiri-sendiri.

Shell hanya **menampilkan authority yang sudah diterbitkan runtime**. Ia tidak melakukan:

```text
bootstrap()
refresh()
switchWorkspace()
permission evaluation
navigation authorization
fetch()
```

Dan pada FEI-11B kita **belum membuat menu/sidebar**. Itu akan masuk FEI-11C/D sehingga kita tidak menciptakan fake route.

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Buat `frontend/src/app/shell/AuthenticatedApplicationShell.tsx`

```tsx
import {
    Outlet,
} from 'react-router';

import {
    useBrowserAuthState,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import {
    LogoutButton,
} from '@/app/auth/LogoutButton';
import {
    useWorkspaceContextState,
} from '@/app/workspace/WorkspaceContextProvider';

export function AuthenticatedApplicationShell() {
    const authentication =
        useBrowserAuthState();

    const workspace =
        useWorkspaceContextState();

    /*
     * The shell lives below the canonical protected
     * application boundary.
     *
     * It must still fail closed if React ever observes an
     * intermediate cross-provider snapshot before the
     * parent boundary rerenders.
     *
     * The shell does not manufacture authentication or
     * Workspace authority and does not start lifecycle work.
     */
    if (
        authentication.status
            !== 'authenticated'
        || workspace.status
            !== 'ready'
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    const {
        person,
        user,
        tenant,
    } =
        authentication.identity;

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100">
            <header className="border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950">
                <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-7xl items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400">
                            EduCore
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-1 truncate text-sm text-slate-300">
                            {tenant.name}
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-4">
                        <div
                            className="hidden min-w-0 text-right sm:block"
                            aria-label="Konteks pengguna aktif"
                        >
                            <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-slate-100">
                                {person.name}
                            </p>

                            <p className="truncate text-xs text-slate-400">
                                {user.email}
                            </p>

                            <p className="truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                                Workspace: {workspace.current.label}
                            </p>
                        </div>

                        <LogoutButton />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </header>

            <main
                className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 lg:px-8"
                id="main-content"
            >
                <Outlet />
            </main>
        </div>
    );
}
```

### Boundary penting

Notice shell hanya membaca:

```text
authentication.identity
workspace.current
```

Ia tidak menulis atau mengubah keduanya.

Ini merupakan **read-only presentation projection**.

## 3. Ubah `frontend/src/app/router.tsx`

Gunakan versi lengkap berikut:

```tsx
import {
    createBrowserRouter,
    type RouteObject,
} from 'react-router';

import {
    App,
} from '@/app/App';
import {
    LoginRouteBoundary,
} from '@/app/routing/LoginRouteBoundary';
import {
    NotFoundPage,
} from '@/app/NotFoundPage';
import {
    ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary,
} from '@/app/routing/ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary';
import {
    ProtectedApplicationLifecycleBoundary,
} from '@/app/routing/ProtectedApplicationLifecycleBoundary';
import {
    RouteErrorPage,
} from '@/app/RouteErrorPage';
import {
    AuthenticatedApplicationShell,
} from '@/app/shell/AuthenticatedApplicationShell';

export const appRoutes = [
    {
        id:
            'protected-application',

        Component:
            ProtectedApplicationLifecycleBoundary,

        children: [
            {
                id:
                    'protected-application-access',

                Component:
                    ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary,

                children: [
                    {
                        id:
                            'authenticated-application-shell',

                        Component:
                            AuthenticatedApplicationShell,

                        children: [
                            {
                                id:
                                    'root',

                                path:
                                    '/',

                                Component:
                                    App,

                                ErrorBoundary:
                                    RouteErrorPage,
                            },
                        ],
                    },
                ],
            },
        ],
    },
    {
        id:
            'auth.login',

        path:
            '/login',

        Component:
            LoginRouteBoundary,

        ErrorBoundary:
            RouteErrorPage,
    },
    {
        id:
            'not-found',

        path:
            '*',

        Component:
            NotFoundPage,
    },
] satisfies RouteObject[];

export function createAppRouter() {
    return createBrowserRouter(
        appRoutes,
    );
}
```

Route `/` dan ID `root` **tetap stabil**.

Yang baru hanya layout parent:

```text
authenticated-application-shell
```

## 5. Update `frontend/src/app/__tests__/router.test.tsx`

Ganti dengan:

```tsx
import {
    matchRoutes,
} from 'react-router';
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    appRoutes,
} from '@/app/router';

function matchedRouteIds(
    location:
        string,
): string[] {
    return (
        matchRoutes(
            appRoutes,
            location,
        )
            ?.map(
                (match) =>
                    match.route.id,
            )
            .filter(
                (
                    routeId,
                ): routeId is string =>
                    routeId !== undefined,
            )
        ?? []
    );
}

function matchedLeafRouteId(
    location:
        string,
): string | undefined {
    return matchedRouteIds(
        location,
    ).at(
        -1,
    );
}

describe(
    'Application router topology',
    () => {
        it('registers the canonical login route as a known application route', () => {
            expect(
                matchedLeafRouteId(
                    '/login',
                ),
            ).toBe(
                'auth.login',
            );
        });

        it('keeps unknown locations distinct from the canonical login route', () => {
            expect(
                matchedLeafRouteId(
                    '/definitely-not-a-route',
                ),
            ).toBe(
                'not-found',
            );
        });

        it('keeps the existing root route stable inside the authenticated application shell', () => {
            expect(
                matchedRouteIds(
                    '/',
                ),
            ).toEqual([
                'protected-application',
                'protected-application-access',
                'authenticated-application-shell',
                'root',
            ]);

            expect(
                matchedLeafRouteId(
                    '/',
                ),
            ).toBe(
                'root',
            );
        });

        it('keeps the public login route outside the authenticated application shell', () => {
            expect(
                matchedRouteIds(
                    '/login',
                ),
            ).toEqual([
                'auth.login',
            ]);

            expect(
                matchedRouteIds(
                    '/login',
                ),
            ).not.toContain(
                'authenticated-application-shell',
            );
        });
    },
);
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Shell berada **di bawah** access boundary

Ini keputusan paling penting.

Kita tidak membuat:

```text
Shell
└── ProtectedRouteBoundary
```

karena itu berpotensi merender authenticated chrome sebelum authority benar-benar allowed.

Kita membuat:

```text
ProtectedRouteBoundary
        ↓ allowed only
Shell
```

Audit menunjukkan protected application policy saat ini memang sudah menjadi canonical root authority boundary. `Pasted text (3).txt`

---

### 2. Shell bukan authorization authority

Shell tidak mempunyai:

```ts
if (permissions.includes(...))
```

Tidak ada role.

Tidak ada:

```ts
is_global_superadmin
```

Tidak ada access decision.

Ia hanya membaca canonical snapshots.

Authorization tetap:

```text
ProtectedRoutePolicy
        ↓
evaluateProtectedRouteAccess()
        ↓
Authorization evaluator
```

Audit mengonfirmasi route evaluator sudah menjaga urutan Auth → Membership → Workspace → Capability → Permission. `Current Shell & Navigation Contract Audit.txt`

---

### 3. Global UI dipisah dari page

Sebelumnya `App.tsx` mencampur:

```text
global chrome
+
route content
```

Setelah B:

```text
AuthenticatedApplicationShell
→ global authenticated UI

App
→ page-specific content
```

Ini memenuhi **Single Responsibility Principle**.

Ketika nanti `/academic/students`, `/dormitory/...`, dan route lain ditambahkan, semua otomatis memakai shell yang sama.

---

### 4. Tidak ada fake navigation

FEI-11A membuktikan production router saat ini hanya punya:

```text
/
 /login
 *
```

Jadi pada B kita tidak membuat menu:

```text
Academic
Dormitory
Users
Dashboard
```

hanya karena permission examples sudah muncul pada tests.

Hardcoded `academic.students.*` dan `dormitory.rooms.*` sekarang adalah route-policy test vocabulary, bukan registered production destinations. `Current Shell & Navigation Contract Audit.txt`

---

### 5. User display menggunakan canonical Auth identity

Kita tidak melakukan request `/me` lagi.

Auth runtime sudah mempunyai:

```text
identity.user
identity.person
identity.tenant
```

dan Workspace runtime sudah memiliki:

```text
current.label
```

Jadi header adalah projection existing state tanpa network dependency baru.

---

### 6. Responsive foundation minimal

Shell menggunakan:

```text
px-4
sm:px-6
lg:px-8
max-w-7xl
hidden sm:block
truncate
```

Ini cukup sebagai structural responsive baseline.

Kita belum membuat mobile drawer karena belum ada navigation model yang bisa dimasukkan ke drawer.

---

# Troubleshooting

### Jika test shell gagal karena fixture Workspace type

Jangan pakai `as any`.

Kirim TypeScript error persis; kita sesuaikan fixture dengan contract `WorkspaceContextState`.

### Jika direct-navigation test gagal mencari LogoutButton atau heading

Jangan ubah routing authority. Kita cek apakah test lama mengasumsikan `App` sebagai full-screen shell.

### Jika `/login` ikut shell

Itu blocker.

Expected topology wajib:

```text
/login
→ auth.login
```

bukan:

```text
protected-app
→ shell
→ login
```

Public route harus tetap tidak mengaktifkan Workspace/Capability lifecycle.

### Jika shell authority grep menemukan `permissions`

Jangan langsung anggap semua match salah; komentar bisa match. Yang dilarang adalah shell melakukan authorization decision sendiri.

### Jika E2E belum dijalankan

Bukan blocker untuk B. Real-browser shell/navigation proof kita simpan untuk FEI-11H setelah navigation model sudah stabil.

# Langkah Berikutnya

Jika FEI-11B hijau, kita lock:

```text
FEI-11B - Authenticated Application Shell Structure
✅ COMPLETE / LOCKED
```

Baru setelah itu masuk:

```text
FEI-11C - Canonical Navigation Model
```

Di sana kita akan mendefinisikan navigation metadata berdasarkan **registered real route identity**, tanpa menduplikasi permission policy dan tanpa membuat fake module routes.

Untuk sekarang kerjakan **FEI-11B saja**.

# FEI-11B.1 — Complete Router Shell Boundary Contract

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita akan menambahkan bukti eksplisit bahwa:

```text
/
→ protected-application
→ protected-application-access
→ authenticated-application-shell
→ root
```

sementara:

```text
/login
→ auth.login
```

dan **tidak pernah**:

```text
/login
→ authenticated-application-shell
```

Ini penting karena public login tidak boleh ikut authenticated shell maupun downstream authenticated lifecycle.

## Struktur Folder & File

Ubah hanya:

```text
frontend/src/app/__tests__/router.test.tsx
```

Tidak perlu menyentuh:

```text
App.tsx
router.tsx
shell/*
platform/*
Modules/*
```

## Kode Lengkap

Ganti isi `frontend/src/app/__tests__/router.test.tsx` dengan:

```tsx
import {
    matchRoutes,
} from 'react-router';
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    appRoutes,
} from '@/app/router';

function matchedRouteIds(
    location:
        string,
): string[] {
    return (
        matchRoutes(
            appRoutes,
            location,
        )
            ?.map(
                (match) =>
                    match.route.id,
            )
            .filter(
                (
                    routeId,
                ): routeId is string =>
                    routeId !== undefined,
            )
        ?? []
    );
}

function matchedLeafRouteId(
    location:
        string,
): string | undefined {
    return matchedRouteIds(
        location,
    ).at(
        -1,
    );
}

describe(
    'Application router topology',
    () => {
        it('registers the canonical login route as a known application route', () => {
            expect(
                matchedLeafRouteId(
                    '/login',
                ),
            ).toBe(
                'auth.login',
            );
        });

        it('keeps unknown locations distinct from the canonical login route', () => {
            expect(
                matchedLeafRouteId(
                    '/definitely-not-a-route',
                ),
            ).toBe(
                'not-found',
            );
        });

        it('keeps the existing root route stable inside the authenticated application shell', () => {
            expect(
                matchedRouteIds(
                    '/',
                ),
            ).toEqual([
                'protected-application',
                'protected-application-access',
                'authenticated-application-shell',
                'root',
            ]);

            expect(
                matchedLeafRouteId(
                    '/',
                ),
            ).toBe(
                'root',
            );
        });

        it('keeps the public login route outside the authenticated application shell', () => {
            const routeIds =
                matchedRouteIds(
                    '/login',
                );

            expect(
                routeIds,
            ).toEqual([
                'auth.login',
            ]);

            expect(
                routeIds,
            ).not.toContain(
                'authenticated-application-shell',
            );

            expect(
                routeIds,
            ).not.toContain(
                'protected-application',
            );

            expect(
                routeIds,
            ).not.toContain(
                'protected-application-access',
            );
        });
    },
);
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

`matchedRouteIds()` lebih kuat daripada hanya memeriksa leaf route.

Test lama hanya bisa membuktikan:

```text
leaf('/') === root
```

tetapi tidak membuktikan parent topology.

Sekarang kita membuktikan keseluruhan hierarchy:

```text
protected lifecycle
→ protected access
→ authenticated shell
→ page
```

Dan untuk login kita melakukan inverse assertion:

```text
auth.login
```

tanpa:

```text
protected-application
protected-application-access
authenticated-application-shell
```

Ini menjaga **Separation of Concerns** antara public authentication UI dan authenticated application UI.

Tidak ada perubahan production code pada langkah ini.

# FEI-11B.2 — Wire Authenticated Shell into Router

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita hanya akan memasang `AuthenticatedApplicationShell` sebagai layout parent di bawah:

```text
ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary
```

dan di atas:

```text
root
```

Target topology final:

```text
ProtectedApplicationLifecycleBoundary
        ↓
ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary
        ↓
AuthenticatedApplicationShell
        ↓
App
```

Ini penting karena shell hanya boleh muncul setelah protected root authority diizinkan.

## Struktur Folder & File

Ubah hanya:

```text
frontend/src/app/router.tsx
```

Jangan ubah test lagi. Test yang gagal sekarang adalah contract yang benar.

## Kode Lengkap

Ganti isi `frontend/src/app/router.tsx` menjadi:

```tsx
import {
    createBrowserRouter,
    type RouteObject,
} from 'react-router';

import {
    App,
} from '@/app/App';
import {
    NotFoundPage,
} from '@/app/NotFoundPage';
import {
    RouteErrorPage,
} from '@/app/RouteErrorPage';
import {
    LoginRouteBoundary,
} from '@/app/routing/LoginRouteBoundary';
import {
    ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary,
} from '@/app/routing/ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary';
import {
    ProtectedApplicationLifecycleBoundary,
} from '@/app/routing/ProtectedApplicationLifecycleBoundary';
import {
    AuthenticatedApplicationShell,
} from '@/app/shell/AuthenticatedApplicationShell';

export const appRoutes = [
    {
        id:
            'protected-application',

        Component:
            ProtectedApplicationLifecycleBoundary,

        children: [
            {
                id:
                    'protected-application-access',

                Component:
                    ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary,

                children: [
                    {
                        id:
                            'authenticated-application-shell',

                        Component:
                            AuthenticatedApplicationShell,

                        children: [
                            {
                                id:
                                    'root',

                                path:
                                    '/',

                                Component:
                                    App,

                                ErrorBoundary:
                                    RouteErrorPage,
                            },
                        ],
                    },
                ],
            },
        ],
    },
    {
        id:
            'auth.login',

        path:
            '/login',

        Component:
            LoginRouteBoundary,

        ErrorBoundary:
            RouteErrorPage,
    },
    {
        id:
            'not-found',

        path:
            '*',

        Component:
            NotFoundPage,
    },
] satisfies RouteObject[];

export function createAppRouter() {
    return createBrowserRouter(
        appRoutes,
    );
}
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

Yang berubah hanya topology route.

Sebelumnya:

```text
access boundary
└── root
```

sekarang:

```text
access boundary
└── authenticated shell
    └── root
```

Kita tidak memindahkan `ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary` ke dalam shell. Itu sengaja, supaya shell tidak pernah menjadi authorization boundary.

Urutannya tetap:

```text
Auth / Membership / Workspace / Capability
        ↓
Protected route decision
        ↓
allowed
        ↓
Authenticated shell
```

Public `/login` tetap sibling terpisah, sehingga tidak mendapat shell dan tidak mengaktifkan protected lifecycle.

# FEI-11B.3 — Router EOF Hygiene

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Tambahkan tepat satu newline di akhir:

## Kode Lengkap

Jalankan:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("frontend/src/app/router.tsx")
data = path.read_bytes()

if data.endswith(b"\n"):
    raise SystemExit(
        "frontend/src/app/router.tsx already ends with a newline"
    )

path.write_bytes(data + b"\n")

print(
    "Added final newline to frontend/src/app/router.tsx"
)
PY
```

# FEI-11C — Canonical Navigation Model

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

FEI-11C belum membuat sidebar/menu UI. Kita membangun **model navigation murni** terlebih dahulu.

Tujuan utamanya:

```text
Registered application destination
        ↓
Canonical Navigation Definition
        ↓
immutable navigation catalog
        ↓
nanti FEI-11D: authorization/workspace projection
        ↓
nanti FEI-11E/F: UI
```

Navigation **tidak boleh** menyimpan ulang authorization policy seperti:

```ts
{
    permission: 'academic.students.view',
    workspace: 'tenant',
}
```

karena itu akan menduplikasi `ProtectedRoutePolicy`.

Untuk sekarang production router hanya memiliki satu destination protected nyata:

```text
/
```

Jadi catalog navigation FEI-11C juga hanya boleh mempunyai **satu entry nyata**. Tidak ada fake `Academic`, `Dormitory`, `HR`, `Users`, atau dashboard baru.

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Buat:

```text
frontend/src/platform/navigation/navigation-definition.ts
frontend/src/platform/navigation/index.ts
frontend/src/platform/navigation/__tests__/navigation-definition.test.ts
```

Tidak perlu mengubah shell atau router pada langkah ini.

---

## Kode Lengkap

### 1. Buat `frontend/src/platform/navigation/navigation-definition.ts`

```ts
export type ApplicationNavigationDestination =
    `/${string}`;

export interface ApplicationNavigationDefinition {
    /*
     * Stable presentation/navigation identity.
     *
     * This is not a translated label and is not an
     * authorization role or permission.
     */
    readonly id:
        string;

    /*
     * Stable application route identity associated with the
     * registered destination.
     *
     * Navigation may refer to route identity, but it does
     * not copy route authorization policy.
     */
    readonly routeId:
        string;

    readonly label:
        string;

    readonly destination:
        ApplicationNavigationDestination;
}

function requireNonEmpty(
    value:
        string,
    field:
        string,
): string {
    if (
        value.trim().length
            === 0
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            `EduCore navigation definition requires a non-empty ${field}.`,
        );
    }

    return value;
}

function normalizeDestination(
    destination:
        ApplicationNavigationDestination,
): ApplicationNavigationDestination {
    if (
        destination.length
            === 0
        || ! destination.startsWith(
            '/',
        )
        || destination.startsWith(
            '//',
        )
        || destination.includes(
            '\\',
        )
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'EduCore navigation definition requires a safe root-relative destination.',
        );
    }

    return destination;
}

export function defineApplicationNavigation(
    definition:
        ApplicationNavigationDefinition,
): ApplicationNavigationDefinition {
    return Object.freeze({
        id:
            requireNonEmpty(
                definition.id,
                'id',
            ),

        routeId:
            requireNonEmpty(
                definition.routeId,
                'routeId',
            ),

        label:
            requireNonEmpty(
                definition.label,
                'label',
            ),

        destination:
            normalizeDestination(
                definition.destination,
            ),
    });
}

export const applicationNavigationCatalog =
    Object.freeze([
        defineApplicationNavigation({
            id:
                'application.home',

            routeId:
                'root',

            label:
                'Beranda',

            destination:
                '/',
        }),
    ]);
```

### 2. Buat `frontend/src/platform/navigation/index.ts`

```ts
    applicationNavigationCatalog,
    defineApplicationNavigation,
} from './navigation-definition';

export type {
    ApplicationNavigationDefinition,
    ApplicationNavigationDestination,
} from './navigation-definition';
```

### 3. Buat `frontend/src/platform/navigation/__tests__/navigation-definition.test.ts`

```ts
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    applicationNavigationCatalog,
    defineApplicationNavigation,
} from '@/platform/navigation';

describe(
    'Application navigation definition',
    () => {
        it('defines the current registered protected root destination without inventing additional module navigation', () => {
            expect(
                applicationNavigationCatalog,
            ).toEqual([
                {
                    id:
                        'application.home',

                    routeId:
                        'root',

                    label:
                        'Beranda',

                    destination:
                        '/',
                },
            ]);
        });

        it('requires a stable non-empty navigation identity', () => {
            expect(
                () =>
                    defineApplicationNavigation({
                        id:
                            '   ',

                        routeId:
                            'root',

                        label:
                            'Beranda',

                        destination:
                            '/',
                    }),
            ).toThrow(
                'EduCore navigation definition requires a non-empty id.',
            );
        });

        it('requires a stable non-empty route identity', () => {
            expect(
                () =>
                    defineApplicationNavigation({
                        id:
                            'application.home',

                        routeId:
                            '',

                        label:
                            'Beranda',

                        destination:
                            '/',
                    }),
            ).toThrow(
                'EduCore navigation definition requires a non-empty routeId.',
            );
        });

        it('requires a non-empty presentation label', () => {
            expect(
                () =>
                    defineApplicationNavigation({
                        id:
                            'application.home',

                        routeId:
                            'root',

                        label:
                            '   ',

                        destination:
                            '/',
                    }),
            ).toThrow(
                'EduCore navigation definition requires a non-empty label.',
            );
        });

        it('rejects protocol-relative navigation destinations', () => {
            expect(
                () =>
                    defineApplicationNavigation({
                        id:
                            'application.unsafe',

                        routeId:
                            'unsafe',

                        label:
                            'Unsafe',

                        destination:
                            '//evil.example' as `/${string}`,
                    }),
            ).toThrow(
                'EduCore navigation definition requires a safe root-relative destination.',
            );
        });

        it('rejects backslash-based ambiguous navigation destinations', () => {
            expect(
                () =>
                    defineApplicationNavigation({
                        id:
                            'application.unsafe',

                        routeId:
                            'unsafe',

                        label:
                            'Unsafe',

                        destination:
                            '/\\evil.example',
                    }),
            ).toThrow(
                'EduCore navigation definition requires a safe root-relative destination.',
            );
        });

        it('publishes immutable navigation definitions', () => {
            const definition =
                defineApplicationNavigation({
                    id:
                        'application.home',

                    routeId:
                        'root',

                    label:
                        'Beranda',

                    destination:
                        '/',
                });

            expect(
                Object.isFrozen(
                    definition,
                ),
            ).toBe(
                true,
            );

            expect(
                Object.isFrozen(
                    applicationNavigationCatalog,
                ),
            ).toBe(
                true,
            );
        });
    },
);
```

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Navigation metadata tidak mengandung permission

Tidak ada:

```ts
requiredPermissions
permissions
role
workspaceType
isSuperAdmin
```

Itu sengaja.

Navigation hanya menjawab:

```text
siapa saya?
route mana yang saya representasikan?
label apa?
destination apa?
```

Sedangkan pertanyaan:

```text
boleh ditampilkan?
sesuai Workspace saat ini?
permission tersedia?
```

akan ditangani oleh projection di fase berikutnya.

Ini menjaga **Single Source of Truth**.

### 2. `routeId` memakai registered router identity

Untuk current root:

```text
routeId = root
destination = /
```

Kita tidak memakai contoh policy test seperti:

```text
academic.students.index
dormitory.rooms.index
```

karena route itu belum production-registered.

### 3. Catalog immutable

`Object.freeze()` mencegah consumer melakukan:

```ts
applicationNavigationCatalog.push(...)
```

atau mengubah definition runtime.

Navigation metadata adalah configuration snapshot, bukan mutable application state.

### 4. Destination tetap divalidasi

Walaupun saat ini metadata bersifat developer-owned, kita tetap fail-closed terhadap:

```text
//evil.example
/\evil.example
```

Navigation model tidak boleh menjadi jalur open redirect di kemudian hari.

### 5. Belum ada `NavLink`

Ini penting.

FEI-11C hanya membangun model.

```text
FEI-11C → data contract
FEI-11D → projection
FEI-11E/F → presentation
```

Dengan urutan ini UI tidak mengambil alih business/authorization logic.

# FEI-11D.1 - Canonical Application Route Access Registry

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita pindahkan ownership policy root menjadi:

```text
Application route identity
        root
         ↓
canonical access registry
         ↓
ProtectedRoutePolicy
 app.protected-root
         ↓
dipakai bersama oleh:
- ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary
- navigation projection nanti
```

Ada dua identity berbeda dan keduanya valid:

```text
root
→ React Router / destination identity

app.protected-root
→ protected access policy identity
```

Yang tidak boleh terjadi adalah navigation membuat ulang:

```ts
contextRequirement: 'tenant'
authorizationScope: 'tenant'
requiredPermissions: null
```

sendiri.

Registry inilah adapter antara route registration dan canonical route policy.

Pada langkah ini kita **belum membuat navigation projection UI/authorization**.

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Buat:

```text
frontend/src/app/routing/application-route-access.ts

frontend/src/app/routing/__tests__/
    application-route-access.test.ts
```

Ubah:

```text
frontend/src/app/routing/
    ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary.tsx
```

Tidak mengubah:

```text
frontend/src/platform/navigation/*
frontend/src/platform/routing/*
frontend/src/app/shell/*
frontend/src/app/router.tsx
```

---

## Kode Lengkap

### 1. Buat `frontend/src/app/routing/application-route-access.ts`

```ts
import {
    defineProtectedRoutePolicy,
    type ProtectedRoutePolicy,
} from '@/platform/routing';

/*
 * Canonical authenticated application boundary.
 *
 * This policy remains distinct from a concrete business
 * route policy. It establishes the minimum verified
 * Tenant-context boundary inherited by the current root
 * application destination.
 */
export const protectedApplicationPolicy =
    defineProtectedRoutePolicy({
        routeId:
            'app.protected-root',

        contextRequirement:
            'tenant',

        authorizationScope:
            'tenant',

        requiredPermissions:
            null,
    });

/*
 * Keys are stable React Router route identities.
 *
 * Values are the canonical effective access policies for
 * those registered application destinations.
 *
 * Navigation consumers may resolve policy through this
 * adapter but must never duplicate policy metadata.
 */
const applicationRouteAccessPolicies =
    Object.freeze({
        root:
            protectedApplicationPolicy,
    }) satisfies Readonly<
        Record<
            string,
            ProtectedRoutePolicy
        >
    >;

export function resolveApplicationRouteAccessPolicy(
    routeId:
        string,
): ProtectedRoutePolicy | null {
    if (
        ! Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            applicationRouteAccessPolicies,
            routeId,
        )
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    return applicationRouteAccessPolicies[
        routeId as keyof typeof applicationRouteAccessPolicies
    ];
}
```

---

### 2. Ganti `frontend/src/app/routing/ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary.tsx`

```tsx
import {
    Outlet,
} from 'react-router';

import {
    protectedApplicationPolicy,
} from '@/app/routing/application-route-access';
import {
    ProtectedRouteBoundary,
} from '@/app/routing/ProtectedRouteBoundary';

/*
 * Application-level protected shell boundary.
 *
 * Policy metadata is owned by the canonical application
 * route-access registry so routing and later navigation
 * projection cannot drift into separate authorization
 * vocabularies.
 */
export function ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary() {
    return (
        <ProtectedRouteBoundary
            policy={
                protectedApplicationPolicy
            }
        >
            <Outlet />
        </ProtectedRouteBoundary>
    );
}
```

Perhatikan bahwa file ini tidak lagi memanggil:

```ts
defineProtectedRoutePolicy(...)
```

sendiri.

---

### 3. Buat `frontend/src/app/routing/__tests__/application-route-access.test.ts`

```ts
import {
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
} from 'vitest';

import {
    protectedApplicationPolicy,
    resolveApplicationRouteAccessPolicy,
} from '@/app/routing/application-route-access';
import {
    applicationNavigationCatalog,
} from '@/platform/navigation';

describe(
    'Application route access registry',
    () => {
        it('owns the canonical protected application policy exactly once', () => {
            expect(
                protectedApplicationPolicy,
            ).toEqual({
                routeId:
                    'app.protected-root',

                contextRequirement:
                    'tenant',

                authorizationScope:
                    'tenant',

                requiredPermissions:
                    null,
            });
        });

        it('resolves the registered root route to the canonical protected application policy', () => {
            expect(
                resolveApplicationRouteAccessPolicy(
                    'root',
                ),
            ).toBe(
                protectedApplicationPolicy,
            );
        });

        it('fails closed for an unknown route identity', () => {
            expect(
                resolveApplicationRouteAccessPolicy(
                    'unknown.route',
                ),
            ).toBeNull();
        });

        it('covers every current canonical navigation destination with a route access policy', () => {
            for (
                const navigation
                of applicationNavigationCatalog
            ) {
                expect(
                    resolveApplicationRouteAccessPolicy(
                        navigation.routeId,
                    ),
                ).not.toBeNull();
            }
        });

        it('keeps navigation metadata independent from authorization policy metadata', () => {
            const rootNavigation =
                applicationNavigationCatalog[
                    0
                ];

            const rootPolicy =
                resolveApplicationRouteAccessPolicy(
                    rootNavigation.routeId,
                );

            expect(
                rootNavigation,
            ).toEqual({
                id:
                    'application.home',

                routeId:
                    'root',

                label:
                    'Beranda',

                destination:
                    '/',
            });

            expect(
                rootPolicy,
            ).toBe(
                protectedApplicationPolicy,
            );
        });
    },
);
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Kita tidak menyamakan dua route identity secara paksa

Saat ini memang ada:

```text
React Router ID:
root

ProtectedRoutePolicy ID:
app.protected-root
```

Policy tersebut sejak FEI-9 memang berfungsi sebagai **application-level protected boundary**, bukan sebagai nama presentation route. `Pasted text (3).txt`

Mengubahnya menjadi:

```text
routeId: root
```

hanya demi navigation justru mengaburkan semantics.

Registry memberi hubungan eksplisit:

```text
root
→ app.protected-root policy
```

---

### 2. Single Source of Truth

Sebelumnya policy dibuat di:

```text
ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary.tsx
```

Nanti navigation projection juga membutuhkan policy itu.

Tanpa refactor, kita berisiko mendapat:

```text
routing:
tenant + no permission

navigation:
tenant + some other rule
```

Sekarang:

```text
application-route-access.ts
               ↓
        same policy object
        ↙             ↘
 routing boundary     navigation projection
```

Ini mengikuti DRY sekaligus menjaga authorization correctness.

---

### 3. Navigation tetap tidak memiliki permission

`applicationNavigationCatalog` masih hanya menyimpan:

```text
id
routeId
label
destination
```

Tidak ditambah:

```text
requiredPermissions
authorizationScope
contextRequirement
role
```

Jadi FEI-11C tetap intact.

---

### 4. Unknown route fail closed

Resolver:

```ts
resolveApplicationRouteAccessPolicy(
    'unknown.route',
)
```

menghasilkan:

```ts
null
```

Nanti FEI-11D projection tidak boleh menganggap route tanpa policy sebagai visible.

Ini lebih aman daripada:

```ts
policy ?? allowEverything
```

---

### 5. Registry berada di `app/routing`

Bukan di:

```text
platform/navigation
```

karena registry mengetahui **application-specific route topology**.

Layering tetap:

```text
platform/navigation
→ generic navigation definition

platform/routing
→ generic route policy/evaluator

app/routing
→ EduCore application route composition
```

Platform tidak mengimpor app layer.

## Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript mengeluh pada indexed access:

```ts
applicationRouteAccessPolicies[
    routeId as keyof ...
]
```

jangan gunakan `as any`.

Kirim error exact karena kita akan menjaga typed registry, bukan melemahkan contract.

Jika routing regression gagal, jangan restore inline policy. Pastikan `ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary` mengimpor **object yang sama** dari registry.

Jika navigation ownership grep menemukan lagi kalimat komentar `permission`, itu bukan blocker selama tidak ada property atau evaluator permission di production navigation model.

# FEI-11D.1A — Strict Navigation Fixture Narrowing

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita tidak akan:

```ts
applicationNavigationCatalog[0]!
```

atau:

```ts
as ApplicationNavigationDefinition
```

karena itu hanya memaksa compiler percaya tanpa runtime proof.

Sebaliknya, test akan mencari navigation berdasarkan stable identity:

```text
application.home
```

kemudian melakukan explicit existence guard.

Ini bahkan lebih tepat daripada mengandalkan posisi index `0`.

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Ubah hanya:

```text
frontend/src/app/routing/__tests__/application-route-access.test.ts
```

Tidak mengubah production:

```text
application-route-access.ts
ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary.tsx
platform/navigation/*
```

---

## Kode Lengkap

Pada test:

```text
keeps navigation metadata independent from authorization policy metadata
```

ganti implementasinya dengan:

```ts
it('keeps navigation metadata independent from authorization policy metadata', () => {
    const rootNavigation =
        applicationNavigationCatalog.find(
            (navigation) =>
                navigation.id
                    === 'application.home',
        );

    if (
        rootNavigation
            === undefined
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'Expected the canonical application.home navigation definition.',
        );
    }

    const rootPolicy =
        resolveApplicationRouteAccessPolicy(
            rootNavigation.routeId,
        );

    expect(
        rootNavigation,
    ).toEqual({
        id:
            'application.home',

        routeId:
            'root',

        label:
            'Beranda',

        destination:
            '/',
    });

    expect(
        rootPolicy,
    ).toBe(
        protectedApplicationPolicy,
    );
});
```

Tidak perlu mengubah bagian test lainnya.

---

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### Kenapa bukan `[0]!`

Kode seperti:

```ts
const rootNavigation =
    applicationNavigationCatalog[0]!;
```

memang menghilangkan error TypeScript, tetapi:

```text
compiler proof   ❌
runtime proof    ❌
position coupling ✅ buruk
```

Test menjadi bergantung pada urutan catalog.

Dengan:

```ts
.find(
    navigation =>
        navigation.id === 'application.home',
)
```

kita menggunakan **stable navigation identity**, bukan array order.

Kemudian:

```ts
if (rootNavigation === undefined) {
    throw new Error(...);
}
```

memberikan:

```text
runtime invariant proof  ✅
TypeScript narrowing     ✅
no non-null assertion    ✅
no unsafe cast           ✅
```

### Ini juga lebih scalable

Nanti catalog mungkin menjadi:

```text
application.home
academic.students
dormitory.rooms
...
```

Test root tetap valid meskipun posisi `application.home` berubah.

Jadi perbaikannya sekaligus mengurangi positional coupling.

```text
diff --check                  clean
```

## Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript tetap menunjuk `rootNavigation` sebagai possibly undefined, pastikan guard berada **sebelum** penggunaan:

```ts
if (rootNavigation === undefined) {
    throw new Error(...);
}
```

Jangan menggantinya dengan hanya:

```ts
expect(rootNavigation).toBeDefined();
```

karena assertion Vitest tersebut tidak selalu memberi control-flow narrowing yang dibutuhkan TypeScript.

Jangan gunakan:

```ts
rootNavigation!
```

atau `as any`.

# FEI-11D.2 — Pure Authorization & Workspace-Aware Navigation Projection

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Sekarang kita membutuhkan fungsi murni yang menjawab:

> Berdasarkan navigation catalog + route policy canonical + snapshot Auth/Membership/Workspace/Capability saat ini, entry mana yang boleh diproyeksikan sebagai visible?

Arsitekturnya:

```text
applicationNavigationCatalog
        │
        │ routeId
        ▼
application-route-access registry
        │
        │ canonical ProtectedRoutePolicy
        ▼
evaluateProtectedRouteAccess()
        │
        ├── allowed
        │      ↓
        │    visible
        │
        └── selain allowed
               ↓
             hidden
```

Yang sangat penting:

```text
Navigation projection
≠
authorization authority
```

Ia hanya **menggunakan evaluator yang sama dengan protected routing**.

Jadi:

```text
Route security tetap di ProtectedRouteBoundary
Navigation hanya presentation projection
```

Tidak ada auto workspace switch.

Tidak ada network request.

Tidak ada runtime lifecycle command.

---

Buat:

```text
frontend/src/app/navigation/navigation-projection.ts

frontend/src/app/navigation/__tests__/
    navigation-projection.test.ts
```

Tidak perlu mengubah:

```text
frontend/src/app/router.tsx
frontend/src/app/shell/*
frontend/src/platform/navigation/*
frontend/src/platform/routing/*
```

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Buat `frontend/src/app/navigation/navigation-projection.ts`

```ts
import type {
    BrowserAuthState,
} from '@/platform/auth';
import type {
    CapabilityState,
} from '@/platform/authorization';
import {
    applicationNavigationCatalog,
    type ApplicationNavigationDefinition,
} from '@/platform/navigation';
import type {
    MembershipContextState,
} from '@/platform/membership';
import {
    evaluateProtectedRouteAccess,
    type ProtectedRouteAccessDecision,
    type ProtectedRoutePolicy,
} from '@/platform/routing';
import type {
    WorkspaceContextState,
} from '@/platform/workspace';

import {
    resolveApplicationRouteAccessPolicy,
} from '@/app/routing/application-route-access';

export type HiddenApplicationNavigationReason =
    | 'route-policy-missing'
    | 'authority-pending'
    | 'unauthenticated'
    | 'membership-required'
    | 'membership-empty'
    | 'authority-unavailable'
    | 'context-required'
    | 'permission-denied';

export interface VisibleApplicationNavigationProjection {
    readonly status:
        'visible';

    readonly navigation:
        ApplicationNavigationDefinition;
}

export interface HiddenApplicationNavigationProjection {
    readonly status:
        'hidden';

    readonly navigation:
        ApplicationNavigationDefinition;

    readonly reason:
        HiddenApplicationNavigationReason;
}

export type ApplicationNavigationProjection =
    | VisibleApplicationNavigationProjection
    | HiddenApplicationNavigationProjection;

export type ApplicationRouteAccessPolicyResolver =
    (
        routeId:
            string,
    ) => ProtectedRoutePolicy | null;

export interface NavigationAuthoritySnapshot {
    readonly authentication:
        BrowserAuthState;

    readonly membership:
        MembershipContextState;

    readonly workspace:
        WorkspaceContextState;

    readonly capability:
        CapabilityState;
}

export interface NavigationProjectionInput
    extends NavigationAuthoritySnapshot {
    readonly definitions:
        readonly ApplicationNavigationDefinition[];

    readonly resolvePolicy:
        ApplicationRouteAccessPolicyResolver;
}

function hiddenReasonFromDecision(
    decision:
        Exclude<
            ProtectedRouteAccessDecision,
            {
                readonly status:
                    'allowed';
            }
        >,
): HiddenApplicationNavigationReason {
    switch (
        decision.status
    ) {
        case 'pending':
            return 'authority-pending';

        case 'unauthenticated':
            return 'unauthenticated';

        case 'membership-required':
            return 'membership-required';

        case 'membership-empty':
            return 'membership-empty';

        case 'unavailable':
            return 'authority-unavailable';

        case 'context-required':
            return 'context-required';

        case 'denied':
            return 'permission-denied';
    }
}

export function projectNavigationDefinitions(
    input:
        NavigationProjectionInput,
): readonly ApplicationNavigationProjection[] {
    const {
        definitions,
        resolvePolicy,
        authentication,
        membership,
        workspace,
        capability,
    } = input;

    const projections =
        definitions.map(
            (
                navigation,
            ): ApplicationNavigationProjection => {
                const policy =
                    resolvePolicy(
                        navigation.routeId,
                    );

                /*
                 * A navigation destination without a canonical
                 * application access policy must fail closed.
                 */
                if (
                    policy === null
                ) {
                    return Object.freeze({
                        status:
                            'hidden',

                        navigation,

                        reason:
                            'route-policy-missing',
                    });
                }

                /*
                 * Reuse the exact same pure route evaluator
                 * used by the protected routing boundary.
                 *
                 * Navigation must never manufacture a second
                 * authorization decision model.
                 */
                const decision =
                    evaluateProtectedRouteAccess({
                        policy,
                        authentication,
                        membership,
                        workspace,
                        capability,
                    });

                if (
                    decision.status
                        === 'allowed'
                ) {
                    return Object.freeze({
                        status:
                            'visible',

                        navigation,
                    });
                }

                return Object.freeze({
                    status:
                        'hidden',

                    navigation,

                    reason:
                        hiddenReasonFromDecision(
                            decision,
                        ),
                });
            },
        );

    return Object.freeze(
        projections,
    );
}

export function projectApplicationNavigation(
    authority:
        NavigationAuthoritySnapshot,
): readonly ApplicationNavigationProjection[] {
    return projectNavigationDefinitions({
        definitions:
            applicationNavigationCatalog,

        resolvePolicy:
            resolveApplicationRouteAccessPolicy,

        authentication:
            authority.authentication,

        membership:
            authority.membership,

        workspace:
            authority.workspace,

        capability:
            authority.capability,
    });
}
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Menggunakan evaluator route yang sama

Ini inti FEI-11D.2:

```ts
evaluateProtectedRouteAccess({
    policy,
    authentication,
    membership,
    workspace,
    capability,
});
```

Kita **tidak** membuat evaluator baru seperti:

```ts
permissions.includes(...)
```

di navigation.

Dengan demikian:

```text
Protected routing
        │
        └── evaluateProtectedRouteAccess()

Navigation projection
        │
        └── evaluateProtectedRouteAccess()
```

Satu semantics.

---

## 2. Permission denial baru terjadi setelah authority READY

Misalnya:

```text
Capability unresolved
```

hasilnya bukan:

```text
permission-denied
```

tetapi:

```text
authority-pending
```

Ini mengikuti semantics FEI-8/9:

```text
unknown authority ≠ denied authority
```

Kita tidak boleh menyimpulkan user tidak punya permission hanya karena projection belum tersedia.

---

## 3. Workspace mismatch bukan permission denial

Untuk:

```text
route requires organizational
current Workspace = TENANT
```

hasilnya:

```text
context-required
```

bukan:

```text
permission-denied
```

Dengan begitu navigation tetap memahami perbedaan:

```text
tidak punya permission

vs

sedang berada pada context yang berbeda
```

Tetapi untuk presentation saat ini keduanya tetap:

```text
hidden
```

Tidak ada automatic Workspace switch.

---

## 4. Route tanpa canonical policy fail closed

Jika navigation mempunyai:

```text
routeId = x
```

tetapi registry tidak mengenal `x`:

```text
route-policy-missing
→ hidden
```

Ini penting untuk mencegah programmer menambah menu tanpa access contract.

---

## 5. Root tidak memerlukan capability secara palsu

Current root memiliki:

```text
requiredPermissions: null
```

Maka walaupun:

```text
capability.status = unresolved
```

route evaluator memang mengizinkannya setelah Auth/Membership/Workspace authority valid.

Navigation mengikuti semantics yang sama.

Kita tidak membuat aturan baru seperti:

```text
semua navigation wajib capability ready
```

karena itu akan lebih ketat daripada canonical route authority.

---

## 6. Pure function, bukan runtime

File projection tidak menggunakan:

```text
useEffect
fetch
bootstrap
switch
navigate
localStorage
sessionStorage
```

Input:

```text
snapshot
```

Output:

```text
immutable projection
```

Sehingga mudah diuji dan deterministic.

---

# Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript menolak:

```ts
readyMembershipState.context
```

karena union narrowing, jangan gunakan `as any`.

Ganti pada workspace fixture dengan explicit canonical context object yang sama seperti membership fixture.

Jika `ProtectedRouteAccessDecision` narrowing di `hiddenReasonFromDecision()` bermasalah, kirim error exact. Jangan tambahkan `default` yang silently mengubah unknown decision menjadi denied; kita ingin exhaustive checking.

Jika test organizational route gagal karena Capability unresolved, perhatikan bahwa `contextRequirement: organizational` diperiksa **sebelum** capability readiness. Expected tetap:

```text
context-required
```

Jika grep menemukan `permission` sebagai type/reason string seperti:

```text
permission-denied
```

itu bukan direct permission evaluation. Yang kita larang adalah navigation membaca `permissions[]` sendiri.

# FEI-11D.3 — React Navigation Projection Adapter

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Pure projection pada D.2 sudah menerima snapshot seperti:

```text id="projection-input"
authentication
membership
workspace
capability
```

Sekarang React membutuhkan adapter yang membaca keempat snapshot dari Provider yang sudah ada lalu menjalankan pure projection.

Target:

```text id="react-nav-flow"
BrowserAuthProvider
        │
MembershipContextProvider
        │
WorkspaceContextProvider
        │
CapabilityContextProvider
        │
        ▼
useApplicationNavigationProjection()
        │
        ▼
projectApplicationNavigation()
        │
        ▼
immutable presentation projection
```

Hook ini **tidak boleh**:

```text id="forbidden-d3"
bootstrap
discover
switch membership
switch workspace
refresh capability
fetch
navigate
modify route state
```

Ia hanya menjadi React adapter.

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Buat:

```text id="d3-files"
frontend/src/app/navigation/
├── useApplicationNavigationProjection.ts
└── __tests__/
    └── useApplicationNavigationProjection.test.tsx
```

Tidak perlu mengubah shell pada langkah ini.

Tidak perlu mengubah:

```text id="d3-no-change"
frontend/src/platform/*
frontend/src/app/router.tsx
frontend/src/app/routing/*
frontend/src/app/shell/*
```

---

## Kode Lengkap

### 1. Buat `frontend/src/app/navigation/useApplicationNavigationProjection.ts`

```ts id="use-nav-projection"
import {
    useMemo,
} from 'react';

import {
    useBrowserAuthState,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import {
    useCapabilityState,
} from '@/app/authorization/CapabilityContextProvider';
import {
    useMembershipContextState,
} from '@/app/membership/MembershipContextProvider';
import {
    projectApplicationNavigation,
    type ApplicationNavigationProjection,
} from '@/app/navigation/navigation-projection';
import {
    useWorkspaceContextState,
} from '@/app/workspace/WorkspaceContextProvider';

export function useApplicationNavigationProjection():
    readonly ApplicationNavigationProjection[] {
    const authentication =
        useBrowserAuthState();

    const membership =
        useMembershipContextState();

    const workspace =
        useWorkspaceContextState();

    const capability =
        useCapabilityState();

    /*
     * Runtime Providers own all lifecycle orchestration.
     *
     * This hook only adapts already-published canonical
     * snapshots into the pure navigation projection.
     *
     * It must never bootstrap, refresh, discover, switch
     * context, or otherwise manufacture authority.
     */
    return useMemo(
        () =>
            projectApplicationNavigation({
                authentication,
                membership,
                workspace,
                capability,
            }),
        [
            authentication,
            membership,
            workspace,
            capability,
        ],
    );
}
```

---

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. Adapter hanya membaca state

Hook hanya memanggil:

```text id="hook-reads"
useBrowserAuthState()
useMembershipContextState()
useWorkspaceContextState()
useCapabilityState()
```

Tidak mengambil runtime object.

Itu sengaja.

Kalau kita mengimpor:

```text id="bad-hooks"
useBrowserAuthRuntime()
useWorkspaceRuntime()
```

maka hook navigation memperoleh akses ke command mutation yang sebenarnya tidak dibutuhkan.

Prinsipnya:

```text id="cqrs-nav"
navigation consumer
→ read model only
```

---

### 2. Pure projection tetap pusat logic

Hook tidak mempunyai:

```ts id="bad-react-auth"
if (capability.permissions.includes(...))
```

atau:

```ts id="bad-react-workspace"
if (workspace.current.type === ...)
```

Semua rule tetap ada di:

```text id="pure-center"
projectApplicationNavigation()
        ↓
evaluateProtectedRouteAccess()
```

Jadi React adapter sangat tipis.

---

### 3. `useMemo` bukan authority cache

`useMemo` hanya menghindari projection ulang jika keempat canonical snapshot references tidak berubah.

Ia bukan persistent cache.

Ia tidak menyimpan state sendiri dengan:

```text id="no-state"
useState
useReducer
sessionStorage
```

Kalau Provider mempublikasikan snapshot baru:

```text id="snapshot-update"
authentication
membership
workspace
capability
```

hook langsung memproyeksikan ulang.

---

### 4. Tidak ada loading UI di adapter

Hook mengembalikan:

```text id="projection-states"
visible
hidden(reason)
```

Ia tidak memutuskan bagaimana pending/denied ditampilkan.

Presentation layer nanti yang memutuskan apakah hidden entry:

```text id="presentation-rule"
tidak dirender
```

atau mungkin suatu hari diberi disabled state.

Saat ini design kita adalah fail-closed visibility.

---

### 5. Test tidak memock pure projector

Perhatikan test memock Provider hooks, **bukan**:

```text id="dont-mock"
projectApplicationNavigation
```

Dengan begitu test benar-benar membuktikan integration:

```text id="test-flow"
Provider snapshots
→ React adapter
→ pure projection
→ route evaluator
```

---

## Troubleshooting

Jika TypeScript mengeluh:

```text id="possible-undefined"
result.current[0] is possibly undefined
```

jangan gunakan `!`.

Ganti assertion tersebut dengan whole-array assertion atau lakukan explicit guard.

Contohnya:

```ts id="guard-item"
const firstItem =
    result.current[0];

if (
    firstItem
        === undefined
) {
    throw new Error(
        'Expected one navigation projection.',
    );
}
```

Lalu assert `firstItem`.

Jika provider regression test lama lambat, itu bukan alasan melewati gate; yang penting hasilnya PASS.

Jika grep `permissions` menemukan hanya nama type/comment di import chain, cek output-nya. Production hook tidak boleh membaca projection permissions sendiri.

# FEI-11E — Authenticated Navigation UI Integration

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Sekarang projection sudah menentukan apakah navigation entry `visible` atau `hidden`. FEI-11E hanya mengubah projection tersebut menjadi semantic navigation UI.

Target:

```text
AuthenticatedApplicationShell
├── Header
│   ├── EduCore
│   ├── Person / Tenant / Workspace
│   └── Logout
│
├── ApplicationNavigation
│   └── NavLink(s) dari visible projection saja
│
└── Outlet
```

Yang paling penting:

```text
ApplicationNavigation
        ↓
membaca hasil projection

BUKAN

ApplicationNavigation
        ↓
membaca permissions[]
```

UI **bukan security boundary**.

Walaupun menu disembunyikan, user yang memasukkan URL secara manual tetap harus melewati:

```text
ProtectedRouteBoundary
```

sebagai authority sebenarnya.

Saat ini production navigation catalog hanya memiliki:

```text
Beranda → /
```

Jadi kita hanya akan merender itu. Tidak membuat Academic/Dormitory/HR/Users palsu.
