# Kode Lengkap

## 1. Buat `frontend/src/app/navigation/ApplicationNavigation.tsx`

```tsx
import {
    NavLink,
} from 'react-router';

import {
    useApplicationNavigationProjection,
} from '@/app/navigation/useApplicationNavigationProjection';

export function ApplicationNavigation() {
    const projection =
        useApplicationNavigationProjection();

    const visibleItems =
        projection.filter(
            (item) =>
                item.status
                    === 'visible',
        );

    /*
     * Navigation is presentation only.
     *
     * A hidden item is not rendered, but protected routing
     * remains the actual security boundary for direct URL
     * navigation.
     */
    if (
        visibleItems.length
            === 0
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    return (
        <nav
            aria-label="Navigasi utama"
        >
            <ul className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                {visibleItems.map(
                    ({
                        navigation,
                    }) => (
                        <li
                            key={
                                navigation.id
                            }
                        >
                            <NavLink
                                end={
                                    navigation
                                        .destination
                                        === '/'
                                }
                                to={
                                    navigation
                                        .destination
                                }
                                className={({
                                    isActive,
                                }) =>
                                    [
                                        'inline-flex min-h-10 items-center rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors',
                                        isActive
                                            ? 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-50'
                                            : 'text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-slate-100',
                                    ].join(
                                        ' ',
                                    )
                                }
                            >
                                {
                                    navigation
                                        .label
                                }
                            </NavLink>
                        </li>
                    ),
                )}
            </ul>
        </nav>
    );
}
```

### Kenapa `end` untuk `/`

React Router secara default menganggap root `/` sebagai prefix banyak destination.

Kita ingin:

```text
/              → Beranda active
/academic/...  → Beranda tidak otomatis active
```

Maka root navigation menggunakan:

```tsx
end
```

Ini presentation/routing semantic, bukan authorization rule.

```tsx
import {
    render,
    screen,
} from '@testing-library/react';
import {
    createMemoryRouter,
} from 'react-router';
import {
    RouterProvider,
} from 'react-router/dom';
import {
    beforeEach,
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
    vi,
} from 'vitest';

import type {
    ApplicationNavigationProjection,
} from '@/app/navigation/navigation-projection';

const mocks =
    vi.hoisted<{
        projection:
            readonly ApplicationNavigationProjection[];
    }>(
        () => ({
            projection:
                [],
        }),
    );

vi.mock(
    '@/app/navigation/useApplicationNavigationProjection',
    () => ({
        useApplicationNavigationProjection:
            () =>
                mocks.projection,
    }),
);

import {
    ApplicationNavigation,
} from '@/app/navigation/ApplicationNavigation';

function renderNavigation(
    initialEntry:
        string = '/',
) {
    const router =
        createMemoryRouter(
            [
                {
                    path:
                        '*',

                    element: (
                        <ApplicationNavigation />
                    ),
                },
            ],
            {
                initialEntries: [
                    initialEntry,
                ],
            },
        );

    render(
        <RouterProvider
            router={router}
        />,
    );

    return router;
}

describe(
    'ApplicationNavigation',
    () => {
        beforeEach(
            () => {
                mocks.projection =
                    [];
            },
        );

        it('renders only navigation entries projected as visible', () => {
            mocks.projection = [
                {
                    status:
                        'visible',

                    navigation: {
                        id:
                            'application.home',

                        routeId:
                            'root',

                        label:
                            'Beranda',

                        destination:
                            '/',
                    },
                },
                {
                    status:
                        'hidden',

                    navigation: {
                        id:
                            'test.hidden',

                        routeId:
                            'test.hidden',

                        label:
                            'Hidden destination',

                        destination:
                            '/hidden',
                    },

                    reason:
                        'permission-denied',
                },
            ];

            renderNavigation();

            expect(
                screen.getByRole(
                    'navigation',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Navigasi utama',
                    },
                ),
            ).toBeInTheDocument();

            expect(
                screen.getByRole(
                    'link',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Beranda',
                    },
                ),
            ).toHaveAttribute(
                'href',
                '/',
            );

            expect(
                screen.queryByRole(
                    'link',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Hidden destination',
                    },
                ),
            ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
        });

        it('marks the exact current root destination as active', () => {
            mocks.projection = [
                {
                    status:
                        'visible',

                    navigation: {
                        id:
                            'application.home',

                        routeId:
                            'root',

                        label:
                            'Beranda',

                        destination:
                            '/',
                    },
                },
            ];

            renderNavigation(
                '/',
            );

            expect(
                screen.getByRole(
                    'link',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Beranda',
                    },
                ),
            ).toHaveAttribute(
                'aria-current',
                'page',
            );
        });

        it('does not keep the root entry active for another application location', () => {
            mocks.projection = [
                {
                    status:
                        'visible',

                    navigation: {
                        id:
                            'application.home',

                        routeId:
                            'root',

                        label:
                            'Beranda',

                        destination:
                            '/',
                    },
                },
            ];

            renderNavigation(
                '/future-route',
            );

            expect(
                screen.getByRole(
                    'link',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Beranda',
                    },
                ),
            ).not.toHaveAttribute(
                'aria-current',
                'page',
            );
        });

        it('does not render an empty navigation landmark when no entry is visible', () => {
            mocks.projection = [
                {
                    status:
                        'hidden',

                    navigation: {
                        id:
                            'application.home',

                        routeId:
                            'root',

                        label:
                            'Beranda',

                        destination:
                            '/',
                    },

                    reason:
                        'authority-pending',
                },
            ];

            renderNavigation();

            expect(
                screen.queryByRole(
                    'navigation',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Navigasi utama',
                    },
                ),
            ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
        });
    },
);
```

Test menggunakan fake hidden destination hanya sebagai fixture presentation. Itu **tidak masuk production navigation catalog**.

## 3. Update `frontend/src/app/shell/AuthenticatedApplicationShell.tsx`

Ganti dengan:

```tsx
import {
    Outlet,
} from 'react-router';

import {
    useBrowserAuthState,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import {
    LogoutButton,
} from '@/app/auth/LogoutButton';
import {
    ApplicationNavigation,
} from '@/app/navigation/ApplicationNavigation';
import {
    useWorkspaceContextState,
} from '@/app/workspace/WorkspaceContextProvider';

export function AuthenticatedApplicationShell() {
    const authentication =
        useBrowserAuthState();

    const workspace =
        useWorkspaceContextState();

    /*
     * The shell lives below the canonical protected
     * application boundary.
     *
     * It must still fail closed if React ever observes an
     * intermediate cross-provider snapshot before the
     * parent boundary rerenders.
     *
     * The shell does not manufacture authentication or
     * Workspace authority and does not start lifecycle work.
     */
    if (
        authentication.status
            !== 'authenticated'
        || workspace.status
            !== 'ready'
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    const {
        person,
        user,
        tenant,
    } =
        authentication.identity;

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100">
            <header className="border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950">
                <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-7xl items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400">
                            EduCore
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-1 truncate text-sm text-slate-300">
                            {tenant.name}
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-4">
                        <div
                            className="hidden min-w-0 text-right sm:block"
                            aria-label="Konteks pengguna aktif"
                        >
                            <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-slate-100">
                                {person.name}
                            </p>

                            <p className="truncate text-xs text-slate-400">
                                {user.email}
                            </p>

                            <p className="truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                                Workspace: {workspace.current.label}
                            </p>
                        </div>

                        <LogoutButton />
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="border-t border-slate-900">
                    <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 py-2 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
                        <ApplicationNavigation />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </header>

            <main
                className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 lg:px-8"
                id="main-content"
            >
                <Outlet />
            </main>
        </div>
    );
}
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### 1. UI hanya memahami `visible` / `hidden`

ApplicationNavigation tidak mengetahui alasan authorization secara detail selain membaca projection status untuk presentation:

```text
visible → render
hidden  → don't render
```

Ia tidak mempunyai kode seperti:

```tsx
if (
    permissions.includes(
        'academic.students.view',
    )
)
```

Itu penting agar UI tidak menjadi authorization implementation kedua.

---

### 2. Direct URL tetap aman

Misalnya suatu hari:

```text
/dormitory/rooms
```

disembunyikan dari navigation.

User tetap bisa mencoba mengetik URL.

Flow-nya:

```text
direct URL
    ↓
React Router
    ↓
ProtectedRouteBoundary
    ↓
evaluateProtectedRouteAccess()
    ↓
allowed / denied
```

Bukan:

```text
menu hidden
→ dianggap security
```

Hiding navigation hanyalah UX.

---

### 3. `NavLink`, bukan `<a>`

Kita menggunakan:

```tsx
<NavLink />
```

bukan:

```tsx
<a href="/">
```

untuk production.

Keuntungannya:

```text
SPA navigation
no full-page reload
active-state semantics
aria-current otomatis
```

---

### 4. Root memakai exact active matching

Ini subtle tetapi penting.

Tanpa:

```tsx
end
```

link `/` berpotensi dianggap aktif saat berada di:

```text
/academic/students
/dormitory/rooms
```

Karena root adalah prefix semua path.

Dengan:

```tsx
end={destination === '/'}
```

`Beranda` hanya aktif tepat di `/`.

---

### 5. Tidak membuat empty navigation landmark

Jika projection semuanya hidden:

```tsx
return null;
```

Lebih baik daripada merender:

```html
<nav aria-label="Navigasi utama">
    <ul></ul>
</nav>
```

yang tidak memberi nilai bagi accessibility tree.

---

### 6. Shell tetap SRP

Sekarang responsibilities-nya:

```text
AuthenticatedApplicationShell
→ global authenticated layout

ApplicationNavigation
→ navigation presentation

useApplicationNavigationProjection
→ React state adapter

projectApplicationNavigation
→ pure projection

evaluateProtectedRouteAccess
→ canonical authority decision
```

Ini separation yang sangat baik untuk nanti menambah puluhan modul tanpa membuat shell menjadi giant component.

# Troubleshooting

Jika `NavLink` test tidak menghasilkan:

```text
aria-current="page"
```

pastikan `ApplicationNavigation` dirender di dalam `RouterProvider`, bukan langsung dengan Testing Library.

Jika root tetap active pada `/future-route`, periksa bahwa:

```tsx
end={
    navigation.destination
        === '/'
}
```

benar-benar ada.

Jika shell test error karena actual `ApplicationNavigation` mencoba membaca Membership/Capability Provider mock yang tidak tersedia, berarti mock:

```tsx
vi.mock(
    '@/app/navigation/ApplicationNavigation',
    ...
)
```

belum ditempatkan sebelum import shell.

Jangan menambahkan Provider fixture tambahan ke shell test; shell unit test sebaiknya tidak menguji seluruh navigation authority stack.

Jika grep authorization menemukan kata hanya dalam komentar, itu bukan blocker. Yang dilarang adalah direct policy/evaluation logic.

# FEI-11E.1 — Cross-Platform Filename Case Hygiene

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita samakan nama test dengan component:

```text
ApplicationNavigation.tsx
ApplicationNavigation.test.tsx
```

Bukan:

```text
ApplicationNavigation.tsx
applicationNavigation.test.tsx
```

Tujuannya bukan sekadar kosmetik. Repository akan berjalan pada environment yang mungkin case-sensitive:

```text
Windows development
        ↓
Linux CI / container / production
```

Perbedaan casing yang lolos di Windows kadang gagal pada Linux.

---

## Struktur Folder & File

Target final:

```text
frontend/src/app/navigation/
├── ApplicationNavigation.tsx
├── navigation-projection.ts
├── useApplicationNavigationProjection.ts
└── __tests__/
    ├── ApplicationNavigation.test.tsx
    ├── navigation-projection.test.ts
    └── useApplicationNavigationProjection.test.tsx
```

Tidak ada perubahan isi source.

---

## Kode Lengkap

Pertama audit nama aktual:

```bash
echo "=== FEI-11E.1 1. ACTUAL NAVIGATION FILENAMES ==="

find frontend/src/app/navigation \
  -maxdepth 2 \
  -type f \
  -print \
  | sort
```

Jika output memang menunjukkan:

```text
frontend/src/app/navigation/__tests__/applicationNavigation.test.tsx
```

jalankan case-safe rename berikut:

```bash
old="frontend/src/app/navigation/__tests__/applicationNavigation.test.tsx"
tmp="frontend/src/app/navigation/__tests__/ApplicationNavigation.test.tmp"
new="frontend/src/app/navigation/__tests__/ApplicationNavigation.test.tsx"

if [ ! -f "$old" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: expected source test file not found: $old"
  exit 1
fi

if [ -e "$tmp" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: temporary path already exists: $tmp"
  exit 1
fi

mv "$old" "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$new"

echo "Renamed:"
echo "  $old"
echo "→ $new"
```

Karena file tersebut masih untracked, kita **tidak perlu `git mv`**.

Kemudian jalankan gate:

## Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

### Mengapa rename dua tahap?

Di Windows, command:

```bash
mv applicationNavigation.test.tsx ApplicationNavigation.test.tsx
```

kadang tidak benar-benar menghasilkan perubahan casing karena filesystem memperlakukan keduanya sebagai nama yang sama.

Maka kita gunakan:

```text
applicationNavigation.test.tsx
        ↓
ApplicationNavigation.test.tmp
        ↓
ApplicationNavigation.test.tsx
```

Ini memastikan casing benar-benar berubah.

### Kenapa konsistensi ini penting?

Component menggunakan PascalCase:

```text
ApplicationNavigation.tsx
```

Maka test component juga sebaiknya:

```text
ApplicationNavigation.test.tsx
```

Sedangkan pure functions memang kita pertahankan kebab-case:

```text
navigation-projection.ts
navigation-projection.test.ts
```

Pattern-nya menjadi jelas:

```text
React Component     PascalCase.tsx
Component Test      PascalCase.test.tsx

Pure module         kebab-case.ts
Pure module test    kebab-case.test.ts
```

### Tidak ada functional change

Langkah ini tidak mengubah:

```text
authorization semantics
workspace semantics
routing topology
navigation projection
React rendering
```

Hanya memastikan repository portable lintas filesystem.

---

## Cara Menjalankan & Menguji (Testing)

Target akhirnya:

```text
ApplicationNavigation.test.tsx
4/4 PASS

typecheck
PASS

case duplicate scan
tepat 1 file:
ApplicationNavigation.test.tsx

diff --check
clean
```

Perhatikan scan `-iname` memang harus menghasilkan **satu file**, bukan kosong. Yang kita pastikan adalah hanya ada satu variant dan casing-nya tepat:

```text
frontend/src/app/navigation/__tests__/ApplicationNavigation.test.tsx
```

---

## Troubleshooting

Jika audit awal ternyata sudah menunjukkan:

```text
ApplicationNavigation.test.tsx
```

maka **jangan rename**. Langsung jalankan gate mulai bagian `2. FINAL FILENAMES`.

Jika kedua file muncul:

```text
ApplicationNavigation.test.tsx
applicationNavigation.test.tsx
```

jangan hapus salah satunya dulu. Kirim output karena kita perlu memastikan mana file canonical dan apakah isinya identik.

Jangan gunakan:

```bash
git add .
```

dan belum perlu staging apa pun.

# FEI-11F.1 — Responsive Shell & Navigation Layout Foundation

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Saat ini ada satu kekurangan UX penting pada shell:

```tsx
className="hidden ... sm:block"
```

pada konteks pengguna.

Akibatnya di viewport mobile informasi:

```text
Person
email
Workspace aktif
```

hilang dari UI.

Padahal Workspace adalah konteks penting bagi aplikasi multi-tenant. Informasi itu tidak boleh hilang hanya karena layar sempit.

Target layout:

```text
MOBILE
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ EduCore              Logout │
│ Tenant                      │
├─────────────────────────────┤
│ Person                      │
│ email                       │
│ Workspace: ...              │
├─────────────────────────────┤
│ ← horizontally scrollable → │
│ Beranda ...                 │
└─────────────────────────────┘
│ Page content                │

DESKTOP
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ EduCore / Tenant   Person + Workspace        Logout │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Beranda ...                                          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
│ Page content                                         │
```

Navigation juga kita siapkan untuk jumlah menu yang lebih banyak:

```text
mobile
→ horizontal scrolling
→ no uncontrolled wrapping

desktop
→ normal horizontal navigation
```

Tidak ada perubahan authorization, route, workspace lifecycle, atau catalog.

```text
frontend/src/app/navigation/
```

```text
frontend/src/app/navigation/useApplicationNavigationProjection.ts
```

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. `frontend/src/app/navigation/ApplicationNavigation.tsx`

Ganti isi file menjadi:

```tsx
import {
    NavLink,
} from 'react-router';

import {
    useApplicationNavigationProjection,
} from '@/app/navigation/useApplicationNavigationProjection';

export function ApplicationNavigation() {
    const projection =
        useApplicationNavigationProjection();

    const visibleItems =
        projection.filter(
            (item) =>
                item.status
                    === 'visible',
        );

    /*
     * Navigation is presentation only.
     *
     * Hidden navigation does not grant or revoke access.
     * Protected routing remains the security boundary for
     * direct navigation to registered application routes.
     */
    if (
        visibleItems.length
            === 0
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    return (
        <nav
            aria-label="Navigasi utama"
            className="min-w-max"
        >
            <ul className="flex min-w-max items-center gap-2">
                {visibleItems.map(
                    ({
                        navigation,
                    }) => (
                        <li
                            key={
                                navigation.id
                            }
                        >
                            <NavLink
                                end={
                                    navigation
                                        .destination
                                        === '/'
                                }
                                to={
                                    navigation
                                        .destination
                                }
                                className={({
                                    isActive,
                                }) =>
                                    [
                                        'inline-flex min-h-10 items-center rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors',
                                        'focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-slate-300 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-slate-950',
                                        isActive
                                            ? 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-50'
                                            : 'text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-slate-100',
                                    ].join(
                                        ' ',
                                    )
                                }
                            >
                                {
                                    navigation
                                        .label
                                }
                            </NavLink>
                        </li>
                    ),
                )}
            </ul>
        </nav>
    );
}
```

Perubahan penting:

```text
flex-wrap
↓
min-w-max
```

Navigation tidak pecah menjadi banyak baris ketika jumlah entry meningkat.

Kita juga menambahkan `focus-visible` state untuk keyboard navigation.

## 2. `frontend/src/app/shell/AuthenticatedApplicationShell.tsx`

Ganti isi file menjadi:

```tsx
import {
    Outlet,
} from 'react-router';

import {
    useBrowserAuthState,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import {
    LogoutButton,
} from '@/app/auth/LogoutButton';
import {
    ApplicationNavigation,
} from '@/app/navigation/ApplicationNavigation';
import {
    useWorkspaceContextState,
} from '@/app/workspace/WorkspaceContextProvider';

export function AuthenticatedApplicationShell() {
    const authentication =
        useBrowserAuthState();

    const workspace =
        useWorkspaceContextState();

    /*
     * The shell lives below the canonical protected
     * application boundary.
     *
     * It still fails closed if React observes an
     * intermediate cross-provider snapshot before the
     * parent protected boundary rerenders.
     *
     * The shell remains presentation-only and does not
     * manufacture authentication or Workspace authority.
     */
    if (
        authentication.status
            !== 'authenticated'
        || workspace.status
            !== 'ready'
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    const {
        person,
        user,
        tenant,
    } =
        authentication.identity;

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100">
            <header className="border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950">
                <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-7xl grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto] items-start gap-x-4 gap-y-3 px-4 py-4 sm:px-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)_auto] lg:items-center lg:px-8">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400">
                            EduCore
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-1 truncate text-sm text-slate-300">
                            {tenant.name}
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <div
                        className="col-span-2 min-w-0 border-t border-slate-900 pt-3 sm:flex sm:flex-wrap sm:items-end sm:justify-between sm:gap-x-6 sm:gap-y-1 lg:col-span-1 lg:border-t-0 lg:pt-0 lg:text-right"
                        aria-label="Konteks pengguna aktif"
                    >
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                            <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-slate-100">
                                {person.name}
                            </p>

                            <p className="truncate text-xs text-slate-400">
                                {user.email}
                            </p>
                        </div>

                        <p className="mt-1 truncate text-xs text-slate-500 sm:mt-0">
                            Workspace: {workspace.current.label}
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="col-start-2 row-start-1 lg:col-start-3 lg:row-start-auto">
                        <LogoutButton />
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="border-t border-slate-900">
                    <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl overflow-x-auto overscroll-x-contain px-4 py-2 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
                        <ApplicationNavigation />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </header>

            <main
                className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 lg:px-8"
                id="main-content"
            >
                <Outlet />
            </main>
        </div>
    );
}
```

### Perubahan utama

Sebelumnya:

```tsx
<div className="hidden ... sm:block">
```

Sekarang context selalu ada:

```tsx
<div
    className="
        col-span-2
        ...
        sm:flex
        ...
        lg:col-span-1
    "
>
```

Tidak ada duplicate mobile/desktop markup.

Jadi screen reader juga hanya menemukan:

```text
EduCore Member
member@example.test
Workspace: EduCore School
```

satu kali.

```tsx
import {
    render,
    screen,
} from '@testing-library/react';
import {
    createMemoryRouter,
} from 'react-router';
import {
    RouterProvider,
} from 'react-router/dom';
import {
    beforeEach,
    describe,
    expect,
    it,
    vi,
} from 'vitest';

import type {
    ApplicationNavigationProjection,
} from '@/app/navigation/navigation-projection';

const mocks =
    vi.hoisted<{
        projection:
            readonly ApplicationNavigationProjection[];
    }>(
        () => ({
            projection:
                [],
        }),
    );

vi.mock(
    '@/app/navigation/useApplicationNavigationProjection',
    () => ({
        useApplicationNavigationProjection:
            () =>
                mocks.projection,
    }),
);

import {
    ApplicationNavigation,
} from '@/app/navigation/ApplicationNavigation';

function renderNavigation(
    initialEntry:
        string = '/',
) {
    const router =
        createMemoryRouter(
            [
                {
                    path:
                        '*',

                    element: (
                        <ApplicationNavigation />
                    ),
                },
            ],
            {
                initialEntries: [
                    initialEntry,
                ],
            },
        );

    render(
        <RouterProvider
            router={router}
        />,
    );

    return router;
}

describe(
    'ApplicationNavigation',
    () => {
        beforeEach(
            () => {
                mocks.projection =
                    [];
            },
        );

        it('renders only navigation entries projected as visible', () => {
            mocks.projection = [
                {
                    status:
                        'visible',

                    navigation: {
                        id:
                            'application.home',

                        routeId:
                            'root',

                        label:
                            'Beranda',

                        destination:
                            '/',
                    },
                },
                {
                    status:
                        'hidden',

                    navigation: {
                        id:
                            'test.hidden',

                        routeId:
                            'test.hidden',

                        label:
                            'Hidden destination',

                        destination:
                            '/hidden',
                    },

                    reason:
                        'permission-denied',
                },
            ];

            renderNavigation();

            expect(
                screen.getByRole(
                    'navigation',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Navigasi utama',
                    },
                ),
            ).toBeInTheDocument();

            expect(
                screen.getByRole(
                    'link',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Beranda',
                    },
                ),
            ).toHaveAttribute(
                'href',
                '/',
            );

            expect(
                screen.queryByRole(
                    'link',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Hidden destination',
                    },
                ),
            ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
        });

        it('marks the exact current root destination as active', () => {
            mocks.projection = [
                {
                    status:
                        'visible',

                    navigation: {
                        id:
                            'application.home',

                        routeId:
                            'root',

                        label:
                            'Beranda',

                        destination:
                            '/',
                    },
                },
            ];

            renderNavigation(
                '/',
            );

            expect(
                screen.getByRole(
                    'link',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Beranda',
                    },
                ),
            ).toHaveAttribute(
                'aria-current',
                'page',
            );
        });

        it('does not keep the root entry active for another application location', () => {
            mocks.projection = [
                {
                    status:
                        'visible',

                    navigation: {
                        id:
                            'application.home',

                        routeId:
                            'root',

                        label:
                            'Beranda',

                        destination:
                            '/',
                    },
                },
            ];

            renderNavigation(
                '/future-route',
            );

            expect(
                screen.getByRole(
                    'link',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Beranda',
                    },
                ),
            ).not.toHaveAttribute(
                'aria-current',
                'page',
            );
        });

        it('does not render an empty navigation landmark when no entry is visible', () => {
            mocks.projection = [
                {
                    status:
                        'hidden',

                    navigation: {
                        id:
                            'application.home',

                        routeId:
                            'root',

                        label:
                            'Beranda',

                        destination:
                            '/',
                    },

                    reason:
                        'authority-pending',
                },
            ];

            renderNavigation();

            expect(
                screen.queryByRole(
                    'navigation',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Navigasi utama',
                    },
                ),
            ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
        });

        it('keeps visible navigation in a non-wrapping row suitable for horizontal overflow', () => {
            mocks.projection = [
                {
                    status:
                        'visible',

                    navigation: {
                        id:
                            'application.home',

                        routeId:
                            'root',

                        label:
                            'Beranda',

                        destination:
                            '/',
                    },
                },
            ];

            renderNavigation();

            expect(
                screen.getByRole(
                    'navigation',
                    {
                        name:
                            'Navigasi utama',
                    },
                ),
            ).toHaveClass(
                'min-w-max',
            );

            expect(
                screen.getByRole(
                    'list',
                ),
            ).toHaveClass(
                'flex',
                'min-w-max',
                'items-center',
                'gap-2',
            );
        });
    },
);
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Tidak ada duplicated responsive markup

Kita tidak melakukan:

```tsx
<div className="sm:hidden">
    mobile context
</div>

<div className="hidden sm:block">
    desktop context
</div>
```

Karena itu menghasilkan dua copy identity di DOM.

Sebaliknya satu struktur yang sama berubah layout melalui CSS:

```text
mobile
grid 2 columns
context row kedua

desktop
grid 3 columns
context di tengah
```

Lebih DRY dan lebih baik untuk accessibility.

---

## 2. Context tidak hilang di mobile

Sebelumnya:

```text
mobile
Person    ❌
Email     ❌
Workspace ❌
```

Sekarang:

```text
mobile
Person    ✅
Email     ✅
Workspace ✅
```

Ini penting karena Workspace adalah bagian dari user context, bukan decorative metadata.

---

## 3. Navigation scalable tanpa hamburger prematur

Kita belum perlu membuat drawer/hamburger/menu state.

Saat production baru mempunyai satu destination, membuat:

```text
menu button
drawer state
focus trap
escape handling
outside click
```

adalah complexity yang belum dibutuhkan.

Sebaliknya:

```text
horizontal scroll
```

merupakan baseline sederhana dan scalable.

KISS tetap terjaga.

---

## 4. Keyboard focus diperjelas

`NavLink` sekarang mempunyai:

```text
focus-visible:ring-2
```

sehingga keyboard user mendapatkan visual focus indicator yang jelas.

Kita tidak mengandalkan warna active/hover saja.

---

## 5. Responsive unit test tidak berpura-pura menjadi browser

Vitest/JSDOM tidak benar-benar mengevaluasi Tailwind media query viewport.

Maka FEI-11F.1 hanya membuktikan:

```text
responsive structural contract
CSS utility contract
no duplicate context
horizontal-overflow structure
```

Validasi nyata:

```text
mobile viewport
desktop viewport
actual scrolling/layout
```

akan dibuktikan di real-browser E2E pada FEI-11H.

Ini lebih jujur daripada membuat unit test seolah-olah memvalidasi layout browser.

---

## 6. Security boundaries tetap utuh

Tidak berubah:

```text
permissions[]
route policy
membership authority
workspace authority
capability authority
```

Shell masih fail-closed pada:

```text
authentication !== authenticated
workspace !== ready
```

Dan navigation tetap berasal dari canonical projection.

# Troubleshooting

Jika shell test gagal karena:

```text
Found multiple elements with the text: EduCore School
```

itu normal karena Tenant dan Workspace sama-sama bernama `EduCore School`.

Jangan gunakan:

```tsx
screen.getByText('EduCore School')
```

untuk assertion yang ambigu.

Gunakan yang sudah dibedakan:

```tsx
screen.getByText(
    'Workspace: EduCore School',
)
```

atau query berdasarkan context container.

Jika TypeScript mengeluh pada:

```ts
navigation.parentElement
```

jangan gunakan non-null assertion `!`. Explicit guard yang diberikan memang sengaja untuk strict safety.

Jika grep `hidden` menghasilkan sesuatu dari test atau komentar, fokus audit pada dua production files yang disebutkan oleh command.

# FEI-11F.2 — Skip Navigation & Main Content Semantics

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Shell sekarang sudah responsive, tetapi keyboard user masih harus melewati seluruh header dan navigation setiap kali membuka halaman.

Kita tambahkan semantic skip-link:

```text
first keyboard focus
       ↓
Lewati ke konten utama
       ↓
#main-content
```

Target:

```text
AuthenticatedApplicationShell
├── Skip link
│      ↓
│   #main-content
│
├── Header
│   ├── identity/context
│   ├── logout
│   └── navigation
│
└── <main id="main-content" tabIndex={-1}>
       <Outlet />
```

Tidak ada JavaScript focus manager pada langkah ini. Kita memakai native document semantics terlebih dahulu.

Validasi focus aktual di browser akan dilakukan pada real-browser E2E nanti.

---

# Struktur Folder & File

Ubah hanya:

```text
frontend/src/app/shell/
├── AuthenticatedApplicationShell.tsx
└── __tests__/
    └── AuthenticatedApplicationShell.test.tsx
```

Tidak mengubah:

```text
frontend/src/app/navigation/*
frontend/src/app/router.tsx
frontend/src/app/routing/*
frontend/src/platform/*
```

# Kode Lengkap

## 1. `frontend/src/app/shell/AuthenticatedApplicationShell.tsx`

Ganti isi file menjadi:

```tsx
import {
    Outlet,
} from 'react-router';

import {
    useBrowserAuthState,
} from '@/app/auth/BrowserAuthProvider';
import {
    LogoutButton,
} from '@/app/auth/LogoutButton';
import {
    ApplicationNavigation,
} from '@/app/navigation/ApplicationNavigation';
import {
    useWorkspaceContextState,
} from '@/app/workspace/WorkspaceContextProvider';

export function AuthenticatedApplicationShell() {
    const authentication =
        useBrowserAuthState();

    const workspace =
        useWorkspaceContextState();

    /*
     * The shell lives below the canonical protected
     * application boundary.
     *
     * It still fails closed if React observes an
     * intermediate cross-provider snapshot before the
     * parent protected boundary rerenders.
     *
     * The shell remains presentation-only and does not
     * manufacture authentication or Workspace authority.
     */
    if (
        authentication.status
            !== 'authenticated'
        || workspace.status
            !== 'ready'
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    const {
        person,
        user,
        tenant,
    } =
        authentication.identity;

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100">
            <a
                href="#main-content"
                className="sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:fixed focus:left-4 focus:top-4 focus:z-50 focus:rounded-md focus:bg-slate-100 focus:px-4 focus:py-2 focus:text-sm focus:font-medium focus:text-slate-950 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-400 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-slate-950"
            >
                Lewati ke konten utama
            </a>

            <header className="border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950">
                <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-7xl grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto] items-start gap-x-4 gap-y-3 px-4 py-4 sm:px-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1fr)_auto] lg:items-center lg:px-8">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400">
                            EduCore
                        </p>

                        <p className="mt-1 truncate text-sm text-slate-300">
                            {tenant.name}
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <div
                        className="col-span-2 min-w-0 border-t border-slate-900 pt-3 sm:flex sm:flex-wrap sm:items-end sm:justify-between sm:gap-x-6 sm:gap-y-1 lg:col-span-1 lg:border-t-0 lg:pt-0 lg:text-right"
                        aria-label="Konteks pengguna aktif"
                    >
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                            <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-slate-100">
                                {person.name}
                            </p>

                            <p className="truncate text-xs text-slate-400">
                                {user.email}
                            </p>
                        </div>

                        <p className="mt-1 truncate text-xs text-slate-500 sm:mt-0">
                            Workspace: {workspace.current.label}
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="col-start-2 row-start-1 lg:col-start-3 lg:row-start-auto">
                        <LogoutButton />
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="border-t border-slate-900">
                    <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl overflow-x-auto overscroll-x-contain px-4 py-2 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
                        <ApplicationNavigation />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </header>

            <main
                className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 lg:px-8"
                id="main-content"
                tabIndex={-1}
            >
                <Outlet />
            </main>
        </div>
    );
}
```

Perubahan production hanya dua contract:

```tsx
<a href="#main-content">
    Lewati ke konten utama
</a>
```

dan:

```tsx
<main
    id="main-content"
    tabIndex={-1}
>
```

## 2. Update shell unit test

Pertahankan fixture/mock FEI-11F.1 yang sudah ada.

Tambahkan dua test berikut ke `describe('AuthenticatedApplicationShell', ...)`:

```tsx
it('provides a keyboard skip link to the canonical main content landmark', () => {
    configureAuthoritativeContext();

    renderShell();

    expect(
        screen.getByRole(
            'link',
            {
                name:
                    'Lewati ke konten utama',
            },
        ),
    ).toHaveAttribute(
        'href',
        '#main-content',
    );

    const main =
        screen.getByRole(
            'main',
        );

    expect(
        main,
    ).toHaveAttribute(
        'id',
        'main-content',
    );

    expect(
        main,
    ).toHaveAttribute(
        'tabindex',
        '-1',
    );
});

it('keeps the skip link before authenticated header controls in document order', () => {
    configureAuthoritativeContext();

    renderShell();

    const skipLink =
        screen.getByRole(
            'link',
            {
                name:
                    'Lewati ke konten utama',
            },
        );

    const logout =
        screen.getByRole(
            'button',
            {
                name:
                    'Logout',
            },
        );

    expect(
        skipLink.compareDocumentPosition(
            logout,
        )
            & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING,
    ).not.toBe(
        0,
    );
});
```

```text
5 tests
↓
7 tests
```

Tidak perlu mengubah lima test sebelumnya.

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Skip link harus menjadi focusable control pertama

Kita menempatkannya sebelum:

```text
header
logout
navigation
```

sehingga keyboard traversal dimulai:

```text
Tab
↓
Lewati ke konten utama
```

bukan:

```text
Tab
↓
Logout
↓
Beranda
↓
...
```

Ini semakin penting saat navigation nanti memiliki banyak modul.

---

## 2. `sr-only` tetapi muncul saat fokus

Normal state:

```text
sr-only
```

Saat keyboard focus:

```text
focus:not-sr-only
focus:fixed
focus:z-50
```

Jadi link tidak mengganggu visual UI, tetapi jelas terlihat bagi keyboard user.

---

## 3. `tabIndex={-1}` bukan tab stop tambahan

Kita sengaja menggunakan:

```tsx
tabIndex={-1}
```

bukan:

```tsx
tabIndex={0}
```

`main` tidak perlu masuk normal tab sequence.

`-1` membuat landmark dapat menjadi programmatic/native focus destination tanpa menambahkan tab stop permanen.

---

## 4. Tidak menggunakan `onClick`

Jangan melakukan:

```tsx
onClick={() => {
    document
        .getElementById('main-content')
        ?.focus();
}}
```

pada foundation ini.

Native:

```html
<a href="#main-content">
```

lebih sederhana, progressive-enhancement friendly, dan tidak membutuhkan imperative DOM manipulation.

KISS.

---

## 5. Tidak ada navigation lifecycle ownership

Skip link tidak menggunakan:

```text
useNavigate
navigate()
location state
router mutation
```

Karena ini bukan application route transition.

Ia hanya fragment navigation di document yang sama.

---

## 6. Accessibility bukan authorization

Penambahan ini sama sekali tidak memengaruhi:

```text
BrowserAuth
Membership
Workspace
Capability
permissions[]
ProtectedRoutePolicy
```

Shell tetap fail-closed sebelum authoritative authenticated context tersedia.

---

## 7. Kenapa belum mengimplementasikan route-change focus manager?

Karena saat production kita masih hanya memiliki satu authenticated content destination:

```text
/
```

Membuat sekarang:

```text
useLocation
useEffect
main.focus()
```

berpotensi menyebabkan unexpected focus stealing tanpa cukup multi-route behavior untuk membuktikan semantics-nya.

Kita akan menguji native skip-link di browser terlebih dahulu dan menambahkan route-transition focus management hanya jika registered application routes memang membutuhkannya.

# Troubleshooting

Jika assertion:

```ts
compareDocumentPosition()
```

gagal karena `Node` tidak tersedia global di test environment, gunakan variant tanpa global constant:

```tsx
expect(
    skipLink.compareDocumentPosition(
        logout,
    ),
).toBeTruthy();
```

Namun JSDOM normalnya menyediakan `Node`.

Jika Testing Library tidak menemukan `main`, pastikan production markup tetap menggunakan semantic:

```tsx
<main>
```

dan bukan diganti `<div role="main">`.

Jika grep menemukan `focus:` pada Tailwind classes, itu **bukan** imperative focus. Yang menjadi blocker adalah `.focus()` atau DOM-manipulation code.

# FEI-11G.1 - Real Application Shell + Navigation Integration Contract

## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Unit test kita saat ini sudah membuktikan komponen secara terpisah:

```text
ApplicationNavigation
AuthenticatedApplicationShell
navigation projection
route policy registry
```

Yang belum dibuktikan dalam satu test adalah alur nyata:

```text
MSW canonical API responses
        ↓
ApplicationRuntime
        ↓
AppBootstrap
        ↓
Auth / Membership / Workspace / Capability Providers
        ↓
ProtectedApplicationLifecycleBoundary
        ↓
ProtectedApplicationAccessBoundary
        ↓
AuthenticatedApplicationShell
        ↓
ApplicationNavigation
        ↓
App / Outlet
```

FEI-11G.1 akan membuktikan dua sisi sekaligus:

```text
authenticated + authoritative
→ shell + navigation + page rendered

anonymous protected navigation
→ login
→ shell/navigation NOT rendered
```

Kita **tidak membuat test router palsu** dan **tidak memock shell/navigation/projection**.

Tidak mengubah:

```text
frontend/src/app/router.tsx
frontend/src/app/shell/*
frontend/src/app/navigation/*
frontend/src/app/routing/*
frontend/src/platform/*
```

## 2. Perkuat anonymous protected-route integration

Pada test:

```text
redirects an anonymous direct protected route to login without activating downstream context lifecycle
```

setelah assertion existing:

```tsx
expect(
    screen.queryByLabelText(
        'Konteks pengguna aktif',
    ),
).not.toBeInTheDocument();

expect(
    screen.queryByRole(
        'link',
        {
            name:
                'Lewati ke konten utama',
        },
    ),
).not.toBeInTheDocument();

expect(
    screen.queryByRole(
        'button',
        {
            name:
                'Keluar',
        },
    ),
).not.toBeInTheDocument();
```

### Catatan penting tentang Logout

Jika actual `LogoutButton` accessible name Anda bukan:

```text
Keluar
```

tetapi masih:

```text
Logout
```

gunakan nama aktual yang sudah dibuktikan oleh:

```text
frontend/src/app/auth/__tests__/LogoutButton.test.tsx
```

Jangan mengubah production button hanya untuk test ini.

Untuk mengaudit lebih dulu:

```bash
grep -nE \
  'Keluar|Logout' \
  frontend/src/app/auth/LogoutButton.tsx
```

Gunakan **tepat nama production yang ditemukan** pada assertion berikutnya.

# 3. Ganti test authenticated direct login dengan contract yang diperkuat

Cari test existing:

```tsx
it('redirects an authenticated direct login route into the verified protected application', async () => {
```

Ganti **seluruh test tersebut** dengan versi berikut.

Saya memakai `Keluar` sebagai contoh canonical accessible name di bawah; jika audit `LogoutButton.tsx` menunjukkan `Logout`, ganti dua occurrence `Keluar` menjadi `Logout`.

```tsx
it('redirects an authenticated direct login route into the verified protected shell and canonical navigation', async () => {
    window.history.replaceState(
        null,
        '',
        '/login',
    );

    let membershipRequestCount =
        0;

    let workspaceRequestCount =
        0;

    let capabilityRequestCount =
        0;

    apiMockServer.use(
        http.get(
            `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/auth/me`,
            () =>
                HttpResponse.json({
                    status:
                        'success',

                    data: {
                        user: {
                            id:
                                userId,

                            email:
                                'member@example.com',
                        },

                        person: {
                            id:
                                personId,

                            name:
                                'EduCore Member',
                        },

                        membership: {
                            id:
                                membershipId,

                            status:
                                'ACTIVE',
                        },

                        tenant: {
                            id:
                                tenantId,

                            name:
                                'EduCore School',

                            subdomain:
                                'school',
                        },
                    },
                }),
        ),

        http.get(
            `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/user/my-memberships`,
            () => {
                membershipRequestCount +=
                    1;

                return membershipResponse();
            },
        ),

        http.get(
            `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/user/my-workspaces`,
            () => {
                workspaceRequestCount +=
                    1;

                return workspaceResponse();
            },
        ),

        http.get(
            `${window.location.origin}/api/v1/core/authorization/capabilities`,
            () => {
                capabilityRequestCount +=
                    1;

                return capabilityResponse();
            },
        ),
    );

    const runtime =
        createApplicationRuntime();

    const rendered =
        render(
            <AppBootstrap
                runtime={runtime}
            />,
        );

    try {
        /*
         * LoginRouteBoundary must redirect the already
         * authenticated browser into the canonical
         * protected application.
         *
         * Waiting for the actual page heading also proves
         * that protected routing eventually reached the
         * application Outlet.
         */
        expect(
            await screen.findByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Frontend Foundation',
                },
            ),
        ).toBeInTheDocument();

        expect(
            runtime.router
                .state
                .location
                .pathname,
        ).toBe(
            '/',
        );

        expect(
            screen.queryByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Masuk ke EduCore',
                },
            ),
        ).not.toBeInTheDocument();

        await waitFor(() => {
            expect(
                runtime.auth
                    .getState()
                    .status,
            ).toBe(
                'authenticated',
            );
        });

        await waitFor(() => {
            expect(
                runtime.membership
                    .getState()
                    .status,
            ).toBe(
                'ready',
            );
        });

        await waitFor(() => {
            expect(
                runtime.workspace
                    .getState()
                    .status,
            ).toBe(
                'ready',
            );
        });

        await waitFor(() => {
            expect(
                runtime.capabilities
                    .getState()
                    .status,
            ).toBe(
                'ready',
            );
        });

        /*
         * These assertions use the real
         * AuthenticatedApplicationShell.
         *
         * They prove that authoritative canonical identity
         * and Workspace state are projected into the
         * authenticated presentation tree.
         */
        const activeContext =
            screen.getByLabelText(
                'Konteks pengguna aktif',
            );

        expect(
            within(
                activeContext,
            ).getByText(
                'EduCore Member',
            ),
        ).toBeInTheDocument();

        expect(
            within(
                activeContext,
            ).getByText(
                'member@example.com',
            ),
        ).toBeInTheDocument();

        expect(
            within(
                activeContext,
            ).getByText(
                'Workspace: EduCore School',
            ),
        ).toBeInTheDocument();

        /*
         * Navigation is not mocked here.
         *
         * The visible Beranda item therefore proves:
         *
         * Provider snapshots
         *   → React navigation adapter
         *   → pure navigation projection
         *   → canonical route policy registry
         *   → protected route evaluator
         *   → ApplicationNavigation
         */
        const navigation =
            screen.getByRole(
                'navigation',
                {
                    name:
                        'Navigasi utama',
                },
            );

        const homeLink =
            within(
                navigation,
            ).getByRole(
                'link',
                {
                    name:
                        'Beranda',
                },
            );

        expect(
            homeLink,
        ).toHaveAttribute(
            'href',
            '/',
        );

        expect(
            homeLink,
        ).toHaveAttribute(
            'aria-current',
            'page',
        );

        expect(
            within(
                navigation,
            ).getAllByRole(
                'link',
            ),
        ).toHaveLength(
            1,
        );

        /*
         * The shell owns one canonical main landmark and
         * the page must be rendered through its Outlet.
         */
        const main =
            screen.getByRole(
                'main',
            );

        expect(
            main,
        ).toHaveAttribute(
            'id',
            'main-content',
        );

        expect(
            main,
        ).toHaveAttribute(
            'tabindex',
            '-1',
        );

        expect(
            within(
                main,
            ).getByRole(
                'heading',
                {
                    name:
                        'Frontend Foundation',
                },
            ),
        ).toBeInTheDocument();

        /*
         * Skip navigation and logout are also real shell
         * controls, not test substitutes.
         */
        expect(
            screen.getByRole(
                'link',
                {
                    name:
                        'Lewati ke konten utama',
                },
            ),
        ).toHaveAttribute(
            'href',
            '#main-content',
        );

        expect(
            screen.getByRole(
                'button',
                {
                    name:
                        'Keluar',
                },
            ),
        ).toBeInTheDocument();

        /*
         * Existing transport/lifecycle contracts remain
         * unchanged by shell/navigation integration.
         */
        expect(
            membershipRequestCount,
        ).toBe(
            1,
        );

        expect(
            workspaceRequestCount,
        ).toBe(
            1,
        );

        /*
         * Workspace verification and active Capability
         * synchronization may currently each obtain a
         * TENANT capability projection.
         */
        expect(
            capabilityRequestCount,
        ).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
            1,
        );
    } finally {
        rendered.unmount();

        runtime.dispose();
    }
});
```

# Penjelasan Kode & Best Practices

## 1. Ini benar-benar integration test

Kita tidak memock:

```text
AuthenticatedApplicationShell
ApplicationNavigation
useApplicationNavigationProjection
projectApplicationNavigation
resolveApplicationRouteAccessPolicy
ProtectedRouteBoundary
```

Test menggunakan actual `AppBootstrap` dan actual runtime, pola yang memang sudah digunakan existing application integration suite. `Pasted text.txt`

Yang dimock hanyalah **network boundary via MSW**.

Itu layer yang tepat:

```text
fake canonical server
        ↓
real frontend application
```

---

## 2. Kita membuktikan positive dan negative composition

Authenticated:

```text
authenticated
membership ready
workspace ready
        ↓
protected authority allowed
        ↓
shell mounted
        ↓
navigation visible
        ↓
page rendered
```

Anonymous:

```text
anonymous
        ↓
protected route rejected
        ↓
/login
        ↓
shell absent
navigation absent
context absent
```

Ini jauh lebih kuat daripada hanya menguji:

```tsx
expect(
    screen.getByText(
        'Frontend Foundation',
    ),
)
```

---

## 3. Navigation visibility membuktikan seluruh canonical chain

Karena `ApplicationNavigation` actual digunakan, munculnya:

```text
Beranda
```

membuktikan secara integratif:

```text
applicationNavigationCatalog
→ routeId root
→ application route access registry
→ protectedApplicationPolicy
→ evaluateProtectedRouteAccess()
→ visible
→ NavLink
```

Tidak ada duplicate permission logic.

---

## 4. `within(navigation)` penting

Jangan melakukan:

```tsx
screen.getAllByRole('link')
```

karena shell sekarang juga mempunyai:

```text
Lewati ke konten utama
```

yang merupakan link.

Dengan:

```tsx
within(navigation).getAllByRole('link')
```

kita hanya menghitung application navigation item.

Expected saat ini:

```text
1
```

karena production catalog memang baru berisi `Beranda`.

---

## 5. Page harus berada di canonical `<main>`

Assertion:

```tsx
within(main).getByRole(
    'heading',
    {
        name:
            'Frontend Foundation',
    },
)
```

membuktikan bahwa `App` benar-benar dirender melalui:

```text
AuthenticatedApplicationShell
        ↓
<Outlet />
        ↓
App
```

bukan di luar shell.

---

## 6. Tidak menambah fake routes untuk testing

Kita tidak membuat:

```text
/academic
/dormitory
/hr
/users
```

untuk memaksa navigation test.

Current registered protected root cukup untuk membuktikan topology integration.

Permission-specific route behavior sudah dibuktikan pure evaluator/projection layer; business routes baru harus datang dari route contribution nyata kelak.

---

## Troubleshooting

Jika assertion Logout gagal, jangan mengganti production wording. Audit actual accessible name:

```bash
sed -n '1,220p' \
  frontend/src/app/auth/LogoutButton.tsx
```

lalu gunakan nama button aktual.

Jika:

```text
Found multiple elements with role main
```

itu adalah blocker karena authenticated route seharusnya hanya mempunyai canonical shell `<main>`. `App.tsx` sejak FEI-11B tidak boleh membuat `<main>` sendiri.

Jika `Beranda` tidak muncul tetapi page `Frontend Foundation` muncul, jangan melemahkan assertion. Itu berarti protected route boleh dirender tetapi navigation projection tidak sinkron dengan authority yang sama-tepat jenis drift yang FEI-11G harus menangkap.

Jika anonymous test menemukan navigation atau user context, itu juga blocker nyata: shell berarti mount sebelum protected access authority mengizinkannya.


## Tujuan Langkah & Konsep

Kita ingin membuktikan alur berikut dalam satu integration test:

```text
authenticated application
        ↓
real AuthenticatedApplicationShell
        ↓
real LogoutButton
        ↓ click "Keluar"
BrowserAuth:
authenticated
→ logging-out
→ anonymous
        ↓
Membership reset
        ↓
Workspace reset
        ↓
Capability reset
        ↓
ProtectedRouteBoundary
        ↓
/login?returnTo=/
        ↓
public LoginPage
```

Keamanan utama yang ingin dikunci:

```text
setelah logout berhasil:

shell lama               ❌
navigation lama          ❌
Person / Workspace lama  ❌
protected page           ❌

Auth authority           anonymous
Membership authority    unresolved
Workspace authority     unresolved
Capability authority    unresolved
```

`BrowserLogoutSuccess` canonical memang berupa:

```ts
{
    status: 'success',
    message: 'Logout completed successfully.',
}
```

jadi kita akan memakai contract itu persis pada MSW response, bukan response buatan lain. `Pasted text.txt`

Langkah ini **test-only**. Tidak ada production code yang perlu diubah.

Ubah hanya:

```text
frontend/src/app/__tests__/
└── direct-navigation-integration.test.tsx
```

Jangan ubah:

```text
frontend/src/app/auth/LogoutButton.tsx
frontend/src/app/router.tsx
frontend/src/app/routing/*
frontend/src/app/navigation/*
frontend/src/app/shell/*
frontend/src/platform/*
Modules/*
```
